entries.1: Α *A A al'-fah of Hebrew origin; the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first: --Alpha. Often used (usually ἄν A)/N án, before a vowel) also in composition (as a contraction from G427) in the sense of privation; so, in many words, beginning with this letter; occasionally in the sense of union (as a contraction of G260).
entries.2: Ἀαρών *)AARW/N Aarṓn ah-ar-ohn' of Hebrew origin (H0175); Aaron, the brother of Moses:--Aaron.
entries.3: Ἀβαδδών *)ABADDW/N Abaddṓn ab-ad-dohn' of Hebrew origin (H011); a destroying angel:--Abaddon.
entries.4: ἀβαρής A)BARH/S abarḗs ab-ar-ace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and G922; weightless, i.e. (figuratively) not burdensome:--from being burdensome.
entries.5: Ἀββᾶ *)ABBA= Abbâ ab-bah' of Chaldee origin (H02); father as a vocative:--Abba.
entries.6: Ἄβελ *)/ABEL Ábel ab'-el of Hebrew origin (H01893); Abel, the son of Adam:--Abel.
entries.7: Ἀβιά *)ABIA/ Abiá ab-ee-ah' of Hebrew origin (H029); Abijah, the name of two Israelites:--Abia.
entries.8: Ἀβιαθάρ *)ABIAQA/R Abiathár ab-ee-ath'-ar of Hebrew origin (H054); Abiathar, an Israelite:--Abiathar.
entries.9: Ἀβιληνή *)ABILHNH/ Abilēnḗ ab-ee-lay-nay' of foreign origin (compare H058); Abilene, a region of Syria:--Abilene.
entries.10: Ἀβιούδ *)ABIOU/D Abioúd ab-ee-ood' of Hebrew origin (H031); Abihud, an Israelite:--Abiud.
entries.11: Ἀβραάμ *)ABRAA/M Abraám ab-rah-am' of Hebrew origin (H085); Abraham, the Hebrew patriarch:--Abraham. (In Acts 7:16 the text should probably read Jacob.)
entries.12: ἄβυσσος A)/BUSSOS ábyssos ab'-us-sos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a variation of G1037; depthless, i.e. (specially) (infernal) "abyss":--deep, (bottomless) pit.
entries.13: Ἄγαβος *)/AGABOS Ágabos ag'-ab-os of Hebrew origin (compare H02285); Agabus, an Israelite:--Agabus.
entries.14: ἀγαθοεργέω A)GAQOERGE/W agathoergéō ag-ath-er-gheh'-o from G18 and G2041; to work good:--do good.
entries.15: ἀγαθοποιέω A)GAQOPOIE/W agathopoiéō ag-ath-op-oy-eh'-o from G17; to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty):--(when) do good (well).
entries.16: ἀγαθοποιΐα A)GAQOPOII/+A agathopoiḯa ag-ath-op-oy-ee'-ah from G17; well-doing, i.e. virtue:--well-doing.
entries.17: ἀγαθοποιός A)GAQOPOIO/S agathopoiós ag-ath-op-oy-os' from G18 and G4160; a well-doer, i.e. virtuous:--them that do well.
entries.18: ἀγαθός A)GAQO/S agathós ag-ath-os' a primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun):--benefit, good(-s, things), well. Compare G2570.
entries.19: ἀγαθωσύνη A)GAQWSU/NH agathōsýnē ag-ath-o-soo'-nay from G18; goodness, i.e. virtue or beneficence:--goodness.
entries.20: ἀγαλλίασις A)GALLI/ASIS agallíasis ag-al-lee'-as-is from G21; exultation; specially, welcome:--gladness, (exceeding) joy.
entries.21: ἀγαλλιάω A)GALLIA/W agalliáō ag-al-lee-ah'-o from ágan (much) and G242; properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult:--be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly).
entries.22: ἄγαμος A)/GAMOS ágamos ag'-am-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1062; unmarried:--unmarried.
entries.23: ἀγανακτέω A)GANAKTE/W aganaktéō ag-an-ak-teh'-o from ἄγαν A)/GAN ágan (much) and ἄχθος A)/XQOS áchthos (grief; akin to the base of G43); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant:--be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation.
entries.24: ἀγανάκτησις A)GANA/KTHSIS aganáktēsis ag-an-ak'-tay-sis from G23; indignation:--indignation.
entries.25: ἀγαπάω A)GAPA/W agapáō ag-ap-ah'-o perhaps from ἄγαν A)/GAN ágan (much) [or compare H5689]; to love (in a social or moral sense):--(be-)love(-ed). Compare G5368.
entries.26: ἀγάπη A)GA/PH agápē ag-ah'-pay from G25; love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast:--(feast of) charity(-ably), dear, love.
entries.27: ἀγαπητός A)GAPHTO/S agapētós ag-ap-ay-tos' from G25; beloved:--(dearly, well) beloved, dear.
entries.28: Ἄγαρ *)/AGAR Ágar ag'-ar of Hebrew origin (H01904); Hagar, the concubine of Abraham:--Hagar.
entries.29: ἀγγαρεύω A)GGAREU/W angareúō ang-ar-yew'-o of foreign origin (compare H0104); properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by implication) to press into public service:--compel (to go).
entries.30: ἀγγεῖον A)GGEI=ON angeîon ang-eye'-on from ἄγγος A)/GGOS ángos (a pail, perhaps as bent; compare the base of G43); a receptacle:--vessel.
entries.31: ἀγγελία A)GGELI/A angelía ang-el-ee'-ah from G32; an announcement, i.e. (by implication) precept:--message.
entries.32: ἄγγελος A)/GGELOS ángelos ang'-el-os from ἀγγέλλω A)GGE/LLW angéllō (probably derived from G71; compare G34) (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor:--angel, messenger.
entries.33: ἄγε A)/GE áge ag'-eh imperative of G71; properly, lead, i.e. come on:--go to.
entries.34: ἀγέλη A)GE/LH agélē ag-el'-ay from G71 (compare G32); a drove:--herd.
entries.35: ἀγενεαλόγητος A)GENEALO/GHTOS agenealógētos ag-en-eh-al-og'-ay-tos from G1 (as negative particle) and G1075; unregistered as to birth:--without descent.
entries.36: ἀγενής A)GENH/S agenḗs ag-en-ace' from G1 (as negative particle) and G1085; properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble:--base things.
entries.37: ἁγιάζω A(GIA/ZW hagiázō hag-ee-ad'-zo from G40; to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate:--hallow, be holy, sanctify.
entries.38: ἁγιασμός A(GIASMO/S hagiasmós hag-ee-as-mos' from G37; properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier:--holiness, sanctification.
entries.39: ἅγιον A(/GION hágion hag'-ee-on neuter of G40; a sacred thing (i.e. spot):--holiest (of all), holy place, sanctuary.
entries.40: ἅγιος A(/GIOS hágios hag'-ee-os from ἅγος A(/GOS hágos (an awful thing) (compare G53, G2282); sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated):--(most) holy (one, thing), saint.
entries.41: ἁγιότης A(GIO/THS hagiótēs hag-ee-ot'-ace from G40; sanctity (i.e. properly, the state):--holiness.
entries.42: ἁγιωσύνη A(GIWSU/NH hagiōsýnē hag-ee-o-soo'-nay from G40; sacredness (i.e. properly, the quality):--holiness.
entries.43: ἀγκάλη A)GKA/LH ankálē ang-kal'-ay from ἄγκος A)/GKOS ánkos (a bend, "ache"); an arm (as curved):--arm.
entries.44: ἄγκιστρον A)/GKISTRON ánkistron ang'-kis-tron from the same as G43; a hook (as bent):--hook.
entries.45: ἄγκυρα A)/GKURA ánkyra ang'-koo-rah from the same as G43; an "anchor" (as crooked):--anchor.
entries.46: ἄγναφος A)/GNAFOS ágnaphos ag'-naf-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and the same as G1102; properly, unfulled, i.e. (by implication) new (cloth):--new.
entries.47: ἁγνεία A(GNEI/A hagneía hag-ni'-ah from G53; cleanliness (the quality), i.e. (specially) chastity:--purity.
entries.48: ἁγνίζω A(GNI/ZW hagnízō hag-nid'-zo from G53; to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally):--purify (self).
entries.49: ἁγνισμός A(GNISMO/S hagnismós hag-nis-mos' from G48; a cleansing (the act), i.e. (ceremonially) lustration:--purification.
entries.50: ἀγνοέω A)GNOE/W agnoéō ag-no-eh'-o from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3539; not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination):--(be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand, unknown.
entries.51: ἀγνόημα A)GNO/HMA agnóēma ag-no'-ay-mah from G50; a thing ignored, i.e. shortcoming:--error.
entries.52: ἄγνοια A)/GNOIA ágnoia ag'-noy-ah from G50; ignorance (properly, the quality):--ignorance.
entries.53: ἁγνός A(GNO/S hagnós hag-nos' from the same as G40; properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect:--chaste, clean, pure.
entries.54: ἁγνότης A(GNO/THS hagnótēs hag-not'-ace from G53; cleanness (the state), i.e. (figuratively) blamelessness:--pureness.
entries.55: ἁγνῶς A(GNW=S hagnōs hag-noce' adverb from G53; purely, i.e. honestly:--sincerely.
entries.56: ἀγνωσία A)GNWSI/A agnōsía ag-no-see'-ah from G1 (as negative particle) and G1108; ignorance (properly, the state):--ignorance, not the knowledge.
entries.57: ἄγνωστος A)/GNWSTOS ágnōstos ag'-noce-tos' from G1 (as negative particle) and G1110; unknown:--unknown.
entries.58: ἀγορά A)GORA/ agorá ag-or-ah' from ἀγείρω A)GEI/RW ageírō (to gather; probably akin to G1453); properly, the town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or thoroughfare:--market(-place), street.
entries.59: ἀγοράζω A)GORA/ZW agorázō ag-or-ad'-zo from G58; properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem:--buy, redeem.
entries.60: ἀγοραῖος A)GORAI=OS agoraîos ag-or-ah'-yos from G58; relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by implication, vulgar:--baser sort, low.
entries.61: ἄγρα A)/GRA ágra ag'-rah from G71; (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish):--draught.
entries.62: ἀγράμματος A)GRA/MMATOS agrámmatos ag-ram-mat-os from G1 (as negative particle) and G1121; unlettered, i.e. illiterate:--unlearned.
entries.63: ἀγραυλέω A)GRAULE/W agrauléō ag-row-leh'-o from G68 and G832 (in the sense of G833); to camp out:--abide in the field.
entries.64: ἀγρεύω A)GREU/W agreúō ag-rew'-o from G61; to hunt, i.e. (figuratively) to entrap:--catch.
entries.65: ἀγριέλαιος A)GRIE/LAIOS agriélaios ag-ree-el'-ah-yos from G66 and G1636; an oleaster:--olive tree (which is) wild.
entries.66: ἄγριος A)/GRIOS ágrios ag'-ree-os from G68; wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce):--wild, raging.
entries.67: Ἀγρίππας *)AGRI/PPAS Agríppas ag-rip'-pas apparently from G66 and G2462; wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods:--Agrippa.
entries.68: ἀγρός A)GRO/S agrós ag-ros' from G71; a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet:--country, farm, piece of ground, land.
entries.69: ἀγρυπνέω A)GRUPNE/W agrypnéō ag-roop-neh'-o ultimately from G1 (as negative particle) and G5258; to be sleepless, i.e. keep awake:--watch.
entries.70: ἀγρυπνία A)GRUPNI/A agrypnía ag-roop-nee'-ah from G69; sleeplessness, i.e. a keeping awake:--watch.
entries.71: ἄγω A)/GW ágō ag'-o a primary verb; properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce:--be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open.
entries.72: ἀγωγή A)GWGH/ agōgḗ ag-o-gay' reduplicated from G71; a bringing up, i.e. mode of living:--manner of life.
entries.73: ἀγών A)GW/N agṓn ag-one' from G71; properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety:--conflict, contention, fight, race.
entries.74: ἀγωνία A)GWNI/A agōnía ag-o-nee'-ah from G73; a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish:--agony.
entries.75: ἀγωνίζομαι A)GWNI/ZOMAI agōnízomai ag-o-nid'-zom-ahee from G73; to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to accomplish something):--fight, labor fervently, strive.
entries.76: Ἀδάμ *)ADA/M Adám ad-am' of Hebrew origin (H0121); Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative):--Adam.
entries.77: ἀδάπανος A)DA/PANOS adápanos ad-ap'-an-os from G1 (as negative particle); and G1160; costless, i.e. gratuitous:--without expense.
entries.78: Ἀδδί *)ADDI/ Addí ad-dee' probably of Hebrew origin (compare H05716); Addi, an Israelite:--Addi.
entries.79: ἀδελφή A)DELFH/ adelphḗ ad-el-fay' feminine of G80; a sister (naturally or ecclesiastically):--sister.
entries.80: ἀδελφός A)DELFO/S adelphós ad-el-fos' from G1 (as a connective particle) and δελφύς DELFU/S delphýs (the womb); a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like G1):--brother.
entries.81: ἀδελφότης A)DELFO/THS adelphótēs ad-el-fot'-ace from G80; brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e. the (Christian) fraternity:--brethren, brotherhood.
entries.82: ἄδηλος A)/DHLOS ádēlos ad'-ay-los from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1212; hidden, figuratively, indistinct:--appear not, uncertain.
entries.83: ἀδηλότης A)DHLO/THS adēlótēs ad-ay-lot'-ace from G82; uncertainty:--X uncertain.
entries.84: ἀδήλως A)DH/LWS adḗlōs ad-ay'-loce adverb from G82; uncertainly:--uncertainly.
entries.85: ἀδημονέω A)DHMONE/W adēmonéō ad-ay-mon-eh'-o from a derivative of ἀδέω A)DE/W adéō (to be sated to loathing); to be in distress (of mind):--be full of heaviness, be very heavy.
entries.86: ᾅδης A(/|DHS háidēs hah'-dace from G1 (as negative particle) and G1492; properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls:--grave, hell.
entries.87: ἀδιάκριτος A)DIA/KRITOS adiákritos ad-ee-ak'-ree-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1252; properly, undistinguished, i.e. (actively) impartial:--without partiality.
entries.88: ἀδιάλειπτος A)DIA/LEIPTOS adiáleiptos ad-ee-al'-ipe-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G1223 and G3007; unintermitted, i.e. permanent:--without ceasing, continual.
entries.89: ἀδιαλείπτως A)DIALEI/PTWS adialeíptōs ad-ee-al-ipe'-toce adverb from G88; uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion):--without ceasing.
entries.90: ἀδιαφθορία A)DIAFQORI/A adiaphthoría ad-ee-af-thor-ee'-ah from a derivative of a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1311; incorruptibleness, i.e. (figuratively) purity (of doctrine):--uncorruptness.
entries.91: ἀδικέω A)DIKE/W adikéō ad-ee-keh'-o from G94; to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically):--hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong.
entries.92: ἀδίκημα A)DI/KHMA adíkēma ad-eek'-ay-mah from G91; a wrong done:--evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong.
entries.93: ἀδικία A)DIKI/A adikía ad-ee-kee'-ah from G94; (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act):--iniquity, unjust, unrighteousness, wrong.
entries.94: ἄδικος A)/DIKOS ádikos ad'-ee-kos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1349; unjust; by extension wicked; by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen:--unjust, unrighteous.
entries.95: ἀδίκως A)DI/KWS adíkōs ad-ee'-koce adverb from G94; unjustly:--wrongfully.
entries.96: ἀδόκιμος A)DO/KIMOS adókimos ad-ok'-ee-mos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1384; unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally):--castaway, rejected, reprobate.
entries.97: ἄδολος A)/DOLOS ádolos ad'-ol-os from G1 (as a negative particle); and G1388; undeceitful, i.e. (figuratively) unadulterated:--sincere.
entries.98: Ἀδραμυττηνός *)ADRAMUTTHNO/S Adramyttēnós ad-ram-oot-tay-nos' from Ἀδραμύττειον *)ADRAMU/TTEION Adramýtteion (a place in Asia Minor); Adramyttene or belonging to Adramyttium:--of Adramyttium.
entries.99: Ἀδρίας *)ADRI/AS Adrías ad-ree'-as from Ἀδρία *)ADRI/A Adría (a place near its shore); the Adriatic sea (including the Ionian):--Adria.
entries.100: ἁδρότης A(DRO/THS hadrótēs had-rot'-ace from ἁδρός A(DRO/S hadrós (stout); plumpness, i.e. (figuratively) liberality:--abundance.
entries.101: ἀδυνατέω A)DUNATE/W adynatéō ad-oo-nat-eh'-o from G102; to be unable, i.e. (passively) impossible:--be impossible.
entries.102: ἀδύνατος A)DU/NATOS adýnatos ad-oo'-nat-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1415; unable, i.e. weak (literally or figuratively); passively, impossible:--could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak.
entries.103: ᾄδω A)/|DW áidō ad'-o a primary verb; to sing:--sing.
entries.104: ἀεί A)EI/ aeí ah-eye' from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration); "ever," by qualification regularly; by implication, earnestly:--always, ever.
entries.105: ἀετός A)ETO/S aetós ah-et-os' from the same as G109; an eagle (from its wind-like flight):--eagle.
entries.106: ἄζυμος A)/ZUMOS ázymos ad'-zoo-mos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2219; unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week:--unleavened (bread).
entries.107: Ἀζώρ *)AZW/R Azṓr ad-zore' of Hebrew origin (compare H05809); Azor, an Israelite:--Azor.
entries.108: Ἄζωτος *)/AZWTOS Ázōtos ad'-zo-tos of Hebrew origin (H0795); Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine:--Azotus.
entries.109: ἀήρ A)H/R aḗr ah-ayr' from ἄημι A)/HMI áēmi (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient):--air. Compare G5594.
entries.110: ἀθανασία A)QANASI/A athanasía ath-an-as-ee'-ah from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G2288; deathlessness:--immortality.
entries.111: ἀθέμιτος A)QE/MITOS athémitos ath-em'-ee-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of θέμις QE/MIS thémis (statute; from the base of G5087); illegal; by implication, flagitious:--abominable, unlawful thing.
entries.112: ἄθεος A)/QEOS átheos ath'-eh-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2316; godless:--without God.
entries.113: ἄθεσμος A)/QESMOS áthesmos ath'-es-mos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087 (in the sense of enacting); lawless, i.e. (by implication) criminal:--wicked.
entries.114: ἀθετέω A)QETE/W athetéō ath-et-eh'-o from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087; to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate:--cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject.
entries.115: ἀθέτησις A)QE/THSIS athétēsis ath-et'-ay-sis from G114; cancellation (literally or figuratively):--disannulling, put away.
entries.116: Ἀθῆναι *)AQH=NAI Athēnai ath-ay-nahee plural of Ἀθήνη *)AQH/NH Athḗnē (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city); Athenæ, the capitol of Greece:-- Athens.
entries.117: Ἀθηναῖος *)AQHNAI=OS Athēnaîos ath-ay-nah'-yos from G116; an Athenæan or inhabitant of Athenæ:--Athenian.
entries.118: ἀθλέω A)QLE/W athléō ath-leh'-o from ἄθλος A)/QLOS áthlos (a contest in the public lists); to contend in the competitive games:--strive.
entries.119: ἄθλησις A)/QLHSIS áthlēsis ath'-lay-sis from G118; a struggle (figuratively):--fight.
entries.120: ἀθυμέω A)QUME/W athyméō ath-oo-meh'-o from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G2372; to be spiritless, i.e. disheartened:--be dismayed.
entries.121: ἄθωος A)/QWOS áthōos ath'-o-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of G5087 (meaning a penalty); not guilty:--innocent.
entries.122: αἴγειος AI)/GEIOS aígeios ah'-ee-ghi-os from αἴξ AI)/C aíx (a goat); belonging to a goat:--goat.
entries.123: αἰγιαλός AI)GIALO/S aigialós ahee-ghee-al-os' from ἀΐσσω A)I/+SSW aḯssō (to rush) and G251 (in the sense of the sea); a beach (on which the waves dash):--shore.
entries.124: Αἰγύπτιος *AI)GU/PTIOS Aigýptios ahee-goop'-tee-os from G125; an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus:--Egyptian.
entries.125: Αἴγυπτος *AI)/GUPTOS Aígyptos ah'-ee-goop-tos of uncertain derivation; Ægyptus, the land of the Nile:--Egypt.
entries.126: ἀΐδιος A)I/+DIOS aḯdios ah-id'-ee-os from G104; everduring (forward and backward, or forward only):--eternal, everlasting.
entries.127: αἰδώς AI)DW/S aidṓs ahee-doce' perhaps from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1492 (through the idea of downcast eyes); bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe:--reverence, shamefacedness.
entries.128: Αἰθίοψ *AI)QI/OY Aithíops ahee-thee'-ops from αἴθω AI)/QW aíthō (to scorch) and ὤψ W)/Y ṓps (the face, from G3700); an Æthiopian (as a blackamoor):--Ethiopian.
entries.129: αἷμα AI(=MA haîma hah'-ee-mah of uncertain derivation; blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred:--blood.
entries.130: αἱματεκχυσία AI(MATEKXUSI/A haimatekchysía hahee-mat-ek-khoo-see'-ah from G129 and a derivative of G1632; an effusion of blood:--shedding of blood.
entries.131: αἱμοῤῥέω AI(MOR)R(E/W haimorrhéō hahee-mor-hreh'-o from G129 and G4482; to flow blood, i.e. have a hæmorrhage:--diseased with an issue of blood.
entries.132: Αἰνέας *AI)NE/AS Ainéas ahee-neh'-as of uncertain derivation; Ænĕas, an Israelite:--Æneas.
entries.133: αἴνεσις AI)/NESIS aínesis ah'-ee-nes-is from G134; a praising (the act), i.e. (specially) a thank(-offering):--praise.
entries.134: αἰνέω AI)NE/W ainéō ahee-neh'-o from G136; to praise (God):--praise.
entries.135: αἴνιγμα AI)/NIGMA aínigma ah'-ee-nig-ma from a derivative of G136 (in its primary sense); an obscure saying ("enigma"), i.e. (abstractly) obscureness:--X darkly.
entries.136: αἶνος AI)=NOS aînos ah'-ee-nos apparently a prime word; properly, a story, but used in the sense of G1868; praise (of God):--praise.
entries.137: Αἰνών *AI)NW/N Ainṓn ahee-nohn' of Hebrew origin (a derivative of H5869, place of springs); Ænon, a place in Palestine:--Ænon.
entries.138: αἱρέομαι AI(RE/OMAI hairéomai hahee-reh'-om-ahee probably akin to G142; to take for oneself, i.e. to prefer:--choose. Some of the forms are borrowed from a cognate ἕλλομαι E(/LLOMAI héllomai hel'-lom-ahee ; which is otherwise obsolete.
entries.139: αἵρεσις AI(/RESIS haíresis hah'-ee-res-is from G138; properly, a choice, i.e. (specially) a party or (abstractly) disunion:--heresy (which is the Greek word itself), sect.
entries.140: αἱρετίζω AI(RETI/ZW hairetízō hahee-ret-id'-zo from a derivative of G138; to make a choice:--choose.
entries.141: αἱρετικός AI(RETIKO/S hairetikós hahee-ret-ee-kos' from the same as G140; a schismatic:--heretic (the Greek word itself).
entries.142: αἴρω AI)/RW aírō ah'-ee-ro a primary root; to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare H05375) to expiate sin:--away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up).
entries.143: αἰσθάνομαι AI)SQA/NOMAI aisthánomai ahee-sthan'-om-ahee of uncertain derivation; to apprehend (properly, by the senses):--perceive.
entries.144: αἴσθησις AI)/SQHSIS aísthēsis ah'-ee-sthay-sis from G143; perception, i.e. (figuratively) discernment:--judgment.
entries.145: αἰσθητήριον AI)SQHTH/RION aisthētḗrion ahee-sthay-tay'-ree-on from a derivative of G143; properly, an organ of perception, i.e. (figuratively) judgment:--senses.
entries.146: αἰσχροκερδής AI)SXROKERDH/S aischrokerdḗs ahee-skhrok-er-dace' from G150 and κέρδος KE/RDOS kérdos (gain); sordid:--given to (greedy of) filthy lucre.
entries.147: αἰσχροκερδῶς AI)SXROKERDW=S aischrokerdōs ahee-skhrok-er-doce' adverb from G146; sordidly:--for filthy lucre's sake.
entries.148: αἰσχρολογία AI)SXROLOGI/A aischrología ahee-skhrol-og-ee'-ah from G150 and G3056; vile conversation:--filthy communication.
entries.149: αἰσχρόν AI)SXRO/N aischrón ahee-skhron' neuter of G150; a shameful thing, i.e. indecorum:--shame.
entries.150: αἰσχρός AI)SXRO/S aischrós ahee-skhros' from the same as G153; shameful, i.e. base (specially, venal):--filthy.
entries.151: αἰσχρότης AI)SXRO/THS aischrótēs ahee-skhrot'-ace from G150; shamefulness, i.e. obscenity:--filthiness.
entries.152: αἰσχύνη AI)SXU/NH aischýnē ahee-skhoo'-nay from G153; shame or disgrace (abstractly or concretely):--dishonesty, shame.
entries.153: αἰσχύνομαι AI)SXU/NOMAI aischýnomai ahee-skhoo'-nom-ahee from αἶσχος AI)=SXOS aîschos (disfigurement, i.e. disgrace); to feel shame (for oneself):--be ashamed.
entries.154: αἰτέω AI)TE/W aitéō ahee-teh'-o of uncertain derivation; to ask (in genitive case):--ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require. Compare G4441.
entries.155: αἴτημα AI)/THMA aítēma ah'-ee-tay-mah from G154; a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking:--petition, request, required.
entries.156: αἰτία AI)TI/A aitía ahee-tee'-a from the same as G154; a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved):--accusation, case, cause, crime, fault, (wh-)ere(-fore).
entries.157: αἰτίαμα AI)TI/AMA aitíama ahee-tee'-am-ah from a derivative of G156; a thing charged:--complaint.
entries.158: αἴτιον AI)/TION aítion ah'-ee-tee-on neuter of G159; a reason or crime (like G156):--cause, fault.
entries.159: αἴτιος AI)/TIOS aítios ah'-ee-tee-os from the same as G154; causative, i.e. (concretely) a causer:--author.
entries.160: αἰφνίδιος AI)FNI/DIOS aiphnídios aheef-nid'-ee-os from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G5316 (compare G1810) (meaning non-apparent); unexpected, i.e. (adverbially) suddenly:--sudden, unawares.
entries.161: αἰχμαλωσία AI)XMALWSI/A aichmalōsía aheekh-mal-o-see'-ah from G164; captivity:--captivity.
entries.162: αἰχμαλωτεύω AI)XMALWTEU/W aichmalōteúō aheekh-mal-o-tew'-o from G164; to capture (like G163):--lead captive.
entries.163: αἰχμαλωτίζω AI)XMALWTI/ZW aichmalōtízō aheekh-mal-o-tid'-zo from G164; to make captive:--lead away captive, bring into captivity.
entries.164: αἰχμάλωτος AI)XMA/LWTOS aichmálōtos aheekh-mal-o-tos' from αἰχμή AI)XMH/ aichmḗ (a spear) and a derivative of the same as G259; properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive:--captive.
entries.165: αἰών AI)W/N aiṓn ahee-ohn' from the same as G104; properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future):--age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the , while the) world (began, without end). Compare G5550.
entries.166: αἰώνιος AI)W/NIOS aiṓnios ahee-o'-nee-os from G165; perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well):--eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).
entries.167: ἀκαθαρσία A)KAQARSI/A akatharsía ak-ath-ar-see'-ah from G169; impurity (the quality), physically or morally:--uncleanness.
entries.168: ἀκαθάρτης A)KAQA/RTHS akathártēs ak-ath-ar'-tace from G169; impurity (the state), morally:--filthiness.
entries.169: ἀκάθαρτος A)KA/QARTOS akáthartos ak-ath'-ar-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2508 (meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specially, (demonic)):--foul, unclean.
entries.170: ἀκαιρέομαι A)KAIRE/OMAI akairéomai ak-ahee-reh'-om-ahee from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G2540 (meaning unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a proper occasion:--lack opportunity.
entries.171: ἀκαίρως A)KAI/RWS akaírōs ak-ah'-ee-roce adverb from the same as G170; inopportunely:--out of season.
entries.172: ἄκακος A)/KAKOS ákakos ak'-ak-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2556; not bad, i.e. (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting:--harmless, simple.
entries.173: ἄκανθα A)/KANQA ákantha ak'-an-thah probably from the same as G188; a thorn:--thorn.
entries.174: ἀκάνθινος A)KA/NQINOS akánthinos ak-an'-thee-nos from G173; thorny:--of thorns.
entries.175: ἄκαρπος A)/KARPOS ákarpos ak'-ar-pos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2590; barren (literally or figuratively):--without fruit, unfruitful.
entries.176: ἀκατάγνωστος A)KATA/GNWSTOS akatágnōstos ak-at-ag'-noce-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2607; unblamable:--that cannot be condemned.
entries.177: ἀκατακάλυπτος A)KATAKA/LUPTOS akatakályptos ak-at-ak-al'-oop-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G2596 and G2572; unveiled:--uncovered.
entries.178: ἀκατάκριτος A)KATA/KRITOS akatákritos ak-at-ak'-ree-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2632; without (legal) trial:--uncondemned.
entries.179: ἀκατάλυτος A)KATA/LUTOS akatálytos ak-at-al'-oo-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2647; indissoluble, i.e. (figuratively) permanent:--endless.
entries.180: ἀκατάπαυστος A)KATA/PAUSTOS akatápaustos ak-at-ap'-ow-stos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2664; unrefraining:--that cannot cease.
entries.181: ἀκαταστασία A)KATASTASI/A akatastasía ak-at-as-tah-see'-ah from G182; instability, i.e. disorder:--commotion, confusion, tumult.
entries.182: ἀκατάστατος A)KATA/STATOS akatástatos ak-at-as'-tat-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2525; inconstant:--unstable.
entries.183: ἀκατάσχετος A)KATA/SXETOS akatáschetos ak-at-as'-khet-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2722; unrestrainable:--unruly.
entries.184: Ἀκελδαμά *)AKELDAMA/ Akeldamá ak-el-dam-ah' of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood; corresponding to H02506 and H01818); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem:--Aceldama.
entries.185: ἀκέραιος A)KE/RAIOS akéraios ak-er'-ah-yos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2767; unmixed, i.e. (figuratively) innocent:--harmless, simple.
entries.186: ἀκλινής A)KLINH/S aklinḗs ak-lee-nace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2827; not leaning, i.e. (figuratively) firm:--without wavering.
entries.187: ἀκμάζω A)KMA/ZW akmázō ak-mad'-zo from the same as G188; to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature:--be fully ripe.
entries.188: ἀκμήν A)KMH/N akmḗn ak-mane' accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to ἀκή A)KH/ akḗ (a point) and meaning the same; adverbially, just now, i.e. still:--yet.
entries.189: ἀκοή A)KOH/ akoḗ ak-o-ay' from G191; hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard):--audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.
entries.190: ἀκολουθέω A)KOLOUQE/W akolouthéō ak-ol-oo-theh'-o from G1 (as a particle of union) and κέλευθος KE/LEUQOS kéleuthos (a road); properly, to be in the same way with, i.e. to accompany (specially, as a disciple):--follow, reach.
entries.191: ἀκούω A)KOU/W akoúō ak-oo'-o a primary verb; to hear (in various senses):--give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand.
entries.192: ἀκρασία A)KRASI/A akrasía ak-ras-ee'-a from G193; want of self-restraint:--excess, incontinency.
entries.193: ἀκρατής A)KRATH/S akratḗs ak-rat'-ace from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2904; powerless, i.e. without self-control:--incontinent.
entries.194: ἄκρατος A)/KRATOS ákratos ak'-rat-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2767; undiluted:--without mixture.
entries.195: ἀκρίβεια A)KRI/BEIA akríbeia ak-ree'-bi-ah from the same as G196; exactness:--perfect manner.
entries.196: ἀκριβέστατος A)KRIBE/STATOS akribéstatos ak-ree-bes'-ta-tos superlative of ἀκρίβης A)KRI/BHS akríbēs (a derivative of the same as G206); most exact:--most straitest.
entries.197: ἀκριβέστερον A)KRIBE/STERON akribésteron ak-ree-bes'-ter-on neuter of the comparative of the same as G196; (adverbially) more exactly:--more perfect(-ly).
entries.198: ἀκριβόω A)KRIBO/W akribóō ak-ree-bo'-o from the same as G196; to be exact, i.e. ascertain:--enquire diligently.
entries.199: ἀκριβῶς A)KRIBW=S akribōs ak-ree-boce' adverb from the same as G196; exactly:--circumspectly, diligently, perfect(-ly).
entries.200: ἀκρίς A)KRI/S akrís ak-rece' apparently from the same as G206; a locust (as pointed, or as lighting on the top of vegetation):--locust.
entries.201: ἀκροατήριον A)KROATH/RION akroatḗrion ak-ro-at-ay'-ree-on from G202; an audience-room:--place of hearing.
entries.202: ἀκροατής A)KROATH/S akroatḗs ak-ro-at-ace' from ἀκροάομαι A)KROA/OMAI akroáomai (to listen; apparently an intensive of G191); a hearer (merely):--hearer.
entries.203: ἀκροβυστία A)KROBUSTI/A akrobystía ak-rob-oos-tee'-ah from G206 and probably a modified form of πόσθη PO/SQH pósthē (the penis or male sexual organ); the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e. gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person:--not circumcised, uncircumcised (with G2192), uncircumcision.
entries.204: ἀκρογωνιαῖος A)KROGWNIAI=OS akrogōniaîos ak-rog-o-nee-ah'-yos from G206 and G1137; belonging to the extreme corner:--chief corner.
entries.205: ἀκροθίνιον A)KROQI/NION akrothínion ak-roth-in'-ee-on from G206 and θίς QI/S thís (a heap); properly (in the plural) the top of the heap, i.e. (by implication) best of the booty:--spoils.
entries.206: ἄκρον A)/KRON ákron ak'-ron neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of G188; the extremity:--one end… other, tip, top, uttermost part.
entries.207: Ἀκύλας *)AKU/LAS Akýlas ak-oo'-las probably for Latin aquila (an eagle); Akulas, an Israelite:--Aquila.
entries.208: ἀκυρόω A)KURO/W akyróō ak-oo-ro'-o from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2964; to invalidate:--disannul, make of none effect.
entries.209: ἀκωλύτως A)KWLU/TWS akōlýtōs ak-o-loo'-toce adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2967; in an unhindered manner, i.e. freely:--no man forbidding him.
entries.210: ἄκων A)/KWN ákōn ak'-ohn from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1635; unwilling:--against the will.
entries.211: ἀλάβαστρον A)LA/BASTRON alábastron al-ab'-as-tron neuter of ἀλάβαστρος A)LA/BASTROS alábastros (of uncertain derivation), the name of a stone; properly, an "alabaster" box, i.e. (by extension) a perfume vase (of any material):--(alabaster) box.
entries.212: ἀλαζονεία A)LAZONEI/A alazoneía al-ad-zon-i'-a from G213; braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) self-confidence:--boasting, pride.
entries.213: ἀλαζών A)LAZW/N alazṓn al-ad-zone' from ἄλη A)/LH álē (vagrancy); braggart:--boaster.
entries.214: ἀλαλάζω A)LALA/ZW alalázō al-al-ad'-zo from ἀλαλή A)LALH/ alalḗ ( a shout, "halloo"); to vociferate, i.e. (by implication) to wail; figuratively, to clang:--tinkle, wail.
entries.215: ἀλάλητος A)LA/LHTOS alálētos al-al'-ay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2980; unspeakable:--unutterable, which cannot be uttered.
entries.216: ἄλαλος A)/LALOS álalos al'-al-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2980; mute:--dumb.
entries.217: ἅλας A(/LAS hálas hal'-as from G251; salt; figuratively, prudence:--salt.
entries.218: ἀλείφω A)LEI/FW aleíphō al-i'-fo from G1 (as particle of union) and the base of G3045; to oil (with perfume):--anoint.
entries.219: ἀλεκτοροφωνία A)LEKTOROFWNI/A alektorophōnía al-ek-tor-of-o-nee'-ah from G220 and G5456; cock-crow, i.e. the third night-watch:--cockcrowing.
entries.220: ἀλέκτωρ A)LE/KTWR aléktōr al-ek'-tore from ἀλέκω A)LE/KW alékō (to ward off); a cock or male fowl:--cock.
entries.221: Ἀλεξανδρεύς *)ALECANDREU/S Alexandreús al-ex-and-reuce' from Ἀλεξάνδρεια *)ALECA/NDREIA Alexándreia (the city so called); an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria:--of Alexandria, Alexandrian.
entries.222: Ἀλεξανδρῖνος *)ALECANDRI=NOS Alexandrînos al-ex-an-dree'-nos from the same as G221; Alexandrine, or belonging to Alexandria:--of Alexandria.
entries.223: Ἀλέξανδρος *)ALE/CANDROS Aléxandros al-ex'-an-dros from the same as (the first part of) G220 and G435; man-defender; Alexander, the name of three Israelites and one other man:--Alexander.
entries.224: ἄλευρον A)/LEURON áleuron al'-yoo-ron from ἀλέω A)LE/W aléō(to grind); flour:--meal.
entries.225: ἀλήθεια A)LH/QEIA alḗtheia al-ay'-thi-a from G227; truth:--true, X truly, truth, verity.
entries.226: ἀληθεύω A)LHQEU/W alētheúō al-ayth-yoo'-o from G227; to be true (in doctrine and profession):--speak (tell) the truth.
entries.227: ἀληθής A)LHQH/S alēthḗs al-ay-thace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2990; true (as not concealing):--true, truly, truth.
entries.228: ἀληθινός A)LHQINO/S alēthinós al-ay-thee-nos' from G227; truthful:--true.
entries.229: ἀλήθω A)LH/QW alḗthō al-ay'-tho from the same as G224; to grind:--grind.
entries.230: ἀληθῶς A)LHQW=S alēthōs al-ay-thoce' adverb from G227; truly:--indeed, surely, of a surety, truly, of a (in) truth, verily, very.
entries.231: ἁλιεύς A(LIEU/S halieús hal-ee-yoos' from G251; a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), i.e. (by implication) a fisher:--fisher(-man).
entries.232: ἁλιεύω A(LIEU/W halieúō hal-ee-yoo'-o from G231; to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish:--go a-fishing.
entries.233: ἁλίζω A(LI/ZW halízō hal-id'-zo from G251; to salt:--salt.
entries.234: ἀλίσγεμα A)LI/SGEMA alísgema al-is'-ghem-ah from ἀλισγέω A)LISGE/W alisgéō (to soil); (ceremonially) defilement:--pollution.
entries.235: ἀλλά A)LLA/ allá al-lah' neuter plural of G243; properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations):--and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet.
entries.236: ἀλλάσσω A)LLA/SSW allássō al-las'-so from G243; to make different:--change.
entries.237: ἀλλαχόθεν A)LLAXO/QEN allachóthen al-lakh-oth'-en from G243; from elsewhere:--some other way.
entries.238: ἀλληγορέω A)LLHGORE/W allēgoréō al-lay-gor-eh'-o from G243 and ἀγορέω A)GORE/W agoréō (to harangue (compare G58)); to allegorize:--be an allegory (the Greek word itself).
entries.239: ἀλληλουϊα A)LLHLOUI+A allēlouïa al-lay-loo'-ee-ah of Hebrew origin (imperative of H01984 and H03050); praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation:--alleluiah.
entries.240: ἀλλήλων A)LLH/LWN allḗlōn al-lay'-lone Genitive plural from G243 reduplicated; one another:--each other, mutual, one another, (the other), (them-, your-)selves, (selves) together (sometimes with G3326 or G4314).
entries.241: ἀλλογενής A)LLOGENH/S allogenḗs al-log-en-ace' from G243 and G1085; foreign, i.e. not a Jew:--stranger.
entries.242: ἅλλομαι A(/LLOMAI hállomai hal'-lom-ahee middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to jump; figuratively, to gush:--leap, spring up.
entries.243: ἄλλος A)/LLOS állos al'-los a primary word; "else," i.e. different (in many applications):--more, one (another), (an-, some an-)other(-s, -wise).
entries.244: ἀλλοτριεπίσκοπος A)LLOTRIEPI/SKOPOS allotriepískopos al-lot-ree-ep-is'-kop-os from G245 and G1985; overseeing others' affairs, i.e. a meddler (specially, in Gentile customs):--busybody in other men's matters.
entries.245: ἀλλότριος A)LLO/TRIOS allótrios al-lot'-ree-os from G243; another's, i.e. not one's own; by extension foreign, not akin, hostile:--alien, (an-)other (man's, men's), strange(-r).
entries.246: ἀλλόφυλος A)LLO/FULOS allóphylos al-lof'-oo-los from G243 and G5443; foreign, i.e. (specially) Gentile:--one of another nation.
entries.247: ἄλλως A)/LLWS állōs al'-loce adverb from G243; differently:--otherwise.
entries.248: ἀλοάω A)LOA/W aloáō al-o-ah'-o from the same as G257; to tread out grain:--thresh, tread out the corn.
entries.249: ἄλογος A)/LOGOS álogos al'-og-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3056; irrational:--brute, unreasonable.
entries.250: ἀλόη A)LO/H alóē al-o-ay' of foreign origin (compare G174); aloes (the gum):--aloes.
entries.251: ἅλς A(/LS háls halce a primary word; "salt":--salt.
entries.252: ἁλυκός A(LUKO/S halykós hal-oo-kos' from G251; briny:--salt.
entries.253: ἀλυπότερος A)LUPO/TEROS alypóteros al-oo-pot'-er-os comparative of a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G3077; more without grief:--less sorrowful.
entries.254: ἅλυσις A(/LUSIS hálysis hal'-oo-sis of uncertain derivation; a fetter or manacle:--bonds, chain.
entries.255: ἀλυσιτελής A)LUSITELH/S alysitelḗs al-oo-sit-el-ace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G3081; gainless, i.e. (by implication) pernicious:--unprofitable.
entries.256: Ἀλφαῖος *)ALFAI=OS Alphaîos al-fah'-yos of Hebrew origin (compare H02501); Alphæus, an Israelite:--Alpheus.
entries.257: ἅλων A(/LWN hálōn hal'-ohn probably from the base of G1507; a threshing-floor (as rolled hard), i.e. (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed):--floor.
entries.258: ἀλώπηξ A)LW/PHC alṓpēx al-o'-pakes of uncertain derivation; a fox, i.e. (figuratively) a cunning person:--fox.
entries.259: ἅλωσις A(/LWSIS hálōsis hal'-o-sis from a collateral form of G138; capture:--be taken.
entries.260: ἅμα A(/MA háma ham'-ah a primary particle; properly, at the "same" time, but freely used as a preposition or adverb denoting close association:--also, and, together, with(-al).
entries.261: ἀμαθής A)MAQH/S amathḗs am-ath-ace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3129; ignorant:--unlearned.
entries.262: ἀμαράντινος A)MARA/NTINOS amarántinos am-ar-an'-tee-nos from G263; "amaranthine", i.e. (by implication) fadeless:--that fadeth not away.
entries.263: ἀμάραντος A)MA/RANTOS amárantos am-ar'-an-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3133; unfading, i.e. (by implication) perpetual:--that fadeth not away.
entries.264: ἁμαρτάνω A(MARTA/NW hamartánō ham-ar-tan'-o perhaps from G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G3313; properly, to miss the mark (and so not share in the prize), i.e. (figuratively) to err, especially (morally) to sin:--for your faults, offend, sin, trespass.
entries.265: ἁμάρτημα A(MA/RTHMA hamártēma ham-ar'-tay-mah from G264; a sin (properly concrete):--sin.
entries.266: ἁμαρτία A(MARTI/A hamartía ham-ar-tee'-ah from G264; a sin (properly abstract):--offence, sin(-ful).
entries.267: ἀμάρτυρος A)MA/RTUROS amártyros am-ar'-too-ros from G1 (as a negative particle) and a form of G3144; unattested:--without witness.
entries.268: ἁμαρτωλός A(MARTWLO/S hamartōlós ham-ar-to-los' from G264; sinful, i.e. a sinner:--sinful, sinner.
entries.269: ἄμαχος A)/MAXOS ámachos am'-akh-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3163; peaceable:--not a brawler.
entries.270: ἀμάω A)MA/W amáō am-ah'-o from G260; properly, to collect, i.e. (by implication) reap:--reap down.
entries.271: ἀμέθυστος A)ME/QUSTOS améthystos am-eth'-oos-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3184; the "amethyst" (supposed to prevent intoxication):--amethyst.
entries.272: ἀμελέω A)MELE/W ameléō am-el-eh'-o from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3199; to be careless of:--make light of, neglect, be negligent, no regard.
entries.273: ἄμεμπτος A)/MEMPTOS ámemptos am'-emp-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3201; irreproachable:--blameless, faultless, unblamable.
entries.274: ἀμέμπτως A)ME/MPTWS amémptōs am-emp'-toce adverb from G273; faultlessly:--blameless, unblamably.
entries.275: ἀμέριμνος A)ME/RIMNOS amérimnos am-er'-im-nos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3308; not anxious:--without care(-fulness), secure.
entries.276: ἀμετάθετος A)META/QETOS ametáthetos am-et-ath'-et-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3346; unchangeable, or (neuter as abstract) unchangeability:--immutable(-ility).
entries.277: ἀμετακίνητος A)METAKI/NHTOS ametakínētos am-et-ak-in'-ay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3334; immovable:--unmovable.
entries.278: ἀμεταμέλητος A)METAME/LHTOS ametamélētos am-et-am-el'-ay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3338; irrevocable:--without repentance, not to be repented of.
entries.279: ἀμετανόητος A)METANO/HTOS ametanóētos am-et-an-o'-ay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3340; unrepentant:--impenitent.
entries.280: ἄμετρος A)/METROS ámetros am'-et-ros from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3358; immoderate:--(thing) without measure.
entries.281: ἀμήν A)MH/N amḗn am-ane' of Hebrew origin (H0543); properly, firm, i.e. (figuratively) trustworthy; adverbially, surely (often as interjection, so be it):--amen, verily.
entries.282: ἀμήτωρ A)MH/TWR amḗtōr am-ay'-tore from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3384; motherless, i.e. of unknown maternity:--without mother.
entries.283: ἀμίαντος A)MI/ANTOS amíantos am-ee'-an-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3392; unsoiled, i.e. (figuratively) pure:--undefiled.
entries.284: Ἀμιναδάβ *)AMINADA/B Aminadáb am-ee-nad-ab' of Hebrew origin (H05992); Aminadab, an Israelite:--Aminadab.
entries.285: ἄμμος A)/MMOS ámmos am'-mos perhaps from G260; sand (as heaped on the beach):--sand.
entries.286: ἀμνός A)MNO/S amnós am-nos' apparently a primary word; a lamb:--lamb.
entries.287: ἀμοιβή A)MOIBH/ amoibḗ am-oy-bay' from ἀμείβω A)MEI/BW ameíbō (to exchange); requital:--requite.
entries.288: ἄμπελος A)/MPELOS ámpelos am'-pel-os probably from the base of G297 and that of G257; a vine (as coiling about a support):--vine.
entries.289: ἀμπελουργός A)MPELOURGO/S ampelourgós am-pel-oor-gos' from G288 and G2041; a vine-worker, i.e. pruner:--vine-dresser.
entries.290: ἀμπελών A)MPELW/N ampelṓn am-pel-ohn' from G288; a vineyard:--vineyard.
entries.291: Ἀμπλίας *)AMPLI/AS Amplías am-plee'-as contracted for Latin ampliatus (enlarged); Amplias, a Roman Christian:--Amplias.
entries.292: ἀμύνομαι A)MU/NOMAI amýnomai am-oo'-nom-ahee middle voice of a primary verb; to ward off (for oneself), i.e. protect:--defend.
entries.293: ἀμφίβληστρον A)MFI/BLHSTRON amphíblēstron am-fib'-lace-tron from a compound of the base of G297 and G906; a (fishing) net (as thrown about the fish):--net.
entries.294: ἀμφιέννυμι A)MFIE/NNUMI amphiénnymi am-fee-en'-noo-mee from the base of G297 and ἕννυμι E(/NNUMI hénnymi (to invest); to enrobe:--clothe.
entries.295: Ἀμφίπολις *)AMFI/POLIS Amphípolis am-fip'-ol-is from the base of G297 and G4172; a city surrounded by a river; Amphipolis, a place in Macedonia:--Amphipolis.
entries.296: ἄμφοδον A)/MFODON ámphodon am'-fod-on from the base of G297 and G3598; a fork in the road:--where two ways meet.
entries.297: ἀμφότερος A)MFO/TEROS amphóteros am-fot'-er-os comparative of ἀμφί A)MFI/ amphí (around); (in plural) both:--both.
entries.298: ἀμώμητος A)MW/MHTOS amṓmētos am-o'-may-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3469; unblamable:--blameless.
entries.299: ἄμωμος A)/MWMOS ámōmos am'-o-mos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3470; unblemished (literally or figuratively):--without blame (blemish, fault, spot), faultless, unblamable.
entries.300: Ἀμών *)AMW/N Amṓn am-one' of Hebrew origin (H0526); Amon, an Israelite:--Amon.
entries.301: Ἀμώς *)AMW/S Amṓs am-oce' of Hebrew origin (H0531); Amos, an Israelite:--Amos.
entries.302: ἄν A)/N án an a primary particle, denoting a supposition, wish, possibility or uncertainty :--(what-, where-, wither-, who-)soever. Usually unexpressed except by the subjunctive or potential mood. Also contracted for G1437.
entries.303: ἀνά A)NA/ aná an-ah' a primary preposition and adverb; properly, up; but (by extension) used (distributively) severally, or (locally) at (etc.):--and, apiece, by, each, every (man), in, through. In compounds (as a prefix) it often means (by implication) repetition, intensity, reversal, etc.
entries.304: ἀναβαθμός A)NABAQMO/S anabathmós an-ab-ath-mos' from G305 (compare G898); a stairway:--stairs.
entries.305: ἀναβαίνω A)NABAI/NW anabaínō an-ab-ah'-ee-no from G303 and the base of G939; to go up (literally or figuratively):--arise, ascend (up), climb (go, grow, rise, spring) up, come (up).
entries.306: ἀναβάλλομαι A)NABA/LLOMAI anabállomai an-ab-al'-lom-ahee middle voice from G303 and G906; to put off (for oneself):--defer.
entries.307: ἀναβιβάζω A)NABIBA/ZW anabibázō an-ab-ee-bad'-zo from G303 and a derivative of the base of G939; to cause to go up, i.e. haul (a net):--draw.
entries.308: ἀναβλέπω A)NABLE/PW anablépō an-ab-lep'-o from G303 and G991; to look up; by implication, to recover sight:--look (up), see, receive sight.
entries.309: ἀνάβλεψις A)NA/BLEYIS anáblepsis an-ab'-lep-sis from G308; restoration of sight:--recovery of sight.
entries.310: ἀναβοάω A)NABOA/W anaboáō an-ab-o-ah'-o from G303 and G994; to halloo:--cry (aloud, out).
entries.311: ἀναβολή A)NABOLH/ anabolḗ an-ab-ol-ay' from G306; a putting off:--delay.
entries.312: ἀναγγέλλω A)NAGGE/LLW anangéllō an-ang-el'-lo from G303 and the base of G32; to announce (in detail):--declare, rehearse, report, show, speak, tell.
entries.313: ἀναγεννάω A)NAGENNA/W anagennáō an-ag-en-nah'-o from G303 and G1080; to beget or (by extension) bear (again):--beget, (bear) X (again).
entries.314: ἀναγινώσκω A)NAGINW/SKW anaginṓskō an-ag-in-oce'-ko from G303 and G1097; to know again, i.e. (by extension) to read:--read.
entries.315: ἀναγκάζω A)NAGKA/ZW anankázō an-ang-kad'-zo from G318; to necessitate:--compel, constrain.
entries.316: ἀναγκαῖος A)NAGKAI=OS anankaîos an-ang-kah'-yos from G318; necessary; by implication, close (of kin):--near, necessary, necessity, needful.
entries.317: ἀναγκαστῶς A)NAGKASTW=S anankastōs an-ang-kas-toce' adverb from a derivative of G315; compulsorily:--by constraint.
entries.318: ἀνάγκη A)NA/GKH anánkē an-ang-kay' from G303 and the base of G43; constraint (literally or figuratively); by implication, distress:--distress, must needs, (of) necessity(-sary), needeth, needful.
entries.319: ἀναγνωρίζομαι A)NAGNWRI/ZOMAI anagnōrízomai an-ag-no-rid'-zom-ahee middle voice from G303 and G1107; to make (oneself) known:--be made known.
entries.320: ἀνάγνωσις A)NA/GNWSIS anágnōsis an-ag'-no-sis from G314; (the act of) reading:--reading.
entries.321: ἀνάγω A)NA/GW anágō an-ag'-o from G303 and G71; to lead up; by extension to bring out; specially, to sail away:--bring (again, forth, up again), depart, launch (forth), lead (up), loose, offer, sail, set forth, take up.
entries.322: ἀναδείκνυμι A)NADEI/KNUMI anadeíknymi an-ad-ike'-noo-mee from G303 and G1166; to exhibit, i.e. (by implication) to indicate, appoint:--appoint, shew.
entries.323: ἀνάδειξις A)NA/DEICIS anádeixis an-ad'-ike-sis from G322; (the act of) exhibition:--shewing.
entries.324: ἀναδέχομαι A)NADE/XOMAI anadéchomai an-ad-ekh'-om-ahee from G303 and G1209; to entertain (as a guest):--receive.
entries.325: ἀναδίδωμι A)NADI/DWMI anadídōmi an-ad-eed'-om-ee from G303 and G1325; to hand over:--deliver.
entries.326: ἀναζάω A)NAZA/W anazáō an-ad-zah'-o from G303 and G2198; to recover life (literally or figuratively):--(be a-)live again, revive.
entries.327: ἀναζητέω A)NAZHTE/W anazētéō an-ad-zay-teh'-o from G303 and G2212; to search out:--seek.
entries.328: ἀναζώννυμι A)NAZW/NNUMI anazṓnnymi an-ad-zone'-noo-mee from G303 and G2224; to gird afresh:--gird up.
entries.329: ἀναζωπυρέω A)NAZWPURE/W anazōpyréō an-ad-zo-poor-eh'-o from G303 and a compound of the base of G2226 and G4442; to re-enkindle:--stir up.
entries.330: ἀναθάλλω A)NAQA/LLW anathállō an-ath-al'-lo from G303 and θάλλω QA/LLW thállō (to flourish); to revive:--flourish again.
entries.331: ἀνάθεμα A)NA/QEMA anáthema an-ath'-em-ah from G394; a (religious) ban or (concretely) excommunicated (thing or person):--accused, anathema, curse, X great.
entries.332: ἀναθεματίζω A)NAQEMATI/ZW anathematízō an-ath-em-at-id'-zo from G331; to declare or vow under penalty of execration:--(bind under a) curse, bind with an oath.
entries.333: ἀναθεωρέω A)NAQEWRE/W anatheōréō an-ath-eh-o-reh'-o from G303 and G2334; to look again (i.e. attentively) at (literally or figuratively):--behold, consider.
entries.334: ἀνάθημα A)NA/QHMA anáthēma an-ath'-ay-mah from G394 (like G331, but in a good sense); a votive offering:--gift.
entries.335: ἀναίδεια A)NAI/DEIA anaídeia an-ah'-ee-die-ah' from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle (compare G427)) and G127; impudence, i.e. (by implication) importunity:--importunity.
entries.336: ἀναίρεσις A)NAI/RESIS anaíresis an-ah'-ee-res-is from G337; (the act of) killing:--death.
entries.337: ἀναιρέω A)NAIRE/W anairéō an-ahee-reh'-o from G303 and (the active of) G138; to take up, i.e. adopt; by implication, to take away (violently), i.e. abolish, murder:--put to death, kill, slay, take away, take up.
entries.338: ἀναίτιος A)NAI/TIOS anaítios an-ah'-ee-tee-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G159 (in the sense of G156); innocent:--blameless, guiltless.
entries.339: ἀνακαθίζω A)NAKAQI/ZW anakathízō an-ak-ath-id'-zo from G303 and G2523; properly, to set up, i.e. (reflexively) to sit up:--sit up.
entries.340: ἀνακαινίζω A)NAKAINI/ZW anakainízō an-ak-ahee-nid'-zo from G303 and a derivative of G2537; to restore:--renew.
entries.341: ἀνακαινόω A)NAKAINO/W anakainóō an-ak-ahee-no'-o from G303 and a derivative of G2537; to renovate:--renew.
entries.342: ἀνακαίνωσις A)NAKAI/NWSIS anakaínōsis an-ak-ah'-ee-no-sis from G341; renovation:--renewing.
entries.343: ἀνακαλύπτω A)NAKALU/PTW anakalýptō an-ak-al-oop'-to from G303 (in the sense of reversal) and G2572; to unveil:--open, (un-)taken away.
entries.344: ἀνακάμπτω A)NAKA/MPTW anakámptō an-ak-amp'-to from G303 and G2578; to turn back:--(re-)turn.
entries.345: ἀνακεῖμαι A)NAKEI=MAI anakeîmai an-ak-i'-mahee from G303 and G2749; to recline (as a corpse or at a meal):--guest, lean, lie, sit (down, at meat), at the table.
entries.346: ἀνακεφαλαίομαι A)NAKEFALAI/OMAI anakephalaíomai an-ak-ef-al-ah'-ee-om-ahee from G303 and G2775 (in its original sense); to sum up:--briefly comprehend, gather together in one.
entries.347: ἀνακλίνω A)NAKLI/NW anaklínō an-ak-lee'-no from G303 and G2827; to lean back:--lay, (make) sit down.
entries.348: ἀνακόπτω A)NAKO/PTW anakóptō an-ak-op'-to from G303 and G2875; to beat back, i.e. check:--hinder.
entries.349: ἀνακράζω A)NAKRA/ZW anakrázō an-ak-rad'-zo from G303 and G2896; to scream up (aloud):--cry out.
entries.350: ἀνακρίνω A)NAKRI/NW anakrínō an-ak-ree'-no from G303 and G2919; properly, to scrutinize, i.e. (by implication) investigate, interrogate, determine:--ask, question, discern, examine, judge, search.
entries.351: ἀνάκρισις A)NA/KRISIS anákrisis an-ak'-ree-sis from G350; a (judicial) investigation:--examination.
entries.352: ἀνακύπτω A)NAKU/PTW anakýptō an-ak-oop'-to from G303 (in the sense of reversal) and G2955; to unbend, i.e. rise; figuratively, be elated:--lift up, look up.
entries.353: ἀναλαμβάνω A)NALAMBA/NW analambánō an-al-am-ban'-o from G303 and G2983; to take up:--receive up, take (in, unto, up).
entries.354: ἀνάληψις A)NA/LHYIS análēpsis an-al'-ape-sis from G353; ascension:--taking up.
entries.355: ἀναλίσκω A)NALI/SKW analískō an-al-is'-ko from G303 and a form of the alternate of G138; properly, to use up, i.e. destroy:--consume.
entries.356: ἀναλογία A)NALOGI/A analogía an-al-og-ee'-ah from a compound of G303 and G3056; proportion:--proportion.
entries.357: ἀναλογίζομαι A)NALOGI/ZOMAI analogízomai an-al-og-id'-zom-ahee middle voice from G356; to estimate, i.e. (figuratively) contemplate:--consider.
entries.358: ἄναλος A)/NALOS ánalos an'-al-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G251; saltless, i.e. insipid:--X lose saltness.
entries.359: ἀνάλυσις A)NA/LUSIS análysis an-al'-oo-sis from G360; departure:--departure.
entries.360: ἀναλύω A)NALU/W analýō an-al-oo'-o from G303 and G3089; to break up, i.e. depart (literally or figuratively):--depart, return.
entries.361: ἀναμάρτητος A)NAMA/RTHTOS anamártētos an-am-ar'-tay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G264; sinless:--that is without sin.
entries.362: ἀναμένω A)NAME/NW anaménō an-am-en'-o from G303 and G3306; to await:--wait for.
entries.363: ἀναμιμνήσκω A)NAMIMNH/SKW anamimnḗskō an-am-im-nace'-ko from G303 and G3403; to remind; (reflexively) to recollect:--call to mind, (bring to , call to, put in), remember(-brance).
entries.364: ἀνάμνησις A)NA/MNHSIS anámnēsis an-am'-nay-sis from G363; recollection:--remembrance (again).
entries.365: ἀνανεόω A)NANEO/W ananeóō an-an-neh-o'-o from G303 and a derivative of G3501; to renovate, i.e. reform:--renew.
entries.366: ἀνανήφω A)NANH/FW ananḗphō an-an-ay'-fo from G303 and G3525; to become sober again, i.e. (figuratively) regain (one's) senses:--recover self.
entries.367: Ἀνανίας *)ANANI/AS Ananías an-an-ee'-as of Hebrew origin (H02608); Ananias, the name of three Israelites:--Ananias.
entries.368: ἀναντίῤῥητος A)NANTI/R)R(HTOS anantírrhētos an-an-tir'-hray-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G473 and G4483; indisputable:--cannot be spoken against.
entries.369: ἀναντιῤῥήτως A)NANTIR)R(H/TWS anantirrhḗtōs an-an-tir-hray'-toce adverb from G368; promptly:--without gainsaying.
entries.370: ἀνάξιος A)NA/CIOS anáxios an-ax'-ee-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G514; unfit:--unworthy.
entries.371: ἀναξίως A)NACI/WS anaxíōs an-ax-ee'-oce adverb from G370; irreverently:--unworthily.
entries.372: ἀνάπαυσις A)NA/PAUSIS anápausis an-ap'-ow-sis from G373; intermission; by implication, recreation:--rest.
entries.373: ἀναπαύω A)NAPAU/W anapaúō an-ap-ow'-o from G303 and G3973; (reflexively) to repose (literally or figuratively (be exempt), remain); by implication, to refresh:--take ease, refresh, (give, take) rest.
entries.374: ἀναπείθω A)NAPEI/QW anapeíthō an-ap-i'-tho from G303 and G3982; to incite:--persuade.
entries.375: ἀναπέμπω A)NAPE/MPW anapémpō an-ap-em'-po from G303 and G3992; to send up or back:--send (again).
entries.376: ἀνάπηρος A)NA/PHROS anápēros an-ap'-ay-ros from G303 (in the sense of intensity) and πῆρος PH=ROS pēros (maimed); crippled:--maimed.
entries.377: ἀναπίπτω A)NAPI/PTW anapíptō an-ap-ip'-to from G303 and G4098; to fall back, i.e. lie down, lean back:--lean, sit down (to meat).
entries.378: ἀναπληρόω A)NAPLHRO/W anaplēróō an-ap-lay-ro'-o from G303 and G4137; to complete; by implication, to occupy, supply; figuratively, to accomplish (by coincidence ot obedience):--fill up, fulfill, occupy, supply.
entries.379: ἀναπολόγητος A)NAPOLO/GHTOS anapológētos an-ap-ol-og'-ay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G626; indefensible:--without an excuse, inexcusable.
entries.380: ἀναπτύσσω A)NAPTU/SSW anaptýssō an-ap-toos'-o from G303 (in the sense of reversal) and G4428; to unroll (a scroll or volume):--open.
entries.381: ἀνάπτω A)NA/PTW anáptō an-ap'-to from G303 and G681; to enkindle:--kindle, light.
entries.382: ἀναρίθμητος A)NARI/QMHTOS anaríthmētos an-ar-ith'-may-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G705; unnumbered, i.e. without number:--innumerable.
entries.383: ἀνασείω A)NASEI/W anaseíō an-as-i'-o from G303 and G4579; figuratively, to excite:--move, stir up.
entries.384: ἀνασκευάζω A)NASKEUA/ZW anaskeuázō an-ask-yoo-ad'-zo from G303 (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of G4632; properly, to pack up (baggage), i.e. (by implication, and figuratively) to upset:--subvert.
entries.385: ἀνασπάω A)NASPA/W anaspáō an-as-pah'-o from G303 and G4685; to take up or extricate:--draw up, pull out.
entries.386: ἀνάστασις A)NA/STASIS anástasis an-as'-tas-is from G450; a standing up again, i.e. (literally) a resurrection from death (individual, genitive case or by implication, (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) recovery (of spiritual truth):--raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again.
entries.387: ἀναστατόω A)NASTATO/W anastatóō an-as-tat-o'-o from a derivative of G450 (in the sense of removal); properly, to drive out of home, i.e. (by implication) to disturb (literally or figuratively):--trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar.
entries.388: ἀνασταυρόω A)NASTAURO/W anastauróō an-as-tow-ro'-o from G303 and G4717; to recrucify (figuratively):--crucify afresh.
entries.389: ἀναστενάζω A)NASTENA/ZW anastenázō an-as-ten-ad'-zo from G303 and G4727; to sigh deeply:--sigh deeply.
entries.390: ἀναστρέφω A)NASTRE/FW anastréphō an-as-tref'-o from G303 and G4762; to overturn; also to return; by implication, to busy oneself, i.e. remain, live:--abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.
entries.391: ἀναστροφή A)NASTROFH/ anastrophḗ an-as-trof-ay' from G390; behavior:--conversation.
entries.392: ἀνατάσσομαι A)NATA/SSOMAI anatássomai an-at-as'-som-ahee from G303 and the middle voice of G5021; to arrange:--set in order.
entries.393: ἀνατέλλω A)NATE/LLW anatéllō an-at-el'-lo from G303 and the base of G5056; to (cause to) arise:--(a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.
entries.394: ἀνατίθεμαι A)NATI/QEMAI anatíthemai an-at-ith'-em-ahee from G303 and the middle voice of G5087; to set forth (for oneself), i.e propound:--communicate, declare.
entries.395: ἀνατολή A)NATOLH/ anatolḗ an-at-ol-ay' from G393; a rising of light, i.e. dawn (figuratively); by implication, the east (also in plural):--dayspring, east, rising.
entries.396: ἀνατρέπω A)NATRE/PW anatrépō an-at-rep'-o from G303 and the base of G5157; to overturn (figuratively):--overthrow, subvert.
entries.397: ἀνατρέφω A)NATRE/FW anatréphō an-at-ref'-o from G303 and G5142; to rear (physically or mentally):--bring up, nourish (up).
entries.398: ἀναφαίνω A)NAFAI/NW anaphaínō an-af-ah'-ee-no from G303 and G5316; to show, i.e. (reflexively) appear, or (passively) to have pointed out:--(should) appear, discover.
entries.399: ἀναφέρω A)NAFE/RW anaphérō an-af-er'-o from G303 and G5342; to take up (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring (carry, lead) up, offer (up).
entries.400: ἀναφωνέω A)NAFWNE/W anaphōnéō an-af-o-neh'-o from G303 and G5455; to exclaim:--speak out.
entries.401: ἀνάχυσις A)NA/XUSIS anáchysis an-akh'-oo-sis from a compound of G303 and χέω XE/W chéō (to pour); properly, effusion, i.e. (figuratively) license:--excess.
entries.402: ἀναχωρέω A)NAXWRE/W anachōréō an-akh-o-reh'-o from G303 and G5562; to retire:--depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self.
entries.403: ἀνάψυξις A)NA/YUCIS anápsyxis an-aps'-ook-sis from G404; properly, a recovery of breath, i.e. (figuratively) revival:--revival.
entries.404: ἀναψύχω A)NAYU/XW anapsýchō an-aps-oo'-kho from G303 and G5594; properly, to cool off, i.e. (figuratively) relieve:--refresh.
entries.405: ἀνδραποδιστής A)NDRAPODISTH/S andrapodistḗs an-drap-od-is-tace' from a derivative of a compound of G435 and G4228; an enslaver (as bringing men to his feet):--menstealer.
entries.406: Ἀνδρέας *)ANDRE/AS Andréas an-dreh'-as from G435; manly; Andreas, an Israelite:--Andrew.
entries.407: ἀνδρίζομαι A)NDRI/ZOMAI andrízomai an-drid'-zom-ahee middle voice from G435; to act manly:--quit like men.
entries.408: Ἀνδρόνικος *)ANDRO/NIKOS Andrónikos an-dron'-ee-kos from G435 and G3534; man of victory; Andronicos, an Israelite:--Adronicus.
entries.409: ἀνδροφόνος A)NDROFO/NOS androphónos an-drof-on'-os from G435 and G5408; a murderer:--manslayer.
entries.410: ἀνέγκλητος A)NE/GKLHTOS anénklētos an-eng'-klay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1458; unaccused, i.e. (by implication) irreproachable:--blameless.
entries.411: ἀνεκδιήγητος A)NEKDIH/GHTOS anekdiḗgētos an-ek-dee-ay'-gay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1555; not expounded in full, i.e. indescribable:--unspeakable.
entries.412: ἀνεκλάλητος A)NEKLA/LHTOS aneklálētos an-ek-lal'-ay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1583; not spoken out, i.e. (by implication) unutterable:--unspeakable.
entries.413: ἀνέκλειπτος A)NE/KLEIPTOS anékleiptos an-ek'-lipe-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1587; not left out, i.e. (by implication) inexhaustible:--that faileth not.
entries.414: ἀνεκτότερος A)NEKTO/TEROS anektóteros an-ek-tot'-er-os comparative of a derivative of G430; more endurable:--more tolerable.
entries.415: ἀνελεήμων A)NELEH/MWN aneleḗmōn an-eleh-ay'-mone from G1 (as a negative particle) and G1655; merciless:--unmerciful.
entries.416: ἀνεμίζω A)NEMI/ZW anemízō an-em-id'-zo from G417; to toss with the wind:--drive with the wind.
entries.417: ἄνεμος A)/NEMOS ánemos an'-em-os from the base of G109; wind; (plural) by implication, (the four) quarters (of the earth):--wind.
entries.418: ἀνένδεκτος A)NE/NDEKTOS anéndektos an-en'-dek-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as G1735; unadmitted, i.e. (by implication) not supposable:--impossible.
entries.419: ἀνεξερεύνητος A)NECEREU/NHTOS anexereúnētos an-ex-er-yoo'-nay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G1830; not searched out, i.e. (by implication) inscrutable:--unsearchable.
entries.420: ἀνεξίκακος A)NECI/KAKOS anexíkakos an-ex-ik'-ak-os from G430 and G2556; enduring of ill, i.e. forbearing:--patient.
entries.421: ἀνεξιχνίαστος A)NECIXNI/ASTOS anexichníastos an-ex-ikh-nee'-as-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1537 and a derivative of G2487; not tracked out, i.e. (by implication) untraceable:--past finding out; unsearchable.
entries.422: ἀνεπαίσχυντος A)NEPAI/SXUNTOS anepaíschyntos an-ep-ah'-ee-skhoon-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of G1909 and G153; not ashamed, i.e. irreprehensible: --that needeth not to be ashamed.
entries.423: ἀνεπίληπτος A)NEPI/LHPTOS anepílēptos an-ep-eel'-ape-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1949; not arrested, i.e. (by implication) inculpable:--blameless, unrebukeable.
entries.424: ἀνέρχομαι A)NE/RXOMAI anérchomai an-erkh'-om-ahee from G303 and G2064; to ascend:--go up.
entries.425: ἄνεσις A)/NESIS ánesis an'-es-is from G447; relaxation or (figuratively) relief:--eased, liberty, rest.
entries.426: ἀνετάζω A)NETA/ZW anetázō an-et-ad'-zo from G303 and ἐτάζω E)TA/ZW etázō (to test); to investigate (judicially):--(should have) examined(-d).
entries.427: ἄνευ A)/NEU áneu an'-yoo a primary particle; without:--without. Compare G1.
entries.428: ἀνεύθετος A)NEU/QETOS aneúthetos an-yoo'-the-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2111; not well set, i.e. inconvenient:--not commodious.
entries.429: ἀνευρίσκω A)NEURI/SKW aneurískō an-yoo-ris'-ko from G303 and G2147; to find out:--find.
entries.430: ἀνέχομαι A)NE/XOMAI anéchomai an-ekh'-om-ahee middle voice from G303 and G2192; to hold oneself up against, i.e. (figuratively) put up with:--bear with, endure, forbear, suffer.
entries.431: ἀνεψιός A)NEYIO/S anepsiós an-eps'-ee-os from G1 (as a particle of union) and an obsolete νέπος NE/POS népos (a brood); properly, akin, i.e. (specially) a cousin:--sister's son.
entries.432: ἄνηθον A)/NHQON ánēthon an'-ay-thon probably of foreign origin; dill:--anise.
entries.433: ἀνήκω A)NH/KW anḗkō an-ay'-ko from G303 and G2240; to attain to, i.e. (figuratively) be proper:--convenient, be fit.
entries.434: ἀνήμερος A)NH/MEROS anḗmeros an-ay'-mer-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and ἥμερος H(/MEROS hḗmeros (lame); savage:--fierce.
entries.435: ἀνήρ A)NH/R anḗr an'-ayr a primary word (compare G444); a man (properly as an individual male):--fellow, husband, man, sir.
entries.436: ἀνθίστημι A)NQI/STHMI anthístēmi anth-is'-tay-mee from G473 and G2476; to stand against, i.e. oppose:--resist, withstand.
entries.437: ἀνθομολογέομαι A)NQOMOLOGE/OMAI anthomologéomai anth-om-ol-og-eh'-om-ahee from G473 and the middle voice of G3670; to confess in turn, i.e. respond in praise:--give thanks.
entries.438: ἄνθος A)/NQOS ánthos anth'-os a primary word; a blossom:--flower.
entries.439: ἀνθρακιά A)NQRAKIA/ anthrakiá anth-rak-ee-ah' from G440; a bed of burning coals:--fire of coals.
entries.440: ἄνθραξ A)/NQRAC ánthrax anth'-rax of uncertain derivation; a live coal:--coal of fire.
entries.441: ἀνθρωπάρεσκος A)NQRWPA/RESKOS anthrōpáreskos anth-ro-par'-es-kos from G444 and G700; man-courting, i.e. fawning:--men-pleaser.
entries.442: ἀνθρώπινος A)NQRW/PINOS anthrṓpinos anth-ro'-pee-nos from G444; human:--human, common to man, man(-kind), (man-)kind, men's, after the manner of men.
entries.443: ἀνθρωποκτόνος A)NQRWPOKTO/NOS anthrōpoktónos anth-ro-pok-ton'-os from G444 and κτείνω KTEI/NW kteínō(to kill); a manslayer:--murderer. Compare G5406.
entries.444: ἄνθρωπος A)/NQRWPOS ánthrōpos anth'-ro-pos from G435 and ὤψ W)/Y ṓps (the countenance; from G3700); man-faced, i.e. a human being:--certain, man.
entries.445: ἀνθυπατεύω A)NQUPATEU/W anthypateúō anth-oo-pat-yoo'-o from G446; to act as proconsul:--be the deputy.
entries.446: ἀνθύπατος A)NQU/PATOS anthýpatos anth-oo'-pat-os from G473 and a superlative of G5228; instead of the highest officer, i.e. (specially) a Roman proconsul:--deputy.
entries.447: ἀνίημι A)NI/HMI aníēmi an-ee'-ay-mee from G303 and ἵημι I(/HMI híēmi (to send); to let up, i.e. (literally) slacken or (figuratively) desert, desist from:--forbear, leave, loose.
entries.448: ἀνίλεως A)NI/LEWS aníleōs an-ee'-leh-oce from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2436; inexorable:--without mercy.
entries.449: ἄνιπτος A)/NIPTOS ániptos an'-ip-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3538; without ablution:--unwashen.
entries.450: ἀνίστημι A)NI/STHMI anístēmi an-is'-tay-mee from G303 and G2476; to stand up (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive):--arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up(-right).
entries.451: Ἄννα *)/ANNA Ánna an'-nah of Hebrew origin (H02584); Anna, an Israelitess:--Anna.
entries.452: Ἄννας *)/ANNAS Ánnas an'-nas of Hebrew origin (H02608); Annas (i.e. G367), an Israelite:--Annas.
entries.453: ἀνόητος A)NO/HTOS anóētos an-o'-ay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3539; unintelligent; by implication, sensual:--fool(-ish), unwise.
entries.454: ἄνοια A)/NOIA ánoia an'-oy-ah from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G3563; stupidity; by implication, rage:--folly, madness.
entries.455: ἀνοίγω A)NOI/GW anoígō an-oy'-go from G303 and οἴγω OI)/GW oígō (to open); to open up (literally or figuratively, in various applications):--open.
entries.456: ἀνοικοδομέω A)NOIKODOME/W anoikodoméō an-oy-kod-om-eh'-o from G303 and G3618; to rebuild:--build again.
entries.457: ἄνοιξις A)/NOICIS ánoixis an'-oix-is from G455; opening (throat):--X open.
entries.458: ἀνομία A)NOMI/A anomía an-om-ee'-ah from G459; illegality, i.e. violation of law or (genitive case) wickedness:--iniquity, X transgress(-ion of) the law, unrighteousness.
entries.459: ἄνομος A)/NOMOS ánomos an'-om-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3551; lawless, i.e. (negatively) not subject to (the Jewish) law; (by implication, a Gentile), or (positively) wicked:--without law, lawless, transgressor, unlawful, wicked.
entries.460: ἀνόμως A)NO/MWS anómōs an-om'-oce adverb from G459; lawlessly, i.e. (specially) not amenable to (the Jewish) law:--without law.
entries.461: ἀνορθόω A)NORQO/W anorthóō an-orth-o'-o from G303 and a derivative of the base of G3717; to straighten up:--lift (set) up, make straight.
entries.462: ἀνόσιος A)NO/SIOS anósios an-os'-ee-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3741; wicked:--unholy.
entries.463: ἀνοχή A)NOXH/ anochḗ an-okh-ay' from G430; self-restraint, i.e. tolerance:--forbearance.
entries.464: ἀνταγωνίζομαι A)NTAGWNI/ZOMAI antagōnízomai an-tag-o-nid'-zom-ahee from G473 and G75; to struggle against (figuratively) ("antagonize"):--strive against.
entries.465: ἀντάλλαγμα A)NTA/LLAGMA antállagma an-tal'-ag-mah from a compound of G473 and G236; an equivalent or ransom:--in exchange.
entries.466: ἀνταναπληρόω A)NTANAPLHRO/W antanaplēróō an-tan-ap-lay-ro'-o from G473 and G378; to supplement:--fill up.
entries.467: ἀνταποδίδωμι A)NTAPODI/DWMI antapodídōmi an-tap-od-ee'-do-mee from G473 and G591; to requite (good or evil):--recompense, render, repay.
entries.468: ἀνταπόδομα A)NTAPO/DOMA antapódoma an-tap-od'-om-ah from G467; a requital (properly, the thing):--recompense.
entries.469: ἀνταπόδοσις A)NTAPO/DOSIS antapódosis an-tap-od'-os-is from G467; requital (properly, the act):--reward.
entries.470: ἀνταποκρίνομαι A)NTAPOKRI/NOMAI antapokrínomai an-tap-ok-ree'-nom-ahee from G473 and G611; to contradict or dispute:--answer again, reply against.
entries.471: ἀντέπω A)NTE/PW antépō an-tep'-o from G473 and G2036; to refute or deny:--gainsay, say against.
entries.472: ἀντέχομαι A)NTE/XOMAI antéchomai an-tekh'-om-ahee from G473 and the middle voice of G2192; to hold oneself opposite to, i.e. (by implication) adhere to; by extension to care for:--hold fast, hold to, support.
entries.473: ἀντί A)NTI/ antí an-tee' a primary particle; opposite, i.e. instead or because of (rarely in addition to):--for, in the room of. Often used in composition to denote contrast, requital, substitution, correspondence, etc.
entries.474: ἀντιβάλλω A)NTIBA/LLW antibállō an-tee-bal'-lo from G473 and G906; to bandy:--have.
entries.475: ἀντιδιατίθεμαι A)NTIDIATI/QEMAI antidiatíthemai an-tee-dee-at-eeth'-em-ahee from G473 and G1303; to set oneself opposite, i.e. be disputatious:--that oppose themselves.
entries.476: ἀντίδικος A)NTI/DIKOS antídikos an-tid'-ee-kos from G473 and G1349; an opponent (in a lawsuit); specially, Satan (as the arch-enemy):--adversary.
entries.477: ἀντίθεσις A)NTI/QESIS antíthesis an-tith'-es-is from a compound of G473 and G5087; opposition, i.e. a conflict (of theories):--opposition.
entries.478: ἀντικαθίστημι A)NTIKAQI/STHMI antikathístēmi an-tee-kath-is'-tay-mee from G473 and G2525; to set down (troops) against, i.e. withstand:--resist.
entries.479: ἀντικαλέω A)NTIKALE/W antikaléō an-tee-kal-eh'-o from G473 and G2564; to invite in return:--bid again.
entries.480: ἀντίκειμαι A)NTI/KEIMAI antíkeimai an-tik'-i-mahee from G473 and G2749; to lie opposite, i.e. be adverse (figuratively, repugnant) to:--adversary, be contrary, oppose.
entries.481: ἀντικρύ A)NTIKRU/ antikrý an-tee-kroo' prolonged from G473; opposite:--over against.
entries.482: ἀντιλαμβάνομαι A)NTILAMBA/NOMAI antilambánomai an-tee-lam-ban'-om-ahee from G473 and the middle voice of G2983; to take hold of in turn, i.e. succor; also to participate:--help, partaker, support.
entries.483: ἀντιλέγω A)NTILE/GW antilégō an-til'-eg-o from G473 and G3004; to dispute, refuse:--answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay(-er), speak against.
entries.484: ἀντίληψις A)NTI/LHYIS antílēpsis an-til'-ape-sis from G482; relief:--help.
entries.485: ἀντιλογία A)NTILOGI/A antilogía an-tee-log-ee'-ah from a derivative of G483; dispute, disobedience:--contradiction, gainsaying, strife.
entries.486: ἀντιλοιδορέω A)NTILOIDORE/W antiloidoréō an-tee-loy-dor-eh'-o from G473 and G3058; to rail in reply:--revile again.
entries.487: ἀντίλυτρον A)NTI/LUTRON antílytron an-til'-oo-tron from G473 and G3083; a redemption-price:--ransom.
entries.488: ἀντιμετρέω A)NTIMETRE/W antimetréō an-tee-met-reh'-o from G473 and G3354; to mete in return:--measure again.
entries.489: ἀντιμισθία A)NTIMISQI/A antimisthía an-tee-mis-thee'-ah from a compound of G473 and G3408; requital, correspondence:--recompense.
entries.490: Ἀντιόχεια *)ANTIO/XEIA Antiócheia an-tee-okh'-i-ah from Ἀντίοχυς *)ANTI/OXUS Antíochys (a Syrian king); Antiochia, a place in Syria:--Antioch.
entries.491: Ἀντιοχεύς *)ANTIOXEU/S Antiocheús an-tee-okh-yoos' from G490; an Antiochian or inhabitant of Antiochia:--of Antioch.
entries.492: ἀντιπαρέρχομαι A)NTIPARE/RXOMAI antiparérchomai an-tee-par-er'-khom-ahee from G473 and G3928; to go along opposite:--pass by on the other side.
entries.493: Ἀντίπας *)ANTI/PAS Antípas an-tee'-pas contracted for a compound of G473 and a derivative of G3962; Antipas, a Christian:--Antipas.
entries.494: Ἀντιπατρίς *)ANTIPATRI/S Antipatrís an-tip-at-rece' from the same as G493; Antipatris, a place in Palestine:--Antipatris.
entries.495: ἀντιπέραν A)NTIPE/RAN antipéran an-tee-per'-an from G473 and G4008; on the opposite side:--over against.
entries.496: ἀντιπίπτω A)NTIPI/PTW antipíptō an-tee-pip'-to from G473 and G4098 (including its alternate); to oppose:--resist.
entries.497: ἀντιστρατεύομαι A)NTISTRATEU/OMAI antistrateúomai an-tee-strat-yoo'-om-ahee from G473 and G4754; (figuratively) to attack, i.e. (by implication) destroy:--war against.
entries.498: ἀντιτάσσομαι A)NTITA/SSOMAI antitássomai an-tee-tas'-som-ahee from G473 and the middle voice of G5021; to range oneself against, i.e. oppose:--oppose themselves, resist.
entries.499: ἀντίτυπον A)NTI/TUPON antítypon an-teet'-oo-pon neuter of a compound of G473 and G5179; corresponding ("antitype"), i.e. a representative, counterpart:--(like) figure (whereunto).
entries.500: ἀντίχριστος A)NTI/XRISTOS antíchristos an-tee'-khris-tos from G473 and G5547; an opponent of the Messiah:--antichrist.
entries.501: ἀντλέω A)NTLE/W antléō ant-leh-o from ἄντλος A)/NTLOS ántlos (the hold of a ship); to bale up (properly, bilge water), i.e. dip water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.):--draw (out).
entries.502: ἄντλημα A)/NTLHMA ántlēma ant'-lay-mah from G501; a baling-vessel:--thing to draw with.
entries.503: ἀντοφθαλμέω A)NTOFQALME/W antophthalméō ant-of-thal-meh'-o from a compound of G473 and G3788; to face:--bear up into.
entries.504: ἄνυδρος A)/NUDROS ánydros an'-oo-dros from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5204; waterless, i.e. dry:--dry, without water.
entries.505: ἀνυπόκριτος A)NUPO/KRITOS anypókritos an-oo-pok'-ree-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5271; undissembled, i.e. sincere:--without dissimulation (hypocrisy), unfeigned.
entries.506: ἀνυπότακτος A)NUPO/TAKTOS anypótaktos an-oo-pot'-ak-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5293; unsubdued, i.e. insubordinate (in fact or temper):--disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.
entries.507: ἄνω A)/NW ánō an'-o adverb from G473; upward or on the top:--above, brim, high, up.
entries.508: ἀνώγεον A)NW/GEON anṓgeon an-ogue'-eh-on from G507 and G1093; above the ground, i.e. (properly) the second floor of a building; used for a dome or a balcony on the upper story:--upper room.
entries.509: ἄνωθεν A)/NWQEN ánōthen an'-o-then from G507; from above; by analogy, from the first; by implication, anew:--from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top.
entries.510: ἀνωτερικός A)NWTERIKO/S anōterikós an-o-ter-ee-kos' from G511; superior, i.e. (locally) more remote:--upper.
entries.511: ἀνώτερος A)NW/TEROS anṓteros an-o'-ter-os comparative degree of G507; upper, i.e. (neuter as adverb) to a more conspicuous place, in a former part of the book:--above, higher.
entries.512: ἀνωφελής A)NWFELH/S anōphelḗs an-o-fel'-ace from G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G5624; useless or (neuter) inutility:--unprofitable(-ness).
entries.513: ἀξίνη A)CI/NH axínē ax-ee'-nay probably from ἄγνυμι A)/GNUMI ágnymi (to break; compare G4486); an axe:--axe.
entries.514: ἄξιος A)/CIOS áxios ax'-ee-os probably from G71; deserving, comparable or suitable (as if drawing praise):--due reward, meet, (un-)worthy.
entries.515: ἀξιόω A)CIO/W axióō ax-ee-o'-o from G514; to deem entitled or fit:--desire, think good, count (think) worthy.
entries.516: ἀξίως A)CI/WS axíōs ax-ee'-oce adverb from G514; appropriately:--as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily(-thy).
entries.517: ἀόρατος A)O/RATOS aóratos ah-or'-at-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3707; invisible:--invisible (thing).
entries.518: ἀπαγγέλλω A)PAGGE/LLW apangéllō ap-ang-el'-lo from G575 and the base of G32; to announce:--bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell.
entries.519: ἀπάγχομαι A)PA/GXOMAI apánchomai ap-ang'-khom-ahee from G575 and ἄγχω A)/GXW ánchō (to choke; akin to the base of G43); to strangle oneself off (i.e. to death):--hang himself.
entries.520: ἀπάγω A)PA/GW apágō ap-ag'-o from G575 and G71; to take off (in various senses):--bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away.
entries.521: ἀπαίδευτος A)PAI/DEUTOS apaídeutos ap-ah'-ee-dyoo-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3811; uninstructed, i.e. (figuratively) stupid:--unlearned.
entries.522: ἀπαίρω A)PAI/RW apaírō ap-ah'-ee-ro from G575 and G142; to lift off, i.e. remove:--take (away).
entries.523: ἀπαιτέω A)PAITE/W apaitéō ap-ah'-ee-teh-o from G575 and G154; to demand back:--ask again, require.
entries.524: ἀπαλγέω A)PALGE/W apalgéō ap-alg-eh'-o from G575 and ἀλγέω A)LGE/W algéō (to smart); to grieve out, i.e. become apathetic:--be past feeling.
entries.525: ἀπαλλάσσω A)PALLA/SSW apallássō ap-al-las'-so from G575 and G236; to change away, i.e. release, (reflexively) remove:--deliver, depart.
entries.526: ἀπαλλοτριόω A)PALLOTRIO/W apallotrióō ap-al-lot-ree-o'-o from G575 and a derivative of G245; to estrange away, i.e. (passively and figuratively) to be non-participant:-- alienate, be alien.
entries.527: ἀπαλός A)PALO/S apalós ap-al-os' of uncertain derivation; soft:--tender.
entries.528: ἀπαντάω A)PANTA/W apantáō ap-an-tah'-o from G575 and a derivative of G473; to meet away, i.e. encounter:--meet.
entries.529: ἀπάντησις A)PA/NTHSIS apántēsis ap-an'-tay-sis from G528; a (friendly) encounter:--meet.
entries.530: ἅπαξ A(/PAC hápax hap'-ax probably from G537; one (or a single) time (numerically or conclusively):--once.
entries.531: ἀπαράβατος A)PARA/BATOS aparábatos ap-ar-ab'-at-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3845; not passing away, i.e. untransferable (perpetual):-- unchangeable.
entries.532: ἀπαρασκεύαστος A)PARASKEU/ASTOS aparaskeúastos ap-ar-ask-yoo'-as-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G3903; unready:--unprepared.
