entries.533: ἀπαρνέομαι A)PARNE/OMAI aparnéomai ap-ar-neh'-om-ahee from G575 and G720; to deny utterly, i.e. disown, abstain:--deny.
entries.534: ἀπάρτι A)PA/RTI apárti ap-ar'-tee from G575 and G737; from now, i.e. henceforth (already):--from henceforth.
entries.535: ἀπαρτισμός A)PARTISMO/S apartismós ap-ar-tis-mos' from a derivative of G534; completion:--finishing.
entries.536: ἀπαρχή A)PARXH/ aparchḗ ap-ar-khay' from a compound of G575 and G756; a beginning of sacrifice, i.e. the (Jewish) first-fruit (figuratively):--first-fruits.
entries.537: ἅπας A(/PAS hápas hap'-as from G1 (as a particle of union) and G3956; absolutely all or (singular) every one:--all (things), every (one), whole.
entries.538: ἀπατάω A)PATA/W apatáō ap-at-ah'-o of uncertain derivation; to cheat, i.e. delude:--deceive.
entries.539: ἀπάτη A)PA/TH apátē ap-at'-ay from G538; delusion:--deceit(-ful, -fulness), deceivableness(-ving).
entries.540: ἀπάτωρ A)PA/TWR apátōr ap-at'-ore from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3962; fatherless, i.e. of unrecorded paternity:--without father.
entries.541: ἀπαύγασμα A)PAU/GASMA apaúgasma ap-ow'-gas-mah from a compound of G575 and G826; an off-flash, i.e. effulgence:--brightness.
entries.542: ἀπείδω A)PEI/DW apeídō ap-i'-do from G575 and the same as G1492; to see fully:--see.
entries.543: ἀπείθεια A)PEI/QEIA apeítheia ap-i'-thi-ah from G545; disbelief (obstinate and rebellious):--disobedience, unbelief.
entries.544: ἀπειθέω A)PEIQE/W apeithéō ap-i-theh'-o from G545; to disbelieve (wilfully and perversely):--not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving.
entries.545: ἀπειθής A)PEIQH/S apeithḗs ap-i-thace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3982; unpersuadable, i.e. contumacious:--disobedient.
entries.546: ἀπειλέω A)PEILE/W apeiléō ap-i-leh'-o of uncertain derivation; to menace; by implication, to forbid:--threaten.
entries.547: ἀπειλή A)PEILH/ apeilḗ ap-i-lay' from G546; a menace:--X straitly, threatening.
entries.548: ἄπειμι A)/PEIMI ápeimi ap'-i-mee from G575 and G1510; to be away:--be absent. Compare G549.
entries.549: ἄπειμι A)/PEIMI ápeimi ap'-i-mee from G575 and εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi (to go); to go away:--go. Compare G548.
entries.550: ἀπειπόμην A)PEIPO/MHN apeipómēn ap-i-pom'-ane reflexive past of a compound of G575 and G2036; to say off for oneself, i.e. disown:--renounce.
entries.551: ἀπείραστος A)PEI/RASTOS apeírastos ap-i'-ras-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G3987; untried, i.e. not temptable:--not to be tempted.
entries.552: ἄπειρος A)/PEIROS ápeiros ap'-i-ros from G1 (as a negative particle) and G3984; inexperienced, i.e. ignorant:--unskilful.
entries.553: ἀπεκδέχομαι A)PEKDE/XOMAI apekdéchomai ap-ek-dekh'-om-ahee from G575 and G1551; to expect fully:--look (wait) for.
entries.554: ἀπεκδύομαι A)PEKDU/OMAI apekdýomai ap-ek-doo'-om-ahee middle voice from G575 and G1562; to divest wholly oneself, or (for oneself) despoil:--put off, spoil.
entries.555: ἀπέκδυσις A)PE/KDUSIS apékdysis ap-ek'-doo-sis from G554; divestment:--putting off.
entries.556: ἀπελαύνω A)PELAU/NW apelaúnō ap-el-ow'-no from G575 and G1643; to dismiss:--drive.
entries.557: ἀπελεγμός A)PELEGMO/S apelegmós ap-el-eg-mos' from a compound of G575 and G1651; refutation, i.e. (by implication) contempt:--nought.
entries.558: ἀπελεύθερος A)PELEU/QEROS apeleútheros ap-el-yoo'-ther-os from G575 and G1658; one freed away, i.e. a freedman:--freeman.
entries.559: Ἀπελλῆς *)APELLH=S Apellēs ap-el-lace' of Latin origin; Apelles, a Christian:--Apelles.
entries.560: ἀπελπίζω A)PELPI/ZW apelpízō ap-el-pid'-zo from G575 and G1679; to hope out, i.e. fully expect:--hope for again.
entries.561: ἀπέναντι A)PE/NANTI apénanti ap-en'-an-tee from G575 and G1725; from in front, i.e. opposite, before or against:--before, contrary, over against, in the presence of.
entries.562: ἀπέραντος A)PE/RANTOS apérantos ap-er'-an-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of G4008; unfinished, i.e. (by implication) interminable:--endless.
entries.563: ἀπερισπάστως A)PERISPA/STWS aperispástōs ap-er-is-pas-toce' adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4049; undistractedly, i.e. free from (domestic) solicitude:--without distraction.
entries.564: ἀπερίτμητος A)PERI/TMHTOS aperítmētos ap-er-eet'-may-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4059; uncircumcised (figuratively):--uncircumcised.
entries.565: ἀπέρχομαι A)PE/RXOMAI apérchomai ap-erkh'-om-ahee from G575 and G2064; to go off (i.e. depart), aside (i.e. apart) or behind (i.e. follow), literally or figuratively:--come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, … ways), pass away, be past.
entries.566: ἀπέχει A)PE/XEI apéchei ap-ekh'-i third person singular present indicative active of G568 used impersonally; it is sufficient:--it is enough.
entries.567: ἀπέχομαι A)PE/XOMAI apéchomai ap-ekh'-om-ahee middle voice (reflexively) of G568; to hold oneself off, i.e. refrain:--abstain.
entries.568: ἀπέχω A)PE/XW apéchō ap-ekh'-o from G575 and G2192; (actively) to have out, i.e. receive in full; (intransitively) to keep (oneself) away, i.e. be distant (literally or figuratively):--be, have, receive.
entries.569: ἀπιστέω A)PISTE/W apistéō ap-is-teh'-o from G571; to be unbelieving, i.e. (transitively) disbelieve, or (by implication) disobey:--believe not.
entries.570: ἀπιστία A)PISTI/A apistía ap-is-tee'-ah from G571; faithlessness, i.e. (negatively) disbelief (lack of Christian faith), or (positively) unfaithfulness (disobedience):--unbelief.
entries.571: ἄπιστος A)/PISTOS ápistos ap'-is-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4103; (actively) disbelieving, i.e. without Christian faith (specially, a heathen); (passively) untrustworthy (person), or incredible (thing):--that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever(-ing).
entries.572: ἁπλότης A(PLO/THS haplótēs hap-lot'-ace from G573; singleness, i.e. (subjectively) sincerity (without dissimulation or self-seeking), or (objectively) generosity (copious bestowal):--bountifulness, liberal(-ity), simplicity, singleness.
entries.573: ἁπλοῦς A(PLOU=S haploûs hap-looce' probably from G1 (as a particle of union) and the base of G4120; properly, folded together, i.e. single (figuratively, clear):--single.
entries.574: ἁπλῶς A(PLW=S haplōs hap-loce' adverb from G573 (in the objective sense of G572); bountifully; --liberally.
entries.575: ἀπό A)PO/ apó apo' a primary particle; "off," i.e. away (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literal or figurative):--(X here-)after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for(-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-)on(-ce), since, with. In composition (as a prefix) it usually denotes separation, departure, cessation, completion, reversal, etc.
entries.576: ἀποβαίνω A)POBAI/NW apobaínō ap-ob-ah'-ee-no from G575 and the base of G939; literally, to disembark; figuratively, to eventuate:--become, go out, turn.
entries.577: ἀποβάλλω A)POBA/LLW apobállō ap-ob-al'-lo from G575 and G906; to throw off; figuratively, to lose:--cast away.
entries.578: ἀποβλέπω A)POBLE/PW apoblépō ap-ob-lep'-o from G575 and G991; to look away from everything else, i.e. (figuratively) intently regard:--have respect.
entries.579: ἀπόβλητος A)PO/BLHTOS apóblētos ap-ob'-lay-tos from G577; cast off, i.e. (figuratively) such as to be rejected:--be refused.
entries.580: ἀποβολή A)POBOLH/ apobolḗ ap-ob-ol-ay' from G577; rejection; figuratively, loss:--casting away, loss.
entries.581: ἀπογενόμενος A)POGENO/MENOS apogenómenos ap-og-en-om'-en-os past participle of a compound of G575 and G1096; absent, i.e. deceased (figuratively, renounced):--being dead.
entries.582: ἀπογραφή A)POGRAFH/ apographḗ ap-og-raf-ay' from G583; an enrollment; by implication, an assessment:--taxing.
entries.583: ἀπογράφω A)POGRA/FW apográphō ap-og-raf'-o from G575 and G1125; to write off (a copy or list), i.e. enrol:--tax, write.
entries.584: ἀποδείκνυμι A)PODEI/KNUMI apodeíknymi ap-od-ike'-noo-mee from G575 and G1166; to show off, i.e. exhibit; figuratively, to demonstrate, i.e. accredit:--(ap-)prove, set forth, shew.
entries.585: ἀπόδειξις A)PO/DEICIS apódeixis ap-od'-ike-sis from G584; manifestation:--demonstration.
entries.586: ἀποδεκατόω A)PODEKATO/W apodekatóō ap-od-ek-at-o'-o from G575 and G1183; to tithe (as debtor or creditor):--(give, pay, take) tithe.
entries.587: ἀπόδεκτος A)PO/DEKTOS apódektos ap-od'-ek-tos from G588; accepted, i.e. agreeable:--acceptable.
entries.588: ἀποδέχομαι A)PODE/XOMAI apodéchomai ap-od-ekh'-om-ahee from G575 and G1209; to take fully, i.e. welcome (persons), approve (things):--accept, receive (gladly).
entries.589: ἀποδημέω A)PODHME/W apodēméō ap-od-ay-meh'-o from G590; to go abroad, i.e. visit a foreign land:--go (travel) into a far country, journey.
entries.590: ἀπόδημος A)PO/DHMOS apódēmos ap-od'-ay-mos from G575 and G1218; absent from one's own people, i.e. a foreign traveller:--taking a far journey.
entries.591: ἀποδίδωμι A)PODI/DWMI apodídōmi ap-od-eed'-o-mee from G575 and G1325; to give away, i.e. up, over, back, etc. (in various applications):--deliver (again), give (again), (re-)pay(-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield.
entries.592: ἀποδιορίζω A)PODIORI/ZW apodiorízō ap-od-ee-or-id'-zo from G575 and a compound of G1223 and G3724; to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively, a party):--separate.
entries.593: ἀποδοκιμάζω A)PODOKIMA/ZW apodokimázō ap-od-ok-ee-mad'-zo from G575 and G1381; to disapprove, i.e. (by implication) to repudiate:--disallow, reject.
entries.594: ἀποδοχή A)PODOXH/ apodochḗ ap-od-okh-ay' from G588; acceptance:--acceptation.
entries.595: ἀπόθεσις A)PO/QESIS apóthesis ap-oth'-es-is from G659; a laying aside (literally or figuratively):--putting away (off).
entries.596: ἀποθήκη A)POQH/KH apothḗkē ap-oth-ay'-kay from G659; a repository, i.e. granary:--barn, garner.
entries.597: ἀποθησαυρίζω A)POQHSAURI/ZW apothēsaurízō ap-oth-ay-sow-rid'-zo from G575 and G2343; to treasure away:--lay up in store.
entries.598: ἀποθλίβω A)POQLI/BW apothlíbō ap-oth-lee'-bo from G575 and G2346; to crowd (from every side):--press.
entries.599: ἀποθνήσκω A)POQNH/SKW apothnḗskō ap-oth-nace'-ko from G575 and G2348; to die off (literally or figuratively):--be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).
entries.600: ἀποκαθίστημι A)POKAQI/STHMI apokathístēmi ap-ok-ath-is'-tay-mee from G575 and G2525; to reconstitute (in health, home or organization):--restore (again).
entries.601: ἀποκαλύπτω A)POKALU/PTW apokalýptō ap-ok-al-oop'-to from G575 and G2572; to take off the cover, i.e. disclose:--reveal.
entries.602: ἀποκάλυψις A)POKA/LUYIS apokálypsis ap-ok-al'-oop-sis from G601; disclosure:--appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation.
entries.603: ἀποκαραδοκία A)POKARADOKI/A apokaradokía ap-ok-ar-ad-ok-ee'-ah from a compound of G575 and a compound of κάρα KA/RA kára (the head) and G1380 (in the sense of watching); intense anticipation:--earnest expectation.
entries.604: ἀποκαταλλάσσω A)POKATALLA/SSW apokatallássō ap-ok-at-al-las'-so from G575 and G2644; to reconcile fully:--reconcile.
entries.605: ἀποκατάστασις A)POKATA/STASIS apokatástasis ap-ok-at-as'-tas-is from G600; reconstitution:--restitution.
entries.606: ἀπόκειμαι A)PO/KEIMAI apókeimai ap-ok'-i-mahee from G575 and G2749; to be reserved; figuratively, to await:--be appointed, (be) laid up.
entries.607: ἀποκεφαλίζω A)POKEFALI/ZW apokephalízō ap-ok-ef-al-id'-zo from G575 and G2776; to decapitate:--behead.
entries.608: ἀποκλείω A)POKLEI/W apokleíō ap-ok-li'-o from G575 and G2808; to close fully:--shut up.
entries.609: ἀποκόπτω A)POKO/PTW apokóptō ap-ok-op'-to from G575 and G2875; to amputate; reflexively (by irony) to mutilate (the privy parts):--cut off. Compare G2699.
entries.610: ἀπόκριμα A)PO/KRIMA apókrima ap-ok'-ree-mah from G611 (in its original sense of judging); a judicial decision:--sentence.
entries.611: ἀποκρίνομαι A)POKRI/NOMAI apokrínomai ap-ok-ree'-nom-ahee from G575 and κρίνω KRI/NW krínō; to conclude for oneself, i.e. (by implication) to respond; by Hebraism (compare H06030) to begin to speak (where an address is expected):--answer.
entries.612: ἀπόκρισις A)PO/KRISIS apókrisis ap-ok'-ree-sis from G611; a response:--answer.
entries.613: ἀποκρύπτω A)POKRU/PTW apokrýptō ap-ok-roop'-to from G575 and G2928; to conceal away (i.e. fully); figuratively, to keep secret:--hide.
entries.614: ἀπόκρυφος A)PO/KRUFOS apókryphos ap-ok'-roo-fos from G613; secret; by implication, treasured:--hid, kept secret.
entries.615: ἀποκτείνω A)POKTEI/NW apokteínō ap-ok-ti'-no from G575 and κτείνω KTEI/NW kteínō (to slay); to kill outright; figuratively, to destroy:--put to death, kill, slay.
entries.616: ἀποκυέω A)POKUE/W apokyéō ap-ok-oo-eh'-o from G575 and the base of G2949; to breed forth, i.e. (by transference) to generate (figuratively):--beget, produce.
entries.617: ἀποκυλίω A)POKULI/W apokylíō ap-ok-oo-lee'-o from G575 and G2947; to roll away:--roll away (back).
entries.618: ἀπολαμβάνω A)POLAMBA/NW apolambánō ap-ol-am-ban'-o from G575 and G2983; to receive (specially, in full, or as a host); also to take aside:--receive, take.
entries.619: ἀπόλαυσις A)PO/LAUSIS apólausis ap-ol'-ow-sis from a compound of G575 and λαύω LAU/W laúō (to enjoy); full enjoyment:--enjoy(-ment).
entries.620: ἀπολείπω A)POLEI/PW apoleípō ap-ol-ipe'-o from G575 and G3007; to leave behind (passively, remain); by implication, to forsake:--leave, remain.
entries.621: ἀπολείχω A)POLEI/XW apoleíchō ap-ol-i'-kho from G575 and λείχω LEI/XW leíchō (to "lick"); to lick clean:--lick.
entries.622: ἀπόλλυμι A)PO/LLUMI apóllymi ap-ol'-loo-mee from G575 and the base of G3639; to destroy fully (reflexively, to perish, or lose), literally or figuratively:--destroy, die, lose, mar, perish.
entries.623: Ἀπολλύων *)APOLLU/WN Apollýōn ap-ol-loo'-ohn active participle of G622; a destroyer (i.e. Satan):--Apollyon.
entries.624: Ἀπολλωνία *)APOLLWNI/A Apollōnía ap-ol-lo-nee'-ah from the pagan deity Ἀπόλλων *)APO/LLWN Apóllōn (i.e. the sun; from G622); Apollonia, a place in Macedonia:--Apollonia.
entries.625: Ἀπολλῶς *)APOLLW=S Apollōs ap-ol-loce' probably from the same as G624; Apollos, an Israelite:--Apollos.
entries.626: ἀπολογέομαι A)POLOGE/OMAI apologéomai ap-ol-og-eh'-om-ahee middle voice from a compound of G575 and G3056; to give an account (legal plea) of oneself, i.e. exculpate (self):--answer (for self), make defence, excuse (self), speak for self.
entries.627: ἀπολογία A)POLOGI/A apología ap-ol-og-ee'-ah from the same as G626; a plea ("apology"):--answer (for self), clearing of self, defence.
entries.628: ἀπολούω A)POLOU/W apoloúō ap-ol-oo'-o from G575 and G3068; to wash fully, i.e. (figuratively) have remitted (reflexively):--wash (away).
entries.629: ἀπολύτρωσις A)POLU/TRWSIS apolýtrōsis ap-ol-oo'-tro-sis from a compound of G575 and G3083; (the act) ransom in full, i.e. (figuratively) riddance, or (specially) Christian salvation:--deliverance, redemption.
entries.630: ἀπολύω A)POLU/W apolýō ap-ol-oo'-o from G575 and G3089; to free fully, i.e. (literally) relieve, release, dismiss (reflexively, depart), or (figuratively) let die, pardon or (specially) divorce:--(let) depart, dismiss, divorce, forgive, let go, loose, put (send) away, release, set at liberty.
entries.631: ἀπομάσσομαι A)POMA/SSOMAI apomássomai ap-om-as'-som-ahee middle voice from G575 and μάσσω MA/SSW mássō (to squeeze, knead, smear); to scrape away:--wipe off.
entries.632: ἀπονέμω A)PONE/MW aponémō ap-on-em'-o from G575 and the base of G3551; to apportion, i.e. bestow:--give.
entries.633: ἀπονίπτω A)PONI/PTW aponíptō ap-on-ip'-to from G575 and G3538; to wash off (reflexively, one's own hands symbolically):--wash.
entries.634: ἀποπίπτω A)POPI/PTW apopíptō ap-op-ip'-to from G575 and G4098; to fall off:--fall.
entries.635: ἀποπλανάω A)POPLANA/W apoplanáō ap-op-lan-ah'-o from G575 and G4105; to lead astray (figuratively); passively, to stray (from truth):--err, seduce.
entries.636: ἀποπλέω A)POPLE/W apopléō ap-op-leh'-o from G575 and G4126; to set sail:--sail away.
entries.637: ἀποπλύνω A)POPLU/NW apoplýnō ap-op-loo'-no from G575 and G4150; to rinse off:--wash.
entries.638: ἀποπνίγω A)POPNI/GW apopnígō ap-op-nee'-go from G575 and G4155; to stifle (by drowning or overgrowth):--choke.
entries.639: ἀπορέω A)PORE/W aporéō ap-or-eh'-o from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G4198; to have no way out, i.e. be at a loss (mentally):-- (stand in) doubt, be perplexed.
entries.640: ἀπορία A)PORI/A aporía ap-or-ee'-a from the same as G639; a (state of) quandary:--perplexity.
entries.641: ἀποῤῥίπτω A)POR)R(I/PTW aporrhíptō ap-or-hrip'-to from G575 and G4496; to hurl off, i.e. precipitate (oneself):--cast.
entries.642: ἀπορφανίζω A)PORFANI/ZW aporphanízō ap-or-fan-id'-zo from G575 and a derivative of G3737; to bereave wholly, i.e. (figuratively) separate (from intercourse):--take.
entries.643: ἀποσκευάζω A)POSKEUA/ZW aposkeuázō ap-osk-yoo-ad'-zo from G575 and a derivative of G4632; to pack up (one's) baggage:--take up… carriages.
entries.644: ἀποσκίασμα A)POSKI/ASMA aposkíasma ap-os-kee'-as-mah from a compound of G575 and a derivative of G4639; a shading off, i.e. obscuration:--shadow.
entries.645: ἀποσπάω A)POSPA/W apospáō ap-os-pah'-o from G575 and G4685; to drag forth, i.e. (literally) unsheathe (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) retire (personally or factiously):--(with-)draw (away), after we were gotten from.
entries.646: ἀποστασία A)POSTASI/A apostasía ap-os-tas-ee'-ah feminine of the same as G647; defection from truth (properly, the state) ("apostasy"):--falling away, forsake.
entries.647: ἀποστάσιον A)POSTA/SION apostásion ap-os-tas'-ee-on neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of G868; properly, something separative, i.e. (specially) divorce:--(writing of) divorcement.
entries.648: ἀποστεγάζω A)POSTEGA/ZW apostegázō ap-os-teg-ad'-zo from G575 and a derivative of G4721; to unroof:--uncover.
entries.649: ἀποστέλλω A)POSTE/LLW apostéllō ap-os-tel'-lo from G575 and G4724; set apart, i.e. (by implication) to send out (properly, on a mission) literally or figuratively:--put in, send (away, forth, out), set (at liberty).
entries.650: ἀποστερέω A)POSTERE/W aposteréō ap-os-ter-eh'-o from G575 and στερέω STERE/W steréō (to deprive); to despoil:--defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud.
entries.651: ἀποστολή A)POSTOLH/ apostolḗ ap-os-tol-ay' from G649; commission, i.e. (specially) apostolate:--apostleship.
entries.652: ἀπόστολος A)PO/STOLOS apóstolos ap-os'-tol-os from G649; a delegate; specially, an ambassador of the Gospel; officially a commissioner of Christ ("apostle") (with miraculous powers):--apostle, messenger, he that is sent.
entries.653: ἀποστοματίζω A)POSTOMATI/ZW apostomatízō ap-os-tom-at-id'-zo from G575 and a (presumed) derivative of G4750; to speak off-hand (properly, dictate), i.e. to catechize (in an invidious manner):--provoke to speak.
entries.654: ἀποστρέφω A)POSTRE/FW apostréphō ap-os-tref'-o from G575 and G4762; to turn away or back (literally or figuratively):--bring again, pervert, turn away (from).
entries.655: ἀποστυγέω A)POSTUGE/W apostygéō ap-os-toog-eh'-o from G575 and the base of G4767; to detest utterly:--abhor.
entries.656: ἀποσυνάγωγος A)POSUNA/GWGOS aposynágōgos ap-os-oon-ag'-o-gos from G575 and G4864; excommunicated:--(put) out of the synagogue(-s).
entries.657: ἀποτάσσομαι A)POTA/SSOMAI apotássomai ap-ot-as'-som-ahee middle voice from G575 and G5021; literally, to say adieu (by departing or dismissing); figuratively, to renounce:--bid farewell, forsake, take leave, send away.
entries.658: ἀποτελέω A)POTELE/W apoteléō ap-ot-el-eh'-o from G575 and G5055; to complete entirely, i.e. consummate:--finish.
entries.659: ἀποτίθημι A)POTI/QHMI apotíthēmi ap-ot-eeth'-ay-mee from G575 and G5087; to put away (literally or figuratively):--cast off, lay apart (aside, down), put away (off).
entries.660: ἀποτινάσσω A)POTINA/SSW apotinássō ap-ot-in-as'-so from G575 and τινάσσω TINA/SSW tinássō (to jostle); to brush off:--shake off.
entries.661: ἀποτίνω A)POTI/NW apotínō ap-ot-ee'-no from G575 and G5099; to pay in full:--repay.
entries.662: ἀποτολμάω A)POTOLMA/W apotolmáō ap-ot-ol-mah'-o from G575 and G5111; to venture plainly:--be very bold.
entries.663: ἀποτομία A)POTOMI/A apotomía ap-ot-om-ee'-ah from the base of G664; (figuratively) decisiveness, i.e. rigor:--severity.
entries.664: ἀποτόμως A)POTO/MWS apotómōs ap-ot-om'-oce adverb from a derivative of a comparative of G575 and τέμνω TE/MNW témnō (to cut); abruptly, i.e. peremptorily:--sharply(-ness).
entries.665: ἀποτρέπω A)POTRE/PW apotrépō ap-ot-rep'-o from G575 and the base of G5157; to deflect, i.e. (reflexively) avoid:--turn away.
entries.666: ἀπουσία A)POUSI/A apousía ap-oo-see'-ah from the participle of G548; a being away:--absence.
entries.667: ἀποφέρω A)POFE/RW apophérō ap-of-er'-o from G575 and G5342; to bear off (literally or relatively):--bring, carry (away).
entries.668: ἀποφεύγω A)POFEU/GW apopheúgō ap-of-yoo'-go from G575 and G5343; (figuratively) to escape:--escape.
entries.669: ἀποφθέγγομαι A)POFQE/GGOMAI apophthéngomai ap-of-theng'-om-ahee from G575 and G5350; to enunciate plainly, i.e. declare:--say, speak forth, utterance.
entries.670: ἀποφορτίζομαι A)POFORTI/ZOMAI apophortízomai ap-of-or-tid'-zom-ahee from G575 and the middle voice of G5412; to unload:--unlade.
entries.671: ἀπόχρησις A)PO/XRHSIS apóchrēsis ap-okh'-ray-sis from a compound of G575 and G5530; the act of using up, i.e. consumption:--using.
entries.672: ἀποχωρέω A)POXWRE/W apochōréō ap-okh-o-reh'-o from G575 and G5562; to go away:--depart.
entries.673: ἀποχωρίζω A)POXWRI/ZW apochōrízō ap-okh-o-rid'-zo from G575 and G5563; to rend apart; reflexively, to separate:--depart (asunder).
entries.674: ἀποψύχω A)POYU/XW apopsýchō ap-ops-oo'-kho from G575 and G5594; to breathe out, i.e. faint:--hearts failing.
entries.675: Ἄππιος *)/APPIOS Áppios ap'-pee-os of Latin origin; (in the genitive, i.e. possessive case) of Appius, the name of a Roman:--Appii.
entries.676: ἀπρόσιτος A)PRO/SITOS aprósitos ap-ros'-ee-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of G4314 and εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi (to go); inaccessible:--which no man can approach.
entries.677: ἀπρόσκοπος A)PRO/SKOPOS apróskopos ap-ros'-kop-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4350; actively, inoffensive, i.e. not leading into sin; passively, faultless, i.e. not led into sin:--none (void of, without) offence.
entries.678: ἀπροσωπολήπτως A)PROSWPOLH/PTWS aprosōpolḗptōs ap-ros-o-pol-ape'-tos adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of G4383 and G2983 (compare G4381); in a way not accepting the person, i.e. impartially:--without respect of persons.
entries.679: ἄπταιστος A)/PTAISTOS áptaistos ap-tah'-ee-stos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4417; not stumbling, i.e. (figuratively) without sin:--from falling.
entries.680: ἅπτομαι A(/PTOMAI háptomai hap'-tom-ahee reflexive of G681; properly, to attach oneself to, i.e. to touch (in many implied relations):--touch.
entries.681: ἅπτω A(/PTW háptō hap'-to a primary verb; properly, to fasten to, i.e. (specially) to set on fire:--kindle, light.
entries.682: Ἀπφία *)APFI/A Apphía ap-fee'-a probably of foreign origin; Apphia, a woman of Collosæ:--Apphia.
entries.683: ἀπωθέομαι A)PWQE/OMAI apōthéomai ap-o-theh'-om-ahee or ἀπώθομαι A)PW/QOMAI apṓthomai ap-o'-thom-ahee from G575 and the middle voice of ὠθέω W)QE/W ōthéō or ὤθω W)/QW ṓthō (to shove); to push off, figuratively, to reject:--cast away, put away (from), thrust away (from).
entries.684: ἀπώλεια A)PW/LEIA apṓleia ap-o'-li-a from a presumed derivative of G622; ruin or loss (physical, spiritual or eternal):--damnable(-nation), destruction, die, perdition, X perish, pernicious ways, waste.
entries.685: ἀρά A)RA/ ará ar-ah' probably from G142; properly, prayer (as lifted to Heaven), i.e. (by implication) imprecation:--curse.
entries.686: ἄρα A)/RA ára ar'-ah probably from G142 (through the idea of drawing a conclusion); a particle denoting an inference more or less decisive (as follows):--haply, (what) manner (of man), no doubt, perhaps, so be, then, therefore, truly, wherefore. Often used in connection with other particles, especially G1065 or G3767 (after) or G1487 (before). Compare also G687.
entries.687: ἆρα A)=RA âra ar'-ah a form of G686, denoting an interrogation to which a negative answer is presumed :--therefore.
entries.688: Ἀραβία *)ARABI/A Arabía ar-ab-ee'-ah of Hebrew origin (H06152); Arabia, a region of Asia:--Arabia.
entries.689: Ἀράμ *)ARA/M Arám ar-am' of Hebrew origin (H07410); Aram (i.e. Ram), an Israelite:--Aram.
entries.690: Ἄραψ *)/ARAY Áraps ar'-aps from G688; an Arab or native of Arabia:--Arabian.
entries.691: ἀργέω A)RGE/W argéō arg-eh'-o from G692; to be idle, i.e. (figuratively) to delay:--linger.
entries.692: ἀργός A)RGO/S argós ar-gos' from G1 (as a negative particle) and G2041; inactive, i.e. unemployed; (by implication) lazy, useless:--barren, idle, slow.
entries.693: ἀργύρεος A)RGU/REOS argýreos ar-goo'-reh-os from G696; made of silver:--(of) silver.
entries.694: ἀργύριον A)RGU/RION argýrion ar-goo'-ree-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G696; silvery, i.e. (by implication) cash; specially, a silverling (i.e. drachma or shekel):--money, (piece of) silver (piece).
entries.695: ἀργυροκόπος A)RGUROKO/POS argyrokópos ar-goo-rok-op'-os from G696 and G2875; a beater (i.e. worker) of silver:--silversmith.
entries.696: ἄργυρος A)/RGUROS árgyros ar'-goo-ros from ἀργός A)RGO/S argós (shining); silver (the metal, in the articles or coin):--silver.
entries.697: Ἄρειος Πάγος *)/AREIOS *PA/GOS Áreios Págos ar'-i-os pag'-os from Ἄρης *)/ARHS Árēs (the name of the Greek deity of war) and a derivative of G4078; rock of Ares, a place in Athens:--Areopagus, Mars' Hill.
entries.698: Ἀρεοπαγίτης *)AREOPAGI/THS Areopagítēs ar-eh-op-ag-ee'-tace from G697; an Areopagite or member of the court held on Mars' Hill:--Areopagite.
entries.699: ἀρεσκεία A)RESKEI/A areskeía ar-es'-ki-ah from a derivative of G700; complaisance:--pleasing.
entries.700: ἀρέσκω A)RE/SKW aréskō ar-es'-ko probably from G142 (through the idea of exciting emotion); to be agreeable (or by implication, to seek to be so):--please.
entries.701: ἀρεστός A)RESTO/S arestós ar-es-tos' from G700; agreeable; by implication, fit:--(things that) please(-ing), reason.
entries.702: Ἀρέτας *)ARE/TAS Arétas ar-et'-as of foreign origin; Aretas, an Arabian:--Aretas.
entries.703: ἀρέτη A)RE/TH arétē ar-et'-ay from the same as G730; properly, manliness (valor), i.e. excellence (intrinsic or attributed):--praise, virtue.
entries.704: ἀρήν A)RH/N arḗn ar-ane' perhaps the same as G730; a lamb (as a male):--lamb.
entries.705: ἀριθμέω A)RIQME/W arithméō ar-ith-meh'-o from G706; to enumerate or count:--number.
entries.706: ἀριθμός A)RIQMO/S arithmós ar-ith-mos' from G142; a number (as reckoned up):--number.
entries.707: Ἀριμαθαία *)ARIMAQAI/A Arimathaía ar-ee-math-ah'-ee-ah of Hebrew origin (H07414); Arimathæa (or Ramah), a place in Palestine:--Arimathæa.
entries.708: Ἀρίσταρχος *)ARI/STARXOS Arístarchos ar-is'-tar-khos from the same as G712 and G757; best ruling; Aristarchus, a Macedonian:--Aristarchus.
entries.709: ἀριστάω A)RISTA/W aristáō ar-is-tah'-o from G712; to take the principle meal:--dine.
entries.710: ἀριστερός A)RISTERO/S aristerós ar-is-ter-os' apparently a comparative of the same as G712; the left hand (as second-best):--left (hand).
entries.711: Ἀριστόβουλος *)ARISTO/BOULOS Aristóboulos ar-is-tob'-oo-los from the same as G712 and G1012; best counselling; Aristoboulus, a Christian:--Aristobulus.
entries.712: ἄριστον A)/RISTON áriston ar'-is-ton apparently neuter of a superlative from the same as G730; the best meal (or breakfast; perhaps from ἦρι H)=RI ēri ("early")), i.e. luncheon:--dinner.
entries.713: ἀρκετός A)RKETO/S arketós ar-ket-os' from G714; satisfactory:--enough, suffice (-ient).
entries.714: ἀρκέω A)RKE/W arkéō ar-keh'-o apparently a primary verb (but probably akin to G142 through the idea of raising a barrier); properly, to ward off, i.e. (by implication) to avail (figuratively, be satisfactory):--be content, be enough, suffice, be sufficient.
entries.715: ἄρκτος A)/RKTOS árktos ark'-tos probably from G714; a bear (as obstructing by ferocity):--bear.
entries.716: ἅρμα A(/RMA hárma har'-mah probably from G142 (perhaps with G1 (as a particle of union) prefixed); a chariot (as raised or fitted together (compare G719)):--chariot.
entries.717: Ἀρμαγεδδών *)ARMAGEDDW/N Armageddṓn ar-mag-ed-dohn' of Hebrew origin (H02022 and H04023); Armageddon (or Har-Meggiddon), a symbolic name:--Armageddon.
entries.718: ἁρμόζω A(RMO/ZW harmózō har-mod'-zo from G719; to joint, i.e. (figuratively) to woo (reflexively, to betroth):--espouse.
entries.719: ἁρμός A(RMO/S harmós har-mos' from the same as G716; an articulation (of the body):--joint.
entries.720: ἀρνέομαι A)RNE/OMAI arnéomai ar-neh'-om-ahee perhaps from G1 (as a negative particle) and the middle voice of G4483; to contradict, i.e. disavow, reject, abnegate:--deny, refuse.
entries.721: ἀρνίον A)RNI/ON arníon ar-nee'-on diminutive from G704; a lambkin:--lamb.
entries.722: ἀροτριόω A)ROTRIO/W arotrióō ar-ot-ree-o'-o from G723; to plow:--plough.
entries.723: ἄροτρον A)/ROTRON árotron ar'-ot-ron from ἀρόω A)RO/W aróō (to till); a plow:--plough.
entries.724: ἁρπαγή A(RPAGH/ harpagḗ har-pag-ay' from G726; pillage (properly abstract):--extortion, ravening, spoiling.
entries.725: ἁρπαγμός A(RPAGMO/S harpagmós har-pag-mos' from G726; plunder (properly concrete):--robbery.
entries.726: ἁρπάζω A(RPA/ZW harpázō har-pad'-zo from a derivative of G138; to seize (in various applications):--catch (away, up), pluck, pull, take (by force).
entries.727: ἅρπαξ A(/RPAC hárpax har'-pax from G726; rapacious:--extortion, ravening.
entries.728: ἀῤῥαβών A)R)R(ABW/N arrhabṓn ar-hrab-ohn' of Hebrew origin (H06162); a pledge, i.e. part of the purchase-money or property given in advance as security for the rest:--earnest.
entries.729: ἄῤῥαφος A)/R)R(AFOS árrhaphos ar'-hhraf-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of the same as G4476; unsewed, i.e. of a single piece:--without seam.
entries.730: ἄῤῥην A)/R)R(HN árrhēn ar'-hrane or ἄρσην A)/RSHN ársēn ar'-sane probably from G142; male (as stronger for lifting):--male, man.
entries.731: ἄῤῥητος A)/R)R(HTOS árrhētos ar'-hray-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and the same as G4490; unsaid, i.e. (by implication) inexpressible:--unspeakable.
entries.732: ἄῤῥωστος A)/R)R(WSTOS árrhōstos ar'-hroce-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4517; infirm:--sick (folk, -ly).
entries.733: ἀρσενοκοίτης A)RSENOKOI/THS arsenokoítēs ar-sen-ok-oy'-tace from G730 and G2845; a sodomite:--abuser of (that defile) self with mankind.
entries.734: Ἀρτεμάς *)ARTEMA/S Artemás ar-tem-as' contracted from a compound of G735 and G1435; gift of Artemis; Artemas (or Artemidorus), a Christian:--Artemas.
entries.735: Ἄρτεμις *)/ARTEMIS Ártemis ar'-tem-is probably from the same as G736; prompt; Artemis, the name of a Grecian goddess borrowed by the Asiatics for one of their deities:--Diana.
entries.736: ἀρτέμων A)RTE/MWN artémōn ar-tem'-ohn from a derivative of G737; properly, something ready (or else more remotely from G142 (compare G740); something hung up), i.e. (specially) the topsail (rather foresail or jib) of a vessel:--mainsail.
entries.737: ἄρτι A)/RTI árti ar'-tee adverb from a derivative of G142 (compare G740) through the idea of suspension; just now:--this day (hour), hence(-forth), here(-after), hither(-to), (even) now, (this) present.
entries.738: ἀρτιγέννητος A)RTIGE/NNHTOS artigénnētos ar-teeg-en'-nay-tos from G737 and G1084; just born, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert:--new born.
entries.739: ἄρτιος A)/RTIOS ártios ar'-tee-os from G737; fresh, i.e. (by implication) complete:--perfect.
entries.740: ἄρτος A)/RTOS ártos ar'-tos from G142; bread (as raised) or a loaf:--(shew-)bread, loaf.
entries.741: ἀρτύω A)RTU/W artýō ar-too'-o from a presumed derivative of G142; to prepare, i.e. spice (with stimulating condiments):--season.
entries.742: Ἀρφαξάδ *)ARFACA/D Arphaxád ar-fax-ad' of Hebrew origin (H0775); Arphaxad, a post-diluvian patriarch:--Arphaxad.
entries.743: ἀρχάγγελος A)RXA/GGELOS archángelos ar-khang'-el-os from G757 and G32; a chief angel:--archangel.
entries.744: ἀρχαῖος A)RXAI=OS archaîos ar-khah'-yos from G746; original or primeval:--(them of) old (time).
entries.745: Ἀρχέλαος *)ARXE/LAOS Archélaos ar-khel'-ah-os from G757 and G2994; people-ruling; Archelaus, a Jewish king:--Archelaus.
entries.746: ἀρχή A)RXH/ archḗ ar-khay' from G756; (properly abstract) a commencement, or (concretely) chief (in various applications of order, time, place, or rank):--beginning, corner, (at the, the) first (estate), magistrate, power, principality, principle, rule.
entries.747: ἀρχηγός A)RXHGO/S archēgós ar-khay-gos' from G746 and G71; a chief leader:--author, captain, prince.
entries.748: ἀρχιερατικός A)RXIERATIKO/S archieratikós ar-khee-er-at-ee-kos' from G746 and a derivative of G2413; high-priestly:--of the high-priest.
entries.749: ἀρχιερεύς A)RXIEREU/S archiereús ar-khee-er-yuce' from G746 and G2409; the high-priest (literally, of the Jews, typically, Christ); by extension a chief priest:--chief (high) priest, chief of the priests.
entries.750: ἀρχιποίμην A)RXIPOI/MHN archipoímēn ar-khee-poy'-mane from G746 and G4166; a head shepherd:--chief shepherd.
entries.751: Ἄρχιππος *)/ARXIPPOS Árchippos ar'-khip-pos from G746 and G2462; horse-ruler; Archippus, a Christian:--Archippus.
entries.752: ἀρχισυνάγωγος A)RXISUNA/GWGOS archisynágōgos ar-khee-soon-ag'-o-gos from G746 and G4864; director of the synagogue services:--(chief) ruler of the synagogue.
entries.753: ἀρχιτέκτων A)RXITE/KTWN architéktōn ar-khee-tek'-tone from G746 and G5045; a chief constructor, i.e. "architect":--masterbuilder.
entries.754: ἀρχιτελώνης A)RXITELW/NHS architelṓnēs ar-khee-tel-o'-nace from G746 and G5057; a principle tax-gatherer:--chief among the publicans.
entries.755: ἀρχιτρίκλινος A)RXITRI/KLINOS architríklinos ar-khee-tree'-klee-nos from G746 and a compound of G5140 and G2827 (a dinner-bed, because composed of three couches); director of the entertainment:--governor (ruler) of the feast.
entries.756: ἄρχομαι A)/RXOMAI árchomai ar'-khom-ahee middle voice of G757 (through the implication, of precedence); to commence (in order of time):--(rehearse from the) begin(-ning).
entries.757: ἄρχω A)/RXW árchō ar'-kho a primary verb; to be first (in political rank or power):--reign (rule) over.
entries.758: ἄρχων A)/RXWN árchōn ar'-khone present participle of G757; a first (in rank or power):--chief (ruler), magistrate, prince, ruler.
entries.759: ἄρωμα A)/RWMA árōma ar'-o-mah from G142 (in the sense of sending off scent); an aromatic:--(sweet) spice.
entries.760: Ἀσά *)ASA/ Asá as-ah' of Hebrew origin (H0609); Asa, an Israelite:--Asa.
entries.761: ἀσάλευτος A)SA/LEUTOS asáleutos as-al'-yoo-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4531; unshaken, i.e. (by implication) immovable (figuratively):--which cannot be moved, unmovable.
entries.762: ἄσβεστος A)/SBESTOS ásbestos as'-bes-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4570; not extinguished, i.e. (by implication) perpetual:--not to be quenched, unquenchable.
entries.763: ἀσέβεια A)SE/BEIA asébeia as-eb'-i-ah from G765; impiety, i.e. (by implication) wickedness:--ungodly(-liness).
entries.764: ἀσεβέω A)SEBE/W asebéō as-eb-eh'-o from G765; to be (by implied act) impious or wicked:--commit (live, that after should live) ungodly.
entries.765: ἀσεβής A)SEBH/S asebḗs as-eb-ace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4576; irreverent, i.e. (by extension) impious or wicked:-- ungodly (man).
entries.766: ἀσέλγεια A)SE/LGEIA asélgeia as-elg'-i-a from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed σελγής SELGH/S selgḗs (of uncertain derivation, but apparently meaning continent); licentiousness (sometimes including other vices):--filthy, lasciviousness, wantonness.
entries.767: ἄσημος A)/SHMOS ásēmos as'-ay-mos from G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G4591; unmarked, i.e. (figuratively) ignoble:--mean.
entries.768: Ἀσήρ *)ASH/R Asḗr as-ayr' of Hebrew origin (H0836); Aser (i.e. Asher), an Israelite tribe:--Aser.
entries.769: ἀσθένεια A)SQE/NEIA asthéneia as-then'-i-ah from G772; feebleness (of mind or body); by implication, malady; morally, frailty:--disease, infirmity, sickness, weakness.
entries.770: ἀσθενέω A)SQENE/W asthenéō as-then-eh'-o from G772; to be feeble (in any sense):--be diseased, impotent folk (man), (be) sick, (be, be made) weak.
entries.771: ἀσθένημα A)SQE/NHMA asthénēma as-then'-ay-mah from G770; a scruple of conscience:--infirmity.
entries.772: ἀσθενής A)SQENH/S asthenḗs as-then-ace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G4599; strengthless (in various applications, literal, figurative and moral):--more feeble, impotent, sick, without strength, weak(-er, -ness, thing).
entries.773: Ἀσία *)ASI/A Asía as-ee'-ah of uncertain derivation; Asia, i.e. Asia Minor, or (usually) only its western shore:--Asia.
entries.774: Ἀσιανός *)ASIANO/S Asianós as-ee-an-os' from G773; an Asian (i.e. Asiatic) or an inhabitant of Asia:--of Asia.
entries.775: Ἀσιάρχης *)ASIA/RXHS Asiárchēs as-ee-ar'-khace from G773 and G746; an Asiarch or president of the public festivities in a city of Asia Minor:--chief of Asia.
entries.776: ἀσιτία A)SITI/A asitía as-ee-tee'-ah from G777; fasting (the state):--abstinence.
entries.777: ἄσιτος A)/SITOS ásitos as'-ee-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4621; without (taking) food:--fasting.
entries.778: ἀσκέω A)SKE/W askéō as-keh'-o probably from the same as G4632; to elaborate, i.e. (figuratively) train (by implication, strive):--exercise.
entries.779: ἀσκός A)SKO/S askós as-kos' from the same as G778; a leathern (or skin) bag used as a bottle:--bottle.
entries.780: ἀσμένως A)SME/NWS asménōs as-men'-oce adverb from a derivative of the base of G2237; with pleasure:--gladly.
entries.781: ἄσοφος A)/SOFOS ásophos as'-of-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4680; unwise:--fool.
entries.782: ἀσπάζομαι A)SPA/ZOMAI aspázomai as-pad'-zom-ahee from G1 (as a particle of union) and a presumed form of G4685; to enfold in the arms, i.e. (by implication) to salute, (figuratively) to welcome:--embrace, greet, salute, take leave.
entries.783: ἀσπασμός A)SPASMO/S aspasmós as-pas-mos' from G782; a greeting (in person or by letter):--greeting, salutation.
entries.784: ἄσπιλος A)/SPILOS áspilos as'-pee-los from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4695; unblemished (physically or morally):--without spot, unspotted.
entries.785: ἀσπίς A)SPI/S aspís as-pece' of uncertain derivation; a buckler (or round shield); used of a serpent (as coiling itself), probably the "asp":--asp.
entries.786: ἄσπονδος A)/SPONDOS áspondos as'-pon-dos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4689; literally, without libation (which usually accompanied a treaty), i.e. (by implication) truceless:--implacable, truce-breaker.
entries.787: ἀσσάριον A)SSA/RION assárion as-sar'-ee-on of Latin origin; an assarius or as, a Roman coin:--farthing.
entries.788: ἆσσον A)=SSON âsson as'-son neuter comparative of the base of G1451; more nearly, i.e. very near:--close.
entries.789: Ἄσσος *)/ASSOS Ássos as'-sos probably of foreign origin; Assus, a city of Asia MInor:--Assos.
entries.790: ἀστατέω A)STATE/W astatéō as-tat-eh'-o from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G2476; to be non-stationary, i.e. (figuratively) homeless:--have no certain dwelling-place.
entries.791: ἀστεῖος A)STEI=OS asteîos as-ti'-os from ἄστυ A)/STU ásty (a city); urbane, i.e. (by implication) handsome:--fair.
entries.792: ἀστήρ A)STH/R astḗr as-tare' probably from the base of G4766; a star (as strown over the sky), literally or figuratively:--star.
entries.793: ἀστήρικτος A)STH/RIKTOS astḗriktos as-tay'-rik-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4741; unfixed, i.e. (figuratively) vacillating:--unstable.
entries.794: ἄστοργος A)/STORGOS ástorgos as'-tor-gos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of στέργω STE/RGW stérgō (to cherish affectionately); hard-hearted towards kindred:--without natural affection.
entries.795: ἀστοχέω A)STOXE/W astochéō as-tokh-eh'-o from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and στοίχος STOI/XOS stoíchos (an aim); to miss the mark, i.e. (figuratively) deviate from truth:--err, swerve.
entries.796: ἀστραπή A)STRAPH/ astrapḗ as-trap-ay' from G797; lightning; by analogy, glare:--lightning, bright shining.
entries.797: ἀστράπτω A)STRA/PTW astráptō as-trap'-to probably from G792; to flash as lightning:--lighten, shine.
entries.798: ἄστρον A)/STRON ástron as'-tron neuter from G792; properly, a constellation; put for a single star (natural or artificial):--star.
entries.799: Ἀσύγκριτος *)ASU/GKRITOS Asýnkritos as-oong'-kree-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4793; incomparable; Asyncritus, a Christian:--Asyncritos.
entries.800: ἀσύμφωνος A)SU/MFWNOS asýmphōnos as-oom'-fo-nos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4859; inharmonious (figuratively):--agree not.
entries.801: ἀσύνετος A)SU/NETOS asýnetos as-oon'-ay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4908; unintelligent; by implication, wicked:--foolish, without understanding.
entries.802: ἀσύνθετος A)SU/NQETOS asýnthetos as-oon'-thet-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G4934; properly, not agreed, i.e. treacherous to compacts:-- covenant-breaker.
entries.803: ἀσφάλεια A)SFA/LEIA aspháleia as-fal'-i-ah from G804; security (literally or figuratively):--certainty, safety.
entries.804: ἀσφαλής A)SFALH/S asphalḗs as-fal-ace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and σφάλλω SFA/LLW sphállō (to "fail"); secure (literally or figuratively):--certain(-ty), safe, sure.
entries.805: ἀσφαλίζω A)SFALI/ZW asphalízō as-fal-id'-zo from G804; to render secure:--make fast (sure).
entries.806: ἀσφαλῶς A)SFALW=S asphalōs as-fal-oce' adverb from G804; securely (literally or figuratively):--assuredly, safely.
entries.807: ἀσχημονέω A)SXHMONE/W aschēmonéō as-kay-mon-eh'-o from G809; to be (i.e. act) unbecoming:--behave self uncomely (unseemly).
entries.808: ἀσχημοσύνη A)SXHMOSU/NH aschēmosýnē as-kay-mos-oo'-nay from G809; an indecency; by implication, the pudenda:--shame, that which is unseemly.
entries.809: ἀσχήμων A)SXH/MWN aschḗmōn as-kay'-mone from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G2192 (in the sense of its congener G4976); properly, shapeless, i.e. (figuratively) inelegant:--uncomely.
entries.810: ἀσωτία A)SWTI/A asōtía as-o-tee'-ah from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G4982; properly, unsavedness, i.e. (by implication) profligacy:--excess, riot.
entries.811: ἀσώτως A)SW/TWS asṓtōs as-o'-toce adverb from the same as G810; dissolutely:--riotous.
entries.812: ἀτακτέω A)TAKTE/W ataktéō at-ak-teh'-o from G813; to be (i.e. act) irregular:--behave self disorderly.
entries.813: ἄτακτος A)/TAKTOS átaktos at'-ak-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5021; unarranged, i.e. (by implication) insubordinate (religiously):--unruly.
entries.814: ἀτάκτως A)TA/KTWS atáktōs at-ak'-toce adverb from G813, irregularly (morally) :--disorderly.
entries.815: ἄτεκνος A)/TEKNOS áteknos at'-ek-nos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5043; childless:--childless, without children.
entries.816: ἀτενίζω A)TENI/ZW atenízō at-en-id'-zo from a compound of G1 (as a particle of union) and τείνω TEI/NW teínō (to stretch); to gaze intently:--behold earnestly (stedfastly), fasten (eyes), look (earnestly, stedfastly, up stedfastly), set eyes.
entries.817: ἄτερ A)/TER áter at'-er a particle probably akin to G427; aloof, i.e. apart from (literally or figuratively):--in the absence of, without.
entries.818: ἀτιμάζω A)TIMA/ZW atimázō at-im-ad'-zo from G820; to render infamous, i.e. (by implication) contemn or maltreat:--despise, dishonour, suffer shame, entreat shamefully.
entries.819: ἀτιμία A)TIMI/A atimía at-ee-mee'-ah from G820; infamy, i.e. (subjectively) comparative indignity, (objectively) disgrace:--dishonour, reproach, shame, vile.
entries.820: ἄτιμος A)/TIMOS átimos at'-ee-mos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5092; (negatively) unhonoured or (positively) dishonoured:--despised, without honour, less honourable (comparative degree).
entries.821: ἀτιμόω A)TIMO/W atimóō at-ee-mo'-o from G820; used like G818, to maltreat:--handle shamefully.
entries.822: ἀτμίς A)TMI/S atmís at-mece' from the same as G109; mist:--vapour.
entries.823: ἄτομος A)/TOMOS átomos at'-om-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and the base of G5114; uncut, i.e. (by implication) indivisible (an "atom" of time):-- moment.
entries.824: ἄτοπος A)/TOPOS átopos at'-op-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5117; out of place, i.e. (figuratively) improper, injurious, wicked:--amiss, harm, unreasonable.
entries.825: Ἀττάλεια *)ATTA/LEIA Attáleia at-tal'-i-ah from Ἄτταλος *)/ATTALOS Áttalos (a king of Pergamus); Attaleia, a place in Pamphylia:--Attalia.
entries.826: αὐγάζω AU)GA/ZW augázō ow-gad'-zo from G827; to beam forth (figuratively):--shine.
entries.827: αὐγή AU)GH/ augḗ owg'-ay of uncertain derivation; a ray of light, i.e. (by implication) radiance, dawn:--break of day.
entries.828: Αὐγοῦστος *AU)GOU=STOS Augoûstos ow'-goos-tos from Latin ("august"); Augustus, a title of the Roman emperor:--Augustus.
entries.829: αὐθάδης AU)QA/DHS authádēs ow-thad'-ace from G846 and the base of G2237; self-pleasing, i.e. arrogant:--self-willed.
entries.830: αὐθαίρετος AU)QAI/RETOS authaíretos ow-thah'-ee-ret-os from G846 and the same as G140; self-chosen, i.e. (by implication) voluntary:--of own accord, willing of self.
entries.831: αὐθεντέω AU)QENTE/W authentéō ow-then-teh'-o from a compound of G846 and an obsolete ἕντης E(/NTHS héntēs (a worker); to act of oneself, i.e. (figuratively) dominate:--usurp authority over.
entries.832: αὐλέω AU)LE/W auléō ow-leh'-o from G836; to play the flute:--pipe.
entries.833: αὐλή AU)LH/ aulḗ ow-lay' from the same as G109; a yard (as open to the wind); by implication, a mansion:--court, (sheep-)fold, hall, palace.
entries.834: αὐλητής AU)LHTH/S aulētḗs ow-lay-tace' from G832; a flute-player:--minstrel, piper.
entries.835: αὐλίζομαι AU)LI/ZOMAI aulízomai ow-lid'-zom-ahee middle voice from G833; to pass the night (properly, in the open air):--abide, lodge.
entries.836: αὐλός AU)LO/S aulós ow-los' from the same as G109; a flute (as blown):--pipe.
entries.837: αὐξάνω AU)CA/NW auxánō owx-an'-o a prolonged form of a primary verb; to grow ("wax"), i.e. enlarge (literal or figurative, active or passive):--grow (up), (give the) increase.
entries.838: αὔξησις AU)/CHSIS aúxēsis owx'-ay-sis from G837; growth:--increase.
entries.839: αὔριον AU)/RION aúrion ow'-ree-on from a derivative of the same as G109 (meaning a breeze, i.e. the morning air); properly, fresh, i.e. (adverb with ellipsis of G2250) to-morrow:--(to-)morrow, next day.
entries.840: αὐστηρός AU)STHRO/S austērós ow-stay-ros' from a (presumed) derivative of the same as G109 (meaning blown); rough (properly as a gale), i.e. (figuratively) severe:--austere.
entries.841: αὐτάρκεια AU)TA/RKEIA autárkeia ow-tar'-ki-ah from G842; self-satisfaction, i.e. (abstractly) contentedness, or (concretely) a competence:--contentment, sufficiency.
entries.842: αὐτάρκης AU)TA/RKHS autárkēs ow-tar'-kace from G846 and G714; self-complacent, i.e. contented:--content.
entries.843: αὐτοκατάκριτος AU)TOKATA/KRITOS autokatákritos ow-tok-at-ak'-ree-tos from G846 and a derivative or G2632; self-condemned:--condemned of self.
entries.844: αὐτόματος AU)TO/MATOS autómatos ow-tom'-at-os from G846 and the same as G3155; self-moved ("automatic"), i.e. spontaneous:--of own accord, of self.
entries.845: αὐτόπτης AU)TO/PTHS autóptēs ow-top'-tace from G846 and G3700; self-seeing, i.e. an eye-witness:--eye-witness.
entries.846: αὐτός AU)TO/S autós ow-tos' from the particle αὖ AU)= aû (perhaps akin to the base of G109 through the idea of a baffling wind) (backward); the reflexive pronoun self, used (alone or in the compound G1438) of the third person , and (with the proper personal pronoun) of the other persons:--her, it(-self), one, the other, (mine) own, said, (self-), the) same, ((him-, my-, thy- )self, (your-)selves, she, that, their(-s), them(-selves), there(-at, - by, -in, -into, -of, -on, -with), they, (these) things, this (man), those, together, very, which. Compare G848.
entries.847: αὐτοῦ AU)TOU= autoû ow-too' genitive (i.e. possessive) of G846, used as an adverb of location; properly, belonging to the same spot, i.e. in this (or that) place:--(t-)here.
entries.848: αὑτοῦ AU(TOU= hautoû how-too' contracted for G1438; self (in some oblique case or reflexive relation):--her (own), (of) him(-self), his (own), of it, thee, their (own), them(-selves), they.
entries.849: αὐτόχειρ AU)TO/XEIR autócheir ow-tokh'-ire from G846 and G5495; self-handed, i.e. doing personally:--with … own hands.
entries.850: αὐχμηρός AU)XMHRO/S auchmērós owkh-may-ros' from αὐχμός AU)XMO/S auchmós (probably from a base akin to that of G109) (dust, as dried by wind); properly, dirty, i.e. (by implication) obscure:--dark.
entries.851: ἀφαιρέω A)FAIRE/W aphairéō af-ahee-reh'-o from G575 and G138; to remove (literally or figuratively):--cut (smite) off, take away.
entries.852: ἀφανής A)FANH/S aphanḗs af-an-ace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5316; non-apparent:--that is not manifest.
entries.853: ἀφανίζω A)FANI/ZW aphanízō af-an-id'-zo from G852; to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed):-- corrupt, disfigure, perish, vanish away.
entries.854: ἀφανισμός A)FANISMO/S aphanismós af-an-is-mos' from G853; disappearance, i.e. (figuratively) abrogation:--vanish away.
entries.855: ἄφαντος A)/FANTOS áphantos af'-an-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5316; non-manifested, i.e. invisible:--vanished out of sight.
entries.856: ἀφεδρών A)FEDRW/N aphedrṓn af-ed-rone' from a compound of G575 and the base of G1476; a place of sitting apart, i.e. a privy:--draught.
entries.857: ἀφειδία A)FEIDI/A apheidía af-i-dee'-ah from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G5339; unsparingness, i.e. austerity (asceticism):--neglecting.
entries.858: ἀφελότης A)FELO/THS aphelótēs af-el-ot'-ace from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and φέλλος FE/LLOS phéllos (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot); smoothness, i.e. (figuratively) simplicity:--singleness.
entries.859: ἄφεσις A)/FESIS áphesis af'-es-is from G863; freedom; (figuratively) pardon:--deliverance, forgiveness, liberty, remission.
entries.860: ἁφή A(FH/ haphḗ haf-ay' from G680; probably a ligament (as fastening):--joint.
entries.861: ἀφθαρσία A)FQARSI/A aphtharsía af-thar-see'-ah from G862; incorruptibility; genitive, unending existence; (figuratively) genuineness:--immortality, incorruption, sincerity.
entries.862: ἄφθαρτος A)/FQARTOS áphthartos af'-thar-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5351; undecaying (in essence or continuance):--not (in-, un-)corruptible, immortal.
entries.863: ἀφίημι A)FI/HMI aphíēmi af-ee'-ay-mee from G575 and ἵημι I(/HMI híēmi (to send; an intensive form of εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi, to go); to send forth, in various applications (as follow):--cry, forgive, forsake, lay aside, leave, let (alone, be, go, have), omit, put (send) away, remit, suffer, yield up.
entries.864: ἀφικνέομαι A)FIKNE/OMAI aphiknéomai af-ik-neh'-om-ahee from G575 and the base of G2425; to go (i.e. spread) forth (by rumor):--come abroad.
entries.865: ἀφιλάγαθος A)FILA/GAQOS aphilágathos af-il-ag'-ath-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5358; hostile to virtue:--despiser of those that are good.
entries.866: ἀφιλάργυρος A)FILA/RGUROS aphilárgyros af-il-ar'-goo-ros from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5366; unavaricious:--without covetousness, not greedy of filthy lucre.
entries.867: ἄφιξις A)/FICIS áphixis af'-ix-is from G864; properly, arrival, i.e. (by implication) departure:--departing.
entries.868: ἀφίστημι A)FI/STHMI aphístēmi af-is'-tay-mee from G575 and G2476; to remove, i.e. (actively) instigate to revolt; usually (reflexively) to desist, desert, etc.:--depart, draw (fall) away, refrain, withdraw self.
entries.869: ἄφνω A)/FNW áphnō af'-no adverb from G852 (contraction); unawares, i.e. unexpectedly:--suddenly.
entries.870: ἀφόβως A)FO/BWS aphóbōs af-ob'-oce adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and G5401; fearlessly:--without fear.
entries.871: ἀφομοιόω A)FOMOIO/W aphomoióō af-om-oy-o'-o from G575 and G3666; to assimilate closely:--make like.
entries.872: ἀφοράω A)FORA/W aphoráō af-or-ah'-o from G575 and G3708; to consider attentively:--look.
entries.873: ἀφορίζω A)FORI/ZW aphorízō af-or-id'-zo from G575 and G3724; to set off by boundary, i.e. (figuratively) limit, exclude, appoint, etc.:--divide, separate, sever.
entries.874: ἀφορμή A)FORMH/ aphormḗ af-or-may' from a compound of G575 and G3729; a starting-point, i.e. (figuratively) an opportunity:--occasion.
entries.875: ἀφρίζω A)FRI/ZW aphrízō af-rid'-zo from G876; to froth at the mouth (in epilepsy):--foam.
entries.876: ἀφρός A)FRO/S aphrós af-ros' apparently a primary word; froth, i.e. slaver:--foaming.
entries.877: ἀφροσύνη A)FROSU/NH aphrosýnē af-ros-oo'-nay from G878; senselessness, i.e. (euphemistically) egotism; (morally) recklessness:--folly, foolishly(-ness).
entries.878: ἄφρων A)/FRWN áphrōn af'-rone from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5424; properly, mindless, i.e. stupid, (by implication) ignorant, (specially) egotistic, (practically) rash, or (morally) unbelieving:--fool(-ish), unwise.
entries.879: ἀφυπνόω A)FUPNO/W aphypnóō af-oop-no'-o from a compound of G575 and G5258; properly, to become awake, i.e. (by implication) to drop (off) in slumber:--fall asleep.
entries.880: ἄφωνος A)/FWNOS áphōnos af'-o-nos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5456; voiceless, i.e. mute (by nature or choice); figuratively, unmeaning:--dumb, without signification.
entries.881: Ἀχάζ *)AXA/Z Acház akh-adz' of Hebrew origin (H0271); Achaz, an Israelite:--Achaz.
entries.882: Ἀχαΐα *)AXAI/+A Achaḯa ach-ah-ee'-ah of uncertain derivation; Achaia (i.e. Greece), a country of Europe:--Achaia.
entries.883: Ἀχαϊκός *)AXAI+KO/S Achaïkós ach-ah-ee-kos' from G882; an Achaian; Achaicus, a Christian:--Achaicus.
entries.884: ἀχάριστος A)XA/RISTOS acháristos ach-ar'-is-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of G5483; thankless, i.e. ungrateful:--unthankful.
entries.885: Ἀχείμ *)AXEI/M Acheím akh-ime' probably of Hebrew origin (compare H03137); Achim, an Israelite:--Achim.
entries.886: ἀχειροποίητος A)XEIROPOI/HTOS acheiropoíētos akh-i-rop-oy'-ay-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5499; unmanufactured, i.e. inartificial:--made without (not made with) hands.
entries.887: ἀχλύς A)XLU/S achlýs akh-looce' of uncertain derivation; dimness of sight, i.e. (probably) a cataract:--mist.
entries.888: ἀχρεῖος A)XREI=OS achreîos akh-ri'-os from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5534 (compare G5532); useless, i.e. (euphemistically) unmeritorious:--unprofitable.
entries.889: ἀχρειόω A)XREIO/W achreióō akh-ri-o'-o from G888; to render useless, i.e. spoil:--become unprofitable.
entries.890: ἄχρηστος A)/XRHSTOS áchrēstos akh'-race-tos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5543; inefficient, i.e. (by implication) detrimental:--unprofitable.
entries.891: ἄχρι A)/XRI áchri akh'-ree or ἄχρις A)/XRIS áchris akh'-rece ; akin to G206 (through the idea of a terminus); (of time) until or (of place) up to:--as far as, for, in(-to), till, (even, un-)to, until, while. Compare G3360.
entries.892: ἄχυρον A)/XURON áchyron akh'-oo-ron perhaps remotely from χέω XE/W chéō (to shed forth); chaff (as diffusive):--chaff.
entries.893: ἀψευδής A)YEUDH/S apseudḗs aps-yoo-dace' from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5579; veracious:--that cannot lie.
entries.894: ἄψινθος A)/YINQOS ápsinthos ap'-sin-thos of uncertain derivation; wormwood (as a type of bitterness, i.e. (figuratively) calamity):--wormwood.
entries.895: ἄψυχος A)/YUXOS ápsychos ap'-soo-khos from G1 (as a negative particle) and G5590; lifeless, i.e. inanimate (mechanical):--without life.
entries.896: Βάαλ *BA/AL Báal bah'-al of Hebrew origin (H01168); Baal, a Phœnician deity (used as a symbol of idolatry):--Baal.
entries.897: Βαβυλών *BABULW/N Babylṓn bab-oo-lone' of Hebrew origin (H0894); Babylon, the capitol of Chaldæa (literally or figuratively (as a type of tyranny)):-- Babylon.
entries.898: βαθμός BAQMO/S bathmós bath-mos' from the same as G899; a step, i.e. (figuratively) grade (of dignity):--degree.
entries.899: βάθος BA/QOS báthos bath'-os from the same as G901; profundity, i.e. (by implication) extent; (figuratively) mystery:--deep(-ness, things), depth.
entries.900: βαθύνω BAQU/NW bathýnō bath-oo'-no from G901; to deepen:--deep.
entries.901: βαθύς BAQU/S bathýs bath-oos' from the base of G939; profound (as going down), literally or figuratively:--deep, very early.
entries.902: βαΐον BAI/+ON baḯon bah-ee'-on a diminutive of a derivative probably of the base of G939; a palm twig (as going out far):--branch.
entries.903: Βαλαάμ *BALAA/M Balaám bal-ah-am' of Hebrew origin (H01109); Balaam, a Mesopotamian (symbolic of a false teacher):--Balaam.
entries.904: Βαλάκ *BALA/K Balák bal-ak' of Hebrew origin (H01111); Balak, a Moabite:--Balac.
entries.905: βαλάντιον BALA/NTION balántion bal-an'-tee-on probably remotely from G906 (as a depository); a pouch (for money):--bag, purse.
entries.906: βάλλω BA/LLW bállō bal'-lo a primary verb; to throw (in various applications, more or less violent or intense):--arise, cast (out), X dung, lay, lie, pour, put (up), send, strike, throw (down), thrust. Compare G4496.
entries.907: βαπτίζω BAPTI/ZW baptízō bap-tid'-zo from a derivative of G911; to immerse, submerge; to make whelmed (i.e. fully wet); used only (in the New Testament) of ceremonial ablution, especially (technically) of the ordinance of Christian baptism:--Baptist, baptize, wash.
entries.908: βάπτισμα BA/PTISMA báptisma bap'-tis-mah from G907; baptism (technically or figuratively):--baptism.
entries.909: βαπτισμός BAPTISMO/S baptismós bap-tis-mos' from G907; ablution (ceremonial or Christian):--baptism, washing.
entries.910: Βαπτιστής *BAPTISTH/S Baptistḗs bap-tis-tace' from G907; a baptizer, as an epithet of Christ's forerunner:--Baptist.
entries.911: βάπτω BA/PTW báptō bap'-to a primary verb; to whelm, i.e. cover wholly with a fluid; in the New Testament only in a qualified or special sense, i.e. (literally) to moisten (a part of one's person), or (by implication) to stain (as with dye):--dip.
entries.912: Βαραββᾶς *BARABBA=S Barabbâs bar-ab-bas' of Chaldee origin (H01347 and H05); son of Abba; Bar-abbas, an Israelite:--Barabbas.
entries.913: Βαράκ *BARA/K Barák bar-ak' of Hebrew origin (H01301); Barak, an Israelite:--Barak.
entries.914: Βαραχίας *BARAXI/AS Barachías bar-akh-ee'-as of Hebrew origin (H01296); Barachias (i.e. Berechijah), an Israelite:--Barachias.
entries.915: βάρβαρος BA/RBAROS bárbaros bar'-bar-os of uncertain derivation; a foreigner (i.e. non-Greek):--barbarian(-rous).
entries.916: βαρέω BARE/W baréō bar-eh'-o from G926; to weigh down (figuratively):--burden, charge, heavy, press.
entries.917: βαρέως BARE/WS baréōs bar-eh'-oce adverb from G926; heavily (figuratively):--dull.
entries.918: Βαρθολομαῖος *BARQOLOMAI=OS Bartholomaîos bar-thol-om-ah'-yos of Chaldee origin (H01247 and H08526); son of Tolmai; Bar-tholomæus, a Christian apostle:--Bartholomeus.
entries.919: Βαριησοῦς *BARIHSOU=S Bariēsoûs bar-ee-ay-sooce' of Chaldee origin (H01247 and H03091); son of Jesus (or Joshua); Bar-jesus, an Israelite:--Barjesus.
entries.920: Βαριωνᾶς *BARIWNA=S Bariōnâs bar-ee-oo-nas' of Chaldee origin (H01247 and H03124); son of Jonas (or Jonah); Bar-jonas, an Israelite:--Bar-jona.
entries.921: Βαρνάβας *BARNA/BAS Barnábas bar-nab'-as of Chaldee origin (H01247 and H05029); son of Nabas (i.e. prophecy); Barnabas, an Israelite:--Barnabas.
entries.922: βάρος BA/ROS báros bar'-os probably from the same as G939 (through the notion of going down; compare G899); weight; in the New Testament only, figuratively, a load, abundance, authority:--burden(-some), weight.
entries.923: Βαρσαβᾶς *BARSABA=S Barsabâs bar-sab-as' of Chaldee origin (H01247 and probably H06634); son of Sabas (or Tsaba); Bar-sabas, the name of two Israelites:--Barsabas.
entries.924: Βαρτιμαῖος *BARTIMAI=OS Bartimaîos bar-tim-ah'-yos of Chaldee origin (H01247 and H02931); son of Timæus (or the unclean); Bar-timæus, an Israelite:--Bartimæus.
entries.925: βαρύνω BARU/NW barýnō bar-oo'-no from G926; to burden (figuratively):--overcharge.
entries.926: βαρύς BARU/S barýs bar-ooce' from the same as G922; weighty, i.e. (fig) burdensome, grave:--grievous, heavy, weightier.
entries.927: βαρύτιμος BARU/TIMOS barýtimos bar-oo'-tim-os from G926 and G5092; highly valuable:--very precious.
entries.928: βασανίζω BASANI/ZW basanízō bas-an-id'-zo from G931; to torture:--pain, toil, torment, toss, vex.
entries.929: βασανισμός BASANISMO/S basanismós bas-an-is-mos' from G928; torture:--torment.
entries.930: βασανιστής BASANISTH/S basanistḗs bas-an-is-tace' from G928; a torturer:--tormentor.
entries.931: βάσανος BA/SANOS básanos bas'-an-os perhaps remotely from the same as G939 (through the notion of going to the bottom); a touch-stone, i.e. (by analogy) torture:--torment.
entries.932: βασιλεία BASILEI/A basileía bas-il-i'-ah from G935; properly, royalty, i.e. (abstractly) rule, or (concretely) a realm (literally or figuratively):--kingdom, + reign.
entries.933: βασίλειον BASI/LEION basíleion bas-il'-i-on neuter of G934; a palace:--king's court.
entries.934: βασίλειος BASI/LEIOS basíleios bas-il'-i-os from G935; kingly (in nature):--royal.
entries.935: βασιλεύς BASILEU/S basileús bas-il-yooce' probably from G939 (through the notion of a foundation of power); a sovereign (abstractly, relatively, or figuratively):--king.
entries.936: βασιλεύω BASILEU/W basileúō bas-il-yoo'-o from G935; to rule (literally or figuratively):--king, reign.
entries.937: βασιλικός BASILIKO/S basilikós bas-il-ee-kos' from G935; regal (in relation), i.e. (literally) belonging to (or befitting) the sovereign (as land, dress, or a courtier), or (figuratively) preeminent:--king's, nobleman, royal.
entries.938: βασίλισσα BASI/LISSA basílissa bas-il'-is-sah feminine from G936; a queen:--queen.
entries.939: βάσις BA/SIS básis bas'-ece from βαίνω BAI/NW baínō (to walk); a pace ("base"), i.e. (by implication) the foot:--foot.
entries.940: βασκαίνω BASKAI/NW baskaínō bas-kah'-ee-no akin to G5335; to malign, i.e. (by extension) to fascinate (by false representations):--bewitch.
entries.941: βαστάζω BASTA/ZW bastázō bas-tad'-zo perhaps remotely derived from the base of G939 (through the idea of removal); to lift, literally or figuratively (endure, declare, sustain, receive, etc.):--bear, carry, take up.
entries.942: βάτος BA/TOS bátos bat'-os of uncertain derivation; a brier shrub:--bramble, bush.
entries.943: βάτος BA/TOS bátos bat'-os of Hebrew origin (H01324); a bath, or measure for liquids:--measure.
entries.944: βάτραχος BA/TRAXOS bátrachos bat'-rakh-os of uncertain derivation; a frog:--frog.
entries.945: βαττολογέω BATTOLOGE/W battologéō bat-tol-og-eh'-o from Βάττος *BA/TTOS Báttos (a proverbial stammerer) and G3056; to stutter, i.e. (by implication) to prate tediously:--use vain repetitions.
entries.946: βδέλυγμα BDE/LUGMA bdélygma bdel'-oog-mah from G948; a detestation, i.e. (specially) idolatry:--abomination.
entries.947: βδελυκτός BDELUKTO/S bdelyktós bdel-ook-tos' from G948; detestable, i.e. (specially) idolatrous:--abominable.
entries.948: βδελύσσω BDELU/SSW bdelýssō bdel-oos'-so from a (presumed) derivative of βδέω BDE/W bdéō (to stink); to be disgusted, i.e. (by implication) detest (especially of idolatry):--abhor, abominable.
entries.949: βέβαιος BE/BAIOS bébaios beb'-ah-yos from the base of G939 (through the idea of basality); stable (literally or figuratively):--firm, of force, stedfast, sure.
entries.950: βεβαιόω BEBAIO/W bebaióō beb-ah-yo'-o from G949; to stabilitate (figuratively):--confirm, (e-)stablish.
entries.951: βεβαίωσις BEBAI/WSIS bebaíōsis beb-ah'-yo-sis from G950; stabiliment:--confirmation.
entries.952: βέβηλος BE/BHLOS bébēlos beb'-ay-los from the base of G939 and βηλός BHLO/S bēlós (a threshold); accessible (as by crossing the door-way), i.e. (by implication, of Jewish notions) heathenish, wicked:--profane (person).
entries.953: βεβηλόω BEBHLO/W bebēlóō beb-ay-lo'-o from G952; to desecrate:--profane.
entries.954: Βεελζεβούλ *BEELZEBOU/L Beelzeboúl beh-el-zeb-ool' of Chaldee origin (by parody on H01176); dung-god; Beelzebul, a name of Satan:--Beelzebub.
entries.955: Βελίαλ *BELI/AL Belíal bel-ee'-al of Hebrew origin (H01100); worthlessness; Belial, as an epithet of Satan:--Belial.
entries.956: βέλος BE/LOS bélos bel'-os from G906; a missile, i.e. spear or arrow:--dart.
entries.957: βελτίον BELTI/ON beltíon bel-tee'-on neuter of a compound of a derivative of G906 (used for the comparative of G18); better:--very well.
entries.958: Βενιαμίν *BENIAMI/N Beniamín ben-ee-am-een' of Hebrew origin (H01144); Benjamin, an Israelite:--Benjamin.
entries.959: Βερνίκη *BERNI/KH Berníkē ber-nee'-kay from a provincial form of G5342 and G3529; victorious; Bernice, a member of the Herodian family:--Bernice.
entries.960: Βέροια *BE/ROIA Béroia ber'-oy-ah perhaps a provincial from a derivative of G4008 (Perœa, i.e. the region beyond the coast-line); Berœa, a place in Macedonia:--Berea.
entries.961: Βεροιαῖος *BEROIAI=OS Beroiaîos ber-oy-ah'-yos from G960; a Berœoean or native of Berœa:--of Berea.
entries.962: Βηθαβαρά *BHQABARA/ Bēthabará bay-thab-ar-ah' of Hebrew origin (H01004 and H05679); ferry-house; Bethabara (i.e. Bethabarah), a place on the Jordan:--Bethabara.
entries.963: Βηθανία *BHQANI/A Bēthanía bay-than-ee'-ah of Chaldee origin; date-house; Beth-any, a place in Palestine:--Bethany.
entries.964: Βηθεσδά *BHQESDA/ Bēthesdá bay-thes-dah' of Chaldee origin (compare H01004 and H02617); house of kindness; Beth-esda, a pool in Jerusalem:--Bethesda.
entries.965: Βηθλεέμ *BHQLEE/M Bēthleém bayth-leh-em' of Hebrew origin (H01036); Bethleem (i.e. Beth-lechem), a place in Palestine:--Bethlehem.
entries.966: Βηθσαϊδά *BHQSAI+DA/ Bēthsaïdá bayth-sahee-dah' of Chaldee origin (compare H01004 and H06719); fishing-house; Bethsaida, a place in Palestine:--Bethsaida.
entries.967: Βηθφαγή *BHQFAGH/ Bēthphagḗ bayth-fag-ay' of Chaldee origin (compare H01004 and H06291); fig-house; Beth-phage, a place in Palestine:--Bethphage.
entries.968: βῆμα BH=MA bēma bay'-ma from the base of G939; a step, i.e. foot-breath; by implication, a rostrum, i.e. a tribunal:--judgment-seat, set (foot) on, throne.
entries.969: βήρυλλος BH/RULLOS bḗryllos bay'-rool-los of uncertain derivation; a "beryl":--beryl.
entries.970: βία BI/A bía bee'-ah probably akin to G979 (through the idea of vital activity); force:--violence.
entries.971: βιάζω BIA/ZW biázō bee-ad'-zo from G970; to force, i.e. (reflexively) to crowd oneself (into), or (passively) to be seized:--press, suffer violence.
entries.972: βίαιος BI/AIOS bíaios bee'-ah-yos from G970; violent:--mighty.
entries.973: βιαστής BIASTH/S biastḗs bee-as-tace' from G971; a forcer, i.e. (figuratively) energetic:--violent.
entries.974: βιβλιαρίδιον BIBLIARI/DION bibliarídion bib-lee-ar-id'-ee-on a diminutive of G975; a booklet:--little book.
entries.975: βιβλίον BIBLI/ON biblíon bib-lee'-on a diminutive of G976; a roll:--bill, book, scroll, writing.
entries.976: βίβλος BI/BLOS bíblos bib'-los properly, the inner bark of the papyrus plant, i.e. (by implication) a sheet or scroll of writing :--book.
entries.977: βιβρώσκω BIBRW/SKW bibrṓskō bib-ro'-sko a reduplicated and prolonged form of an obsolete primary verb (perhaps causative of G1006); to eat:--eat.
entries.978: Βιθυνία *BIQUNI/A Bithynía bee-thoo-nee'-ah of uncertain derivation; Bithynia, a region of Asia:--Bithynia.
entries.979: βίος BI/OS bíos bee'-os a primary word; life, i.e. (literally) the present state of existence; by implication, the means of livelihood:--good, life, living.
entries.980: βιόω BIO/W bióō bee-o'-o from G979; to spend existence:--live.
entries.981: βίωσις BI/WSIS bíōsis bee'-o-sis from G980; living (properly, the act, by implication, the mode):--manner of life.
entries.982: βιωτικός BIWTIKO/S biōtikós bee-o-tee-kos' from a derivative of G980; relating to the present existence:--of (pertaining to, things that pertain to) this life.
entries.983: βλαβερός BLABERO/S blaberós blab-er-os' from G984; injurious:--hurtful.
entries.984: βλάπτω BLA/PTW bláptō blap'-to a primary verb; properly, to hinder, i.e. (by implication) to injure:--hurt.
entries.985: βλαστάνω BLASTA/NW blastánō blas-tan'-o from βλαστός BLASTO/S blastós (a sprout); to germinate; by implication, to yield fruit:--bring forth, bud, spring (up).
entries.986: Βλάστος *BLA/STOS Blástos blas'-tos perhaps the same as the base of G985; Blastus, an officer of Herod Agrippa:--Blastus.
entries.987: βλασφημέω BLASFHME/W blasphēméō blas-fay-meh'-o from G989; to vilify; specially, to speak impiously:--(speak) blaspheme(-er, -mously, -my), defame, rail on, revile, speak evil.
entries.988: βλασφημία BLASFHMI/A blasphēmía blas-fay-me'-ah from G989; vilification (especially against God):--blasphemy, evil speaking, railing.
entries.989: βλάσφημος BLA/SFHMOS blásphēmos blas'-fay-mos from a derivative of G984 and G5345; scurrilious, i.e. calumnious (against men), or (specially) impious (against God):--blasphemer(-mous), railing.
entries.990: βλέμμα BLE/MMA blémma blem'-mah from G991; vision (properly concrete; by implication, abstract):--seeing.
entries.991: βλέπω BLE/PW blépō blep'-o a primary verb; to look at (literally or figuratively):--behold, beware, lie, look (on, to), perceive, regard, see, sight, take heed. Compare G3700.
entries.992: βλητέος BLHTE/OS blētéos blay-teh'-os from G906; fit to be cast (i.e. applied):--must be put.
entries.993: Βοανεργές *BOANERGE/S Boanergés bo-an-erg-es' of Chaldee origin (H01123 and H07266); sons of commotion; Boanerges, an epithet of two of the apostles:--Boanerges.
entries.994: βοάω BOA/W boáō bo-ah'-o apparently a prolonged form of a primary verb; to halloo, i.e. shout (for help or in a tumultuous way):--cry.
entries.995: βοή BOH/ boḗ bo-ay' from G994; a halloo, i.e. call (for aid, etc.):--cry.
entries.996: βοήθεια BOH/QEIA boḗtheia bo-ay'-thi-ah from G998; aid; specially, a rope or chain for frapping a vessel:--help.
entries.997: βοηθέω BOHQE/W boēthéō bo-ay-theh'-o from G998; to aid or relieve:--help, succor.
entries.998: βοηθός BOHQO/S boēthós bo-ay-thos' from G995 and theo (to run); a succorer:--helper.
entries.999: βόθυνος BO/QUNOS bóthynos both'-oo-nos akin to G900; a hole (in the ground); specially, a cistern:--ditch, pit.
entries.1000: βολή BOLH/ bolḗ bol-ay' from G906; a throw (as a measure of distance):--cast.
entries.1001: βολίζω BOLI/ZW bolízō bol-id'-zo from G1002; to heave the lead:--sound.
entries.1002: βολίς BOLI/S bolís bol-ece' from G906; a missile, i.e. javelin:--dart.
entries.1003: Βοόζ *BOO/Z Boóz bo-oz' of Hebrew origin (H01162); Booz, (i.e. Boaz), an Israelite:--Booz.
entries.1004: βόρβορος BO/RBOROS bórboros bor'-bor-os of uncertain derivation; mud:--mire.
entries.1005: βοῤῥᾶς BOR)R(A=S borrhâs bor-hras' of uncertain derivation; the north (properly, wind):--north.
entries.1006: βόσκω BO/SKW bóskō bos'-ko a prolonged form of a primary verb (compare G977, G1016); to pasture; by extension to, fodder; reflexively, to graze:--feed, keep.
entries.1007: Βοσόρ *BOSO/R Bosór bos-or' of Hebrew origin (H01160); Bosor (i.e. Beor), a Moabite:--Bosor.
entries.1008: βοτάνη BOTA/NH botánē bot-an'-ay from G1006; herbage (as if for grazing):--herb.
entries.1009: βότρυς BO/TRUS bótrys bot'-rooce of uncertain derivation; a bunch (of grapes):--(vine) cluster (of the vine).
entries.1010: βουλευτής BOULEUTH/S bouleutḗs bool-yoo-tace' from G1011; an adviser, i.e. (specially) a councillor or member of the Jewish Sanhedrin:--counsellor.
entries.1011: βουλεύω BOULEU/W bouleúō bool-yoo'-o from G1012; to advise, i.e. (reflexively) deliberate, or (by implication) resolve:--consult, take counsel, determine, be minded, purpose.
entries.1012: βουλή BOULH/ boulḗ boo-lay' from G1014; volition, i.e. (objectively) advice, or (by implication) purpose:--+ advise, counsel, will.
entries.1013: βούλημα BOU/LHMA boúlēma boo'-lay-mah from G1014; a resolve:--purpose, will.
entries.1014: βούλομαι BOU/LOMAI boúlomai boo'-lom-ahee middle voice of a primary verb; to "will," i.e. (reflexively) be willing:--be disposed, minded, intend, list, (be, of own) will (-ing). Compare G2309.
entries.1015: βουνός BOUNO/S bounós boo-nos' probably of foreign origin; a hillock:--hill.
entries.1016: βοῦς BOU=S boûs booce probably from the base of G1006; an ox (as grazing), i.e. an animal of that species ("beef"):--ox.
entries.1017: βραβεῖον BRABEI=ON brabeîon brab-i'-on from βραβεύς BRABEU/S brabeús (an umpire of uncertain derivation); an award (of arbitration), i.e. (specially) a prize in the public games:--prize.
entries.1018: βραβεύω BRABEU/W brabeúō brab-yoo'-o from the same as G1017; to arbitrate, i.e. (genitive case) to govern (figuratively, prevail):--rule.
entries.1019: βραδύνω BRADU/NW bradýnō brad-oo'-no from G1021; to delay:--be slack, tarry.
entries.1020: βραδυπλοέω BRADUPLOE/W bradyploéō brad-oo-plo-eh'-o from G1021 and a prolonged form of G4126; to sail slowly:--sail slowly.
entries.1021: βραδύς BRADU/S bradýs brad-ooce' of uncertain affinity; slow; figuratively, dull:--slow.
entries.1022: βραδύτης BRADU/THS bradýtēs brad-oo'-tace from G1021; tardiness:--slackness.
entries.1023: βραχίων BRAXI/WN brachíōn brakh-ee'-own properly, comparative of G1024, but apparently in the sense of βράσσω BRA/SSW brássō (to wield); the arm, i.e. (figuratively) strength:--arm.
entries.1024: βραχύς BRAXU/S brachýs brakh-ooce' of uncertain affinity; short (of time, place, quantity, or number):--few words, little (space, while).
entries.1025: βρέφος BRE/FOS bréphos bref'-os of uncertain affinity; an infant (properly, unborn) literally or figuratively:--babe, (young) child, infant.
entries.1026: βρέχω BRE/XW bréchō brekh'-o a primary verb; to moisten (especially by a shower):--(send) rain, wash.
entries.1027: βροντή BRONTH/ brontḗ bron-tay' akin to βρέμω BRE/MW brémō (to roar); thunder:--thunder(-ing).
entries.1028: βροχή BROXH/ brochḗ brokh-ay' from G1026; rain:--rain.
entries.1029: βρόχος BRO/XOS bróchos brokh'-os of uncertain derivation; a noose:--snare.
entries.1030: βρυγμός BRUGMO/S brygmós broog-mos' from G1031; a grating (of the teeth):--gnashing.
entries.1031: βρύχω BRU/XW brýchō broo'-kho a primary verb; to grate the teeth (in pain or rage):--gnash.
entries.1032: βρύω BRU/W brýō broo'-o a primary verb; to swell out, i.e. (by implication) to gush:--send forth.
entries.1033: βρῶμα BRW=MA brōma bro'-mah from the base of G977; food (literally or figuratively), especially (ceremonially) articles allowed or forbidden by the Jewish law:--meat, victuals.
entries.1034: βρώσιμος BRW/SIMOS brṓsimos bro'-sim-os from G1035; eatable:--meat.
entries.1035: βρῶσις BRW=SIS brōsis bro'-sis from the base of G977; (abstractly) eating (literally or figuratively); by extension (concretely) food (literally or figuratively):--eating, food, meat.
entries.1036: βυθίζω BUQI/ZW bythízō boo-thid'-zo from G1037; to sink; by implication, to drown:--begin to sink, drown.
entries.1037: βυθός BUQO/S bythós boo-thos' a variation of G899; depth, i.e. (by implication) the sea:--deep.
entries.1038: βυρσεύς BURSEU/S byrseús boorce-yooce' from βύρσα BU/RSA býrsa (a hide); a tanner:--tanner.
entries.1039: βύσσινος BU/SSINOS býssinos boos'-see-nos from G1040; made of linen (neuter a linen cloth):--fine linen.
entries.1040: βύσσος BU/SSOS býssos boos'-sos of Hebrew origin (H0948); white linen:--fine linen.
entries.1041: βωμός BWMO/S bōmós bo'-mos from the base of G939; properly, a stand, i.e. (specially) an altar:--altar.
entries.1042: γαββαθά GABBAQA/ gabbathá gab-bath-ah' of Chaldee origin (compare H01355); the knoll; gabbatha, a vernacular term for the Roman tribunal in Jerusalem:-- Gabbatha.
entries.1043: Γαβριήλ *GABRIH/L Gabriḗl gab-ree-ale' of Hebrew origin (H01403); Gabriel, an archangel:--Gabriel.
entries.1044: γάγγραινα GA/GGRAINA gángraina gang'-grahee-nah from γραίνω GRAI/NW graínō (to gnaw); an ulcer ("gangrene"):--canker.
entries.1045: Γάδ *GA/D Gád gad of Hebrew origin (H01410); Gad, a tribe of Israelites:--Gad.
entries.1046: Γαδαρηνός *GADARHNO/S Gadarēnós gad-ar-ay-nos' from Γαδαρά *GADARA/ Gadará (a town east of the Jordan); a Gadarene or inhabitant of Gadara:--Gadarene.
entries.1047: γάζα GA/ZA gáza gad'-zah of foreign origin; a treasure:--treasure.
entries.1048: Γάζα *GA/ZA Gáza gad'-zah of Hebrew origin (H05804); Gazah (i.e. Azzah), a place in Palestine:--Gaza.
entries.1049: γαζοφυλάκιον GAZOFULA/KION gazophylákion gad-zof-oo-lak'-ee-on from G1047 and G5438; a treasure-house, i.e. a court in the temple for the collection-boxes:--treasury.
entries.1050: Γάϊος *GA/I+OS Gáïos gah'-ee-os of Latin origin; Gaius (i.e. Caius), a Christian:--Gaius.
entries.1051: γάλα GA/LA gála gal'-ah of uncertain affinity; milk (figuratively):--milk.
entries.1052: Γαλάτης *GALA/THS Galátēs gal-at'-ace from G1053; a Galatian or inhabitant of Galatia:--Galatian.
entries.1053: Γαλατία *GALATI/A Galatía gal-at-ee'-ah of foreign origin; Galatia, a region of Asia:--Galatia.
entries.1054: Γαλατικός *GALATIKO/S Galatikós gal-at-ee-kos' from G1053; Galatic or relating to Galatia:--of Galatia.
entries.1055: γαλήνη GALH/NH galḗnē gal-ay'-nay of uncertain derivation; tranquillity:--calm.
entries.1056: Γαλιλαία *GALILAI/A Galilaía gal-il-ah'-yah of Hebrew origin (H01551); Galilæa (i.e. the heathen circle), a region of Palestine:--Galilee.
entries.1057: Γαλιλαῖος *GALILAI=OS Galilaîos gal-ee-lah'-yos from G1056; Galilean or belonging to Galilea:--Galilean, of Galilee.
entries.1058: Γαλλίων *GALLI/WN Gallíōn gal-lee'-own of Latin origin; Gallion (i.e. Gallio), a Roman officer:--Gallio.
entries.1059: Γαμαλιήλ *GAMALIH/L Gamaliḗl gam-al-ee-ale' of Hebrew origin (H01583); Gamaliel (i.e. Gamliel), an Israelite:--Gamaliel.
entries.1060: γαμέω GAME/W gaméō gam-eh'-o from G1062; to wed (of either sex):--marry (a wife).
entries.1061: γαμίσκω GAMI/SKW gamískō gam-is'-ko from G1062; to espouse (a daughter to a husband):--give in marriage.
entries.1062: γάμος GA/MOS gámos gam'-os of uncertain affinity; nuptials:--marriage, wedding.
entries.1063: γάρ GA/R gár gar a primary particle; properly, assigning a reason (used in argument, explanation or intensification; often with other particles):--and, as, because (that), but, even, for, indeed, no doubt, seeing, then, therefore, verily, what, why, yet.
entries.1064: γαστήρ GASTH/R gastḗr gas-tare' of uncertain derivation; the stomach; by analogy, the matrix; figuratively, a gourmand:--belly, + with child, womb.
entries.1065: γέ GE/ gé gheh a primary particle of emphasis or qualification (often used with other particles prefixed) :--and besides, doubtless, at least, yet.
entries.1066: Γεδεών *GEDEW/N Gedeṓn ghed-eh-own' of Hebrew origin (H01439); Gedeon (i.e. Gid(e)on), an Israelite:--Gedeon (in the King James Version).
