entries.1067: γέεννα GE/ENNA géenna gheh'-en-nah of Hebrew origin (H01516 and H02011); valley of (the son of) Hinnom; ge-henna (or Ge-Hinnom), a valley of Jerusalem, used (figuratively) as a name for the place (or state) of everlasting punishment:--hell.
entries.1068: Γεθσημανῆ *GEQSHMANH= Gethsēmanē gheth-say-man-ay' of Chaldee origin (compare H01660 and H08081); oil-press; Gethsemane, a garden near Jerusalem:--Gethsemane.
entries.1069: γείτων GEI/TWN geítōn ghi'-tone from G1093; a neighbour (as adjoining one's ground); by implication, a friend:--neighbour.
entries.1070: γελάω GELA/W geláō ghel-ah'-o of uncertain affinity; to laugh (as a sign of joy or satisfaction):--laugh.
entries.1071: γέλως GE/LWS gélōs ghel'-os from G1070; laughter (as a mark of gratification):--laughter.
entries.1072: γεμίζω GEMI/ZW gemízō ghem-id'-zo transitive from G1073; to fill entirely:--fill (be) full.
entries.1073: γέμω GE/MW gémō ghem'-o a primary verb; to swell out, i.e. be full:--be full.
entries.1074: γενεά GENEA/ geneá ghen-eh-ah' from (a presumed derivative of) G1085; a generation; by implication, an age (the period or the persons):--age, generation, nation, time.
entries.1075: γενεαλογέω GENEALOGE/W genealogéō ghen-eh-al-og-eh'-o from G1074 and G3056; to reckon by generations, i.e. trace in genealogy:--count by descent.
entries.1076: γενεαλογία GENEALOGI/A genealogía ghen-eh-al-og-ee'-ah from the same as G1075; tracing by generations, i.e. "genealogy":--genealogy.
entries.1077: γενέσια GENE/SIA genésia ghen-es'-ee-ah neuter plural of a derivative of G1078; birthday ceremonies:--birthday.
entries.1078: γένεσις GE/NESIS génesis ghen'-es-is from the same as G1074; nativity; figuratively, nature:--generation, nature(-ral).
entries.1079: γενετή GENETH/ genetḗ ghen-et-ay feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of G1074; birth:--birth.
entries.1080: γεννάω GENNA/W gennáō ghen-nah'-o from a variation of G1085; to procreate (properly, of the father, but by extension of the mother); figuratively, to regenerate:--bear, beget, be born, bring forth, conceive, be delivered of, gender, make, spring.
entries.1081: γέννημα GE/NNHMA génnēma ghen'-nay-mah from G1080; offspring; by analogy, produce (literally or figuratively):--fruit, generation.
entries.1082: Γεννησαρέτ *GENNHSARE/T Gennēsarét ghen-nay-sar-et' of Hebrew origin (compare H03672); Gennesaret (i.e. Kinnereth), a lake and plain in Palestine:--Gennesaret.
entries.1083: γέννησις GE/NNHSIS génnēsis ghen'-nay-sis from G1080; nativity:--birth.
entries.1084: γεννητός GENNHTO/S gennētós ghen-nay-tos' from G1080; born:--they that are born.
entries.1085: γένος GE/NOS génos ghen'-os from G1096; "kin" (abstract or concrete, literal or figurative, individual or collective):--born, country(-man), diversity, generation, kind(-red), nation, offspring, stock.
entries.1086: Γεργεσηνός *GERGESHNO/S Gergesēnós gher-ghes-ay-nos' of Hebrew origin (H01622); a Gergesene (i.e. Girgashite) or one of the aborigines of Palestine:--Gergesene.
entries.1087: γερουσία GEROUSI/A gerousía gher-oo-see'-ah from G1088; the eldership, i.e. (collectively) the Jewish Sanhedrin:--senate.
entries.1088: γέρων GE/RWN gérōn gher'-own of uncertain affinity (compare G1094); aged:--old.
entries.1089: γεύομαι GEU/OMAI geúomai ghyoo'-om-ahee a primary verb; to taste; by implication, to eat; figuratively, to experience (good or ill):--eat, taste.
entries.1090: γεωργέω GEWRGE/W geōrgéō gheh-or-gheh'-o from G1092; to till (the soil):--dress.
entries.1091: γεώργιον GEW/RGION geṓrgion gheh-ore'-ghee-on neuter of a (presumed) derivative of G1092; cultivable, i.e. a farm:--husbandry.
entries.1092: γεωργός GEWRGO/S geōrgós gheh-ore-gos' from G1093 and the base of G2041; a land-worker, i.e. farmer:--husbandman.
entries.1093: γῆ GH= gē ghay contracted from a primary word; soil; by extension a region, or the solid part or the whole of the terrene globe (including the occupants in each application):--country, earth(-ly), ground, land, world.
entries.1094: γῆρας GH=RAS gēras ghay'-ras akin to G1088; senility:--old age.
entries.1095: γηράσκω GHRA/SKW gēráskō ghay-ras'-ko from G1094; to be senescent:--be (wax) old.
entries.1096: γίνομαι GI/NOMAI gínomai ghin'-om-ahee a prolongation and middle voice form of a primary verb; to cause to be ("gen"-erate), i.e. (reflexively) to become (come into being), used with great latitude (literal, figurative, intensive, etc.):--arise, be assembled, be(-come, -fall, -have self), be brought (to pass), (be) come (to pass), continue, be divided, draw, be ended, fall, be finished, follow, be found, be fulfilled, + God forbid, grow, happen, have, be kept, be made, be married, be ordained to be, partake, pass, be performed, be published, require, seem, be showed, X soon as it was, sound, be taken, be turned, use, wax, will, would, be wrought.
entries.1097: γινώσκω GINW/SKW ginṓskō ghin-oce'-ko a prolonged form of a primary verb; to "know" (absolutely) in a great variety of applications and with many implications (as follow, with others not thus clearly expressed):--allow, be aware (of), feel, (have) know(-ledge), perceived, be resolved, can speak, be sure, understand.
entries.1098: γλεῦκος GLEU=KOS gleûkos glyoo'-kos akin to G1099; sweet wine, i.e. (properly) must (fresh juice), but used of the more saccharine (and therefore highly inebriating) fermented wine:--new wine.
entries.1099: γλυκύς GLUKU/S glykýs gloo-koos' of uncertain affinity; sweet (i.e. not bitter nor salt):--sweet, fresh.
entries.1100: γλῶσσα GLW=SSA glōssa gloce-sah' of uncertain affinity; the tongue; by implication, a language (specially, one naturally unacquired):--tongue.
entries.1101: γλωσσόκομον GLWSSO/KOMON glōssókomon gloce-sok'-om-on from G1100 and the base of G2889; properly, a case (to keep mouthpieces of wind-instruments in) i.e. (by extension) a casket or (specially) purse:--bag.
entries.1102: γναφεύς GNAFEU/S gnapheús gnaf-yuce' by variation for a derivative from κνάπτω KNA/PTW knáptō (to tease cloth); a cloth-dresser:--fuller.
entries.1103: γνήσιος GNH/SIOS gnḗsios gnay'-see-os from the same as G1077; legitimate (of birth), i.e. genuine:--own, sincerity, true.
entries.1104: γνησίως GNHSI/WS gnēsíōs gnay-see'-ose adverb from G1103; genuinely, i.e. really:--naturally.
entries.1105: γνόφος GNO/FOS gnóphos gnof'-os akin to G3509; gloom (as of a storm):--blackness.
entries.1106: γνώμη GNW/MH gnṓmē gno'-may from G1097; cognition, i.e. (subjectively) opinion, or (objectively) resolve (counsel, consent, etc.):--advice, + agree, judgment, mind, purpose, will.
entries.1107: γνωρίζω GNWRI/ZW gnōrízō gno-rid'-zo from a derivative of G1097; to make known; subjectively, to know:--certify, declare, make known, give to understand, do to wit, wot.
entries.1108: γνῶσις GNW=SIS gnōsis gno'-sis from G1097; knowing (the act), i.e. (by implication) knowledge:--knowledge, science.
entries.1109: γνώστης GNW/STHS gnṓstēs gnoce'-tace from G1097; a knower:--expert.
entries.1110: γνωστός GNWSTO/S gnōstós gnoce-tos' from G1097; well-known:--acquaintance, (which may be) known, notable.
entries.1111: γογγύζω GOGGU/ZW gongýzō gong-good'-zo of uncertain derivation; to grumble:--murmur.
entries.1112: γογγυσμός GOGGUSMO/S gongysmós gong-goos-mos' from G1111; a grumbling:--grudging, murmuring.
entries.1113: γογγυστής GOGGUSTH/S gongystḗs gong-goos-tace' from G1111; a grumbler:--murmurer.
entries.1114: γόης GO/HS góēs go'-ace from γοάω GOA/W goáō (to wail); properly, a wizard (as muttering spells), i.e. (by implication) an imposter:--seducer.
entries.1115: Γολγοθᾶ *GOLGOQA= Golgothâ gol-goth-ah' of Chaldee origin (compare H01538); the skull; Golgotha, a knoll near Jerusalem:--Golgotha.
entries.1116: Γόμοῤῥα *GO/MOR)R(A Gómorrha gom'-or-hrhah of Hebrew origin (H06017); Gomorrha (i.e. Amorah), a place near the Dead Sea:--Gomorrha.
entries.1117: γόμος GO/MOS gómos gom'-os from G1073; a load (as filling), i.e. (specially) a cargo, or (by extension) wares:--burden, merchandise.
entries.1118: γονεύς GONEU/S goneús gon-yooce' from the base of G1096; a parent:--parent.
entries.1119: γόνυ GO/NU góny gon-oo' of uncertain affinity; the "knee":--knee(X -l).
entries.1120: γονυπετέω GONUPETE/W gonypetéō gon-oo-pet-eh'-o from a compound of G1119 and the alternate of G4098; to fall on the knee:--bow the knee, kneel down.
entries.1121: γράμμα GRA/MMA grámma gram'-mah from G1125; a writing, i.e. a letter, note, epistle, book, etc.; plural learning:--bill, learning, letter, scripture, writing, written.
entries.1122: γραμματεύς GRAMMATEU/S grammateús gram-mat-yooce' from G1121. a writer, i.e. (professionally) scribe or secretary :--scribe, town-clerk.
entries.1123: γραπτός GRAPTO/S graptós grap-tos' from G1125; inscribed (figuratively):--written.
entries.1124: γραφή GRAFH/ graphḗ graf-ay' from G1125; a document, i.e. holy Writ (or its contents or a statement in it):--scripture.
entries.1125: γράφω GRA/FW gráphō graf'-o a primary verb; to "grave", especially to write; figuratively, to describe:--describe, write(-ing, -ten).
entries.1126: γραώδης GRAW/DHS graṓdēs grah-o'-dace from γραύς GRAU/S graús (an old woman) and G1491; crone-like, i.e. silly:--old wives'.
entries.1127: γρηγορεύω GRHGOREU/W grēgoreúō gray-gor-yoo'-o from G1453; to keep awake, i.e. watch (literally or figuratively):--be vigilant, wake, (be) watch(-ful).
entries.1128: γυμνάζω GUMNA/ZW gymnázō goom-nad'-zo from G1131; to practise naked (in the games), i.e. train (figuratively):--exercise.
entries.1129: γυμνασία GUMNASI/A gymnasía goom-nas-ee'-ah from G1128; training, i.e. (figuratively) asceticism:--exercise.
entries.1130: γυμνητεύω GUMNHTEU/W gymnēteúō goom-nayt-yoo'-o from a derivative of G1131; to strip, i.e. (reflexively) go poorly clad:--be naked.
entries.1131: γυμνός GUMNO/S gymnós goom-nos' of uncertain affinity; nude (absolute or relative, literal or figurative):--naked.
entries.1132: γυμνότης GUMNO/THS gymnótēs goom-not'-ace from G1131; nudity (absolute or comparative):--nakedness.
entries.1133: γυναικάριον GUNAIKA/RION gynaikárion goo-nahee-kar'-ee-on a diminutive from G1135; a little (i.e. foolish) woman:--silly woman.
entries.1134: γυναικεῖος GUNAIKEI=OS gynaikeîos goo-nahee-ki'-os from G1135; feminine:--wife.
entries.1135: γυνή GUNH/ gynḗ goo-nay' probably from the base of G1096; a woman; specially, a wife:--wife, woman.
entries.1136: Γώγ *GW/G Gṓg gogue of Hebrew origin (H01463); Gog, a symbolic name for some future Antichrist:--Gog.
entries.1137: γωνία GWNI/A gōnía go-nee'-ah probably akin to G1119; an angle:--corner, quarter.
entries.1138: Δαβίδ *DABI/D Dabíd dab-eed' of Hebrew origin (H01732); Dabid (i.e. David), the Israelite king:--David.
entries.1139: δαιμονίζομαι DAIMONI/ZOMAI daimonízomai dahee-mon-id'-zom-ahee middle voice from G1142; to be exercised by a dæmon:--have a (be vexed with, be possessed with) devil(-s).
entries.1140: δαιμόνιον DAIMO/NION daimónion dahee-mon'-ee-on neuter of a derivative of G1142; a dæmonic being; by extension a deity:--devil, god.
entries.1141: δαιμονιώδης DAIMONIW/DHS daimoniṓdēs dahee-mon-ee-o'-dace from G1140 and G1142; dæmon-like:--devilish.
entries.1142: δαίμων DAI/MWN daímōn dah'-ee-mown from δαίω DAI/W daíō (to distribute fortunes); a dæmon or supernatural spirit (of a bad nature):--devil.
entries.1143: δάκνω DA/KNW dáknō dak'-no a prolonged form of a primary root; to bite, i.e. (figuratively) thwart:--bite.
entries.1144: δάκρυ DA/KRU dákry dak'-roo or δάκρυον DA/KRUON dákryon dak'-roo-on of uncertain affinity; a tear:--tear.
entries.1145: δακρύω DAKRU/W dakrýō dak-roo'-o from G1144; to shed tears:--weep. Compare G2799.
entries.1146: δακτύλιος DAKTU/LIOS daktýlios dak-too'-lee-os from G1147; a finger-ring:--ring.
entries.1147: δάκτυλος DA/KTULOS dáktylos dak'-too-los probably from G1176; a finger:--finger.
entries.1148: Δαλμανουθά *DALMANOUQA/ Dalmanouthá dal-man-oo-thah' probably of Chaldee origin; Dalmanutha, a place in Palestine:--Dalmanutha.
entries.1149: Δαλματία *DALMATI/A Dalmatía dal-mat-ee'-ah probably of foreign derivation; Dalmatia, a region of Europe:--Dalmatia.
entries.1150: δαμάζω DAMA/ZW damázō dam-ad'-zo a variation of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to tame:--tame.
entries.1151: δάμαλις DA/MALIS dámalis dam'-al-is probably from the base of G1150; a heifer (as tame):--heifer.
entries.1152: Δάμαρις *DA/MARIS Dámaris dam'-ar-is probably from the base of G1150; perhaps gentle; Damaris, an Athenian woman:--Damaris.
entries.1153: Δαμασκηνός *DAMASKHNO/S Damaskēnós dam-as-kay-nos' from G1154; a Damascene or inhabitant of Damascus:--Damascene.
entries.1154: Δαμασκός *DAMASKO/S Damaskós dam-as-kos' of Hebrew origin (H01834); Damascus, a city of Syria:--Damascus.
entries.1155: δανείζω DANEI/ZW daneízō dan-ide'-zo from G1156; to loan on interest; reflexively, to borrow:--borrow, lend.
entries.1156: δάνειον DA/NEION dáneion dan'-i-on from δάνος DA/NOS dános (a gift); probably akin to the base of G1325; a loan:--debt.
entries.1157: δανειστής DANEISTH/S daneistḗs dan-ice-tace' from G1155; a lender:--creditor.
entries.1158: Δανιήλ *DANIH/L Daniḗl dan-ee-ale' of Hebrew origin (H01840); Daniel, an Israelite:--Daniel.
entries.1159: δαπανάω DAPANA/W dapanáō dap-an-ah'-o from G1160; to expend, i.e. (in a good sense) to incur cost, or (in a bad one) to waste:--be at charges, consume, spend.
entries.1160: δαπάνη DAPA/NH dapánē dap-an'-ay from δάπτω DA/PTW dáptō (to devour); expense (as consuming):--cost.
entries.1161: δέ DE/ dé deh a primary particle (adversative or continuative); but, and, etc.:--also, and, but, moreover, now (often unexpressed in English).
entries.1162: δέησις DE/HSIS déēsis deh'-ay-sis from G1189; a petition:--prayer, request, supplication.
entries.1163: δεῖ DEI= deî die 3rd person singular active present of G1210; also δέον DE/ON déon deh-on' ; neuter active participle of the same; both used impersonally; it is (was, etc.) necessary (as binding):--behoved, be meet, must (needs), (be) need(-ful), ought, should.
entries.1164: δεῖγμα DEI=GMA deîgma digh'-mah from the base of G1166; a specimen (as shown):--example.
entries.1165: δειγματίζω DEIGMATI/ZW deigmatízō digh-mat-id'-zo from G1164; to exhibit:--make a shew.
entries.1166: δεικνύω DEIKNU/W deiknýō dike-noo'-o a prolonged form of an obsolete primary of the same meaning; to show (literally or figuratively):--shew.
entries.1167: δειλία DEILI/A deilía di-lee'-ah from G1169; timidity:--fear.
entries.1168: δειλιάω DEILIA/W deiliáō di-lee-ah'-o from G1167; to be timid:--be afraid.
entries.1169: δειλός DEILO/S deilós di-los' from δεός DEO/S deós (dread); timid, i.e. (by implication) faithless:--fearful.
entries.1170: δεῖνα DEI=NA deîna di'-nah probably from the same as G1171 (through the idea of forgetting the name as fearful, i.e. strange); so and so (when the person is not specified):--such a man.
entries.1171: δεινῶς DEINW=S deinōs di-noce' adverb from a derivative of the same as G1169; terribly, i.e. excessively:--grievously, vehemently.
entries.1172: δειπνέω DEIPNE/W deipnéō dipe-neh'-o from G1173; to dine, i.e. take the principle (or evening) meal:--sup (X -er).
entries.1173: δεῖπνον DEI=PNON deîpnon dipe'-non from the same as G1160; dinner, i.e. the chief meal (usually in the evening):--feast, supper.
entries.1174: δεισιδαιμονέστερος DEISIDAIMONE/STEROS deisidaimonésteros dice-ee-dahee-mon-es'-ter-os the compound of a derivative of the base of G1169 and G1142; more religious than others:--too superstitious.
entries.1175: δεισιδαιμονία DEISIDAIMONI/A deisidaimonía dice-ee-dahee-mon-ee'-ah from the same as G1174; religion:--superstition.
entries.1176: δέκα DE/KA déka dek'-ah a primary number; ten:--(eight-)een, ten.
entries.1177: δεκαδύο DEKADU/O dekadýo dek-ad-oo'-o from G1176 and G1417; two and ten, i.e. twelve:--twelve.
entries.1178: δεκαπέντε DEKAPE/NTE dekapénte dek-ap-en'-teh from G1176 and G4002; ten and five, i.e. fifteen:--fifteen.
entries.1179: Δεκάπολις *DEKA/POLIS Dekápolis dek-ap'-ol-is from G1176 and G4172; the ten-city region; the Decapolis, a district in Syria:--Decapolis.
entries.1180: δεκατέσσαρες DEKATE/SSARES dekatéssares dek-at-es'-sar-es from G1176 and G5064; ten and four, i.e. fourteen:--fourteen.
entries.1181: δεκάτη DEKA/TH dekátē dek-at'-ay feminine of G1182; a tenth, i.e. as a percentage or (technically) tithe:--tenth (part), tithe.
entries.1182: δέκατος DE/KATOS dékatos dek'-at-os ordinal from G1176; tenth:--tenth.
entries.1183: δεκατόω DEKATO/W dekatóō dek-at-o'-o from G1181; to tithe, i.e. to give or take a tenth:--pay (receive) tithes.
entries.1184: δεκτός DEKTO/S dektós dek-tos' from G1209; approved; (figuratively) propitious:-- accepted(-table).
entries.1185: δελεάζω DELEA/ZW deleázō del-eh-ad'-zo from the base of G1388; to entrap, i.e. (figuratively) delude:--allure, beguile, entice.
entries.1186: δένδρον DE/NDRON déndron den'-dron probably from δρύς DRU/S drýs (an oak); a tree:--tree.
entries.1187: δεξιολάβος DECIOLA/BOS dexiolábos dex-ee-ol-ab'-os from G1188 and G2983; a guardsman (as if taking the right) or light-armed soldier:--spearman.
entries.1188: δεξιός DECIO/S dexiós dex-ee-os' from G1209; the right side or (feminine) hand (as that which usually takes):--right (hand, side).
entries.1189: δέομαι DE/OMAI déomai deh'-om-ahee middle voice of G1210; to beg (as binding oneself), i.e. petition:--beseech, pray (to), make request. Compare G4441.
entries.1190: Δερβαῖος *DERBAI=OS Derbaîos der-bah'-ee-os from G1191; a Derbæan or inhabitant of Derbe:--of Derbe.
entries.1191: Δέρβη *DE/RBH Dérbē der-bay' of foreign origin; Derbe, a place in Asia Minor:--Derbe.
entries.1192: δέρμα DE/RMA dérma der'-mah from G1194; a hide:--skin.
entries.1193: δερμάτινος DERMA/TINOS dermátinos der-mat'-ee-nos from G1192; made of hide:--leathern, of a skin.
entries.1194: δέρω DE/RW dérō der'-o a primary verb; properly, to flay, i.e. (by implication) to scourge, or (by analogy) to thrash:--beat, smite.
entries.1195: δεσμεύω DESMEU/W desmeúō des-myoo'-o from a (presumed) derivative of G1196; to be a binder (captor), i.e. to enchain (a prisoner), to tie on (a load):-- bind.
entries.1196: δεσμέω DESME/W desméō des-meh'-o from G1199; to tie, i.e. shackle:--bind.
entries.1197: δέσμη DE/SMH désmē des-may' from G1196; a bundle:--bundle.
entries.1198: δέσμιος DE/SMIOS désmios des'-mee-os from G1199; a captive (as bound):--in bonds, prisoner.
entries.1199: δεσμόν DESMO/N desmón des-mon' or δεσμός DESMO/S desmós des-mos' neuter and masculine respectively from G1210; a band, i.e. ligament (of the body) or shackle (of a prisoner); figuratively, an impediment or disability:--band, bond, chain, string.
entries.1200: δεσμοφύλαξ DESMOFU/LAC desmophýlax des-mof-oo'-lax from G1199 and G5441; a jailer (as guarding the prisoners):--jailor, keeper of the prison.
entries.1201: δεσμωτήριον DESMWTH/RION desmōtḗrion des-mo-tay'-ree-on from a derivative of G1199 (equivalent to G1196); a place of bondage, i.e. a dungeon:--prison.
entries.1202: δεσμώτης DESMW/THS desmṓtēs des-mo'-tace from the same as G1201; (passively) a captive:--prisoner.
entries.1203: δεσπότης DESPO/THS despótēs des-pot'-ace perhaps from G1210 and πόσις PO/SIS pósis (a husband); an absolute ruler ("despot"):--Lord, master.
entries.1204: δεῦρο DEU=RO deûro dyoo'-ro of uncertain affinity; here; used also imperative hither!; and of time, hitherto:--come (hither), hither(-to).
entries.1205: δεῦτε DEU=TE deûte dyoo'-teh from G1204 and an imperative form of εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi (to go); come hither!:--come, X follow.
entries.1206: δευτεραῖος DEUTERAI=OS deuteraîos dyoo-ter-ah'-yos from G1208; secondary, i.e. (specially) on the second day:--next day.
entries.1207: δευτερόπρωτος DEUTERO/PRWTOS deuteróprōtos dyoo-ter-op'-ro-tos from G1208 and G4413; second-first, i.e. (specially) a designation of the Sabbath immediately after the Paschal week (being the second after Passover day, and the first of the seven Sabbaths intervening before Pentecost):--second … after the first.
entries.1208: δεύτερος DEU/TEROS deúteros dyoo'-ter-os as the comparative of G1417; (ordinal) second (in time, place, or rank; also adverb):--afterward, again, second(-arily, time).
entries.1209: δέχομαι DE/XOMAI déchomai dekh'-om-ahee middle voice of a primary verb; to receive (in various applications, literally or figuratively):--accept, receive, take. Compare G2983.
entries.1210: δέω DE/W déō deh'-o a primary verb; to bind (in various applications, literally or figuratively):--bind, be in bonds, knit, tie, wind. See also G1163, G1189.
entries.1211: δή DH/ dḗ day probably akin to G1161; a particle of emphasis or explicitness; now, then, etc.:--also, and, doubtless, now, therefore.
entries.1212: δῆλος DH=LOS dēlos day'-los of uncertain derivation; clear:--+ bewray, certain, evident, manifest.
entries.1213: δηλόω DHLO/W dēlóō day-lo'-o from G1212; to make plain (by words):--declare, shew, signify.
entries.1214: Δημᾶς *DHMA=S Dēmâs day-mas' probably for G1216; Demas, a Christian:--Demas.
entries.1215: δημηγορέω DHMHGORE/W dēmēgoréō day-may-gor-eh'-o from a compound of G1218 and G58; to be a people-gatherer, i.e. to address a public assembly:--make an oration.
entries.1216: Δημήτριος *DHMH/TRIOS Dēmḗtrios day-may'-tree-os from Δημήτηρ *DHMH/THR Dēmḗtēr (Ceres); Demetrius, the name of an Ephesian and of a Christian:--Demetrius.
entries.1217: δημιουργός DHMIOURGO/S dēmiourgós day-me-oor-gos' from G1218 and G2041; a worker for the people, i.e. mechanic (spoken of the Creator):--maker.
entries.1218: δῆμος DH=MOS dēmos day'-mos from G1210; the public (as bound together socially):--people.
entries.1219: δημόσιος DHMO/SIOS dēmósios day-mos'ee-os from G1218; public; (feminine singular dative case as adverb) in public:--common, openly, publickly.
entries.1220: δηνάριον DHNA/RION dēnárion day-nar'-ee-on of Latin origin; a denarius (or ten asses):--pence, penny(-worth).
entries.1221: δήποτε DH/POTE dḗpote day'-pot-eh from G1211 and G4218; a particle of generalization; indeed, at any time:--(what-)soever.
entries.1222: δήπου DH/POU dḗpou day'-poo from G1211 and G4225; a particle of asseveration; indeed doubtless:--verily.
entries.1223: διά DIA/ diá dee-ah' a primary preposition denoting the channel of an act; through (in very wide applications, local, causal, or occasional):--after, always, among, at, to avoid, because of (that), briefly, by, for (cause) … fore, from, in, by occasion of, of, by reason of, for sake, that, thereby, therefore, X though, through(-out), to, wherefore, with (-in). In composition it retains the same general importance.
entries.1224: διαβαίνω DIABAI/NW diabaínō dee-ab-ah'-ee-no from G1223 and the base of G939; to cross:--come over, pass (through).
entries.1225: διαβάλλω DIABA/LLW diabállō dee-ab-al'-lo from G1223 and G906; (figuratively) to traduce:--accuse.
entries.1226: διαβεβαιόομαι DIABEBAIO/OMAI diabebaióomai dee-ab-eb-ahee-o'-om-ahee middle voice of a compound of G1223 and G950; to confirm thoroughly (by words), i.e. asseverate:--affirm constantly.
entries.1227: διαβλέπω DIABLE/PW diablépō dee-ab-lep'-o from G1223 and G991; to look through, i.e. recover full vision:--see clearly.
entries.1228: διάβολος DIA/BOLOS diábolos dee-ab'-ol-os from G1225; a traducer; specially, Satan (compare H07854):--false accuser, devil, slanderer.
entries.1229: διαγγέλλω DIAGGE/LLW diangéllō de-ang-gel'-lo from G1223 and the base of G32; to herald thoroughly:--declare, preach, signify.
entries.1230: διαγίνομαι DIAGI/NOMAI diagínomai dee-ag-in'-om-ahee from G1223 and G1096; to elapse meanwhile:--X after, be past, be spent.
entries.1231: διαγινώσκω DIAGINW/SKW diaginṓskō dee-ag-in-o'-sko from G1223 and G1097; to know thoroughly, i.e. ascertain exactly:--(would) enquire, know the uttermost.
entries.1232: διαγνωρίζω DIAGNWRI/ZW diagnōrízō dee-ag-no-rid'-zo from G1123 and G1107; to tell abroad:--make known.
entries.1233: διάγνωσις DIA/GNWSIS diágnōsis dee-ag'-no-sis from G1231; (magisterial) examination ("diagnosis"):--hearing.
entries.1234: διαγογγύζω DIAGOGGU/ZW diagongýzō dee-ag-ong-good'-zo from G1223 and G1111; to complain throughout a crowd:--murmur.
entries.1235: διαγρηγορέω DIAGRHGORE/W diagrēgoréō dee-ag-ray-gor-eh'-o from G1223 and G1127; to waken thoroughly:--be awake.
entries.1236: διάγω DIA/GW diágō dee-ag'-o from G1223 and G71; to pass time or life:--lead life, living.
entries.1237: διαδέχομαι DIADE/XOMAI diadéchomai dee-ad-ekh'-om-ahee from G1223 and G1209; to receive in turn, i.e. (figuratively) succeed to:--come after.
entries.1238: διάδημα DIA/DHMA diádēma dee-ad'-ay-mah from a compound of G1223 and G1210; a "diadem" (as bound about the head):--crown. Compare G4735.
entries.1239: διαδίδωμι DIADI/DWMI diadídōmi dee-ad-id'-o-mee from G1223 and G1325; to give throughout a crowd, i.e. deal out; also to deliver over (as to a successor):--(make) distribute(-ion), divide, give.
entries.1240: διάδοχος DIA/DOXOS diádochos dee-ad'-okh-os from G1237; a successor in office:--room.
entries.1241: διαζώννυμι DIAZW/NNUMI diazṓnnymi dee-az-own'-noo-mee from G1223 and G2224; to gird tightly:--gird.
entries.1242: διαθήκη DIAQH/KH diathḗkē dee-ath-ay'-kay from G1303; properly, a disposition, i.e. (specially) a contract (especially a devisory will):--covenant, testament.
entries.1243: διαίρεσις DIAI/RESIS diaíresis dee-ah'-ee-res-is from G1244; a distinction or (concretely) variety:--difference, diversity.
entries.1244: διαιρέω DIAIRE/W diairéō dee-ahee-reh'-o from G1223 and G138; to separate, i.e. distribute:--divide.
entries.1245: διακαθαρίζω DIAKAQARI/ZW diakatharízō dee-ak-ath-ar-id'-zo from G1223 and G2511; to cleanse perfectly, i.e. (specially) winnow:--thoroughly purge.
entries.1246: διακατελέγχομαι DIAKATELE/GXOMAI diakatelénchomai dee-ak-at-el-eng'-khom-ahee middle voice from G1223 and a compound of G2596 and G1651; to prove downright, i.e. confute:--convince.
entries.1247: διακονέω DIAKONE/W diakonéō dee-ak-on-eh'-o from G1249; to be an attendant, i.e. wait upon (menially or as a host, friend, or (figuratively) teacher); technically, to act as a Christian deacon:--(ad-)minister (unto), serve, use the office of a deacon.
entries.1248: διακονία DIAKONI/A diakonía dee-ak-on-ee'-ah from G1249; attendance (as a servant, etc.); figuratively (eleemosynary) aid, (official) service (especially of the Christian teacher, or technically of the diaconate):--(ad-)minister(-ing, -tration, -try), office, relief, service(-ing).
entries.1249: διάκονος DIA/KONOS diákonos dee-ak'-on-os probably from an obsolete διάκω DIA/KW diákō (to run on errands; compare G1377); an attendant, i.e. (genitive case) a waiter (at table or in other menial duties); specially, a Christian teacher and pastor (technically, a deacon or deaconess):--deacon, minister, servant.
entries.1250: διακόσιοι DIAKO/SIOI diakósioi dee-ak-os'-ee-oy from G1364 and G1540; two hundred:--two hundred.
entries.1251: διακούομαι DIAKOU/OMAI diakoúomai dee-ak-oo'-om-ahee middle voice from G1223 and G191; to hear throughout, i.e. patiently listen (to a prisoner's plea):--hear.
entries.1252: διακρίνω DIAKRI/NW diakrínō dee-ak-ree'-no from G1223 and G2919; to separate thoroughly, i.e. (literally and reflexively) to withdraw from, or (by implication) oppose; figuratively, to discriminate (by implication, decide), or (reflexively) hesitate:--contend, make (to) differ(-ence), discern, doubt, judge, be partial, stagger, waver.
entries.1253: διάκρισις DIA/KRISIS diákrisis dee-ak'-ree-sis from G1252; judicial estimation:--discern(-ing), disputation.
entries.1254: διακωλύω DIAKWLU/W diakōlýō dee-ak-o-loo'-o from G1223 and G2967; to hinder altogether, i.e. utterly prohibit:--forbid.
entries.1255: διαλαλέω DIALALE/W dialaléō dee-al-al-eh'-o from G1223 and G2980; to talk throughout a company, i.e. converse or (genitive case) publish:--commune, noise abroad.
entries.1256: διαλέγομαι DIALE/GOMAI dialégomai dee-al-eg'-om-ahee middle voice from G1223 and G3004; to say thoroughly, i.e. discuss (in argument or exhortation):--dispute, preach (unto), reason (with), speak.
entries.1257: διαλείπω DIALEI/PW dialeípō dee-al-i'-po from G1223 and G3007; to leave off in the middle, i.e. intermit:--cease.
entries.1258: διάλεκτος DIA/LEKTOS diálektos dee-al'-ek-tos from G1256; a (mode of) discourse, i.e. "dialect":--language, tongue.
entries.1259: διαλλάσσω DIALLA/SSW diallássō dee-al-las'-so from G1223 and G236; to change thoroughly, i.e. (mentally) to conciliate:--reconcile.
entries.1260: διαλογίζομαι DIALOGI/ZOMAI dialogízomai dee-al-og-id'-zom-ahee from G1223 and G3049; to reckon thoroughly, i.e. (genitive case) to deliberate (by reflection or discussion):--cast in mind, consider, dispute, muse, reason, think.
entries.1261: διαλογισμός DIALOGISMO/S dialogismós dee-al-og-is-mos' from G1260; discussion, i.e. (internal) consideration (by implication, purpose), or (external) debate:--dispute, doubtful(-ing), imagination, reasoning, thought.
entries.1262: διαλύω DIALU/W dialýō dee-al-oo'-o from G1223 and G3089; to dissolve utterly:--scatter.
entries.1263: διαμαρτύρομαι DIAMARTU/ROMAI diamartýromai dee-am-ar-too'-rom-ahee from G1223 and G3140; to attest or protest earnestly, or (by implication) hortatively:--charge, testify (unto), witness.
entries.1264: διαμάχομαι DIAMA/XOMAI diamáchomai dee-am-akh'-om-ahee from G1223 and G3164; to fight fiercely (in altercation):--strive.
entries.1265: διαμένω DIAME/NW diaménō dee-am-en'-o from G1223 and G3306; to stay constantly (in being or relation):--continue, remain.
entries.1266: διαμερίζω DIAMERI/ZW diamerízō dee-am-er-id'-zo from G1223 and G3307; to partition thoroughly (literally in distribution, figuratively in dissension):--cloven, divide, part.
entries.1267: διαμερισμός DIAMERISMO/S diamerismós dee-am-er-is-mos' from G1266; disunion (of opinion and conduct):--division.
entries.1268: διανέμω DIANE/MW dianémō dee-an-em'-o from G1223 and the base of G3551; to distribute, i.e. (of information) to disseminate:--spread.
entries.1269: διανεύω DIANEU/W dianeúō dee-an-yoo'-o from G1223 and G3506; to nod (or express by signs) across an intervening space:--beckon.
entries.1270: διανόημα DIANO/HMA dianóēma dee-an-o'-ay-mah from a compound of G1223 and G3539; something thought through, i.e. a sentiment:--thought.
entries.1271: διάνοια DIA/NOIA diánoia dee-an'-oy-ah from G1223 and G3563; deep thought, properly, the faculty (mind or its disposition), by implication, its exercise:-- imagination, mind, understanding.
entries.1272: διανοίγω DIANOI/GW dianoígō dee-an-oy'-go from G1223 and G455; to open thoroughly, literally (as a first-born) or figuratively (to expound):--open.
entries.1273: διανυκτερεύω DIANUKTEREU/W dianyktereúō dee-an-ook-ter-yoo'-o from G1223 and a derivative of G3571; to sit up the whole night:--continue all night.
entries.1274: διανύω DIANU/W dianýō dee-an-oo'-o from G1223 and ἀνύω A)NU/W anýō (to effect); to accomplish thoroughly:--finish.
entries.1275: διαπαντός DIAPANTO/S diapantós dee-ap-an-tos' from G1223 and the genitive case of G3956; through all time, i.e. (adverbially) constantly:--alway(-s), continually.
entries.1276: διαπεράω DIAPERA/W diaperáō dee-ap-er-ah'-o from G1223 and a derivative of the base of G4008; to cross entirely:--go over, pass (over), sail over.
entries.1277: διαπλέω DIAPLE/W diapléō dee-ap-leh'-o from G1223 and G4126; to sail through:--sail over.
entries.1278: διαπονέω DIAPONE/W diaponéō dee-ap-on-eh'-o from G1223 and a derivative of G4192; to toil through, i.e. (passively) be worried:--be grieved.
entries.1279: διαπορεύομαι DIAPOREU/OMAI diaporeúomai dee-ap-or-yoo'-om-ahee from G1223 and G4198; to travel through:--go through, journey in, pass by.
entries.1280: διαπορέω DIAPORE/W diaporéō dee-ap-or-eh'-o from G1223 and G639; to be thoroughly nonplussed:--(be in) doubt, be (much) perplexed.
entries.1281: διαπραγματεύομαι DIAPRAGMATEU/OMAI diapragmateúomai dee-ap-rag-mat-yoo'-om-ahee from G1223 and G4231; to thoroughly occupy oneself, i.e. (transitively and by implication) to earn in business:--gain by trading.
entries.1282: διαπρίω DIAPRI/W diapríō dee-ap-ree'-o from G1223 and the base of G4249; to saw asunder, i.e. (figuratively) to exasperate:--cut (to the heart).
entries.1283: διαρπάζω DIARPA/ZW diarpázō dee-ar-pad'-zo from G1223 and G726; to seize asunder, i.e. plunder:--spoil.
entries.1284: διαῤῥήσσω DIAR)R(H/SSW diarrhḗssō dee-ar-hrayce'-so from G1223 and G4486; to tear asunder:--break, rend.
entries.1285: διασαφέω DIASAFE/W diasaphéō dee-as-af-eh'-o from G1223 and σαφής SAFH/S saphḗs (clear); to clear thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) declare:--tell unto.
entries.1286: διασείω DIASEI/W diaseíō dee-as-i'-o from G1223 and G4579; to shake thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to intimidate:--do violence to.
entries.1287: διασκορπίζω DIASKORPI/ZW diaskorpízō dee-as-kor-pid'-zo from G1223 and G4650; to dissipate, i.e. (genitive case) to rout or separate; specially, to winnow; figuratively, to squander:--disperse, scatter (abroad), strew, waste.
entries.1288: διασπάω DIASPA/W diaspáō dee-as-pah'-o from G1223 and G4685; to draw apart, i.e. sever or dismember:--pluck asunder, pull in pieces.
entries.1289: διασπείρω DIASPEI/RW diaspeírō dee-as-pi'-ro from G1223 and G4687; to sow throughout, i.e. (figuratively) distribute in foreign lands:--scatter abroad.
entries.1290: διασπορά DIASPORA/ diasporá dee-as-por-ah' from G1289; dispersion, i.e. (specially and concretely) the (converted) Israelite resident in Gentile countries:--(which are) scattered (abroad).
entries.1291: διαστέλλομαι DIASTE/LLOMAI diastéllomai dee-as-tel'-lom-ahee middle voice from G1223 and G4724; to set (oneself) apart (figuratively, distinguish), i.e. (by implication) to enjoin:--charge, that which was (give) commanded(-ment).
entries.1292: διάστημα DIA/STHMA diástēma dee-as'-tay-mah from G1339; an interval:--space.
entries.1293: διαστολή DIASTOLH/ diastolḗ dee-as-tol-ay' from G1291; a variation:--difference, distinction.
entries.1294: διαστρέφω DIASTRE/FW diastréphō dee-as-tref'-o from G1223 and G4762; to distort, i.e. (figuratively) misinterpret, or (morally) corrupt:--perverse(-rt), turn away.
entries.1295: διασώζω DIASW/ZW diasṓzō dee-as-odze'-o from G1223 and G4982; to save thoroughly, i.e. (by implication or analogy) to cure, preserve, rescue, etc.:--bring safe, escape (safe), heal, make perfectly whole, save.
entries.1296: διαταγή DIATAGH/ diatagḗ dee-at-ag-ay' from G1299; arrangement, i.e. institution:--instrumentality.
entries.1297: διάταγμα DIA/TAGMA diátagma dee-at'-ag-mah from G1299; an arrangement, i.e. (authoritative) edict:--commandment.
entries.1298: διαταράσσω DIATARA/SSW diatarássō dee-at-ar-as'-so from G1223 and G5015; to disturb wholly, i.e. agitate (with alarm):--trouble.
entries.1299: διατάσσω DIATA/SSW diatássō dee-at-as'-so from G1223 and G5021; to arrange thoroughly, i.e. (specially) institute, prescribe, etc.:--appoint, command, give, (set in) order, ordain.
entries.1300: διατελέω DIATELE/W diateléō dee-at-el-eh'-o from G1223 and G5055; to accomplish thoroughly, i.e. (subjectively) to persist:--continue.
entries.1301: διατηρέω DIATHRE/W diatēréō dee-at-ay-reh'-o from G1223 and G5083; to watch thoroughly, i.e. (positively and transitively) to observe strictly, or (negatively and reflexively) to avoid wholly:--keep.
entries.1302: διατί DIATI/ diatí dee-at-ee' from G1223 and G5101; through what cause ?, i.e. why?:--wherefore, why.
entries.1303: διατίθεμαι DIATI/QEMAI diatíthemai dee-at-ith'-em-ahee middle voice from G1223 and G5087; to put apart, i.e. (figuratively) dispose (by assignment, compact, or bequest):--appoint, make, testator.
entries.1304: διατρίβω DIATRI/BW diatríbō dee-at-ree'-bo from G1223 and the base of G5147; to wear through (time), i.e. remain:--abide, be, continue, tarry.
entries.1305: διατροφή DIATROFH/ diatrophḗ dee-at-rof-ay' from a compound of G1223 and G5142; nourishment:--food.
entries.1306: διαυγάζω DIAUGA/ZW diaugázō dee-ow-gad'-zo from G1223 and G826; to glimmer through, i.e. break (as day):--dawn.
entries.1307: διαφανής DIAFANH/S diaphanḗs dee-af-an-ace' from G1223 and G5316; appearing through, i.e. "diaphanous":--transparent.
entries.1308: διαφέρω DIAFE/RW diaphérō dee-af-er'-o from G1223 and G5342; to bear through, i.e. (literally) transport; usually to bear apart, i.e. (objectively) to toss about (figuratively, report); subjectively, to "differ", or (by implication) surpass:--be better, carry, differ from, drive up and down, be (more) excellent, make matter, publish, be of more value.
entries.1309: διαφεύγω DIAFEU/GW diapheúgō dee-af-yoo'-go from G1223 and G5343; to flee through, i.e. escape:--escape.
entries.1310: διαφημίζω DIAFHMI/ZW diaphēmízō dee-af-ay-mid'-zo from G1223 and a derivative of G5345; to report thoroughly, i.e. divulgate:--blaze abroad, commonly report, spread abroad, fame.
entries.1311: διαφθείρω DIAFQEI/RW diaphtheírō dee-af-thi'-ro from G1225 and G5351; to rot thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to ruin (passively, decay utterly, figuratively, pervert):--corrupt, destroy, perish.
entries.1312: διαφθορά DIAFQORA/ diaphthorá dee-af-thor-ah' from G1311; decay:--corruption.
entries.1313: διάφορος DIA/FOROS diáphoros dee-af'-or-os from G1308; varying; also surpassing:--differing, divers, more excellent.
entries.1314: διαφυλάσσω DIAFULA/SSW diaphylássō dee-af-oo-las'-so from G1223 and G5442; to guard thoroughly, i.e. protect:--keep.
entries.1315: διαχειρίζομαι DIAXEIRI/ZOMAI diacheirízomai dee-akh-i-rid'-zom-ahee from G1223 and a derivative of G5495; to handle thoroughly, i.e. lay violent hands upon:--kill, slay.
entries.1316: διαχωρίζομαι DIAXWRI/ZOMAI diachōrízomai dee-akh-o-rid'-zom-ahee from G1223 and the middle voice of G5563; to remove (oneself) wholly, i.e. retire:--depart.
entries.1317: διδακτικός DIDAKTIKO/S didaktikós did-ak-tik-os' from G1318; instructive ("didactic"):--apt to teach.
entries.1318: διδακτός DIDAKTO/S didaktós did-ak-tos' from G1321; (subjectively) instructed, or (objectively) communicated by teaching:--taught, which … teacheth.
entries.1319: διδασκαλία DIDASKALI/A didaskalía did-as-kal-ee'-ah from G1320; instruction (the function or the information):--doctrine, learning, teaching.
entries.1320: διδάσκαλος DIDA/SKALOS didáskalos did-as'-kal-os from G1321; an instructor (genitive case or specially):--doctor, master, teacher.
entries.1321: διδάσκω DIDA/SKW didáskō did-as'-ko a prolonged (causative) form of a primary verb δάω DA/W dáō (to learn); to teach (in the same broad application):--teach.
entries.1322: διδαχή DIDAXH/ didachḗ did-akh-ay' from G1321; instruction (the act or the matter):--doctrine, hath been taught.
entries.1323: δίδραχμον DI/DRAXMON dídrachmon did'-rakh-mon from G1364 and G1406; a double drachma (didrachm):--tribute.
entries.1324: Δίδυμος *DI/DUMOS Dídymos did'-oo-mos prolongation from G1364; double, i.e. twin; Didymus, a Christian:--Didymus.
entries.1325: δίδωμι DI/DWMI dídōmi did'-o-mee a prolonged form of a primary verb (which is used as an alternative in most of the tenses); to give (used in a very wide application, properly, or by implication, literally or figuratively; greatly modified by the connection):--adventure, bestow, bring forth, commit, deliver (up), give, grant, hinder, make, minister, number, offer, have power, put, receive, set, shew, smite (+ with the hand), strike (+ with the palm of the hand), suffer, take, utter, yield.
entries.1326: διεγείρω DIEGEI/RW diegeírō dee-eg-i'-ro from G1223 and G1453; to wake fully; i.e. arouse (literally or figuratively):--arise, awake, raise, stir up.
entries.1327: διέξοδος DIE/CODOS diéxodos dee-ex'-od-os from G1223 and G1841; an outlet through, i.e. probably an open square (from which roads diverge):--highway.
entries.1328: διερμηνευτής DIERMHNEUTH/S diermēneutḗs dee-er-main-yoo-tace' from G1329; an explainer:--interpreter.
entries.1329: διερμηνεύω DIERMHNEU/W diermēneúō dee-er-main-yoo'-o from G1223 and G2059; to explain thoroughly, by implication, to translate:--expound, interpret(-ation).
entries.1330: διέρχομαι DIE/RXOMAI diérchomai dee-er'-khom-ahee from G1223 and G2064; to traverse (literally):--come, depart, go (about, abroad, everywhere, over, through, throughout), pass (by, over, through, throughout), pierce through, travel, walk through.
entries.1331: διερωτάω DIERWTA/W dierōtáō dee-er-o-tah'-o from G1223 and G2065; to question throughout, i.e. ascertain by interrogation:--make enquiry for.
entries.1332: διετής DIETH/S dietḗs dee-et-ace' from G1364 and G2094; of two years (in age):--two years old.
entries.1333: διετία DIETI/A dietía dee-et-ee'-a from G1332; a space of two years (biennium):--two years.
entries.1334: διηγέομαι DIHGE/OMAI diēgéomai dee-ayg-eh'-om-ahee from G1223 and G2233; to relate fully:--declare, shew, tell.
entries.1335: διήγεσις DIH/GESIS diḗgesis dee-ayg'-es-is from G1334; a recital:--declaration.
entries.1336: διηνεκής DIHNEKH/S diēnekḗs dee-ay-nek-es' neuter of a compound of G1223 and a derivative of an alternate of G5342; carried through, i.e. (adverbially with G1519 and G3588 prefixed) perpetually:--+ continually, for ever.
entries.1337: διθάλασσος DIQA/LASSOS dithálassos dee-thal'-as-sos from G1364 and G2281; having two seas, i.e. a sound with a double outlet:--where two seas meet.
entries.1338: διϊκνέομαι DII+KNE/OMAI diïknéomai dee-ik-neh'-om-ahee from G1223 and the base of G2425; to reach through, i.e. penetrate:--pierce.
entries.1339: διΐστημι DII/+STHMI diḯstēmi dee-is'-tay-mee from G1223 and G2476; to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove, intervene:--go further, be parted, after the space of.
entries.1340: διϊσχυρίζομαι DII+SXURI/ZOMAI diïschyrízomai dee-is-khoo-rid'-zom-ahee from G1223 and a derivative of G2478; to stout it through, i.e. asservate:--confidently (constantly) affirm.
entries.1341: δικαιοκρισία DIKAIOKRISI/A dikaiokrisía dik-ah-yok-ris-ee'-ah from G1342 and G2920; a just sentence:--righteous judgment.
entries.1342: δίκαιος DI/KAIOS díkaios dik'-ah-yos from G1349; equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent, holy (absolutely or relatively):--just, meet, right(-eous).
entries.1343: δικαιοσύνη DIKAIOSU/NH dikaiosýnē dik-ah-yos-oo'-nay from G1342; equity (of character or act); specially (Christian) justification:--righteousness.
entries.1344: δικαιόω DIKAIO/W dikaióō dik-ah-yo'-o from G1342; to render (i.e. show or regard as) just or innocent:--free, justify(-ier), be righteous.
entries.1345: δικαίωμα DIKAI/WMA dikaíōma dik-ah'-yo-mah from G1344; an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or decision:--judgment, justification, ordinance, righteousness.
entries.1346: δικαίως DIKAI/WS dikaíōs dik-ah'-yoce adverb from G1342; equitably:--justly, (to) righteously(-ness).
entries.1347: δικαίωσις DIKAI/WSIS dikaíōsis dik-ah'-yo-sis from G1344; aquittal (for Christ's sake):--justification.
entries.1348: δικαστής DIKASTH/S dikastḗs dik-as-tace' from a derivative of G1349; a judger:--judge.
entries.1349: δίκη DI/KH díkē dee'-kay probably from G1166; right (as self-evident), i.e. justice (the principle, a decision, or its execution):--judgment, punish, vengeance.
entries.1350: δίκτυον DI/KTUON díktyon dik'-too-on probably from a primary verb δίκω DI/KW díkō (to cast); a seine (for fishing):--net.
entries.1351: δίλογος DI/LOGOS dílogos dil'-og-os from G1364 and G3056; equivocal, i.e. telling a different story:--double-tongued.
entries.1352: διό DIO/ dió dee-o' from G1223 and G3739; through which thing, i.e. consequently:--for which cause, therefore, wherefore.
entries.1353: διοδεύω DIODEU/W diodeúō dee-od-yoo'-o from G1223 and G3593; to travel through:--go throughout, pass through.
entries.1354: Διονύσιος *DIONU/SIOS Dionýsios dee-on-oo'-see-os from Διόνυσος *DIO/NUSOS Diónysos (Bacchus); reveller; Dionysius, an Athenian:--Dionysius.
entries.1355: διόπερ DIO/PER dióper dee-op'-er from G1352 and G4007; on which very account:--wherefore.
entries.1356: διοπετής DIOPETH/S diopetḗs dee-op-et'-ace from the alternate of G2203 and the alternate of G4098; sky-fallen (i.e. an aerolite):--which fell down from Jupiter.
entries.1357: διόρθωσις DIO/RQWSIS diórthōsis dee-or'-tho-sis from a compound of G1223 and a derivative of G3717, meaning to straighten thoroughly; rectification, i.e. (specially) the Messianic restauration:--reformation.
entries.1358: διορύσσω DIORU/SSW diorýssō dee-or-oos'-so from G1223 and G3736; to penetrate burglariously:--break through (up).
entries.1359: Διόσκουροι *DIO/SKOUROI Dióskouroi dee-os'-koo-roy from the alternate of G2203 and a form of the base of G2877; sons of Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri:--Castor and Pollux.
entries.1360: διότι DIO/TI dióti dee-ot'-ee from G1223 and G3754; on the very account that, or inasmuch as:--because (that), for, therefore.
entries.1361: Διοτρεφής *DIOTREFH/S Diotrephḗs dee-ot-ref-ace' from the alternate of G2203 and G5142; Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity:--Diotrephes.
entries.1362: διπλοῦς DIPLOU=S diploûs dip-looce' from G1364 and (probably) the base of G4119; two-fold:--double, two-fold more.
entries.1363: διπλόω DIPLO/W diplóō dip-lo'-o from G1362; to render two-fold:--double.
entries.1364: δίς DI/S dís dece adverb from G1417; twice:--again, twice.
entries.1365: διστάζω DISTA/ZW distázō dis-tad'-zo from G1364; properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in opinion):--doubt.
entries.1366: δίστομος DI/STOMOS dístomos dis'-tom-os from G1364 and G4750; double-edged:--with two edges, two-edged.
entries.1367: δισχίλιοι DISXI/LIOI dischílioi dis-khil'-ee-oy from G1364 and G5507; two thousand:--two thousand.
entries.1368: διϋλίζω DIU+LI/ZW diÿlízō dee-oo-lid'-zo from G1223 and ὑλίζω U(LI/ZW hylízō hoo-lid'-zo (to filter); to strain out:--strain at (probably by misprint).
entries.1369: διχάζω DIXA/ZW dicházō dee-khad'-zo from a derivative of G1364; to make apart, i.e. sunder (figuratively, alienate):--set at variance.
entries.1370: διχοστασία DIXOSTASI/A dichostasía dee-khos-tas-ee'-ah from a derivative of G1364 and G4714; disunion, i.e. (figuratively) dissension:--division, sedition.
entries.1371: διχοτομέω DIXOTOME/W dichotoméō dee-khot-om-eh'-o from a compound of a derivative of G1364 and a derivative of τέμνω TE/MNW témnō (to cut); to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog severely:--cut asunder (in sunder).
entries.1372: διψάω DIYA/W dipsáō dip-sah'-o from a variation of G1373; to thirst for (literally or figuratively):--(be, be a-)thirst(-y).
entries.1373: δίψος DI/YOS dípsos dip'-sos of uncertain affinity; thirst:--thirst.
entries.1374: δίψυχος DI/YUXOS dípsychos dip'-soo-khos from G1364 and G5590; two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or purpose):--double minded.
entries.1375: διωγμός DIWGMO/S diōgmós dee-ogue-mos' from G1377; persecution:--persecution.
entries.1376: διώκτης DIW/KTHS diṓktēs dee-oke'-tace from G1377; a persecutor:--persecutor.
entries.1377: διώκω DIW/KW diṓkō dee-o'-ko a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb δίω DI/W díō (to flee; compare the base of G1169 and G1249); to pursue (literally or figuratively); by implication, to persecute:--ensue, follow (after), given to, (suffer) persecute(-ion), press forward.
entries.1378: δόγμα DO/GMA dógma dog'-mah from the base of G1380; a law (civil, ceremonial or ecclesiastical):--decree, ordinance.
entries.1379: δογματίζω DOGMATI/ZW dogmatízō dog-mat-id'-zo from G1378; to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to, ceremonially rule:--be subject to ordinances.
entries.1380: δοκέω DOKE/W dokéō dok-eh'-o a prolonged form of a primary verb, δόκω DO/KW dókō dok'-o (used only in an alternate in certain tenses; compare the base of G1166) of the same meaning; to think; by implication, to seem (truthfully or uncertainly):--be accounted, (of own) please(-ure), be of reputation, seem (good), suppose, think, trow.
entries.1381: δοκιμάζω DOKIMA/ZW dokimázō dok-im-ad'-zo from G1384; to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to approve:--allow, discern, examine, X like, (ap-)prove, try.
entries.1382: δοκιμή DOKIMH/ dokimḗ dok-ee-may' from the same as G1384; test (abstractly or concretely); by implication, trustiness:--experience(-riment), proof, trial.
entries.1383: δοκίμιον DOKI/MION dokímion dok-im'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G1382; a testing; by implication, trustworthiness:--trial, trying.
entries.1384: δόκιμος DO/KIMOS dókimos dok'-ee-mos from G1380; properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e. approved:--approved, tried.
entries.1385: δοκός DOKO/S dokós dok-os' from G1209 (through the idea of holding up); a stick of timber:--beam.
entries.1386: δόλιος DO/LIOS dólios dol'-ee-os from G1388; guileful:--deceitful.
entries.1387: δολιόω DOLIO/W dolióō dol-ee-o'-o from G1386; to be guileful:--use deceit.
entries.1388: δόλος DO/LOS dólos dol'-os from an obsolete primary verb, δέλλω DE/LLW déllō (probably meaning to decoy; compare G1185); a trick (bait), i.e. (figuratively) wile:--craft, deceit, guile, subtilty.
entries.1389: δολόω DOLO/W dolóō dol-o'-o from G1388; to ensnare, i.e. (figuratively) adulterate:--handle deceitfully.
entries.1390: δόμα DO/MA dóma dom'-ah from the base of G1325; a present:--gift.
entries.1391: δόξα DO/CA dóxa dox'-ah from the base of G1380; glory (as very apparent), in a wide application (literal or figurative, objective or subjective):--dignity, glory(-ious), honour, praise, worship.
entries.1392: δοξάζω DOCA/ZW doxázō dox-ad'-zo from G1391; to render (or esteem) glorious (in a wide application):--(make) glorify(-ious), full of (have) glory, honour, magnify.
entries.1393: Δορκάς *DORKA/S Dorkás dor-kas' gazelle; Dorcas, a Christian woman:--Dorcas.
entries.1394: δόσις DO/SIS dósis dos'-is from the base of G1325; a giving; by implication, (concretely) a gift:--gift, giving.
entries.1395: δότης DO/THS dótēs dot'-ace from the base of G1325; a giver:--giver.
entries.1396: δουλαγωγέω DOULAGWGE/W doulagōgéō doo-lag-ogue-eh'-o from a presumed compound of G1401 and G71; to be a slave-driver, i.e. to enslave (figuratively, subdue):--bring into subjection.
entries.1397: δουλεία DOULEI/A douleía doo-li'-ah from G1398; slavery (ceremonially or figuratively):--bondage.
entries.1398: δουλεύω DOULEU/W douleúō dool-yoo'-o from G1401; to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary):--be in bondage, (do) serve(-ice).
entries.1399: δούλη DOU/LH doúlē doo'-lay feminine of G1401; a female slave (involuntarily or voluntarily):--handmaid(-en).
entries.1400: δοῦλον DOU=LON doûlon doo'-lon neuter of G1401; subservient:--servant.
entries.1401: δοῦλος DOU=LOS doûlos doo'-los from G1210; a slave (literal or figurative, involuntary or voluntary; frequently, therefore in a qualified sense of subjection or subserviency):--bond(-man), servant.
entries.1402: δουλόω DOULO/W doulóō doo-lo'-o from G1401; to enslave (literally or figuratively):--bring into (be under) bondage, X given, become (make) servant.
entries.1403: δοχή DOXH/ dochḗ dokh-ay' from G1209; a reception, i.e. convivial entertainment:--feast.
entries.1404: δράκων DRA/KWN drákōn drak'-own probably from an alternate form of δέρκομαι DE/RKOMAI dérkomai (to look); a fabulous kind of serpent (perhaps as supposed to fascinate):--dragon.
entries.1405: δράσσομαι DRA/SSOMAI drássomai dras'-som-ahee perhaps akin to the base of G1404 (through the idea of capturing); to grasp, i.e. (figuratively) entrap:--take.
entries.1406: δραχμή DRAXMH/ drachmḗ drakh-may' from G1405; a drachma or (silver) coin (as handled):--piece (of silver).
entries.1407: δρέπανον DRE/PANON drépanon drep'-an-on from δρέπω DRE/PW drépō (to pluck); a gathering hook (especially for harvesting):--sickle.
entries.1408: δρόμος DRO/MOS drómos drom'-os from the alternate of G5143; a race, i.e. (figuratively) career:--course.
entries.1409: Δρούσιλλα *DROU/SILLA Droúsilla droo'-sil-lah a feminine diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name); Drusilla, a member of the Herodian family:--Drusilla.
entries.1410: δύναμαι DU/NAMAI dýnamai doo'-nam-ahee of uncertain affinity; to be able or possible:--be able, can (do, + -not), could, may, might, be possible, be of power.
entries.1411: δύναμις DU/NAMIS dýnamis doo'-nam-is from G1410; force (literally or figuratively); specially, miraculous power (usually by implication, a miracle itself):--ability, abundance, meaning, might(-ily, -y, -y deed), (worker of) miracle(-s), power, strength, violence, mighty (wonderful) work.
entries.1412: δυναμόω DUNAMO/W dynamóō doo-nam-o'-o from G1411; to enable:--strengthen.
entries.1413: δυνάστης DUNA/STHS dynástēs doo-nas'-tace from G1410; a ruler or officer:--of great authority, mighty, potentate.
entries.1414: δυνατέω DUNATE/W dynatéō doo-nat-eh'-o from G1415; to be efficient (figuratively):--be mighty.
entries.1415: δυνατός DUNATO/S dynatós doo-nat-os' from G1410; powerful or capable (literally or figuratively); neuter possible:--able, could, (that is) mighty (man), possible, power, strong.
entries.1416: δύνω DU/NW dýnō doo'-no or δῦμι DU=MI dŷmi doo'-mee prolonged forms of an obsolete primary δύο DU/O dýo doo'-o (to sink); to go "down":--set.
entries.1417: δύο DU/O dýo doo'-o a primary numeral; "two":--both, twain, two.
entries.1418: δυσ‐ DUS- dys- doos a primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation; used only in composition as a prefix; hard, i.e. with difficulty:--+ hard, + grievous, etc.
entries.1419: δυσβάστακτος DUSBA/STAKTOS dysbástaktos doos-bas'-tak-tos from G1418 and a derivative of G941; oppressive:--grievous to be borne.
entries.1420: δυσεντερία DUSENTERI/A dysentería doos-en-ter-ee'-ah from G1418 and a compound of G1787 (meaning a bowel); a "dysentery":--bloody flux.
entries.1421: δυσερμήνευτος DUSERMH/NEUTOS dysermḗneutos doos-er-mane'-yoo-tos from G1418 and a presumed derivative of G2059; difficult of explanation:--hard to be uttered.
entries.1422: δύσκολος DU/SKOLOS dýskolos doo'-kol-os from G1418 and κόλον KO/LON kólon (food); properly, fastidious about eating (peevish), i.e. (genitive case) impracticable:--hard.
entries.1423: δυσκόλως DUSKO/LWS dyskólōs doos-kol'-oce adverb from G1422; impracticably:--hardly.
entries.1424: δυσμή DUSMH/ dysmḗ doos-may' from G1416; the sun-set, i.e. (by implication) the western region:--west.
entries.1425: δυσνόητος DUSNO/HTOS dysnóētos doos-no'-ay-tos from G1418 and a derivative of G3539; difficult of perception:--hard to be understood.
entries.1426: δυσφημία DUSFHMI/A dysphēmía doos-fay-mee'-ah from a compound of G1418 and G5345; defamation:--evil report.
entries.1427: δώδεκα DW/DEKA dṓdeka do'-dek-ah from G1417 and G1176; two and ten, i.e. a dozen:--twelve.
entries.1428: δωδέκατος DWDE/KATOS dōdékatos do-dek'-at-os from G1427; twelfth:--twelfth.
entries.1429: δωδεκάφυλον DWDEKA/FULON dōdekáphylon do-dek-af'-oo-lon from G1427 and G5443; the commonwealth of Israel:--twelve tribes.
entries.1430: δῶμα DW=MA dōma do'-mah from δέμω DE/MW démō (to build); properly, an edifice, i.e. (specially) a roof:--housetop.
entries.1431: δωρεά DWREA/ dōreá do-reh-ah' from G1435; a gratuity:--gift.
entries.1432: δωρεάν DWREA/N dōreán do-reh-an' accusative case of G1431 as adverb; gratuitously (literally or figuratively):--without a cause, freely, for naught, in vain.
entries.1433: δωρέομαι DWRE/OMAI dōréomai do-reh'-om-ahee middle voice from G1435; to bestow gratuitously:--give.
entries.1434: δώρημα DW/RHMA dṓrēma do'-ray-mah from G1433; a bestowment:--gift.
entries.1435: δῶρον DW=RON dōron do'-ron a present; specially, a sacrifice:--gift, offering.
entries.1436: ἔα E)/A éa eh'-ah apparent imperative of G1439; properly, let it be, i.e. (as interjection) aha!:--let alone.
entries.1437: ἐάν E)A/N eán eh-an' from G1487 and G302; a conditional particle; in case that, provided, etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote indefiniteness or uncertainty:--before, but, except, (and) if, (if) so, (what-, whither-)soever, though, when (-soever), whether (or), to whom, (who-)so(-ever). See G3361.
entries.1438: ἑαυτοῦ E(AUTOU= heautoû heh-ow-too' from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of G846; him- (her-, it-, them-, also (in conjunction with the personal pronoun of the other persons) my-, thy-, our-, your-) self (selves), etc.:--alone, her (own, -self), (he) himself, his (own), itself, one (to) another, our (thine) own(-selves), + that she had, their (own, own selves), (of) them(-selves), they, thyself, you, your (own, own conceits, own selves, -selves).
entries.1439: ἐάω E)A/W eáō eh-ah'-o of uncertain affinity; to let be, i.e. permit or leave alone:--commit, leave, let (alone), suffer. See also G1436.
entries.1440: ἑβδομήκοντα E(BDOMH/KONTA hebdomḗkonta heb-dom-ay'-kon-tah from G1442 and a modified form of G1176; seventy:--seventy, three score and ten.
entries.1441: ἑβδομηκοντάκις E(BDOMHKONTA/KIS hebdomēkontákis heb-dom-ay-kon-tak-is multiple adverb from G1440; seventy times:--seventy times.
entries.1442: ἕβδομος E(/BDOMOS hébdomos heb'-dom-os ordinal from G2033; seventh:--seventh.
entries.1443: Ἐβέρ *)EBE/R Ebér eb-er' of Hebrew origin (H05677); Eber, a patriarch:--Eber.
entries.1444: Ἑβραϊκός *(EBRAI+KO/S Hebraïkós heb-rah-ee-kos' from G1443; Hebraic or the Jewish language:--Hebrew.
entries.1445: Ἑβραῖος *(EBRAI=OS Hebraîos heb-rah'-yos from G1443; a Hebræan (i.e. Hebrew) or Jew:--Hebrew.
entries.1446: Ἑβραΐς *(EBRAI/+S Hebraḯs heb-rah-is' from G1443; the Hebraistic (Hebrew) or Jewish (Chaldee) language:--Hebrew.
entries.1447: Ἑβραϊστί *(EBRAI+STI/ Hebraïstí heb-rah-is-tee' adverb from G1446; Hebraistically or in the Jewish (Chaldee) language:--in (the) Hebrew (tongue).
entries.1448: ἐγγίζω E)GGI/ZW engízō eng-id'-zo from G1451; to make near, i.e. (reflexively) approach:--approach, be at hand, come (draw) near, be (come, draw) nigh.
entries.1449: ἐγγράφω E)GGRA/FW engráphō eng-graf'-o from G1722 and G1125; to "engrave", i.e. inscribe:--write (in).
entries.1450: ἔγγυος E)/GGUOS éngyos eng'-goo-os from G1722 and γυῖον GUI=ON guîon (a limb); pledged (as if articulated by a member), i.e. a bondsman:--surety.
entries.1451: ἐγγύς E)GGU/S engýs eng-goos' from a primary verb ἄγχω A)/GXW ánchō (to squeeze or throttle; akin to the base of G43); near (literally or figuratively, of place or time):--from , at hand, near, nigh (at hand, unto), ready.
entries.1452: ἐγγύτερον E)GGU/TERON engýteron eng-goo'-ter-on neuter of the comparative of G1451; nearer:--nearer.
entries.1453: ἐγείρω E)GEI/RW egeírō eg-i'-ro probably akin to the base of G58 (through the idea of collecting one's faculties); to waken (transitively or intransitively), i.e. rouse (literally, from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively, from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, nonexistence):--awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-)rise (again, up), stand, take up.
entries.1454: ἔγερσις E)/GERSIS égersis eg'-er-sis from G1453; a resurgence (from death):--resurrection.
entries.1455: ἐγκάθετος E)GKA/QETOS enkáthetos eng-kath'-et-os from G1722 and a derivative of G2524; subinduced, i.e. surreptitiously suborned as a lier-in-wait:--spy.
entries.1456: ἐγκαίνια E)GKAI/NIA enkaínia eng-kah'-ee-nee-ah neuter plural of a presumed compound from G1722 and G2537; innovatives, i.e. (specially) renewal (of religious services after the Antiochian interruption):--dedication.
entries.1457: ἐγκαινίζω E)GKAINI/ZW enkainízō eng-kahee-nid'-zo from G1456; to renew, i.e. inaugurate:--consecrate, dedicate.
entries.1458: ἐγκαλέω E)GKALE/W enkaléō eng-kal-eh'-o from G1722 and G2564; to call in (as a debt or demand), i.e. bring to account (charge, criminate, etc.):--accuse, call in question, implead, lay to the charge.
entries.1459: ἐγκαταλείπω E)GKATALEI/PW enkataleípō eng-kat-al-i'-po from G1722 and G2641; to leave behind in some place, i.e. (in a good sense) let remain over, or (in a bad sense) to desert:--forsake, leave.
entries.1460: ἐγκατοικέω E)GKATOIKE/W enkatoikéō eng-kat-oy-keh'-o from G1722 and G2730; to settle down in a place, i.e. reside:--dwell among.
entries.1461: ἐγκεντρίζω E)GKENTRI/ZW enkentrízō eng-ken-trid'-zo from G1722 and a derivative of G2759; to prick in, i.e. ingraft:--graff in(-to).
entries.1462: ἔγκλημα E)/GKLHMA énklēma eng'-klay-mah from G1458; an accusation, i.e. offence alleged:--crime laid against, laid to charge.
entries.1463: ἐγκομβόομαι E)GKOMBO/OMAI enkombóomai eng-kom-bo'-om-ahee middle voice from G1722 and κομβόω KOMBO/W kombóō (to gird); to engirdle oneself (for labor), i.e. figuratively (the apron as being a badge of servitude) to wear (in token of mutual deference):--be clothed with.
entries.1464: ἐγκοπή E)GKOPH/ enkopḗ eng-kop-ay' from G1465; a hindrance:--X hinder.
entries.1465: ἐγκόπτω E)GKO/PTW enkóptō eng-kop'-to from G1722 and G2875; to cut into, i.e. (figuratively) impede, detain:--hinder, be tedious unto.
entries.1466: ἐγκράτεια E)GKRA/TEIA enkráteia eng-krat'-i-ah from G1468; self-control (especially continence):--temperance.
entries.1467: ἐγκρατεύομαι E)GKRATEU/OMAI enkrateúomai eng-krat-yoo'-om-ahee middle voice from G1468; to exercise self-restraint (in diet and chastity):--can(-not) contain, be temperate.
entries.1468: ἐγκρατής E)GKRATH/S enkratḗs eng-krat-ace' from G1722 and G2904; strong in a thing (masterful), i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) self-controlled (in appetite, etc.):--temperate.
entries.1469: ἐγκρίνω E)GKRI/NW enkrínō eng-kree'-no from G1722 and G2919; to judge in, i.e. count among:--make of the number.
entries.1470: ἐγκρύπτω E)GKRU/PTW enkrýptō eng-kroop'-to from G1722 and G2928; to conceal in, i.e. incorporate with:--hid in.
entries.1471: ἔγκυος E)/GKUOS énkyos eng'-koo-os from G1722 and the base of G2949; swelling inside, i.e. pregnant:--great with child.
entries.1472: ἐγχρίω E)GXRI/W enchríō eng-khree'-o from G1722 and G5548; to rub in (oil), i.e. besmear:--anoint.
entries.1473: ἐγώ E)GW/ egṓ eg-o' a primary pronoun of the first person I (only expressed when emphatic) :--I, me. For the other cases and the plural see G1691, G1698, G1700, G2248, G2249, G2254, G2257, etc.
entries.1474: ἐδαφίζω E)DAFI/ZW edaphízō ed-af-id'-zo from G1475; to raze:--lay even with the ground.
entries.1475: ἔδαφος E)/DAFOS édaphos ed'-af-os from the base of G1476; a basis (bottom), i.e. the soil:--ground.
entries.1476: ἑδραῖος E(DRAI=OS hedraîos hed-rah'-yos from a derivative of ἕζομαι E(/ZOMAI hézomai (to sit); sedentary, i.e. (by implication) immovable:--settled, stedfast.
entries.1477: ἑδραίωμα E(DRAI/WMA hedraíōma hed-rah'-yo-mah from a derivative of G1476; a support, i.e. (figuratively) basis:--ground.
entries.1478: Ἐζεκίας *)EZEKI/AS Ezekías ed-zek-ee'-as of Hebrew origin (H02396); Ezekias (i.e. Hezekeiah), an Israelite:--Ezekias.
entries.1479: ἐθελοθρησκεία E)QELOQRHSKEI/A ethelothrēskeía eth-el-oth-race-ki'-ah from G2309 and G2356; voluntary (arbitrary and unwarranted) piety, i.e. sanctimony:--will worship.
entries.1480: ἐθίζω E)QI/ZW ethízō eth-id'-zo from G1485; to accustom, i.e. (neuter passive participle) customary:--custom.
entries.1481: ἐθνάρχης E)QNA/RXHS ethnárchēs eth-nar'-khace from G1484 and G746; the governor (not king) of a district:--ethnarch.
entries.1482: ἐθνικός E)QNIKO/S ethnikós eth-nee-kos' from G1484; national ("ethnic"), i.e. (specially) a Gentile:--heathen (man).
entries.1483: ἐθνικῶς E)QNIKW=S ethnikōs eth-nee-koce' adverb from G1482; as a Gentile:--after the manner of Gentiles.
entries.1484: ἔθνος E)/QNOS éthnos eth'-nos probably from G1486; a race (as of the same habit), i.e. a tribe; specially, a foreign (non-Jewish) one (usually, by implication, pagan):--Gentile, heathen, nation, people.
entries.1485: ἔθος E)/QOS éthos eth'-os from G1486; a usage (prescribed by habit or law):--custom, manner, be wont.
entries.1486: ἔθω E)/QW éthō eth'-o a primary verb; to be used (by habit or conventionality); neuter perfect participle usage:--be custom (manner, wont).
entries.1487: εἰ EI) ei i a primary particle of conditionality; if, whether, that, etc.:--forasmuch as, if, that, (al-)though, whether. Often used in connection or composition with other particles, especially as in G1489, G1490, G1499, G1508, G1509, G1512, G1513, G1536, G1537. See also G1437.
entries.1488: εἶ EI)= eî i second person singular present of G1510; thou art:--art, be.
entries.1489: εἴγε EI)/GE eíge i'-gheh from G1487 and G1065; if indeed, seeing that, unless, (with negative) otherwise:--if (so be that, yet).
entries.1490: εἰ δὲ μή(γε) EI) DE\ MH/[1GE]1 ei dè mḗ(ge) i deh may'-(gheh) from G1487, G1161, and G3361 (sometimes with G1065 added); but if not:--(or) else, if (not, otherwise), otherwise.
entries.1491: εἶδος EI)=DOS eîdos i'-dos from G1492; a view, i.e. form (literally or figuratively):--appearance, fashion, shape, sight.
entries.1492: εἴδω EI)/DW eídō i'-do a primary verb; used only in certain past tenses, the others being borrowed from the equivalent G3700 and G3708; properly, to see (literally or figuratively); by implication, (in the perfect tense only) to know:--be aware, behold, X can (+ not tell), consider, (have) know(-ledge), look (on), perceive, see, be sure, tell, understand, wish, wot. Compare G3700.
entries.1493: εἰδωλεῖον EI)DWLEI=ON eidōleîon i-do-li'-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G1497; an image-fane:--idol's temple.
entries.1494: εἰδωλόθυτον EI)DWLO/QUTON eidōlóthyton i-do-loth'-oo-ton neuter of a compound of G1497 and a presumed derivative of G2380; an image-sacrifice, i.e. part of an idolatrous offering:--(meat, thing that is) offered (in sacrifice, sacrificed) to (unto) idols.
entries.1495: εἰδωλολατρεία EI)DWLOLATREI/A eidōlolatreía i-do-lol-at-ri'-ah from G1497 and G2999; image-worship (literally or figuratively):--idolatry.
entries.1496: εἰδωλολάτρης EI)DWLOLA/TRHS eidōlolátrēs i-do-lol-at'-race from G1497 and the base of G3000; an image- (servant or) worshipper (literally or figuratively):--idolater.
entries.1497: εἴδωλον EI)/DWLON eídōlon i'-do-lon from G1491; an image (i.e. for worship); by implication, a heathen god, or (plural) the worship of such:--idol.
entries.1498: εἴην EI)/HN eíēn i'-ane optative (i.e. English subjunctive) present of G1510 (including the other person); might (could, would, or should) be:--mean, + perish, should be, was, were.
entries.1499: εἰ καί EI) KAI/ ei kaí i kahee from G1487 and G2532; if also (or even):--if (that), though.
entries.1500: εἰκῆ EI)KH= eikē i-kay' probably from G1502 (through the idea of failure); idly, i.e. without reason (or effect):--without a cause, (in) vain(-ly).
entries.1501: εἴκοσι EI)/KOSI eíkosi i'-kos-ee of uncertain affinity; a score:--twenty.
entries.1502: εἴκω EI)/KW eíkō i'-ko apparently a primary verb; properly, to be weak, i.e. yield:--give place.
entries.1503: εἴκω EI)/KW eíkō i'-ko apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to G1502 through the idea of faintness as a copy); to resemble:--be like.
entries.1504: εἰκών EI)KW/N eikṓn i-kone' from G1503; a likeness, i.e. (literally) statue, profile, or (figuratively) representation, resemblance:--image.
entries.1505: εἰλικρίνεια EI)LIKRI/NEIA eilikríneia i-lik-ree'-ni-ah from G1506; clearness, i.e. (by implication) purity (figuratively):--sincerity.
entries.1506: εἰλικρινής EI)LIKRINH/S eilikrinḗs i-lik-ree-nace' from εἵλη EI(/LH heílē (the sun's ray) and G2919; judged by sunlight, i.e. tested as genuine (figuratively):--pure, sincere.
entries.1507: εἱλίσσω EI(LI/SSW heilíssō hi-lis'-so a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb εἵλω EI(/LW heílō (of the same meaning); to coil or wrap:--roll together. See also G1667.
entries.1508: εἰ μή EI) MH/ ei mḗ i may from G1487 and G3361; if not:--but, except (that), if not, more than, save (only) that, saving, till.
entries.1509: εἰ μή τι EI) MH/ TI ei mḗ ti i may tee from G1508 and the neuter of G5100; if not somewhat:--except.
entries.1510: εἰμί EI)MI/ eimí i-mee' the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb; I exist (used only when emphatic):--am, have been, X it is I, was. See also G1488, G1498, G1511, G1526, G2258, G2071, G2070, G2075, G2076, G2771, G2468, G5600.
entries.1511: εἶναι EI)=NAI eînai i'-nahee present infinitive from G1510; to exist:--am, was. come, is, X lust after, X please well, there is, to be, was.
entries.1512: εἴ περ EI)/ PER eí per i per from G1487 and G4007; if perhaps:--if so be (that), seeing, though.
entries.1513: εἴ πως EI)/ PWS eí pōs i poce from G1487 and G4458; if somehow:--if by any means.
entries.1514: εἰρηνεύω EI)RHNEU/W eirēneúō i-rane-yoo'-o from G1515; to be (act) peaceful:--be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably.
entries.1515: εἰρήνη EI)RH/NH eirḗnē i-ray'-nay probably from a primary verb εἴρω EI)/RW eírō (to join); peace (literally or figuratively); by implication, prosperity:--one, peace, quietness, rest, + set at one again.
entries.1516: εἰρηνικός EI)RHNIKO/S eirēnikós i-ray-nee-kos' from G1515; pacific; by implication, salutary:--peaceable.
entries.1517: εἰρηνοποιέω EI)RHNOPOIE/W eirēnopoiéō i-ray-nop-oy-eh'-o from G1518; to be a peace-maker, i.e. (figuratively) to harmonize:--make peace.
entries.1518: εἰρηνοποιός EI)RHNOPOIO/S eirēnopoiós i-ray-nop-oy-os' from G1515 and G4160; pacificatory, i.e. (subjectively) peaceable:--peacemaker.
entries.1519: εἰς EI)S eis ice a primary preposition; to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases:--(abundant-)ly, against, among, as, at, (back-)ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more exceeding, for (intent, purpose), fore, + forth, in (among, at, unto, -so much that, -to), to the intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-)on, + perish, + set at one again, (so) that, therefore(-unto), throughout, til, to (be, the end, -ward), (here-)until(-to), …ward, (where-)fore, with. Often used in composition with the same general import, but only with verbs (etc.) expressing motion (literally or figuratively).
entries.1520: εἷς EI(=S heîs hice (including the neuter (etc.) ἕν E(/N hén); a primary numeral; one:--a(-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some. See also G1527, G3367, G3391, G3762.
entries.1521: εἰσάγω EI)SA/GW eiságō ice-ag'-o from G1519 and G71; to introduce (literally or figuratively):--bring in(-to), (+ was to) lead into.
entries.1522: εἰσακούω EI)SAKOU/W eisakoúō ice-ak-oo'-o from G1519 and G191; to listen to:--hear.
entries.1523: εἰσδέχομαι EI)SDE/XOMAI eisdéchomai ice-dekh'-om-ahee from G1519 and G1209; to take into one's favor:--receive.
entries.1524: εἴσειμι EI)/SEIMI eíseimi ice'-i-mee from G1519 and εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi (to go); to enter:--enter (go) into.
entries.1525: εἰσέρχομαι EI)SE/RXOMAI eisérchomai ice-er'-khom-ahee from G1519 and G2064; to enter (literally or figuratively):--X arise, come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through).
entries.1526: εἰσί EI)SI/ eisí i-see' 3rd person plural present indicative of G1510; they are:--agree, are, be, dure, X is, were.
entries.1527: εἷς καθ’ εἷς EI(=S KAQ' EI(=S heîs kath’ heîs hice kath hice from G1520 repeated with G2596 inserted; severally:--one by one.
entries.1528: εἰσκαλέω EI)SKALE/W eiskaléō ice-kal-eh'-o from G1519 and G2564; to invite in:--call in.
entries.1529: εἴσοδος EI)/SODOS eísodos ice'-od-os from G1519 and G3598; an entrance (literally or figuratively):--coming, enter(-ing) in (to).
entries.1530: εἰσπηδάω EI)SPHDA/W eispēdáō ice-pay-dah'-o from G1519 and πηδάω PHDA/W pēdáō (to leap); to rush in:--run (spring) in.
entries.1531: εἰσπορεύομαι EI)SPOREU/OMAI eisporeúomai ice-por-yoo'-om-ahee from G1519 and G4198; to enter (literally or figuratively):--come (enter) in, go into.
entries.1532: εἰστρέχω EI)STRE/XW eistréchō ice-trekh'-o from G1519 and G5143; to hasten inward:--run in.
entries.1533: εἰσφέρω EI)SFE/RW eisphérō ice-fer'-o from G1519 and G5342; to carry inward (literally or figuratively):--bring (in), lead into.
entries.1534: εἶτα EI)=TA eîta i'-tah of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical enumeration), then, moreover:--after that(-ward), furthermore, then. See also G1899.
entries.1535: εἴτε EI)/TE eíte i'-teh from G1487 and G5037; if too:--if, or, whether.
entries.1536: εἴ τις EI)/ TIS eí tis i tis from G1487 and G5100; if any:--he that, if a(-ny) man('s thing, from any, ought), whether any, whosoever.
entries.1537: ἐκ E)K ek ek or ἐξ E)C ex ex a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause; literal or figurative; direct or remote):--after, among, X are, at, betwixt(-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above), for(- th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, X heavenly, X hereby, + very highly, in, …ly, (because, by reason) of, off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, X thenceforth, through, X unto, X vehemently, with(-out). Often used in composition, with the same general import; often of completion.
entries.1538: ἕκαστος E(/KASTOS hékastos hek'-as-tos as if a superlative of ἕκας E(/KAS hékas (afar); each or every:--any, both, each (one), every (man, one, woman), particularly.
entries.1539: ἑκάστοτε E(KA/STOTE hekástote hek-as'-tot-eh as if from G1538 and G5119; at every time:--always.
entries.1540: ἑκατόν E(KATO/N hekatón hek-at-on' of uncertain affinity; a hundred:--hundred.
entries.1541: ἑκατονταέτης E(KATONTAE/THS hekatontaétēs hek-at-on-tah-et'-ace from G1540 and G2094; centenarian:--hundred years old.
entries.1542: ἑκατονταπλασίων E(KATONTAPLASI/WN hekatontaplasíōn hek-at-on-ta-plah-sec'-own from G1540 and a presumed derivative of G4111; a hundred times:--hundredfold.
entries.1543: ἑκατοντάρχης E(KATONTA/RXHS hekatontárchēs hek-at-on-tar'-khace or ἑκατόνταρχος E(KATO/NTARXOS hekatóntarchos hek-at-on'-tar-khos from G1540 and G757; the captain of one hundred men:--centurion.
entries.1544: ἐκβάλλω E)KBA/LLW ekbállō ek-bal'-lo from G1537 and G906; to eject (literally or figuratively):--bring forth, cast (forth, out), drive (out), expel, leave, pluck (pull, take, thrust) out, put forth (out), send away (forth, out).
entries.1545: ἔκβασις E)/KBASIS ékbasis ek'-bas-is from a compound of G1537 and the base of G939 (meaning to go out); an exit (literally or figuratively):--end, way to escape.
entries.1546: ἐκβολή E)KBOLH/ ekbolḗ ek-bol-ay' from G1544; ejection, i.e. (specially) a throwing overboard of the cargo:--+ lighten the ship.
entries.1547: ἐκγαμίζω E)KGAMI/ZW ekgamízō ek-gam-id'-zo from G1537 and a form of G1061 (compare G1548); to marry off a daughter:--give in marriage.
entries.1548: ἐκγαμίσκω E)KGAMI/SKW ekgamískō ek-gam-is'-ko from G1537 and G1061; the same as 1547:--give in marriage.
entries.1549: ἔκγονον E)/KGONON ékgonon ek'-gon-on neuter of a derivative of a compound of G1537 and G1096; a descendant, i.e. (specially) grandchild:--nephew.
entries.1550: ἐκδαπανάω E)KDAPANA/W ekdapanáō ek-dap-an-ah'-o from G1537 and G1159; to expend (wholly), i.e. (figuratively) exhaust:--spend.
entries.1551: ἐκδέχομαι E)KDE/XOMAI ekdéchomai ek-dekh'-om-ahee from G1537 and G1209; to accept from some source, i.e. (by implication) to await:--expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).
entries.1552: ἔκδηλος E)/KDHLOS ékdēlos ek'-day-los from G1537 and G1212; wholly evident:--manifest.
entries.1553: ἐκδημέω E)KDHME/W ekdēméō ek-day-meh'-o from a compound of G1537 and G1218; to emigrate, i.e. (figuratively) vacate or quit:--be absent.
entries.1554: ἐκδίδωμι E)KDI/DWMI ekdídōmi ek-did-o'-mee from G1537 and G1325; to give forth, i.e. (specially) to lease:--let forth (out).
entries.1555: ἐκδιηγέομαι E)KDIHGE/OMAI ekdiēgéomai ek-dee-ayg-eh'-om-ahee from G1537 and a compound of G1223 and G2233; to narrate through wholly:--declare.
entries.1556: ἐκδικέω E)KDIKE/W ekdikéō ek-dik-eh'-o from G1558; to vindicate, retaliate, punish:--a (re-)venge.
entries.1557: ἐκδίκησις E)KDI/KHSIS ekdíkēsis ek-dik'-ay-sis from G1556; vindication, retribution:--(a-, re-)venge(-ance), punishment.
entries.1558: ἔκδικος E)/KDIKOS ékdikos ek'-dik-os from G1537 and G1349; carrying justice out, i.e. a punisher:--a (re-)venger.
entries.1559: ἐκδιώκω E)KDIW/KW ekdiṓkō ek-dee-o'-ko from G1537 and G1377; to pursue out, i.e. expel or persecute implacably:--persecute.
entries.1560: ἔκδοτος E)/KDOTOS ékdotos ek'-dot-os from G1537 and a derivative of G1325; given out or over, i.e. surrendered:--delivered.
entries.1561: ἐκδοχή E)KDOXH/ ekdochḗ ek-dokh-ay' from G1551; expectation:--looking for.
entries.1562: ἐκδύω E)KDU/W ekdýō ek-doo'-o from G1537 and the base of G1416; to cause to sink out of, i.e. (specially as of clothing) to divest:--strip, take off from, unclothe.
entries.1563: ἐκεῖ E)KEI= ekeî ek-i' of uncertain affinity; there; by extension, thither:--there, thither(-ward), (to) yonder (place).
entries.1564: ἐκεῖθεν E)KEI=QEN ekeîthen ek-i'-then from G1563; thence:--from that place, (from) thence, there.
entries.1565: ἐκεῖνος E)KEI=NOS ekeînos ek-i'-nos from G1563; that one (or (neuter) thing); often intensified by the article prefixed:--he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same, very), X their, X them, they, this, those. See also G3778.
entries.1566: ἐκεῖσε E)KEI=SE ekeîse ek-i'-seh from G1563; thither:--there.
entries.1567: ἐκζητέω E)KZHTE/W ekzētéō ek-zay-teh'-o from G1537 and G2212; to search out, i.e. (figuratively)investigate, crave, demand, (by Hebraism) worship:--en- (re-)quire, seek after (carefully, diligently).
entries.1568: ἐκθαμβέω E)KQAMBE/W ekthambéō ek-tham-beh'-o from G1569; to astonish utterly:--affright, greatly (sore) amaze.
entries.1569: ἔκθαμβος E)/KQAMBOS ékthambos ek'-tham-bos from G1537 and G2285; utterly astounded:--greatly wondering.
entries.1570: ἔκθετος E)/KQETOS ékthetos ek'-thet-os from G1537 and a derivative of G5087; put out, i.e. exposed to perish:--cast out.
entries.1571: ἐκκαθαίρω E)KKAQAI/RW ekkathaírō ek-kath-ah'-ee-ro from G1537 and G2508; to cleanse thoroughly:--purge (out).
entries.1572: ἐκκαίω E)KKAI/W ekkaíō ek-kah'-yo from G1537 and G2545; to inflame deeply:--burn.
entries.1573: ἐκκακέω E)KKAKE/W ekkakéō ek-kak-eh'-o from G1537 and G2556; to be (bad or) weak, i.e. (by implication) to fail (in heart):--faint, be weary.
entries.1574: ἐκκεντέω E)KKENTE/W ekkentéō ek-ken-teh'-o from G1537 and the base of G2759; to transfix:--pierce.
entries.1575: ἐκκλάω E)KKLA/W ekkláō ek-klah'-o from G1537 and G2806; to exscind:--break off.
entries.1576: ἐκκλείω E)KKLEI/W ekkleíō ek-kli'-o from G1537 and G2808; to shut out (literally or figuratively):--exclude.
entries.1577: ἐκκλησία E)KKLHSI/A ekklēsía ek-klay-see'-ah from a compound of G1537 and a derivative of G2564; a calling out, i.e. (concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation (Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or saints in heaven or both):--assembly, church.
entries.1578: ἐκκλίνω E)KKLI/NW ekklínō ek-klee'-no from G1537 and G2827; to deviate, i.e. (absolutely) to shun (literally or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety):--avoid, eschew, go out of the way.
entries.1579: ἐκκολυμβάω E)KKOLUMBA/W ekkolymbáō ek-kol-oom-bah'-o from G1537 and G2860; to escape by swimming:--swim out.
entries.1580: ἐκκομίζω E)KKOMI/ZW ekkomízō ek-kom-id'-zo from G1537 and G2865; to bear forth (to burial):--carry out.
entries.1581: ἐκκόπτω E)KKO/PTW ekkóptō ek-kop'-to from G1537 and G2875; to exscind; figuratively, to frustrate:--cut down (off, out), hew down, hinder.
entries.1582: ἐκκρέμαμαι E)KKRE/MAMAI ekkrémamai ek-krem'-am-ahee middle voice from G1537 and G2910; to hang upon the lips of a speaker, i.e. listen closely:--be very attentive.
entries.1583: ἐκλαλέω E)KLALE/W eklaléō ek-lal-eh'-o from G1537 and G2980; to divulge:--tell.
entries.1584: ἐκλάμπω E)KLA/MPW eklámpō ek-lam'-po from G1537 and G2989; to be resplendent:--shine forth.
entries.1585: ἐκλανθάνομαι E)KLANQA/NOMAI eklanthánomai ek-lan-than'-om-ahee middle voice from G1537 and G2990; to be utterly oblivious of:--forget.
entries.1586: ἐκλέγομαι E)KLE/GOMAI eklégomai ek-leg'-om-ahee middle voice from G1537 and G3004 (in its primary sense); to select:--make choice, choose (out), chosen.
