entries.1587: ἐκλείπω E)KLEI/PW ekleípō ek-li'-po from G1537 and G3007; to omit, i.e. (by implication) cease (die):--fail.
entries.1588: ἐκλεκτός E)KLEKTO/S eklektós ek-lek-tos' from G1586; select; by implication, favorite:--chosen, elect.
entries.1589: ἐκλογή E)KLOGH/ eklogḗ ek-log-ay' from G1586; (divine) selection (abstractly or concretely):--chosen, election.
entries.1590: ἐκλύω E)KLU/W eklýō ek-loo'-o from G1537 and G3089; to relax (literally or figuratively):--faint.
entries.1591: ἐκμάσσω E)KMA/SSW ekmássō ek-mas'-so from G1537 and the base of G3145; to knead out, i.e. (by analogy) to wipe dry:--wipe.
entries.1592: ἐκμυκτηρίζω E)KMUKTHRI/ZW ekmyktērízō ek-mook-ter-id'-zo from G1537 and G3456; to sneer outright at:--deride.
entries.1593: ἐκνεύω E)KNEU/W ekneúō ek-nyoo'-o from G1537 and G3506; (by analogy) to slip off, i.e. quietly withdraw:--convey self away.
entries.1594: ἐκνήφω E)KNH/FW eknḗphō ek-nay'-fo from G1537 and G3525; (figuratively) to rouse (oneself) out of stupor:--awake.
entries.1595: ἑκούσιον E(KOU/SION hekoúsion hek-oo'-see-on neuter of a derivative from G1635; voluntariness:--willingly.
entries.1596: ἑκουσίως E(KOUSI/WS hekousíōs hek-oo-see'-ose adverb from the same as G1595; voluntarily:--wilfully, willingly.
entries.1597: ἔκπαλαι E)/KPALAI ékpalai eh'-pal-ahee from G1537 and G3819; long ago, for a long while:--of a long time, of old.
entries.1598: ἐκπειράζω E)KPEIRA/ZW ekpeirázō ek-pi-rad'-zo from G1537 and G3985; to test thoroughly:--tempt.
entries.1599: ἐκπέμπω E)KPE/MPW ekpémpō ek-pem'-po from G1537 and G3992; to despatch:--send away (forth).
entries.1600: ἐκπετάννυμι E)KPETA/NNUMI ekpetánnymi ek-pet-an'-noo-mee from G1537 and a form of G4072; to fly out, i.e. (by analogy) to extend:--stretch forth.
entries.1601: ἐκπίπτω E)KPI/PTW ekpíptō ek-pip'-to from G1537 and G4098; to drop away; specially, be driven out of one's course; figuratively, to lose, become inefficient:--be cast, fail, fall (away, off), take none effect.
entries.1602: ἐκπλέω E)KPLE/W ekpléō ek-pleh'-o from G1537 and G4126; to depart by ship:--sail (away, thence).
entries.1603: ἐκπληρόω E)KPLHRO/W ekplēróō ek-play-ro'-o from G1537 and G4137; to accomplish entirely:--fulfill.
entries.1604: ἐκπλήρωσις E)KPLH/RWSIS ekplḗrōsis ek-play'-ro-sis from G1603; completion:--accomplishment.
entries.1605: ἐκπλήσσω E)KPLH/SSW ekplḗssō ek-place'-so from G1537 and G4141; to strike with astonishment:--amaze, astonish.
entries.1606: ἐκπνέω E)KPNE/W ekpnéō ek-pneh'-o from G1537 and G4154; to expire:--give up the ghost.
entries.1607: ἐκπορεύομαι E)KPOREU/OMAI ekporeúomai ek-por-yoo'-om-ahee from G1537 and G4198; to depart, be discharged, proceed, project:--come (forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of).
entries.1608: ἐκπορνεύω E)KPORNEU/W ekporneúō ek-porn-yoo'-o from G1537 and G4203; to be utterly unchaste:--give self over to fornication.
entries.1609: ἐκπτύω E)KPTU/W ekptýō ek-ptoo'-o from G1537 and G4429; to spit out, i.e. (figuratively) spurn:--reject.
entries.1610: ἐκριζόω E)KRIZO/W ekrizóō ek-rid-zo'-o from G1537 and G4492; to uproot:--pluck up by the root, root up.
entries.1611: ἔκστασις E)/KSTASIS ékstasis ek'-stas-is from G1839; a displacement of the mind, i.e. bewilderment, "ecstasy":--+ be amazed, amazement, astonishment, trance.
entries.1612: ἐκστρέφω E)KSTRE/FW ekstréphō ek-stref'-o from G1537 and G4762; to pervert (figuratively):--subvert.
entries.1613: ἐκταράσσω E)KTARA/SSW ektarássō ek-tar-as'-so from G1537 and G5015; to disturb wholly:--exceedingly trouble.
entries.1614: ἐκτείνω E)KTEI/NW ekteínō ek-ti'-no from G1537 and teino (to stretch); to extend:--cast, put forth, stretch forth (out).
entries.1615: ἐκτελέω E)KTELE/W ekteléō ek-tel-eh'-o from G1537 and G5055; to complete fully:--finish.
entries.1616: ἐκτένεια E)KTE/NEIA ekténeia ek-ten'-i-ah from G1618; intentness:--X instantly.
entries.1617: ἐκτενέστερον E)KTENE/STERON ektenésteron ek-ten-es'-ter-on neuter of the comparative of G1618; more intently:--more earnestly.
entries.1618: ἐκτενής E)KTENH/S ektenḗs ek-ten-ace' from G1614; intent:--without ceasing, fervent.
entries.1619: ἐκτενῶς E)KTENW=S ektenōs ek-ten-oce' adverb from G1618; intently:--fervently.
entries.1620: ἐκτίθημι E)KTI/QHMI ektíthēmi ek-tith'-ay-mee from G1537 and G5087; to expose; figuratively, to declare:--cast out, expound.
entries.1621: ἐκτινάσσω E)KTINA/SSW ektinássō ek-tin-as'-so from G1537 and tinasso (to swing); to shake violently:--shake (off).
entries.1622: ἐκτός E)KTO/S ektós ek-tos' from G1537; the exterior; figuratively (as a preposition) aside from, besides:--but, except(-ed), other than, out of, outside, unless, without.
entries.1623: ἕκτος E(/KTOS héktos hek'-tos ordinal from G1803; sixth:--sixth.
entries.1624: ἐκτρέπω E)KTRE/PW ektrépō ek-trep'-o from G1537 and the base of G5157; to deflect, i.e. turn away (literally or figuratively):--avoid, turn (aside, out of the way).
entries.1625: ἐκτρέφω E)KTRE/FW ektréphō ek-tref'-o from G1537 and G5142; to rear up to maturity, i.e. (genitive case) to cherish or train:--bring up, nourish.
entries.1626: ἔκτρωμα E)/KTRWMA éktrōma ek'-tro-mah from a compound of G1537 and τιτρώσκω TITRW/SKW titrṓskō (to wound); a miscarriage (abortion), i.e. (by analogy) untimely birth:--born out of due time.
entries.1627: ἐκφέρω E)KFE/RW ekphérō ek-fer'-o from G1537 and G5342; to bear out (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring forth, carry forth (out).
entries.1628: ἐκφεύγω E)KFEU/GW ekpheúgō ek-fyoo'-go from G1537 and G5343; to flee out:--escape, flee.
entries.1629: ἐκφοβέω E)KFOBE/W ekphobéō ek-fob-eh'-o from G1537 and G5399; to frighten utterly:--terrify.
entries.1630: ἔκφοβος E)/KFOBOS ékphobos ek'-fob-os from G1537 and G5401; frightened out of one's wits:-- sore afraid, exceedingly fear.
entries.1631: ἐκφύω E)KFU/W ekphýō ek-foo'-o from G1537 and G5453; to sprout up:--put forth.
entries.1632: ἐκχέω E)KXE/W ekchéō ek-kheh'-o , or (by variation) ἐκχύνω E)KXU/NW ekchýnō ek-khoo'-no from G1537 and χέω XE/W chéō (to pour); to pour forth; figuratively, to bestow:--gush (pour) out, run greedily (out), shed (abroad, forth), spill.
entries.1633: ἐκχωρέω E)KXWRE/W ekchōréō ek-kho-reh'-o from G1537 and G5562; to depart:--depart out.
entries.1634: ἐκψύχω E)KYU/XW ekpsýchō ek-psoo'-kho from G1537 and G5594; to expire:--give (yield) up the ghost.
entries.1635: ἑκών E(KW/N hekṓn hek-own' of uncertain affinity; voluntary:--willingly.
entries.1636: ἐλαία E)LAI/A elaía el-ah'-yah feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary; an olive (the tree or the fruit):--olive (berry, tree).
entries.1637: ἔλαιον E)/LAION élaion el'-ah-yon neuter of the same as G1636; olive oil:--oil.
entries.1638: ἐλαιών E)LAIW/N elaiṓn el-ah-yone' from G1636; an olive-orchard, i.e. (specially) the Mount of Olives:--Olivet.
entries.1639: Ἐλαμίτης *)ELAMI/THS Elamítēs el-am-ee'-tace of Hebrew origin (H05867); an Elamite or Persian:--Elamite.
entries.1640: ἐλάσσων E)LA/SSWN elássōn el-as'-sone or ἐλάττων E)LA/TTWN eláttōn el-at-tone' comparative of the same as G1646; smaller (in size, quantity, age or quality):--less, under, worse, younger.
entries.1641: ἐλαττονέω E)LATTONE/W elattonéō el-at-ton-eh-o from G1640; to diminish, i.e. fall short:--have lack.
entries.1642: ἐλαττόω E)LATTO/W elattóō el-at-to'-o from G1640; to lessen (in rank or influence):--decrease, make lower.
entries.1643: ἐλαύνω E)LAU/NW elaúnō el-ow'-no a prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an alternative of this) of uncertain affinity; to push (as wind, oars or dæmonical power):--carry, drive, row.
entries.1644: ἐλαφρία E)LAFRI/A elaphría el-af-ree'-ah from G1645; levity (figuratively), i.e. fickleness:--lightness.
entries.1645: ἐλαφρός E)LAFRO/S elaphrós el-af-ros' probably akin to G1643 and the base of G1640; light, i.e. easy:--light.
entries.1646: ἐλάχιστος E)LA/XISTOS eláchistos el-akh'-is-tos superlative of ἔλαχυς E)/LAXUS élachys (short); used as equivalent to G3398; least (in size, amount, dignity, etc.):--least, very little (small), smallest.
entries.1647: ἐλαχιστότερος E)LAXISTO/TEROS elachistóteros el-akh-is-tot'-er-os comparative of G1646; far less:--less than the least.
entries.1648: Ἐλεάζαρ *)ELEA/ZAR Eleázar el-eh-ad'-zar of Hebrew origin (H0499); Eleazar, an Israelite:--Eleazar.
entries.1649: ἔλεγξις E)/LEGCIS élenxis el'-eng-xis from G1651; refutation, i.e. reproof:--rebuke.
entries.1650: ἔλεγχος E)/LEGXOS élenchos el'-eng-khos from G1651; proof, conviction:--evidence, reproof.
entries.1651: ἐλέγχω E)LE/GXW elénchō el-eng'-kho of uncertain affinity; to confute, admonish:--convict, convince, tell a fault, rebuke, reprove.
entries.1652: ἐλεεινός E)LEEINO/S eleeinós el-eh-i-nos' from G1656; pitiable:--miserable.
entries.1653: ἐλεέω E)LEE/W eleéō el-eh-eh'-o from G1656; to compassionate (by word or deed, specially, by divine grace):--have compassion (pity on), have (obtain, receive, shew) mercy (on).
entries.1654: ἐλεημοσύνη E)LEHMOSU/NH eleēmosýnē el-eh-ay-mos-oo'-nay from G1656; compassionateness, i.e. (as exercised towards the poor) beneficence, or (concretely) a benefaction:--alms(-deeds).
entries.1655: ἐλεήμων E)LEH/MWN eleḗmōn el-eh-ay'-mone from G1653; compassionate (actively):--merciful.
entries.1656: ἔλεος E)/LEOS éleos el'-eh-os of uncertain affinity; compassion (human or divine, especially active):--(+ tender) mercy.
entries.1657: ἐλευθερία E)LEUQERI/A eleuthería el-yoo-ther-ee'-ah from G1658; freedom (legitimate or licentious, chiefly moral or ceremonial):--liberty.
entries.1658: ἐλεύθερος E)LEU/QEROS eleútheros el-yoo'-ther-os probably from the alternate of G2064; unrestrained (to go at pleasure), i.e. (as a citizen) not a slave (whether freeborn or manumitted), or (genitive case) exempt (from obligation or liability):--free (man, woman), at liberty.
entries.1659: ἐλευθερόω E)LEUQERO/W eleutheróō el-yoo-ther-o'-o from G1658; to liberate, i.e. (figuratively) to exempt (from moral, ceremonial or mortal liability):--deliver, make free.
entries.1660: ἔλευσις E)/LEUSIS éleusis el'-yoo-sis from the alternate of G2064; an advent:--coming.
entries.1661: ἐλεφάντινος E)LEFA/NTINOS elephántinos el-ef-an'-tee-nos from ἔλεφας E)/LEFAS élephas (an "elephant"); elephantine, i.e. (by implication) composed of ivory:--of ivory.
entries.1662: Ἐλιακείμ *)ELIAKEI/M Eliakeím el-ee-ak-ime' of Hebrew origin (H0471); Eliakim, an Israelite:--Eliakim.
entries.1663: Ἐλιέζερ *)ELIE/ZER Eliézer el-ee-ed'-zer of Hebrew origin (H0461); Eliezer, an Israelite:--Eliezer.
entries.1664: Ἐλιούδ *)ELIOU/D Elioúd el-ee-ood' of Hebrew origin (H0410 and H01935); God of majesty; Eliud, an Israelite:--Eliud.
entries.1665: Ἐλισάβετ *)ELISA/BET Elisábet el-ee-sab'-et of Hebrew origin (H0472); Elisabet, an Israelitess:--Elisabeth.
entries.1666: Ἐλισσαῖος *)ELISSAI=OS Elissaîos el-is-sah'-yos of Hebrew origin (H0477); Elissæus, an Israelite:--Elissæus.
entries.1667: ἑλίσσω E(LI/SSW helíssō hel-is'-so a form of G1507; to coil or wrap:--fold up.
entries.1668: ἕλκος E(/LKOS hélkos hel'-kos probably from G1670; an ulcer (as if drawn together):--sore.
entries.1669: ἑλκόω E(LKO/W helkóō hel-ko'-o from G1668; to cause to ulcerate, i.e. (passively) be ulcerous:--full of sores.
entries.1670: ἑλκύω E(LKU/W helkýō hel-koo'-o or ἕλκω E(/LKW hélkō hel'-ko ; probably akin to G138; to drag (literally or figuratively):--draw. Compare G1667.
entries.1671: Ἑλλάς *(ELLA/S Hellás hel-las' of uncertain affinity; Hellas (or Greece), a country of Europe:--Greece.
entries.1672: Ἕλλην *(/ELLHN Héllēn hel'-lane from G1671; a Hellen (Grecian) or inhabitant of Hellas; by extension a Greek-speaking person, especially a non-Jew:-- Gentile, Greek.
entries.1673: Ἑλληνικός *(ELLHNIKO/S Hellēnikós hel-lay-nee-kos' from G1672; Hellenic, i.e. Grecian (in language):--Greek.
entries.1674: Ἑλληνίς *(ELLHNI/S Hellēnís hel-lay-nis' feminine of G1672; a Grecian (i.e. non-Jewish) woman:--Greek.
entries.1675: Ἑλληνιστής *(ELLHNISTH/S Hellēnistḗs hel-lay-nis-tace' from a derivative of G1672; a Hellenist or Greek-speaking Jew:--Grecian.
entries.1676: Ἑλληνιστί *(ELLHNISTI/ Hellēnistí hel-lay-nis-tee' adverb from the same as G1675; Hellenistically, i.e. in the Grecian language:--Greek.
entries.1677: ἐλλογέω E)LLOGE/W ellogéō el-log-eh'-o from G1722 and G3056 (in the sense of account); to reckon in, i.e. attribute:--impute, put on account.
entries.1678: Ἐλμωδάμ *)ELMWDA/M Elmōdám el-mo-dam' of Hebrew origin (perhaps for H0486); Elmodam, an Israelite:--Elmodam.
entries.1679: ἐλπίζω E)LPI/ZW elpízō el-pid'-zo from G1680; to expect or confide:--(have, thing) hope(-d) (for), trust.
entries.1680: ἐλπίς E)LPI/S elpís el-pece' from a primary ἔλπω E)/LPW élpō (to anticipate, usually with pleasure); expectation (abstractly or concretely) or confidence:--faith, hope.
entries.1681: Ἐλύμας *)ELU/MAS Elýmas el-oo'-mas of foreign origin; Elymas, a wizard:--Elymas.
entries.1682: ἐλοΐ E)LOI/+ eloḯ el-o-ee' of Chaldean origin (H0426 with pronominal suffix) my God :--Eloi.
entries.1683: ἐμαυτοῦ E)MAUTOU= emautoû em-ow-too' genitive case compound of G1700 and G846; of myself so likewise the dative case ἐμαυτῷ E)MAUTW=| emautōi em-ow-to' , and accusative case ἐμαυτόν E)MAUTO/N emautón em-ow-ton' :--me, mine own (self), myself.
entries.1684: ἐμβαίνω E)MBAI/NW embaínō em-ba'-hee-no from G1722 and the base of G939; to walk on, i.e. embark (aboard a vessel), reach (a pool):--come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into, step in, take ship.
entries.1685: ἐμβάλλω E)MBA/LLW embállō em-bal'-lo from G1722 and G906; to throw on, i.e. (figuratively) subject to (eternal punishment):--cast into.
entries.1686: ἐμβάπτω E)MBA/PTW embáptō em-bap'-to from G1722 and G911; to whelm on, i.e. wet (a part of the person, etc.) by contact with a fluid:--dip.
entries.1687: ἐμβατεύω E)MBATEU/W embateúō em-bat-yoo'-o from G1722 and a presumed derivative of the base of G939; equivalent to G1684; to intrude on (figuratively):--intrude into.
entries.1688: ἐμβιβάζω E)MBIBA/ZW embibázō em-bib-ad'-zo from G1722 and βιβάζω BIBA/ZW bibázō (to mount; causative of G1684); to place on, i.e. transfer (aboard a vessel):--put in.
entries.1689: ἐμβλέπω E)MBLE/PW emblépō em-blep'-o from G1722 and G991; to look on, i.e. (relatively) to observe fixedly, or (absolutely) to discern clearly:--behold, gaze up, look upon, (could) see.
entries.1690: ἐμβριμάομαι E)MBRIMA/OMAI embrimáomai em-brim-ah'-om-ahee from G1722 and βριμάομαι BRIMA/OMAI brimáomai (to snort with anger); to have indignation on, i.e. (transitively) to blame, (intransitively) to sigh with chagrin, (specially) to sternly enjoin:--straitly charge, groan, murmur against.
entries.1691: ἐμέ E)ME/ emé em-eh' a prolonged form of G3165; me:--I, me, my(-self).
entries.1692: ἐμέω E)ME/W eméō em-eh'-o of uncertain affinity; to vomit:--(will) spue.
entries.1693: ἐμμαίνομαι E)MMAI/NOMAI emmaínomai em-mah'-ee-nom-ahee from G1722 and G3105; to rave on, i.e. rage at:--be mad against.
entries.1694: Ἐμμανουήλ *)EMMANOUH/L Emmanouḗl em-man-oo-ale' of Hebrew origin (H06005); God with us; Emmanuel, a name of Christ:--Emmanuel.
entries.1695: Ἐμμαούς *)EMMAOU/S Emmaoús em-mah-ooce' probably of Hebrew origin (compare H03222); Emmaus, a place in Palestine:--Emmaus.
entries.1696: ἐμμένω E)MME/NW emménō em-men'-o from G1722 and G3306; to stay in the same place, i.e. (figuratively) persevere:--continue.
entries.1697: Ἐμμόρ *)EMMO/R Emmór em-mor' of Hebrew origin (H02544); Emmor (i.e. Chamor), a Canaanite:--Emmor.
entries.1698: ἐμοί E)MOI/ emoí em-oy' a prolonged form of G3427; to me:--I, me, mine, my.
entries.1699: ἐμός E)MO/S emós em-os' from the oblique cases of G1473 (G1698, G1700, G1691); my:--of me, mine (own), my.
entries.1700: ἐμοῦ E)MOU= emoû em-oo' a prolonged form of G3449; of me:--me, mine, my.
entries.1701: ἐμπαιγμός E)MPAIGMO/S empaigmós emp-aheeg-mos' from G1702; derision:--mocking.
entries.1702: ἐμπαίζω E)MPAI/ZW empaízō emp-aheed'-zo from G1722 and G3815; to jeer at, i.e. deride:--mock.
entries.1703: ἐμπαίκτης E)MPAI/KTHS empaíktēs emp-aheek-tace' from G1702; a derider, i.e. (by implication) a false teacher:--mocker, scoffer.
entries.1704: ἐμπεριπατέω E)MPERIPATE/W emperipatéō em-per-ee-pat-eh'-o from G1722 and G4043; to perambulate on a place, i.e. (figuratively) to be occupied among persons:--walk in.
entries.1705: ἐμπίπλημι E)MPI/PLHMI empíplēmi em-pip'-lay-mee or ἐμπλήθω E)MPLH/QW emplḗthō em-play'-tho from G1722 and the base of G4118; to fill in (up), i.e. (by implication) to satisfy (literally or figuratively):--fill.
entries.1706: ἐμπίπτω E)MPI/PTW empíptō em-pip'-to from G1722 and G4098; to fall on, i.e. (literally) to be entrapped by, or (figuratively) be overwhelmed with:--fall among (into).
entries.1707: ἐμπλέκω E)MPLE/KW emplékō em-plek'-o from G1722 and G4120; to entwine, i.e. (figuratively) involve with:--entangle (in, self with).
entries.1708: ἐμπλοκή E)MPLOKH/ emplokḗ em-plok-ay' from G1707; elaborate braiding of the hair:--plaiting.
entries.1709: ἐμπνέω E)MPNE/W empnéō emp-neh'-o from G1722 and G4154; to inhale, i.e. (figuratively) to be animated by (bent upon):--breathe.
entries.1710: ἐμπορεύομαι E)MPOREU/OMAI emporeúomai em-por-yoo'-om-ahee from G1722 and G4198; to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by implication) to trade:--buy and sell, make merchandise.
entries.1711: ἐμπορία E)MPORI/A emporía em-por-ee'-ah feminine from G1713; traffic:--merchandise.
entries.1712: ἐμπόριον E)MPO/RION empórion em-por'-ee-on neuter from G1713; a mart ("emporium"):--merchandise.
entries.1713: ἔμπορος E)/MPOROS émporos em'-por-os from G1722 and the base of G4198; a (wholesale) tradesman:--merchant.
entries.1714: ἐμπρήθω E)MPRH/QW emprḗthō em-pray'-tho from G1722 and πρήθω PRH/QW prḗthō (to blow a flame); to enkindle, i.e. set on fire:--burn up.
entries.1715: ἔμπροσθεν E)/MPROSQEN émprosthen em'-pros-then from G1722 and G4314; in front of (in place (literally or figuratively) or time):--against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of.
entries.1716: ἐμπτύω E)MPTU/W emptýō emp-too'-o from G1722 and G4429; to spit at or on:--spit (upon).
entries.1717: ἐμφανής E)MFANH/S emphanḗs em-fan-ace' from a compound of G1722 and G5316; apparent in self:--manifest, openly.
entries.1718: ἐμφανίζω E)MFANI/ZW emphanízō em-fan-id'-zo from G1717; to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words):--appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify.
entries.1719: ἔμφοβος E)/MFOBOS émphobos em'-fob-os from G1722 and G5401; in fear, i.e. alarmed:--affrighted, afraid, tremble.
entries.1720: ἐμφυσάω E)MFUSA/W emphysáō em-foo-sah'-o from G1722 and φυσάω FUSA/W physáō (to puff) (compare G5453); to blow at or on:--breathe on.
entries.1721: ἔμφυτος E)/MFUTOS émphytos em'-foo-tos from G1722 and a derivative of G5453; implanted (figuratively):--engrafted.
entries.1722: ἐν E)N en en a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between G1519 and G1537); "in," at, (up-)on, by, etc.:--about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-)by (+ all means), for (… sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-)in(-to, -wardly), X mightily, (because) of, (up-)on, (open-)ly, X outwardly, one, X quickly, X shortly, (speedi-)ly, X that, X there(-in, -on), through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), under, when, where(-with), while, with(-in). Often used in compounds, with substantially the same import; rarely with verbs of motion, and then not to indicate direction, except (elliptically) by a separate (and different) preposition.
entries.1723: ἐναγκαλίζομαι E)NAGKALI/ZOMAI enankalízomai en-ang-kal-id'-zom-ahee from G1722 and a derivative of G43; to take in one's arms, i.e. embrace:--take up in arms.
entries.1724: ἐνάλιος E)NA/LIOS enálios en-al'-ee-os from G1722 and G251; in the sea, i.e. marine:--thing in the sea.
entries.1725: ἔναντι E)/NANTI énanti en'-an-tee from G1722 and G473; in front (i.e. figuratively, presence) of:--before.
entries.1726: ἐναντίον E)NANTI/ON enantíon en-an-tee'-on neuter of G1727; (adverbially) in the presence (view) of:--before, in the presence of.
entries.1727: ἐναντίος E)NANTI/OS enantíos en-an-tee'-os from G1725; opposite; figuratively, antagonistic:--(over) against, contrary.
entries.1728: ἐνάρχομαι E)NA/RXOMAI enárchomai en-ar'-khom-ahee from G1722 and G756; to commence on:--rule (by mistake for G757).
entries.1729: ἐνδεής E)NDEH/S endeḗs en-deh-ace' from a compound of G1722 and G1210 (in the sense of lacking); deficient in:--lacking.
entries.1730: ἔνδειγμα E)/NDEIGMA éndeigma en'-dighe-mah from G1731; an indication (concretely):--manifest token.
entries.1731: ἐνδείκνυμι E)NDEI/KNUMI endeíknymi en-dike'-noo-mee from G1722 and G1166; to indicate (by word or act):--do, show (forth).
entries.1732: ἔνδειξις E)/NDEICIS éndeixis en'-dike-sis from G1731; indication (abstractly):--declare, evident token, proof.
entries.1733: ἕνδεκα E(/NDEKA héndeka hen'-dek-ah from (the neuter of) G1520 and G1176; one and ten, i.e. eleven:--eleven.
entries.1734: ἑνδέκατος E(NDE/KATOS hendékatos hen-dek'-at-os ordinal from G1733; eleventh:--eleventh.
entries.1735: ἐνδέχεται E)NDE/XETAI endéchetai en-dekh'-et-ahee third person singular present of a compound of G1722 and G1209; (impersonally) it is accepted in, i.e. admitted (possible):--can (+ not) be.
entries.1736: ἐνδημέω E)NDHME/W endēméō en-day-meh'-o from a compound of G1722 and G1218; to be in one's own country, i.e. home (figuratively):--be at home (present).
entries.1737: ἐνδιδύσκω E)NDIDU/SKW endidýskō en-did-oos'-ko a prolonged form of G1746; to invest (with a garment):--clothe in, wear.
entries.1738: ἔνδικος E)/NDIKOS éndikos en'-dee-kos from G1722 and G1349; in the right, i.e. equitable:--just.
entries.1739: ἐνδόμησις E)NDO/MHSIS endómēsis en-dom'-ay-sis from a compound of G1722 and a derivative of the base of G1218; a housing in (residence), i.e. structure:--building.
entries.1740: ἐνδοξάζω E)NDOCA/ZW endoxázō en-dox-ad'-zo from G1741; to glorify:--glorify.
entries.1741: ἔνδοξος E)/NDOCOS éndoxos en'-dox-os from G1722 and G1391; in glory, i.e. splendid, (figuratively) noble:--glorious, gorgeous(-ly), honourable.
entries.1742: ἔνδυμα E)/NDUMA éndyma en'-doo-mah from G1746; apparel (especially the outer robe):--clothing, garment, raiment.
entries.1743: ἐνδυναμόω E)NDUNAMO/W endynamóō en-doo-nam-o'-o from G1722 and G1412; to empower:--enable, (increase in) strength(-en), be (make) strong.
entries.1744: ἐνδύνω E)NDU/NW endýnō en-doo'-no from G1772 and G1416; to sink (by implication, wrap (compare G1746) on, i.e. (figuratively) sneak:--creep.
entries.1745: ἔνδυσις E)/NDUSIS éndysis en'-doo-sis from G1746; investment with clothing:--putting on.
entries.1746: ἐνδύω E)NDU/W endýō en-doo'-o from G1722 and G1416 (in the sense of sinking into a garment); to invest with clothing (literally or figuratively):--array, clothe (with), endue, have (put) on.
entries.1747: ἐνέδρα E)NE/DRA enédra en-ed'-rah feminine from G1722 and the base of G1476; an ambuscade, i.e. (figuratively) murderous purpose:--lay wait. See also G1749.
entries.1748: ἐνεδρεύω E)NEDREU/W enedreúō en-ed-ryoo'-o from G1747; to lurk, i.e. (figuratively) plot assassination:--lay wait for.
entries.1749: ἔνεδρον E)/NEDRON énedron en'-ed-ron neuter of the same as G1747; an ambush, i.e. (figuratively) murderous design:--lying in wait.
entries.1750: ἐνειλέω E)NEILE/W eneiléō en-i-leh'-o from G1772 and the base of G1507; to enwrap:--wrap in.
entries.1751: ἔνειμι E)/NEIMI éneimi en'-i-mee from G1772 and G1510; to be within (neuter participle plural):--such things as … have. See also G1762.
entries.1752: ἕνεκα E(/NEKA héneka hen'-ek-ah or ἕνεκεν E(/NEKEN héneken hen'-ek-en or εἵνεκεν EI(/NEKEN heíneken hi'-nek-en of uncertain affinity; on account of:--because, for (cause, sake), (where-)fore, by reason of, that.
entries.1753: ἐνέργεια E)NE/RGEIA enérgeia en-erg'-i-ah from G1756; efficiency ("energy"):--operation, strong, (effectual) working.
entries.1754: ἐνεργέω E)NERGE/W energéō en-erg-eh'-o from G1756; to be active, efficient:--do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in).
entries.1755: ἐνέργημα E)NE/RGHMA enérgēma en-erg'-ay-mah from G1754; an effect:--operation, working.
entries.1756: ἐνεργής E)NERGH/S energḗs en-er-gace' from G1722 and G2041; active, operative:--effectual, powerful.
entries.1757: ἐνευλογέω E)NEULOGE/W eneulogéō en-yoo-log-eh'-o from G1722 and G2127; to confer a benefit on:--bless.
entries.1758: ἐνέχω E)NE/XW enéchō en-ekh'-o from G1722 and G2192; to hold in or upon, i.e. ensnare; by implication, to keep a grudge:--entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge.
entries.1759: ἐνθάδε E)NQA/DE entháde en-thad'-eh from a prolonged form of G1722; properly, within, i.e. (of place) here, hither:--(t-)here, hither.
entries.1760: ἐνθυμέομαι E)NQUME/OMAI enthyméomai en-thoo-meh'-om-ahee from a compound of G1722 and G2372; to be inspirited, i.e. ponder:--think.
entries.1761: ἐνθύμησις E)NQU/MHSIS enthýmēsis en-thoo'-may-sis from G1760; deliberation:--device, thought.
entries.1762: ἔνι E)/NI éni en'-ee contraction for the third person singular present indicative of G1751; impersonally, there is in or among:--be, (there) is.
entries.1763: ἐνιαυτός E)NIAUTO/S eniautós en-ee-ow-tos' prolongation from a primary ἔνος E)/NOS énos (a year); a year:--year.
entries.1764: ἐνίστημι E)NI/STHMI enístēmi en-is'-tay-mee from G1722 and G2476; to place on hand, i.e. (reflexively) impend, (participle) be instant:--come, be at hand, present.
entries.1765: ἐνισχύω E)NISXU/W enischýō en-is-khoo'-o from G1722 and G2480; to invigorate (transitively or reflexively):--strengthen.
entries.1766: ἔννατος E)/NNATOS énnatos en'-nat-os ordinal from G1767; ninth:--ninth.
entries.1767: ἐννέα E)NNE/A ennéa en-neh'-ah a primary number; nine:--nine.
entries.1768: ἐννενηκονταεννέα E)NNENHKONTAENNE/A ennenēkontaennéa en-nen-ay-kon-tah-en-neh'-ah from a (tenth) multiple of G1767 and G1767 itself; ninety-nine:--ninety and nine.
entries.1769: ἐννεός E)NNEO/S enneós en-neh-os' from G1770; dumb (as making signs), i.e. silent from astonishment:--speechless.
entries.1770: ἐννεύω E)NNEU/W enneúō en-nyoo'-o from G1722 and G3506; to nod at, i.e. beckon or communicate by gesture:--make signs.
entries.1771: ἔννοια E)/NNOIA énnoia en'-noy-ah from a compound of G1722 and G3563; thoughtfulness, i.e. moral understanding:--intent, mind.
entries.1772: ἔννομος E)/NNOMOS énnomos en'-nom-os from G1722 and G3551; (subjectively) legal, or (objectively) subject to:--lawful, under law.
entries.1773: ἔννυχον E)/NNUXON énnychon en'-noo-khon neuter of a compound of G1722 and G3571; (adverbially) by night:--before day.
entries.1774: ἐνοικέω E)NOIKE/W enoikéō en-oy-keh'-o from G1722 and G3611; to inhabit (figuratively):--dwell in.
entries.1775: ἑνότης E(NO/THS henótēs hen-ot-ace' from G1520; oneness, i.e. (figuratively) unanimity:--unity.
entries.1776: ἐνοχλέω E)NOXLE/W enochléō en-okh-leh'-o from G1722 and G3791; to crowd in, i.e. (figuratively) to annoy:--trouble.
entries.1777: ἔνοχος E)/NOXOS énochos en'-okh-os from G1758; liable to (a condition, penalty or imputation):--in danger of, guilty of, subject to.
entries.1778: ἔνταλμα E)/NTALMA éntalma en'-tal-mah from G1781; an injunction, i.e. religious precept:--commandment.
entries.1779: ἐνταφιάζω E)NTAFIA/ZW entaphiázō en-taf-ee-ad'-zo from a compound of G1722 and G5028; to inswathe with cerements for interment:--bury.
entries.1780: ἐνταφιασμός E)NTAFIASMO/S entaphiasmós en-taf-ee-as-mos' from G1779; preparation for interment:--burying.
entries.1781: ἐντέλλομαι E)NTE/LLOMAI entéllomai en-tel'-lom-ahee from G1722 and the base of G5056; to enjoin:--(give) charge, (give) command(-ments), injoin.
entries.1782: ἐντεῦθεν E)NTEU=QEN enteûthen ent-yoo'-then from the same as G1759; hence (literally or figuratively); (repeated) on both sides:--(from) hence, on either side.
entries.1783: ἔντευξις E)/NTEUCIS énteuxis ent'-yook-sis from G1793; an interview, i.e. (specially) supplication:--intercession, prayer.
entries.1784: ἔντιμος E)/NTIMOS éntimos en'-tee-mos from G1722 and G5092; valued (figuratively):--dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation.
entries.1785: ἐντολή E)NTOLH/ entolḗ en-tol-ay' from G1781; injunction, i.e. an authoritative prescription:--commandment, precept.
entries.1786: ἐντόπιος E)NTO/PIOS entópios en-top'-ee-os from G1722 and G5117; a resident:--of that place.
entries.1787: ἐντός E)NTO/S entós en-tos' from G1722; inside (adverb or noun):--within.
entries.1788: ἐντρέπω E)NTRE/PW entrépō en-trep'-o from G1722 and the base of G5157; to invert, i.e. (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to respect; or in a bad one, to confound:--regard, (give) reference, shame.
entries.1789: ἐντρέφω E)NTRE/FW entréphō en-tref'-o from G1722 and G5142; (figuratively) to educate:--nourish up in.
entries.1790: ἔντρομος E)/NTROMOS éntromos en'-trom-os from G1722 and G5156; terrified:--X quake, X trembled.
entries.1791: ἐντροπή E)NTROPH/ entropḗ en-trop-ay' from G1788; confusion:--shame.
entries.1792: ἐντρυφάω E)NTRUFA/W entrypháō en-troo-fah'-o from G1722 and G5171; to revel in:--sporting selves.
entries.1793: ἐντυγχάνω E)NTUGXA/NW entynchánō en-toong-khan'-o from G1722 and G5177; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) confer with; by extension to entreat (in favor or against):--deal with, make intercession.
entries.1794: ἐντυλίσσω E)NTULI/SSW entylíssō en-too-lis'-so from G1722 and τυλίσσω TULI/SSW tylíssō (to twist; probably akin to G1507); to entwine, i.e. wind up in:--wrap in (together).
entries.1795: ἐντυπόω E)NTUPO/W entypóō en-too-po'-o from G1722 and a derivative of G5179; to enstamp, i.e. engrave:--engrave.
entries.1796: ἐνυβρίζω E)NUBRI/ZW enybrízō en-oo-brid'-zo from G1722 and G5195; to insult:--do despite unto.
entries.1797: ἐνυπνιάζομαι E)NUPNIA/ZOMAI enypniázomai en-oop-nee-ad'-zom-ahee middle voice from G1798; to dream:--dream(-er).
entries.1798: ἐνύπνιον E)NU/PNION enýpnion en-oop'-nee-on from G1722 and G5258; something seen in sleep, i.e. a dream (vision in a dream):--dream.
entries.1799: ἐνώπιον E)NW/PION enṓpion en-o'-pee-on neuter of a compound of G1722 and a derivative of G3700; in the face of (literally or figuratively):--before, in the presence (sight) of, to.
entries.1800: Ἐνώς *)ENW/S Enṓs en-oce' of Hebrew origin (H0583); Enos (i.e. Enosh), a patriarch:--Enos.
entries.1801: ἐνωτίζομαι E)NWTI/ZOMAI enōtízomai en-o-tid'-zom-ahee middle voice from a compound of G1722 and G3775; to take in one's ear, i.e. to listen:--hearken.
entries.1802: Ἐνώχ *)ENW/X Enṓch en-oke' of Hebrew origin (H02585); Enoch (i.e. Chanok), an antediluvian:--Enoch.
entries.1803: ἕξ E(/C héx hex a primary numeral; six:--six.
entries.1804: ἐξαγγέλλω E)CAGGE/LLW exangéllō ex-ang-el'-lo from G1537 and the base of G32; to publish, i.e. celebrate:--shew forth.
entries.1805: ἐξαγοράζω E)CAGORA/ZW exagorázō ex-ag-or-ad'-zo from G1537 and G59; to buy up, i.e. ransom; figuratively, to rescue from loss (improve opportunity):--redeem.
entries.1806: ἐξάγω E)CA/GW exágō ex-ag'-o from G1537 and G71; to lead forth:--bring forth (out), fetch (lead) out.
entries.1807: ἐξαιρέω E)CAIRE/W exairéō ex-ahee-reh'-o from G1537 and G138; actively, to tear out; middle voice, to select; figuratively, to release:--deliver, pluck out, rescue.
entries.1808: ἐξαίρω E)CAI/RW exaírō ex-ah'-ee-ro from G1537 and G142; to remove:--put (take) away.
entries.1809: ἐξαιτέομαι E)CAITE/OMAI exaitéomai ex-ahee-teh'-om-ahee middle voice from G1537 and G154; to demand (for trial):--desire.
entries.1810: ἐξαίφνης E)CAI/FNHS exaíphnēs ex-ah'-eef-nace from G1537 and the base of G160; of a sudden (unexpectedly):--suddenly. Compare G1819.
entries.1811: ἐξακολουθέω E)CAKOLOUQE/W exakolouthéō ex-ak-ol-oo-theh'-o from G1537 and G190; to follow out, i.e. (figuratively) to imitate, obey, yield to:--follow.
entries.1812: ἑξακόσιοι E(CAKO/SIOI hexakósioi hex-ak-os'-ee-oy plural ordinal from G1803 and G1540; six hundred:--six hundred.
entries.1813: ἐξαλείφω E)CALEI/FW exaleíphō ex-al-i'-fo from G1537 and G218; to smear out, i.e. obliterate (erase tears, figuratively, pardon sin):--blot out, wipe away.
entries.1814: ἐξάλλομαι E)CA/LLOMAI exállomai ex-al'-lom-ahee from G1537 and G242; to spring forth :--leap up.
entries.1815: ἐξανάστασις E)CANA/STASIS exanástasis ex-an-as'-tas-is from G1817; a rising from death:--resurrection.
entries.1816: ἐξανατέλλω E)CANATE/LLW exanatéllō ex-an-at-el'-lo from G1537 and G393; to start up out of the ground, i.e. germinate:--spring up.
entries.1817: ἐξανίστημι E)CANI/STHMI exanístēmi ex-an-is'-tay-mee from G1537 and G450; objectively, to produce, i.e. (figuratively) beget; subjectively, to arise, i.e. (figuratively) object:--raise (rise) up.
entries.1818: ἐξαπατάω E)CAPATA/W exapatáō ex-ap-at-ah'-o from G1537 and G538; to seduce wholly:--beguile, deceive.
entries.1819: ἐξάπινα E)CA/PINA exápina ex-ap'-ee-nah from G1537 and a derivative of the same as G160; of a sudden, i.e. unexpectedly:--suddenly. Compare G1810.
entries.1820: ἐξαπορέομαι E)CAPORE/OMAI exaporéomai ex-ap-or-eh'-om-ahee middle voice from G1537 and G639; to be utterly at a loss, i.e. despond:--(in) despair.
entries.1821: ἐξαποστέλλω E)CAPOSTE/LLW exapostéllō ex-ap-os-tel'-lo from G1537 and G649; to send away forth, i.e. (on a mission) to despatch, or (peremptorily) to dismiss:--send (away, forth, out).
entries.1822: ἐξαρτίζω E)CARTI/ZW exartízō ex-ar-tid'-zo from G1537 and a derivative of G739; to finish out (time); figuratively, to equip fully (a teacher):--accomplish, thoroughly furnish.
entries.1823: ἐξαστράπτω E)CASTRA/PTW exastráptō ex-as-trap'-to from G1537 and G797; to lighten forth, i.e. (figuratively) to be radiant (of very white garments):--glistening.
entries.1824: ἐξαυτῆς E)CAUTH=S exautēs ex-ow'-tace from G1537 and the genitive case singular feminine of G846 (G5610 being understood); from that hour, i.e. instantly:--by and by, immediately, presently, straightway.
entries.1825: ἐξεγείρω E)CEGEI/RW exegeírō ex-eg-i'-ro from G1537 and G1453; to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction):--raise up.
entries.1826: ἔξειμι E)/CEIMI éxeimi ex'-i-mee from G1537 and εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi (to go); to issue, i.e. leave (a place), escape (to the shore):--depart, get (to land), go out.
entries.1827: ἐξελέγχω E)CELE/GXW exelénchō ex-el-eng'-kho from G1537 and G1651; to convict fully, i.e. (by implication) to punish:--convince.
entries.1828: ἐξέλκω E)CE/LKW exélkō ex-el'-ko from G1537 and G1670; to drag forth, i.e. (figuratively) to entice (to sin):--draw away.
entries.1829: ἐξέραμα E)CE/RAMA exérama ex-er'-am-ah from a compound of G1537 and a presumed ἐράω E)RA/W eráō (to spue); vomit, i.e. food disgorged:--vomit.
entries.1830: ἐξερευνάω E)CEREUNA/W exereunáō ex-er-yoo-nah'-o from G1537 and G2045; to explore (figuratively):--search diligently.
entries.1831: ἐξέρχομαι E)CE/RXOMAI exérchomai ex-er'-khom-ahee from G1537 and G2064; to issue (literally or figuratively):--come (forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad.
entries.1832: ἔξεστι E)/CESTI éxesti ex'-es-tee third person singular present indicative of a compound of G1537 and G1510; so also ἐξόν E)CO/N exón ex-on' neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of G1510 expressed); impersonally, it is right (through the figurative idea of being out in public):--be lawful, let, X may(-est).
entries.1833: ἐξετάζω E)CETA/ZW exetázō ex-et-ad'-zo from G1537 and ἐτάζω E)TA/ZW etázō (to examine); to test thoroughly (by questions), i.e. ascertain or interrogate:--ask, enquire, search.
entries.1834: ἐξηγέομαι E)CHGE/OMAI exēgéomai ex-ayg-eh'-om-ahee from G1537 and G2233; to consider out (aloud), i.e. rehearse, unfold:--declare, tell.
entries.1835: ἑξήκοντα E(CH/KONTA hexḗkonta hex-ay'-kon-tah the tenth multiple of G1803; sixty:--sixty(-fold), threescore.
entries.1836: ἑξῆς E(CH=S hexēs hex-ace' from G2192 (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining); successive:--after, following, X morrow, next.
entries.1837: ἐξηχέομαι E)CHXE/OMAI exēchéomai ex-ay-kheh'-om-ahee middle voice from G1537 and G2278; to "echo" forth, i.e. resound (be generally reported):--sound forth.
entries.1838: ἕξις E(/CIS héxis hex'-is from G2192; habit, i.e. (by implication) practice:--use.
entries.1839: ἐξίστημι E)CI/STHMI exístēmi ex-is'-tay-mee from G1537 and G2476; to put (stand) out of wits, i.e. astound, or (reflexively) become astounded, insane:--amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder.
entries.1840: ἐξισχύω E)CISXU/W exischýō ex-is-khoo'-o from G1537 and G2480; to have full strength, i.e. be entirely competent:--be able.
entries.1841: ἔξοδος E)/CODOS éxodos ex'-od-os from G1537 and G3598; an exit, i.e. (figuratively) death:--decease, departing.
entries.1842: ἐξολοθρεύω E)COLOQREU/W exolothreúō ex-ol-oth-ryoo'-o from G1537 and G3645; to extirpate:--destroy.
entries.1843: ἐξομολογέω E)COMOLOGE/W exomologéō ex-om-ol-og-eh'-o from G1537 and G3670; to acknowledge or (by implication, of assent) agree fully:--confess, profess, promise.
entries.1844: ἐξορκίζω E)CORKI/ZW exorkízō ex-or-kid'-zo from G1537 and G3726; to exact an oath, i.e. conjure:--adjure.
entries.1845: ἐξορκιστής E)CORKISTH/S exorkistḗs ex-or-kis-tace' from G1844; one that binds by an oath (or spell), i.e. (by implication) an "exorcist" (conjurer):--exorcist.
entries.1846: ἐξορύσσω E)CORU/SSW exorýssō ex-or-oos'-so from G1537 and G3736; to dig out, i.e. (by extension) to extract (an eye), remove (roofing):--break up, pluck out.
entries.1847: ἐξουδενόω E)COUDENO/W exoudenóō ex-oo-den-o'-o from G1537 and a derivative of the neuter of G3762; to make utterly nothing of, i.e. despise:--set at nought. See also G1848.
entries.1848: ἐξουθενέω E)COUQENE/W exouthenéō ex-oo-then-eh'-o a variation of G1847 and meaning the same :--contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought.
entries.1849: ἐξουσία E)COUSI/A exousía ex-oo-see'-ah from G1832 (in the sense of ability); privilege, i.e. (subjectively) force, capacity, competency, freedom, or (objectively) mastery (concretely, magistrate, superhuman, potentate, token of control), delegated influence:--authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength.
entries.1850: ἐξουσιάζω E)COUSIA/ZW exousiázō ex-oo-see-ad'-zo from G1849; to control:--exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of.
entries.1851: ἐξοχή E)COXH/ exochḗ ex-okh-ay' from a compound of G1537 and G2192 (meaning to stand out); prominence (figuratively):--principal.
entries.1852: ἐξυπνίζω E)CUPNI/ZW exypnízō ex-oop-nid'-zo from G1853; to waken:--awake out of sleep.
entries.1853: ἔξυπνος E)/CUPNOS éxypnos ex'-oop-nos from G1537 and G5258; awake:--X out of sleep.
entries.1854: ἔξω E)/CW éxō ex'-o adverb from G1537; out(-side, of doors), literally or figuratively:--away, forth, (with-)out (of, -ward), strange.
entries.1855: ἔξωθεν E)/CWQEN éxōthen ex'-o-then from G1854; external(-ly):--out(-side, -ward, - wardly), (from) without.
entries.1856: ἐξωθέω E)CWQE/W exōthéō ex-o-theh'-o or ἐξώθω E)CW/QW exṓthō ex-o'-tho from G1537 and ὠθέω W)QE/W ōthéō (to push); to expel; by implication, to propel:--drive out, thrust in.
entries.1857: ἐξώτερος E)CW/TEROS exṓteros ex-o'-ter-os comparative of G1854; exterior:--outer.
entries.1858: ἑορτάζω E(ORTA/ZW heortázō heh-or-tad'-zo from G1859; to observe a festival:--keep the feast.
entries.1859: ἑορτή E(ORTH/ heortḗ heh-or-tay' of uncertain affinity; a festival:--feast, holyday.
entries.1860: ἐπαγγελία E)PAGGELI/A epangelía ep-ang-el-ee'-ah from G1861; an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good):--message, promise.
entries.1861: ἐπαγγέλλω E)PAGGE/LLW epangéllō ep-ang-el'-lo from G1909 and the base of G32; to announce upon (reflexively), i.e. (by implication) to engage to do something, to assert something respecting oneself:--profess, (make) promise.
entries.1862: ἐπάγγελμα E)PA/GGELMA epángelma ep-ang'-el-mah from G1861; a self-committal (by assurance of conferring some good):--promise.
entries.1863: ἐπάγω E)PA/GW epágō ep-ag'-o from G1909 and G71; to superinduce, i.e. inflict (an evil), charge (a crime):--bring upon.
entries.1864: ἐπαγωνίζομαι E)PAGWNI/ZOMAI epagōnízomai ep-ag-o-nid'-zom-ahee from G1909 and G75; to struggle for:--earnestly contend for.
entries.1865: ἐπαθροίζω E)PAQROI/ZW epathroízō ep-ath-roid'-zo from G1909 and ἀθροίζω A)QROI/ZW athroízō (to assemble); o accumulate:--gather thick together.
entries.1866: Ἐπαίνετος *)EPAI/NETOS Epaínetos ep-a'-hee-net-os from G1867; praised; Epænetus, a Christian:--Epenetus.
entries.1867: ἐπαινέω E)PAINE/W epainéō ep-ahee-neh'-o from G1909 and G134; to applaud:--commend, laud, praise.
entries.1868: ἔπαινος E)/PAINOS épainos ep'-ahee-nos from G1909 and the base of G134; laudation; concretely, a commendable thing:--praise.
entries.1869: ἐπαίρω E)PAI/RW epaírō ep-ahee'-ro from G1909 and G142; to raise up (literally or figuratively):--exalt self, poise (lift, take) up.
entries.1870: ἐπαισχύνομαι E)PAISXU/NOMAI epaischýnomai ep-ahee-skhoo'-nom-ahee from G1909 and G153; to feel shame for something:--be ashamed.
entries.1871: ἐπαιτέω E)PAITE/W epaitéō ep-ahee-teh'-o from G1909 and G154; to ask for:--beg.
entries.1872: ἐπακολουθέω E)PAKOLOUQE/W epakolouthéō ep-ak-ol-oo-theh'-o from G1909 and G190; to accompany:--follow (after).
entries.1873: ἐπακούω E)PAKOU/W epakoúō ep-ak-oo'-o from G1909 and G191; to hearken (favorably) to:--hear.
entries.1874: ἐπακροάομαι E)PAKROA/OMAI epakroáomai ep-ak-ro-ah'-om-ahee from G1909 and the base of G202; to listen (intently) to:--hear.
entries.1875: ἐπάν E)PA/N epán ep-an' from G1909 and G302; a particle of indefinite contemporaneousness; whenever, as soon as:--when.
entries.1876: ἐπάναγκες E)PA/NAGKES epánankes ep-an'-ang-kes neuter of a presumed compound of G1909 and G318; (adverbially) on necessity, i.e. necessarily:--necessary.
entries.1877: ἐπανάγω E)PANA/GW epanágō ep-an-ag'-o from G1909 and G321; to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to sea); (intransitively) to return:--launch (thrust) out, return.
entries.1878: ἐπαναμιμνήσκω E)PANAMIMNH/SKW epanamimnḗskō ep-an-ah-mim-nace'-ko from G1909 and G363; to remind of:--put in mind.
entries.1879: ἐπαναπαύομαι E)PANAPAU/OMAI epanapaúomai ep-an-ah-pow'-om-ahee middle voice from G1909 and G373; to settle on; literally (remain) or figuratively (rely):--rest in (upon).
entries.1880: ἐπανέρχομαι E)PANE/RXOMAI epanérchomai ep-an-er'-khom-ahee from G1909 and G424; to come up on, i.e. return:--come again, return.
entries.1881: ἐπανίσταμαι E)PANI/STAMAI epanístamai ep-an-is'-tam-ahee middle voice from G1909 and G450; to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to attack:--rise up against.
entries.1882: ἐπανόρθωσις E)PANO/RQWSIS epanórthōsis ep-an-or'-tho-sis from a compound of G1909 and G461; a straightening up again, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (reformation):-- correction.
entries.1883: ἐπάνω E)PA/NW epánō ep-an'-o from G1909 and G507; up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank, etc.):--above, more than, (up-)on, over.
entries.1884: ἐπαρκέω E)PARKE/W eparkéō ep-ar-keh'-o from G1909 and G714; to avail for, i.e. help:--relieve.
entries.1885: ἐπαρχία E)PARXI/A eparchía ep-ar-khee'-ah from a compound of G1909 and G757 (meaning a governor of a district, "eparch"); a special region of government, i.e. a Roman præfecture:--province.
entries.1886: ἔπαυλις E)/PAULIS épaulis ep'-ow-lis from G1909 and an equivalent of G833; a hut over the head, i.e. a dwelling:--habitation.
entries.1887: ἐπαύριον E)PAU/RION epaúrion ep-ow'-ree-on from G1909 and G839; occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. (G2250 being implied) to-morrow:--day following, morrow, next day (after).
entries.1888: ἐπαυτοφώρῳ E)PAUTOFW/RW| epautophṓrōi ep-ow-tof-o'-ro from G1909 and G846 and (the dative case singular of) a derivative of φώρ FW/R phṓr (a thief); in theft itself, i.e. (by analogy) in actual crime:--in the very act.
entries.1889: Ἐπαφρᾶς *)EPAFRA=S Epaphrâs ep-af-ras' contracted from G1891; Epaphras, a Christian:--Epaphras.
entries.1890: ἐπαφρίζω E)PAFRI/ZW epaphrízō ep-af-rid'-zo from G1909 and G875; to foam upon, i.e. (figuratively) to exhibit (a vile passion):--foam out.
entries.1891: Ἐπαφρόδιτος *)EPAFRO/DITOS Epaphróditos ep-af-rod'-ee-tos from G1909 (in the sense of devoted to) and Ἀφροδίτη *)AFRODI/TH Aphrodítē (Venus); Epaphroditus, a Christian:--Epaphroditus. Compare G1889.
entries.1892: ἐπεγείρω E)PEGEI/RW epegeírō ep-eg-i'-ro from G1909 and G1453; to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite against:--raise, stir up.
entries.1893: ἐπεί E)PEI/ epeí ep-i' from G1909 and G1487; thereupon, i.e. since (of time or cause):--because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when.
entries.1894: ἐπειδή E)PEIDH/ epeidḗ ep-i-day' from G1893 and G1211; since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause) whereas:--after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since.
entries.1895: ἐπειδήπερ E)PEIDH/PER epeidḗper ep-i-day'-per from G1894 and G4007; since indeed (of cause):--forasmuch.
entries.1896: ἐπεῖδον E)PEI=DON epeîdon ep-i'-don and other moods and persons of the same tense; from G1909 and G1492; to regard (favorably or otherwise):--behold, look upon.
entries.1897: ἐπείπερ E)PEI/PER epeíper ep-i'-per from G1893 and G4007; since indeed (of cause):--seeing.
entries.1898: ἐπεισαγωγή E)PEISAGWGH/ epeisagōgḗ ep-ice-ag-o-gay' from a compound of G1909 and G1521; a superintroduction:--bringing in.
entries.1899: ἔπειτα E)/PEITA épeita ep'-i-tah from G1909 and G1534; thereafter:--after that(-ward), then.
entries.1900: ἐπέκεινα E)PE/KEINA epékeina ep-ek'-i-nah from G1909 and (the accusative case plural neuter of) G1565; upon those parts of, i.e. on the further side of:--beyond.
entries.1901: ἐπεκτείνομαι E)PEKTEI/NOMAI epekteínomai ep-ek-ti'-nom-ahee middle voice from G1909 and G1614; to stretch (oneself) forward upon:--reach forth.
entries.1902: ἐπενδύομαι E)PENDU/OMAI ependýomai ep-en-doo'-om-ahee middle voice from G1909 and G1746; to invest upon oneself:--be clothed upon.
entries.1903: ἐπενδύτης E)PENDU/THS ependýtēs ep-en-doo'-tace from G1902; a wrapper, i.e. outer garment:--fisher's coat.
entries.1904: ἐπέρχομαι E)PE/RXOMAI epérchomai ep-er'-khom-ahee from G1909 and G2064; to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack, (figuratively) influence:--come (in, upon).
entries.1905: ἐπερωτάω E)PERWTA/W eperōtáō ep-er-o-tah'-o from G1909 and G2065; to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek:--ask (after, questions), demand, desire, question.
entries.1906: ἐπερώτημα E)PERW/THMA eperṓtēma ep-er-o'-tay-mah from G1905; an inquiry:--answer.
entries.1907: ἐπέχω E)PE/XW epéchō ep-ekh'-o from G1909 and G2192; to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by extension) to detain; (with implication, of G3563) to pay attention to:--give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay.
entries.1908: ἐπηρεάζω E)PHREA/ZW epēreázō ep-ay-reh-ad'-zo from a compound of G1909 and (probably) ἀρειά A)REIA/ areiá (threats); to insult, slander:--use despitefully, falsely accuse.
entries.1909: ἐπί E)PI/ epí ep-ee' a primary preposition; properly, meaning superimposition (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on, etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon, etc.:--about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward), with. In compounds it retains essentially the same import, at, upon, etc. (literally or figuratively).
entries.1910: ἐπιβαίνω E)PIBAI/NW epibaínō ep-ee-bah'-ee-no from G1909 and the base of G939; to walk upon, i.e. mount, ascend, embark, arrive:--come (into), enter into, go abroad, sit upon, take ship.
entries.1911: ἐπιβάλλω E)PIBA/LLW epibállō ep-ee-bal'-lo from G1909 and G906; to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with G1438 implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to:--beat into, cast (up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on.
entries.1912: ἐπιβαρέω E)PIBARE/W epibaréō ep-ee-bar-eh'-o from G1909 and G916; to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards:--be chargeable to, overcharge.
entries.1913: ἐπιβιβάζω E)PIBIBA/ZW epibibázō ep-ee-bee-bad'-zo from G1909 and a reduplicated derivative of the base of G939 (compare G307); to cause to mount (an animal):--set on.
entries.1914: ἐπιβλέπω E)PIBLE/PW epiblépō ep-ee-blep'-o from G1909 and G991; to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality):--look upon, regard, have respect to.
entries.1915: ἐπίβλημα E)PI/BLHMA epíblēma ep-ib'-lay-mah from G1911; a patch:--piece.
entries.1916: ἐπιβοάω E)PIBOA/W epiboáō ep-ee-bo-ah'-o from G1909 and G994; to exclaim against:--cry.
entries.1917: ἐπιβουλή E)PIBOULH/ epiboulḗ ep-ee-boo-lay' from a presumed compound of G1909 and G1014; a plan against someone, i.e. a plot:--laying (lying) in wait.
entries.1918: ἐπιγαμβρεύω E)PIGAMBREU/W epigambreúō ep-ee-gam-bryoo'-o from G1909 and a derivative of G1062; to form affinity with, i.e. (specially) in a levirate way:--marry.
entries.1919: ἐπίγειος E)PI/GEIOS epígeios ep-ig'-i-os from G1909 and G1093; worldly (physically or morally):--earthly, in earth, terrestrial.
entries.1920: ἐπιγίνομαι E)PIGI/NOMAI epigínomai ep-ig-in'-om-ahee from G1909 and G1096; to arrive upon, i.e. spring up (as a wind):--blow.
entries.1921: ἐπιγινώσκω E)PIGINW/SKW epiginṓskō ep-ig-in-oce'-ko from G1909 and G1097; to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge:--(ac-, have, take)know(-ledge, well), perceive.
entries.1922: ἐπίγνωσις E)PI/GNWSIS epígnōsis ep-ig'-no-sis from G1921; recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment, acknowledgement:--(ac-)knowledge(-ing, - ment).
entries.1923: ἐπιγραφή E)PIGRAFH/ epigraphḗ ep-ig-raf-ay' from G1924; an inscription:--superscription.
entries.1924: ἐπιγράφω E)PIGRA/FW epigráphō ep-ee-graf'-o from G1909 and G1125; to inscribe (physically or mentally):--inscription, write in (over, thereon).
entries.1925: ἐπιδείκνυμι E)PIDEI/KNUMI epideíknymi ep-ee-dike'-noo-mee from G1909 and G1166; to exhibit (physically or mentally):--shew.
entries.1926: ἐπιδέχομαι E)PIDE/XOMAI epidéchomai ep-ee-dekh'-om-ahee from G1909 and G1209; to admit (as a guest or (figuratively) teacher):--receive.
entries.1927: ἐπιδημέω E)PIDHME/W epidēméō ep-ee-day-meh'-o from a compound of G1909 and G1218; to make oneself at home, i.e. (by extension) to reside (in a foreign country):--(be) dwelling (which were) there, stranger.
entries.1928: ἐπιδιατάσσομαι E)PIDIATA/SSOMAI epidiatássomai ep-ee-dee-ah-tas'-som-ahee middle voice from G1909 and G1299; to appoint besides, i.e. supplement (as a codicil):--add to.
entries.1929: ἐπιδίδωμι E)PIDI/DWMI epidídōmi ep-ee-did'-o-mee from G1909 and G1325; to give over (by hand or surrender):--deliver unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer.
entries.1930: ἐπιδιορθόω E)PIDIORQO/W epidiorthóō ep-ee-dee-or-tho'-o from G1909 and a derivative of G3717; to straighten further, i.e. (figuratively) arrange additionally:--set in order.
entries.1931: ἐπιδύω E)PIDU/W epidýō ep-ee-doo'-o from G1909 and G1416; to set fully (as the sun):--go down.
entries.1932: ἐπιείκεια E)PIEI/KEIA epieíkeia ep-ee-i'-ki-ah from G1933; suitableness, i.e. (by implication) equity, mildness:--clemency, gentleness.
entries.1933: ἐπιεικής E)PIEIKH/S epieikḗs ep-ee-i-kace' from G1909 and G1503; appropriate, i.e. (by implication) mild:--gentle, moderation, patient.
entries.1934: ἐπιζητέω E)PIZHTE/W epizētéō ep-eed-zay-teh'-o from G1909 and G2212; to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand, to crave:--desire, enquire, seek (after, for).
entries.1935: ἐπιθανάτιος E)PIQANA/TIOS epithanátios ep-ee-than-at'-ee-os from G1909 and G2288; doomed to death:--appointed to death.
entries.1936: ἐπίθεσις E)PI/QESIS epíthesis ep-ith'-es-is from G2007; an imposition (of hands officially):--laying (putting) on.
entries.1937: ἐπιθυμέω E)PIQUME/W epithyméō ep-ee-thoo-meh'-o from G1909 and G2372; to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully or otherwise):--covet, desire, would fain, lust (after).
entries.1938: ἐπιθυμητής E)PIQUMHTH/S epithymētḗs ep-ee-thoo-may-tace' from G1937; a craver:--+ lust after.
entries.1939: ἐπιθυμία E)PIQUMI/A epithymía ep-ee-thoo-mee'-ah from G1937; a longing (especially for what is forbidden):--concupiscence, desire, lust (after).
entries.1940: ἐπικαθίζω E)PIKAQI/ZW epikathízō ep-ee-kath-id'-zo from G1909 and G2523; to seat upon:--set on.
entries.1941: ἐπικαλέομαι E)PIKALE/OMAI epikaléomai ep-ee-kal-eh'-om-ahee middle voice from G1909 and G2564; to entitle; by implication, to invoke (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.):--appeal (unto), call (on, upon), surname.
entries.1942: ἐπικάλυμα E)PIKA/LUMA epikályma ep-ee-kal'-oo-mah from G1943; a covering, i.e. (figuratively) pretext:--cloke.
entries.1943: ἐπικαλύπτω E)PIKALU/PTW epikalýptō ep-ee-kal-oop'-to from G1909 and G2572; to conceal, i.e. (figuratively) forgive:--cover.
entries.1944: ἐπικατάρατος E)PIKATA/RATOS epikatáratos ep-ee-kat-ar'-at-os from G1909 and a derivative of G2672; imprecated, i.e. execrable:--accursed.
entries.1945: ἐπίκειμαι E)PI/KEIMAI epíkeimai ep-ik'-i-mahee from G1909 and G2749; to rest upon (literally or figuratively):--impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-)on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon.
entries.1946: Ἐπικούρειος *)EPIKOU/REIOS Epikoúreios ep-ee-koo'-ri-os from Ἐπίκουρος *)EPI/KOUROS Epíkouros (compare G1947) (a noted philosopher); an Epicurean or follower of Epicurus:--Epicurean.
entries.1947: ἐπικουρία E)PIKOURI/A epikouría ep-ee-koo-ree'-ah from a compound of G1909 and a (prolonged) form of the base of G2877 (in the sense of servant); assistance:--help.
entries.1948: ἐπικρίνω E)PIKRI/NW epikrínō ep-ee-kree'-no from G1909 and G2919; to adjudge:--give sentence.
entries.1949: ἐπιλαμβάνομαι E)PILAMBA/NOMAI epilambánomai ep-ee-lam-ban'-om-ahee middle voice from G1909 and G2983; to seize (for help, injury, attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively):--catch, lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on).
entries.1950: ἐπιλανθάνομαι E)PILANQA/NOMAI epilanthánomai ep-ee-lan-than'-om-ahee middle voice from G1909 and G2990; to lose out of mind; by implication, to neglect:--(be) forget(-ful of).
entries.1951: ἐπιλέγομαι E)PILE/GOMAI epilégomai ep-ee-leg'-om-ahee middle voice from G1909 and G3004; to surname, select:--call, choose.
entries.1952: ἐπιλείπω E)PILEI/PW epileípō ep-ee-li'-po from G1909 and G3007; to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be insufficient for:--fail.
entries.1953: ἐπιλησμονή E)PILHSMONH/ epilēsmonḗ ep-ee-lace-mon-ay' from a derivative of G1950; negligence:--X forgetful.
entries.1954: ἐπίλοιπος E)PI/LOIPOS epíloipos ep-il'-oy-pos from G1909 and G3062; left over, i.e. remaining:--rest.
entries.1955: ἐπίλυσις E)PI/LUSIS epílysis ep-il'-oo-sis from G1956; explanation, i.e. application:--interpretation.
entries.1956: ἐπιλύω E)PILU/W epilýō ep-ee-loo'-o from G1909 and G3089; to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain, decide:--determine, expound.
entries.1957: ἐπιμαρτυρέω E)PIMARTURE/W epimartyréō ep-ee-mar-too-reh'-o from G1909 and G3140; to attest further, i.e. corroborate:--testify.
entries.1958: ἐπιμέλεια E)PIME/LEIA epiméleia ep-ee-mel'-i-ah from G1959; carefulness, i.e. kind attention (hospitality):--+ refresh self.
entries.1959: ἐπιμελέομαι E)PIMELE/OMAI epimeléomai ep-ee-mel-eh'-om-ahee middle voice from G1909 and the same as G3199; to care for (physically or otherwise):--take care of.
entries.1960: ἐπιμελῶς E)PIMELW=S epimelōs ep-ee-mel-oce' adverb from a derivative of G1959; carefully:--diligently.
entries.1961: ἐπιμένω E)PIME/NW epiménō ep-ee-men'-o from G1909 and G3306; to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively, persevere):--abide (in), continue (in), tarry.
entries.1962: ἐπινεύω E)PINEU/W epineúō ep-een-yoo'-o from G1909 and G3506; to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to assent:--consent.
entries.1963: ἐπίνοια E)PI/NOIA epínoia ep-in'-oy-ah from G1909 and G3563; attention of the mind, i.e. (by implication) purpose:--thought.
entries.1964: ἐπιορκέω E)PIORKE/W epiorkéō ep-ee-or-keh'-o from G1965; to commit perjury:--forswear self.
entries.1965: ἐπίορκος E)PI/ORKOS epíorkos ep-ee'-or-kos from G1909 and G3727; on oath, i.e. (falsely) a forswearer:--perjured person.
entries.1966: ἐπιοῦσα E)PIOU=SA epioûsa ep-ee-oo'-sah feminine singular participle of a compound of G1909 and εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi (to go); supervening, i.e. (G2250 or G3571 being expressed or implied) the ensuing day or night:--following, next.
entries.1967: ἐπιούσιος E)PIOU/SIOS epioúsios ep-ee-oo'-see-os perhaps from the same as G1966; tomorrow's; but more probably from G1909 and a derivative of the present participle feminine of G1510; for subsistence, i.e. needful:--daily.
entries.1968: ἐπιπίπτω E)PIPI/PTW epipíptō ep-ee-pip'-to from G1909 and G4098; to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively):--fall into (on, upon) lie on, press upon.
entries.1969: ἐπιπλήσσω E)PIPLH/SSW epiplḗssō ep-ee-place'-so from G1909 and G4141; to chastise, i.e. (with words) to upbraid:--rebuke.
entries.1970: ἐπιπνίγω E)PIPNI/GW epipnígō ep-ee-pnee'-go from G1909 and G4155; to throttle upon, i.e. (figuratively) overgrow:--choke.
entries.1971: ἐπιποθέω E)PIPOQE/W epipothéō ep-ee-poth-eh'-o from G1909 and potheo (to yearn); to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave possession (lawfully or wrongfully):--(earnestly) desire (greatly), (greatly) long (after), lust.
entries.1972: ἐπιπόθησις E)PIPO/QHSIS epipóthēsis ep-ee-poth'-ay-sis from G1971; a longing for:--earnest (vehement) desire.
entries.1973: ἐπιπόθητος E)PIPO/QHTOS epipóthētos ep-ee-poth'-ay-tos from G1909 and a derivative of the latter part of G1971; yearned upon, i.e. greatly loved:--longed for.
entries.1974: ἐπιποθία E)PIPOQI/A epipothía ep-ee-poth-ee'-ah from G1971; intense longing:--great desire.
entries.1975: ἐπιπορεύομαι E)PIPOREU/OMAI epiporeúomai ep-ee-por-yoo'-om-ahee from G1909 and G4198; to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach):--come.
entries.1976: ἐπιῤῥάπτω E)PIR)R(A/PTW epirrháptō ep-ir-hrap'-to from G1909 and the base of G4476; to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the needle:--sew on.
entries.1977: ἐπιῤῥίπτω E)PIR)R(I/PTW epirrhíptō ep-ir-hrip'-to from G1909 and G4496; to throw upon (literally or figuratively):--cast upon.
entries.1978: ἐπίσημος E)PI/SHMOS epísēmos ep-is'-ay-mos from G1909 and some form of the base of G4591; remarkable, i.e. (figuratively) eminent:--notable, of note.
entries.1979: ἐπισιτισμός E)PISITISMO/S episitismós ep-ee-sit-is-mos' from a compound of G1909 and a derivative of G4621; a provisioning, i.e. (concretely) food:--victuals.
entries.1980: ἐπισκέπτομαι E)PISKE/PTOMAI episképtomai ep-ee-skep'-tom-ahee middle voice from G1909 and the base of G4649; to inspect, i.e. (by implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve:--look out, visit.
entries.1981: ἐπισκηνόω E)PISKHNO/W episkēnóō ep-ee-skay-no'-o from G1909 and G4637; to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with :--rest upon.
entries.1982: ἐπισκιάζω E)PISKIA/ZW episkiázō ep-ee-skee-ad'-zo from G1909 and a derivative of G4639; to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest with preternatural influence:--overshadow.
entries.1983: ἐπισκοπέω E)PISKOPE/W episkopéō ep-ee-skop-eh'-o from G1909 and G4648; to oversee; by implication, to beware:--look diligently, take the oversight.
entries.1984: ἐπισκοπή E)PISKOPH/ episkopḗ ep-is-kop-ay' from G1980; inspection (for relief); by implication, superintendence; specially, the Christian "episcopate":--the office of a "bishop", bishoprick, visitation.
entries.1985: ἐπίσκοπος E)PI/SKOPOS epískopos ep-is'-kop-os from G1909 and G4649 (in the sense of G1983); a superintendent, i.e. Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively):--bishop, overseer.
entries.1986: ἐπισπάομαι E)PISPA/OMAI epispáomai ep-ee-spah'-om-ahee from G1909 and G4685; to draw over, i.e. (with G203 implied) efface the mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin):--become uncircumcised.
entries.1987: ἐπίσταμαι E)PI/STAMAI epístamai ep-is'-tam-ahee apparently a middle voice of G2186 (with G3563 implied); to put the mind upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with:--know, understand.
entries.1988: ἐπιστάτης E)PISTA/THS epistátēs ep-is-tat'-ace from G1909 and a presumed derivative of G2476; an appointee over, i.e. commander (teacher):--master.
entries.1989: ἐπιστέλλω E)PISTE/LLW epistéllō ep-ee-stel'-lo from G1909 and G4724; to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to communicate by letter (for any purpose):--write (a letter, unto).
entries.1990: ἐπιστήμων E)PISTH/MWN epistḗmōn ep-ee-stay'-mone from G1987; intelligent:--endued with knowledge.
entries.1991: ἐπιστηρίζω E)PISTHRI/ZW epistērízō ep-ee-stay-rid'-zo from G1909 and G4741; to support further, i.e. reestablish:--confirm, strengthen.
entries.1992: ἐπιστολή E)PISTOLH/ epistolḗ ep-is-tol-ay' from G1989; a written message:--"epistle," letter.
entries.1993: ἐπιστομίζω E)PISTOMI/ZW epistomízō ep-ee-stom-id'-zo from G1909 and G4750; to put something over the mouth, i.e. (figuratively) to silence:--stop mouths.
entries.1994: ἐπιστρέφω E)PISTRE/FW epistréphō ep-ee-stref'-o from G1909 and G4762; to revert (literally, figuratively or morally):--come (go) again, convert, (re-)turn (about, again).
entries.1995: ἐπιστροφή E)PISTROFH/ epistrophḗ ep-is-trof-ay' from G1994; reversion, i.e. morally, revolution:--conversion.
entries.1996: ἐπισυνάγω E)PISUNA/GW episynágō ep-ee-soon-ag'-o from G1909 and G4863; to collect upon the same place:--gather (together).
entries.1997: ἐπισυναγωγή E)PISUNAGWGH/ episynagōgḗ ep-ee-soon-ag-o-gay' from G1996; a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for worship):--assembling (gathering) together.
entries.1998: ἐπισυντρέχω E)PISUNTRE/XW episyntréchō ep-ee-soon-trekh'-o from G1909 and G4936; to hasten together upon one place (or a particular occasion):--come running together.
entries.1999: ἐπισύστασις E)PISU/STASIS episýstasis ep-ee-soo'-stas-is from the middle voice of a compound of G1909 and G4921; a conspiracy, i.e. concourse (riotous or friendly):--that which cometh upon, + raising up.
entries.2000: ἐπισφαλής E)PISFALH/S episphalḗs ep-ee-sfal-ace' from a compound of G1909 and σφάλλω SFA/LLW sphállō (to trip); figuratively, insecure:--dangerous.
entries.2001: ἐπισχύω E)PISXU/W epischýō ep-is-khoo'-o from G1909 and G2480; to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist stoutly:--be the more fierce.
entries.2002: ἐπισωρεύω E)PISWREU/W episōreúō ep-ee-so-ryoo'-o from G1909 and G4987; to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally:--heap.
entries.2003: ἐπιταγή E)PITAGH/ epitagḗ ep-ee-tag-ay' from G2004; an injunction or decree; by implication, authoritativeness:--authority, commandment.
entries.2004: ἐπιτάσσω E)PITA/SSW epitássō ep-ee-tas'-so from G1909 and G5021; to arrange upon, i.e. order:--charge, command, injoin.
entries.2005: ἐπιτελέω E)PITELE/W epiteléō ep-ee-tel-eh'-o from G1909 and G5055; to fulfill further (or completely), i.e. execute; by implication, to terminate, undergo:--accomplish, do, finish, (make) (perfect), perform(X -ance).
entries.2006: ἐπιτήδειος E)PITH/DEIOS epitḗdeios ep-ee-tay'-di-os from ἐπιτηδές E)PITHDE/S epitēdés (enough); serviceable, i.e. (by implication) requisite:--things which are needful.
entries.2007: ἐπιτίθημι E)PITI/QHMI epitíthēmi ep-ee-tith'-ay-mee from G1909 and G5087; to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense):--add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound.
entries.2008: ἐπιτιμάω E)PITIMA/W epitimáō ep-ee-tee-mah'-o from G1909 and G5091; to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by implication, forbid:--(straitly) charge, rebuke.
entries.2009: ἐπιτιμία E)PITIMI/A epitimía ep-ee-tee-mee'-ah from a compound of G1909 and G5092; properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship; used (in the sense of G2008) of a penalty:--punishment.
entries.2010: ἐπιτρέπω E)PITRE/PW epitrépō ep-ee-trep'-o from G1909 and the base of G5157; to turn over (transfer), i.e. allow:--give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.
entries.2011: ἐπιτροπή E)PITROPH/ epitropḗ ep-ee-trop-ay' from G2010; permission, i.e. (by implication) full power:--commission.
entries.2012: ἐπίτροπος E)PI/TROPOS epítropos ep-it'-rop-os from G1909 and G5158 (in the sense of G2011); a commissioner, i.e. domestic manager, guardian:--steward, tutor.
entries.2013: ἐπιτυγχάνω E)PITUGXA/NW epitynchánō ep-ee-toong-khan'-o from G1909 and G5177; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to attain:--obtain.
entries.2014: ἐπιφαίνω E)PIFAI/NW epiphaínō ep-ee-fah'-ee-no from G1909 and G5316; to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or (figuratively) known:--appear, give light.
entries.2015: ἐπιφάνεια E)PIFA/NEIA epipháneia ep-if-an'-i-ah from G2016; a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ (past or future):--appearing, brightness.
entries.2016: ἐπιφανής E)PIFANH/S epiphanḗs ep-if-an-ace' from G2014; conspicuous, i.e. (figuratively) memorable:--notable.
entries.2017: ἐπιφαύω E)PIFAU/W epiphaúō ep-ee-fow'-o a form of G2014; to illuminate (figuratively):--give light.
entries.2018: ἐπιφέρω E)PIFE/RW epiphérō ep-ee-fer'-o from G1909 and G5342; to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce:--add, bring (against), take.
entries.2019: ἐπιφωνέω E)PIFWNE/W epiphōnéō ep-ee-fo-neh'-o from G1909 and G5455; to call at something, i.e. exclaim:--cry (against), give a shout.
entries.2020: ἐπιφώσκω E)PIFW/SKW epiphṓskō ep-ee-foce'-ko a form of G2017; to begin to grow light:--begin to dawn, X draw on.
entries.2021: ἐπιχειρέω E)PIXEIRE/W epicheiréō ep-ee-khi-reh'-o from G1909 and G5495; to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake:--go about, take in hand (upon).
entries.2022: ἐπιχέω E)PIXE/W epichéō ep-ee-kheh'-o from G1909 and χέω XE/W chéō (to pour); --to pour upon:--pour in.
entries.2023: ἐπιχορηγέω E)PIXORHGE/W epichorēgéō ep-ee-khor-ayg-eh'-o from G1909 and G5524; to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply, (figuratively) aid or contribute:--add, minister (nourishment, unto).
entries.2024: ἐπιχορηγία E)PIXORHGI/A epichorēgía ep-ee-khor-ayg-ee'-ah from G2023; contribution:--supply.
entries.2025: ἐπιχρίω E)PIXRI/W epichríō ep-ee-khree'-o from G1909 and G5548; to smear over:--anoint.
entries.2026: ἐποικοδομέω E)POIKODOME/W epoikodoméō ep-oy-kod-om-eh'-o from G1909 and G3618; to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear up:--build thereon (thereupon, on, upon).
entries.2027: ἐποκέλλω E)POKE/LLW epokéllō ep-ok-el'-lo from G1909 and ὀκέλλω O)KE/LLW okéllō (to urge); to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach a vessel:--run aground.
entries.2028: ἐπονομάζω E)PONOMA/ZW eponomázō ep-on-om-ad'-zo from G1909 and G3687; to name further, i.e. denominate:--call.
entries.2029: ἐποπτεύω E)POPTEU/W epopteúō ep-opt-yoo'-o from G1909 and a derivative of G3700; to inspect, i.e. watch:--behold.
entries.2030: ἐπόπτης E)PO/PTHS epóptēs ep-op'-tace from G1909 and a presumed derivative of G3700; a looker-on:--eye-witness.
entries.2031: ἔπος E)/POS épos ep'-os from G2036; a word:--X say.
entries.2032: ἐπουράνιος E)POURA/NIOS epouránios ep-oo-ran'-ee-os from G1909 and G3772; above the sky:--celestial, (in) heaven(-ly), high.
entries.2033: ἑπτά E(PTA/ heptá hep-tah' a primary number; seven:--seven.
entries.2034: ἑπτάκις E(PTA/KIS heptákis hep-tak-is' adverb from G2033; seven times:--seven times.
entries.2035: ἑπτακισχίλιοι E(PTAKISXI/LIOI heptakischílioi hep-tak-is-khil'-ee-oy from G2034 and G5507; seven times a thousand:--seven thousand.
entries.2036: ἔπω E)/PW épō ep'-o a primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from G2046, G4483, and G5346); to speak or say (by word or writing):--answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell. Compare G3004.
entries.2037: Ἔραστος *)/ERASTOS Érastos er'-as-tos from ἐράω E)RA/W eráō (to love); beloved; Erastus, a Christian:--Erastus.
entries.2038: ἐργάζομαι E)RGA/ZOMAI ergázomai er-gad'-zom-ahee middle voice from G2041; to toil (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by implication) effect, be engaged in or with, etc.:--commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work.
entries.2039: ἐργασία E)RGASI/A ergasía er-gas-ee'-ah from G2040; occupation; by implication, profit, pains:--craft, diligence, gain, work.
entries.2040: ἐργάτης E)RGA/THS ergátēs er-gat'-ace from G2041; a toiler; figuratively, a teacher:--labourer, worker(-men).
entries.2041: ἔργον E)/RGON érgon er'-gon from a primary (but obsolete) ἔργω E)/RGW érgō (to work); toil (as an effort or occupation); by implication, an act:--deed, doing, labour, work.
entries.2042: ἐρεθίζω E)REQI/ZW erethízō er-eth-id'-zo from a presumed prolonged form of G2054; to stimulate (especially to anger):--provoke.
entries.2043: ἐρείδω E)REI/DW ereídō er-i'-do of obscure affinity; to prop, i.e. (reflexively) get fast:--stick fast.
entries.2044: ἐρεύγομαι E)REU/GOMAI ereúgomai er-yoog'-om-ahee of uncertain affinity; to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak out:--utter.
entries.2045: ἐρευνάω E)REUNA/W ereunáō er-yoo-nah'-o apparently from G2046 (through the idea of inquiry); to seek, i.e. (figuratively) to investigate:--search.
entries.2046: ἐρέω E)RE/W eréō er-eh'-o probably a fuller form of G4483; an alternate for G2036 in certain tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say:--call, say, speak (of), tell.
entries.2047: ἐρημία E)RHMI/A erēmía er-ay-mee'-ah from G2048; solitude (concretely):--desert, wilderness.
entries.2048: ἔρημος E)/RHMOS érēmos er'-ay-mos of uncertain affinity; lonesome, i.e. (by implication) waste (usually as a noun, G5561 being implied):--desert, desolate, solitary, wilderness.
entries.2049: ἐρημόω E)RHMO/W erēmóō er-ay-mo'-o from G2048; to lay waste (literally or figuratively):--(bring to, make) desolate(-ion), come to nought.
entries.2050: ἐρήμωσις E)RH/MWSIS erḗmōsis er-ay'-mo-sis from G2049; despoliation:--desolation.
entries.2051: ἐρίζω E)RI/ZW erízō er-id'-zo from G2054; to wrangle:--strive.
entries.2052: ἐριθεία E)RIQEI/A eritheía er-ith-i'-ah perhaps as the same as G2042; properly, intrigue, i.e. (by implication) faction:--contention(-ious), strife.
entries.2053: ἔριον E)/RION érion er'-ee-on of obscure affinity; wool:--wool.
entries.2054: ἔρις E)/RIS éris er'-is of uncertain affinity; a quarrel, i.e. (by implication) wrangling:--contention, debate, strife, variance.
entries.2055: ἐρίφιον E)RI/FION eríphion er-if'-ee-on from G2056; a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person):--goat.
entries.2056: ἔριφος E)/RIFOS ériphos er'-if-os perhaps from the same as G2053 (through the idea of hairiness); a kid or (genitive case) goat:--goat, kid.
entries.2057: Ἑρμᾶς *(ERMA=S Hermâs her-mas' probably from G2060; Hermas, a Christian:--Hermas.
entries.2058: ἑρμηνεία E(RMHNEI/A hermēneía her-may-ni'-ah from the same as G2059; translation:--interpretation.
entries.2059: ἑρμηνεύω E(RMHNEU/W hermēneúō her-mayn-yoo'-o from a presumed derivative of G2060 (as the god of language); to translate:--interpret.
entries.2060: Ἑρμῆς *(ERMH=S Hermēs her-mace' perhaps from G2046; Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian:--Hermes, Mercury.
entries.2061: Ἑρμογένης *(ERMOGE/NHS Hermogénēs her-mog-en'-ace from G2060 and G1096; born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate Christian:--Hermogenes.
entries.2062: ἑρπετόν E(RPETO/N herpetón her-pet-on' neuter of a derivative of ἕρπω E(/RPW hérpō (to creep); a reptile, i.e. (by Hebraism (compare H07431)) a small animal:--creeping thing, serpent.
entries.2063: ἐρυθρός E)RUQRO/S erythrós er-oo-thros' of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with G2281) the Red Sea:--red.
entries.2064: ἔρχομαι E)/RXOMAI érchomai er'-khom-ahee middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred (middle voice) ἐλεύθομαι E)LEU/QOMAI eleúthomai el-yoo'-thom-ahee , or (active) ἔλθω E)/LQW élthō el'-tho , which do not otherwise occur); to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively):--accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set.
entries.2065: ἐρωτάω E)RWTA/W erōtáō er-o-tah'-o apparently from G2046 (compare G2045); to interrogate; by implication, to request:--ask, beseech, desire, intreat, pray. Compare G4441.
entries.2066: ἐσθής E)SQH/S esthḗs es-thace' from ἕννυμι E(/NNUMI hénnymi (to clothe); dress:--apparel, clothing, raiment, robe.
entries.2067: ἔσθησις E)/SQHSIS ésthēsis es'-thay-sis from a derivative of G2066; clothing (concretely):--government.
entries.2068: ἐσθίω E)SQI/W esthíō es-thee'-o strengthened for a primary ἔδω E)/DW édō (to eat); used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by G5315; to eat (usually literal):--devour, eat, live.
entries.2069: Ἐσλί *)ESLI/ Eslí es-lee' of Hebrew origin (probably for H0454); Esli, an Israelite:--Esli.
entries.2070: ἐσμέν E)SME/N esmén es-men' first person plural indicative of G1510; we are:--are, be, have our being, X have hope, + (the gospel) was (preached unto) us.
entries.2071: ἔσομαι E)/SOMAI ésomai es'-om-ahee future of G1510; will be:--shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn.
entries.2072: ἔσοπτρον E)/SOPTRON ésoptron es'-op-tron from G1519 and a presumed derivative of G3700; a mirror (for looking into):--glass. Compare G2734.
entries.2073: ἑσπέρα E(SPE/RA hespéra hes-per'-ah feminine of an adjective hesperos (evening); the eve (G5610 being implied) :--evening(-tide).
entries.2074: Ἐσρώμ *)ESRW/M Esrṓm es-rome of Hebrew origin (H02696); Esrom (i.e. Chetsron), an Israelite:--Esrom.
entries.2075: ἐστέ E)STE/ esté es-teh' second person plural present indicative of G1510; ye are:--be, have been, belong.
entries.2076: ἐστί E)STI/ estí es-tee' third person singular present indicative of G1510; he (she or it) is; also (with neuter plural) they are:--are, be(-long), call, X can(-not), come, consisteth, X dure for a while, + follow, X have, (that) is (to say), make, meaneth, X must needs, + profit, + remaineth, + wrestle.
entries.2077: ἔστω E)/STW éstō es'-to second person singular present imperative of G1510; be thou; also ἔστωσαν E)/STWSAN éstōsan es'-to-san , third person of the same; let them be:--be.
entries.2078: ἔσχατος E)/SXATOS éschatos es'-khat-os a superlative probably from G2192 (in the sense of contiguity); farthest, final (of place or time):--ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost.
entries.2079: ἐσχάτως E)SXA/TWS eschátōs es-khat'-oce adverb from G2078; finally, i.e. (with G2192) at the extremity of life:--point of death.
entries.2080: ἔσω E)/SW ésō es'-o from G1519; inside (as preposition or adjective):-- (with-)in(-ner, -to, -ward).
entries.2081: ἔσωθεν E)/SWQEN ésōthen es'-o-then from G2080; from inside; also used as equivalent to G2080 (inside):--inward(-ly), (from) within, without.
entries.2082: ἐσώτερος E)SW/TEROS esṓteros es-o'-ter-os comparative of G2080; interior:--inner, within.
entries.2083: ἑταῖρος E(TAI=ROS hetaîros het-ah'-ee-ros from ἔτης E)/THS étēs (a clansman); a comrade:--fellow, friend.
entries.2084: ἑτερόγλωσσος E(TERO/GLWSSOS heteróglōssos het-er-og'-loce-sos from G2087 and G1100; other- tongued, i.e. a foreigner:--man of other tongue.
entries.2085: ἑτεροδιδασκαλέω E(TERODIDASKALE/W heterodidaskaléō het-er-od-id-as-kal-eh'-o from G2087 and G1320; to instruct differently:--teach other doctrine(-wise).
entries.2086: ἑτεροζυγέω E(TEROZUGE/W heterozygéō het-er-od-zoog-eh'-o from a compound of G2087 and G2218; to yoke up differently, i.e. (figuratively) to associate discordantly:--unequally yoke together with.
entries.2087: ἕτερος E(/TEROS héteros het'-er-os of uncertain affinity; (an-, the) other or different:--altered, else, next (day), one, (an-)other, some, strange.
entries.2088: ἑτέρως E(TE/RWS hetérōs het-er'-oce adverb from G2087; differently:--otherwise.
entries.2089: ἔτι E)/TI éti et'-ee perhaps akin to G2094; "yet," still (of time or degree):--after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-)henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer, (any) more(-one), now, still, yet.
entries.2090: ἑτοιμάζω E(TOIMA/ZW hetoimázō het-oy-mad'-zo from G2092; to prepare:--prepare, provide, make ready. Compare G2680.
entries.2091: ἑτοιμασία E(TOIMASI/A hetoimasía het-oy-mas-ee'-ah from G2090; preparation:--preparation.
entries.2092: ἕτοιμος E(/TOIMOS hétoimos het-oy'-mos from an old noun ἐτεός E)TEO/S eteós (fitness); adjusted, i.e. ready:--prepared, (made) ready(-iness, to our hand).
entries.2093: ἑτοίμως E(TOI/MWS hetoímōs het'-oy-moce adverb from G2092; in readiness:--ready.
entries.2094: ἔτος E)/TOS étos et'-os apparently a primary word; a year:--year.
entries.2095: εὖ EU)= eû yoo neuter of a primary εὖς EU)=S eûs (good); (adverbially) well:--good, well (done).
entries.2096: Εὖα *EU)=A Eûa yoo'-ah of Hebrew origin (H02332); Eua (or Eva, i.e. Chavvah), the first woman:--Eve.
entries.2097: εὐαγγελίζω EU)AGGELI/ZW euangelízō yoo-ang-ghel-id'-zo from G2095 and G32; to announce good news ("evangelize") especially the gospel:--declare, bring (declare, show) glad (good) tidings, preach (the gospel).
entries.2098: εὐαγγέλιον EU)AGGE/LION euangélion yoo-ang-ghel'-ee-on from the same as G2097; a good message, i.e. the gospel:--gospel.
entries.2099: εὐαγγελιστής EU)AGGELISTH/S euangelistḗs yoo-ang-ghel-is-tace' from G2097; a preacher of the gospel:--evangelist.
entries.2100: εὐαρεστέω EU)ARESTE/W euarestéō yoo-ar-es-teh'-o from G2101; to gratify entirely:--please (well).
entries.2101: εὐάρεστος EU)A/RESTOS euárestos yoo-ar'-es-tos from G2095 and G701; fully agreeable:--acceptable(-ted), wellpleasing.
entries.2102: εὐαρέστως EU)ARE/STWS euaréstōs yoo-ar-es'-toce adverb from G2101; quite agreeably:--acceptably, + please well.
entries.2103: Εὔβουλος *EU)/BOULOS Eúboulos yoo'-boo-los from G2095 and G1014; good-willer; Eubulus, a Christian:--Eubulus.
entries.2104: εὐγενής EU)GENH/S eugenḗs yoog-en'-ace from G2095 and G1096; well born, i.e. (literally) high in rank, or (figuratively) generous:--more noble, nobleman.
entries.2105: εὐδία EU)DI/A eudía yoo-dee'-ah feminine from G2095 and the alternate of G2203 (as the god of the weather); a clear sky, i.e. fine weather:--fair weather.
entries.2106: εὐδοκέω EU)DOKE/W eudokéō yoo-dok-eh'-o from G2095 and G1380; to think well of, i.e. approve (an act); specially, to approbate (a person or thing):--think good, (be well) please(-d), be the good (have, take) pleasure, be willing.
entries.2107: εὐδοκία EU)DOKI/A eudokía yoo-dok-ee'-ah from a presumed compound of G2095 and the base of G1380; satisfaction, i.e. (subjectively) delight, or (objectively) kindness, wish, purpose:--desire, good pleasure (will), X seem good.
entries.2108: εὐεργεσία EU)ERGESI/A euergesía yoo-erg-es-ee'-ah from G2110; beneficence (genitive case or specially):--benefit, good deed done.
entries.2109: εὐεργετέω EU)ERGETE/W euergetéō yoo-erg-et-eh'-o from G2110; to be philanthropic:--do good.
entries.2110: εὐεργέτης EU)ERGE/THS euergétēs yoo-erg-et'-ace from G2095 and the base of G2041; a worker of good, i.e. (specially) a philanthropist:--benefactor.
entries.2111: εὔθετος EU)/QETOS eúthetos yoo'-thet-os from G2095 and a derivative of G5087; well placed, i.e. (figuratively) appropriate:--fit, meet.
entries.2112: εὐθέως EU)QE/WS euthéōs yoo-theh'-oce adverb from G2117; directly, i.e. at once or soon:--anon, as soon as, forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway.
