entries.2113: εὐθυδρομέω EU)QUDROME/W euthydroméō yoo-thoo-drom-eh'-o from G2117 and G1408; to lay a straight course, i.e. sail direct:--(come) with a straight course.
entries.2114: εὐθυμέω EU)QUME/W euthyméō yoo-thoo-meh'-o from G2115; to cheer up, i.e. (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter comparative (adverbially) more cheerfully:--be of good cheer (merry).
entries.2115: εὔθυμος EU)/QUMOS eúthymos yoo'-thoo-mos from G2095 and G2372; in fine spirits, i.e. cheerful:--of good cheer, the more cheerfully.
entries.2116: εὐθύνω EU)QU/NW euthýnō yoo-thoo'-no from G2117; to straighten (level); technically, to steer:--governor, make straight.
entries.2117: εὐθύς EU)QU/S euthýs yoo-thoos' perhaps from G2095 and G5087; straight, i.e. (literally) level, or (figuratively) true; adverbially (of time) at once:--anon, by and by, forthwith, immediately, straightway.
entries.2118: εὐθύτης EU)QU/THS euthýtēs yoo-thoo'-tace from G2117; rectitude:--righteousness.
entries.2119: εὐκαιρέω EU)KAIRE/W eukairéō yoo-kahee-reh'-o from G2121; to have good time, i.e. opportunity or leisure:--have leisure (convenient time), spend time.
entries.2120: εὐκαιρία EU)KAIRI/A eukairía yoo-kahee-ree'-ah from G2121; a favorable occasion:--opportunity.
entries.2121: εὔκαιρος EU)/KAIROS eúkairos yoo'-kahee-ros from G2095 and G2540; well-timed, i.e. opportune:--convenient, in time of need.
entries.2122: εὐκαίρως EU)KAI/RWS eukaírōs yoo-kah'-ee-roce adverb from G2121; opportunely:--conveniently, in season.
entries.2123: εὐκοπώτερος EU)KOPW/TEROS eukopṓteros yoo-kop-o'-ter-os comparative of a compound of G2095 and G2873; better for toil, i.e. more facile:--easier.
entries.2124: εὐλάβεια EU)LA/BEIA eulábeia yoo-lab'-i-ah from G2126; properly, caution, i.e. (religiously) reverence (piety); by implication, dread (concretely):--fear(-ed).
entries.2125: εὐλαβέομαι EU)LABE/OMAI eulabéomai yoo-lab-eh'-om-ahee middle voice from G2126; to be circumspect, i.e. (by implication) to be apprehensive; religiously, to reverence:--(moved with) fear.
entries.2126: εὐλαβής EU)LABH/S eulabḗs yoo-lab-ace' from G2095 and G2983; taking well (carefully), i.e. circumspect (religiously, pious):--devout.
entries.2127: εὐλογέω EU)LOGE/W eulogéō yoo-log-eh'-o from a compound of G2095 and G3056; to speak well of, i.e. (religiously) to bless (thank or invoke a benediction upon, prosper):--bless, praise.
entries.2128: εὐλογητός EU)LOGHTO/S eulogētós yoo-log-ay-tos' from G2127; adorable:--blessed.
entries.2129: εὐλογία EU)LOGI/A eulogía yoo-log-ee'-ah from the same as G2127; fine speaking, i.e. elegance of language; commendation ("eulogy"), i.e. (reverentially) adoration; religiously, benediction; by implication, consecration; by extension, benefit or largess:--blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech.
entries.2130: εὐμετάδοτος EU)META/DOTOS eumetádotos yoo-met-ad'-ot-os from G2095 and a presumed derivative of G3330; good at imparting, i.e. liberal:--ready to distribute.
entries.2131: Εὐνίκη *EU)NI/KH Euníkē yoo-nee'-kay from G2095 and G3529; victorious; Eunice, a Jewess:--Eunice.
entries.2132: εὐνοέω EU)NOE/W eunoéō yoo-no-eh'-o from a compound of G2095 and G3563; to be well- minded, i.e. reconcile:--agree.
entries.2133: εὔνοια EU)/NOIA eúnoia yoo'-noy-ah from the same as G2132; kindness; euphemistically, conjugal duty:--benevolence, good will.
entries.2134: εὐνουχίζω EU)NOUXI/ZW eunouchízō yoo-noo-khid'-zo from G2135; to castrate (figuratively, live unmarried):--make…eunuch.
entries.2135: εὐνοῦχος EU)NOU=XOS eunoûchos yoo-noo'-khos from εὐνή EU)NH/ eunḗ (a bed) and G2192; a castrated person (such being employed in Oriental bed-chambers); by extension an impotent or unmarried man; by implication, a chamberlain (state-officer):--eunuch.
entries.2136: Εὐοδία *EU)ODI/A Euodía yoo-od-ee'-ah from the same as G2137; fine travelling; Euodia, a Christian woman:--Euodias.
entries.2137: εὐοδόω EU)ODO/W euodóō yoo-od-o'-o from a compound of G2095 and G3598; to help on the road, i.e. (passively) succeed in reaching; figuratively, to succeed in business affairs:--(have a) prosper(-ous journey).
entries.2138: εὐπειθής EU)PEIQH/S eupeithḗs yoo-pi-thace' from G2095 and G3982; good for persuasion, i.e. (intransitively) complaint:--easy to be intreated.
entries.2139: εὐπερίστατος EU)PERI/STATOS euperístatos yoo-per-is'-tat-os from G2095 and a derivative of a presumed compound of G4012 and G2476; well standing around, i.e. (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every direction (figuratively, of sin in genitive case):--which doth so easily beset.
entries.2140: εὐποιΐα EU)POII/+A eupoiḯa yoo-poy-ee'-ah from a compound of G2095 and G4160; well-doing, i.e. beneficence:--to do good.
entries.2141: εὐπορέω EU)PORE/W euporéō yoo-por-eh'-o from a compound of G2090 and the base of G4197; (intransitively) to be good for passing through, i.e. (figuratively) have pecuniary means:--ability.
entries.2142: εὐπορία EU)PORI/A euporía yoo-por-ee'-ah from the same as G2141; pecuniary resources:--wealth.
entries.2143: εὐπρέπεια EU)PRE/PEIA euprépeia yoo-prep'-i-ah from a compound of G2095 and G4241; good suitableness, i.e. gracefulness:--grace.
entries.2144: εὐπρόσδεκτος EU)PRO/SDEKTOS euprósdektos yoo-pros'-dek-tos from G2095 and a derivative of G4327; well-received, i.e. approved, favorable:--acceptable(-ted).
entries.2145: εὐπρόσεδρος EU)PRO/SEDROS euprósedros yoo-pros'-ed-ros from G2095 and the same as G4332; sitting well towards, i.e. (figuratively) assiduous (neuter, diligent service):--X attend upon.
entries.2146: εὐπροσωπέω EU)PROSWPE/W euprosōpéō yoo-pros-o-peh'-o from a compound of G2095 and G4383; to be of good countenance, i.e. (figuratively) to make a display:--make a fair show.
entries.2147: εὑρίσκω EU(RI/SKW heurískō hyoo-ris'-ko , a prolonged form of a primary εὕρω EU(/RW heúrō hyoo'-ro , which (together with another cognate form) εὑρέω EU(RE/W heuréō hyoo-reh'-o is used for it in all the tenses except the present and imperfect; to find (literally or figuratively):--find, get, obtain, perceive, see.
entries.2148: Εὐροκλύδων *EU)ROKLU/DWN Euroklýdōn yoo-rok-loo'-dohn from Εὖρος *EU)=ROS Eûros (the east wind) and G2830; a storm from the East (or southeast), i.e. (in modern phrase) a Levanter:--Euroklydon.
entries.2149: εὐρύχωρος EU)RU/XWROS eurýchōros yoo-roo'-kho-ros from εὐρύς EU)RU/S eurýs (wide) and G5561; spacious:--broad.
entries.2150: εὐσέβεια EU)SE/BEIA eusébeia yoo-seb'-i-ah from G2152; piety; specially, the gospel scheme:--godliness, holiness.
entries.2151: εὐσεβέω EU)SEBE/W eusebéō yoo-seb-eh'-o from G2152; to be pious, i.e. (towards God) to worship, or (towards parents) to respect (support):--show piety, worship.
entries.2152: εὐσεβής EU)SEBH/S eusebḗs yoo-seb-ace' from G2095 and G4576; well-reverent, i.e. pious:--devout, godly.
entries.2153: εὐσεβῶς EU)SEBW=S eusebōs yoo-seb-oce' adverb from G2152; piously:--godly.
entries.2154: εὔσημος EU)/SHMOS eúsēmos yoo'-say-mos from G2095 and the base of G4591; well indicated, i.e. (figuratively) significant:--easy to be understood.
entries.2155: εὔσπλαγχνος EU)/SPLAGXNOS eúsplanchnos yoo'-splangkh-nos from G2095 and G4698; well compassioned, i.e. sympathetic:--pitiful, tender-hearted.
entries.2156: εὐσχημόνως EU)SXHMO/NWS euschēmónōs yoo-skhay-mon'-ose adverb from G2158; decorously:--decently, honestly.
entries.2157: εὐσχημοσύνη EU)SXHMOSU/NH euschēmosýnē yoo-skhay-mos-oo'-nay from G2158; decorousness:--comeliness.
entries.2158: εὐσχήμων EU)SXH/MWN euschḗmōn yoo-skhay'-mone from G2095 and G4976; well-formed, i.e. (figuratively) decorous, noble (in rank):--comely, honourable.
entries.2159: εὐτόνως EU)TO/NWS eutónōs yoo-ton'-oce adverb from a compound of G2095 and a derivative of τείνω TEI/NW teínō (to stretch); in a well-strung manner, i.e. (figuratively) intensely (in a good sense, cogently; in a bad one, fiercely):--mightily, vehemently.
entries.2160: εὐτραπελία EU)TRAPELI/A eutrapelía yoo-trap-el-ee'-ah from a compound of G2095 and a derivative of the base of G5157 (meaning well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose); witticism, i.e. (in a vulgar sense) ribaldry:--jesting.
entries.2161: Εὔτυχος *EU)/TUXOS Eútychos yoo'-too-khos from G2095 and a derivative of G5177; well- fated, i.e. fortunate; Eutychus, a young man:--Eutychus.
entries.2162: εὐφημία EU)FHMI/A euphēmía yoo-fay-mee'-ah from G2163; good language ("euphemy"), i.e. praise (repute):--good report.
entries.2163: εὔφημος EU)/FHMOS eúphēmos yoo'-fay-mos from G2095 and G5345; well spoken of, i.e. reputable:--of good report.
entries.2164: εὐφορέω EU)FORE/W euphoréō yoo-for-eh'-o from G2095 and G5409; to bear well, i.e. be fertile:--bring forth abundantly.
entries.2165: εὐφραίνω EU)FRAI/NW euphraínō yoo-frah'-ee-no from G2095 and G5424; to put (middle voice or passively, be) in a good frame of mind, i.e. rejoice:--fare, make glad, be (make) merry, rejoice.
entries.2166: Εὐφράτης *EU)FRA/THS Euphrátēs yoo-frat'-ace of foreign origin (compare H06578); Euphrates, a river of Asia:--Euphrates.
entries.2167: εὐφροσύνη EU)FROSU/NH euphrosýnē yoo-fros-oo'-nay from the same as G2165; joyfulness:--gladness, joy.
entries.2168: εὐχαριστέω EU)XARISTE/W eucharistéō yoo-khar-is-teh'-o from G2170; to be grateful, i.e. (actively) to express gratitude (towards); specially, to say grace at a meal:--(give) thank(-ful, -s).
entries.2169: εὐχαριστία EU)XARISTI/A eucharistía yoo-khar-is-tee'-ah from G2170; gratitude; actively, grateful language (to God, as an act of worship):--thankfulness, (giving of) thanks(-giving).
entries.2170: εὐχάριστος EU)XA/RISTOS eucháristos yoo-khar'-is-tos from G2095 and a derivative of G5483; well favored, i.e. (by implication) grateful:--thankful.
entries.2171: εὐχή EU)XH/ euchḗ yoo-khay' from G2172; properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation:--prayer, vow.
entries.2172: εὔχομαι EU)/XOMAI eúchomai yoo'-khom-ahee middle voice of a primary verb; to wish; by implication, to pray to God:--pray, will, wish.
entries.2173: εὔχρηστος EU)/XRHSTOS eúchrēstos yoo'-khrays-tos from G2095 and G5543; easily used, i.e. useful:--profitable, meet for use.
entries.2174: εὐψυχέω EU)YUXE/W eupsychéō yoo-psoo-kheh'-o from a compound of G2095 and G5590; to be in good spirits, i.e. feel encouraged:--be of good comfort.
entries.2175: εὐωδία EU)WDI/A euōdía yoo-o-dee'-ah from a compound of G2095 and a derivative of G3605; good-scentedness, i.e. fragrance:--sweet savour (smell, -smelling).
entries.2176: εὐώνυμος EU)W/NUMOS euṓnymos yoo-o'-noo-mos from G2095 and G3686; properly, well-named (good-omened), i.e. the left (which was the lucky side among the pagan Greeks); neuter as adverbial, at the left hand:--(on the) left.
entries.2177: ἐφάλλομαι E)FA/LLOMAI ephállomai ef-al'-lom-ahee from G1909 and G242; to spring upon:--leap on.
entries.2178: ἐφάπαξ E)FA/PAC ephápax ef-ap'-ax from G1909 and G530; upon one occasion (only):--(at) once (for all).
entries.2179: Ἐφεσῖνος *)EFESI=NOS Ephesînos ef-es-ee'-nos from G2181; Ephesine, or situated at Ephesus:--of Ephesus.
entries.2180: Ἐφέσιος *)EFE/SIOS Ephésios ef-es'-ee-os from G2181; an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus:--Ephesian, of Ephesus.
entries.2181: Ἔφεσος *)/EFESOS Éphesos ef'-es-os probably of foreign origin; Ephesus, a city of Asia Minor:--Ephesus.
entries.2182: ἐφευρετής E)FEURETH/S epheuretḗs ef-yoo-ret'-ace from a compound of G1909 and G2147; a discoverer, i.e. contriver:--inventor.
entries.2183: ἐφημερία E)FHMERI/A ephēmería ef-ay-mer-ee'-ah from G2184; diurnality, i.e. (specially) the quotidian rotation or class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by families:--course.
entries.2184: ἐφήμερος E)FH/MEROS ephḗmeros ef-ay'-mer-os from G1909 and G2250; for a day ("ephemeral"), i.e. diurnal:--daily.
entries.2185: ἐφικνέομαι E)FIKNE/OMAI ephiknéomai ef-ik-neh'-om-ahee from G1909 and a cognate of G2240; to arrive upon, i.e. extend to:--reach.
entries.2186: ἐφίστημι E)FI/STHMI ephístēmi ef-is'-tay-mee from G1909 and G2476; to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal); --assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, over).
entries.2187: Ἐφραίμ *)EFRAI/M Ephraím ef-rah-im' of Hebrew origin (H0669 or better H06085); Ephraim, a place in Palestine:--Ephraim.
entries.2188: ἐφφαθά E)FFAQA/ ephphathá ef-fath-ah' of Chaldee origin (H06606); be opened!:--Ephphatha.
entries.2189: ἔχθρα E)/XQRA échthra ekh'-thrah feminine of G2190; hostility; by implication, a reason for opposition:--enmity, hatred.
entries.2190: ἐχθρός E)XQRO/S echthrós ech-thros' from a primary ἔχθω E)/XQW échthō (to hate); hateful (passively, odious, or actively, hostile); usually as a noun, an adversary (especially Satan):--enemy, foe.
entries.2191: ἔχιδνα E)/XIDNA échidna ekh'-id-nah of uncertain origin; an adder or other poisonous snake (literally or figuratively):--viper.
entries.2192: ἔχω E)/XW échō ekh'-o , including an alternate form σχέω SXE/W schéō skheh'-o ; (used in certain tenses only) a primary verb; to hold (used in very various applications, literally or figuratively, direct or remote; such as possession; ability, contiuity, relation, or condition):--be (able, X hold, possessed with), accompany, + begin to amend, can(+ -not), X conceive, count, diseased, do + eat, + enjoy, + fear, following, have, hold, keep, + lack, + go to law, lie, + must needs, + of necessity, + need, next, + recover, + reign, + rest, + return, X sick, take for, + tremble, + uncircumcised, use.
entries.2193: ἕως E(/WS héōs heh'-oce of uncertain affinity; a conjunction, preposition and adverb of continuance, until (of time and place):--even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-)til(-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while(-s).
entries.2194: Ζαβουλών *ZABOULW/N Zaboulṓn dzab-oo-lone' of Hebrew origin (H02074); Zabulon (i.e. Zebulon), a region of Palestine:--Zabulon.
entries.2195: Ζακχαῖος *ZAKXAI=OS Zakchaîos dzak-chah'-ee-yos of Hebrew origin (compare H02140); Zacchæus, an Israelite:--Zacchæus.
entries.2196: Ζαρά *ZARA/ Zará dzar-ah' of Hebrew origin (H02226); Zara, (i.e. Zerach), an Israelite:--Zara.
entries.2197: Ζαχαρίας *ZAXARI/AS Zacharías dzakh-ar-ee'-as of Hebrew origin (H02148); Zacharias (i.e. Zechariah), the name of two Israelites:--Zacharias.
entries.2198: ζάω ZA/W záō dzah'-o a primary verb; to live (literally or figuratively):--life(-time), (a-)live(-ly), quick.
entries.2199: Ζεβεδαῖος *ZEBEDAI=OS Zebedaîos dzeb-ed-ah'-yos of Hebrew origin (compare H02067); Zebedæus, an Israelite:--Zebedee.
entries.2200: ζεστός ZESTO/S zestós dzes-tos' from G2204; boiled, i.e. (by implication) calid (figuratively, fervent):--hot.
entries.2201: ζεῦγος ZEU=GOS zeûgos dzyoo'-gos from the same as G2218; a couple, i.e. a team (of oxen yoked together) or brace (of birds tied together):--yoke, pair.
entries.2202: ζευκτηρία ZEUKTHRI/A zeuktēría dzook-tay-ree'-ah feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as G2218; a fastening (tiller-rope):--band.
entries.2203: Ζεύς *ZEU/S Zeús dzyooce of uncertain affinity; in the oblique cases there is used instead of it a (probably cognate) name Δίς *DI/S Dís deece , which is otherwise obsolete; Zeus or Dis (among the Latins, Jupiter or Jove), the supreme deity of the Greeks:--Jupiter.
entries.2204: ζέω ZE/W zéō dzeh'-o a primary verb; to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e. (figuratively) be fervid (earnest):--be fervent.
entries.2205: ζῆλος ZH=LOS zēlos dzay'-los from G2204; properly, heat, i.e. (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband (figuratively, of God), or an enemy, malice):--emulation, envy(-ing), fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal.
entries.2206: ζηλόω ZHLO/W zēlóō dzay-lo'-o from G2205; to have warmth of feeling for or against:--affect, covet (earnestly), (have) desire, (move with) envy, be jealous over, (be) zealous(-ly affect).
entries.2207: ζηλωτής ZHLWTH/S zēlōtḗs dzay-lo-tace' from G2206; a "zealot":--zealous.
entries.2208: Ζηλωτής *ZHLWTH/S Zēlōtḗs dzay-lo-tace' the same as G2207; a Zealot, i.e. (specially) partisan for Jewish political independence:--Zelotes.
entries.2209: ζημία ZHMI/A zēmía dzay-mee'-ah probably akin to the base of G1150 (through the idea of violence); detriment:--damage, loss.
entries.2210: ζημιόω ZHMIO/W zēmióō dzay-mee-o'-o from G2209; to injure, i.e. (reflexively or passively) to experience detriment:--be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss.
entries.2211: Ζηνᾶς *ZHNA=S Zēnâs dzay-nas' probably contracted from a poetic form of G2203 and G1435; Jove-given; Zenas, a Christian:--Zenas.
entries.2212: ζητέω ZHTE/W zētéō dzay-teh'-o of uncertain affinity; to seek (literally or figuratively); specially, (by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against life):--be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means). Compare G4441.
entries.2213: ζήτημα ZH/THMA zḗtēma dzay'-tay-mah from G2212; a search (properly concretely), i.e. (in words) a debate:--question.
entries.2214: ζήτησις ZH/THSIS zḗtēsis dzay'-tay-sis from G2212; a searching (properly, the act), i.e. a dispute or its theme:--question.
entries.2215: ζιζάνιον ZIZA/NION zizánion dziz-an'-ee-on of uncertain origin; darnel or false grain:--tares.
entries.2216: Ζοροβάβελ *ZOROBA/BEL Zorobábel dzor-ob-ab'-el of Hebrew origin (H02216); Zorobabel (i.e. Zerubbabel), an Israelite:--Zorobabel.
entries.2217: ζόφος ZO/FOS zóphos dzof'-os akin to the base of G3509; gloom (as shrouding like a cloud):--blackness, darkness, mist.
entries.2218: ζυγός ZUGO/S zygós dzoo-gos' from the root of ζεύγνυμι ZEU/GNUMI zeúgnymi (to join, especially by a "yoke"); a coupling, i.e. (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also (literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales):--pair of balances, yoke.
entries.2219: ζύμη ZU/MH zýmē dzoo'-may probably from G2204; ferment (as if boiling up):--leaven.
entries.2220: ζυμόω ZUMO/W zymóō dzoo-mo'-o from G2219; to cause to ferment:--leaven.
entries.2221: ζωγρέω ZWGRE/W zōgréō dzogue-reh'-o from the same as G2226 and G64; to take alive (make a prisoner of war), i.e. (figuratively) to capture or ensnare:--take captive, catch.
entries.2222: ζωή ZWH/ zōḗ dzo-ay' from G2198; life (literally or figuratively):--life(-time). Compare G5590.
entries.2223: ζώνη ZW/NH zṓnē dzo'-nay probably akin to the base of G2218; a belt; by implication, a pocket:--girdle, purse.
entries.2224: ζώννυμι ZW/NNUMI zṓnnymi dzone'-noo-mi from G2223; to bind about (especially with a belt):--gird.
entries.2225: ζωογονέω ZWOGONE/W zōogonéō dzo-og-on-eh'-o from the same as G2226 and a derivative of G1096; to engender alive, i.e. (by analogy) to rescue (passively, be saved) from death:--live, preserve.
entries.2226: ζῶον ZW=ON zōon dzo'-on neuter of a derivative of G2198; a live thing, i.e. an animal:--beast.
entries.2227: ζωοποιέω ZWOPOIE/W zōopoiéō dzo-op-oy-eh'-o from the same as G2226 and G4160; to (re-)vitalize (literally or figuratively):--make alive, give life, quicken.
entries.2228: ἤ H)/ ḗ ay a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms; disjunctive, or; comparative, than:--and, but (either), (n-)either, except it be, (n-)or (else), rather, save, than, that, what, yea. Often used in connection with other particles. Compare especially G2235, G2260, G2273.
entries.2229: ἦ H)= ē ay an adverb of confirmation; perhaps intensive of G2228; used only (in the New Testament) before G3303; assuredly:--surely.
entries.2230: ἡγεμονεύω H(GEMONEU/W hēgemoneúō hayg-em-on-yoo'-o from G2232; to act as ruler:--be governor.
entries.2231: ἡγεμονία H(GEMONI/A hēgemonía hayg-em-on-ee'-ah from G2232; government, i.e. (in time) official term:--reign.
entries.2232: ἡγεμών H(GEMW/N hēgemṓn hayg-em-ohn' from G2233; a leader, i.e. chief person (or figuratively, place) of a province:--governor, prince, ruler.
entries.2233: ἡγέομαι H(GE/OMAI hēgéomai hayg-eh'-om-ahee middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of G71; to lead, i.e. command (with official authority); figuratively, to deem, i.e. consider:--account, (be) chief, count, esteem, governor, judge, have the rule over, suppose, think.
entries.2234: ἡδέως H(DE/WS hēdéōs hay-deh'-oce adverb from a derivative of the base of G2237; sweetly, i.e. (figuratively) with pleasure:--gladly.
entries.2235: ἤδη H)/DH ḗdē ay'-day apparently from G2228 (or possibly G2229) and G1211; even now:--already, (even) now (already), by this time.
entries.2236: ἥδιστα H(/DISTA hḗdista hay'-dis-tah neuter plural of the superlative of the same as G2234; with great pleasure:--most (very) gladly.
entries.2237: ἡδονή H(DONH/ hēdonḗ hay-don-ay' from ἁνδάνω A(NDA/NW handánō (to please); sensual delight; by implication, desire:--lust, pleasure.
entries.2238: ἡδύοσμον H(DU/OSMON hēdýosmon hay-doo'-os-mon neuter of the compound of the same as G2234 and G3744; a sweet-scented plant, i.e. mint:--mint.
entries.2239: ἦθος H)=QOS ēthos ay'-thos a strengthened form of G1485; usage, i.e. (plural) moral habits:--manners.
entries.2240: ἥκω H(/KW hḗkō hay'-ko a primary verb; to arrive, i.e. be present (literally or figuratively):--come.
entries.2241: ἠλί H)LI/ ēlí ay-lee' of Hebrew origin (H0410 with pronominal suffix); my God:-- Eli.
entries.2242: Ἡλί *(HLI/ Hēlí hay-lee' of Hebrew origin (H05941); Heli (i.e. Eli), an Israelite:--Heli.
entries.2243: Ἡλίας *(HLI/AS Hēlías hay-lee'-as of Hebrew origin (H0452); Helias (i.e. Elijah), an Israelite:--Elias.
entries.2244: ἡλικία H(LIKI/A hēlikía hay-lik-ee'-ah from the same as G2245; maturity (in years or size):--age, stature.
entries.2245: ἡλίκος H(LI/KOS hēlíkos hay-lee'-kos from ἧλιξ H(=LIC hēlix (a comrade, i.e. one of the same age); as big as, i.e. (interjectively) how much:--how (what) great.
entries.2246: ἥλιος H(/LIOS hḗlios hay'-lee-os from ἕλη E(/LH hélē (a ray; perhaps akin to the alternate of G138); the sun; by implication, light:--+ east, sun.
entries.2247: ἧλος H(=LOS hēlos hay'-los of uncertain affinity; a stud, i.e. spike:--nail.
entries.2248: ἡμᾶς H(MA=S hēmâs hay-mas' accusative case plural of G1473; us:--our, us, we.
entries.2249: ἡμεῖς H(MEI=S hēmeîs hay-mice' nominative plural of G1473; we (only used when emphatic):--us, we (ourselves).
entries.2250: ἡμέρα H(ME/RA hēméra hay-mer'-ah feminine (with G5610 implied) of a derivative of ἧμαι H(=MAI hēmai (to sit; akin to the base of G1476) meaning tame, i.e. gentle; day, i.e. (literally) the time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less clearly by the context):--age, + alway, (mid-)day (by day, (-ly)), + for ever, judgment, (day) time, while, years.
entries.2251: ἡμέτερος H(ME/TEROS hēméteros hay-met'-er-os from G2349; our:--our, your (by a different reading).
entries.2252: ἤμην H)/MHN ḗmēn ay'-mane a prolonged form of G2258; I was:--be, was. (Sometimes unexpressed).
entries.2253: ἡμιθανής H(MIQANH/S hēmithanḗs hay-mee-than-ace' from a presumed compound of the base of G2255 and G2348; half dead, i.e. entirely exhausted:--half dead.
entries.2254: ἡμῖν H(MI=N hēmîn hay-meen' dative case plural of G1473; to (or for, with, by) us:--our, (for) us, we.
entries.2255: ἥμισυ H(/MISU hḗmisy hay'-mee-soo neuter of a derivative from an inseparable prefix akin to G260 (through the idea of partition involved in connection) and meaning semi-; (as noun) half:--half.
entries.2256: ἡμιώριον H(MIW/RION hēmiṓrion hay-mee-o'-ree-on from the base of G2255 and G5610; a half-hour:--half an hour.
entries.2257: ἡμῶν H(MW=N hēmōn hay-mone' genitive case plural of G1473; of (or from) us:--our (company), us, we.
entries.2258: ἦν H)=N ēn ane imperfect of G1510; I (thou, etc.) was (wast or were):--+ agree, be, X have (+ charge of), hold, use, was(-t), were.
entries.2259: ἡνίκα H(NI/KA hēníka hay-nee'-kah of uncertain affinity; at which time:--when.
entries.2260: ἤπερ H)/PER ḗper ay'-per from G2228 and G4007; than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed):--than.
entries.2261: ἤπιος H)/PIOS ḗpios ay'-pee-os probably from G2031; properly, affable, i.e. mild or kind:--gentle.
entries.2262: Ἤρ *)/HR Ḗr ayr of Hebrew origin (H06147); Er, an Israelite:--Er.
entries.2263: ἤρεμος H)/REMOS ḗremos ay'-rem-os perhaps by transposition from G2048 (through the idea of stillness); tranquil:--quiet.
entries.2264: Ἡρώδης *(HRW/DHS Hērṓdēs hay-ro'-dace compound of ἥρως H(/RWS hḗrōs (a "hero") and G1491; heroic; Herod, the name of four Jewish kings:--Herod.
entries.2265: Ἡρωδιανοί *(HRWDIANOI/ Hērōdianoí hay-ro-dee-an-oy' plural of a derivative of G2264; Herodians, i.e. partisans of Herod:--Herodians.
entries.2266: Ἡρωδιάς *(HRWDIA/S Hērōdiás hay-ro-dee-as' from G2264; Herodias, a woman of the Heodian family:--Herodias.
entries.2267: Ἡρωδίων *(HRWDI/WN Hērōdíōn hay-ro-dee'-ohn from G2264; Herodion, a Christian:--Herodion.
entries.2268: Ἡσαΐας *(HSAI/+AS Hēsaḯas hay-sah-ee'-as of Hebrew origin (H03470); Hesaias (i.e. Jeshajah), an Israelite:--Esaias.
entries.2269: Ἠσαῦ *)HSAU= Ēsaû ay-sow' of Hebrew origin (H06215); Esau, an Edomite:--Esau.
entries.2270: ἡσυχάζω H(SUXA/ZW hēsycházō hay-soo-khad'-zo from the same as G2272; to keep still (intransitively), i.e. refrain from labor, meddlesomeness or speech:--cease, hold peace, be quiet, rest.
entries.2271: ἡσυχία H(SUXI/A hēsychía hay-soo-khee'-ah feminine of G2272; (as noun) stillness, i.e. desistance from bustle or language:--quietness, silence.
entries.2272: ἡσύχιος H(SU/XIOS hēsýchios hay-soo'-khee-os a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of G1476 and perhaps G2192; properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e. (by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing):--peaceable, quiet.
entries.2273: ἤτοι H)/TOI ḗtoi ay'-toy from G2228 and G5104; either indeed:--whether.
entries.2274: ἡττάω H(TTA/W hēttáō hayt-tah'-o from the same as G2276; to make worse, i.e. vanquish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to rate lower:--be inferior, overcome.
entries.2275: ἥττημα H(/TTHMA hḗttēma hayt'-tay-mah from G2274; a deterioration, i.e. (objectively) failure or (subjectively) loss:--diminishing, fault.
entries.2276: ἥττον H(/TTON hḗtton hate'-ton neuter of comparative of ἧκα H(=KA hēka (slightly) used for that of G2556; worse (as noun); by implication, less (as adverb):--less, worse.
entries.2277: ἤτω H)/TW ḗtō ay'-to third person singular imperative of G1510; let him (or it) be:--let … be.
entries.2278: ἠχέω H)XE/W ēchéō ay-kheh'-o from G2279; to make a loud noise, i.e. reverberate:--roar, sound.
entries.2279: ἦχος H)=XOS ēchos ay'-khos of uncertain affinity; a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e. roar; figuratively, a rumor:--fame, sound.
entries.2280: Θαδδαῖος *QADDAI=OS Thaddaîos thad-dah'-yos of uncertain origin; Thaddæus, one of the Apostles:--Thaddæus.
entries.2281: θάλασσα QA/LASSA thálassa thal'-as-sah probably prolonged from G251; the sea (genitive case or specially):--sea.
entries.2282: θάλπω QA/LPW thálpō thal'-po probably akin to θάλλω QA/LLW thállō (to warm); to brood, i.e. (figuratively) to foster:--cherish.
entries.2283: Θάμαρ *QA/MAR Thámar tham'-ar of Hebrew origin (H08559); Thamar (i.e. Tamar), an Israelitess:--Thamar.
entries.2284: θαμβέω QAMBE/W thambéō tham-beh'-o from G2285; to stupefy (with surprise), i.e. astound:--amaze, astonish.
entries.2285: θάμβος QA/MBOS thámbos tham'-bos akin to an obsolete τάφω TA/FW táphō (to dumbfound); stupefaction (by surprise), i.e. astonishment:--X amazed, + astonished, wonder.
entries.2286: θανάσιμος QANA/SIMOS thanásimos than-as'-ee-mos from G2288; fatal, i.e. poisonous:--deadly.
entries.2287: θανατήφορος QANATH/FOROS thanatḗphoros than-at-ay'-for-os from (the feminine form of) G2288 and G5342; death-bearing, i.e. fatal:--deadly.
entries.2288: θάνατος QA/NATOS thánatos than'-at-os from G2348; (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively):--X deadly, (be…) death.
entries.2289: θανατόω QANATO/W thanatóō than-at-o'-o from G2288 to kill (literally or figuratively) :--become dead, (cause to be) put to death, kill, mortify.
entries.2290: θάπτω QA/PTW tháptō thap'-to a primary verb; to celebrate funeral rites, i.e. inter:--bury.
entries.2291: Θάρα *QA/RA Thára thar'-ah of Hebrew origin (H08646); Thara (i.e. Terach), the father of Abraham:--Thara.
entries.2292: θαῤῥέω QAR)R(E/W tharrhéō thar-hreh'-o another form for G2293; to exercise courage:--be bold, X boldly, have confidence, be confident. Compare G5111.
entries.2293: θαρσέω QARSE/W tharséō thar-seh'-o from G2294; to have courage:--be of good cheer (comfort). Compare G2292.
entries.2294: θάρσος QA/RSOS thársos thar'-sos akin (by transposition) to θράσος QRA/SOS thrásos (daring); boldness (subjectively):--courage.
entries.2295: θαῦμα QAU=MA thaûma thos'-mah apparently from a form of G2300; wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract):--admiration.
entries.2296: θαυμάζω QAUMA/ZW thaumázō thou-mad'-zo from G2295; to wonder; by implication, to admire:--admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder.
entries.2297: θαυμάσιος QAUMA/SIOS thaumásios thow-mas'-ee-os from G2295; wondrous, i.e. (neuter as noun) a miracle:--wonderful thing.
entries.2298: θαυμαστός QAUMASTO/S thaumastós thow-mas-tos' from G2296; wondered at, i.e. (by implication) wonderful:--marvel(-lous).
entries.2299: θεά QEA/ theá theh-ah' feminine of G2316; a female deity:--goddess.
entries.2300: θεάομαι QEA/OMAI theáomai theh-ah'-om-ahee a prolonged form of a primary verb; to look closely at, i.e. (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit:--behold, look (upon), see. Compare G3700.
entries.2301: θεατρίζω QEATRI/ZW theatrízō theh-at-rid'-zo from G2302; to expose as a spectacle:--make a gazing stock.
entries.2302: θέατρον QE/ATRON théatron theh'-at-ron from G2300; a place for public show ("theatre"), i.e. general audience-room; by implication, a show itself (figuratively):--spectacle, theatre.
entries.2303: θεῖον QEI=ON theîon thi'-on probably neuter of G2304 (in its original sense of flashing); sulphur:--brimstone.
entries.2304: θεῖος QEI=OS theîos thi'-os from G2316; godlike (neuter as noun, divinity):-- divine, godhead.
entries.2305: θειότης QEIO/THS theiótēs thi-ot'-ace from G2304; divinity (abstractly):--godhead.
entries.2306: θειώδης QEIW/DHS theiṓdēs thi-o'-dace from G2303 and 1491; sulphur-like, i.e. sulphurous:--brimstone.
entries.2307: θέλημα QE/LHMA thélēma thel'-ay-mah from the prolonged form of G2309; a determination (properly, the thing), i.e. (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination:-- desire, pleasure, will.
entries.2308: θέλησις QE/LHSIS thélēsis thel'-ay-sis from G2309; determination (properly, the act), i.e. option:--will.
entries.2309: θέλω QE/LW thélō thel'-o or ἐθέλω E)QE/LW ethélō eth-el'-o , in certain tenses θελέω QELE/W theléō thel-eh'-o , and ἐθελέω E)QELE/W etheléō eth-el-eh'-o , which are otherwise obsolete apparently strengthened from the alternate form of G138; to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas G1014 properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e. choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e. be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by Hebraism, to delight in:--desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, - ling(-ly)).
entries.2310: θεμέλιος QEME/LIOS themélios them-el'-ee-os from a derivative of G5087; something put down, i.e. a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively):--foundation.
entries.2311: θεμελιόω QEMELIO/W themelióō them-el-ee-o'-o from G2310; to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate:--(lay the) found(- ation), ground, settle.
entries.2312: θεοδίδακτος QEODI/DAKTOS theodídaktos theh-od-id'-ak-tos from G2316 and G1321; divinely instructed:--taught of God.
entries.2313: θεομαχέω QEOMAXE/W theomachéō theh-o-makh-eh'-o from G2314; to resist deity:--fight against God.
entries.2314: θεομάχος QEOMA/XOS theomáchos theh-om'-akh-os from G2316 and G3164; an opponent of deity:--to fight against God.
entries.2315: θεόπνευστος QEO/PNEUSTOS theópneustos theh-op'-nyoo-stos from G2316 and a presumed derivative of G4154; divinely breathed in:--given by inspiration of God.
entries.2316: θεός QEO/S theós theh'-os of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with G3588) the supreme Divinity; figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very:--X exceeding, God, god(-ly, -ward).
entries.2317: θεοσέβεια QEOSE/BEIA theosébeia theh-os-eb'-i-ah from G2318; devoutness, i.e. piety:--godliness.
entries.2318: θεοσεβής QEOSEBH/S theosebḗs theh-os-eb-ace' from G2316 and G4576; reverent of God, i.e. pious:--worshipper of God.
entries.2319: θεοστυγής QEOSTUGH/S theostygḗs theh-os-too-gace' from G2316 and the base of G4767; hateful to God, i.e. impious:--hater of God.
entries.2320: θεότης QEO/THS theótēs theh-ot'-ace from G2316; divinity (abstractly):--godhead.
entries.2321: Θεόφιλος *QEO/FILOS Theóphilos theh-of'-il-os from G2316 and G5384; friend of God; Theophilus, a Christian:--Theophilus.
entries.2322: θεραπεία QERAPEI/A therapeía ther-ap-i'-ah from G2323; attendance (specially, medical, i.e. cure); figuratively and collectively, domestics:--healing, household.
entries.2323: θεραπεύω QERAPEU/W therapeúō ther-ap-yoo'-o from the same as G2324; to wait upon menially, i.e. (figuratively) to adore (God), or (specially) to relieve (of disease):--cure, heal, worship.
entries.2324: θεράπων QERA/PWN therápōn ther-ap'-ohn apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of G2330; a menial attendant (as if cherishing):--servant.
entries.2325: θερίζω QERI/ZW therízō ther-id'-zo from G2330 (in the sense of the crop); to harvest:--reap.
entries.2326: θερισμός QERISMO/S therismós ther-is-mos' from G2325; reaping, i.e. the crop:--harvest.
entries.2327: θεριστής QERISTH/S theristḗs ther-is-tace' from G2325; a harvester:--reaper.
entries.2328: θερμαίνω QERMAI/NW thermaínō ther-mah'-ee-no from G2329; to heat (oneself):--(be) warm(-ed, self).
entries.2329: θέρμη QE/RMH thérmē ther'-may from the base of G2330; warmth:--heat.
entries.2330: θέρος QE/ROS théros ther'-os from a primary θέρω QE/RW thérō (to heat); properly, heat, i.e. summer:--summer.
entries.2331: Θεσσαλονικεύς *QESSALONIKEU/S Thessalonikeús thes-sal-on-ik-yoos' from G2332; a Thessalonican, i.e. inhabitant of Thessalonice:--Thessalonian.
entries.2332: Θεσσαλονίκη *QESSALONI/KH Thessaloníkē thes-sal-on-ee'-kay from Θεσσαλός *QESSALO/S Thessalós (a Thessalian) and G3529; Thessalonice, a place in Asia Minor:--Thessalonica.
entries.2333: Θευδᾶς *QEUDA=S Theudâs thyoo-das' of uncertain origin; Theudas, an Israelite:--Theudas.
entries.2334: θεωρέω QEWRE/W theōréō theh-o-reh'-o from a derivative of G2300 (perhaps by addition of G3708); to be a spectator of, i.e. discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge)):--behold, consider, look on, perceive, see. Compare G3700.
entries.2335: θεωρία QEWRI/A theōría theh-o-ree'-ah from the same as G2334; spectatorship, i.e. (concretely) a spectacle:--sight.
entries.2336: θήκη QH/KH thḗkē thay'-kay from G5087; a receptacle, i.e. scabbard:--sheath.
entries.2337: θηλάζω QHLA/ZW thēlázō thay-lad'-zo from θηλή QHLH/ thēlḗ (the nipple); to suckle, (by implication) to suck:--(give) suck(-ling).
entries.2338: θῆλυς QH=LUS thēlys thay'-loos from the same as G2337; female:--female, woman.
entries.2339: θήρα QH/RA thḗra thay'-rah from θήρ QH/R thḗr (a wild animal, as game); hunting, i.e. (figuratively) destruction:--trap.
entries.2340: θηρεύω QHREU/W thēreúō thay-ryoo'-o from G2339; to hunt (an animal), i.e. (figuratively) to carp at:--catch.
entries.2341: θηριομαχέω QHRIOMAXE/W thēriomachéō thay-ree-om-akh-eh'-o from a compound of G2342 and G3164; to be a beast-fighter (in the gladiatorial show), i.e. (figuratively) to encounter (furious men):--fight with wild beasts.
entries.2342: θηρίον QHRI/ON thēríon thay-ree'-on diminutive from the same as G2339; a dangerous animal:--(venomous, wild) beast.
entries.2343: θησαυρίζω QHSAURI/ZW thēsaurízō thay-sow-rid'-zo from G2344; to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively):--lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up).
entries.2344: θησαυρός QHSAURO/S thēsaurós thay-sow-ros' from G5087; a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or figuratively):--treasure.
entries.2345: θιγγάνω QIGGA/NW thingánō thing-gan'-o a prolonged form of an obsolete primary θίγω QI/GW thígō (to finger); to manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure:--handle, touch.
entries.2346: θλίβω QLI/BW thlíbō thlee'-bo akin to the base of G5147; to crowd (literally or figuratively):--afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble.
entries.2347: θλῖψις QLI=YIS thlîpsis thlip'-sis from G2346; pressure (literally or figuratively):--afflicted(-tion), anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble.
entries.2348: θνήσκω QNH/SKW thnḗskō thnay'-sko a strengthened form of a simpler primary θάνω QA/NW thánō than'-o (which is used for it only in certain tenses); to die (literally or figuratively):--be dead, die.
entries.2349: θνητός QNHTO/S thnētós thnay-tos' from G2348; liable to die:--mortal(-ity).
entries.2350: θορυβέω QORUBE/W thorybéō thor-oo-beh'-o from G2351; to be in tumult, i.e. disturb, clamor:--make ado (a noise), trouble self, set on an uproar.
entries.2351: θόρυβος QO/RUBOS thórybos thor'-oo-bos from the base of G2360; a disturbance:--tumult, uproar.
entries.2352: θραύω QRAU/W thraúō throw'-o a primary verb; to crush:--bruise. Compare G4486.
entries.2353: θρέμμα QRE/MMA thrémma threm'-mah from G5142; stock (as raised on a farm):--cattle.
entries.2354: θρηνέω QRHNE/W thrēnéō thray-neh'-o from G2355; to bewail:--lament, mourn.
entries.2355: θρῆνος QRH=NOS thrēnos thray'-nos from the base of G2360; wailing:--lamentation.
entries.2356: θρησκεία QRHSKEI/A thrēskeía thrace-ki'-ah from a derivative of G2357; ceremonial observance:--religion, worshipping.
entries.2357: θρησκός QRHSKO/S thrēskós thrace'-kos probably from the base of G2360; ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e. pious:--religious.
entries.2358: θριαμβεύω QRIAMBEU/W thriambeúō three-am-byoo'-o from a prolonged compound of the base of G2360; and a derivative of G680 (meaning a noisy iambus, sung in honor of Bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer or (by Hebraism) to give victory:--(cause) to triumph (over).
entries.2359: θρίξ QRI/C thríx threeks genitive case τριχός TRIXO/S trichós, etc.; of uncertain derivation; hair:--hair. Compare G2864.
entries.2360: θροέω QROE/W throéō thro-eh'-o from θρέομαι QRE/OMAI thréomai to wail; to clamor, i.e. (by implication) to frighten:--trouble.
entries.2361: θρόμβος QRO/MBOS thrómbos throm'-bos perhaps from G5142 (in the sense of thickening); a clot:--great drop.
entries.2362: θρόνος QRO/NOS thrónos thron'-os from θράω QRA/W thráō (to sit); a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate:--seat, throne.
entries.2363: Θυάτειρα *QUA/TEIRA Thyáteira thoo-at'-i-rah of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor:--Thyatira.
entries.2364: θυγάτηρ QUGA/THR thygátēr thoo-gat'-air apparently a primary word (compare "daughter"); a female child, or (by Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant):--daughter.
entries.2365: θυγάτριον QUGA/TRION thygátrion thoo-gat'-ree-on from G2364; a daughterling:--little (young) daughter.
entries.2366: θύελλα QU/ELLA thýella thoo'-el-lah from G2380 (in the sense of blowing) a storm :--tempest.
entries.2367: θύϊνος QU/I+NOS thýïnos thoo'-ee-nos from a derivative of G2380 (in the sense of blowing; denoting a certain fragrant tree); made of citron-wood:--thyine.
entries.2368: θυμίαμα QUMI/AMA thymíama thoo-mee'-am-ah from G2370; an aroma, i.e. fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself:--incense, odour.
entries.2369: θυμιαστήριον QUMIASTH/RION thymiastḗrion thoo-mee-as-tay'-ree-on from a derivative of G2370; a place of fumigation, i.e. the alter of incense (in the Temple):--censer.
entries.2370: θυμιάω QUMIA/W thymiáō thoo-mee-ah'-o from a derivative of G2380 (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, i.e. offer aromatic fumes:--burn incense.
entries.2371: θυμομαχέω QUMOMAXE/W thymomachéō thoo-mom-akh-eh'-o from a presumed compound of G2372 and G3164; to be in a furious fight, i.e. (figuratively) to be exasperated:--be highly displeased.
entries.2372: θυμός QUMO/S thymós thoo-mos' from G2380; passion (as if breathing hard):--fierceness, indignation, wrath. Compare G5590.
entries.2373: θυμόω QUMO/W thymóō tho-mo'-o from G2372; to put in a passion, i.e. enrage:--be wroth.
entries.2374: θύρα QU/RA thýra thoo'-rah apparently a primary word (compare "door"); a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively):--door, gate.
entries.2375: θυρεός QUREO/S thyreós thoo-reh-os' from G2374; a large shield (as door-shaped):--shield.
entries.2376: θυρίς QURI/S thyrís thoo-rece' from G2374; an aperture, i.e. window:--window.
entries.2377: θυρωρός QURWRO/S thyrōrós thoo-ro-ros' from G2374 and οὖρος OU)=ROS oûros (a watcher); a gate- warden:--that kept the door, porter.
entries.2378: θυσία QUSI/A thysía thoo-see'-ah from G2380; sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively):--sacrifice.
entries.2379: θυσιαστήριον QUSIASTH/RION thysiastḗrion thoo-see-as-tay'-ree-on from a derivative of G2378; a place of sacrifice, i.e. an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative):--altar.
entries.2380: θύω QU/W thýō thoo'-o a primary verb; properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e. (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose):--kill, (do) sacrifice, slay.
entries.2381: Θωμᾶς *QWMA=S Thōmâs tho-mas' of Chaldee origin (compare H08380); the twin; Thomas, a Christian:--Thomas.
entries.2382: θώραξ QW/RAC thṓrax tho'-rax of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet:--breast-plate.
entries.2383: Ἰάειρος *)IA/EIROS Iáeiros ee-ah'-i-ros of Hebrew origin (H02971); Jairus (i.e. Jair), an Israelite:--Jairus.
entries.2384: Ἰακώβ *)IAKW/B Iakṓb ee-ak-obe' of Hebrew origin (H03290); Jacob (i.e. Ja`akob), the progenitor of the Israelites:--also an Israelite:--Jacob.
entries.2385: Ἰάκωβος *)IA/KWBOS Iákōbos ee-ak'-o-bos the same as G2384 Græcized; Jacobus, the name of three Israelites:--James.
entries.2386: ἴαμα I)/AMA íama ee'-am-ah from G2390; a cure (the effect):--healing.
entries.2387: Ἰαμβρῆς *)IAMBRH=S Iambrēs ee-am-brace' of Egyptian origin; Jambres, an Egyptian:--Jambres.
entries.2388: Ἰαννά *)IANNA/ Ianná ee-an-nah' probably of Hebrew origin (compare H03238); Janna, an Israelite:--Janna.
entries.2389: Ἰαννῆς *)IANNH=S Iannēs ee-an-nace' of Egyptian origin; Jannes, an Egyptian:--Jannes.
entries.2390: ἰάομαι I)A/OMAI iáomai ee-ah'-om-ahee middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to cure (literally or figuratively):--heal, make whole.
entries.2391: Ἰάρεδ *)IA/RED Iáred ee-ar'-ed of Hebrew origin (H03382); Jared (i.e. Jered), an antediluvian:--Jared.
entries.2392: ἴασις I)/ASIS íasis ee'-as-is from G2390; curing (the act):--cure, heal(-ing).
entries.2393: ἴασπις I)/ASPIS íaspis ee'-as-pis probably of foreign origin (see H03471); "jasper", a gem:--jasper.
entries.2394: Ἰάσων *)IA/SWN Iásōn ee-as'-oan future active participle masculine of G2390; about to cure; Jason, a Christian:--Jason.
entries.2395: ἰατρός I)ATRO/S iatrós ee-at-ros' from G2390; a physician:--physician.
entries.2396: ἴδε I)/DE íde id'-eh second person singular imperative active of G1492; used as an interjection to denote surprise; lo!:--behold, lo, see.
entries.2397: ἰδέα I)DE/A idéa id-eh'-ah from G1492; a sight (compare figuratively "idea"), i.e. aspect:--countenance.
entries.2398: ἴδιος I)/DIOS ídios id'-ee-os of uncertain affinity; pertaining to self, i.e. one's own; by implication, private or separate:--X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our, thine, your) own (business), private(-ly), proper, severally, their (own).
entries.2399: ἰδιώτης I)DIW/THS idiṓtēs id-ee-o'-tace from G2398; a private person, i.e. (by implication) an ignoramus (compare "idiot"):--ignorant, rude, unlearned.
entries.2400: ἰδού I)DOU/ idoú id-oo' second person singular imperative middle voice of G1492; used as imperative lo!; --behold, lo, see.
entries.2401: Ἰδουμαία *)IDOUMAI/A Idoumaía id-oo-mah'-yah of Hebrew origin (H0123); Idumæa (i.e. Edom), a region East (and South) of Palestine:--Idumæa.
entries.2402: ἱδρώς I(DRW/S hidrṓs hid-roce' a strengthened form of a primary ἴδος I)/DOS ídos (sweat): perspiration :--sweat.
entries.2403: Ἰεζαβήλ *)IEZABH/L Iezabḗl ee-ed-zab-ale' of Hebrew origin (H0348); Jezabel (i.e. Jezebel), a Tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher):--Jezabel.
entries.2404: Ἱεράπολις *(IERA/POLIS Hierápolis hee-er-ap'-ol-is from G2413 and G4172; holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia Minor:--Hierapolis.
entries.2405: ἱερατεία I(ERATEI/A hierateía hee-er-at-i'-ah from G2407; priestliness, i.e. the sacerdotal function:--office of the priesthood, priest's office.
entries.2406: ἱεράτευμα I(ERA/TEUMA hieráteuma hee-er-at'-yoo-mah from G2407; the priestly fraternity, i.e. sacerdotal order (figuratively):--priesthood.
entries.2407: ἱερατεύω I(ERATEU/W hierateúō hee-er-at-yoo'-o prolongation from G2409; to be a priest, i.e. perform his functions:--execute the priest's office.
entries.2408: Ἱερεμίας *(IEREMI/AS Hieremías hee-er-em-ee'-as of Hebrew origin (H03414); Hieremias (i.e. Jermijah), an Israelite:--Jeremiah.
entries.2409: ἱερεύς I(EREU/S hiereús hee-er-yooce' from G2413; a priest (literally or figuratively):--(high) priest.
entries.2410: Ἱεριχώ *(IERIXW/ Hierichṓ hee-er-ee-kho' of Hebrew origin (H03405); Jericho, a place in Palestine:--Jericho.
entries.2411: ἱερόν I(ERO/N hierón hee-er-on' neuter of G2413; a sacred place, i.e. the entire precincts (whereas G3485 denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the Temple (at Jerusalem or elsewhere):--temple.
entries.2412: ἱεροπρεπής I(EROPREPH/S hieroprepḗs hee-er-op-rep-ace' from G2413 and the same as G4241; reverent:--as becometh holiness.
entries.2413: ἱερός I(ERO/S hierós hee-er-os' of uncertain affinity; sacred:--holy.
entries.2414: Ἱεροσόλυμα *(IEROSO/LUMA Hierosólyma hee-er-os-ol'-oo-mah of Hebrew origin (H03389); Hierosolyma (i.e. Jerushalaim), the capitol of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare G2419.
entries.2415: Ἱεροσολυμίτης *(IEROSOLUMI/THS Hierosolymítēs hee-er-os-ol-oo-mee'-tace from G2414; a Hierosolymite, i.e. inhabitant of Hierosolyma:--of Jerusalem.
entries.2416: ἱεροσυλέω I(EROSULE/W hierosyléō hee-er-os-ool-eh'-o from G2417; to be a temple-robber (figuratively):--commit sacrilege.
entries.2417: ἱερόσυλος I(ERO/SULOS hierósylos hee-er-os'-oo-los from G2411 and G4813; a temple-despoiler:--robber of churches.
entries.2418: ἱερουργέω I(EROURGE/W hierourgéō hee-er-oorg-eh'-o from a compound of G2411 and the base of G2041; to be a temple-worker, i.e. officiate as a priest (figuratively):--minister.
entries.2419: Ἱερουσαλήμ *(IEROUSALH/M Hierousalḗm hee-er-oo-sal-ame' of Hebrew origin (H03389); Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare G2414.
entries.2420: ἱερωσύνη I(ERWSU/NH hierōsýnē hee-er-o-soo'-nay from G2413; sacredness, i.e. (by implication) the priestly office:--priesthood.
entries.2421: Ἰεσσαί *)IESSAI/ Iessaí es-es-sah'-ee of Hebrew origin (H03448); Jessæ (i.e. Jishai), an Israelite:--Jesse.
entries.2422: Ἰεφθάε *)IEFQA/E Iephtháe ee-ef-thah'-eh of Hebrew origin (H03316); Jephthaë (i.e. Jiphtach), an Israelite:--Jephthah.
entries.2423: Ἰεχονίας *)IEXONI/AS Iechonías ee-ekh-on-ee'-as of Hebrew origin (H03204); Jechonias (i.e. Jekonjah), an Israelite:--Jechonias.
entries.2424: Ἰησοῦς *)IHSOU=S Iēsoûs ee-ay-sooce' of Hebrew origin (H03091); Jesus (i.e. Jehoshua), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites:--Jesus.
entries.2425: ἱκανός I(KANO/S hikanós hik-an-os' from ἵκω I(/KW híkō ( ἱκάνω I(KA/NW hikánō or ἱκνέομαι I(KNE/OMAI hiknéomai, akin to G2240) (to arrive); competent (as if coming in season), i.e. ample (in amount) or fit (in character):--able, + content, enough, good, great, large, long (while), many, meet, much, security, sore, sufficient, worthy.
entries.2426: ἱκανότης I(KANO/THS hikanótēs hik-an-ot'-ace from G2425; ability:--sufficiency.
entries.2427: ἱκανόω I(KANO/W hikanóō hik-an-o'-o from G2425; to enable, i.e. qualify:--make able (meet).
entries.2428: ἱκετηρία I(KETHRI/A hiketēría hik-et-ay-ree'-ah from a derivative of the base of G2425 (through the idea of approaching for a favor); intreaty:--supplication.
entries.2429: ἱκμάς I(KMA/S hikmás hik-mas' of uncertain affinity; dampness:--moisture.
entries.2430: Ἰκόνιον *)IKO/NION Ikónion ee-kon'-ee-on perhaps from G1504; image-like; Iconium, a place in Asia Minor:--Iconium.
entries.2431: ἱλαρός I(LARO/S hilarós hil-ar-os' from the same as G2436; propitious or merry ("hilarious"), i.e. prompt or willing:--cheerful.
entries.2432: ἱλαρότης I(LARO/THS hilarótēs hil-ar-ot'-ace from G2431; alacrity:--cheerfulness.
entries.2433: ἱλάσκομαι I(LA/SKOMAI hiláskomai hil-as'-kom-ahee middle voice from the same as G2436; to conciliate, i.e. (transitively) to atone for (sin), or (intransitively) be propitious:--be merciful, make reconciliation for.
entries.2434: ἱλασμός I(LASMO/S hilasmós hil-as-mos' atonement, i.e. (concretely) an expiator:--propitiation.
entries.2435: ἱλαστήριον I(LASTH/RION hilastḗrion hil-as-tay'-ree-on neuter of a derivative of G2433; an expiatory (place or thing), i.e. (concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the Ark (in the Temple):--mercyseat, propitiation.
entries.2436: ἵλεως I(/LEWS híleōs hil'-eh-oce perhaps from the alternate form of G138; cheerful (as attractive), i.e. propitious; adverbially (by Hebraism) God be gracious!, i.e. (in averting some calamity) far be it:--be it far, merciful.
entries.2437: Ἰλλυρικόν *)ILLURIKO/N Illyrikón il-loo-ree-kon' neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation; (the) Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of Europe:--Illyricum.
entries.2438: ἱμάς I(MA/S himás hee-mas' perhaps from the same as G260; a strap, i.e. (specially) the tie (of a sandal) or the lash (of a scourge):--latchet, thong.
entries.2439: ἱματίζω I(MATI/ZW himatízō him-at-id'-zo from G2440; to dress:--clothe.
entries.2440: ἱμάτιον I(MA/TION himátion him-at'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on); a dress (inner or outer):--apparel, cloke, clothes, garment, raiment, robe, vesture.
entries.2441: ἱματισμός I(MATISMO/S himatismós him-at-is-mos' from G2439; clothing:--apparel (X -led), array, raiment, vesture.
entries.2442: ἱμείρομαι I(MEI/ROMAI himeíromai him-i'-rom-ahee middle voice from ἵμερος I(/MEROS hímeros (a yearning; of uncertain affinity); to long for:--be affectionately desirous.
entries.2443: ἵνα I(/NA hína hin'-ah probably from the same as the former part of G1438 (through the demonstrative idea; compare G3588); in order that (denoting the purpose or the result):--albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as, (so) that, (for) to. Compare G3363.
entries.2444: ἱνατί I(NATI/ hinatí hin-at-ee' from G2443 and G5101; for what reason ?, i.e. why?:--wherefore, why.
entries.2445: Ἰόππη *)IO/PPH Ióppē ee-op'-pay of Hebrew origin (H03305); Joppe (i.e. Japho), a place in Palestine:--Joppa.
entries.2446: Ἰορδάνης *)IORDA/NHS Iordánēs ee-or-dan'-ace of Hebrew origin (H03383); the Jordanes (i.e. Jarden), a river of Palestine:--Jordan.
entries.2447: ἰός I)O/S iós ee-os' perhaps from εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi (to go) or ἵημι I(/HMI híēmi (to send); rust (as if emitted by metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents):--poison, rust.
entries.2448: Ἰουδά *)IOUDA/ Ioudá ee-oo-dah' of Hebrew origin (H03063 or perhaps H03194); Judah (i.e. Jehudah or Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine:--Judah.
entries.2449: Ἰουδαία *)IOUDAI/A Ioudaía ee-oo-dah'-yah feminine of G2453 (with G1093 implied); the Judæan land (i.e. Judæa), a region of Palestine:--Judæa.
entries.2450: Ἰουδαΐζω *)IOUDAI/+ZW Ioudaḯzō ee-oo-dah-id'-zo from G2453; to become a Judæan, i.e. "Judaize":--live as the Jews.
entries.2451: Ἰουδαϊκός *)IOUDAI+KO/S Ioudaïkós ee-oo-dah-ee-kos' from G2453; Judaïc, i.e. resembling a Judæan:--Jewish.
entries.2452: Ἰουδαϊκῶς *)IOUDAI+KW=S Ioudaïkōs ee-oo-dah-ee-koce' adverb from G2451; Judaïcally or in a manner resembling a Judæan:--as do the Jews.
entries.2453: Ἰουδαῖος *)IOUDAI=OS Ioudaîos ee-oo-dah'-yos from G2448 (in the sense of G2455 as a country); Judæan, i.e. belonging to Jehudah:--Jew(-ess), of Judæa.
entries.2454: Ἰουδαϊσμός *)IOUDAI+SMO/S Ioudaïsmós ee-oo-dah-is-mos' from G2450; "Judaism", i.e. the Jewish faith and usages:--Jews' religion.
entries.2455: Ἰούδας *)IOU/DAS Ioúdas ee-oo-das' of Hebrew origin (H03063); Judas (i.e. Jehudah), the name of ten Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region:--Juda(-h, -s); Jude.
entries.2456: Ἰουλία *)IOULI/A Ioulía ee-oo-lee'-ah feminine of the same as G2457; Julia, a Christian woman:--Julia.
entries.2457: Ἰούλιος *)IOU/LIOS Ioúlios ee-oo'-lee-os of Latin origin; Julius, a centurion:--Julius.
entries.2458: Ἰουνιᾶς *)IOUNIA=S Iouniâs ee-oo-nee'-as of Latin origin; Junias, a Christian:--Junias.
entries.2459: Ἰοῦστος *)IOU=STOS Ioûstos ee-ooce'-tos of Latin origin ("just"); Justus, the name of three Christian:--Justus.
entries.2460: ἱππεύς I(PPEU/S hippeús hip-yooce' from G2462; an equestrian, i.e. member of a cavalry corps:--horseman.
entries.2461: ἱππικόν I(PPIKO/N hippikón hip-pee-kon' neuter of a derivative of G2462; the cavalry force:--horse(-men).
entries.2462: ἵππος I(/PPOS híppos hip'-pos of uncertain affinity; a horse:--horse.
entries.2463: ἶρις I)=RIS îris ee'-ris perhaps from G2046 (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities); a rainbow ("iris"):--rainbow.
entries.2464: Ἰσαάκ *)ISAA/K Isaák ee-sah-ak' of Hebrew origin (H03327); Isaac (i.e. Jitschak), the son of Abraham:--Isaac.
entries.2465: ἰσάγγελος I)SA/GGELOS isángelos ee-sang'-el-los from G2470 and G32; like an angel, i.e. angelic:--equal unto the angels.
entries.2466: Ἰσαχάρ *)ISAXA/R Isachár ee-sakh-ar' of Hebrew origin (H03485); Isachar (i.e. Jissaskar), a son of Jacob (figuratively, his descendant):--Issachar.
entries.2467: ἴσημι I)/SHMI ísēmi is'-ay-mee assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of G1492; to know:--know.
entries.2468: ἴσθι I)/SQI ísthi is'-thee second person imperative present of G1510; be thou:--+ agree, be, X give thyself wholly to.
entries.2469: Ἰσκαριώτης *)ISKARIW/THS Iskariṓtēs is-kar-ee-o'-tace of Hebrew origin (probably H0377 and H07149); inhabitant of Kerioth; Iscariotes (i.e. Keriothite), an epithet of Judas the traitor:--Iscariot.
entries.2470: ἴσος I)/SOS ísos ee'-sos probably from G1492 (through the idea of seeming); similar (in amount and kind):--+ agree, as much, equal, like.
entries.2471: ἰσότης I)SO/THS isótēs ee-sot'-ace likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication, equity:--equal(-ity).
entries.2472: ἰσότιμος I)SO/TIMOS isótimos ee-sot'-ee-mos from G2470 and G5092; of equal value or honor:--like precious.
entries.2473: ἰσόψυχος I)SO/YUXOS isópsychos ee-sop'-soo-khos from G2470 and G5590; of similar spirit:--likeminded.
entries.2474: Ἰσραήλ *)ISRAH/L Israḗl is-rah-ale' of Hebrew origin (H03478); Israel (i.e. Jisrael), the adopted name of Jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively):--Israel.
entries.2475: Ἰσραηλίτης *)ISRAHLI/THS Israēlítēs is-rah-ale-ee'-tace from G2474; an "Israelite", i.e. descendant of Israel (literally or figuratively):--Israelite.
entries.2476: ἵστημι I(/STHMI hístēmi his'-tay-mee a prolonged form of a primary στάω STA/W stáō stah'-o (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses); to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively):--abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up). Compare G5087.
entries.2477: ἱστορέω I(STORE/W historéō his-tor-eh'-o from a derivative of G1492; to be knowing (learned), i.e. (by implication) to visit for information (interview):--see.
entries.2478: ἰσχυρός I)SXURO/S ischyrós is-khoo-ros' from G2479; forcible (literally or figuratively):--boisterous, mighty(-ier), powerful, strong(-er, man), valiant.
entries.2479: ἰσχύς I)SXU/S ischýs is-khoos' from a derivative of ἰς I)S is (force; compare ἔσχον E)/SXON éschon, a form of G2192); forcefulness (literally or figuratively):--ability, might(-ily), power, strength.
entries.2480: ἰσχύω I)SXU/W ischýō is-khoo'-o from G2479; to have (or exercise) force (literally or figuratively):--be able, avail, can do(-not), could, be good, might, prevail, be of strength, be whole, + much work.
entries.2481: ἴσως I)/SWS ísōs ee'-soce adverb from G2470; likely, i.e. perhaps:--it may be.
entries.2482: Ἰταλία *)ITALI/A Italía ee-tal-ee'-ah probably of foreign origin; Italia, a region of Europe:--Italy.
entries.2483: Ἰταλικός *)ITALIKO/S Italikós ee-tal-ee-kos' from G2482; Italic, i.e. belonging to Italia:--Italian.
entries.2484: Ἰτουραΐα *)ITOURAI/+A Itouraḯa ee-too-rah'-yah of Hebrew origin (H03195); Ituræa (i.e. Jetur), a region of Palestine:--Ituræa.
entries.2485: ἰχθύδιον I)XQU/DION ichthýdion ikh-thoo'-dee-on diminutive from G2486; a petty fish:--little (small) fish.
entries.2486: ἰχθύς I)XQU/S ichthýs ikh-thoos' of uncertain affinity; a fish:--fish.
entries.2487: ἴχνος I)/XNOS íchnos ikh'-nos from ἰκνέομαι I)KNE/OMAI iknéomai (to arrive; compare G2240); a track (figuratively):--step.
entries.2488: Ἰωάθαμ *)IWA/QAM Iōátham ee-o-ath'-am of Hebrew origin (H03147); Joatham (i.e. Jotham), an Israelite:--Joatham.
entries.2489: Ἰωάννα *)IWA/NNA Iōánna ee-o-an'-nah feminine of the same as G2491; Joanna, a Christian:--Joanna.
entries.2490: Ἰωαννᾶς *)IWANNA=S Iōannâs ee-o-an-nas' a form of G2491; Joannas, an Israelite:--Joannas.
entries.2491: Ἰωάννης *)IWA/NNHS Iōánnēs ee-o-an'-nace of Hebrew origin (H03110); Joannes (i.e. Jochanan), the name of four Israelites:--John.
entries.2492: Ἰώβ *)IW/B Iṓb ee-obe' of Hebrew origin (H0347); Job (i.e. Ijob), a patriarch:--Job.
entries.2493: Ἰωήλ *)IWH/L Iōḗl ee-o-ale' of Hebrew origin (H03100); Joel, an Israelite:--Joel.
entries.2494: Ἰωνάν *)IWNA/N Iōnán ee-o-nan' probably for G2491 or G2495; Jonan, an Israelite:--Jonan.
entries.2495: Ἰωνᾶς *)IWNA=S Iōnâs ee-o-nas' of Hebrew origin (H03124); Jonas (i.e. Jonah), the name of two Israelites:--Jonas.
entries.2496: Ἰωράμ *)IWRA/M Iōrám ee-o-ram' of Hebrew origin (H03141); Joram, an Israelite:--Joram.
entries.2497: Ἰωρείμ *)IWREI/M Iōreím ee-o-rime' perhaps for G2496; Jorim, an Israelite:--Jorim.
entries.2498: Ἰωσαφάτ *)IWSAFA/T Iōsaphát ee-o-saf-at' of Hebrew origin (H03092); Josaphat (i.e. Jehoshaphat), an Israelite:--Josaphat.
entries.2499: Ἰωσή *)IWSH/ Iōsḗ ee-o-say' genitive case of G2500; Jose, an Israelite:--Jose.
entries.2500: Ἰωσῆς *)IWSH=S Iōsēs ee-o-sace' perhaps for G2501; Joses, the name of two Israelites:--Joses. Compare G2499.
entries.2501: Ἰωσήφ *)IWSH/F Iōsḗph ee-o-safe' of Hebrew origin (H03130); Joseph, the name of seven Israelites:--Joseph.
entries.2502: Ἰωσίας *)IWSI/AS Iōsías ee-o-see'-as of Hebrew origin (H02977); Josias (i.e. Joshiah), an Israelite:--Josias.
entries.2503: ἰῶτα I)W=TA iōta ee-o'-tah of Hebrew origin (the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet); "iota", the name of the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, put (figuratively) for a very small part of anything:--jot.
entries.2504: κἀγώ KA)GW/ kagṓ kag-o' from G2532 and G1473; so also the dative case κἀμοί KA)MOI/ kamoí kam-oy' , and accusative case κἀμέ KA)ME/ kamé kam-eh' and (or also, even, etc.) I, (to) me:--(and, even, even so, so) I (also, in like wise), both me, me also.
entries.2505: καθά KAQA/ kathá kath-ah' from G2596 and the neuter plural of G3739; according to which things, i.e. just as:--as.
entries.2506: καθαίρεσις KAQAI/RESIS kathaíresis kath-ah'-ee-res-is from G2507; demolition; figuratively, extinction:--destruction, pulling down.
entries.2507: καθαιρέω KAQAIRE/W kathairéō kath-ahee-reh'-o from G2596 and G138 (including its alternate); to lower (or with violence) demolish (literally or figuratively):--cast (pull, put, take) down, destroy.
entries.2508: καθαίρω KAQAI/RW kathaírō kath-ah'-ee-ro from G2513; to cleanse, i.e. (specially) to prune; figuratively, to expiate:--purge.
entries.2509: καθάπερ KAQA/PER katháper kath-ap'-er from G2505 and G4007; exactly as:--(even, as well) as.
entries.2510: καθάπτω KAQA/PTW katháptō kath-ap'-to from G2596 and G680; to seize upon:--fasten on.
entries.2511: καθαρίζω KAQARI/ZW katharízō kath-ar-id'-zo from G2513; to cleanse (literally or figuratively):--(make) clean(-se), purge, purify.
entries.2512: καθαρισμός KAQARISMO/S katharismós kath-ar-is-mos' from G2511; a washing off, i.e. (ceremonially) ablution, (morally) expiation:--cleansing, + purge, purification(-fying).
entries.2513: καθαρός KAQARO/S katharós kath-ar-os' of uncertain affinity; clean (literally or figuratively):--clean, clear, pure.
entries.2514: καθαρότης KAQARO/THS katharótēs kath-ar-ot'-ace from G2513; cleanness (ceremonially):--purification.
entries.2515: καθέδρα KAQE/DRA kathédra kath-ed'-rah from G2596 and the same as G1476; a bench (literally or figuratively):--seat.
entries.2516: καθέζομαι KAQE/ZOMAI kathézomai kath-ed'-zom-ahee from G2596 and the base of G1476; to sit down:--sit.
entries.2517: καθεξῆς KAQECH=S kathexēs kath-ex-ace' from G2596 and G1836; thereafter, i.e. consecutively; as a noun (by ellipsis of noun) a subsequent person or time:--after(-ward), by (in) order.
entries.2518: καθεύδω KAQEU/DW katheúdō kath-yoo'-do from G2596 and εὕδω EU(/DW heúdō (to sleep); to lie down to rest, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep (literally or figuratively):--(be a-)sleep.
entries.2519: καθηγητής KAQHGHTH/S kathēgētḗs kath-ayg-ay-tace' from a compound of G2596 and G2233; a guide, i.e. (figuratively) a teacher:--master.
entries.2520: καθήκω KAQH/KW kathḗkō kath-ay'-ko from G2596 and G2240; to reach to, i.e. (neuter of present active participle, figuratively as adjective) becoming:-- convenient, fit.
entries.2521: κάθημαι KA/QHMAI káthēmai kath'-ay-mahee from G2596; and ἧμαι H(=MAI hēmai (to sit; akin to the base of G1476); to sit down; figuratively, to remain, reside:--dwell, sit (by, down).
entries.2522: καθημερινός KAQHMERINO/S kathēmerinós kath-ay-mer-ee-nos' from G2596 and G2250; quotidian:--daily.
entries.2523: καθίζω KAQI/ZW kathízō kath-id'-zo another (active) form for G2516; to seat down, i.e. set (figuratively, appoint); intransitively, to sit (down); figuratively, to settle (hover, dwell):--continue, set, sit (down), tarry.
entries.2524: καθίημι KAQI/HMI kathíēmi kath-ee'-ay-mee from G2596; and ἵημι I(/HMI híēmi (to send); to lower:--let down.
entries.2525: καθίστημι KAQI/STHMI kathístēmi kath-is'-tay-mee from G2596 and G2476; to place down (permanently), i.e. (figuratively) to designate, constitute, convoy:--appoint, be, conduct, make, ordain, set.
entries.2526: καθό KAQO/ kathó kath-o' from G2596 and G3739; according to which thing, i.e. precisely as, in proportion as:--according to that, (inasmuch) as.
entries.2527: καθόλου KAQO/LOU kathólou kath-ol'-oo from G2596 and G3650; on the whole, i.e. entirely:--at all.
entries.2528: καθοπλίζω KAQOPLI/ZW kathoplízō kath-op-lid'-zo from G2596; and G3695; to equip fully with armor:--arm.
entries.2529: καθοράω KAQORA/W kathoráō kath-or-ah'-o from G2596 and G3708; to behold fully, i.e. (figuratively) distinctly apprehend:--clearly see.
entries.2530: καθότι KAQO/TI kathóti kath-ot'-ee from G2596; and G3739 and G5100; according to which certain thing, i.e. as far (or inasmuch) as:--(according, forasmuch) as, because (that).
entries.2531: καθώς KAQW/S kathṓs kath-oce' from G2596 and G5613; just (or inasmuch) as, that:--according to, (according, even) as, how, when.
entries.2532: καί KAI/ kaí kahee apparently, a primary particle, having a copulative and sometimes also a cumulative force; and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in connection (or composition) with other particles or small words:--and, also, both, but, even, for, if, or, so, that, then, therefore, when, yet.
entries.2533: Καϊάφας *KAI+A/FAS Kaïáphas kah-ee-af'-as of Chaldee origin; the dell; Caiaphas (i.e. Cajepha), an Israelite:--Caiaphas.
entries.2534: καίγε KAI/GE kaíge kah'-ee-gheh from G2532 and G1065; and at least (or even, indeed):--and, at least.
entries.2535: Κάϊν *KA/I+N Káïn kah'-in of Hebrew origin (H07014); Cain, (i.e. Cajin), the son of Adam:--Cain.
entries.2536: Καϊνάν *KAI+NA/N Kaïnán kah-ee-nan' of Hebrew origin (H07018); Cainan (i.e. Kenan), the name of two patriarchs:--Cainan.
entries.2537: καινός KAINO/S kainós kahee-nos' of uncertain affinity; new (especially in freshness; while G3501 is properly so with respect to age:--new.
entries.2538: καινότης KAINO/THS kainótēs kahee-not'-ace from G2537; renewal (figuratively):--newness.
entries.2539: καίπερ KAI/PER kaíper kah'-ee-per from G2532 and G4007; and indeed, i.e. nevertheless or notwithstanding:--and yet, although.
entries.2540: καιρός KAIRO/S kairós kahee-ros' of uncertain affinity; an occasion, i.e. set or proper time:--X always, opportunity, (convenient, due) season, (due, short, while) time, a while. Compare G5550.
entries.2541: Καῖσαρ *KAI=SAR Kaîsar kah'-ee-sar of Latin origin; Cæsar, a title of the Roman emperor:--Cæsar.
entries.2542: Καισάρεια *KAISA/REIA Kaisáreia kahee-sar'-i-a from G2541; Cæsaria, the name of two places in Palestine:--Cæsarea.
entries.2543: καίτοι KAI/TOI kaítoi kah'-ee-toy from G2532 and G5104; and yet, i.e. nevertheless:--although.
entries.2544: καίτοιγε KAI/TOIGE kaítoige kah'-ee-toyg-eh from G2543 and G1065; and yet indeed, i.e. although really:--nevertheless, though.
entries.2545: καίω KAI/W kaíō kah'-yo apparently a primary verb; to set on fire, i.e. kindle or (by implication) consume:--burn, light.
entries.2546: κἀκεῖ KA)KEI= kakeî kak-i' from G2532 and G1563; likewise in that place:--and there, there (thither) also.
entries.2547: κἀκεῖθεν KA)KEI=QEN kakeîthen kak-i'-then from G2532 and G1564; likewise from that place (or time):--and afterward (from) (thence), thence also.
entries.2548: κἀκεῖνος KA)KEI=NOS kakeînos kak-i'-nos from G2532 and G1565; likewise that (or those):--and him (other, them), even he, him also, them (also), (and) they.
entries.2549: κακία KAKI/A kakía kak-ee'-ah from G2556; badness, i.e. (subjectively) depravity, or (actively) malignity, or (passively) trouble:--evil, malice(-iousness), naughtiness, wickedness.
entries.2550: κακοήθεια KAKOH/QEIA kakoḗtheia kak-o-ay'-thi-ah from a compound of G2556 and G2239; bad character, i.e. (specially) mischievousness:--malignity.
entries.2551: κακολογέω KAKOLOGE/W kakologéō kak-ol-og-eh'-o from a compound of G2556 and G3056; to revile:--curse, speak evil of.
entries.2552: κακοπάθεια KAKOPA/QEIA kakopátheia kak-op-ath'-i-ah from a compound of G2556 and G3806; hardship:--suffering affliction.
entries.2553: κακοπαθέω KAKOPAQE/W kakopathéō kak-op-ath-eh'-o from the same as G2552; to undergo hardship:--be afflicted, endure afflictions (hardness), suffer trouble.
entries.2554: κακοποιέω KAKOPOIE/W kakopoiéō kak-op-oy-eh'-o from G2555; to be a bad-doer, i.e. (objectively) to injure, or (genitive) to sin:--do(ing) evil.
entries.2555: κακοποιός KAKOPOIO/S kakopoiós kak-op-oy-os' from G2556 and G4160; a bad-doer; (specially), a criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.
entries.2556: κακός KAKO/S kakós kak-os' apparently a primary word; worthless (intrinsically, such; whereas G4190 properly refers to effects), i.e. (subjectively) depraved, or (objectively) injurious:--bad, evil, harm, ill, noisome, wicked.
entries.2557: κακοῦργος KAKOU=RGOS kakoûrgos kak-oor'-gos from G2556 and the base of G2041; a wrong-doer, i.e. criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.
entries.2558: κακουχέω KAKOUXE/W kakouchéō kak-oo-kheh'-o from a presumed compound of G2556 and G2192; to maltreat:--which suffer adversity, torment.
entries.2559: κακόω KAKO/W kakóō kak-o'-o from G2556; to injure; figuratively, to exasperate:--make evil affected, entreat evil, harm, hurt, vex.
entries.2560: κακῶς KAKW=S kakōs kak-oce' from G2556; badly (physically or morally):--amiss, diseased, evil, grievously, miserably, sick, sore.
entries.2561: κάκωσις KA/KWSIS kákōsis kak'-o-sis from G2559; maltreatment:--affliction.
entries.2562: καλάμη KALA/MH kalámē kal-am'-ay feminine of G2563; a stalk of grain, i.e. (collectively) stubble:--stubble.
entries.2563: κάλαμος KA/LAMOS kálamos kal'-am-os of uncertain affinity; a reed (the plant or its stem, or that of a similar plant); by implication, a pen:--pen, reed.
entries.2564: καλέω KALE/W kaléō kal-eh'-o akin to the base of G2753; to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise):--bid, call (forth), (whose, whose sur-)name (was (called)).
entries.2565: καλλιέλαιος KALLIE/LAIOS kalliélaios kal-le-el'-ah-yos from the base of G2566 and G1636; a cultivated olive tree, i.e. a domesticated or improved one:--good olive tree.
entries.2566: καλλίον KALLI/ON kallíon kal-lee'-on neuter of the (irregular) comparative of G2570; (adverbially) better than many:--very well.
entries.2567: καλοδιδάσκαλος KALODIDA/SKALOS kalodidáskalos kal-od-id-as'-kal-os from G2570 and G1320; a teacher of the right:--teacher of good things.
entries.2568: Καλοὶ Λιμένες *KALOI\ *LIME/NES Kaloì Liménes kal-oy' lee-men'-es plural of G2570 and G3040; Good Harbors, i.e. Fairhaven, a bay of Crete:--fair havens.
entries.2569: καλοποιέω KALOPOIE/W kalopoiéō kal-op-oy-eh'-o from G2570 and G4160; to do well, i.e. live virtuously:--well doing.
entries.2570: καλός KALO/S kalós kal-os' of uncertain affinity; properly, beautiful, but chiefly (figuratively) good (literally or morally), i.e. valuable or virtuous (for appearance or use, and thus distinguished from G18, which is properly intrinsic):--X better, fair, good(-ly), honest, meet, well, worthy.
entries.2571: κάλυμα KA/LUMA kályma kal'-oo-mah from G2572; a cover, i.e. veil:--vail.
entries.2572: καλύπτω KALU/PTW kalýptō kal-oop'-to akin to G2813 and G2928; to cover up (literally or figuratively):--cover, hide.
entries.2573: καλῶς KALW=S kalōs kal-oce' adverb from G2570; well (usually morally):--(in a) good (place), honestly, + recover, (full) well.
entries.2574: κάμηλος KA/MHLOS kámēlos kam'-ay-los of Hebrew origin (H01581); a "camel":--camel.
entries.2575: κάμινος KA/MINOS káminos kam'-ee-nos probably from G2545; a furnace:--furnace.
entries.2576: καμμύω KAMMU/W kammýō kam-moo'-o from a compound of G2596 and the base of G3466; to shut down, i.e. close the eyes:--close.
entries.2577: κάμνω KA/MNW kámnō kam'-no apparently a primary verb; properly, to toil, i.e. (by implication) to tire (figuratively, faint, sicken):--faint, sick, be wearied.
entries.2578: κάμπτω KA/MPTW kámptō kamp'-to apparently a primary verb; to bend:--bow.
entries.2579: κἄν KA)/N kán kan from G2532 and G1437; and (or even) if:--and (also) if (so much as), if but, at the least, though, yet.
entries.2580: Κανᾶ *KANA= Kanâ kan-ah' of Hebrew origin (compare H07071); Cana, a place in Palestine:--Cana.
entries.2581: Κανανίτης *KANANI/THS Kananítēs kan-an-ee'-tace of Chaldee origin (compare H07067); zealous; Cananites, an epithet:--Canaanite (by mistake for a derivative from G5477).
entries.2582: Κανδάκη *KANDA/KH Kandákē kan-dak'-ay of foreign origin; Candacè, an Egyptian queen:--Candace.
entries.2583: κανών KANW/N kanṓn kan-ohn' from κάνη KA/NH kánē (a straight reed, i.e. rod); a rule ("canon"), i.e. (figuratively) a standard (of faith and practice); by implication, a boundary, i.e. (figuratively) a sphere (of activity):--line, rule.
entries.2584: Καπερναούμ *KAPERNAOU/M Kapernaoúm cap-er-nah-oom' of Hebrew origin (probably H03723 and H05151); Capernaum (i.e. Caphanachum), a place in Palestine:--Capernaum.
entries.2585: καπηλεύω KAPHLEU/W kapēleúō kap-ale-yoo'-o from κάπηλος KA/PHLOS kápēlos (a huckster); to retail, i.e. (by implication) to adulterate (figuratively):--corrupt.
entries.2586: καπνός KAPNO/S kapnós kap-nos' of uncertain affinity; smoke:--smoke.
entries.2587: Καππαδοκία *KAPPADOKI/A Kappadokía kap-pad-ok-ee'-ah of foreign origin; Cappadocia, a region of Asia Minor:--Cappadocia.
entries.2588: καρδία KARDI/A kardía kar-dee'-ah prolonged from a primary κάρ KA/R kár (Latin cor, "heart"); the heart, i.e. (figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the middle:--(+ broken-)heart(-ed).
entries.2589: καρδιογνώστης KARDIOGNW/STHS kardiognṓstēs kar-dee-og-noce'-tace from G2588 and G1097; a heart-knower:--which knowest the hearts.
entries.2590: καρπός KARPO/S karpós kar-pos' probably from the base of G726; fruit (as plucked), literally or figuratively:--fruit.
entries.2591: Κάρπος *KA/RPOS Kárpos kar'-pos perhaps for G2590; Carpus, probably a Christian:--Carpus.
entries.2592: καρποφορέω KARPOFORE/W karpophoréō kar-pof-or-eh'-o from G2593; to be fertile (literally or figuratively):--be (bear, bring forth) fruit(-ful).
entries.2593: καρποφόρος KARPOFO/ROS karpophóros kar-pof-or'-os from G2590 and G5342; fruitbearing (figuratively):--fruitful.
entries.2594: καρτερέω KARTERE/W karteréō kar-ter-eh'-o from a derivative of G2904 (transposed); to be strong, i.e. (figuratively) steadfast (patient):--endure.
entries.2595: κάρφος KA/RFOS kárphos kar'-fos from κάρφω KA/RFW kárphō (to wither); a dry twig or straw:--mote.
entries.2596: κατά KATA/ katá kat-ah' a primary particle; (prepositionally) down (in place or time), in varied relations (according to the case (genitive, dative or accusative) with which it is joined):--about, according as (to), after, against, (when they were) X alone, among, and, X apart, (even, like) as (concerning, pertaining to touching), X aside, at, before, beyond, by, to the charge of, (charita-)bly, concerning, + covered, (dai-)ly, down, every, (+ far more) exceeding, X more excellent, for, from … to, godly, in(-asmuch, divers, every, -to, respect of), … by, after the manner of, + by any means, beyond (out of) measure, X mightily, more, X natural, of (up-)on (X part), out (of every), over against, (+ your) X own, + particularly, so, through(-oughout, -oughout every), thus, (un-)to(-gether, -ward), X uttermost, where(-by), with. In composition it retains many of these applications, and frequently denotes opposition, distribution, or intensity.
entries.2597: καταβαίνω KATABAI/NW katabaínō kat-ab-ah'-ee-no from G2596 and the base of G939; to descend (literally or figuratively):--come (get, go, step) down, fall (down).
entries.2598: καταβάλλω KATABA/LLW katabállō kat-ab-al'-lo from G2596 and G906; to throw down:--cast down, lay.
entries.2599: καταβαρέω KATABARE/W katabaréō kat-ab-ar-eh'-o from G2596 and G916; to impose upon:--burden.
entries.2600: κατάβασις KATA/BASIS katábasis kat-ab'-as-is from G2597; a declivity:--descent.
entries.2601: καταβιβάζω KATABIBA/ZW katabibázō kat-ab-ib-ad'-zo from G2596 and a derivative of the base of G939; to cause to go down, i.e. precipitate:--bring (thrust) down.
entries.2602: καταβολή KATABOLH/ katabolḗ kat-ab-ol-ay' from G2598; a deposition, i.e. founding; figuratively, conception:--conceive, foundation.
entries.2603: καταβραβεύω KATABRABEU/W katabrabeúō kat-ab-rab-yoo'-o from G2596 and G1018 (in its original sense); to award the price against, i.e. (figuratively) to defraud (of salvation):--beguile of reward.
entries.2604: καταγγελεύς KATAGGELEU/S katangeleús kat-ang-gel-yooce' from G2605; a proclaimer:--setter forth.
entries.2605: καταγγέλλω KATAGGE/LLW katangéllō kat-ang-gel'-lo from G2596 and the base of G32; to proclaim, promulgate:--declare, preach, shew, speak of, teach.
entries.2606: καταγελάω KATAGELA/W katageláō kat-ag-el-ah'-o to laugh down, i.e. deride:--laugh to scorn.
entries.2607: καταγινώσκω KATAGINW/SKW kataginṓskō kat-ag-in-o'-sko from G2596 and G1097; to note against, i.e. find fault with:--blame, condemn.
entries.2608: κατάγνυμι KATA/GNUMI katágnymi kat-ag'-noo-mee from G2596 and the base of G4486; to rend in pieces, i.e. crack apart:--break.
entries.2609: κατάγω KATA/GW katágō kat-ag'-o from G2596 and G71; to lead down; specially, to moor a vessel:--bring (down, forth), (bring to) land, touch.
entries.2610: καταγωνίζομαι KATAGWNI/ZOMAI katagōnízomai kat-ag-o-nid'-zom-ahee from G2596 and G75; to struggle against, i.e. (by implication) to overcome:--subdue.
entries.2611: καταδέω KATADE/W katadéō kat-ad-eh'-o from G2596 and G1210; to tie down, i.e. bandage (a wound):--bind up.
entries.2612: κατάδηλος KATA/DHLOS katádēlos kat-ad'-ay-los from G2596 intensive and G1212; manifest:--far more evident.
entries.2613: καταδικάζω KATADIKA/ZW katadikázō kat-ad-ik-ad'-zo from G2596 and a derivative of G1349; to adjudge against, i.e. pronounce guilty:--condemn.
entries.2614: καταδιώκω KATADIW/KW katadiṓkō kat-ad-ee-o'-ko from G2596 and G1377; to hunt down, i.e. search for:--follow after.
entries.2615: καταδουλόω KATADOULO/W katadoulóō kat-ad-oo-lo'-o from G2596 and G1402; to enslave utterly:--bring into bondage.
entries.2616: καταδυναστεύω KATADUNASTEU/W katadynasteúō kat-ad-oo-nas-tyoo'-o from G2596 and a derivative of G1413; to exercise dominion against, i.e. oppress:--oppress.
entries.2617: καταισχύνω KATAISXU/NW kataischýnō kat-ahee-skhoo'-no from G2596 and G153; to shame down, i.e. disgrace or (by implication) put to the blush:--confound, dishonour, (be a-, make a-)shame(-d).
entries.2618: κατακαίω KATAKAI/W katakaíō kat-ak-ah'-ee-o from G2596 and G2545; to burn down (to the ground), i.e. consume wholly:--burn (up, utterly).
entries.2619: κατακαλύπτω KATAKALU/PTW katakalýptō kat-ak-al-oop'-to from G2596 and G2572; to cover wholly, i.e. veil:--cover, hide.
entries.2620: κατακαυχάομαι KATAKAUXA/OMAI katakaucháomai kat-ak-ow-khah'-om-ahee from G2596 and G2744; to exult against (i.e. over):--boast (against), glory, rejoice against.
entries.2621: κατάκειμαι KATA/KEIMAI katákeimai kat-ak'-i-mahee from G2596 and G2749; to lie down, i.e. (by implication) be sick; specially, to recline at a meal:--keep, lie, sit at meat (down).
entries.2622: κατακλάω KATAKLA/W katakláō kat-ak-lah'-o from G2596 and G2806; to break down, i.e. divide:--break.
entries.2623: κατακλείω KATAKLEI/W katakleíō kat-ak-li'-o from G2596 and G2808; to shut down (in a dungeon), i.e. incarcerate:--shut up.
entries.2624: κατακληροδοτέω KATAKLHRODOTE/W kataklērodotéō kat-ak-lay-rod-ot-eh'-o from G2596 and a derivative of a compound of G2819 and G1325; to be a giver of lots to each, i.e. (by implication) to apportion an estate:--divide by lot.
entries.2625: κατακλίνω KATAKLI/NW kataklínō kat-ak-lee'-no from G2596 and G2827; to recline down, i.e. (specially) to take a place at table:--(make) sit down (at meat).
entries.2626: κατακλύζω KATAKLU/ZW kataklýzō kat-ak-lood'-zo from G2596 and the base of G2830; to dash (wash) down, i.e. (by implication) to deluge:--overflow.
entries.2627: κατακλυσμός KATAKLUSMO/S kataklysmós kat-ak-looce-mos' from G2626; an inundation:--flood.
entries.2628: κατακολουθέω KATAKOLOUQE/W katakolouthéō kat-ak-ol-oo-theh'-o from G2596 and G190; to accompany closely:--follow (after).
entries.2629: κατακόπτω KATAKO/PTW katakóptō kat-ak-op'-to from G2596 and G2875; to chop down, i.e. mangle:--cut.
entries.2630: κατακρημνίζω KATAKRHMNI/ZW katakrēmnízō kat-ak-rame-nid'-zo from G2596 and a derivative of G2911; to precipitate down:--cast down headlong.
entries.2631: κατάκριμα KATA/KRIMA katákrima kat-ak'-ree-mah from G2632; an adverse sentence (the verdict):--condemnation.
