entries.2632: κατακρίνω KATAKRI/NW katakrínō kat-ak-ree'-no from G2596 and G2919; to judge against, i.e. sentence:--condemn, damn.
entries.2633: κατάκρισις KATA/KRISIS katákrisis kat-ak'-ree-sis from G2632; sentencing adversely (the act):--condemn(-ation).
entries.2634: κατακυριεύω KATAKURIEU/W katakyrieúō kat-ak-oo-ree-yoo'-o from G2596 and G2961; to lord against, i.e. control, subjugate:--exercise dominion over (lordship), be lord over, overcome.
entries.2635: καταλαλέω KATALALE/W katalaléō kat-al-al-eh'-o from G2637; to be a traducer, i.e. to slander:--speak against (evil of).
entries.2636: καταλαλία KATALALI/A katalalía kat-al-al-ee'-ah from G2637; defamation:--backbiting, evil speaking.
entries.2637: κατάλαλος KATA/LALOS katálalos kat-al'-al-os from G2596 and the base of G2980; talkative against, i.e. a slanderer:--backbiter.
entries.2638: καταλαμβάνω KATALAMBA/NW katalambánō kat-al-am-ban'-o from G2596 and G2983; to take eagerly, i.e. seize, possess, etc. (literally or figuratively):--apprehend, attain, come upon, comprehend, find, obtain, perceive, (over-)take.
entries.2639: καταλέγω KATALE/GW katalégō kat-al-eg'-o from G2596 and G3004 (in its original meaning); to lay down, i.e. (figuratively) to enrol:--take into the number.
entries.2640: κατάλειμμα KATA/LEIMMA katáleimma kat-al'-ime-mah from G2641; a remainder, i.e. (by implication) a few:--remnant.
entries.2641: καταλείπω KATALEI/PW kataleípō kat-al-i'-po from G2596 and G3007; to leave down, i.e. behind; by implication, to abandon, have remaining:--forsake, leave, reserve.
entries.2642: καταλιθάζω KATALIQA/ZW katalitházō kat-al-ith-ad'-zo from G2596 and G3034; to stone down, i.e. to death:--stone.
entries.2643: καταλλαγή KATALLAGH/ katallagḗ kat-al-lag-ay' from G2644; exchange (figuratively, adjustment), i.e. restoration to (the divine) favor:--atonement, reconciliation(-ing).
entries.2644: καταλλάσσω KATALLA/SSW katallássō kat-al-las'-so from G2596 and G236; to change mutually, i.e. (figuratively) to compound a difference:--reconcile.
entries.2645: κατάλοιπος KATA/LOIPOS katáloipos kat-al'-oy-pos from G2596 and G3062; left down (behind), i.e remaining (plural the rest):--residue.
entries.2646: κατάλυμα KATA/LUMA katályma kat-al'-oo-mah from G2647; properly, a dissolution (breaking up of a journey), i.e. (by implication) a lodging-place:-- guestchamber, inn.
entries.2647: καταλύω KATALU/W katalýō kat-al-oo'-o from G2596 and G3089; to loosen down (disintegrate), i.e. (by implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specially (compare G2646) to halt for the night:--destroy, dissolve, be guest, lodge, come to nought, overthrow, throw down.
entries.2648: καταμανθάνω KATAMANQA/NW katamanthánō kat-am-an-than'-o from G2596 and G3129; to learn thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to note carefully:--consider.
entries.2649: καταμαρτυρέω KATAMARTURE/W katamartyréō kat-am-ar-too-reh'-o from G2596 and G3140; to testify against:--witness against.
entries.2650: καταμένω KATAME/NW kataménō kat-am-en'-o from G2596 and G3306; to stay fully, i.e. reside:--abide.
entries.2651: καταμόνας KATAMO/NAS katamónas kat-am-on'-as from G2596 and accusative case plural feminine of G3441 (with G5561 implied); according to sole places, i.e. (adverbially) separately:--alone.
entries.2652: κατανάθεμα KATANA/QEMA katanáthema kat-an-ath'-em-ah from G2596 (intensive) and G331; an imprecation:--curse.
entries.2653: καταναθεματίζω KATANAQEMATI/ZW katanathematízō kat-an-ath-em-at-id'-zo from G2596 (intensive) and G332; to imprecate:--curse.
entries.2654: καταναλίσκω KATANALI/SKW katanalískō kat-an-al-is'-ko from G2596 and G355; to consume utterly:--consume.
entries.2655: καταναρκάω KATANARKA/W katanarkáō kat-an-ar-kah'-o from G2596 and ναρκάω NARKA/W narkáō (to be numb); to grow utterly torpid, i.e. (by implication) slothful (figuratively, expensive):--be burdensome (chargeable).
entries.2656: κατανεύω KATANEU/W kataneúō kat-an-yoo'-o from G2596 and G3506; to nod down (towards), i.e. (by analogy) to make signs to:--beckon.
entries.2657: κατανοέω KATANOE/W katanoéō kat-an-o-eh'-o from G2596 and G3539; to observe fully:--behold, consider, discover, perceive.
entries.2658: καταντάω KATANTA/W katantáō kat-an-tah'-o from G2596 and a derivative of G473; to meet against, i.e. arrive at (literally or figuratively):--attain, come.
entries.2659: κατάνυξις KATA/NUCIS katányxis kat-an'-oox-is from G2660; a prickling (sensation, as of the limbs asleep), i.e. (by implication, (perhaps by some confusion with G3506 or even with G3571)) stupor (lethargy):--slumber.
entries.2660: κατανύσσω KATANU/SSW katanýssō kat-an-oos'-so from G2596 and G3572; to pierce thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to agitate violently ("sting to the quick"):--prick.
entries.2661: καταξιόω KATACIO/W kataxióō kat-ax-ee-o'-o from G2596 and G515; to deem entirely deserving:--(ac-)count worthy.
entries.2662: καταπατέω KATAPATE/W katapatéō kat-ap-at-eh'-o from G2596 and G3961; to trample down; figuratively, to reject with disdain:--trample, tread (down, underfoot).
entries.2663: κατάπαυσις KATA/PAUSIS katápausis kat-ap'-ow-sis from G2664; reposing down, i.e. (by Hebraism) abode:--rest.
entries.2664: καταπαύω KATAPAU/W katapaúō kat-ap-ow'-o from G2596 and G3973; to settle down, i.e. (literally) to colonize, or (figuratively) to (cause to) desist:--cease, (give) rest(-rain).
entries.2665: καταπέτασμα KATAPE/TASMA katapétasma kat-ap-et'-as-mah from a compound of G2596 and a congener of G4072; something spread thoroughly, i.e. (specially) the door screen (to the Most Holy Place) in the Jewish Temple:--vail.
entries.2666: καταπίνω KATAPI/NW katapínō kat-ap-ee'-no from G2596 and G4095; to drink down, i.e. gulp entire (literally or figuratively):--devour, drown, swallow (up).
entries.2667: καταπίπτω KATAPI/PTW katapíptō kat-ap-ip'-to from G2596 and G4098; to fall down:--fall (down).
entries.2668: καταπλέω KATAPLE/W katapléō kat-ap-leh'-o from G2596 and G4126; to sail down upon a place, i.e. to land at:--arrive.
entries.2669: καταπονέω KATAPONE/W kataponéō kat-ap-on-eh'-o from G2596 and a derivative of G4192; to labor down, i.e. wear with toil (figuratively, harass):--oppress, vex.
entries.2670: καταποντίζω KATAPONTI/ZW katapontízō kat-ap-on-tid'-zo from G2596 and a derivative of the same as G4195; to plunge down, i.e. submerge:--drown, sink.
entries.2671: κατάρα KATA/RA katára kat-ar'-ah from G2596 (intensive) and G685; imprecation, execration:--curse(-d, ing).
entries.2672: καταράομαι KATARA/OMAI kataráomai kat-ar-ah'-om-ahee middle voice from G2671; to execrate; by analogy, to doom:--curse.
entries.2673: καταργέω KATARGE/W katargéō kat-arg-eh'-o from G2596 and G691; to be (render) entirely idle (useless), literally or figuratively:--abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away, become (make) of no (none, without) effect, fail, loose, bring (come) to nought, put away (down), vanish away, make void.
entries.2674: καταριθμέω KATARIQME/W katarithméō kat-ar-ith-meh'-o from G2596 and G705; to reckon among:--number with.
entries.2675: καταρτίζω KATARTI/ZW katartízō kat-ar-tid'-zo from G2596 and a derivative of G739; to complete thoroughly, i.e. repair (literally or figuratively) or adjust:--fit, frame, mend, (make) perfect(-ly join together), prepare, restore.
entries.2676: κατάρτισις KATA/RTISIS katártisis kat-ar'-tis-is from G2675; thorough equipment (subjectively):--perfection.
entries.2677: καταρτισμός KATARTISMO/S katartismós kat-ar-tis-mos' from G2675; complete furnishing (objectively):--perfecting.
entries.2678: κατασείω KATASEI/W kataseíō kat-as-i'-o from G2596 and G4579; to sway downward, i.e. make a signal:--beckon.
entries.2679: κατασκάπτω KATASKA/PTW kataskáptō kat-as-kap'-to from G2596 and G4626; to undermine, i.e. (by implication) destroy:--dig down, ruin.
entries.2680: κατασκευάζω KATASKEUA/ZW kataskeuázō kat-ask-yoo-ad'-zo from G2596 and a derivative of G4632; to prepare thoroughly (properly, by external equipment; whereas G2090 refers rather to internal fitness); by implication, to construct, create:--build, make, ordain, prepare.
entries.2681: κατασκηνόω KATASKHNO/W kataskēnóō kat-as-kay-no'-o from G2596 and G4637; to camp down, i.e. haunt; figuratively, to remain:--lodge, rest.
entries.2682: κατασκήνωσις KATASKH/NWSIS kataskḗnōsis kat-as-kay'-no-sis from G2681; an encamping, i.e. (figuratively) a perch:--nest.
entries.2683: κατασκιάζω KATASKIA/ZW kataskiázō kat-as-kee-ad'-zo from G2596 and a derivative of G4639; to overshade, i.e. cover:--shadow.
entries.2684: κατασκοπέω KATASKOPE/W kataskopéō kat-as-kop-eh'-o from G2685; to be a sentinel, i.e. to inspect insidiously:--spy out.
entries.2685: κατάσκοπος KATA/SKOPOS katáskopos kat-as'-kop-os from G2596 (intensive) and G4649 (in the sense of a watcher); a reconnoiterer:--spy.
entries.2686: κατασοφίζομαι KATASOFI/ZOMAI katasophízomai kat-as-of-id'-zom-ahee middle voice from G2596 and G4679; to be crafty against, i.e. circumvent:--deal subtilly with.
entries.2687: καταστέλλω KATASTE/LLW katastéllō kat-as-tel'-lo from G2596 and G4724; to put down, i.e. quell:--appease, quiet.
entries.2688: κατάστημα KATA/STHMA katástēma kat-as'-tay-mah from G2525; properly, a position or condition, i.e. (subjectively) demeanor:--behaviour.
entries.2689: καταστολή KATASTOLH/ katastolḗ kat-as-tol-ay' from G2687; a deposit, i.e. (specially) costume:--apparel.
entries.2690: καταστρέφω KATASTRE/FW katastréphō kat-as-tref'-o from G2596 and G4762; to turn upside down, i.e. upset:--overthrow.
entries.2691: καταστρηνιάω KATASTRHNIA/W katastrēniáō kat-as-tray-nee-ah'-o from G2596 and G4763; to become voluptuous against:--begin to wax wanton against.
entries.2692: καταστροφή KATASTROFH/ katastrophḗ kat-as-trof-ay' from G2690; an overturn ("catastrophe"), i.e. demolition; figuratively, apostasy:--overthrow, subverting.
entries.2693: καταστρώννυμι KATASTRW/NNUMI katastrṓnnymi kat-as-trone'-noo-mee from G2596 and G4766; to strew down, i.e. (by implication) to prostrate (slay):--overthrow.
entries.2694: κατασύρω KATASU/RW katasýrō kat-as-oo'-ro from G2596 and G4951; to drag down, i.e. arrest judicially:--hale.
entries.2695: κατασφάττω KATASFA/TTW kataspháttō kat-as-fat'-to from G2596 and G4969; to kill down, i.e. slaughter:--slay.
entries.2696: κατασφραγίζω KATASFRAGI/ZW katasphragízō kat-as-frag-id'-zo from G2596 and G4972; to seal closely:--seal.
entries.2697: κατάσχεσις KATA/SXESIS katáschesis kat-as'-khes-is from G2722; a holding down, i.e. occupancy:--possession.
entries.2698: κατατίθημι KATATI/QHMI katatíthēmi kat-at-ith'-ay-mee from G2596 and G5087; to place down, i.e. deposit (literally or figuratively):--do, lay, shew.
entries.2699: κατατομή KATATOMH/ katatomḗ kat-at-om-ay' from a compound of G2596 and τέμνω TE/MNW témnō (to cut); a cutting down (off), i.e. mutilation (ironically):--concision. Compare G609.
entries.2700: κατατοξεύω KATATOCEU/W katatoxeúō kat-at-ox-yoo'-o from G2596 and a derivative of G5115; to shoot down with an arrow or other missile:--thrust through.
entries.2701: κατατρέχω KATATRE/XW katatréchō kat-at-rekh'-o from G2596 and G5143; to run down, i.e. hasten from a tower:--run down.
entries.2702: καταφέρω KATAFE/RW kataphérō kat-af-er'-o from G2596 and G5342 (including its alternate); to bear down, i.e. (figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specially, to cast a vote:--fall, give, sink down.
entries.2703: καταφεύγω KATAFEU/GW katapheúgō kat-af-yoo'-go from G2596 and G5343; to flee down (away):--flee.
entries.2704: καταφθείρω KATAFQEI/RW kataphtheírō kat-af-thi'-ro from G2596 and G5351; to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or (figuratively) to deprave; --corrupt, utterly perish.
entries.2705: καταφιλέω KATAFILE/W kataphiléō kat-af-ee-leh'-o from 2596 and 5368; to kiss earnestly:--kiss.
entries.2706: καταφρονέω KATAFRONE/W kataphronéō kat-af-ron-eh'-o from G2596 and G5426; to think against, i.e. disesteem:--despise.
entries.2707: καταφροντής KATAFRONTH/S kataphrontḗs kat-af-ron-tace' from G2706; a contemner:--despiser.
entries.2708: καταχέω KATAXE/W katachéō kat-akh-eh'-o from G2596 and cheo (to pour); to pour down (out):--pour.
entries.2709: καταχθόνιος KATAXQO/NIOS katachthónios kat-akh-thon'-ee-os from G2596 and χθών XQW/N chthṓn (the ground); subterranean, i.e. infernal (belonging to the world of departed spirits):--under the earth.
entries.2710: καταχράομαι KATAXRA/OMAI katachráomai kat-akh-rah'-om-ahee from G2596 and G5530; to overuse, i.e. misuse:--abuse.
entries.2711: καταψύχω KATAYU/XW katapsýchō kat-ap-soo'-kho from G2596 and G5594; to cool down (off), i.e. refresh:--cool.
entries.2712: κατείδωλος KATEI/DWLOS kateídōlos kat-i'-do-los from G2596 (intensively) and G1497; utterly idolatrous:--wholly given to idolatry.
entries.2713: κατέναντι KATE/NANTI katénanti kat-en'-an-tee from G2596 and G1725; directly opposite:--before, over against.
entries.2714: κατενώπιον KATENW/PION katenṓpion kat-en-o'-pee-on from G2596 and G1799; directly in front of:--before (the presence of), in the sight of.
entries.2715: κατεξουσιάζω KATECOUSIA/ZW katexousiázō kat-ex-oo-see-ad'-zo from G2596 and G1850; to have (wield) full privilege over:--exercise authority.
entries.2716: κατεργάζομαι KATERGA/ZOMAI katergázomai kat-er-gad'-zom-ahee from G2596 and G2038; to work fully, i.e. accomplish; by implication, to finish, fashion:--cause, to (deed), perform, work (out).
entries.2718: κατέρχομαι KATE/RXOMAI katérchomai kat-er'-khom-ahee from G2596 and G2064 (including its alternate); to come (or go) down (literally or figuratively):--come (down), depart, descend, go down, land.
entries.2719: κατεσθίω KATESQI/W katesthíō kat-es-thee'-o from G2596 and G2068 (including its alternate); to eat down, i.e. devour (literally or figuratively):--devour.
entries.2720: κατευθύνω KATEUQU/NW kateuthýnō kat-yoo-thoo'-no from G2596 and G2116; to straighten fully, i.e. (figuratively) direct:--guide, direct.
entries.2721: κατεφίστημι KATEFI/STHMI katephístēmi kat-ef-is'-tay-mee from G2596 and G2186; to stand over against, i.e. rush upon (assault):--make insurrection against.
entries.2722: κατέχω KATE/XW katéchō kat-ekh'-o from G2596 and G2192; to hold down (fast), in various applications (literally or figuratively):--have, hold (fast), keep (in memory), let, X make toward, possess, retain, seize on, stay, take, withhold.
entries.2723: κατηγορέω KATHGORE/W katēgoréō kat-ay-gor-eh'-o from G2725; to be a plaintiff, i.e. to charge with some offence:--accuse, object.
entries.2724: κατηγορία KATHGORI/A katēgoría kat-ay-gor-ee'-ah from G2725; a complaint ("category"), i.e. criminal charge:--accusation (X -ed).
entries.2725: κατήγορος KATH/GOROS katḗgoros kat-ay'-gor-os from G2596 and G58; against one in the assembly, i.e. a complainant at law; specially, Satan:--accuser.
entries.2726: κατήφεια KATH/FEIA katḗpheia kat-ay'-fi-ah from a compound of G2596 and perhaps a derivative of the base of G5316 (meaning downcast in look); demureness, i.e. (by implication) sadness:--heaviness.
entries.2727: κατηχέω KATHXE/W katēchéō kat-ay-kheh'-o from G2596 and G2279; to sound down into the ears, i.e. (by implication) to indoctrinate ("catechize") or (genitive case) to apprise of:--inform, instruct, teach.
entries.2728: κατιόω KATIO/W katióō kat-ee-o'-o from G2596 and a derivative of G2447; to rust down, i.e. corrode:--canker.
entries.2729: κατισχύω KATISXU/W katischýō kat-is-khoo'-o from G2596 and G2480; to overpower:--prevail (against).
entries.2730: κατοικέω KATOIKE/W katoikéō kat-oy-keh'-o from G2596 and G3611; to house permanently, i.e. reside (literally or figuratively):--dwell(-er), inhabitant(-ter).
entries.2731: κατοίκησις KATOI/KHSIS katoíkēsis kat-oy'-kay-sis from G2730; residence (properly, the act; but by implication, concretely, the mansion):--dwelling.
entries.2732: κατοικητήριον KATOIKHTH/RION katoikētḗrion kat-oy-kay-tay'-ree-on from a derivative of G2730; a dwelling-place:--habitation.
entries.2733: κατοικία KATOIKI/A katoikía kat-oy-kee'-ah residence (properly, the condition; but by implication, the abode itself):--habitation.
entries.2734: κατοπτρίζομαι KATOPTRI/ZOMAI katoptrízomai kat-op-trid'-zom-ahee middle voice from a compound of G2596 and a derivative of G3700 (compare G2072); to mirror oneself, i.e. to see reflected (figuratively):--behold as in a glass.
entries.2735: κατόρθωμα KATO/RQWMA katórthōma kat-or'-tho-mah from a compound of G2596 and a derivative of G3717 (compare G1357); something made fully upright, i.e. (figuratively) rectification (specially, good public administration):--very worthy deed.
entries.2736: κάτω KA/TW kátō kat'-o ; also (compare) κατωτέρω KATWTE/RW katōtérō kat-o-ter'-o (compare G2737); adverb from G2596; downwards:--beneath, bottom, down, under.
entries.2737: κατώτερος KATW/TEROS katṓteros kat-o'-ter-os comparative from G2736; inferior (locally, of Hades):--lower.
entries.2738: καῦμα KAU=MA kaûma kow'-mah from G2545; properly, a burn (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a glow:--heat.
entries.2739: καυματίζω KAUMATI/ZW kaumatízō kow-mat-id'-zo from G2738; to burn:--scorch.
entries.2740: καῦσις KAU=SIS kaûsis kow'-sis from G2545; burning (the act):--be burned.
entries.2741: καυσόω KAUSO/W kausóō kow-so'-o from G2740; to set on fire:--fervent heat.
entries.2742: καύσων KAU/SWN kaúsōn kow'-sone from G2741; a glare:--(burning) heat.
entries.2743: καυτηριάζω KAUTHRIA/ZW kautēriázō kow-tay-ree-ad'-zo from a derivative of G2545; to brand ("cauterize"), i.e. (by implication) to render unsensitive (figuratively):--sear with a hot iron.
entries.2744: καυχάομαι KAUXA/OMAI kaucháomai kow-khah'-om-ahee from some (obsolete) base akin to that of αὐχέω AU)XE/W auchéō (to boast) and G2172; to vaunt (in a good or a bad sense):--(make) boast, glory, joy, rejoice.
entries.2745: καύχημα KAU/XHMA kaúchēma kow'-khay-mah from G2744; a boast (properly, the object; by implication, the act) in a good or a bad sense:--boasting, (whereof) to glory (of), glorying, rejoice(-ing).
entries.2746: καύχησις KAU/XHSIS kaúchēsis kow'-khay-sis from G2744; boasting (properly, the act; by implication, the object), in a good or a bad sense:--boasting, whereof I may glory, glorying, rejoicing.
entries.2747: Κεγχρεαί *KEGXREAI/ Kenchreaí keng-khreh-a'-hee probably from κέγχρος KE/GXROS kénchros (millet); Cenchreæ, a port of Corinth:--Cencrea.
entries.2748: Κεδρών *KEDRW/N Kedrṓn ked-rone' of Hebrew origin (H06939); Cedron (i.e. Kidron), a brook near Jerusalem:--Cedron.
entries.2749: κεῖμαι KEI=MAI keîmai ki'-mahee middle voice of a primary verb; to lie outstretched (literally or figuratively):--be (appointed, laid up, made, set), lay, lie. Compare G5087.
entries.2750: κειρία KEIRI/A keiría ki-ree'-ah of uncertain affinity; a swathe, i.e. winding-sheet:--graveclothes.
entries.2751: κείρω KEI/RW keírō ki'-ro a primary verb; to shear:--shear(-er).
entries.2752: κέλευμα KE/LEUMA kéleuma kel'-yoo-mah from G2753; a cry of incitement:--shout.
entries.2753: κελεύω KELEU/W keleúō kel-yoo'-o from a primary κέλλω KE/LLW kéllō (to urge on); "hail"; to incite by word, i.e. order:--bid, (at, give) command(-ment).
entries.2754: κενοδοξία KENODOCI/A kenodoxía ken-od-ox-ee'-ah from G2755; empty glorying, i.e. self-conceit:--vain-glory.
entries.2755: κενόδοξος KENO/DOCOS kenódoxos ken-od'-ox-os from G2756 and G1391; vainly glorifying, i.e. self-conceited:--desirous of vain-glory.
entries.2756: κενός KENO/S kenós ken-os' apparently a primary word; empty (literally or figuratively):--empty, (in) vain.
entries.2757: κενοφωνία KENOFWNI/A kenophōnía ken-of-o-nee'-ah from a presumed compound of G2756 and G5456; empty sounding, i.e. fruitless discussion:--vain.
entries.2758: κενόω KENO/W kenóō ken-o'-o from G2756; to make empty, i.e. (figuratively) to abase, neutralize, falsify:--make (of none effect, of no reputation, void), be in vain.
entries.2759: κέντρον KE/NTRON kéntron ken'-tron from κεντέω KENTE/W kentéō (to prick); a point ("centre"), i.e. a sting (figuratively, poison) or goad (figuratively, divine impulse):--prick, sting.
entries.2760: κεντυρίων KENTURI/WN kentyríōn ken-too-ree'-ohn of Latin origin; a centurion, i.e. captain of one hundred soldiers:--centurion.
entries.2761: κενῶς KENW=S kenōs ken-oce' adverb from G2756; vainly, i.e. to no purpose:--in vain.
entries.2762: κεραία KERAI/A keraía ker-ah'-yah feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of G2768; something horn-like, i.e. (specially) the apex of a Hebrew letter (figuratively, the least particle):--tittle.
entries.2763: κεραμεύς KERAMEU/S kerameús ker-am-yooce' from G2766; a potter:--potter.
entries.2764: κεραμικός KERAMIKO/S keramikós ker-am-ik-os' from G2766; made of clay, i.e. earthen:--of a potter.
entries.2765: κεράμιον KERA/MION kerámion ker-am'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G2766; an earthenware vessel, i.e. jar:--pitcher.
entries.2766: κέραμος KE/RAMOS kéramos ker'-am-os probably from the base of G2767 (through the idea of mixing clay and water); earthenware, i.e. a tile (by analogy, a thin roof or awning):--tiling.
entries.2767: κεράννυμι KERA/NNUMI keránnymi ker-an'-noo-mee prolonged form of a more primary κεράω KERA/W keráō ker-ah'-o (which is used in certain tenses); to mingle, i.e. (by implication) to pour out (for drinking):--fill, pour out. Compare G3396.
entries.2768: κέρας KE/RAS kéras ker'-as from a primary κάρ KA/R kár (the hair of the head); a horn (literally or figuratively):--horn.
entries.2769: κεράτιον KERA/TION kerátion ker-at'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G2768; something horned, i.e. (specially) the pod of the carob-tree:--husk.
entries.2770: κερδαίνω KERDAI/NW kerdaínō ker-dah'-ee-no from G2771; to gain (literally or figuratively):--(get) gain, win.
entries.2771: κέρδος KE/RDOS kérdos ker'-dos of uncertain affinity; gain (pecuniary or genitive case):--gain, lucre.
entries.2772: κέρμα KE/RMA kérma ker'-mah from G2751; a clipping (bit), i.e. (specially) a coin:--money.
entries.2773: κερματιστής KERMATISTH/S kermatistḗs ker-mat-is-tace' from a derivative of G2772; a handler of coins, i.e. money-broker:--changer of money.
entries.2774: κεφάλαιον KEFA/LAION kephálaion kef-al'-ah-yon neuter of a derivative of G2776; a principal thing, i.e. main point; specially, an amount (of money):--sum.
entries.2775: κεφαλαιόω KEFALAIO/W kephalaióō kef-al-ahee-o'-o from the same as G2774; (specially) to strike on the head:--wound in the head.
entries.2776: κεφαλή KEFALH/ kephalḗ kef-al-ay' from the primary κάπτω KA/PTW káptō (in the sense of seizing); the head (as the part most readily taken hold of), literally or figuratively:--head.
entries.2777: κεφαλίς KEFALI/S kephalís kef-al-is' from G2776; properly, a knob, i.e. (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled):--volume.
entries.2778: κῆνσος KH=NSOS kēnsos kane'-sos of Latin origin; properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e. (by implication) a tax:--tribute.
entries.2779: κῆπος KH=POS kēpos kay'-pos of uncertain affinity; a garden:--garden.
entries.2780: κηπουρός KHPOURO/S kēpourós kay-poo-ros' from G2779 and οὖρος OU)=ROS oûros (a warden); a garden-keeper, i.e. gardener:--gardener.
entries.2781: κηρίον KHRI/ON kēríon kay-ree'-on diminutive from κηός KHO/S kēós (wax); a cell for honey, i.e. (collectively) the comb:--(honey-)comb.
entries.2782: κήρυγμα KH/RUGMA kḗrygma kay'-roog-mah from G2784; a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication, the gospel itself):--preaching.
entries.2783: κῆρυξ KH=RUC kēryx kay'-roox from G2784; a herald, i.e. of divine truth (especially of the gospel):--preacher.
entries.2784: κηρύσσω KHRU/SSW kērýssō kay-roos'-so of uncertain affinity; to herald (as a public crier), especially divine truth (the gospel):--preacher(-er), proclaim, publish.
entries.2785: κῆτος KH=TOS kētos kay'-tos probably from the base of G5490; a huge fish (as gaping for prey):--whale.
entries.2786: Κηφᾶς *KHFA=S Kēphâs kay-fas' of Chaldee origin (compare H03710); the Rock; Cephas (i.e. Kepha), a surname of Peter:--Cephas.
entries.2787: κιβωτός KIBWTO/S kibōtós kib-o-tos' of uncertain derivation; a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of Noah:--ark.
entries.2788: κιθάρα KIQA/RA kithára kith-ar'-ah of uncertain affinity; a lyre:--harp.
entries.2789: κιθαρίζω KIQARI/ZW kitharízō kith-ar-id'-zo from G2788; to play on a lyre:--harp.
entries.2790: κιθαρῳδός KIQARW|DO/S kitharōidós kith-ar-o'-dos from G2788 and a derivative of the same as G5603; a lyre-singer(-player), i.e. harpist:--harper.
entries.2791: Κιλικία *KILIKI/A Kilikía kil-ik-ee'-ah probably of foreign origin; Cilicia, a region of Asia Minor:--Cilicia.
entries.2792: κινάμωμον KINA/MWMON kinámōmon kin-am'-o-mon of foreign origin (compare H07076); cinnamon:--cinnamon.
entries.2793: κινδυνεύω KINDUNEU/W kindyneúō kin-doon-yoo'-o from G2794; to undergo peril:--be in danger, be (stand) in jeopardy.
entries.2794: κίνδυνος KI/NDUNOS kíndynos kin'-doo-nos of uncertain derivation; danger:--peril.
entries.2795: κινέω KINE/W kinéō kin-eh'-o from κίω KI/W kíō (poetic for εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi, to go); to stir (transitively), literally or figuratively:--(re-)move(-r), way.
entries.2796: κίνησις KI/NHSIS kínēsis kin'-ay-sis from G2795; a stirring:--moving.
entries.2797: Κίς *KI/S Kís kis of Hebrew origin (H07027); Cis (i.e. Kish), an Israelite:--Cis.
entries.2798: κλάδος KLA/DOS kládos klad'-os from G2806; a twig or bough (as if broken off):--branch.
entries.2799: κλαίω KLAI/W klaíō klah'-yo of uncertain affinity; to sob, i.e. wail aloud (whereas 1145 is rather to cry silently):--bewail, weep.
entries.2800: κλάσις KLA/SIS klásis klas'-is from G2806; fracture (the act):--breaking.
entries.2801: κλάσμα KLA/SMA klásma klas'-mah from G2806; a piece (bit):--broken, fragment.
entries.2802: Κλαύδη *KLAU/DH Klaúdē klow'-day of uncertain derivation; Claude, an island near Crete:--Clauda.
entries.2803: Κλαυδία *KLAUDI/A Klaudía klow-dee'-ah feminine of G2804; Claudia, a Christian woman:--Claudia.
entries.2804: Κλαύδιος *KLAU/DIOS Klaúdios klow'-dee-os of Latin origin; Claudius, the name of two Romans:--Claudius.
entries.2805: κλαυθμός KLAUQMO/S klauthmós klowth-mos' from G2799; lamentation:--wailing, weeping, X wept.
entries.2806: κλάω KLA/W kláō klah'-o a primary verb; to break (specially, of bread):--break.
entries.2807: κλείς KLEI/S kleís klice from G2808; a key (as shutting a lock), literally or figuratively:--key.
entries.2808: κλείω KLEI/W kleíō kli'-o a primary verb; to close (literally or figuratively):--shut (up).
entries.2809: κλέμμα KLE/MMA klémma klem'-mah from G2813; stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the act):--theft.
entries.2810: Κλεόπας *KLEO/PAS Kleópas kleh-op'-as probably contracted from Κλεόπατρος *KLEO/PATROS Kleópatros (compound of G2811 and G3962); Cleopas, a Christian:--Cleopas.
entries.2811: κλέος KLE/OS kléos kleh'-os from a shorter form of G2564; renown (as if being called):--glory.
entries.2812: κλέπτης KLE/PTHS kléptēs klep'-tace from G2813; a stealer (literally or figuratively):--thief. Compare G3027.
entries.2813: κλέπτω KLE/PTW kléptō klep'-to a primary verb; to filch:--steal.
entries.2814: κλῆμα KLH=MA klēma kaly'-mah from G2806; a limb or shoot (as if broken off):--branch.
entries.2815: Κλήμης *KLH/MHS Klḗmēs klay'-mace of Latin origin; merciful; Clemes (i.e. Clemens), a Christian:--Clement.
entries.2816: κληρονομέω KLHRONOME/W klēronoméō klay-ron-om-eh'-o from G2818; to be an heir to (literally or figuratively):--be heir, (obtain by) inherit(-ance).
entries.2817: κληρονομία KLHRONOMI/A klēronomía klay-ron-om-ee'-ah from G2818; heirship, i.e. (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case) a possession:--inheritance.
entries.2818: κληρονόμος KLHRONO/MOS klēronómos klay-ron-om'-os from G2819 and the base of G3551 (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. (reflexively) getting by apportionment); a sharer by lot, i.e. inheritor (literally or figuratively); by implication, a possessor:--heir.
entries.2819: κλῆρος KLH=ROS klēros klay'-ros probably from G2806 (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose; a die (for drawing chances); by implication, a portion (as if so secured); by extension, an acquisition (especially a patrimony, figuratively):--heritage, inheritance, lot, part.
entries.2820: κληρόω KLHRO/W klēróō klay-ro'-o from G2819; to allot, i.e. (figuratively) to assign (a privilege):--obtain an inheritance.
entries.2821: κλῆσις KLH=SIS klēsis klay'-sis from a shorter form of G2564; an invitation (figuratively):--calling.
entries.2822: κλητός KLHTO/S klētós klay-tos' from the same as G2821; invited, i.e. appointed, or (specially), a saint:--called.
entries.2823: κλίβανος KLI/BANOS klíbanos klib'-an-os of uncertain derivation; an earthen pot used for baking in:--oven.
entries.2824: κλίμα KLI/MA klíma klee'-mah from G2827; a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of country:--part, region.
entries.2825: κλίνη KLI/NH klínē klee'-nay from G2827; a couch (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating):--bed, table.
entries.2826: κλινίδιον KLINI/DION klinídion klin-id'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G2825; a pallet or little couch:--bed.
entries.2827: κλίνω KLI/NW klínō klee'-no a primary verb; to slant or slope, i.e. incline or recline (literally or figuratively):--bow (down), be far spent, lay, turn to flight, wear away.
entries.2828: κλισία KLISI/A klisía klee-see'-ah from a derivative of G2827; properly, reclination, i.e. (concretely and specially), a party at a meal:--company.
entries.2829: κλοπή KLOPH/ klopḗ klop-ay' from G2813; stealing:--theft.
entries.2830: κλύδων KLU/DWN klýdōn kloo'-dohn from κλύζω KLU/ZW klýzō (to billow or dash over); a surge of the sea (literally or figuratively):--raging, wave.
entries.2831: κλυδωνίζομαι KLUDWNI/ZOMAI klydōnízomai kloo-do-nid'-zom-ahee middle voice from G2830; to surge, i.e. (figuratively) to fluctuate:--toss to and fro.
entries.2832: Κλωπᾶς *KLWPA=S Klōpâs klo-pas' of Chaldee origin (corresponding to H0256); Clopas, an Israelite:--Cleophas.
entries.2833: κνήθω KNH/QW knḗthō knay'-tho from a primary κνάω KNA/W knáō (to scrape); to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to tickle:--X itching.
entries.2834: Κνίδος *KNI/DOS Knídos knee'-dos probably of foreign origin; Cnidus, a place in Asia Minor:--Cnidus.
entries.2835: κοδράντης KODRA/NTHS kodrántēs kod-ran'-tace of Latin origin; a quadrans, i.e. the fourth part of an as:--farthing.
entries.2836: κοιλία KOILI/A koilía koy-lee'-ah from κοῖλος KOI=LOS koîlos ("hollow"); a cavity, i.e. (especially) the abdomen; by implication, the matrix; figuratively, the heart:--belly, womb.
entries.2837: κοιμάω KOIMA/W koimáō koy-mah'-o from G2749; to put to sleep, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to slumber; figuratively, to decease:--(be a-, fall a-, fall on) sleep, be dead.
entries.2838: κοίμησις KOI/MHSIS koímēsis koy'-may-sis from G2837; sleeping, i.e. (by implication) repose:--taking of rest.
entries.2839: κοινός KOINO/S koinós koy-nos' probably from G4862; common, i.e. (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) profane:--common, defiled, unclean, unholy.
entries.2840: κοινόω KOINO/W koinóō koy-no'-o from G2839; to make (or consider) profane (ceremonially):--call common, defile, pollute, unclean.
entries.2841: κοινωνέω KOINWNE/W koinōnéō koy-no-neh'-o from G2844; to share with others (objectively or subjectively):--communicate, distribute, be partaker.
entries.2842: κοινωνία KOINWNI/A koinōnía koy-nohn-ee'-ah from G2844; partnership, i.e. (literally) participation, or (social) intercourse, or (pecuniary) benefaction:--(to) communicate(-ation), communion, (contri-)distribution, fellowship.
entries.2843: κοινωνικός KOINWNIKO/S koinōnikós koy-no-nee-kos' from G2844; communicative, i.e. (pecuniarily) liberal:--willing to communicate.
entries.2844: κοινωνός KOINWNO/S koinōnós koy-no-nos' from G2839; a sharer, i.e. associate:--companion, X fellowship, partaker, partner.
entries.2845: κοίτη KOI/TH koítē koy'-tay from G2749; a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the male sperm:--bed, chambering, X conceive.
entries.2846: κοιτών KOITW/N koitṓn koy-tone' from G2845; a bedroom:--+ chamberlain.
entries.2847: κόκκινος KO/KKINOS kókkinos kok'-kee-nos from G2848 (from the kernel-shape of the insect); crimson-colored:--scarlet (colour, coloured).
entries.2848: κόκκος KO/KKOS kókkos kok'-kos apparently a primary word; a kernel of seed:--corn, grain.
entries.2849: κολάζω KOLA/ZW kolázō kol-ad'-zo from κόλος KO/LOS kólos (dwarf); properly, to curtail, i.e. (figuratively) to chastise (or reserve for infliction):--punish.
entries.2850: κολακεία KOLAKEI/A kolakeía kol-ak-i'-ah from a derivative of κόλαξ KO/LAC kólax (a fawner); flattery:-- X flattering.
entries.2851: κόλασις KO/LASIS kólasis kol'-as-is from G2849; penal infliction:--punishment, torment.
entries.2852: κολαφίζω KOLAFI/ZW kolaphízō kol-af-id'-zo from a derivative of the base of G2849; to rap with the fist:--buffet.
entries.2853: κολλάω KOLLA/W kolláō kol-lah'-o from κόλλα KO/LLA kólla ("glue"); to glue, i.e. (passively or reflexively) to stick (figuratively):--cleave, join (self), keep company.
entries.2854: κολλούριον KOLLOU/RION kolloúrion kol-loo'-ree-on neuter of a presumed derivative of κολλύρα KOLLU/RA kollýra (a cake; prob akin to the base of G2853); properly, a poultice (as made of or in the form of crackers), i.e. (by analogy) a plaster:-- eyesalve.
entries.2855: κολλυβιστής KOLLUBISTH/S kollybistḗs kol-loo-bis-tace' from a presumed derivative of κόλλυβος KO/LLUBOS kóllybos (a small coin; probably akin to G2854); a coin-dealer:--(money-)changer.
entries.2856: κολοβόω KOLOBO/W kolobóō kol-ob-o'-o from a derivative of the base of G2849; to dock, i.e. (figuratively) abridge:--shorten.
entries.2857: Κολοσσαί *KOLOSSAI/ Kolossaí kol-os-sah'-ee apparently feminine plural of κολοσσός KOLOSSO/S kolossós ("colossal"); Colossæ, a place in Asia Minor:--Colosse.
entries.2858: Κολοσσαεύς *KOLOSSAEU/S Kolossaeús kol-os-sayoos' from G2857; a Colossæan, (i.e. inhabitant of Colossæ:--Colossian.
entries.2859: κόλπος KO/LPOS kólpos kol'-pos apparently a primary word; the bosom; by analogy, a bay:--bosom, creek.
entries.2860: κολυμβάω KOLUMBA/W kolymbáō kol-oom-bah'-o from κόλυμβος KO/LUMBOS kólymbos (a diver); to plunge into water:--swim.
entries.2861: κολυμβήθρα KOLUMBH/QRA kolymbḗthra kol-oom-bay'-thrah from G2860; a diving-place, i.e. pond for bathing (or swimming):--pool.
entries.2862: κολωνία KOLWNI/A kolōnía kol-o-nee'-ah of Latin origin; a Roman "colony" for veterans:--colony.
entries.2863: κομάω KOMA/W komáō kom-ah'-o from G2864; to wear tresses of hair:--have long hair.
entries.2864: κόμη KO/MH kómē kom'-ay apparently from the same as G2865; the hair of the head (locks, as ornamental, and thus differing from G2359; which properly denotes merely the scalp):--hair.
entries.2865: κομίζω KOMI/ZW komízō kom-id'-zo from a primary κομέω KOME/W koméō (to tend, i.e. take care of); properly, to provide for, i.e. (by implication) to carry off (as if from harm; genitive case obtain):--bring, receive.
entries.2866: κομψότερον KOMYO/TERON kompsóteron komp-sot'-er-on neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of 2865 (meaning, properly, well dressed, i.e. nice); figuratively, convalescent:--+ began to amend.
entries.2867: κονιάω KONIA/W koniáō kon-ee-ah'-o from κονία KONI/A konía (dust; by analogy, lime); to whitewash:--whiten.
entries.2868: κονιορτός KONIORTO/S koniortós kon-ee-or-tos' from the base of G2867 and ὄρνυμι O)/RNUMI órnymi (to "rouse"); pulverulence (as blown about):--dust.
entries.2869: κοπάζω KOPA/ZW kopázō kop-ad'-zo from G2873; to tire, i.e. (figuratively) to relax:--cease.
entries.2870: κοπετός KOPETO/S kopetós kop-et-os' from G2875; mourning (properly, by beating the breast):--lamentation.
entries.2871: κοπή KOPH/ kopḗ kop-ay' from G2875; cutting, i.e. carnage:--slaughter.
entries.2872: κοπιάω KOPIA/W kopiáō kop-ee-ah'-o from a derivative of G2873; to feel fatigue; by implication, to work hard:--(bestow) labour, toil, be wearied.
entries.2873: κόπος KO/POS kópos kop'-os from G2875; a cut, i.e. (by analogy) toil (as reducing the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication, pains:--labour, + trouble, weariness.
entries.2874: κοπρία KOPRI/A kopría kop-ree'-ah from κόπρος KO/PROS kópros (ordure; perhaps akin to G2875); manure:--dung(-hill).
entries.2875: κόπτω KO/PTW kóptō kop'-to a primary verb; to "chop"; specially, to beat the breast in grief:--cut down, lament, mourn, (be-)wail. Compare the base of G5114.
entries.2876: κόραξ KO/RAC kórax kor'-ax perhaps from G2880; a crow (from its voracity):--raven.
entries.2877: κοράσιον KORA/SION korásion kor-as'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of κόρη KO/RH kórē (a maiden); a (little) girl:--damsel, maid.
entries.2878: κορβᾶν KORBA=N korbân kor-ban' and κορβανᾶς KORBANA=S korbanâs kor-ban-as' of Hebrew and Chaldee origin respectively (H07133); a votive offering and the offering; a consecrated present (to the Temple fund); by extension (the latter term) the Treasury itself, i.e. the room where the contribution boxes stood:--Corban, treasury.
entries.2879: Κορέ *KORE/ Koré kor-eh' of Hebrew origin (H07141); Core (i.e. Korach), an Israelite:--Core.
entries.2880: κορέννυμι KORE/NNUMI korénnymi kor-en'-noo-mee a primary verb; to cram, i.e. glut or sate:--eat enough, full.
entries.2881: Κορίνθιος *KORI/NQIOS Korínthios kor-in'-thee-os from G2882; a Corinthian, i.e. inhabitant of Corinth:--Corinthian.
entries.2882: Κόρινθος *KO/RINQOS Kórinthos kor'-in-thos of uncertain derivation; Corinthus, a city of Greece:--Corinth.
entries.2883: Κορνήλιος *KORNH/LIOS Kornḗlios kor-nay'-lee-os of Latin origin; Cornelius, a Roman:--Cornelius.
entries.2884: κόρος KO/ROS kóros kor'-os of Hebrew origin (H03734); a cor, i.e. a specific measure:--measure.
entries.2885: κοσμέω KOSME/W kosméō kos-meh'-o from G2889; to put in proper order, i.e. decorate (literally or figuratively); specially, to snuff (a wick):--adorn, garnish, trim.
entries.2886: κοσμικός KOSMIKO/S kosmikós kos-mee-kos' from G2889 (in its secondary sense); terrene ("cosmic"), literally (mundane) or figuratively (corrupt):--worldly.
entries.2887: κόσμιος KO/SMIOS kósmios kos'-mee-os from G2889 (in its primary sense); orderly, i.e. decorous:--of good behaviour, modest.
entries.2888: κοσμοκράτωρ KOSMOKRA/TWR kosmokrátōr kos-mok-fat'-ore from G2889 and G2902; a world-ruler, an epithet of Satan:--ruler.
entries.2889: κόσμος KO/SMOS kósmos kos'-mos probably from the base of G2865; orderly arrangement, i.e. decoration; by implication, the world (in a wide or narrow sense, including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively (morally)):--adorning, world.
entries.2890: Κούαρτος *KOU/ARTOS Koúartos koo'-ar-tos of Latin origin (fourth); Quartus, a Christian:--Quartus.
entries.2891: κοῦμι KOU=MI koûmi koo'-mee of Chaldee origin (H06966); cumi (i.e. rise!):--cumi.
entries.2892: κουστωδία KOUSTWDI/A koustōdía koos-to-dee'-ah of Latin origin; "custody", i.e. a Roman sentry:--watch.
entries.2893: κουφίζω KOUFI/ZW kouphízō koo-fid'-zo from κοῦφος KOU=FOS koûphos (light in weight); to unload:--lighten.
entries.2894: κόφινος KO/FINOS kóphinos kof'-ee-nos of uncertain derivation; a (small) basket:--basket.
entries.2895: κράββατος KRA/BBATOS krábbatos krab'-bat-os probably of foreign origin; a mattress:--bed.
entries.2896: κράζω KRA/ZW krázō krad'-zo a primary verb; properly, to "croak" (as a raven) or scream, i.e. (genitive case) to call aloud (shriek, exclaim, intreat):--cry (out).
entries.2897: κραιπάλη KRAIPA/LH kraipálē krahee-pal'-ay probably from the same as G726; properly, a headache (as a seizure of pain) from drunkenness, i.e. (by implication) a debauch (by analogy, a glut):--surfeiting.
entries.2898: κρανίον KRANI/ON kraníon kran-ee'-on diminutive of a derivative of the base of G2768; a skull ("cranium"):--Calvary, skull.
entries.2899: κράσπεδον KRA/SPEDON kráspedon kras'-ped-on of uncertain derivation; a margin, i.e. (specially), a fringe or tassel:--border, hem.
entries.2900: κραταιός KRATAIO/S krataiós krat-ah-yos' from G2904; powerful:--mighty.
entries.2901: κραταιόω KRATAIO/W krataióō krat-ah-yo'-o from G2900; to empower, i.e. (passively) increase in vigor:--be strengthened, be (wax) strong.
entries.2902: κρατέω KRATE/W kratéō krat-eh'-o from G2904; to use strength, i.e. seize or retain (literally or figuratively):--hold (by, fast), keep, lay hand (hold) on, obtain, retain, take (by).
entries.2903: κράτιστος KRA/TISTOS krátistos krat'-is-tos superlative of a derivative of G2904; strongest, i.e. (in dignity) very honorable:--most excellent (noble).
entries.2904: κράτος KRA/TOS krátos krat'-os perhaps a primary word; vigor ("great") (literally or figuratively):--dominion, might(-ily), power, strength.
entries.2905: κραυγάζω KRAUGA/ZW kraugázō krow-gad'-zo from G2906; to clamor:--cry out.
entries.2906: κραυγή KRAUGH/ kraugḗ krow-gay' from G2896; an outcry (in notification, tumult or grief):--clamour, cry(-ing).
entries.2907: κρέας KRE/AS kréas kreh'-as perhaps a primary word; (butcher's) meat:--flesh.
entries.2908: κρεῖσσον KREI=SSON kreîsson krice'-son neuter of an alternate form of G2909; (as noun) better, i.e. greater advantage:--better.
entries.2909: κρείττων KREI/TTWN kreíttōn krite'-tohn comparative of a derivative of G2904; stronger, i.e. (figuratively) better, i.e. nobler:--best, better.
entries.2910: κρεμάννυμι KREMA/NNUMI kremánnymi krem-an'-noo-mee a prolonged form of a primary verb; to hang:--hang.
entries.2911: κρημνός KRHMNO/S krēmnós krame-nos' from G2910; overhanging, i.e. a precipice:--steep place.
entries.2912: Κρής *KRH/S Krḗs krace from G2914; a Cretan, i.e. inhabitant of Crete:--Crete, Cretian.
entries.2913: Κρήσκης *KRH/SKHS Krḗskēs krace'-kace of Latin origin; growing; Cresces (i.e. Crescens), a Christian:--Crescens.
entries.2914: Κρήτη *KRH/TH Krḗtē kray'-tay of uncertain derivation; Crete, an island in the Mediterranean:--Crete.
entries.2915: κριθή KRIQH/ krithḗ kree-thay' of uncertain derivation; barley:--barley.
entries.2916: κρίθινος KRI/QINOS kríthinos kree'-thee-nos from G2915; consisting of barley:--barley.
entries.2917: κρίμα KRI/MA kríma kree'-mah from G2919; a decision (the function or the effect, for or against ("crime")):--avenge, condemned, condemnation, damnation, + go to law, judgment.
entries.2918: κρίνον KRI/NON krínon kree'-non perhaps a prim word; a lily:--lily.
entries.2919: κρίνω KRI/NW krínō kree'-no properly, to distinguish, i.e. decide (mentally or judicially); by implication, to try, condemn, punish:--avenge, conclude, condemn, damn, decree, determine, esteem, judge, go to (sue at the) law, ordain, call in question, sentence to, think.
entries.2920: κρίσις KRI/SIS krísis kree'-sis decision (subjectively or objectively, for or against); by extension, a tribunal; by implication, justice (especially, divine law):--accusation, condemnation, damnation, judgment.
entries.2921: Κρίσπος *KRI/SPOS Kríspos kris'-pos of Latin origin; "crisp"; Crispus, a Corinthian:--Crispus.
entries.2922: κριτήριον KRITH/RION kritḗrion kree-tay'-ree-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G2923; a rule of judging ("criterion"), i.e. (by implication) a tribunal:--to judge, judgment (seat).
entries.2923: κριτής KRITH/S kritḗs kree-tace' from G2919; a judge (genitive case or specially):--judge.
entries.2924: κριτικός KRITIKO/S kritikós krit-ee-kos' from G2923; decisive ("critical"), i.e. discriminative:--discerner.
entries.2925: κρούω KROU/W kroúō kroo'-o apparently a primary verb; to rap:--knock.
entries.2926: κρύπτη KRU/PTH krýptē kroop-tay' feminine of G2927; a hidden place, i.e. cellar ("crypt"):--secret.
entries.2927: κρυπτός KRUPTO/S kryptós kroop-tos' from G2928; concealed, i.e. private:--hid(-den), inward(-ly), secret.
entries.2928: κρύπτω KRU/PTW krýptō kroop'-to a primary verb; to conceal (properly, by covering):--hide (self), keep secret, secret(-ly).
entries.2929: κρυσταλλίζω KRUSTALLI/ZW krystallízō kroos-tal-lid'-zo from G2930; to make (i.e. intransitively, resemble) ice ("crystallize"):--be clear as crystal.
entries.2930: κρύσταλλος KRU/STALLOS krýstallos kroos'-tal-los from a derivative of κρύος KRU/OS krýos (frost); ice, i.e. (by analogy) rock "crystal":--crystal.
entries.2931: κρυφῆ KRUFH= kryphē kroo-fay' adverb from G2928; privately:--in secret.
entries.2932: κτάομαι KTA/OMAI ktáomai ktah'-om-ahee a primary verb; to get, i.e. acquire (by any means; own):--obtain, possess, provide, purchase.
entries.2933: κτῆμα KTH=MA ktēma ktay'-mah from G2932; an acquirement, i.e. estate:--possession.
entries.2934: κτῆνος KTH=NOS ktēnos ktay'-nos from G2932; property, i.e. (specially) a domestic animal:--beast.
entries.2935: κτήτωρ KTH/TWR ktḗtōr ktay'-tore from G2932; an owner:--possessor.
entries.2936: κτίζω KTI/ZW ktízō ktid'-zo probably akin to G2932 (through the idea of proprietorship of the manufacturer); to fabricate, i.e. found (form originally):--create, Creator, make.
entries.2937: κτίσις KTI/SIS ktísis ktis'-is from G2936; original formation (properly, the act; by implication, the thing, literally or figuratively):--building, creation, creature, ordinance.
entries.2938: κτίσμα KTI/SMA ktísma ktis'-mah from G2936; an original formation (concretely), i.e. product (created thing):--creature.
entries.2939: κτίστης KTI/STHS ktístēs ktis-tace' from G2936; a founder, i.e. God (as author of all things):--Creator.
entries.2940: κυβεία KUBEI/A kybeía koo-bi'-ah from κύβος KU/BOS kýbos (a "cube", i.e. die for playing); gambling, i.e. (figuratively) artifice or fraud:--sleight.
entries.2941: κυβέρνησις KUBE/RNHSIS kybérnēsis koo-ber'-nay-sis from κυβερνάω KUBERNA/W kybernáō (of Latin origin, to steer); pilotage, i.e. (figuratively) directorship (in the church):--government.
entries.2942: κυβερνήτης KUBERNH/THS kybernḗtēs koo-ber-nay'-tace from the same as G2941; helmsman, i.e. (by implication) captain:--(ship) master.
entries.2943: κυκλόθεν KUKLO/QEN kyklóthen koo-kloth'-en adverb from the same as G2945; from the circle, i.e. all around:--(round) about.
entries.2944: κυκλόω KUKLO/W kyklóō koo-klo'-o from the same as G2945; to encircle, i.e. surround:--compass (about), come (stand) round about.
entries.2945: κύκλῳ KU/KLW| kýklōi koo'-klo as if dative case of κύκλος KU/KLOS kýklos (a ring, "cycle"; akin to G2947); i.e. in a circle (by implication, of G1722), i.e. (adverbially) all around:--round about.
entries.2946: κύλισμα KU/LISMA kýlisma koo'-lis-mah from G2947; a wallow (the effect of rolling), i.e. filth:--wallowing.
entries.2947: κυλιόω KULIO/W kylióō koo-lee-o'-o from the base of G2949 (through the idea of circularity; compare G2945, G1507); to roll about:--wallow.
entries.2948: κυλλός KULLO/S kyllós kool-los' from the same as G2947; rocking about, i.e. crippled (maimed, in feet or hands):--maimed.
entries.2949: κῦμα KU=MA kŷma koo'-mah from κύω KU/W kýō (to swell (with young), i.e. bend, curve); a billow (as bursting or toppling):--wave.
entries.2950: κύμβαλον KU/MBALON kýmbalon koom'-bal-on from a derivative of the base of G2949; a "cymbal" (as hollow):--cymbal.
entries.2951: κύμινον KU/MINON kýminon koo'-min-on of foreign origin (compare H03646); dill or fennel ("cummin"):--cummin.
entries.2952: κυνάριον KUNA/RION kynárion koo-nar'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G2965; a puppy:--dog.
entries.2953: Κύπριος *KU/PRIOS Kýprios koo'-pree-os from G2954; a Cyprian (Cypriot), i.e. inhabitant of Cyprus:--of Cyprus.
entries.2954: Κύπρος *KU/PROS Kýpros koo'-pros of uncertain origin; Cyprus, an island in the Mediterranean:--Cyprus.
entries.2955: κύπτω KU/PTW kýptō koop'-to probably from the base of G2949; to bend forward:--stoop (down).
entries.2956: Κυρηναῖος *KURHNAI=OS Kyrēnaîos koo-ray-nah'-yos from G2957; i.e. Cyrenæan, i.e. inhabitant of Cyrene:--of Cyrene, Cyrenian.
entries.2957: Κυρήνη *KURH/NH Kyrḗnē koo-ray'-nay of uncertain derivation; Cyrene, a region of Africa:--Cyrene.
entries.2958: Κυρήνιος *KURH/NIOS Kyrḗnios koo-ray'-nee-os of Latin origin; Cyrenius (i.e. Quirinus), a Roman:--Cyrenius.
entries.2959: Κυρία *KURI/A Kyría koo-ree'-ah feminine of G2962; Cyria, a Christian woman:--lady.
entries.2960: κυριακός KURIAKO/S kyriakós koo-ree-ak-os' from G2962; belonging to the Lord (Jehovah or Jesus):--Lord's.
entries.2961: κυριεύω KURIEU/W kyrieúō ko-ree-yoo'-o from G2962; to rule:--have dominion over, lord, be lord of, exercise lordship over.
entries.2962: κύριος KU/RIOS kýrios koo'-ree-os from κῦρος KU=ROS kŷros (supremacy); supreme in authority, i.e. (as noun) controller; by implication, Master (as a respectful title):-- God, Lord, master, Sir.
entries.2963: κυριότης KURIO/THS kyriótēs koo-ree-ot'-ace from G2962; mastery, i.e. (concretely and collectively) rulers:--dominion, government.
entries.2964: κυρόω KURO/W kyróō koo-ro'-o from the same as G2962; to make authoritative, i.e. ratify:--confirm.
entries.2965: κύων KU/WN kýōn koo'-ohn a primary word; a dog ("hound") (literally or figuratively):--dog.
entries.2966: κῶλον KW=LON kōlon ko'-lon from the base of G2849; a limb of the body (as if lopped):--carcase.
entries.2967: κωλύω KWLU/W kōlýō ko-loo'-o from the base of G2849; to estop, i.e. prevent (by word or act):--forbid, hinder, keep from, let, not suffer, withstand.
entries.2968: κώμη KW/MH kṓmē ko'-may from G2749; a hamlet (as if laid down):--town, village.
entries.2969: κωμόπολις KWMO/POLIS kōmópolis ko-mop'-ol-is from G2968 and G4172; an unwalled city:--town.
entries.2970: κῶμος KW=MOS kōmos ko'-mos from G2749; a carousal (as if letting loose):--revelling, rioting.
entries.2971: κώνωψ KW/NWY kṓnōps ko'-nopes apparently a derivative of the base of G2759 and a derivative of G3700; a mosquito (from its stinging proboscis):--gnat.
entries.2972: Κώς *KW/S Kṓs koce of uncertain origin; Cos, an island in the Mediterranean:--Cos.
entries.2973: Κωσάμ *KWSA/M Kōsám ko-sam' of Hebrew origin (compare H07081); Cosam (i.e. Kosam) an Israelite:--Cosam.
entries.2974: κωφός KWFO/S kōphós ko-fos' from G2875; blunted, i.e. (figuratively) of hearing (deaf) or speech (dumb):--deaf, dumb, speechless.
entries.2975: λαγχάνω LAGXA/NW lanchánō lang-khan'-o a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses; to lot, i.e. determine (by implication, receive) especially by lot:--his lot be, cast lots, obtain.
entries.2976: Λάζαρος *LA/ZAROS Lázaros lad'-zar-os probably of Hebrew origin (H0499); Lazarus (i.e. Elazar), the name of two Israelites (one imaginary):--Lazarus.
entries.2977: λάθρα LA/QRA láthra lath'-rah adverb from G2990; privately:--privily, secretly.
entries.2978: λαῖλαψ LAI=LAY laîlaps lah'-ee-laps of uncertain derivation; a whirlwind (squall):--storm, tempest.
entries.2979: λακτίζω LAKTI/ZW laktízō lak-tid'-zo from adverb λάξ LA/C láx (heelwise); to recalcitrate:--kick.
entries.2980: λαλέω LALE/W laléō lal-eh'-o a prolonged form of an otherwise obsolete verb; to talk, i.e. utter words:--preach, say, speak (after), talk, tell, utter. Compare G3004.
entries.2981: λαλιά LALIA/ laliá lal-ee-ah' from G2980; talk:--saying, speech.
entries.2982: λαμά LAMA/ lamá lam-ah' or λαμμᾶ LAMMA= lammâ lam-mah' ; of Hebrew origin (H04100 with prepositional prefix); lama (i.e. why):--lama.
entries.2983: λαμβάνω LAMBA/NW lambánō lam-ban'-o a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is use only as an alternate in certain tenses; to take (in very many applications, literally and figuratively (properly objective or active, to get hold of; whereas G1209 is rather subjective or passive, to have offered to one; while G138 is more violent, to seize or remove)):--accept, + be amazed, assay, attain, bring, X when I call, catch, come on (X unto), + forget, have, hold, obtain, receive (X after), take (away, up).
entries.2984: Λάμεχ *LA/MEX Lámech lam'-ekh of Hebrew origin (H03929); Lamech (i.e. Lemek), a patriarch:--Lamech.
entries.2985: λαμπάς LAMPA/S lampás lam-pas' from G2989; a "lamp" or flambeau:--lamp, light, torch.
entries.2986: λαμπρός LAMPRO/S lamprós lam-pros' from the same as G2985; radiant; by analogy, limpid; figuratively, magnificent or sumptuous (in appearance):--bright, clear, gay, goodly, gorgeous, white.
entries.2987: λαμπρότης LAMPRO/THS lamprótēs lam-prot'-ace from G2986; brilliancy:--brightness.
entries.2988: λαμπρῶς LAMPRW=S lamprōs lam-proce' adverb from G2986; brilliantly, i.e. figuratively, luxuriously:--sumptuously.
entries.2989: λάμπω LA/MPW lámpō lam'-po a primary verb; to beam, i.e. radiate brilliancy (literally or figuratively):--give light, shine.
entries.2990: λανθάνω LANQA/NW lanthánō lan-than'-o a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is used only as an alternate in certain tenses; to lie hid (literally or figuratively); often used adverbially, unwittingly:--be hid, be ignorant of, unawares.
entries.2991: λαξευτός LACEUTO/S laxeutós lax-yoo-tos' from a compound of λᾶς LA=S lâs (a stone) and the base of G3584 (in its original sense of scraping); rock-quarried:--hewn in stone.
entries.2992: λαός LAO/S laós lah-os' apparently a primary word; a people (in general; thus differing from G1218, which denotes one's own populace):--people.
entries.2993: Λαοδίκεια *LAODI/KEIA Laodíkeia lah-od-ik'-i-ah from a compound of G2992 and G1349; Laodicia, a place in Asia Minor:--Laodicea.
entries.2994: Λαοδικεύς *LAODIKEU/S Laodikeús lah-od-ik-yooce' from G2993; a Laodicean, i.e. inhabitant of Laodicia:--Laodicean.
entries.2995: λάρυγξ LA/RUGC lárynx lar'-oongks of uncertain derivation; the throat ("larynx"):--throat.
entries.2996: Λασαία *LASAI/A Lasaía las-ah'-yah of uncertain origin; Lasæa, a place in Crete:--Lasea.
entries.2997: λάσχω LA/SXW láschō las'-kho a strengthened form of a primary verb, which only occurs in this and another prolonged form as alternate in certain tenses; to crack open (from a fall):--burst asunder.
entries.2998: λατομέω LATOME/W latoméō lat-om-eh'-o from the same as the first part of G2991 and the base of G5114; to quarry:--hew.
entries.2999: λατρεία LATREI/A latreía lat-ri'-ah from G3000; ministration of God, i.e. worship:--(divine) service.
entries.3000: λατρεύω LATREU/W latreúō lat-ryoo'-o from λάτρις LA/TRIS látris (a hired menial); to minister (to God), i.e. render religious homage:--serve, do the service, worship(-per).
entries.3001: λάχανον LA/XANON láchanon lakh'-an-on from λαχαίνω LAXAI/NW lachaínō (to dig); a vegetable:--herb.
entries.3002: Λεββαῖος *LEBBAI=OS Lebbaîos leb-bah'-yos of uncertain origin; Lebbæus, a Christian:--Lebbæus.
entries.3003: λεγεών LEGEW/N legeṓn leg-eh-ohn' of Latin origin; a "legion", i.e. Roman regiment (figuratively):--legion.
entries.3004: λέγω LE/GW légō leg'-o a primary verb; properly, to "lay" forth, i.e. (figuratively) relate (in words (usually of systematic or set discourse; whereas G2036 and G5346 generally refer to an individual expression or speech respectively; while G4483 is properly to break silence merely, and G2980 means an extended or random harangue)); by implication, to mean:--ask, bid, boast, call, describe, give out, name, put forth, say(-ing, on), shew, speak, tell, utter.
entries.3005: λεῖμμα LEI=MMA leîmma lime'-mah from G3007; a remainder:--remnant.
entries.3006: λεῖος LEI=OS leîos li'-os apparently a primary word; smooth, i.e. "level":--smooth.
entries.3007: λείπω LEI/PW leípō li'-po a primary verb; to leave, i.e. (intransitively or passively) to fail or be absent:--be destitute (wanting), lack.
entries.3008: λειτουργέω LEITOURGE/W leitourgéō li-toorg-eh'-o from G3011; to be a public servant, i.e. (by analogy) to perform religious or charitable functions (worship, obey, relieve):--minister.
entries.3009: λειτουργία LEITOURGI/A leitourgía li-toorg-ee'-ah from G3008; public function (as priest ("liturgy") or almsgiver):--ministration(-try), service.
entries.3010: λειτουργικός LEITOURGIKO/S leitourgikós li-toorg-ik-os' from the same as G3008; functional publicly ("liturgic"); i.e. beneficient:--ministering.
entries.3011: λειτουργός LEITOURGO/S leitourgós li-toorg-os' from a derivative of G2992 and G2041; a public servant, i.e. a functionary in the Temple or Gospel, or (genitive case) a worshipper (of God) or benefactor (of man):--minister(-ed).
entries.3012: λέντιον LE/NTION léntion len'-tee-on of Latin origin; a "linen" cloth, i.e. apron:--towel.
entries.3013: λεπίς LEPI/S lepís lep-is' from λέπω LE/PW lépō (to peel); a flake:--scale.
entries.3014: λέπρα LE/PRA lépra lep'-rah from the same as G3013; scaliness, i.e. "leprosy":--leprosy.
entries.3015: λεπρός LEPRO/S leprós lep-ros' from the same as G3014; scaly, i.e. leprous (a leper):--leper.
entries.3016: λεπτόν LEPTO/N leptón lep-ton' neuter of a derivative of the same as G3013; something scaled (light), i.e. a small coin:--mite.
entries.3017: Λευΐ *LEUI/+ Leuḯ lyoo'-ee of Hebrew origin (H03878); Levi, the name of three Israelites:--Levi. Compare G3018.
entries.3018: Λευΐς *LEUI/+S Leuḯs lyoo-is' a form of G3017; Lewis (i.e. Levi), a Christian:--Levi.
entries.3019: Λευΐτης *LEUI/+THS Leuḯtēs lyoo-ee'-tace from G3017; a Levite, i.e. descendant of Levi:--Levite.
entries.3020: Λευϊτικός *LEUI+TIKO/S Leuïtikós lyoo-it'-ee-kos from G3019; Levitic, i.e. relating to the Levites:--Levitical.
entries.3021: λευκαίνω LEUKAI/NW leukaínō lyoo-kah'-ee-no from G3022; to whiten:--make white, whiten.
entries.3022: λευκός LEUKO/S leukós lyoo-kos' from λύκη LU/KH lýkē ("light"); white:--white.
entries.3023: λέων LE/WN léōn leh-ohn' a primary word; a "lion":--lion.
entries.3024: λήθη LH/QH lḗthē lay'-thay from G2990; forgetfulness:--+ forget.
entries.3025: ληνός LHNO/S lēnós lay-nos' apparently a primary word; a trough, i.e. wine-vat:--winepress.
entries.3026: λῆρος LH=ROS lēros lay'-ros apparently a primary word; twaddle, i.e. an incredible story:--idle tale.
entries.3027: λῃστής LH|STH/S lēistḗs lace-tace' from ληΐζομαι LHI/+ZOMAI lēḯzomai (to plunder); a brigand:--robber, thief.
entries.3028: λῆμψις LH=MYIS lēmpsis lape'-sis from G2983; receipt (the act):--receiving.
entries.3029: λίαν LI/AN lían lee'-an of uncertain affinity; much (adverbially):--exceeding, great(-ly), sore, very (+ chiefest).
entries.3030: λίβανος LI/BANOS líbanos lib'-an-os of foreign origin (H03828); the incense-tree, i.e. (by implication) incense itself:--frankincense.
entries.3031: λιβανωτός LIBANWTO/S libanōtós lib-an-o-tos' from G3030; frankincense, i.e. (by extension) a censer for burning it:--censer.
entries.3032: Λιβερτῖνος *LIBERTI=NOS Libertînos lib-er-tee'-nos of Latin origin; a Roman freedman:--Libertine.
entries.3033: Λιβύη *LIBU/H Libýē lib-oo'-ay probably from G3047; Libye, a region of Africa:--Libya.
entries.3034: λιθάζω LIQA/ZW litházō lith-ad'-zo from G3037; to lapidate:--stone.
entries.3035: λίθινος LI/QINOS líthinos lith-ee'-nos from G3037; stony, i.e. made of stone:--of stone.
entries.3036: λιθοβολέω LIQOBOLE/W lithoboléō lith-ob-ol-eh'-o from a compound of G3037 and G906; to throw stones, i.e. lapidate:--stone, cast stones.
entries.3037: λίθος LI/QOS líthos lee'-thos apparently a primary word; a stone (literally or figuratively):--(mill-, stumbling-)stone.
entries.3038: λιθόστρωτος LIQO/STRWTOS lithóstrōtos lith-os'-tro-tos from G3037 and a derivative of G4766; stone-strewed, i.e. a tessellated mosaic on which the Roman tribunal was placed:--Pavement.
entries.3039: λικμάω LIKMA/W likmáō lik-mah'-o from λικμός LIKMO/S likmós, the equivalent of λίκνον LI/KNON líknon (a winnowing fan or basket); to winnow, i.e. (by analogy), to triturate:--grind to powder.
entries.3040: λιμήν LIMH/N limḗn lee-mane' apparently a primary word; a harbor:--haven. Compare G2568.
entries.3041: λίμνη LI/MNH límnē lim'-nay probably from G3040 (through the idea of nearness of shore); a pond (large or small):--lake.
entries.3042: λιμός LIMO/S limós lee-mos' probably from G3007 (through the idea of destitution); a scarcity of food:--dearth, famine, hunger.
entries.3043: λίνον LI/NON línon lee'-non probably a primary word; flax, i.e. (by implication) "linen":--linen.
entries.3044: Λίνος *LI/NOS Línos lee'-nos perhaps from G3043; Linus, a Christian:--Linus.
entries.3045: λιπαρός LIPARO/S liparós lip-ar-os' from λίπος LI/POS lípos (grease); fat, i.e. (figuratively) sumptuous:--dainty.
entries.3046: λίτρα LI/TRA lítra lee'-trah of Latin origin (libra); a pound in weight:--pound.
entries.3047: λίψ LI/Y líps leeps probably from λείβω LEI/BW leíbō (to pour a "libation"); the south(- west) wind (as bringing rain, i.e. (by extension) the south quarter):--southwest.
entries.3048: λογία LOGI/A logía log-ee'-ah from G3056 (in the commercial sense); a contribution:--collection, gathering.
entries.3049: λογίζομαι LOGI/ZOMAI logízomai log-id'-zom-ahee middle voice from G3056; to take an inventory, i.e. estimate (literally or figuratively):--conclude, (ac-)count (of), + despise, esteem, impute, lay, number, reason, reckon, suppose, think (on).
entries.3050: λογικός LOGIKO/S logikós log-ik-os' from G3056; rational ("logical"):--reasonable, of the word.
entries.3051: λόγιον LO/GION lógion log'-ee-on neuter of G3052; an utterance (of God):--oracle.
entries.3052: λόγιος LO/GIOS lógios log'-ee-os from G3056; fluent, i.e. an orator:--eloquent.
entries.3053: λογισμός LOGISMO/S logismós log-is-mos' from G3049; computation, i.e. (figuratively) reasoning (conscience, conceit):--imagination, thought.
entries.3054: λογομαχέω LOGOMAXE/W logomachéō log-om-akh-eh'-o from a compound of G3056 and G3164; to be disputatious (on trifles):--strive about words.
entries.3055: λογομαχία LOGOMAXI/A logomachía log-om-akh-ee'-ah from the same as G3054; disputation about trifles ("logomachy"):--strife of words.
entries.3056: λόγος LO/GOS lógos log'-os from G3004; something said (including the thought); by implication, a topic (subject of discourse), also reasoning (the mental faculty) or motive; by extension, a computation; specially, (with the article in John) the Divine Expression (i.e. Christ):--account, cause, communication, X concerning, doctrine, fame, X have to do, intent, matter, mouth, preaching, question, reason, + reckon, remove, say(-ing), shew, X speaker, speech, talk, thing, + none of these things move me, tidings, treatise, utterance, word, work.
entries.3057: λόγχη LO/GXH lónchē long'-khay perhaps a primary word; a "lance":--spear.
entries.3058: λοιδορέω LOIDORE/W loidoréō loy-dor-eh'-o from G3060; to reproach, i.e. vilify:--revile.
entries.3059: λοιδορία LOIDORI/A loidoría loy-dor-ee'-ah from G3060; slander or vituperation:--railing, reproach(-fully).
entries.3060: λοίδορος LOI/DOROS loídoros loy'-dor-os from λοιδός LOIDO/S loidós (mischief); abusive, i.e. a blackguard:--railer, reviler.
entries.3061: λοιμός LOIMO/S loimós loy'-mos of uncertain affinity; a plague (literally, the disease, or figuratively, a pest):--pestilence(-t).
entries.3062: λοιποί LOIPOI/ loipoí loy-poy' masculine plural of a derivative of G3007; remaining ones:--other, which remain, remnant, residue, rest.
entries.3063: λοιπόν LOIPO/N loipón loy-pon' neuter singular of the same as G3062; something remaining (adverbially):--besides, finally, furthermore, (from) henceforth, moreover, now, + it remaineth, then.
entries.3064: λοιποῦ LOIPOU= loipoû loy-poo' genitive case singular of the same as G3062; remaining time:--from henceforth.
entries.3065: Λουκᾶς *LOUKA=S Loukâs loo-kas' contracted from Latin Lucanus; Lucas, a Christian:--Lucas, Luke.
entries.3066: Λούκιος *LOU/KIOS Loúkios loo'-kee-os of Latin origin; illuminative; Lucius, a Christian:--Lucius.
entries.3067: λουτρόν LOUTRO/N loutrón loo-tron' from G3068; a bath, i.e. (figuratively), baptism:--washing.
entries.3068: λούω LOU/W loúō loo'-o a primary verb; to bathe (the whole person; whereas G3538 means to wet a part only, and G4150 to wash, cleanse garments exclusively):--wash.
entries.3069: Λύδδα *LU/DDA Lýdda lud'-dah of Hebrew origin (H03850); Lydda (i.e. Lod), a place in Palestine:--Lydda.
entries.3070: Λυδία *LUDI/A Lydía loo-dee'-ah properly, feminine of Ludios (of foreign origin) (a Lydian, in Asia Minor); Lydia, a Christian woman:--Lydia.
entries.3071: Λυκαονία *LUKAONI/A Lykaonía loo-kah-on-ee'-ah perhaps remotely from G3074; Lycaonia, a region of Asia Minor:--Lycaonia.
entries.3072: Λυκαονιστί *LUKAONISTI/ Lykaonistí loo-kah-on-is-tee' adverb from a derivative of G3071; Lycaonistically, i.e. in the language of the Lycaonians:--in the speech of Lycaonia.
entries.3073: Λυκία *LUKI/A Lykía loo-kee'-ah probably remotely from G3074; Lycia, a province of Asia Minor:--Lycia.
entries.3074: λύκος LU/KOS lýkos loo'-kos perhaps akin to the base of G3022 (from the whitish hair); a wolf:--wolf.
entries.3075: λυμαίνομαι LUMAI/NOMAI lymaínomai loo-mah'-ee-nom-ahee middle voice from a probably derivative of G3089 (meaning filth); properly, to soil, i.e. (figuratively) insult (maltreat):--make havock of.
entries.3076: λυπέω LUPE/W lypéō loo-peh'-o from G3077; to distress; reflexively or passively, to be sad:--cause grief, grieve, be in heaviness, (be) sorrow(-ful), be (make) sorry.
entries.3077: λύπη LU/PH lýpē loo'-pay apparently a primary word; sadness:--grief, grievous, + grudgingly, heaviness, sorrow.
entries.3078: Λυσανίας *LUSANI/AS Lysanías loo-san-ee'-as from G3080 and ἀνία A)NI/A anía (trouble); grief-dispelling; Lysanias, a governor of Abilene:--Lysanias.
entries.3079: Λυσίας *LUSI/AS Lysías loo-see'-as of uncertain affinity; Lysias, a Roman:--Lysias.
entries.3080: λύσις LU/SIS lýsis loo'-sis from G3089; a loosening, i.e. (specially), divorce:--to be loosed.
entries.3081: λυσιτελεῖ LUSITELEI= lysiteleî loo-sit-el-i' third person singular present indicative active of a derivative of a compound of G3080 and G5056; impersonally, it answers the purpose, i.e. is advantageous:--it is better.
entries.3082: Λύστρα *LU/STRA Lýstra loos'-trah of uncertain origin; Lystra, a place in Asia Minor:--Lystra.
entries.3083: λύτρον LU/TRON lýtron loo'-tron from G3089; something to loosen with, i.e. a redemption price (figuratively, atonement):--ransom.
entries.3084: λυτρόω LUTRO/W lytróō loo-tro'-o from G3083; to ransom (literally or figuratively):--redeem.
entries.3085: λύτρωσις LU/TRWSIS lýtrōsis loo'-tro-sis from G3084; a ransoming (figuratively):--+ redeemed, redemption.
entries.3086: λυτρωτής LUTRWTH/S lytrōtḗs loo-tro-tace' from G3084; a redeemer (figuratively):--deliverer.
entries.3087: λυχνία LUXNI/A lychnía lookh-nee'-ah from G3088; a lamp-stand (literally or figuratively):--candlestick.
entries.3088: λύχνος LU/XNOS lýchnos lookh'-nos from the base of G3022; a portable lamp or other illuminator (literally or figuratively):--candle, light.
entries.3089: λύω LU/W lýō loo'-o a primary verb; to "loosen" (literally or figuratively):--break (up), destroy, dissolve, (un-)loose, melt, put off. Compare G4486.
entries.3090: Λωΐς *LWI/+S Lōḯs lo-ece' of uncertain origin; Lois, a Christian woman:--Lois.
entries.3091: Λώτ *LW/T Lṓt lote of Hebrew origin (H03876); Lot, a patriarch:--Lot.
entries.3092: Μαάθ *MAA/Q Maáth mah-ath' probably of Hebrew origin; Maath, an Israelite:--Maath.
entries.3093: Μαγδαλά *MAGDALA/ Magdalá mag-dal-ah' of Chaldee origin (compare H04026); the tower; Magdala (i.e. Migdala), a place in Palestine:--Magdala.
entries.3094: Μαγδαληνή *MAGDALHNH/ Magdalēnḗ mag-dal-ay-nay' feminine of a derivative of G3093; a female Magdalene, i.e. inhabitant of Magdala:--Magdalene.
entries.3095: μαγεία MAGEI/A mageía mag-i'-ah from G3096; "magic":--sorcery.
entries.3096: μαγεύω MAGEU/W mageúō mag-yoo'-o from G3097; to practice magic:--use sorcery.
entries.3097: μάγος MA/GOS mágos mag'-os of foreign origin (H07248); a Magian, i.e. Oriental scientist; by implication, a magician:--sorcerer, wise man.
entries.3098: Μαγώγ *MAGW/G Magṓg mag-ogue' of Hebrew origin (H04031); Magog, a foreign nation, i.e. (figuratively) an Antichristian party:--Magog.
entries.3099: Μαδιάν *MADIA/N Madián mad-ee-on' of Hebrew origin (H04080); Madian (i.e. Midian), a region of Arabia:--Madian.
entries.3100: μαθητεύω MAQHTEU/W mathēteúō math-ayt-yoo'-o from G3101; intransitively, to become a pupil; transitively, to disciple, i.e. enrol as scholar:--be disciple, instruct, teach.
entries.3101: μαθητής MAQHTH/S mathētḗs math-ay-tes' from G3129; a learner, i.e. pupil:--disciple.
entries.3102: μαθήτρια MAQH/TRIA mathḗtria math-ay'-tree-ah feminine from G3101; a female pupil:--disciple.
entries.3103: Μαθουσάλα *MAQOUSA/LA Mathousála math-oo-sal'-ah of Hebrew origin (H04968); Mathusala (i.e. Methushelach), an antediluvian:--Mathusala.
entries.3104: Μαϊνάν *MAI+NA/N Maïnán mahee-nan' probably of Hebrew origin; Mainan, an Israelite:--Mainan.
entries.3105: μαίνομαι MAI/NOMAI maínomai mah'-ee-nom-ahee middle voice from a primary μάω MA/W máō (to long for; through the idea of insensate craving); to rave as a "maniac":--be beside self (mad).
entries.3106: μακαρίζω MAKARI/ZW makarízō mak-ar-id'-zo from G3107; to beatify, i.e. pronounce (or esteem) fortunate:--call blessed, count happy.
entries.3107: μακάριος MAKA/RIOS makários mak-ar'-ee-os a prolonged form of the poetical μάκαρ MA/KAR mákar (meaning the same); supremely blest; by extension, fortunate, well off:-- blessed, happy(X -ier).
entries.3108: μακαρισμός MAKARISMO/S makarismós mak-ar-is-mos' from G3106; beatification, i.e. attribution of good fortune:--blessedness.
entries.3109: Μακεδονία *MAKEDONI/A Makedonía mak-ed-on-ee'-ah from G3110; Macedonia, a region of Greece:--Macedonia.
entries.3110: Μακεδών *MAKEDW/N Makedṓn mak-ed'-ohn of uncertain derivation; a Macedon (Macedonian), i.e. inhabitant of Macedonia:--of Macedonia, Macedonian.
entries.3111: μάκελλον MA/KELLON mákellon mak'-el-lon of Latin origin (macellum); a butcher's stall, meat market or provision-shop:--shambles.
entries.3112: μακράν MAKRA/N makrán mak-ran' feminine accusative case singular of G3117 (G3598 being implied); at a distance (literally or figuratively):--(a-)far (off), good (great) way off.
entries.3113: μακρόθεν MAKRO/QEN makróthen mak-roth'-en adverb from G3117; from a distance or afar:--afar off, from far.
entries.3114: μακροθυμέω MAKROQUME/W makrothyméō mak-roth-oo-meh'-o from the same as G3116; to be long-spirited, i.e. (objectively) forbearing or (subjectively) patient:--bear (suffer) long, be longsuffering, have (long) patience, be patient, patiently endure.
entries.3115: μακροθυμία MAKROQUMI/A makrothymía mak-roth-oo-mee'-ah from the same as G3116; longanimity, i.e. (objectively) forbearance or (subjectively) fortitude:--longsuffering, patience.
entries.3116: μακροθυμώς MAKROQUMW/S makrothymṓs mak-roth-oo-moce' adverb of a compound of G3117 and G2372; with long (enduring) temper, i.e. leniently:--patiently.
entries.3117: μακρός MAKRO/S makrós mak-ros' from G3372; long (in place (distant) or time (neuter plural)):--far, long.
entries.3118: μακροχρόνιος MAKROXRO/NIOS makrochrónios mak-rokh-ron'-ee-os from G3117 and G5550; long-timed, i.e. long-lived:--live long.
entries.3119: μαλακία MALAKI/A malakía mal-ak-ee'-ah from G3120; softness, i.e. enervation (debility):--disease.
entries.3120: μαλακός MALAKO/S malakós mal-ak-os' of uncertain affinity; soft, i.e. fine (clothing); figuratively, a catamite:--effeminate, soft.
entries.3121: Μαλελεήλ *MALELEH/L Maleleḗl mal-el-eh-ale' of Hebrew origin (H04111); Maleleel (i.e. Mahalalel), an antediluvian:--Maleleel.
entries.3122: μάλιστα MA/LISTA málista mal'-is-tah neuter plural of the superlative of an apparently primary adverb μάλα MA/LA mála (very); (adverbially) most (in the greatest degree) or particularly:--chiefly, most of all, (e-)specially.
entries.3123: μᾶλλον MA=LLON mâllon mal'-lon neuter of the comparative of the same as G3122; (adverbially) more (in a greater degree) or rather:--+ better, X far, (the) more (and more), (so) much (the more), rather.
entries.3124: Μάλχος *MA/LXOS Málchos mal'-khos of Hebrew origin (H04429); Malchus, an Israelite:--Malchus.
entries.3125: μάμμη MA/MMH mámmē mam'-may of natural origin ("mammy"); a grandmother:--grandmother.
entries.3126: μαμμωνᾶς MAMMWNA=S mammōnâs mam-mo-nas' of Chaldee origin (confidence, i.e. wealth, personified); mammonas, i.e. avarice (deified):--mammon.
entries.3127: Μαναήν *MANAH/N Manaḗn man-ah-ane' of uncertain origin; Manaën, a Christian:--Manaen.
entries.3128: Μανασσῆς *MANASSH=S Manassēs man-as-sace' of Hebrew origin (H04519); Mannasses (i.e. Menashsheh), an Israelite:--Manasses.
entries.3129: μανθάνω MANQA/NW manthánō man-than'-o prolongation from a primary verb, another form of which, μαθέω MAQE/W mathéō, is used as an alternate in certain tenses; to learn (in any way):--learn, understand.
entries.3130: μανία MANI/A manía man-ee'-ah from G3105; craziness:--(+ make) X mad.
entries.3131: μάννα MA/NNA mánna man'-nah of Hebrew origin (H04478); manna (i.e. man), an edible gum:--manna.
entries.3132: μαντεύομαι MANTEU/OMAI manteúomai mant-yoo'-om-ahee from a derivative of G3105 (meaning a prophet, as supposed to rave through inspiration); to divine, i.e. utter spells (under pretense of foretelling:--by soothsaying.
entries.3133: μαραίνω MARAI/NW maraínō mar-ah'-ee-no of uncertain affinity; to extinguish (as fire), i.e. (figuratively and passively) to pass away:--fade away.
entries.3134: μαρὰν ἀθά MARA\N A)QA/ maràn athá mar'-an ath'-ah of Chaldee origin (meaning our Lord has come); maranatha, i.e. an exclamation of the approaching divine judgment:--Maran-atha.
entries.3135: μαργαρίτης MARGARI/THS margarítēs mar-gar-ee'-tace from μάργαρος MA/RGAROS márgaros (a pearl-oyster); a pearl:--pearl.
entries.3136: Μάρθα *MA/RQA Mártha mar'-thah probably of Chaldee origin (meaning mistress); Martha, a Christian woman:--Martha.
entries.3137: Μαρία *MARI/A María mar-ee'-ah or Μαριάμ *MARIA/M Mariám mar-ee-am' of Hebrew origin (H04813); Maria or Mariam (i.e. Mirjam), the name of six Christian females:-- Mary.
entries.3138: Μάρκος *MA/RKOS Márkos mar'-kos of Latin origin; Marcus, a Christian:--Marcus, Mark.
entries.3139: μάρμαρος MA/RMAROS mármaros mar'-mar-os from μαρμαίρω MARMAI/RW marmaírō (to glisten); marble (as sparkling white):--marble.
entries.3140: μαρτυρέω MARTURE/W martyréō mar-too-reh'-o from G3144; to be a witness, i.e. testify (literally or figuratively):--charge, give (evidence), bear record, have (obtain, of) good (honest) report, be well reported of, testify, give (have) testimony, (be, bear, give, obtain) witness.
entries.3141: μαρτυρία MARTURI/A martyría mar-too-ree'-ah from G3144; evidence given (judicially or genitive case):--record, report, testimony, witness.
entries.3142: μαρτύριον MARTU/RION martýrion mar-too'-ree-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G3144; something evidential, i.e. (genitive case) evidence given or (specially), the Decalogue (in the sacred Tabernacle):--to be testified, testimony, witness.
entries.3143: μαρτύρομαι MARTU/ROMAI martýromai mar-too'-rom-ahee middle voice from G3144; to be adduced as a witness, i.e. (figuratively) to obtest (in affirmation or exhortation):--take to record, testify.
entries.3144: μάρτυς MA/RTUS mártys mar'-toos of uncertain affinity; a witness (literally (judicially) or figuratively (genitive case)); by analogy, a "martyr":-- martyr, record, witness.
entries.3145: μασσάομαι MASSA/OMAI massáomai mas-sah'-om-ahee from a primary μάσσω MA/SSW mássō (to handle or squeeze); to chew:--gnaw.
entries.3146: μαστιγόω MASTIGO/W mastigóō mas-tig-o'-o from G3148; to flog (literally or figuratively):--scourge.
entries.3147: μαστίζω MASTI/ZW mastízō mas-tid'-zo from G3149; to whip (literally):--scourge.
entries.3148: μάστιξ MA/STIC mástix mas'-tix probably from the base of G3145 (through the idea of contact); a whip (literally, the Roman flagellum for criminals; figuratively, a disease):--plague, scourging.
entries.3149: μαστός MASTO/S mastós mas-tos' from the base of G3145; a (properly, female) breast (as if kneaded up):--pap.
entries.3150: ματαιολογία MATAIOLOGI/A mataiología mat-ah-yol-og-ee'-ah from G3151; random talk, i.e. babble:--vain jangling.
entries.3151: ματαιολόγος MATAIOLO/GOS mataiológos mat-ah-yol-og'-os from G3152 and G3004; an idle (i.e. senseless or mischievous) talker, i.e. a wrangler:--vain talker.
entries.3152: μάταιος MA/TAIOS mátaios mat'-ah-yos from the base of G3155; empty, i.e. (literally) profitless, or (specially), an idol:--vain, vanity.
entries.3153: ματαιότης MATAIO/THS mataiótēs mat-ah-yot'-ace from G3152; inutility; figuratively, transientness; morally, depravity:--vanity.
entries.3154: ματαιόω MATAIO/W mataióō mat-ah-yo'-o from G3152; to render (passively, become) foolish, i.e. (morally) wicked or (specially), idolatrous:--become vain.
entries.3155: μάτην MA/THN mátēn mat'-ane accusative case of a derivative of the base of G3145 (through the idea of tentative manipulation, i.e. unsuccessful search, or else of punishment); folly, i.e. (adverbially) to no purpose:--in vain.
entries.3156: Ματθαῖος *MATQAI=OS Matthaîos mat-thah'-yos a shorter form of G3161; Matthæus (i.e. Matthitjah), an Israelite and a Christian:--Matthew.
entries.3157: Ματθάν *MATQA/N Matthán mat-than' of Hebrew origin (H04977); Matthan (i.e. Mattan), an Israelite:--Matthan.
entries.3158: Ματθάτ *MATQA/T Matthát mat-that' probably a shortened form of G3161; Matthat (i.e. Mattithjah), the name of two Israelites:--Mathat.
entries.3159: Ματθίας *MATQI/AS Matthías mat-thee'-as apparently a shortened form of G3161; Matthias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Matthias.
entries.3160: Ματταθά *MATTAQA/ Mattathá mat-tath-ah' probably a shortened form of G3161 (compare H4992); Mattatha (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Mattatha.
entries.3161: Ματταθίας *MATTAQI/AS Mattathías mat-tath-ee'-as of Hebrew origin (H04993); Mattathias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite and a Christian:--Mattathias.
entries.3162: μάχαιρα MA/XAIRA máchaira makh'-ahee-rah probably feminine of a presumed derivative of G3163; a knife, i.e. dirk; figuratively, war, judicial punishment:--sword.
entries.3163: μάχη MA/XH máchē makh'-ay from G3164; a battle, i.e. (figuratively) controversy:--fighting, strive, striving.
entries.3164: μάχομαι MA/XOMAI máchomai makh'-om-ahee middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to war, i.e. (figuratively) to quarrel, dispute:--fight, strive.
entries.3165: μέ ME/ mé meh a shorter (and probably original) form of G1691; me:--I, me, my.
entries.3166: μεγαλαυχέω MEGALAUXE/W megalauchéō meg-al-ow-kheh'-o from a compound of G3173 and αὐχέω AU)XE/W auchéō (to boast; akin to G837 and G2744); to talk big, i.e. be grandiloquent (arrogant, egotistic):--boast great things.
entries.3167: μεγαλεῖος MEGALEI=OS megaleîos meg-al-i'-os from G3173; magnificent, i.e. (neuter, plural as noun) a conspicuous favor, or (subjectively) perfection:--great things, wonderful works.
entries.3168: μεγαλειότης MEGALEIO/THS megaleiótēs meg-al-i-ot'-ace from G3167; superbness, i.e. glory or splendor:--magnificence, majesty, mighty power.
entries.3169: μεγαλοπρεπής MEGALOPREPH/S megaloprepḗs meg-al-op-rep-ace' from G3173 and G4241; befitting greatness or magnificence (majestic):--excellent.
entries.3170: μεγαλύνω MEGALU/NW megalýnō meg-al-oo'-no from G3173; to make (or declare) great, i.e. increase or (figuratively) extol:--enlarge, magnify, shew great.
entries.3171: μεγάλως MEGA/LWS megálōs meg-al'-oce adverb from G3173; much:--greatly.
entries.3172: μεγαλωσύνη MEGALWSU/NH megalōsýnē meg-al-o-soo'-nay from G3173; greatness, i.e. (figuratively) divinity (often God himself):--majesty.
entries.3173: μέγας ME/GAS mégas meg'-as (including the prolonged forms, feminine μεγάλη MEGA/LH megálē, plural μεγάλοι MEGA/LOI megáloi, etc.; compare also G3176, G3187); big (literally or figuratively, in a very wide application):--(+ fear) exceedingly, great(-est), high, large, loud, mighty, + (be) sore (afraid), strong, X to years.
entries.3174: μέγεθος ME/GEQOS mégethos meg'-eth-os from G3173; magnitude (figuratively):--greatness.
entries.3175: μεγιστᾶνες MEGISTA=NES megistânes meg-is-tan'-es plural from G3176; grandees:--great men, lords.
entries.3176: μέγιστος ME/GISTOS mégistos meg'-is-tos superlative of G3173; greatest or very great:--exceeding great.
