entries.3177: μεθερμηνεύω MEQERMHNEU/W methermēneúō meth-er-mane-yoo'-o from G3326 and G2059; to explain over, i.e. translate:--(by) interpret(-ation).
entries.3178: μέθη ME/QH méthē meth'-ay apparently a primary word; an intoxicant, i.e. (by implication) intoxication:--drunkenness.
entries.3179: μεθίστημι MEQI/STHMI methístēmi meth-is'-tay-mee , or (1 Cor. 13:2) μεθιστάνω MEQISTA/NW methistánō meth-is-tan'-o from G3326 and G2476; to transfer, i.e. carry away, depose or (figuratively) exchange, seduce:--put out, remove, translate, turn away.
entries.3180: μεθοδεία MEQODEI/A methodeía meth-od-i'-ah from a compound of G3326 and G3593 (compare "method"); travelling over, i.e. travesty (trickery):--wile, lie in wait.
entries.3181: μεθόριος MEQO/RIOS methórios meth-or'-ee-os from G3326 and G3725; bounded alongside, i.e. contiguous (neuter plural as noun, frontier):--border.
entries.3182: μεθύσκω MEQU/SKW methýskō meth-oos'-ko a prolonged (transitive) form of G3184; to intoxicate:--be drunk(-en).
entries.3183: μέθυσος ME/QUSOS méthysos meth'-oo-sos from G3184; tipsy, i.e. (as noun) a sot:--drunkard.
entries.3184: μεθύω MEQU/W methýō meth-oo'-o from another form of G3178; to drink to intoxication, i.e. get drunk:--drink well, make (be) drunk(-en).
entries.3185: μεῖζον MEI=ZON meîzon mide'-zon neuter of G3187; (adverbially) in greater degree:--the more.
entries.3186: μειζότερος MEIZO/TEROS meizóteros mide-zot'-er-os continued comparative of G3187; still larger (figuratively):--greater.
entries.3187: μείζων MEI/ZWN meízōn mide'-zone irregular comparative of G3173; larger (literally or figuratively, specially, in age):--elder, greater(-est), more.
entries.3188: μέλαν ME/LAN mélan mel'-an neuter of G3189 as noun; ink:--ink.
entries.3189: μέλας ME/LAS mélas mel'-as apparently a primary word; black:--black.
entries.3190: Μελεᾶς *MELEA=S Meleâs mel-eh-as' of uncertain origin; Meleas, an Israelite:--Meleas.
entries.3191: μελετάω MELETA/W meletáō mel-et-ah'-o from a presumed derivative of G3199; to take care of, i.e. (by implication) revolve in the mind:--imagine, (pre-)meditate.
entries.3192: μέλι ME/LI méli mel'-ee apparently a primary word; honey:--honey.
entries.3193: μελίσσιος MELI/SSIOS melíssios mel-is'-see-os from G3192; relating to honey, i.e. bee (comb):--honeycomb.
entries.3194: Μελίτη *MELI/TH Melítē mel-ee'-tay of uncertain origin; Melita, an island in the Mediterranean:--Melita.
entries.3195: μέλλω ME/LLW méllō mel'-lo a strengthened form of G3199 (through the idea of expectation); to intend, i.e. be about to be, do, or suffer something (of persons or things, especially events; in the sense of purpose, duty, necessity, probability, possibility, or hesitation):--about, after that, be (almost), (that which is, things, + which was for) to come, intend, was to (be), mean, mind, be at the point, (be) ready, + return, shall (begin), (which, that) should (after, afterwards, hereafter) tarry, which was for, will, would, be yet.
entries.3196: μέλος ME/LOS mélos mel'-os of uncertain affinity; a limb or part of the body:--member.
entries.3197: Μελχί *MELXI/ Melchí mel-khee' of Hebrew origin (H04428 with pronominal suffix, my king); Melchi (i.e. Malki), the name of two Israelites:--Melchi.
entries.3198: Μελχισεδέκ *MELXISEDE/K Melchisedék mel-khis-ed-ek' of Hebrew origin (H04442); Melchisedek (i.e. Malkitsedek), a patriarch:--Melchisedec.
entries.3199: μέλω ME/LW mélō mel'-o a primary verb; to be of interest to, i.e. to concern (only third person singular present indicative used impersonally, it matters):--(take) care.
entries.3200: μεμβράνα MEMBRA/NA membrána mem-bran'-ah of Latin origin ("membrane"); a (written) sheep-skin:--parchment.
entries.3201: μέμφομαι ME/MFOMAI mémphomai mem'-fom-ahee middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to blame:--find fault.
entries.3202: μεμψίμοιρος MEMYI/MOIROS mempsímoiros mem-psim'-oy-ros from a presumed derivative of G3201 and μοῖρα MOI=RA moîra (fate; akin to the base of G3313); blaming fate, i.e. querulous (discontented):--complainer.
entries.3303: μέν ME/N mén men a primary particle; properly, indicative of affirmation or concession (in fact); usually followed by a contrasted clause with G1161 (this one, the former, etc.):--even, indeed, so, some, truly, verily. Often compounded with other particles in an intensive or asseverative sense.
entries.3304: μενοῦνγε MENOU=NGE menoûnge men-oon'-geh from G3303 and G3767 and G1065; so then at least:--nay but, yea doubtless (rather, verily).
entries.3305: μέντοι ME/NTOI méntoi men'-toy from G3303 and G5104; indeed though, i.e. however:--also, but, howbeit, nevertheless, yet.
entries.3306: μένω ME/NW ménō men'-o a primary verb; to stay (in a given place, state, relation or expectancy):--abide, continue, dwell, endure, be present, remain, stand, tarry (for), X thine own.
entries.3307: μερίζω MERI/ZW merízō mer-id'-zo from G3313; to part, i.e. (literally) to apportion, bestow, share, or (figuratively) to disunite, differ:--deal, be difference between, distribute, divide, give part.
entries.3308: μέριμνα ME/RIMNA mérimna mer'-im-nah from G3307 (through the idea of distraction); solicitude:--care.
entries.3309: μεριμνάω MERIMNA/W merimnáō mer-im-nah'-o from G3308; to be anxious about:--(be, have) care(-ful), take thought.
entries.3310: μερίς MERI/S merís mer-ece' feminine of G3313; a portion, i.e. province, share or (abstractly) participation:--part (X -akers).
entries.3311: μερισμός MERISMO/S merismós mer-is-mos' from G3307; a separation or distribution:--dividing asunder, gift.
entries.3312: μεριστής MERISTH/S meristḗs mer-is-tace' from G3307; an apportioner (administrator):--divider.
entries.3313: μέρος ME/ROS méros mer'-os from an obsolete but more primary form of μείρομαι MEI/ROMAI meíromai (to get as a section or allotment); a division or share (literally or figuratively, in a wide application):--behalf, course, coast, craft, particular (+ -ly), part (+ -ly), piece, portion, respect, side, some sort(-what).
entries.3314: μεσημβρία MESHMBRI/A mesēmbría mes-ame-bree'-ah from G3319 and G2250; midday; by implication, the south:--noon, south.
entries.3315: μεσιτεύω MESITEU/W mesiteúō mes-it-yoo'-o from G3316; to interpose (as arbiter), i.e (by implication) to ratify (as surety):--confirm.
entries.3316: μεσίτης MESI/THS mesítēs mes-ee'-tace from G3319; a go-between, i.e. (simply) an internunciator, or (by implication) a reconciler (intercessor):--mediator.
entries.3317: μεσονύκτιον MESONU/KTION mesonýktion mes-on-ook'-tee-on neuter of compound of G3319 and G3571; midnight (especially as a watch):--midnight.
entries.3318: Μεσοποταμία *MESOPOTAMI/A Mesopotamía mes-op-ot-am-ee'-ah from G3319 and G4215; Mesopotamia (as lying between the Euphrates and the Tigris; compare H0763), a region of Asia:--Mesopotamia.
entries.3319: μέσος ME/SOS mésos mes'-os from G3326; middle (as an adjective or (neuter) noun):--among, X before them, between, + forth, mid(-day, -night), midst, way.
entries.3320: μεσότοιχον MESO/TOIXON mesótoichon mes-ot'-oy-khon from G3319 and G5109; a partition (figuratively):--middle wall.
entries.3321: μεσουράνημα MESOURA/NHMA mesouránēma mes-oo-ran'-ay-mah from a presumed compound of G3319 and G3772; mid-sky:--midst of heaven.
entries.3322: μεσόω MESO/W mesóō mes-o'-o from G3319; to form the middle, i.e. (in point of time), to be half-way over:--be about the midst.
entries.3323: Μεσσίας *MESSI/AS Messías mes-see'-as of Hebrew origin (H04899); the Messias (i.e. Mashiach), or Christ:--Messias.
entries.3324: μεστός MESTO/S mestós mes-tos' of uncertain derivation; replete (literally or figuratively):--full.
entries.3325: μεστόω MESTO/W mestóō mes-to'-o from G3324; to replenish, i.e. (by implication) to intoxicate:--fill.
entries.3326: μετά META/ metá met-ah' a primary preposition (often used adverbially); properly, denoting accompaniment; "amid" (local or causal); modified variously according to the case (genitive association, or accusative succession) with which it is joined; occupying an intermediate position between G575 or G1537 and G1519 or G4314; less intimate than G1722 and less close than G4862):--after(-ward), X that he again, against, among, X and, + follow, hence, hereafter, in, of, (up-)on, + our, X and setting, since, (un-)to, + together, when, with (+ -out). Often used in composition, in substantially the same relations of participation or proximity, and transfer or sequence.
entries.3327: μεταβαίνω METABAI/NW metabaínō met-ab-ah'-ee-no from G3326 and the base of G939; to change place:--depart, go, pass, remove.
entries.3328: μεταβάλλω METABA/LLW metabállō met-ab-al'-lo from G3326 and G906; to throw over, i.e. (middle voice figuratively) to turn about in opinion:--change mind.
entries.3329: μετάγω META/GW metágō met-ag'-o from G3326 and G718; to lead over, i.e. transfer (direct):--turn about.
entries.3330: μεταδίδωμι METADI/DWMI metadídōmi met-ad-id'-o-mee from G3326 and G1325; to give over, i.e. share:--give, impart.
entries.3331: μετάθεσις META/QESIS metáthesis met-ath'-es-is from G3346; transposition, i.e. transferral (to heaven), disestablishment (of a law):--change, removing, translation.
entries.3332: μεταίρω METAI/RW metaírō met-ah'-ee-ro from G3326 and G142; to materialke oneself, i.e. remove (locally):--depart.
entries.3333: μετακαλέω METAKALE/W metakaléō met-ak-al-eh'-o from G3326 and G2564; to call elsewhere, i.e. summon:--call (for, hither).
entries.3334: μετακινέω METAKINE/W metakinéō met-ak-ee-neh'-o from G3326 and G2795; to stir to a place elsewhere, i.e. remove (figuratively):--move away.
entries.3335: μεταλαμβάνω METALAMBA/NW metalambánō met-al-am-ban'-o from G3326 and G2983; to participate; genitive case, to accept (and use):--eat, have, be partaker, receive, take.
entries.3336: μετάλημψις META/LHMYIS metálēmpsis met-al'-ape-sis from G3335; participation:--taking.
entries.3337: μεταλλάσσω METALLA/SSW metallássō met-al-las'-so from G3326 and G236; to exchange:--change.
entries.3338: μεταμέλλομαι METAME/LLOMAI metaméllomai met-am-el'-lom-ahee from G3326 and the middle voice of G3199; to care afterwards, i.e. regret:--repent (self).
entries.3339: μεταμορφόω METAMORFO/W metamorphóō met-am-or-fo'-o from G3326 and G3445; to transform (literally or figuratively, "metamorphose"):--change, transfigure, transform.
entries.3340: μετανοέω METANOE/W metanoéō met-an-o-eh'-o from G3326 and G3539; to think differently or afterwards, i.e. reconsider (morally, feel compunction):--repent.
entries.3341: μετάνοια META/NOIA metánoia met-an'-oy-ah from G3340; (subjectively) compunction (for guilt, including reformation); by implication, reversal (of (another's) decision):--repentance.
entries.3342: μεταξύ METACU/ metaxý met-ax-oo' from G3326 and a form of G4862; betwixt (of place or person); (of time) as adjective, intervening, or (by implication) adjoining:--between, mean while, next.
entries.3343: μεταπέμπω METAPE/MPW metapémpō met-ap-emp'-o from G3326 and G3992; to send from elsewhere, i.e. (middle voice) to summon or invite:--call (send) for.
entries.3344: μεταστρέφω METASTRE/FW metastréphō met-as-tref'-o from G3326 and G4762; to turn across, i.e. transmute or (figuratively) corrupt:--pervert, turn.
entries.3345: μετασχηματίζω METASXHMATI/ZW metaschēmatízō met-askh-ay-mat-id'-zo from G3326 and a derivative of G4976; to transfigure or disguise; figuratively, to apply (by accommodation):--transfer, transform (self).
entries.3346: μετατίθημι METATI/QHMI metatíthēmi met-at-ith'-ay-mee from G3326 and G5087; to transfer, i.e. (literally) transport, (by implication) exchange, (reflexively) change sides, or (figuratively) pervert:--carry over, change, remove, translate, turn.
entries.3347: μετέπειτα METE/PEITA metépeita met-ep'-i-tah from G3326 and G1899; thereafter:--afterward.
entries.3348: μετέχω METE/XW metéchō met-ekh'-o from G3326 and G2192; to share or participate; by implication, belong to, eat (or drink):--be partaker, pertain, take part, use.
entries.3349: μετεωρίζω METEWRI/ZW meteōrízō met-eh-o-rid'-zo from a compound of G3326 and a collateral form of G142 or perhaps rather G109 (compare "meteor"); to raise in mid-air, i.e. (figuratively) suspend (passively, fluctuate or be anxious):--be of doubtful mind.
entries.3350: μετοικεσία METOIKESI/A metoikesía met-oy-kes-ee'-ah from a derivative of a compound of G3326 and G3624; a change of abode, i.e. (specially), expatriation:--X brought, carried(-ying) away (in-)to.
entries.3351: μετοικίζω METOIKI/ZW metoikízō met-oy-kid'-zo from the same as G3350; to transfer as a settler or captive, i.e colonize or exile:--carry away, remove into.
entries.3352: μετοχή METOXH/ metochḗ met-okh-ay' from G3348; participation, i.e. intercourse:--fellowship.
entries.3353: μέτοχος ME/TOXOS métochos met'-okh-os from G3348; participant, i.e. (as noun) a sharer; by implication, an associate:--fellow, partaker, partner.
entries.3354: μετρέω METRE/W metréō met-reh'-o from G3358; to measure (i.e. ascertain in size by a fixed standard); by implication, to admeasure (i.e. allot by rule):--figuratively, to estimate:--measure, mete.
entries.3355: μετρητής METRHTH/S metrētḗs met-ray-tace' from G3354; a measurer, i.e. (specially), a certain standard measure of capacity for liquids:--firkin.
entries.3356: μετριοπαθέω METRIOPAQE/W metriopathéō met-ree-op-ath-eh'-o from a compound of the base of G3357 and G3806; to be moderate in passion, i.e. gentle (to treat indulgently):--have compassion.
entries.3357: μετρίως METRI/WS metríōs met-ree'-oce adverb from a derivative of G3358; moderately, i.e. slightly:--a little.
entries.3358: μέτρον ME/TRON métron met'-ron an apparently primary word; a measure ("metre"), literally or figuratively; by implication, a limited portion (degree):-- measure.
entries.3359: μέτωπον ME/TWPON métōpon met'-o-pon from G3326 and ops (the face); the forehead (as opposite the countenance):--forehead.
entries.3360: μέχρι ME/XRI méchri mekh'-ree or μεχρίς MEXRI/S mechrís mekh-ris' from G3372; as far as, i.e. up to a certain point (as a preposition, of extent (denoting the terminus, whereas G891 refers especially to the space of time or place intervening) or conjunction):--till, (un-)to, until.
entries.3361: μή MH/ mḗ may a primary particle of qualified negation (whereas G3756 expresses an absolute denial); (adverb) not, (conjunction) lest; also (as an interrogative implying a negative answer (whereas G3756 expects an affirmative one)) whether:--any but (that), X forbear, + God forbid, + lack, lest, neither, never, no (X wise in), none, nor, (can-)not, nothing, that not, un(-taken), without. Often used in compounds in substantially the same relations. See also G3362, G3363, G3364, G3372, G3373, G3375, G3378.
entries.3362: ἐὰν μή E)A\N MH/ eàn mḗ eh-an' may i.e. G1437 and G3361; if not, i.e. unless:--X before, but, except, if, no, (if, + whosoever) not.
entries.3363: ἵνα μή I(/NA MH/ hína mḗ hin'-ah may i.e. G2443 and G3361; in order (or so) that not:--albeit not, lest, that, no(-t, (-thing)).
entries.3364: οὐ μή OU) MH/ ou mḗ oo may i.e. G3756 and G3361; a double negative strengthening the denial; not at all:--any more, at all, by any (no) means, neither, never, no (at all), in no case (wise), nor ever, not (at all, in any wise). Compare G3378.
entries.3365: μηδαμῶς MHDAMW=S mēdamōs may-dam-oce' adverb from a compound of G3361 and ἀμός A)MO/S amós (somebody); by no means:--not so.
entries.3366: μηδέ MHDE/ mēdé may-deh' from G3361 and G1161; but not, not even; in a continued negation, nor:--neither, nor (yet), (no) not (once, so much as).
entries.3367: μηδείς MHDEI/S mēdeís may-dice' , including the irregular feminine μηδεμία MHDEMI/A mēdemía may-dem-ee'-ah , and the neuter μηδέν MHDE/N mēdén may-den' from G3361 and G1520; not even one (man, woman, thing):--any (man, thing), no (man), none, not (at all, any man, a whit), nothing, + without delay.
entries.3368: μηδέποτε MHDE/POTE mēdépote may-dep'-ot-eh from G3366 and G4218; not even ever:--never.
entries.3369: μηδέπω MHDE/PW mēdépō may-dep'-o from G3366 and G4452; not even yet:--not yet.
entries.3370: Μῆδος *MH=DOS Mēdos may'-dos of foreign origin (compare H04074); a Median, or inhabitant of Media:--Mede.
entries.3371: μηκέτι MHKE/TI mēkéti may-ket'-ee from G3361 and G2089; no further:--any longer, (not) henceforth, hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more.
entries.3372: μῆκος MH=KOS mēkos may'-kos probably akin to G3173; length (literally or figuratively):--length.
entries.3373: μηκύνω MHKU/NW mēkýnō may-koo'-no from G3372; to lengthen, i.e. (middle voice) to enlarge:--grow up.
entries.3374: μηλωτή MHLWTH/ mēlōtḗ may-lo-tay' from μῆλον MH=LON mēlon (a sheep); a sheep-skin:--sheepskin.
entries.3375: μήν MH/N mḗn mane a stronger form of G3303; a particle of affirmation (only with G2229); assuredly:--+ surely.
entries.3376: μήν MH/N mḗn mane a primary word; a month:--month.
entries.3377: μηνύω MHNU/W mēnýō may-noo'-o probably from the same base as G3145 and G3415 (i.e. μάω MA/W máō, to strive); to disclose (through the idea of mental effort and thus calling to mind), i.e. report, declare, intimate:--shew, tell.
entries.3378: μὴ οὐκ MH\ OU)K mḕ ouk ouk may ook i.e. G3361 and G3756; as interrogative and negative, is it not that?:--neither (followed by no), + never, not. Compare G3364.
entries.3379: μήποτε MH/POTE mḗpote may'-pot-eh or μή ποτε MH/ POTE mḗ pote may pot'-eh from G3361 and G4218; not ever; also if (or lest) ever (or perhaps):--if peradventure, lest (at any time, haply), not at all, whether or not.
entries.3380: μήπω MH/PW mḗpō may'-po from G3361 and G4452; not yet:--not yet.
entries.3381: μήπως MH/PWS mḗpōs may'-pos or μή πως MH/ PWS mḗ pōs may tis from G3361 and G4458; lest somehow:--lest (by any means, by some means, haply, perhaps).
entries.3382: μηρός MHRO/S mērós may-ros' perhaps a primary word; a thigh:--thigh.
entries.3383: μήτε MH/TE mḗte may'-teh from G3361 and G5037; not too, i.e. (in continued negation) neither or nor; also, not even:--neither, (n-)or, so as much.
entries.3384: μήτηρ MH/THR mḗtēr may'-tare apparently a primary word; a "mother" (literally or figuratively, immediate or remote):--mother.
entries.3385: μήτι MH/TI mḗti may'-tee from G3361 and the neuter of G5100; whether at all:--not (the particle usually not expressed, except by the form of the question).
entries.3386: μήτιγε MH/TIGE mḗtige may'-tig-eh from G3385 and G1065; not at all then, i.e. not to say (the rather still):--how much more.
entries.3387: μήτις MH/TIS mḗtis may'-tis or μή τις MH/ TIS mḗ tis may tis from G3361 and G5100; whether any:--any (sometimes unexpressed except by the simple interrogative form of the sentence).
entries.3388: μήτρα MH/TRA mḗtra may'-trah from G3384; the matrix:--womb.
entries.3389: μητραλῴας MHTRALW/|AS mētralṓias may-tral-o'-as from G3384 and the base of G257; a mother-thresher, i.e. matricide:--murderer of mothers.
entries.3390: μητρόπολις MHTRO/POLIS mētrópolis may-trop'-ol-is from G3384 and G4172; a mother city, i.e. "metropolis":--chiefest city.
entries.3391: μία MI/A mía mee'-ah irregular feminine of G1520; one or first:--a (certain), + agree, first, one, X other.
entries.3392: μιαίνω MIAI/NW miaínō me-ah'-ee-no perhaps a primary verb; to sully or taint, i.e. contaminate (ceremonially or morally):--defile.
entries.3393: μίασμα MI/ASMA míasma mee'-as-mah from G3392 ("miasma"); (morally) foulness (properly, the effect):--pollution.
entries.3394: μιασμός MIASMO/S miasmós mee-as-mos' from G3392; (morally) contamination (properly, the act):--uncleanness.
entries.3395: μίγμα MI/GMA mígma mig'-mah from G3396; a compound:--mixture.
entries.3396: μίγνυμι MI/GNUMI mígnymi mig'-noo-mee a primary verb; to mix:--mingle.
entries.3397: μικρόν MIKRO/N mikrón mik-ron' masculine or neuter singular of G3398 (as noun); a small space of time or degree:--a (little) (while).
entries.3398: μικρός MIKRO/S mikrós mik-ros' , including the comparative μικρότερος MIKRO/TEROS mikróteros mik-rot'-er-os apparently a primary word; small (in size, quantity, number or (figuratively) dignity):--least, less, little, small.
entries.3399: Μίλητος *MI/LHTOS Mílētos mil'-ay-tos of uncertain origin; Miletus, a city of Asia Minor:--Miletus.
entries.3400: μίλιον MI/LION mílion mil'-ee-on of Latin origin; a thousand paces, i.e. a "mile":--mile.
entries.3401: μιμέομαι MIME/OMAI miméomai mim-eh'-om-ahee middle voice from μῖμος MI=MOS mîmos (a "mimic"); to imitate:--follow.
entries.3402: μιμητής MIMHTH/S mimētḗs mim-ay-tace' from G3401; an imitator:--follower.
entries.3403: μιμνήσκω MIMNH/SKW mimnḗskō mim-nace'-ko a prolonged form of G3415 (from which some of the tenses are borrowed); to remind, i.e. (middle voice) to recall to mind:--be mindful, remember.
entries.3404: μισέω MISE/W miséō mis-eh'-o from a primary μῖσος MI=SOS mîsos (hatred); to detest (especially to persecute); by extension, to love less:--hate(-ful).
entries.3405: μισθαποδοσία MISQAPODOSI/A misthapodosía mis-thap-od-os-ee'-ah from G3406; requital (good or bad):--recompence of reward.
entries.3406: μισθαποδότης MISQAPODO/THS misthapodótēs mis-thap-od-ot'-ace from G3409 and G591; a renumerator:--rewarder.
entries.3407: μίσθιος MI/SQIOS místhios mis'-thee-os from G3408; a wage-earner:--hired servant.
entries.3408: μισθός MISQO/S misthós mis-thos' apparently a primary word; pay for service (literally or figuratively), good or bad:--hire, reward, wages.
entries.3409: μισθόω MISQO/W misthóō mis-tho'-o from G3408; to let out for wages, i.e. (middle voice) to hire:--hire.
entries.3410: μίσθωμα MI/SQWMA místhōma mis'-tho-mah from G3409; a rented building:--hired house.
entries.3411: μισθωτός MISQWTO/S misthōtós mis-tho-tos' from G3409; a wage-worker (good or bad):--hired servant, hireling.
entries.3412: Μιτυλήνη *MITULH/NH Mitylḗnē mit-oo-lay'-nay for μυτιλήνη MUTILH/NH mytilḗnē (abounding in shellfish); Mitylene (or Mytilene), a town on the island of Lesbos:--Mitylene.
entries.3413: Μιχαήλ *MIXAH/L Michaḗl mikh-ah-ale' of Hebrew origin (H04317); Michael, an archangel:--Michael.
entries.3414: μνᾶ MNA= mnâ mnah of Latin origin; a mna (i.e. mina), a certain weight:-- pound.
entries.3415: μνάομαι MNA/OMAI mnáomai mnah'-om-ahee middle voice of a derivative of G3306 or perhaps of the base of G3145 (through the idea of fixture in the mind or of mental grasp); to bear in mind, i.e. recollect; by implication, to reward or punish:--be mindful, remember, come (have) in remembrance. Compare G3403.
entries.3416: Μνάσων *MNA/SWN Mnásōn mnah'-sohn of uncertain origin; Mnason, a Christian:--Mnason.
entries.3417: μνεία MNEI/A mneía mni'-ah from G3415 or G3403; recollection; by implication, recital:--mention, remembrance.
entries.3418: μνῆμα MNH=MA mnēma mnay'-mah from G3415; a memorial, i.e. sepulchral monument (burial-place):--grave, sepulchre, tomb.
entries.3419: μνημεῖον MNHMEI=ON mnēmeîon mnay-mi'-on from G3420; a remembrance, i.e. cenotaph (place of interment):--grave, sepulchre, tomb.
entries.3420: μνήμη MNH/MH mnḗmē mnay'-may from G3403; memory:--remembrance.
entries.3421: μνημονεύω MNHMONEU/W mnēmoneúō mnay-mon-yoo'-o from a derivative of G3420; to exercise memory, i.e. recollect; by implication, to punish; also to rehearse:--make mention; be mindful, remember.
entries.3422: μνημόσυνον MNHMO/SUNON mnēmósynon mnay-mos'-oo-non from G3421; a reminder (memorandum), i.e. record:--memorial.
entries.3423: μνηστεύω MNHSTEU/W mnēsteúō mnace-tyoo'-o from a derivative of G3415; to give a souvenir (engagement present), i.e. betroth:--espouse.
entries.3424: μογιλάλος MOGILA/LOS mogilálos mog-il-al'-os from G3425 and G2980; hardly talking, i.e. dumb (tongue-tied):--having an impediment in his speech.
entries.3425: μόγις MO/GIS mógis mog'-is adverb from a primary μόγος MO/GOS mógos (toil); with difficulty:--hardly.
entries.3426: μόδιος MO/DIOS módios mod'-ee-os of Latin origin; a modius, i.e. certain measure for things dry (the quantity or the utensil):--bushel.
entries.3427: μοί MOI/ moí moy the simpler form of G1698; to me:--I, me, mine, my.
entries.3428: μοιχαλίς MOIXALI/S moichalís moy-khal-is' a prolonged form of the feminine of G3432; an adulteress (literally or figuratively):--adulteress(-ous, -y).
entries.3429: μοιχάω MOIXA/W moicháō moy-khah'-o from G3432; (middle voice) to commit adultery:--commit adultery.
entries.3430: μοιχεία MOIXEI/A moicheía moy-khi'-ah from G3431; adultery:--adultery.
entries.3431: μοιχεύω MOIXEU/W moicheúō moy-khyoo'-o from G3432; to commit adultery:--commit adultery.
entries.3432: μοιχός MOIXO/S moichós moy-khos' perhaps a primary word; a (male) paramour; figuratively, apostate:--adulterer.
entries.3433: μόλις MO/LIS mólis mol'-is probably by variation for G3425; with difficulty:--hardly, scarce(-ly), + with much work.
entries.3434: Μολόχ *MOLO/X Molóch mol-okh' of Hebrew origin (H04432); Moloch (i.e. Molek), an idol:--Moloch.
entries.3435: μολύνω MOLU/NW molýnō mol-oo'-no probably from G3189; to soil (figuratively):--defile.
entries.3436: μολυσμός MOLUSMO/S molysmós mol-oos-mos' from G3435; a stain; i.e. (figuratively) immorality:--filthiness.
entries.3437: μομφή MOMFH/ momphḗ mom-fay' from G3201; blame, i.e. (by implication), a fault:--quarrel.
entries.3438: μονή MONH/ monḗ mon-ay' from G3306; a staying, i.e. residence (the act or the place):--abode, mansion.
entries.3439: μονογενής MONOGENH/S monogenḗs mon-og-en-ace' from G3441 and G1096; only-born, i.e. sole:--only (begotten, child).
entries.3440: μόνον MO/NON mónon mon'-on neuter of G3441 as adverb; merely:--alone, but, only.
entries.3441: μόνος MO/NOS mónos mon'-os probably from G3306; remaining, i.e. sole or single; by implication, mere:--alone, only, by themselves.
entries.3442: μονόφθαλμος MONO/FQALMOS monóphthalmos mon-of'-thal-mos from G3441 and G3788; one-eyed:--with one eye.
entries.3443: μονόω MONO/W monóō mon-o'-o from G3441; to isolate, i.e. bereave:--be desolate.
entries.3444: μορφή MORFH/ morphḗ mor-fay' perhaps from the base of G3313 (through the idea of adjustment of parts); shape; figuratively, nature:--form.
entries.3445: μορφόω MORFO/W morphóō mor-fo'-o from the same as G3444; to fashion (figuratively):--form.
entries.3446: μόρφωσις MO/RFWSIS mórphōsis mor'-fo-sis from G3445; formation, i.e. (by implication), appearance (semblance or (concretely) formula):--form.
entries.3447: μοσχοποιέω MOSXOPOIE/W moschopoiéō mos-khop-oy-eh'-o from G3448 and G4160; to fabricate the image of a bullock:--make a calf.
entries.3448: μόσχος MO/SXOS móschos mos'-khos probably strengthened for όσχος O/SXOS óschos (a shoot); a young bullock:--calf.
entries.3449: μόχθος MO/XQOS móchthos mokh'-thos from the base of G3425; toil, i.e. (by implication) sadness:--painfulness, travail.
entries.3450: μοῦ MOU= moû moo the simpler form of G1700; of me:--I, me, mine (own), my.
entries.3451: μουσικός MOUSIKO/S mousikós moo-sik-os' from Μοῦσα *MOU=SA Moûsa (a Muse); "musical", i.e. (as noun) a minstrel:--musician.
entries.3452: μυελός MUELO/S myelós moo-el-os' perhaps a primary word; the marrow:--marrow.
entries.3453: μυέω MUE/W myéō moo-eh'-o from the base of G3466; to initiate, i.e. (by implication) to teach:--instruct.
entries.3454: μῦθος MU=QOS mŷthos moo'-thos perhaps from the same as G3453 (through the idea of tuition); a tale, i.e. fiction ("myth"):--fable.
entries.3455: μυκάομαι MUKA/OMAI mykáomai moo-kah'-om-ahee from a presumed derivative of μύζω MU/ZW mýzō ( to "moo"); to bellow (roar):--roar.
entries.3456: μυκτηρίζω MUKTHRI/ZW myktērízō mook-tay-rid'-zo from a derivative of the base of G3455 (meaning snout, as that whence lowing proceeds); to make mouths at, i.e. ridicule:--mock.
entries.3457: μυλικός MULIKO/S mylikós moo-lee-kos' from G3458; belonging to a mill:--mill(-stone).
entries.3458: μύλος MU/LOS mýlos moo'-los probably ultimately from the base of G3433 (through the idea of hardship); a "mill", i.e. (by implication), a grinder (millstone):--millstone.
entries.3459: μύλων MU/LWN mýlōn moo'-lone from G3458; a mill-house:--mill.
entries.3460: Μύρα *MU/RA Mýra moo'-rah of uncertain derivation; Myra, a place in Asia Minor:--Myra.
entries.3461: μυριάς MURIA/S myriás moo-ree'-as from G3463; a ten-thousand; by extension, a "myriad" or indefinite number:--ten thousand.
entries.3462: μυρίζω MURI/ZW myrízō moo-rid'-zo from G3464; to apply (perfumed) unguent to:--anoint.
entries.3463: μύριοι MU/RIOI mýrioi moo'-ree-oi plural of an apparently primary word (properly, meaning very many); ten thousand; by extension, innumerably many:--ten thousand.
entries.3464: μύρον MU/RON mýron moo'-ron probably of foreign origin (compare H04753, G4666); "myrrh", i.e. (by implication) perfumed oil:--ointment.
entries.3465: Μυσία *MUSI/A Mysía moo-see'-ah of uncertain origin; Mysia, a region of Asia Minor:--Mysia.
entries.3466: μυστήριον MUSTH/RION mystḗrion moos-tay'-ree-on from a derivative of μύω MU/W mýō (to shut the mouth); a secret or "mystery" (through the idea of silence imposed by initiation into religious rites):--mystery.
entries.3467: μυωπάζω MUWPA/ZW myōpázō moo-ope-ad'-zo from a compound of the base of G3466 and ὤψ W)/Y ṓps (the face; from G3700); to shut the eyes, i.e. bref (see indistinctly):-- cannot see far off.
entries.3468: μώλωψ MW/LWY mṓlōps mo'-lopes from μῶλος MW=LOS mōlos ("moil"; probably akin to the base of G3433) and probably ὤψ W)/Y ṓps (the face; from G3700); a mole ("black eye") or blow-mark:--stripe.
entries.3469: μωμάομαι MWMA/OMAI mōmáomai mo-mah'-om-ahee from G3470; to carp at, i.e. censure (discredit):--blame.
entries.3470: μῶμος MW=MOS mōmos mo'-mos perhaps from G3201; a flaw or blot, i.e. (figuratively) disgraceful person:--blemish.
entries.3471: μωραίνω MWRAI/NW mōraínō mo-rah'-ee-no from G3474; to become insipid; figuratively, to make (passively, act) as a simpleton:--become fool, make foolish, lose savour.
entries.3472: μωρία MWRI/A mōría mo-ree'-ah from G3474; silliness, i.e. absurdity:--foolishness.
entries.3473: μωρολογία MWROLOGI/A mōrología mo-rol-og-ee'-ah from a compound of G3474 and G3004; silly talk, i.e. buffoonery:--foolish talking.
entries.3474: μωρός MWRO/S mōrós mo-ros' probably from the base of G3466; dull or stupid (as if shut up), i.e. heedless, (morally) blockhead, (apparently) absurd:--fool(-ish, X -ishness).
entries.3475: Μωσεύς *MWSEU/S Mōseús moce-yoos' or Μωσῆς *MWSH=S Mōsēs mo-sace' , or Μωϋσῆς *MWU+SH=S Mōÿsēs mo-oo-sace' of Hebrew origin; (H04872); Moseus, Moses, or Mouses (i.e. Mosheh), the Hebrew lawgiver:--Moses.
entries.3476: Ναασσών *NAASSW/N Naassṓn nah-as-sone' of Hebrew origin (H05177); Naasson (i.e. Nachshon), an Israelite:--Naasson.
entries.3477: Ναγγαί *NAGGAI/ Nangaí nang-gah'-ee probably of Hebrew origin (compare H05052); Nangæ (i.e. perhaps Nogach), an Israelite:--Nagge.
entries.3478: Ναζαρέθ *NAZARE/Q Nazaréth nad-zar-eth' or Ναζαρέτ *NAZARE/T Nazarét nad-zar-et' ; of uncertain derivation; Nazareth or Nazaret, a place in Palestine:--Nazareth.
entries.3479: Ναζαρηνός *NAZARHNO/S Nazarēnós nad-zar-ay-nos' from G3478; a Nazarene, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth:--of Nazareth.
entries.3480: Ναζωραῖος *NAZWRAI=OS Nazōraîos nad-zo-rah'-yos from G3478; a Nazoræan, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth; by extension, a Christian:--Nazarene, of Nazareth.
entries.3481: Ναθάν *NAQA/N Nathán nath-an' of Hebrew origin (H05416); Nathan, an Israelite:--Nathan.
entries.3482: Ναθαναήλ *NAQANAH/L Nathanaḗl nath-an-ah-ale' of Hebrew origin (H05417); Nathanaël (i.e. Nathanel), an Israelite and Christian:--Nathanael.
entries.3483: ναί NAI/ naí nahee a primary particle of strong affirmation; yes:--even so, surely, truth, verily, yea, yes.
entries.3484: Ναΐν *NAI/+N Naḯn nah-in' probably of Hebrew origin (compare H04999); Nain, a place in Palestine:--Nain.
entries.3485: ναός NAO/S naós nah-os' from a primary ναίω NAI/W naíō (to dwell); a fane, shrine, temple :--shrine, temple. Compare G2411.
entries.3486: Ναούμ *NAOU/M Naoúm nah-oom' of Hebrew origin (H05151); Naum (i.e. Nachum), an Israelite:--Naum.
entries.3487: νάρδος NA/RDOS nárdos nar'dos of foreign origin (compare H05373); "nard":--(spike-)nard.
entries.3488: Νάρκισσος *NA/RKISSOS Nárkissos nar'-kis-sos a flower of the same name, from νάρκη NA/RKH nárkē (stupefaction, as a "narcotic"); Narcissus, a Roman:--Narcissus.
entries.3489: ναυαγέω NAUAGE/W nauagéō now-ag-eh'-o from a compound of G3491 and G71; to be shipwrecked (stranded, "navigate"), literally or figuratively:--make (suffer) shipwreck.
entries.3490: ναύκληρος NAU/KLHROS naúklēros now'-klay-ros from G3491 and G2819 ("clerk"); a captain:--owner of a ship.
entries.3491: ναῦς NAU=S naûs nowce from νάω NA/W náō or νέω NE/W néō (to float); a boat (of any size):--ship.
entries.3492: ναύτης NAU/THS naútēs now'-tace from G3491; a boatman, i.e. seaman:--sailor, shipman.
entries.3493: Ναχώρ *NAXW/R Nachṓr nakh-ore' of Hebrew origin (H05152); Nachor, the grandfather of Abraham:--Nachor.
entries.3494: νεανίας NEANI/AS neanías neh-an-ee'-as from a derivative of G3501; a youth (up to about forty years):--young man.
entries.3495: νεανίσκος NEANI/SKOS neanískos neh-an-is'-kos from the same as G3494; a youth (under forty):--young man.
entries.3496: Νεάπολις *NEA/POLIS Neápolis neh-ap'-ol-is from G3501 and G4172; new town; Neapolis, a place in Macedonia:--Neapolis.
entries.3497: Νεεμάν *NEEMA/N Neemán neh-eh-man' of Hebrew origin (H05283); Neeman (i.e. Naaman), a Syrian:--Naaman.
entries.3498: νεκρός NEKRO/S nekrós nek-ros' from an apparently primary νέκυς NE/KUS nékys (a corpse); dead (literally or figuratively; also as noun):--dead.
entries.3499: νεκρόω NEKRO/W nekróō nek-ro'-o from G3498; to deaden, i.e. (figuratively) to subdue:--be dead, mortify.
entries.3500: νέκρωσις NE/KRWSIS nékrōsis nek'-ro-sis from G3499; decease; figuratively, impotency:--deadness, dying.
entries.3501: νέος NE/OS néos neh'-os including the comparative νεότερος NEO/TEROS neóteros neh-o'-ter-os ; a primary word;"new", i.e. (of persons) youthful, or (of things) fresh; figuratively, regenerate:--new, young.
entries.3502: νεοσσός NEOSSO/S neossós neh-os-sos' from G3501; a youngling (nestling):--young.
entries.3503: νεότης NEO/THS neótēs neh-ot'-ace from G3501; newness, i.e. youthfulness:--youth.
entries.3504: νεόφυτος NEO/FUTOS neóphytos neh-of'-oo-tos from G3501 and a derivative of G5453; newly planted, i.e. (figuratively) a young convert ("neophyte"):--novice.
entries.3505: Νέρων *NE/RWN Nérōn ner'-ohn of Latin origin; Neron (i.e. Nero), a Roman emperor:--Nero.
entries.3506: νεύω NEU/W neúō nyoo'-o apparently a primary verb; to "nod", i.e. (by analogy), signal:--beckon.
entries.3507: νεφέλη NEFE/LH nephélē nef-el'-ay from G3509; properly, cloudiness, i.e. (concretely) a cloud:--cloud.
entries.3508: Νεφθαλείμ *NEFQALEI/M Nephthaleím nef-thal-ime' of Hebrew origin (H05321); Nephthaleim (i.e. Naphthali), a tribe in Palestine:--Nephthalim.
entries.3509: νέφος NE/FOS néphos nef'-os apparently a primary word; a cloud:--cloud.
entries.3510: νεφρός NEFRO/S nephrós nef-ros' of uncertain affinity; a kidney (plural), i.e. (figuratively) the inmost mind:--reins.
entries.3511: νεωκόρος NEWKO/ROS neōkóros neh-o-kor'-os from a form of G3485 and κορέω KORE/W koréō (to sweep); a temple-servant, i.e. (by implication) a votary:--worshipper.
entries.3512: νεωτερικός NEWTERIKO/S neōterikós neh-o-ter'-ik-os from the comparative of G3501; appertaining to younger persons, i.e. juvenile:--youthful.
entries.3513: νή NH/ nḗ nay probably an intensive form of G3483; a particle of attestation (accompanied by the object invoked or appealed to in confirmation); as sure as:--I protest by.
entries.3514: νήθω NH/QW nḗthō nay'-tho from νέω NE/W néō (of like meaning); to spin:--spin.
entries.3515: νηπιάζω NHPIA/ZW nēpiázō nay-pee-ad'-zo from G3516; to act as a babe, i.e. (figuratively) innocently:--be a child.
entries.3516: νήπιος NH/PIOS nḗpios nay'-pee-os from an obsolete particle νή‐ NH/- nḗ- (implying negation) and G2031; not speaking, i.e. an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded person, an immature Christian:--babe, child (+ -ish).
entries.3517: Νηρεύς *NHREU/S Nēreús nare-yoos' apparently from a derivative of the base of G3491 (meaning wet); Nereus, a Christian:--Nereus.
entries.3518: Νηρί *NHRI/ Nērí nay-ree' of Hebrew origin (H05374); Neri (i.e. Nerijah), an Israelite:--Neri.
entries.3519: νησίον NHSI/ON nēsíon nay-see'-on diminutive of G3520; an islet:--island.
entries.3520: νῆσος NH=SOS nēsos nay'-sos probably from the base of G3491; an island:--island, isle.
entries.3521: νηστεία NHSTEI/A nēsteía nace-ti'-ah from G3522; abstinence (from lack of food, or voluntary and religious); specially, the fast of the Day of Atonement:-- fast(-ing).
entries.3522: νηστεύω NHSTEU/W nēsteúō nace-tyoo'-o from G3523; to abstain from food (religiously):--fast.
entries.3523: νῆστις NH=STIS nēstis nace'-tis from the inseparable negative particle νή‐ NH/- nḗ- (not) and G2068; not eating, i.e. abstinent from food (religiously):--fasting.
entries.3524: νηφάλεος NHFA/LEOS nēpháleos nay-fal'-eh-os , or νηφάλιος NHFA/LIOS nēphálios nay-fal'-ee-os from G3525; sober, i.e. (figuratively) circumspect:--sober.
entries.3525: νήφω NH/FW nḗphō nay'-fo of uncertain affinity; to abstain from wine (keep sober), i.e. (figuratively) be discreet:--be sober, watch.
entries.3526: Νίγερ *NI/GER Níger neeg'-er of Latin origin; black; Niger, a Christian:--Niger.
entries.3527: Νικάνωρ *NIKA/NWR Nikánōr nik-an'-ore probably from G3528; victorious; Nicanor, a Christian:--Nicanor.
entries.3528: νικάω NIKA/W nikáō nik-ah'-o from G3529; to subdue (literally or figuratively):--conquer, overcome, prevail, get the victory.
entries.3529: νίκη NI/KH níkē nee'-kay apparently a primary word; conquest (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) the means of success:--victory.
entries.3530: Νικόδημος *NIKO/DHMOS Nikódēmos nik-od'-ay-mos from G3534 and G1218; victorious among his people; Nicodemus, an Israelite:--Nicodemus.
entries.3531: Νικολαΐτης *NIKOLAI/+THS Nikolaḯtēs nik-ol-ah-ee'-tace from G3532; a Nicolaïte, i.e. adherent of Nicolaüs:--Nicolaitane.
entries.3532: Νικόλαος *NIKO/LAOS Nikólaos nik-ol'-ah-os from G3534 and G2992; victorious over the people; Nicolaüs, a heretic:--Nicolaus.
entries.3533: Νικόπολις *NIKO/POLIS Nikópolis nik-op'-ol-is from G3534 and G4172; victorious city; Nicopolis, a place in Macedonia:--Nicopolis.
entries.3534: νῖκος NI=KOS nîkos nee'-kos from G3529; a conquest (concretely), i.e. (by implication) triumph:--victory.
entries.3535: Νινευΐ *NINEUI/+ Nineuḯ nin-yoo-ee' of Hebrew origin (H05210); Ninevi (i.e. Nineveh), the capital of Assyria:--Nineve.
entries.3536: Νινευΐτης *NINEUI/+THS Nineuḯtēs nin-yoo-ee'-tace from G3535; a Ninevite, i.e. inhabitant of Nineveh:--of Nineve, Ninevite.
entries.3537: νιπτήρ NIPTH/R niptḗr nip-tare' from G3538; a ewer:--bason.
entries.3538: νίπτω NI/PTW níptō nip'-to to cleanse (especially the hands or the feet or the face); ceremonially, to perform ablution:--wash. Compare G3068.
entries.3539: νοιέω NOIE/W noiéō noy-eh'-o from G3563; to exercise the mind (observe), i.e. (figuratively) to comprehend, heed:--consider, perceive, think, understand.
entries.3540: νόημα NO/HMA nóēma no'-ay-mah from G3539; a perception, i.e. purpose, or (by implication) the intellect, disposition, itself:--device, mind, thought.
entries.3541: νόθος NO/QOS nóthos noth'-os of uncertain affinity; a spurious or illegitimate son:--bastard.
entries.3542: νομή NOMH/ nomḗ nom-ay' feminine from the same as G3551; pasture, i.e. (the act) feeding (figuratively, spreading of a gangrene), or (the food) pasturage:--X eat, pasture.
entries.3543: νομίζω NOMI/ZW nomízō nom-id'-zo from G3551; properly, to do by law (usage), i.e. to accustom (passively, be usual); by extension, to deem or regard:-- suppose, thing, be wont.
entries.3544: νομικός NOMIKO/S nomikós nom-ik-os' from G3551; according (or pertaining) to law, i.e. legal (ceremonially); as noun, an expert in the (Mosaic) law:--about the law, lawyer.
entries.3545: νομίμως NOMI/MWS nomímōs nom-im'-oce adverb from a derivative of G3551; legitimately (specially, agreeably to the rules of the lists):--lawfully.
entries.3546: νόμισμα NO/MISMA nómisma nom'-is-mah from G3543; what is reckoned as of value (after the Latin numisma), i.e. current coin:--money.
entries.3547: νομοδιδάσκαλος NOMODIDA/SKALOS nomodidáskalos nom-od-id-as'-kal-os from G3551 and G1320; an expounder of the (Jewish) law, i.e. a Rabbi:--doctor (teacher) of the law.
entries.3548: νομοθεσία NOMOQESI/A nomothesía nom-oth-es-ee'-ah from G3550; legislation (specially, the institution of the Mosaic code):--giving of the law.
entries.3549: νομοθετέω NOMOQETE/W nomothetéō nom-oth-et-eh'-o from G3550; to legislate, i.e. (passively) to have (the Mosaic) enactments injoined, be sanctioned (by them):--establish, receive the law.
entries.3550: νομοθέτης NOMOQE/THS nomothétēs nom-oth-et'-ace from G3551 and a derivative of G5087; a legislator:--lawgiver.
entries.3551: νόμος NO/MOS nómos nom'-os from a primary νέμω NE/MW némō (to parcel out, especially food or grazing to animals); law (through the idea of prescriptive usage), genitive case (regulation), specially, (of Moses (including the volume); also of the Gospel), or figuratively (a principle):--law.
entries.3552: νοσέω NOSE/W noséō nos-eh'-o from G3554; to be sick, i.e. (by implication, of a diseased appetite) to hanker after (figuratively, to harp upon):--dote.
entries.3553: νόσημα NO/SHMA nósēma nos'-ay-ma from G3552; an ailment:--disease.
entries.3554: νόσος NO/SOS nósos nos'-os of uncertain affinity; a malady (rarely figuratively, of moral disability):--disease, infirmity, sickness.
entries.3555: νοσσιά NOSSIA/ nossiá nos-see-ah' from G3502; a brood (of chickens):--brood.
entries.3556: νοσσίον NOSSI/ON nossíon nos-see'-on diminutive of G3502; a birdling:--chicken.
entries.3557: νοσφίζομαι NOSFI/ZOMAI nosphízomai nos-fid'-zom-ahee middle voice from νοσφί NOSFI/ nosphí (apart or clandestinely); to sequestrate for oneself, i.e. embezzle:--keep back, purloin.
entries.3558: νότος NO/TOS nótos not'-os of uncertain affinity; the south(-west) wind; by extension, the southern quarter itself:--south (wind).
entries.3559: νουθεσία NOUQESI/A nouthesía noo-thes-ee'-ah from G3563 and a derivative of G5087; calling attention to, i.e. (by implication) mild rebuke or warning:--admonition.
entries.3560: νουθετέω NOUQETE/W nouthetéō noo-thet-eh'-o from the same as G3559; to put in mind, i.e. (by implication) to caution or reprove gently:--admonish, warn.
entries.3561: νουμηνία NOUMHNI/A noumēnía noo-may-nee'-ah feminine of a compound of G3501 and G3376 (as noun by implication, of G2250); the festival of new moon:--new moon.
entries.3562: νουνεχῶς NOUNEXW=S nounechōs noon-ekh-oce' adverb from a compound of the accusative case of G3563 and G2192; in a mind-having way, i.e. prudently:--discreetly.
entries.3563: νοῦς NOU=S noûs nooce probably from the base of G1097; the intellect, i.e. mind (divine or human; in thought, feeling, or will); by implication, meaning:--mind, understanding. Compare G5590.
entries.3564: Νυμφᾶς *NUMFA=S Nymphâs noom-fas' probably contracted for a compound of G3565 and G1435; nymph-given (i.e. -born); Nymphas, a Christian:--Nymphas.
entries.3565: νύμφη NU/MFH nýmphē noom-fay' from a primary but obsolete verb νύπτω NU/PTW nýptō (to veil as a bride; compare Latin "nupto," to marry); a young married woman (as veiled), including a betrothed girl; by implication, a son's wife:--bride, daughter in law.
entries.3566: νυμφίος NUMFI/OS nymphíos noom-fee'-os from G3565; a bride-groom (literally or figuratively):--bridegroom.
entries.3567: νυμφών NUMFW/N nymphṓn noom-fohn' from G3565; the bridal room:--bridechamber.
entries.3568: νῦν NU=N nŷn noon a primary particle of present time; "now" (as adverb of date, a transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective present or immediate:--henceforth, + hereafter, of late, soon, present, this (time). See also G3569, G3570.
entries.3569: τανῦν TANU=N tanŷn tan-oon' or τὰ νῦν TA\ NU=N tà nŷn tah noon from neuter plural of G3588 and G3568; the things now, i.e. (adverbially) at present:--(but) now.
entries.3570: νυνί NUNI/ nyní noo-nee' a prolonged form of G3568 for emphasis; just now:--now.
entries.3571: νύξ NU/C nýx noox a primary word; "night" (literally or figuratively):-- (mid-)night.
entries.3572: νύσσω NU/SSW nýssō noos'-so apparently a primary word; to prick ("nudge"):--pierce.
entries.3573: νυστάζω NUSTA/ZW nystázō noos-tad'-zo from a presumed derivative of G3506; to nod, i.e. (by implication) to fall asleep; figuratively, to delay:--slumber.
entries.3574: νυχθήμερον NUXQH/MERON nychthḗmeron nookh-thay'-mer-on from G3571 and G2250; a day-and-night, i.e. full day of twenty-four hours:--night and day.
entries.3575: Νῶε *NW=E Nōe no'-eh of Hebrew origin (H05146); Noë, (i.e. Noäch), a patriarch:--Noe.
entries.3576: νωθρός NWQRO/S nōthrós no-thros' from a derivative of G3541; sluggish, i.e. (literally) lazy, or (figuratively) stupid:--dull, slothful.
entries.3577: νῶτος NW=TOS nōtos no'-tos of uncertain affinity; the back:--back.
entries.3578: ξενία CENI/A xenía xen-ee'-ah from G3581; hospitality, i.e. (by implication) a place of entertainment:--lodging.
entries.3579: ξενίζω CENI/ZW xenízō xen-id'-zo from G3581; to be a host (passively, a guest); by implication, be (make, appear) strange:--entertain, lodge, (think it) strange.
entries.3580: ξενοδοχέω CENODOXE/W xenodochéō xen-od-okh-eh'-o from a compound of G3581 and G1209; to be hospitable:--lodge strangers.
entries.3581: ξένος CE/NOS xénos xen'-os apparently a primary word; foreign (literally, alien, or figuratively, novel); by implication, a guest or (vice-versa) entertainer:--host, strange(-r).
entries.3582: ξέστης CE/STHS xéstēs xes'-tace as if from ξέω CE/W xéō (properly, to smooth; by implication, (of friction) to boil or heat); a vessel (as fashioned or for cooking) (or perhaps by corruption from the Latin sextarius, the sixth of a modius, i.e. about a pint), i.e. (specially), a measure for liquids or solids, (by analogy, a pitcher):--pot.
entries.3583: ξηραίνω CHRAI/NW xēraínō xay-rah'-ee-no from G3584; to desiccate; by implication, to shrivel, to mature:--dry up, pine away, be ripe, wither (away).
entries.3584: ξηρός CHRO/S xērós xay-ros' from the base of G3582 (through the idea of scorching); arid; by implication, shrunken, earth (as opposed to water):--dry land, withered.
entries.3585: ξύλινος CU/LINOS xýlinos xoo'-lin-os from G3586; wooden:--of wood.
entries.3586: ξύλον CU/LON xýlon xoo'-lon from another form of the base of G3582; timber (as fuel or material); by implication, a stick, club or tree or other wooden article or substance:--staff, stocks, tree, wood.
entries.3587: ξυράω CURA/W xyráō xoo-rah'-o from a derivative of the same as G3586 (meaning a razor); to shave or "shear" the hair:--shave.
entries.3588: ὁ O( ho ho , including the feminine ἡ H( hē hay , and the neuter τό TO/ tó to in all their inflections; the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom):--the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.
entries.3589: ὀγδοήκοντα O)GDOH/KONTA ogdoḗkonta og-do-ay'-kon-tah from G3590; ten times eight:--fourscore.
entries.3590: ὄγδοος O)/GDOOS ógdoos og'-do-os from G3638; the eighth:--eighth.
entries.3591: ὄγκος O)/GKOS ónkos ong'-kos probably from the same as G43; a mass (as bending or bulging by its load), i.e. burden (hindrance):--weight.
entries.3592: ὅδε O(/DE hóde hod'-eh , including the feminine ἥδε H(/DE hḗde hay'-deh , and the neuter τόδε TO/DE tóde tod'-e from G3588 and G1161; the same, i.e. this or that one (plural these or those); often used as a personal pronoun:--he, she, such, these, thus.
entries.3593: ὁδεύω O(DEU/W hodeúō hod-yoo'-o from G3598; to travel:--journey.
entries.3594: ὁδηγέω O(DHGE/W hodēgéō hod-ayg-eh'-o from G3595; to show the way (literally or figuratively (teach)):--guide, lead.
entries.3595: ὁδηγός O(DHGO/S hodēgós hod-ayg-os' from G3598 and G2233; a conductor (literally or figuratively (teacher)):--guide, leader.
entries.3596: ὁδοιπορέω O(DOIPORE/W hodoiporéō hod-oy-por-eh'-o from a compound of G3598 and G4198; to be a wayfarer, i.e. travel:--go on a journey.
entries.3597: ὁδοιπορία O(DOIPORI/A hodoiporía hod-oy-por-ee'-ah from the same as G3596; travel:--journey(-ing).
entries.3598: ὁδός O(DO/S hodós hod-os' apparently a primary word; a road; by implication, a progress (the route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means:--journey, (high-)way.
entries.3599: ὀδούς O)DOU/S odoús od-ooce perhaps from the base of G2068; a "tooth":--tooth.
entries.3600: ὀδυνάω O)DUNA/W odynáō od-oo-nah'-o from G3601; to grieve:--sorrow, torment.
entries.3601: ὀδύνη O)DU/NH odýnē od-oo'-nay from G1416; grief (as dejecting):--sorrow.
entries.3602: ὀδυρμός O)DURMO/S odyrmós od-oor-mos' from a derivative of the base of G1416; moaning, i.e. lamentation:--mourning.
entries.3603: ὅ ἐστι O(/ E)STI hó esti ho es-tee' from the neuter of G3739 and the third person singular present indicative of G1510; which is:--called, which is (make), that is (to say).
entries.3604: Ὀζίας *)OZI/AS Ozías od-zee'-as of Hebrew origin (H05818); Ozias (i.e. Uzzijah), an Israelite:--Ozias.
entries.3605: ὄζω O)/ZW ózō od'-zo a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to scent (usually an ill "odor"):--stink.
entries.3606: ὅθεν O(/QEN hóthen hoth'-en from G3739 with the directive enclitic of source; from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction):--from thence, (from) whence, where(-by, -fore, -upon).
entries.3607: ὀθόνη O)QO/NH othónē oth-on'-ay of uncertain affinity; a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a sail:--sheet.
entries.3608: ὀθόνιον O)QO/NION othónion oth-on'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G3607; a linen bandage:--linen clothes.
entries.3609: οἰκεῖος OI)KEI=OS oikeîos oy-ki'-os from G3624; domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent:--(those) of the (his own) house(-hold).
entries.3610: οἰκέτης OI)KE/THS oikétēs oy-ket'-ace from G3611; a fellow resident, i.e. menial domestic:--(household) servant.
entries.3611: οἰκέω OI)KE/W oikéō oy-keh'-o from G3624; to occupy a house, i.e. reside (figuratively, inhabit, remain, inhere); by implication, to cohabit:--dwell. See also G3625.
entries.3612: οἴκημα OI)/KHMA oíkēma oy'-kay-mah from G3611; a tenement, i.e. (specially), a jail:--prison.
entries.3613: οἰκητήριον OI)KHTH/RION oikētḗrion oy-kay-tay'-ree-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G3611 (equivalent to G3612); a residence (literally or figuratively):--habitation, house.
entries.3614: οἰκία OI)KI/A oikía oy-kee'-ah from G3624; properly, residence (abstractly), but usually (concretely) an abode (literally or figuratively); by implication, a family (especially domestics):--home, house(-hold).
entries.3615: οἰκιακός OI)KIAKO/S oikiakós oy-kee-ak-os' from G3614; familiar, i.e. (as noun) relatives:--they (them) of (his own) household.
entries.3616: οἰκοδεσποτέω OI)KODESPOTE/W oikodespotéō oy-kod-es-pot-eh'-o from G3617; to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family:--guide the house.
entries.3617: οἰκοδεσπότης OI)KODESPO/THS oikodespótēs oy-kod-es-pot'-ace from G3624 and G1203; the head of a family:--goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house.
entries.3618: οἰκοδομέω OI)KODOME/W oikodoméō oy-kod-om-eh'-o from the same as G3619; to be a house-builder, i.e. construct or (figuratively) confirm:--(be in) build(-er, -ing, up), edify, embolden.
entries.3619: οἰκοδομή OI)KODOMH/ oikodomḗ oy-kod-om-ay' feminine (abstract) of a compound of G3624 and the base of G1430; architecture, i.e. (concretely) a structure; figuratively, confirmation:--building, edify(-ication, -ing).
entries.3620: οἰκοδομία OI)KODOMI/A oikodomía oy-kod-om-ee'-ah from the same as G3619; confirmation:--edifying.
entries.3621: οἰκονομέω OI)KONOME/W oikonoméō oy-kon-om-eh'-o from G3623; to manage (a house, i.e. an estate):--be steward.
entries.3622: οἰκονομία OI)KONOMI/A oikonomía oy-kon-om-ee'-ah from G3623; administration (of a household or estate); specially, a (religious) "economy":--dispensation, stewardship.
entries.3623: οἰκονόμος OI)KONO/MOS oikonómos oy-kon-om'-os from G3624 and the base of G3551; a house-distributor (i.e. manager), or overseer, i.e. an employee in that capacity; by extension, a fiscal agent (treasurer); figuratively, a preacher (of the Gospel):--chamberlain, governor, steward.
entries.3624: οἶκος OI)=KOS oîkos oy'-kos of uncertain affinity; a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively):--home, house(-hold), temple.
entries.3625: οἰκουμένη OI)KOUME/NH oikouménē oy-kou-men'-ay feminine participle present passive of G3611 (as noun, by implication, of G1093); land, i.e. the (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the Roman empire:--earth, world.
entries.3626: οἰκουρός OI)KOURO/S oikourós oy-koo-ros' from G3624 and οὖρος OU)=ROS oûros (a guard; be "ware"); a stayer at home, i.e. domestically inclined (a "good housekeeper"):--keeper at home.
entries.3627: οἰκτείρω OI)KTEI/RW oikteírō oyk-ti'-ro also (in certain tenses) prolonged οἰκτερέω OI)KTERE/W oikteréō oyk-ter-eh'-o from οἶκτος OI)=KTOS oîktos (pity); to exercise pity:--have compassion on.
entries.3628: οἰκτιρμός OI)KTIRMO/S oiktirmós oyk-tir-mos' from G3627; pity:--mercy.
entries.3629: οἰκτίρμων OI)KTI/RMWN oiktírmōn oyk-tir'-mone from G3627; compassionate:--merciful, of tender mercy.
entries.3630: οἰνοπότης OI)NOPO/THS oinopótēs oy-nop-ot'-ace from G3631 and a derivative of the alternate of G4095; a tippler:--winebibber.
entries.3631: οἶνος OI)=NOS oînos oy'-nos a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin (H03196)); "wine" (literally or figuratively):--wine.
entries.3632: οἰνοφλυγία OI)NOFLUGI/A oinophlygía oy-nof-loog-ee'-ah from G3631 and a form of the base of G5397; an overflow (or surplus) of wine, i.e. vinolency (drunkenness):--excess of wine.
entries.3633: οἴομαι OI)/OMAI oíomai oy'-om-ahee , or (shorter) οἶμαι OI)=MAI oîmai oy'-mahee middle voice apparently from G3634; to make like (oneself), i.e. imagine (be of the opinion):--suppose, think.
entries.3634: οἷος OI(=OS hoîos hoy'-os probably akin to G3588, G3739, and G3745; such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so:--so (as), such as, what (manner of), which.
entries.3635: ὀκνέω O)KNE/W oknéō ok-neh'-o from ὄκνος O)/KNOS óknos (hesitation); to be slow (figuratively, loath):--delay.
entries.3636: ὀκνηρός O)KNHRO/S oknērós ok-nay-ros' from G3635; tardy, i.e. indolent; (figuratively) irksome:--grievous, slothful.
entries.3637: ὀκταήμερος O)KTAH/MEROS oktaḗmeros ok-tah-ay'-mer-os from G3638 and G2250; an eight-day old person or act:--the eighth day.
entries.3638: ὀκτώ O)KTW/ oktṓ ok-to' a primary numeral; "eight":--eight.
entries.3639: ὄλεθρος O)/LEQROS ólethros ol'-eth-ros from a primary ὄλλυμι O)/LLUMI óllymi (to destroy; a prolonged form); ruin, i.e. death, punishment:--destruction.
entries.3640: ὀλιγόπιστος O)LIGO/PISTOS oligópistos ol-ig-op'-is-tos from G3641 and G4102; incredulous, i.e. lacking confidence (in Christ):--of little faith.
entries.3641: ὀλίγος O)LI/GOS olígos ol-ee'-gos of uncertain affinity; puny (in extent, degree, number, duration or value); especially neuter (adverbially) somewhat:--+ almost, brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while.
entries.3642: ὀλιγόψυχος O)LIGO/YUXOS oligópsychos ol-ig-op'-soo-khos from G3641 and G5590; little-spirited, i.e. faint-hearted:--feebleminded.
entries.3643: ὀλιγωρέω O)LIGWRE/W oligōréō ol-ig-o-reh'-o from a compound of G3641 and ὤρα W)/RA ṓra ("care"); to have little regard for, i.e. to disesteem:--despise.
entries.3644: ὀλοθρευτής O)LOQREUTH/S olothreutḗs ol-oth-ryoo-tace' from G3645; a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent:--destroyer.
entries.3645: ὀλοθρεύω O)LOQREU/W olothreúō ol-oth-ryoo'-o from G3639; to spoil, i.e. slay:--destroy.
entries.3646: ὁλοκαύτωμα O(LOKAU/TWMA holokaútōma hol-ok-ow'-to-mah from a derivative of a compound of G3650 and a derivative of G2545; a wholly-consumed sacrifice ("holocaust"):--(whole) burnt offering.
entries.3647: ὁλοκληρία O(LOKLHRI/A holoklēría hol-ok-lay-ree'-ah from G3648; integrity, i.e. physical wholeness:--perfect soundness.
entries.3648: ὁλόκληρος O(LO/KLHROS holóklēros hol'-ok'-lay-ros from G3650 and G2819; complete in every part, i.e. perfectly sound (in body):--entire, whole.
entries.3649: ὀλολύζω O)LOLU/ZW ololýzō ol-ol-odd'-zo a reduplicated primary verb; to "howl" or "halloo", i.e. shriek:--howl.
entries.3650: ὅλος O(/LOS hólos hol'-os a primary word; "whole" or "all", i.e. complete (in extent, amount, time or degree), especially (neuter) as noun or adverb:--all, altogether, every whit, + throughout, whole.
entries.3651: ὁλοτελής O(LOTELH/S holotelḗs hol-ot-el-ace' from G3650 and G5056; complete to the end, i.e. absolutely perfect:--wholly.
entries.3652: Ὀλυμπᾶς *)OLUMPA=S Olympâs ol-oom-pas' probably a contraction from Ὀλυμπιόδωρος *)OLUMPIO/DWROS Olympiódōros (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. heaven-descended); Olympas, a Christian:--Olympas.
entries.3653: ὄλυνθος O)/LUNQOS ólynthos ol'-oon-thos of uncertain derivation; an unripe (because out of season) fig:--untimely fig.
entries.3654: ὅλως O(/LWS hólōs hol'-oce adverb from G3650; completely, i.e. altogether; (by analogy), everywhere; (negatively) not by any means:--at all, commonly, utterly.
entries.3655: ὄμβρος O)/MBROS ómbros om'-bros of uncertain affinity; a thunder storm:--shower.
entries.3656: ὁμιλέω O(MILE/W homiléō hom-il-eh'-o from G3658; to be in company with, i.e. (by implication) to converse:--commune, talk.
entries.3657: ὁμιλία O(MILI/A homilía hom-il-ee'-ah from G3658; companionship ("homily"), i.e. (by implication) intercourse:--communication.
entries.3658: ὅμιλος O(/MILOS hómilos hom'-il-os from the base of G3674 and a derivative of the alternate of G138 (meaning a crowd); association together, i.e. a multitude:--company.
entries.3659: ὄμμα O)/MMA ómma om'-mah from G3700; a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye:--eye.
entries.3660: ὀμνύω O)MNU/W omnýō om-noo'-o ; a prolonged form of a primary, but obsolete ὄμω O)/MW ómō, for which another prolonged form ὀμόω O)MO/W omóō om-o'-o is used in certain tenses; to swear, i.e. take (or declare on) oath:--swear.
entries.3661: ὁμοθυμαδόν O(MOQUMADO/N homothymadón hom-oth-oo-mad-on' adverb from a compound of the base of G3674 and G2372; unanimously:--with one accord (mind).
entries.3662: ὁμοιάζω O(MOIA/ZW homoiázō hom-oy-ad'-zo from G3664; to resemble:--agree.
entries.3663: ὁμοιοπαθής O(MOIOPAQH/S homoiopathḗs hom-oy-op-ath-ace' from G3664 and the alternate of G3958; similarly affected:--of (subject to) like passions.
entries.3664: ὅμοιος O(/MOIOS hómoios hom'-oy-os from the base of G3674; similar (in appearance or character):--like, + manner.
entries.3665: ὁμοιότης O(MOIO/THS homoiótēs hom-oy-ot'-ace from G3664; resemblance:--like as, similitude.
entries.3666: ὁμοιόω O(MOIO/W homoióō hom-oy-o'-o from G3664; to assimilate, i.e. compare; passively, to become similar:--be (make) like, (in the) liken(-ess), resemble.
entries.3667: ὁμοίωμα O(MOI/WMA homoíōma hom-oy'-o-mah from G3666; a form; abstractly, resemblance:--made like to, likeness, shape, similitude.
entries.3668: ὁμοίως O(MOI/WS homoíōs hom-oy'-oce adverb from G3664; similarly:--likewise, so.
entries.3669: ὁμοίωσις O(MOI/WSIS homoíōsis hom-oy'-o-sis from G3666; assimilation, i.e. resemblance:--similitude.
entries.3670: ὁμολογέω O(MOLOGE/W homologéō hom-ol-og-eh'-o from a compound of the base of G3674 and G3056; to assent, i.e. covenant, acknowledge:--con- (pro-)fess, confession is made, give thanks, promise.
entries.3671: ὁμολογία O(MOLOGI/A homología hom-ol-og-ee'-ah from the same as G3670; acknowledgment:--con- (pro-)fession, professed.
entries.3672: ὁμολογουμένως O(MOLOGOUME/NWS homologouménōs hom-ol-og-ow-men'-oce adverb of present passive participle of G3670; confessedly:--without controversy.
entries.3673: ὁμότεχνος O(MO/TEXNOS homótechnos hom-ot'-ekh-nos from the base of G3674 and G5078; a fellow-artificer:--of the same craft.
entries.3674: ὁμοῦ O(MOU= homoû hom-oo' genitive case of ὁμός O(MO/S homós (the same; akin to G260) as adverb; at the same place or time:--together.
entries.3675: ὁμόφρων O(MO/FRWN homóphrōn hom-of'-rone from the base of G3674 and G5424; like-minded, i.e. harmonious:--of one mind.
entries.3676: ὅμως O(/MWS hómōs hom'-oce adverb from the base of G3674; at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally) notwithstanding, yet still:--and even, nevertheless, though but.
entries.3677: ὄναρ O)/NAR ónar on'-ar of uncertain derivation; a dream:--dream.
entries.3678: ὀνάριον O)NA/RION onárion on-ar'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G3688; a little ass:--young ass.
entries.3679: ὀνειδίζω O)NEIDI/ZW oneidízō on-i-did'-zo from G3681; to defame, i.e. rail at, chide, taunt:--cast in teeth, (suffer) reproach, revile, upbraid.
entries.3680: ὀνειδισμός O)NEIDISMO/S oneidismós on-i-dis-mos' from G3679; contumely:--reproach.
entries.3681: ὄνειδος O)/NEIDOS óneidos on'-i-dos probably akin to the base of G3686; notoriety, i.e. a taunt (disgrace):--reproach.
entries.3682: Ὀνήσιμος *)ONH/SIMOS Onḗsimos on-ay'-sim-os from G3685; profitable; Onesimus, a Christian:--Onesimus.
entries.3683: Ὀνησίφορος *)ONHSI/FOROS Onēsíphoros on-ay-sif'-or-os from a derivative of G3685 and G5411; profit-bearer; Onesiphorus, a Christian:--Onespiphorus.
entries.3684: ὀνικός O)NIKO/S onikós on-ik-os' from G3688; belonging to a ass, i.e. large (so as to be turned by a ass):--millstone.
entries.3685: ὀνίνημι O)NI/NHMI onínēmi on-in'-ay-mee a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb ( ὄνομαι O)/NOMAI ónomai, to slur); for which another prolonged form ( ὀνάω O)NA/W onáō) is used as an alternate in some tenses (unless indeed it be identical with the base of G3686 through the idea of notoriety); to gratify, i.e. (middle voice) to derive pleasure or advantage from:--have joy.
entries.3686: ὄνομα O)/NOMA ónoma on'-om-ah from a presumed derivative of the base of G1097 (compare G3685); a "name" (literally or figuratively) (authority, character):--called, (+ sur-)name(-d).
entries.3687: ὀνομάζω O)NOMA/ZW onomázō on-om-ad'-zo from G3686; to name, i.e. assign an appellation; by extension, to utter, mention, profess:--call, name.
entries.3688: ὄνος O)/NOS ónos on'-os apparently a primary word; a donkey:--an ass.
entries.3689: ὄντως O)/NTWS óntōs on'-toce adverb of the oblique cases of G5607; really:--certainly, clean, indeed, of a truth, verily.
entries.3690: ὄξος O)/COS óxos oz-os from G3691; vinegar, i.e. sour wine:--vinegar.
entries.3691: ὀξύς O)CU/S oxýs oz-oos' probably akin to the base of G188 ("acid"); keen; by analogy, rapid:--sharp, swift.
entries.3692: ὀπή O)PH/ opḗ op-ay' probably from G3700; a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy, a spring (of water):--cave, place.
entries.3693: ὄπισθεν O)/PISQEN ópisthen op'-is-then from ὄπις O)/PIS ópis (regard; from G3700) with enclitic of source; from the rear (as a secure aspect), i.e. at the back (adverb and preposition of place or time):--after, backside, behind.
entries.3694: ὀπίσω O)PI/SW opísō op-is'-o from the same as G3693 with enclitic of direction; to the back, i.e. aback (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun):--after, back(-ward), (+ get) behind, + follow.
entries.3695: ὁπλίζω O(PLI/ZW hoplízō hop-lid'-zo from G3696; to equip (with weapons (middle voice and figuratively)):--arm self.
entries.3696: ὅπλον O(/PLON hóplon hop'-lon probably from a primary ἕπω E(/PW hépō (to be busy about); an implement or utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for war):--armour, instrument, weapon.
entries.3697: ὁποῖος O(POI=OS hopoîos hop-oy'-os from G3739 and G4169; of what kind that, i.e. how (as) great (excellent) (specially, as an indefinite correlative to the definite antecedent G5108 of quality):--what manner (sort) of, such as whatsoever.
entries.3698: ὁπότε O(PO/TE hopóte hop-ot'-eh from G3739 and G4218; what(-ever) then, i.e. (of time) as soon as:--when.
entries.3699: ὅπου O(/POU hópou hop'-oo from G3739 and G4225; what(-ever) where, i.e. at whichever spot:--in what place, where(-as, -soever), whither (+ soever).
entries.3700: ὀπτάνομαι O)PTA/NOMAI optánomai op-tan'-om-ahee ; a (middle voice) prolonged form of the primary (middle voice) ὄπτομαι O)/PTOMAI óptomai op'-tom-ahee ; which is used for it in certain tenses; and both as alternate of G3708; to gaze (i.e. with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and thus differing from G991, which denotes simply voluntary observation; and from G1492, which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual vision; while G2300, and still more emphatically its intensive G2334, signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and G4648 a watching from a distance):--appear, look, see, shew self.
entries.3701: ὀπτασία O)PTASI/A optasía op-tas-ee'-ah from a presumed derivative of G3700; visuality, i.e. (concretely) an apparition:--vision.
entries.3702: ὀπτός O)PTO/S optós op-tos' from an obsolete verb akin to ἕπσω E(/PSW hépsō (to "steep"); cooked, i.e. roasted:--broiled.
entries.3703: ὀπώρα O)PW/RA opṓra op-o'-rah apparently from the base of G3796 and G5610; properly, even-tide of the (summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit:--fruit.
entries.3704: ὅπως O(/PWS hópōs hop'-oce from G3739 and G4459; what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or actual):--because, how, (so) that, to, when.
entries.3705: ὅραμα O(/RAMA hórama hor'-am-ah from G3708; something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially supernatural):--sight, vision.
entries.3706: ὅρασις O(/RASIS hórasis hor'-as-is from G3708; the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or (internally) an inspired appearance:--sight, vision.
entries.3707: ὁρατός O(RATO/S horatós hor-at-os' from G3708; gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being seen:--visible.
entries.3708: ὁράω O(RA/W horáō hor-ah'-o properly, to stare at (compare G3700), i.e. (by implication) to discern clearly (physically or mentally); by extension, to attend to; by Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear:--behold, perceive, see, take heed.
entries.3709: ὀργή O)RGH/ orgḗ or-gay' from G3713; properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable) abhorrence); by implication punishment:--anger, indignation, vengeance, wrath.
entries.3710: ὀργίζω O)RGI/ZW orgízō or-gid'-zo from G3709; to provoke or enrage, i.e. (passively) become exasperated:--be angry (wroth).
entries.3711: ὀργίλος O)RGI/LOS orgílos org-ee'-los from G3709; irascible:--soon angry.
entries.3712: ὀργυιά O)RGUIA/ orguiá org-wee-ah' from G3713; a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom:--fathom.
entries.3713: ὀρέγομαι O)RE/GOMAI orégomai or-eg'-om-ahee middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (compare G3735); to stretch oneself, i.e. reach out after (long for):--covet after, desire.
entries.3714: ὀρεινός O)REINO/S oreinós or-i-nos from G3735; mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of G5561) the Highlands (of Judæa):--hill country.
entries.3715: ὄρεξις O)/RECIS órexis or'-ex-is from G3713; excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after:--lust.
entries.3716: ὀρθοποδέω O)RQOPODE/W orthopodéō or-thop-od-eh'-o from a compound of G3717 and G4228; to be straight-footed, i.e. (figuratively) to go directly forward:--walk uprightly.
entries.3717: ὀρθός O)RQO/S orthós or-thos' probably from the base of G3735; right (as rising), i.e. (perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally) level or direct:--straight, upright.
entries.3718: ὀρθοτομέω O)RQOTOME/W orthotoméō or-thot-om-eh'-o from a compound of G3717 and the base of G5114, to make a straight cut, i.e. (figuratively) to dissect (expound) correctly (the divine message) :--rightly divide.
entries.3719: ὀρθρίζω O)RQRI/ZW orthrízō or-thrid'-zo from G3722; to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair betimes:--come early in the morning.
entries.3720: ὀρθρινός O)RQRINO/S orthrinós or-thrin-os' from G3722; relating to the dawn, i.e. matutinal (as an epithet of Venus, especially brilliant in the early day):--morning.
entries.3721: ὄρθριος O)/RQRIOS órthrios or'-three-os from G3722; in the dawn, i.e. up at day-break:--early.
entries.3722: ὄρθρος O)/RQROS órthros or'-thros from the same as G3735; dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by extension, morn:--early in the morning.
entries.3723: ὀρθῶς O)RQW=S orthōs or-thoce' adverb from G3717; in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly (also morally):--plain, right(-ly).
entries.3724: ὁρίζω O(RI/ZW horízō hor-id'-zo from G3725; to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to appoint, decree, specify:--declare, determine, limit, ordain.
entries.3725: ὅριον O(/RION hórion hor'-ee-on neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary ὅρος O(/ROS hóros (a bound or limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier (region):--border, coast.
entries.3726: ὁρκίζω O(RKI/ZW horkízō hor-kid'-zo from G3727; to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly enjoin:--adjure, charge.
entries.3727: ὅρκος O(/RKOS hórkos hor'-kos from ἕρκος E(/RKOS hérkos (a fence; perhaps akin to G3725); a limit, i.e. (sacred) restraint (specially, an oath):--oath.
entries.3728: ὁρκωμοσία O(RKWMOSI/A horkōmosía hor-ko-mos-ee'ah from a compound of G3727 and a derivative of G3660; asseveration on oath:--oath.
entries.3729: ὁρμάω O(RMA/W hormáō hor-mah'-o from G3730; to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or plunge:--run (violently), rush.
entries.3730: ὁρμή O(RMH/ hormḗ hor-may' of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset:--assault.
entries.3731: ὅρμημα O(/RMHMA hórmēma hor'-may-mah from G3730; an attack, i.e. (abstractly) precipitancy:--violence.
entries.3732: ὄρνεον O)/RNEON órneon or'-neh-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G3733; a birdling:--bird, fowl.
entries.3733: ὄρνις O)/RNIS órnis or'-nis probably from a prolonged form of the base of G3735; a bird (as rising in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl):--hen.
entries.3734: ὁροθεσία O(ROQESI/A horothesía hor-oth-es-ee'-ah from a compound of the base of G3725 and a derivative of G5087; a limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line:--bound.
entries.3735: ὄρος O)/ROS óros or'-os probably from an obsolete ὄρω O)/RW órō (to rise or "rear"; perhaps akin to G142; compare G3733); a mountain (as lifting itself above the plain):--hill, mount(-ain).
entries.3736: ὀρύσσω O)RU/SSW orýssō or-oos'-so apparently a primary verb; to "burrow" in the ground, i.e. dig:--dig.
entries.3737: ὀρφανός O)RFANO/S orphanós or-fan-os' of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e. parentless:--comfortless, fatherless.
entries.3738: ὀρχέομαι O)RXE/OMAI orchéomai or-kheh'-om-ahee middle voice from ὄρχος O)/RXOS órchos (a row or ring); to dance (from the ranklike or regular motion):--dance.
entries.3739: ὅς O(/S hós hos , including feminine ἥ H(/ hḗ hay , and neuter ὅ O(/ hó ho probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article G3588); the relatively (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, who, which, what, that:--one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who(-m, -se), etc. See also G3757.
entries.3740: ὁσάκις O(SA/KIS hosákis hos-ak'-is multiple adverb from G3739; how (i.e. with G302, so) many times as:--as oft(-en) as.
entries.3741: ὅσιος O(/SIOS hósios hos'-ee-os of uncertain affinity; properly, right (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from 1342, which refers rather to human statutes and relations; from G2413, which denotes formal consecration; and from G40, which relates to purity from defilement), i.e. hallowed (pious, sacred, sure):--holy, mercy, shalt be. 342
entries.3742: ὁσιότης O(SIO/THS hosiótēs hos-ee-ot'-ace from G3741; piety:--holiness.
entries.3743: ὁσίως O(SI/WS hosíōs hos-ee-oce' adverb from G3741; piously:--holily.
entries.3744: ὀσμή O)SMH/ osmḗ os-may' from G3605; fragrance (literally or figuratively):--odour, savour.
entries.3745: ὅσος O(/SOS hósos hos'-os by reduplication from G3739; as (much, great, long, etc.) as:--all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), (in-)asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while, who(-soever).
entries.3746: ὅσπερ O(/SPER hósper hos'-per from G3739 and G4007; who especially:--whomsoever.
entries.3747: ὀστέον O)STE/ON ostéon os-teh'-on , or contracted ὀστοῦν O)STOU=N ostoûn os-toon' of uncertain affinity; a bone:--bone.
entries.3748: ὅστις O(/STIS hóstis hos'-tis , including the feminine ἥτις H(/TIS hḗtis hay'-tis , and the neuter ὅτι O(/TI hóti hot'-ee from G3739 and G5100; which some, i.e. any that; also (definite) which same:--X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what(-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who(-soever). Compare G3754.
entries.3749: ὀστράκινος O)STRA/KINOS ostrákinos os-tra'-kin-os from ὄστρακον O)/STRAKON óstrakon ("oyster") (a tile, i.e. terra cotta); earthen-ware, i.e. clayey; by implication, frail:--of earth, earthen.
entries.3750: ὄσφρησις O)/SFRHSIS ósphrēsis os'-fray-sis from a derivative of G3605; smell (the sense):--smelling.
entries.3751: ὀσφῦς O)SFU=S osphŷs os-foos' of uncertain affinity; the loin (externally), i.e. the hip; internally (by extension) procreative power:--loin.
entries.3752: ὅταν O(/TAN hótan hot'-an from G3753 and G302; whenever (implying hypothesis or more or less uncertainty); also causatively (conjunctionally) inasmuch as:--as long (soon) as, that, + till, when(-soever), while.
entries.3753: ὅτε O(/TE hóte hot'-eh from G3739 and G5037; at which (thing) too, i.e. when:--after (that), as soon as, that, when, while.
entries.3754: ὅτι O(/TI hóti hot'-ee neuter of G3748 as conjunction; demonstrative, that (sometimes redundant); causative, because:--as concerning that, as though, because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why.
entries.3755: ὅτου O(/TOU hótou hot'-oo for the genitive case of G3748 (as adverb); during which same time, i.e. whilst:--whiles.
entries.3756: οὐ OU) ou oo , also (before a vowel) οὐκ OU)K ouk ook , and (before an aspirate) οὐχ OU)X ouch ookh a primary word; the absolute negative (compare G3361) adverb; no or not:--+ long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, (can-)not, + nothing, + special, un(-worthy), when, + without, + yet but. See also G3364, G3372.
entries.3757: οὗ OU(= hoû hoo genitive case of G3739 as adverb; at which place, i.e. where:--where(-in), whither(-soever).
entries.3758: οὐά OU)A/ ouá oo-ah' a primary exclamation of surprise; "ah":--ah.
entries.3759: οὐαί OU)AI/ ouaí oo-ah'-ee a primary exclamation of grief; "woe":--alas, woe.
entries.3760: οὐδαμῶς OU)DAMW=S oudamōs oo-dam-oce' adverb from (the feminine) of G3762; by no means:--not.
entries.3761: οὐδέ OU)DE/ oudé oo-deh' from G3756 and G1161; not however, i.e. neither, nor, not even:--neither (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then) not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as.
entries.3762: οὐδείς OU)DEI/S oudeís oo-dice' , including feminine οὐδεμία OU)DEMI/A oudemía oo-dem-ee'-ah , and neuter οὐδέν OU)DE/N oudén oo-den' from G3761 and G1520; not even one (man, woman or thing), i.e. none, nobody, nothing:--any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing), nought.
entries.3763: οὐδέποτε OU)DE/POTE oudépote oo-dep'-ot-eh from G3761 and G4218; not even at any time, i.e. never at all:--neither at any time, never, nothing at any time.
entries.3764: οὐδέπω OU)DE/PW oudépō oo-dep'-o from G3761 and G4452; not even yet:--as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet.
entries.3765: οὐκέτι OU)KE/TI oukéti ook-et'-ee , also (separately) οὐκ ἔτι OU)K E)/TI ouk éti ook et'-ee from G3756 and G2089; not yet, no longer:--after that (not), (not) any more, henceforth (hereafter) not, no longer (more), not as yet (now), now no more (not), yet (not).
entries.3766: οὐκοῦν OU)KOU=N oukoûn ook-oon' from G3756 and G3767; is it not therefore that, i.e. (affirmatively) hence or so:--then.
entries.3767: οὖν OU)=N oûn oon apparently a primary word; (adverbially) certainly, or (conjunctionally) accordingly:--and (so, truly), but, now (then), so (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore.
entries.3768: οὔπω OU)/PW oúpō oo'-po from G3756 and G4452; not yet:--hitherto not, (no…) as yet, not yet.
entries.3769: οὐρά OU)RA/ ourá oo-rah' apparently a primary word; a tail:--tail.
entries.3770: οὐράνιος OU)RA/NIOS ouránios oo-ran'-ee-os from G3772; celestial, i.e. belonging to or coming from the sky:--heavenly.
entries.3771: οὐρανόθεν OU)RANO/QEN ouranóthen oo-ran-oth'-en from G3772 and the enclitic of source; from the sky:--from heaven.
entries.3772: οὐρανός OU)RANO/S ouranós oo-ran-os' perhaps from the same as G3735 (through the idea of elevation); the sky; by extension, heaven (as the abode of God); by implication, happiness, power, eternity; specially, the Gospel (Christianity):--air, heaven(-ly), sky.
entries.3773: Οὐρβανός *OU)RBANO/S Ourbanós oor-ban-os' of Latin origin; Urbanus (of the city, "urbane"), a Christian:--Urbanus.
entries.3774: Οὐρίας *OU)RI/AS Ourías oo-ree'-as of Hebrew origin (H0223); Urias (i.e. Urijah), a Hittite:--Urias.
entries.3775: οὖς OU)=S oûs ooce apparently a primary word; the ear (physically or mentally):--ear.
entries.3776: οὐσία OU)SI/A ousía oo-see'-ah from the feminine of G5607; substance, i.e. property (possessions):--goods, substance.
entries.3777: οὔτε OU)/TE oúte oo'-teh from G3756 and G5037; not too, i.e. neither or nor; by analogy, not even:--neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing.
entries.3778: οὗτος OU(=TOS hoûtos hoo'-tos , including nominative masculine plural οὗτοι OU(=TOI hoûtoi hoo'-toy , nominative feminine singular αὕτη AU(/TH haútē how'-tay , and nominative feminine plural αὕται AU(/TAI haútai how'-tahee from the article G3588 and G846; the he (she or it), i.e. this or that (often with article repeated):--he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who.
entries.3779: οὕτω OU(/TW hoútō hoo'-to , or (before a vowel οὕτως OU(/TWS hoútōs hoo'-toce adverb from G3778; in this way (referring to what precedes or follows):--after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like(-wise), no more, on this fashion(-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what.
entries.3780: οὐχί OU)XI/ ouchí oo-khee' intensive of G3756; not indeed:--nay, not.
entries.3781: ὀφειλέτης O)FEILE/THS opheilétēs of-i-let'-ace from G3784; an ower, i.e. person indebted; figuratively, a delinquent; morally, a transgressor (against God):--debtor, which owed, sinner.
entries.3782: ὀφειλή O)FEILH/ opheilḗ of-i-lay' from G3784; indebtedness, i.e. (concretely) a sum owed; figuratively, obligation, i.e. (conjugal) duty:--debt, due.
entries.3783: ὀφείλημα O)FEI/LHMA opheílēma of-i'-lay-mah from (the alternate of) G3784; something owed, i.e. (figuratively) a due; morally, a fault:--debt.
entries.3784: ὀφείλω O)FEI/LW opheílō of-i'-lo , or (in certain tenses), its prolonged form ὀφειλέω O)FEILE/W opheiléō of-i-leh'-o probably from the base of G3786 (through the idea of accruing); to owe (pecuniarily); figuratively, to be under obligation (ought, must, should); morally, to fail in duty:--behove, be bound, (be) debt(-or), (be) due(-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need(-s), ought, owe, should. See also G3785.
entries.3785: ὄφελον O)/FELON óphelon of'-el-on first person singular of a past tense of G3784; I ought (wish), i.e. (interjection) oh that!:--would (to God).
entries.3786: ὄφελος O)/FELOS óphelos of'-el-os from ὀφέλλω O)FE/LLW ophéllō (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit); gain:--advantageth, profit.
entries.3787: ὀφθαλμοδουλεία O)FQALMODOULEI/A ophthalmodouleía of-thal-mod-oo-li'-ah from G3788 and G1397; sight-labor, i.e. that needs watching (remissness):--eye-service.
