entries.4747: στοιχεῖον STOIXEI=ON stoicheîon stoy-khi'-on neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of G4748; something orderly in arrangement, i.e. (by implication) a serial (basal, fundamental, initial) constituent (literally), proposition (figuratively):--element, principle, rudiment.
entries.4748: στοιχέω STOIXE/W stoichéō stoy-kheh'-o from a derivative of στείχω STEI/XW steíchō (to range in regular line); to march in (military) rank (keep step), i.e. (figuratively) to conform to virtue and piety:--walk (orderly).
entries.4749: στολή STOLH/ stolḗ stol-ay' from G4724; equipment, i.e. (specially), a "stole" or long-fitting gown (as a mark of dignity):--long clothing (garment), (long) robe.
entries.4750: στόμα STO/MA stóma stom'-a probably strengthened from a presumed derivative of the base of G5114; the mouth (as if a gash in the face); by implication, language (and its relations); figuratively, an opening (in the earth); specially, the front or edge (of a weapon):--edge, face, mouth.
entries.4751: στόμαχος STO/MAXOS stómachos stom'-akh-os from G4750; an orifice (the gullet), i.e. (specially), the "stomach":--stomach.
entries.4752: στρατεία STRATEI/A strateía strat-i'-ah from G4754; military service, i.e. (figuratively) the apostolic career (as one of hardship and danger):--warfare.
entries.4753: στράτευμα STRA/TEUMA stráteuma strat'-yoo-mah from G4754; an armament, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops (more or less extensive or systematic):--army, soldier, man of war.
entries.4754: στρατεύομαι STRATEU/OMAI strateúomai strat-yoo'-om-ahee middle voice from the base of G4756; to serve in a military campaign; figuratively, to execute the apostolate (with its arduous duties and functions), to contend with carnal inclinations:--soldier, (go to) war(-fare).
entries.4755: στρατηγός STRATHGO/S stratēgós strat-ay-gos' from the base of G4756 and G71 or G2233; a general, i.e. (by implication or analogy) a (military) governor (prætor), the chief (præfect) of the (Levitical) temple-wardens:--captain, magistrate.
entries.4756: στρατιά STRATIA/ stratiá strat-ee'-ah feminine of a derivative of στρατός STRATO/S stratós (an army; from the base of G4766, as encamped); camp-likeness, i.e. an army, i.e. (figuratively) the angels, the celestial luminaries:--host.
entries.4757: στρατιώτης STRATIW/THS stratiṓtēs strat-ee-o'-tace from a presumed derivative of the same as G4756; a camper-out, i.e. a (common) warrior (literally or figuratively):--soldier.
entries.4758: στρατολογέω STRATOLOGE/W stratologéō strat-ol-og-eh'-o from a compound of the base of G4756 and G3004 (in its original sense); to gather (or select) as a warrior, i.e. enlist in the army:--choose to be a soldier.
entries.4759: στρατοπεδάρχης STRATOPEDA/RXHS stratopedárchēs strat-op-ed-ar'-khace from G4760 and G757; a ruler of an army, i.e. (specially), a Prætorian præfect:--captain of the guard.
entries.4760: στρατόπεδον STRATO/PEDON stratópedon strat-op'-ed-on from the base of G4756 and the same as G3977; a camping-ground, i.e. (by implication) a body of troops:--army.
entries.4761: στρεβλόω STREBLO/W streblóō streb-lo'-o from a derivative of G4762; to wrench, i.e. (specially), to torture (by the rack), but only figuratively, to pervert:-- wrest.
entries.4762: στρέφω STRE/FW stréphō stref'-o strengthened from the base of G5157; to twist, i.e. turn quite around or reverse (literally or figuratively):--convert, turn (again, back again, self, self about).
entries.4763: στρηνιάω STRHNIA/W strēniáō stray-nee-ah'-o from a presumed derivative of G4764; to be luxurious:--live deliciously.
entries.4764: στρῆνος STRH=NOS strēnos stray'-nos akin to G4731; a "straining", "strenuousness" or "strength", i.e. (figuratively) luxury (voluptuousness):--delicacy.
entries.4765: στρουθίον STROUQI/ON strouthíon stroo-thee'-on diminutive of στρουθός STROUQO/S strouthós (a sparrow); a little sparrow:--sparrow.
entries.4766: στρώννυμι STRW/NNUMI strṓnnymi strone'-noo-mee , or simpler στρωννύω STRWNNU/W strōnnýō strone-noo'-o ; prolongation from a still simpler στρόω STRO/W stróō stro'-o , (used only as an alternate in certain tenses) (probably akin to G4731 through the idea of positing); to "strew," i.e. spread (as a carpet or couch):--make bed, furnish, spread, strew.
entries.4767: στυγνητός STUGNHTO/S stygnētós stoog-nay-tos' from a derivative of an obsolete apparently primary στύγω STU/GW stýgō (to hate); hated, i.e. odious:--hateful.
entries.4768: στυγνάζω STUGNA/ZW stygnázō stoog-nad'-zo from the same as G4767; to render gloomy, i.e. (by implication) glower (be overcast with clouds, or sombreness of speech):--lower, be sad.
entries.4769: στῦλος STU=LOS stŷlos stoo'-los from στύω STU/W stýō (to stiffen; properly akin to the base of G2476); a post ("style"), i.e. (figuratively) support:--pillar.
entries.4770: Στωϊκός *STWI+KO/S Stōïkós sto-ik-os' from G4745; a "Stoic" (as occupying a particular porch in Athens), i.e. adherent of a certin philosophy:--Stoick.
entries.4771: σύ SU/ sý soo the personal pronoun of the second person singular; thou:-- thou. See also G4571, G4671, G4675; and for the plural G5209, G5210, G5213, G5216.
entries.4772: συγγένεια SUGGE/NEIA syngéneia soong-ghen'-i-ah from G4773; relationship, i.e. (concretely) relatives:--kindred.
entries.4773: συγγενής SUGGENH/S syngenḗs soong-ghen-ace' from G4862 and G1085; a relative (by blood); by extension, a fellow countryman:--cousin, kin(-sfolk, -sman).
entries.4774: συγγνώμη SUGGNW/MH syngnṓmē soong-gno'-may from a compound of G4862 and G1097; fellow knowledge, i.e. concession:--permission.
entries.4775: συγκάθημαι SUGKA/QHMAI synkáthēmai soong-kath'-ay-mahee from G4862 and G2521; to seat oneself in company with:--sit with.
entries.4776: συγκαθίζω SUGKAQI/ZW synkathízō soong-kath-id'-zo from G4862 and G2523; to give (or take) a seat in company with:--(make) sit (down) together.
entries.4777: συγκακοπαθέω SUGKAKOPAQE/W synkakopathéō soong-kak-op-ath-eh'-o from G4862 and G2553; to suffer hardship in company with:--be partaker of afflictions.
entries.4778: συγκακουχέω SUGKAKOUXE/W synkakouchéō soong-kak-oo-kheh'-o from G4862 and G2558; to maltreat in company with, i.e. (passively) endure persecution together:--suffer affliction with.
entries.4779: συγκαλέω SUGKALE/W synkaléō soong-kal-eh'-o from G4862 and G2564; to convoke:--call together.
entries.4780: συγκαλύπτω SUGKALU/PTW synkalýptō soong-kal-oop'-to from G4862 and G2572; to conceal altogether:--cover.
entries.4781: συγκάμπτω SUGKA/MPTW synkámptō soong-kamp'-to from G4862 and G2578; to bend together, i.e. (figuratively) to afflict:--bow down.
entries.4782: συγκαταβαίνω SUGKATABAI/NW synkatabaínō soong-kat-ab-ah'-ee-no from G4862 and G2597; to descend in company with:--go down with.
entries.4783: συγκατάθεσις SUGKATA/QESIS synkatáthesis soong-kat-ath'-es-is from G4784; a deposition (of sentiment) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) accord with:--agreement.
entries.4784: συγκατατίθεμαι SUGKATATI/QEMAI synkatatíthemai soong-kat-at-ith'-em-ahee middle from G4862 and G2698; to deposit (one's vote or opinion) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to accord with:--consent.
entries.4785: συγκαταψηφίζω SUGKATAYHFI/ZW synkatapsēphízō soong-kat-aps-ay-fid'-zo from G4862 and a compound of G2596 and G5585; to count down in company with, i.e. enroll among:--number with.
entries.4786: συγκεράννυμι SUGKERA/NNUMI synkeránnymi soong-ker-an'-noo-mee from G4862 and G2767; to commingle, i.e. (figuratively) to combine or assimilate:--mix with, temper together.
entries.4787: συγκινέω SUGKINE/W synkinéō soong-kin-eh'-o from G4682 and G2795; to move together, i.e. (specially), to excite as a mass (to sedition):--stir up.
entries.4788: συγκλείω SUGKLEI/W synkleíō soong-kli'-o from G4862 and G2808; to shut together, i.e. include or (figuratively) embrace in a common subjection to:--conclude, inclose, shut up.
entries.4789: συγκληρονόμος SUGKLHRONO/MOS synklēronómos soong-klay-ron-om'-os from G4862 and G2818; a co-heir, i.e. (by analogy) participant in common:--fellow (joint)-heir, heir together, heir with.
entries.4790: συγκοινωνέω SUGKOINWNE/W synkoinōnéō soong-koy-no-neh'-o from G4862 and G2841; to share in company with, i.e. co-participate in:--communicate (have fellowship) with, be partaker of.
entries.4791: συγκοινωνός SUGKOINWNO/S synkoinōnós soong-koy-no-nos' from G4862 and G2844; a co-participant:--companion, partake(-r, -r with).
entries.4792: συγκομίζω SUGKOMI/ZW synkomízō soong-kom-id'-zo from G4862 and G2865; to convey together, i.e. collect or bear away in company with others:--carry.
entries.4793: συγκρίνω SUGKRI/NW synkrínō soong-kree'-no from G4862 and G2919; to judge of one thing in connection with another, i.e. combine (spiritual ideas with appropriate expressions) or collate (one person with another by way of contrast or resemblance):--compare among (with).
entries.4794: συγκύπτω SUGKU/PTW synkýptō soong-koop'-to from G4862 and G2955; to stoop altogether, i.e. be completely overcome by:--bow together.
entries.4795: συγκυρία SUGKURI/A synkyría soong-koo-ree'-ah from a compound of G4862 and κυρέω KURE/W kyréō (to light or happen; from the base of G2962); concurrence, i.e. accident:--chance.
entries.4796: συγχαίρω SUGXAI/RW synchaírō soong-khah'-ee-ro from G4862 and G5463; to sympathize in gladness, congratulate:--rejoice in (with).
entries.4797: συγχέω SUGXE/W synchéō soong-kheh'-o or συγχύνω SUGXU/NW synchýnō soong-khoo'-no from G4862 and χέω XE/W chéō (to pour) or its alternate; to commingle promiscuously, i.e. (figuratively) to throw (an assembly) into disorder, to perplex (the mind):--confound, confuse, stir up, be in an uproar.
entries.4798: συγχράομαι SUGXRA/OMAI synchráomai soong-khrah'-om-ahee from G4862 and G5530; to use jointly, i.e. (by implication) to hold intercourse in common:--have dealings with.
entries.4799: σύγχυσις SU/GXUSIS sýnchysis soong'-khoo-sis from G4797; commixture, i.e. (figuratively) riotous disturbance:--confusion.
entries.4800: συζάω SUZA/W syzáō sood-zah'-o from G4862 and G2198; to continue to live in common with, i.e. co-survive (literally or figuratively):--live with.
entries.4801: συζεύγνυμι SUZEU/GNUMI syzeúgnymi sood-zyoog'-noo-mee from G4862 and the base of G2201; to yoke together, i.e. (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage):--join together.
entries.4802: συζητέω SUZHTE/W syzētéō sood-zay-teh'-o from G4862 and G2212; to investigate jointly, i.e. discuss, controvert, cavil:--dispute (with), enquire, question (with), reason (together).
entries.4803: συζήτησις SUZH/THSIS syzḗtēsis sood-zay'-tay-sis from G4802; mutual questioning, i.e. discussion:--disputation(-ting), reasoning.
entries.4804: συζητητής SUZHTHTH/S syzētētḗs sood-zay-tay-tace' from G4802; a disputant, i.e. sophist:--disputer.
entries.4805: σύζυγος SU/ZUGOS sýzygos sood'-zoo-gos from G4801; co-yoked, i.e. (figuratively) as noun, a colleague; probably rather as a proper name; Syzygus, a Christian:--yokefellow.
entries.4806: συζωοποιέω SUZWOPOIE/W syzōopoiéō sood-zo-op-oy-eh'-o from G4862 and G2227; to reanimate conjointly with (figuratively):--quicken together with.
entries.4807: συκάμινος SUKA/MINOS sykáminos soo-kam'-ee-nos of Hebrew origin (H08256) in imitation of G4809; a sycamore-fig tree:--sycamine tree.
entries.4808: συκῆ SUKH= sykē soo-kay' from G4810; a fig-tree:--fig tree.
entries.4809: συκομωραία SUKOMWRAI/A sykomōraía soo-kom-o-rah'-yah from G4810 and μόρον MO/RON móron (the mulberry); the "sycamore"-fig tree:--sycamore tree. Compare G4807.
entries.4810: σῦκον SU=KON sŷkon soo'-kon apparently a primary word; a fig:--fig.
entries.4811: συκοφαντέω SUKOFANTE/W sykophantéō soo-kof-an-teh'-o from a compound of G4810 and a derivative of G5316; to be a fig-informer (reporter of the law forbidding the exportation of figs from Greece), "sycophant", i.e. (genitive and by extension) to defraud (exact unlawfully, extort):--accuse falsely, take by false accusation.
entries.4812: συλαγωγέω SULAGWGE/W sylagōgéō soo-lag-ogue-eh'-o from the base of G4813 and (the reduplicated form of) G71; to lead away as booty, i.e. (figuratively) seduce:--spoil.
entries.4813: συλάω SULA/W syláō soo-lah'-o from a derivative of σύλλω SU/LLW sýllō (to strip; probably akin to G138; compare G4661); to despoil:--rob.
entries.4814: συλλαλέω SULLALE/W syllaléō sool-lal-eh'-o from G4862 and G2980; to talk together, i.e. converse:--commune (confer, talk) with, speak among.
entries.4815: συλλαμβάνω SULLAMBA/NW syllambánō sool-lam-ban'-o from G4862 and G2983; to clasp, i.e. seize (arrest, capture); specially, to conceive (literally or figuratively); by implication, to aid:--catch, conceive, help, take.
entries.4816: συλλέγω SULLE/GW syllégō sool-leg'-o from G4862 and G3004 in its original sense; to collect:--gather (together, up).
entries.4817: συλλογίζομαι SULLOGI/ZOMAI syllogízomai sool-log-id'-zom-ahee from G4862 and G3049; to reckon together (with oneself), i.e. deliberate:--reason with.
entries.4818: συλλυπέω SULLUPE/W syllypéō sool-loop-eh'-o from G4862 and G3076; to afflict jointly, i.e. (passive) sorrow at (on account of) someone:--be grieved.
entries.4819: συμβαίνω SUMBAI/NW symbaínō soom-bah'-ee-no from G4862 and the base of G939; to walk (figuratively, transpire) together, i.e. concur (take place):--be(-fall), happen (unto).
entries.4820: συμβάλλω SUMBA/LLW symbállō soom-bal'-lo from G4862 and G906; to combine, i.e. (in speaking) to converse, consult, dispute, (mentally) to consider, (by implication) to aid, (personally) to join, attack:--confer, encounter, help, make, meet with, ponder.
entries.4821: συμβασιλεύω SUMBASILEU/W symbasileúō soom-bas-il-yoo'-o from G4862 and G936; to be co-regent (figuratively):--reign with.
entries.4822: συμβιβάζω SUMBIBA/ZW symbibázō soom-bib-ad'-zo from G4862 and βιβάζω BIBA/ZW bibázō (to force; causative (by reduplication) of the base of G939); to drive together, i.e. unite (in association or affection), (mentally) to infer, show, teach:--compact, assuredly gather, intrust, knit together, prove.
entries.4823: συμβουλεύω SUMBOULEU/W symbouleúō soom-bool-yoo'-o from G4862 and G1011; to give (or take) advice jointly, i.e. recommend, deliberate or determine:--consult, (give, take) counsel (together).
entries.4824: συμβούλιον SUMBOU/LION symboúlion soom-boo'-lee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G4825; advisement; specially, a deliberative body, i.e. the provincial assessors or lay-court:--consultation, counsel, council.
entries.4825: σύμβουλος SU/MBOULOS sýmboulos soom'-boo-los from G4862 and G1012; a consultor, i.e. adviser:--counsellor.
entries.4826: Συμεών *SUMEW/N Symeṓn soom-eh-one' from the same as G4613; Symeon (i.e. Shimon), the name of five Israelites:--Simeon, Simon.
entries.4827: συμμαθητής SUMMAQHTH/S symmathētḗs soom-math-ay-tace' from a compound of G4862 and G3129; a co-learner (of Christianity):--fellow disciple.
entries.4828: συμμαρτυρέω SUMMARTURE/W symmartyréō soom-mar-too-reh'-o from G4862 and G3140; to testify jointly, i.e. corroborate by (concurrent) evidence:--testify unto, (also) bear witness (with).
entries.4829: συμμερίζομαι SUMMERI/ZOMAI symmerízomai soom-mer-id'-zom-ahee middle voice from G4862 and G3307; to share jointly, i.e. participate in:--be partaker with.
entries.4830: συμμέτοχος SUMME/TOXOS symmétochos soom-met'-okh-os from G4862 and G3353; a co-participant:--partaker.
entries.4831: συμμιμητής SUMMIMHTH/S symmimētḗs soom-mim-ay-tace' from a presumed compound of G4862 and G3401; a co-imitator, i.e. fellow votary:--follower together.
entries.4832: σύμμορφος SU/MMORFOS sýmmorphos soom-mor-fos' from G4862 and G3444; jointly formed, i.e. (figuratively) similar:--conformed to, fashioned like unto.
entries.4833: συμμορφόω SUMMORFO/W symmorphóō soom-mor-fo'-o from G4832; to render like, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate:--make conformable unto.
entries.4834: συμπαθέω SUMPAQE/W sympathéō soom-path-eh'-o from G4835; to feel "sympathy" with, i.e. (by implication) to commiserate:--have compassion, be touched with a feeling of.
entries.4835: συμπαθής SUMPAQH/S sympathḗs soom-path-ace' from G4841; having a fellow-feeling ("sympathetic"), i.e. (by implication) mutually commiserative:--having compassion one of another.
entries.4836: συμπαραγίνομαι SUMPARAGI/NOMAI symparagínomai soom-par-ag-in'-om-ahee from G4862 and G3854; to be present together, i.e. to convene; by implication, to appear in aid:--come together, stand with.
entries.4837: συμπαρακαλέω SUMPARAKALE/W symparakaléō soom-par-ak-al-eh'-o from G4862 and G3870; to console jointly:--comfort together.
entries.4838: συμπαραλαμβάνω SUMPARALAMBA/NW symparalambánō soom-par-al-am-ban'-o from G4862 and G3880; to take along in company:--take with.
entries.4839: συμπαραμένω SUMPARAME/NW symparaménō soom-par-am-en'-o from G4862 and G3887; to remain in company, i.e. still live:--continue with.
entries.4840: συμπάρειμι SUMPA/REIMI sympáreimi soom-par'-i-mee from G4862 and G3918; to be at hand together, i.e. now present:--be here present with.
entries.4841: συμπάσχω SUMPA/SXW sympáschō soom-pas'-kho from G4862 and G3958 (including its alternate); to experience pain jointly or of the same kind (specially, persecution; to "sympathize"):--suffer with.
entries.4842: συμπέμπω SUMPE/MPW sympémpō soom-pem'-po from G4862 and G3992; to despatch in company:--send with.
entries.4843: συμπεριλαμβάνω SUMPERILAMBA/NW symperilambánō soom-per-ee-lam-ban'-o from G4862 and a compound of G4012 and G2983; to take by enclosing altogether, i.e. earnestly throw the arms about one:--embrace.
entries.4844: συμπίνω SUMPI/NW sympínō soom-pee'-no from G4862 and G4095; to partake a beverage in company:--drink with.
entries.4845: συμπληρόω SUMPLHRO/W symplēróō soom-play-ro'-o from G4862 and G4137; to implenish completely, i.e. (of space) to swamp (a boat), or (of time) to accomplish (passive, be complete):--(fully) come, fill up.
entries.4846: συμπνίγω SUMPNI/GW sympnígō soom-pnee'-go from G4862 and G4155; to strangle completely, i.e. (literally) to drown, or (figuratively) to crowd:--choke, throng.
entries.4847: συμπολίτης SUMPOLI/THS sympolítēs soom-pol-ee'-tace from G4862 and G4177; a native of the same town, i.e. (figuratively) co-religionist (fellow-Christian):--fellow- citizen.
entries.4848: συμπορεύομαι SUMPOREU/OMAI symporeúomai soom-por-yoo'-om-ahee from G4862 and G4198; to journey together; by implication, to assemble:--go with, resort.
entries.4849: συμπόσιον SUMPO/SION sympósion soom-pos'-ee-on neuter of a derivative of the alternate of G4844; a drinking-party ("symposium"), i.e. (by extension) a room of guests:--company.
entries.4850: συμπρεσβύτερος SUMPRESBU/TEROS sympresbýteros soom-pres-boo'-ter-os from G4862 and G4245; a co-presbyter:--presbyter, also an elder.
entries.4851: συμφέρω SUMFE/RW symphérō soom-fer'-o from G4862 and G5342 (including its alternate); to bear together (contribute), i.e. (literally) to collect, or (figuratively) to conduce; especially (neuter participle as a noun) advantage:--be better for, bring together, be expedient (for), be good, (be) profit(-able for).
entries.4852: σύμφημι SU/MFHMI sýmphēmi soom'-fay-mee from G4862 and G5346; to say jointly, i.e. assent to:--consent unto.
entries.4853: συμφυλέτης SUMFULE/THS symphylétēs soom-foo-let'-ace from G4862 and a derivative of G5443; a co-tribesman, i.e. native of the same country:--countryman.
entries.4854: σύμφυτος SU/MFUTOS sýmphytos soom'-foo-tos from G4862 and a derivative of G5453; grown along with (connate), i.e. (figuratively) closely united to:--planted together.
entries.4855: συμφύω SUMFU/W symphýō soom-foo'-o from G4862 and G5453; passive, to grow jointly:--spring up with.
entries.4856: συμφωνέω SUMFWNE/W symphōnéō soom-fo-neh'-o from G4859; to be harmonious, i.e. (figuratively) to accord (be suitable, concur) or stipulate (by compact):--agree (together, with).
entries.4857: συμφώνησις SUMFW/NHSIS symphṓnēsis soom-fo'-nay-sis from G4856; accordance:--concord.
entries.4858: συμφωνία SUMFWNI/A symphōnía soom-fo-nee'-ah from G4859; unison of sound ("symphony"), i.e. a concert of instruments (harmonious note):--music.
entries.4859: σύμφωνος SU/MFWNOS sýmphōnos soom'-fo-nos from G4862 and G5456; sounding together (alike), i.e. (figuratively) accordant (neuter as noun, agreement):-- consent.
entries.4860: συμψηφίζω SUMYHFI/ZW sympsēphízō soom-psay-fid'-zo from G4862 and G5585; to compute jointly:--reckon.
entries.4861: σύμψυχος SU/MYUXOS sýmpsychos soom'-psoo-khos from G4862 and G5590; co-spirited, i.e. similar in sentiment:--like-minded.
entries.4862: σύν SU/N sýn soon a primary preposition denoting union; with or together (but much closer than G3326 or G3844), i.e. by association, companionship, process, resemblance, possession, instrumentality, addition, etc.:--beside, with. In composition it has similar applications, including completeness.
entries.4863: συνάγω SUNA/GW synágō soon-ag'-o from G4862 and G71; to lead together, i.e. collect or convene; specially, to entertain (hospitably):--+ accompany, assemble (selves, together), bestow, come together, gather (selves together, up, together), lead into, resort, take in.
entries.4864: συναγωγή SUNAGWGH/ synagōgḗ soon-ag-o-gay' from (the reduplicated form of) G4863; an assemblage of persons; specially, a Jewish "synagogue" (the meeting or the place); by analogy, a Christian church:--assembly, congregation, synagogue.
entries.4865: συναγωνίζομαι SUNAGWNI/ZOMAI synagōnízomai soon-ag-o-nid'-zom-ahee from G4862 and G75; to struggle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to be a partner (assistant):--strive together with.
entries.4866: συναθλέω SUNAQLE/W synathléō soon-ath-leh'-o from G4862 and G118; to wrestle in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to seek jointly:--labour with, strive together for.
entries.4867: συναθροίζω SUNAQROI/ZW synathroízō soon-ath-royd'-zo from G4862 and ἀθροίζω A)QROI/ZW athroízō (to hoard); to convene:--call (gather) together.
entries.4868: συναίρω SUNAI/RW synaírō soon-ah'-ee-ro from G4862 and G142; to make up together, i.e. (figuratively) to compute (an account):--reckon, take.
entries.4869: συναιχμάλωτος SUNAIXMA/LWTOS synaichmálōtos soon-aheekh-mal'-o-tos from G4862 and G164; a co-captive:--fellowprisoner.
entries.4870: συνακολουθέω SUNAKOLOUQE/W synakolouthéō soon-ak-ol-oo-theh'-o from G4862 and G190; to accompany:--follow.
entries.4871: συναλίζω SUNALI/ZW synalízō soon-al-id'-zo from G4862 and ἁλίζω A(LI/ZW halízō (to throng); to accumulate, i.e. convene:--assemble together.
entries.4872: συναναβαίνω SUNANABAI/NW synanabaínō soon-an-ab-ah'-ee-no from G4862 and G305; to ascend in company with:--come up with.
entries.4873: συνανάκειμαι SUNANA/KEIMAI synanákeimai soon-an-ak'-i-mahee from G4862 and G345; to recline in company with (at a meal):--sit (down, at the table, together) with (at meat).
entries.4874: συναναμίγνυμι SUNANAMI/GNUMI synanamígnymi soon-an-am-ig'-noo-mee from G4862 and a compound of G303 and G3396; to mix up together, i.e. (figurative) associate with:--(have, keep) company (with).
entries.4875: συναναπαύομαι SUNANAPAU/OMAI synanapaúomai soon-an-ap-ow'-om-ahee middle from G4862 and G373; to recruit oneself in company with:--refresh with.
entries.4876: συναντάω SUNANTA/W synantáō soon-an-tah'-o from G4862 and a derivative of G473; to meet with; figuratively, to occur:--befall, meet.
entries.4877: συνάντησις SUNA/NTHSIS synántēsis soon-an'-tay-sis from G4876; a meeting with:--meet.
entries.4878: συναντιλαμβάνομαι SUNANTILAMBA/NOMAI synantilambánomai soon-an-tee-lam-ban'-om-ahee from G4862 and G482; to take hold of opposite together, i.e. co-operate (assist):--help.
entries.4879: συναπάγω SUNAPA/GW synapágō soon-ap-ag'-o from G4862 and G520; to take off together, i.e. transport with (seduce, passively, yield):--carry (lead) away with, condescend.
entries.4880: συναποθνήσκω SUNAPOQNH/SKW synapothnḗskō soon-ap-oth-nace'-ko from G4862 and G599; to decease (literally) in company with, or (figuratively), similarly to:--be dead (die) with.
entries.4881: συναπόλλυμι SUNAPO/LLUMI synapóllymi soon-ap-ol'-loo-mee from G4862 and G622; to destroy (middle voice or passively, be slain) in company with:--perish with.
entries.4882: συναποστέλλω SUNAPOSTE/LLW synapostéllō soon-ap-os-tel'-lo from G4862 and G649; to despatch (on an errand) in company with:--send with.
entries.4883: συναρμολογέω SUNARMOLOGE/W synarmologéō soon-ar-mol-og-eh'-o from G4862 and a derivative of a compound of G719 and G3004 (in its original sense of laying); to render close-jointed together, i.e. organize compactly:--be fitly framed (joined) together.
entries.4884: συναρπάζω SUNARPA/ZW synarpázō soon-ar-pad'-zo from G4862 and G726; to snatch together, i.e. seize:--catch.
entries.4885: συναυξάνω SUNAUCA/NW synauxánō soon-owx-an'-o from G4862 and G837; to increase (grow up) together:--grow together.
entries.4886: σύνδεσμος SU/NDESMOS sýndesmos soon'-des-mos from G4862 and G1199; a joint tie, i.e. ligament, (figuratively) uniting principle, control:--band, bond.
entries.4887: συνδέω SUNDE/W syndéō soon-deh'-o from G4862 and G1210; to bind with, i.e. (passively) be a fellow-prisoner (figuratively):--be bound with.
entries.4888: συνδοξάζω SUNDOCA/ZW syndoxázō soon-dox-ad'-zo from G4862 and G1392; to exalt to dignity in company (i.e. similarly) with:--glorify together.
entries.4889: σύνδουλος SU/NDOULOS sýndoulos soon'-doo-los from G4862 and G1401; a co-slave, i.e. servitor or ministrant of the same master (human or divine):--fellowservant.
entries.4890: συνδρομή SUNDROMH/ syndromḗ soon-drom-ay' from (the alternate of) G4936; a running together, i.e. (riotous) concourse:--run together.
entries.4891: συνεγείρω SUNEGEI/RW synegeírō soon-eg-i'-ro from G4862 and G1453; to rouse (from death) in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to revivify (spirtually) in resemblance to:--raise up together, rise with.
entries.4892: συνέδριον SUNE/DRION synédrion soon-ed'-ree-on neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4862 and the base of G1476; a joint session, i.e. (specially), the Jewish Sanhedrin; by analogy, a subordinate tribunal:--council.
entries.4893: συνείδησις SUNEI/DHSIS syneídēsis soon-i'-day-sis from a prolonged form of G4894; co-perception, i.e. moral consciousness:--conscience.
entries.4894: συνείδω SUNEI/DW syneídō soon-i'-do from G4862 and G1492; to see completely; used (like its primary) only in two past tenses, respectively meaning to understand or become aware, and to be conscious or (clandestinely) informed of:--consider, know, be privy, be ware of.
entries.4895: σύνειμι SU/NEIMI sýneimi soon'-i-mee from G4862 and G1510 (including its various inflections); to be in company with, i.e. present at the time:--be with.
entries.4896: σύνειμι SU/NEIMI sýneimi soon'-i-mee from G4862 and εἶμι EI)=MI eîmi (to go); to assemble:--gather together.
entries.4897: συνεισέρχομαι SUNEISE/RXOMAI syneisérchomai soon-ice-er'-khom-ahee from G4862 and G1525; to enter in company with:--go in with, go with into.
entries.4898: συνέκδημος SUNE/KDHMOS synékdēmos soon-ek'-day-mos from G4862 and the base of G1553; a co-absentee from home, i.e. fellow-traveller:--companion in travel, travel with.
entries.4899: συνεκλεκτός SUNEKLEKTO/S syneklektós soon-ek-lek-tos' from a compound of G4862 and G1586; chosen in company with, i.e. co-elect (fellow Christian):--elected together with.
entries.4900: συνελαύνω SUNELAU/NW synelaúnō soon-el-ow'-no from G4862 and G1643; to drive together, i.e. (figuratively) exhort (to reconciliation):--+ set at one again.
entries.4901: συνεπιμαρτυρέω SUNEPIMARTURE/W synepimartyréō soon-ep-ee-mar-too-reh'-o from G4862 and G1957; to testify further jointly, i.e. unite in adding evidence:--also bear witness.
entries.4902: συνέπομαι SUNE/POMAI synépomai soon-ep'-om-ahee middle voice from G4862 and a primary ἕπω E(/PW hépō (to follow); to attend (travel) in company with:--accompany.
entries.4903: συνεργέω SUNERGE/W synergéō soon-erg-eh'-o from G4904; to be a fellow-worker, i.e. co-operate:--help (work) with, work(-er) together.
entries.4904: συνεργός SUNERGO/S synergós soon-er-gos' from a presumed compound of G4862 and the base of G2041; a co-laborer, i.e. coadjutor:--companion in labour, (fellow-)helper(-labourer, -worker), labourer together with, workfellow.
entries.4905: συνέρχομαι SUNE/RXOMAI synérchomai soon-er'-khom-ahee from G4862 and G2064; to convene, depart in company with, associate with, or (specially), cohabit (conjugally):--accompany, assemble (with), come (together), come (company, go) with, resort.
entries.4906: συνεσθίω SUNESQI/W synesthíō soon-es-thee'-o from G4862 and G2068 (including its alternate); to take food in company with:--eat with.
entries.4907: σύνεσις SU/NESIS sýnesis soon'-es-is from G4920; a mental putting together, i.e. intelligence or (concretely) the intellect:--knowledge, understanding.
entries.4908: συνετός SUNETO/S synetós soon-et'-os from G4920; mentally put (or putting) together, i.e. sagacious:--prudent. Compare G5429.
entries.4909: συνευδοκέω SUNEUDOKE/W syneudokéō soon-yoo-dok-eh'-o from G4862 and G2106; to think well of in common, i.e. assent to, feel gratified with:--allow, assent, be pleased, have pleasure.
entries.4910: συνευωχέω SUNEUWXE/W syneuōchéō soon-yoo-o-kheh'-o from G4862 and a derivative of a presumed compound of G2095 and a derivative of G2192 (meaning to be in good condition, i.e. (by implication) to fare well, or feast); to entertain sumptuously in company with, i.e. (middle voice or passive) to revel together:--feast with.
entries.4911: συνεφίστημι SUNEFI/STHMI synephístēmi soon-ef-is'-tay-mee from G4862 and G2186; to stand up together, i.e. to resist (or assault) jointly:--rise up together.
entries.4912: συνέχω SUNE/XW synéchō soon-ekh'-o from G4862 and G2192; to hold together, i.e. to compress (the ears, with a crowd or siege) or arrest (a prisoner); figuratively, to compel, perplex, afflict, preoccupy:--constrain, hold, keep in, press, lie sick of, stop, be in a strait, straiten, be taken with, throng.
entries.4913: συνήδομαι SUNH/DOMAI synḗdomai soon-ay'-dom-ahee middle voice from G4862 and the base of G2237; to rejoice in with oneself, i.e. feel satisfaction concerning:--delight.
entries.4914: συνήθεια SUNH/QEIA synḗtheia soon-ay'-thi-ah from a compound of G4862 and G2239; mutual habituation, i.e. usage:--custom.
entries.4915: συνηλικιώτης SUNHLIKIW/THS synēlikiṓtēs soon-ay-lik-ee-o'-tace from G4862 and a derivative of G2244; a co-aged person, i.e. alike in years:--equal.
entries.4916: συνθάπτω SUNQA/PTW syntháptō soon-thap'-to from G4862 and G2290; to inter in company with, i.e. (figuratively) to assimilate spiritually (to Christ by a sepulture as to sin):--bury with.
entries.4917: συνθλάω SUNQLA/W synthláō soon-thlah'-o from G4862 and thlao (to crush); to dash together, i.e. shatter:--break.
entries.4918: συνθλίβω SUNQLI/BW synthlíbō soon-thlee'-bo from G4862 and G2346; to compress, i.e. crowd on all sides:--throng.
entries.4919: συνθρύπτω SUNQRU/PTW synthrýptō soon-throop'-to from G4862 and θρύπτω QRU/PTW thrýptō (to crumble); to crush together, i.e. (figuratively) to dispirit:--break.
entries.4920: συνίημι SUNI/HMI syníēmi soon-ee'-ay-mee from G4862 and ἵημι I(/HMI híēmi (to send); to put together, i.e. (mentally) to comprehend; by implication, to act piously:-- consider, understand, be wise.
entries.4921: συνιστάω SUNISTA/W synistáō soon-is-tah'-o , or (strengthened) συνιστάνω SUNISTA/NW synistánō soon-is-tan'-o , or συνίστημι SUNI/STHMI synístēmi soon-is'-tay-mee from G4862 and G2476 (including its collateral forms); to set together, i.e. (by implication) to introduce (favorably), or (figuratively) to exhibit; intransitively, to stand near, or (figuratively) to constitute:--approve, commend, consist, make, stand (with).
entries.4922: συνοδεύω SUNODEU/W synodeúō soon-od-yoo'-o from G4862 and G3593; to travel in company with:--journey with.
entries.4923: συνοδία SUNODI/A synodía soon-od-ee'-ah from a compound of G4862 and G3598 ("synod"); companionship on a journey, i.e. (by implication), a caravan:--company.
entries.4924: συνοικέω SUNOIKE/W synoikéō soon-oy-keh'-o from G4862 and G3611; to reside together (as a family):--dwell together.
entries.4925: συνοικοδομέω SUNOIKODOME/W synoikodoméō soon-oy-kod-om-eh'-o from G4862 and G3618; to construct, i.e. (passively) to compose (in company with other Christians, figuratively):--build together.
entries.4926: συνομιλέω SUNOMILE/W synomiléō soon-om-il-eh'-o from G4862 and G3656; to converse mutually:--talk with.
entries.4927: συνομορέω SUNOMORE/W synomoréō soon-om-or-eh'-o from G4862 and a derivative of a compound of the base of 3674 and the base of G3725; to border together, i.e. adjoin:--join hard.
entries.4928: συνοχή SUNOXH/ synochḗ soon-okh-ay' from G4912; restraint, i.e. (figuratively) anxiety:--anguish, distress.
entries.4929: συντάσσω SUNTA/SSW syntássō soon-tas-so from G4862 and G5021; to arrange jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to direct:--appoint.
entries.4930: συντέλεια SUNTE/LEIA syntéleia soon-tel'-i-ah from G4931; entire completion, i.e. consummation (of a dispensation):--end.
entries.4931: συντελέω SUNTELE/W synteléō soon-tel-eh'-o from G4862 and G5055; to complete entirely; generally, to execute (literally or figuratively):--end, finish, fulfil, make.
entries.4932: συντέμνω SUNTE/MNW syntémnō soon-tem'-no from G4862 and the base of G5114; to contract by cutting, i.e. (figuratively) do concisely (speedily):--(cut) short.
entries.4933: συντηρέω SUNTHRE/W syntēréō soon-tay-reh'-o from G4862 and G5083; to keep closely together, i.e. (by implication) to conserve (from ruin); mentally, to remember (and obey):--keep, observe, preserve.
entries.4934: συντίθεμαι SUNTI/QEMAI syntíthemai soon-tith'-em-ahee middle voice from G4862 and G5087; to place jointly, i.e. (figuratively) to consent (bargain, stipulate), concur:--agree, assent, covenant.
entries.4935: συντόμως SUNTO/MWS syntómōs soon-tom'-oce adverb from a derivative of G4932; concisely (briefly):--a few words.
entries.4936: συντρέχω SUNTRE/XW syntréchō soon-trekh'-o from G4862 and G5143 (including its alternate); to rush together (hastily assemble) or headlong (figuratively):--run (together, with).
entries.4937: συντρίβω SUNTRI/BW syntríbō soon-tree'-bo from G4862 and the base of G5147; to crush completely, i.e. to shatter (literally or figuratively):--break (in pieces), broken to shivers (+ -hearted), bruise.
entries.4938: σύντριμμα SU/NTRIMMA sýntrimma soon-trim'-mah from G4937; concussion or utter fracture (properly, concretely), i.e. complete ruin:--destruction.
entries.4939: σύντροφος SU/NTROFOS sýntrophos soon'-trof-os from G4862 and G5162 (in a passive sense); a fellow-nursling, i.e. comrade:--brought up with.
entries.4940: συντυγχάνω SUNTUGXA/NW syntynchánō soon-toong-khan'-o from G4862 and G5177; to chance together, i.e. meet with (reach):--come at.
entries.4941: Συντύχη *SUNTU/XH Syntýchē soon-too'-khay from G4940; an accident; Syntyche, a Christian female:--Syntyche.
entries.4942: συνυποκρίνομαι SUNUPOKRI/NOMAI synypokrínomai soon-oo-pok-rin'-om-ahee from G4862 and G5271; to act hypocritically in concert with:--dissemble with.
entries.4943: συνυπουργέω SUNUPOURGE/W synypourgéō soon-oop-oorg-eh'-o from G4862 and a derivative of a compound of G5259 and the base of G2041; to be a co-auxiliary, i.e. assist:--help together.
entries.4944: συνωδίνω SUNWDI/NW synōdínō soon-o-dee'-no from G4862 and G5605; to have (parturition) pangs in company (concert, simultaneously) with, i.e. (figuratively) to sympathize (in expectation of relief from suffering):--travail in pain together.
entries.4945: συνωμοσία SUNWMOSI/A synōmosía soon-o-mos-ee'-ah from a compound of G4862 and G3660; a swearing together, i.e. (by implication) a plot:--comspiracy.
entries.4946: Συράκουσαι *SURA/KOUSAI Syrákousai soo-rak'-oo-sahee plural of uncertain derivation; Syracuse, the capital of Sicily:--Syracuse.
entries.4947: Συρία *SURI/A Syría soo-ree'-ah probably of Hebrew origin (H06865); Syria (i.e. Tsyria or Tyre), a region of Asia:--Syria.
entries.4948: Σύρος *SU/ROS Sýros soo'-ros from the same as G4947; a Syran (i.e. probably Tyrian), a native of Syria:--Syrian.
entries.4949: Συροφοίνισσα *SUROFOI/NISSA Syrophoínissa soo-rof-oy'-nis-sah feminine of a compound of G4948 and the same as G5403; a Syro-phœnician woman, i.e. a female native of Phœnicia in Syria:--Syrophenician.
entries.4950: σύρτις SU/RTIS sýrtis soor'-tis from G4951; a shoal (from the sand drawn thither by the waves), i.e. the Syrtis Major or great bay on the north coast of Africa:--quicksands.
entries.4951: σύρω SU/RW sýrō soo'-ro probably akin to G138; to trail:--drag, draw, hale.
entries.4952: συσπαράσσω SUSPARA/SSW sysparássō soos-par-as'-so from G4862 and G4682; to rend completely, i.e. (by analogy) to convulse violently:--throw down.
entries.4953: σύσσημον SU/SSHMON sýssēmon soos'-say-mon neuter of a compound of G4862 and the base of G4591; a sign in common, i.e. preconcerted signal:--token.
entries.4954: σύσσωμος SU/SSWMOS sýssōmos soos'-so-mos from G4862 and G4983; of a joint body, i.e. (figuratively) a fellow-member of the Christian community:--of the same body.
entries.4955: συστασιαστής SUSTASIASTH/S systasiastḗs soos-tas-ee-as-tace' from a compound of G4862 and a derivative of G4714; a fellow-insurgent:--make insurrection with.
entries.4956: συστατικός SUSTATIKO/S systatikós soos-tat-ee-kos' from a derivative of G4921; introductory, i.e. recommendatory:--of commendation.
entries.4957: συσταυρόω SUSTAURO/W systauróō soos-tow-ro'-o from G4862 and G4717; to impale in company with (literally or figuratively):--crucify with.
entries.4958: συστέλλω SUSTE/LLW systéllō soos-tel'-lo from G4862 and G4724; to send (draw) together, i.e. enwrap (enshroud a corpse for burial), contract (an interval):-- short, wind up.
entries.4959: συστενάζω SUSTENA/ZW systenázō soos-ten-ad'-zo from G4862 and G4727; to moan jointly, i.e. (figuratively) experience a common calamity:--groan together.
entries.4960: συστοιχέω SUSTOIXE/W systoichéō soos-toy-kheh'-o from G4862 and G4748; to file together (as soldiers in ranks), i.e. (figuratively) to correspond to:--answer to.
entries.4961: συστρατιώτης SUSTRATIW/THS systratiṓtēs soos-trat-ee-o'-tace from G4862 and G4757; a co-campaigner, i.e. (figuratively) an associate in Christian toil:--fellowsoldier.
entries.4962: συστρέφω SUSTRE/FW systréphō soos-tref'-o from G4862 and G4762; to twist together, i.e. collect (a bundle, a crowd):--gather.
entries.4963: συστροφή SUSTROFH/ systrophḗ soos-trof-ay' from G4962; a twisting together, i.e. (figuratively) a secret coalition, riotous crowd:--+ band together, concourse.
entries.4964: συσχηματίζω SUSXHMATI/ZW syschēmatízō soos-khay-mat-id'-zo from G4862 and a derivative of G4976; to fashion alike, i.e. conform to the same pattern (figuratively):--conform to, fashion self according to.
entries.4965: Συχάρ *SUXA/R Sychár soo-khar' of Hebrew origin (H07941); Sychar (i.e. Shekar), a place in Palestine:--Sychar.
entries.4966: Συχέμ *SUXE/M Sychém soo-khem' of Hebrew origin (H07927); Sychem (i.e. Shekem), the name of a Canaanite and of a place in Palestine:--Sychem.
entries.4967: σφαγή SFAGH/ sphagḗ sfag-ay' from G4969; butchery (of animals for food or sacrifice, or (figuratively) of men (destruction)):--slaughter.
entries.4968: σφάγιον SFA/GION sphágion sfag'-ee-on neuter of a derivative of G4967; a victim (in sacrifice):--slain beast.
entries.4969: σφάζω SFA/ZW spházō sfad'-zo a primary verb; to butcher (especially an animal for food or in sacrifice) or (generally) to slaughter, or (specially), to maim (violently):--kill, slay, wound.
entries.4970: σφόδρα SFO/DRA sphódra sfod'-rah neuter plural of σφοδρός SFODRO/S sphodrós (violent; of uncertain derivation) as adverb; vehemently, i.e. in a high degree, much:-- exceeding(-ly), greatly, sore, very.
entries.4971: σφοδρῶς SFODRW=S sphodrōs sfod-roce' adverb from the same as G4970; very much:--exceedingly.
entries.4972: σφραγίζω SFRAGI/ZW sphragízō sfrag-id'-zo from G4973; to stamp (with a signet or private mark) for security or preservation (literally or figuratively); by implication, to keep secret, to attest:--(set a, set to) seal up, stop.
entries.4973: σφραγίς SFRAGI/S sphragís sfrag-ece' probably strengthened from G5420; a signet (as fencing in or protecting from misappropriation); by implication, the stamp impressed (as a mark of privacy, or genuineness), literally or figuratively:--seal.
entries.4974: σφυρόν SFURO/N sphyrón sfoo-ron' neuter of a presumed derivative probably of the same as σφαῖρα SFAI=RA sphaîra (a ball, "sphere"; compare the feminine σφῦρα SFU=RA sphŷra, a hammer); the ankle (as globular):--ancle bone.
entries.4975: σχεδόν SXEDO/N schedón skhed-on' neuter of a presumed derivative of the alternate of G2192 as adverb; nigh, i.e. nearly:--almost.
entries.4976: σχῆμα SXH=MA schēma skhay'-mah from the alternate of G2192; a figure (as a mode or circumstance), i.e. (by implication) external condition:--fashion.
entries.4977: σχίζω SXI/ZW schízō skhid'-zo apparently a primary verb; to split or sever (literally or figuratively):--break, divide, open, rend, make a rent.
entries.4978: σχίσμα SXI/SMA schísma skhis'-mah from G4977; a split or gap ("schism"), literally or figuratively:--division, rent, schism.
entries.4979: σχοινίον SXOINI/ON schoiníon skhoy-nee'-on diminutive of σχοῖνος SXOI=NOS schoînos (a rush or flag-plant; of uncertain derivation); a rushlet, i.e. grass-withe or tie (generally):--small cord, rope.
entries.4980: σχολάζω SXOLA/ZW scholázō skhol-ad'-zo from G4981; to take a holiday, i.e. be at leisure for (by implication, devote oneself wholly to); figuratively, to be vacant (of a house):--empty, give self.
entries.4981: σχολή SXOLH/ scholḗ skhol-ay' probably feminine of a presumed derivative of the alternate of G2192; properly, loitering (as a withholding of oneself from work) or leisure, i.e. (by implication) a "school" (as vacation from physical employment):--school.
entries.4982: σώζω SW/ZW sṓzō sode'-zo from a primary σῶς SW=S sōs (contraction for obsolete σάος SA/OS sáos, "safe"); to save, i.e. deliver or protect (literally or figuratively):--heal, preserve, save (self), do well, be (make) whole.
entries.4983: σῶμα SW=MA sōma so'-mah from G4982; the body (as a sound whole), used in a very wide application, literally or figuratively:--bodily, body, slave.
entries.4984: σωματικός SWMATIKO/S sōmatikós so-mat-ee-kos' from G4983; corporeal or physical:--bodily.
entries.4985: σωματικῶς SWMATIKW=S sōmatikōs so-mat-ee-koce' adverb from G4984; corporeally or physically:--bodily.
entries.4986: Σώπατρος *SW/PATROS Sṓpatros so'-pat-ros from the base of G4982 and G3962; of a safe father; Sopatrus, a Christian:--Sopater. Compare G4989.
entries.4987: σωρεύω SWREU/W sōreúō sore-yoo'-o from another form of G4673; to pile up (literally or figuratively):--heap, load.
entries.4988: Σωσθένης *SWSQE/NHS Sōsthénēs soce-then'-ace from the base of G4982 and that of G4599; of safe strength; Sosthenes, a Christian:--Sosthenes.
entries.4989: Σωσίπατρος *SWSI/PATROS Sōsípatros so-sip'-at-ros prolongation for G4986; Sosipatrus, a Christian:--Sosipater.
entries.4990: σωτήρ SWTH/R sōtḗr so-tare' from G4982; a deliverer, i.e. God or Christ:--saviour.
entries.4991: σωτηρία SWTHRI/A sōtēría so-tay-ree'-ah feminine of a derivative of G4990 as (properly, abstract) noun; rescue or safety (physically or morally):--deliver, health, salvation, save, saving.
entries.4992: σωτήριον SWTH/RION sōtḗrion so-tay'-ree-on neuter of the same as G4991 as (properly, concretely) noun; defender or (by implication) defence:--salvation.
entries.4993: σωφρονέω SWFRONE/W sōphronéō so-fron-eh'-o from G4998; to be of sound mind, i.e. sane, (figuratively) moderate:--be in right mind, be sober (minded), soberly.
entries.4994: σωφρονίζω SWFRONI/ZW sōphronízō so-fron-id'-zo from G4998; to make of sound mind, i.e. (figuratively) to discipline or correct:--teach to be sober.
entries.4995: σωφρονισμός SWFRONISMO/S sōphronismós so-fron-is-mos' from G4994; discipline, i.e. self-control:--sound mind.
entries.4996: σωφρόνως SWFRO/NWS sōphrónōs so-fron'-oce adverb from G4998; with sound mind, i.e. moderately:--soberly.
entries.4997: σωφροσύνη SWFROSU/NH sōphrosýnē so-fros-oo'-nay from G4998; soundness of mind, i.e. (literally) sanity or (figuratively) self-control:--soberness, sobriety.
entries.4998: σώφρων SW/FRWN sṓphrōn so'-frone from the base of G4982 and that of G5424; safe (sound) in mind, i.e. self-controlled (moderate as to opinion or passion):--discreet, sober, temperate.
entries.4999: Ταβέρναι *TABE/RNAI Tabérnai tab-er'-nahee plural of Latin origin; huts or wooden-walled buildings; Tabernæ:--taverns.
entries.5000: Ταβιθά *TABIQA/ Tabithá tab-ee-thah' of Chaldee origin (compare H06646); the gazelle; Tabitha (i.e. Tabjetha), a Christian female:--Tabitha.
entries.5001: τάγμα TA/GMA tágma tag'-mah from G5021; something orderly in arrangement (a troop), i.e. (figuratively) a series or succession:--order.
entries.5002: τακτός TAKTO/S taktós tak-tos' from G5021; arranged, i.e. appointed or stated:--set.
entries.5003: ταλαιπωρέω TALAIPWRE/W talaipōréō tal-ahee-po-reh'-o from G5005; to be wretched, i.e. realize one's own misery:--be afflicted.
entries.5004: ταλαιπωρία TALAIPWRI/A talaipōría tal-ahee-po-ree'-ah from G5005; wretchedness, i.e. calamity:--misery.
entries.5005: ταλαίπωρος TALAI/PWROS talaípōros tal-ah'-ee-po-ros from the base of G5007 and a derivative of the base of G3984; enduring trial, i.e. miserable:--wretched.
entries.5006: ταλαντιαῖος TALANTIAI=OS talantiaîos tal-an-tee-ah'-yos from G5007; talent-like in weight:--weight of a talent.
entries.5007: τάλαντον TA/LANTON tálanton tal'-an-ton neuter of a presumed derivative of the original form of τλάω TLA/W tláō (to bear; equivalent to G5342); a balance (as supporting weights), i.e. (by implication) a certain weight (and thence a coin or rather sum of money) or "talent":--talent.
entries.5008: ταλιθά TALIQA/ talithá tal-ee-thah' of Chaldee origin (compare H02924); the fresh, i.e. young girl; talitha (O maiden):--talitha.
entries.5009: ταμεῖον TAMEI=ON tameîon tam-i'-on neuter contraction of a presumed derivative of ταμίας TAMI/AS tamías (a dispenser or distributor; akin to τέμνω TE/MNW témnō, to cut); a dispensary or magazine, i.e. a chamber on the ground-floor or interior of an Oriental house (generally used for storage or privacy, a spot for retirement):--secret chamber, closet, storehouse.
entries.5010: τάξις TA/CIS táxis tax'-is from G5021; regular arrangement, i.e. (in time) fixed succession (of rank or character), official dignity:--order.
entries.5011: ταπεινός TAPEINO/S tapeinós tap-i-nos' of uncertain derivation; depressed, i.e. (figuratively) humiliated (in circumstances or disposition):--base, cast down, humble, of low degree (estate), lowly.
entries.5012: ταπεινοφροσύνη TAPEINOFROSU/NH tapeinophrosýnē tap-i-nof-ros-oo'-nay from a compound of G5011 and the base of G5424; humiliation of mind, i.e. modesty:--humbleness of mind, humility (of mind, loneliness (of mind).
entries.5013: ταπεινόω TAPEINO/W tapeinóō tap-i-no'-o from G5011; to depress; figuratively, to humiliate (in condition or heart):--abase, bring low, humble (self).
entries.5014: ταπείνωσις TAPEI/NWSIS tapeínōsis tap-i'-no-sis from G5013; depression (in rank or feeling):--humiliation, be made low, low estate, vile.
entries.5015: ταράσσω TARA/SSW tarássō tar-as'-so of uncertain affinity; to stir or agitate (roil water):--trouble.
entries.5016: ταραχή TARAXH/ tarachḗ tar-akh-ay' feminine from G5015; disturbance, i.e. (of water) roiling, or (of a mob) sedition:--trouble(-ing).
entries.5017: τάραχος TA/RAXOS tárachos tar'-akh-os masculine from G5015; a disturbance, i.e. (popular) tumult:--stir.
entries.5018: Ταρσεύς *TARSEU/S Tarseús tar-syoos' from G5019; a Tarsean, i.e. native of Tarsus:--of Tarsus.
entries.5019: Ταρσός *TARSO/S Tarsós tar-sos' perhaps the same as ταρσός TARSO/S tarsós (a flat basket); Tarsus, a place in Asia Minor:--Tarsus.
entries.5020: ταρταρόω TARTARO/W tartaróō tar-tar-o'-o from Τάρταρος *TA/RTAROS Tártaros (the deepest abyss of Hades); to incarcerate in eternal torment:--cast down to hell.
entries.5021: τάσσω TA/SSW tássō tas'-so a prolonged form of a primary verb (which latter appears only in certain tenses); to arrange in an orderly manner, i.e. assign or dispose (to a certain position or lot):--addict, appoint, determine, ordain, set.
entries.5022: ταῦρος TAU=ROS taûros tow'-ros apparently a primary word (compare H08450, "steer"); a bullock:--bull, ox.
entries.5023: ταῦτα TAU=TA taûta tow'-tah nominative or accusative case neuter plural of G3778; these things:--+ afterward, follow, + hereafter, X him, the same, so, such, that, then, these, they, this, those, thus.
entries.5024: ταὐτά TAU)TA/ tautá tow-tah' neuter plural of G3588 and G846 as adverb; in the same way:--even thus, (manner) like, so.
entries.5025: ταύταις TAU/TAIS taútais tow'-taheece , and ταύτας TAU/TAS taútas tow'-tas dative case and accusative case feminine plural respectively of G3778; (to or with or by, etc.) these:--hence, that, then, these, those.
entries.5026: ταύτῃ TAU/TH| taútēi tow'-tay , and ταύτην TAU/THN taútēn tow'-tane , and ταύτης TAU/THS taútēs tow'-tace dative case, accusative case and genitive case respectively of the feminine singular of G3778; (towards or of) this:--her, + hereof, it, that, + thereby, the (same), this (same).
entries.5027: ταφή TAFH/ taphḗ taf-ay' feminine from G2290; burial (the act):--X bury.
entries.5028: τάφος TA/FOS táphos taf'-os masculine from G2290; a grave (the place of interment):--sepulchre, tomb.
entries.5029: τάχα TA/XA tácha takh'-ah as if neuter plural of G5036 (adverbially); shortly, i.e. (figuratively) possibly:--peradventure(-haps).
entries.5030: ταχέως TAXE/WS tachéōs takh-eh'-oce adverb from G5036; briefly, i.e. (in time) speedily, or (in manner) rapidly:--hastily, quickly, shortly, soon, suddenly.
entries.5031: ταχινός TAXINO/S tachinós takh-ee-nos' from G5034; curt, i.e. impending:--shortly, swift.
entries.5032: τάχιον TA/XION táchion takh'-ee-on neuter singular of the comparative of G5036 (as adverb); more swiftly, i.e. (in manner) more rapidly, or (in time) more speedily:--out (run), quickly, shortly, sooner.
entries.5033: τάχιστα TA/XISTA táchista takh'-is-tah neuter plural of the superlative of G5036 (as adverb); most quickly, i.e. (with G5613 prefixed) as soon as possible:--+ with all speed.
entries.5034: τάχος TA/XOS táchos takh'-os from the same as G5036; a brief space (of time), i.e. (with G1722 prefixed) in haste:--+ quickly, + shortly, + speedily.
entries.5035: ταχύ TAXU/ tachý takh-oo' neuter singular of G5036 (as adverb); shortly, i.e. without delay, soon, or (by surprise) suddenly, or (by implication, of ease) readily:--lightly, quickly.
entries.5036: ταχύς TAXU/S tachýs takh-oos' of uncertain affinity; fleet, i.e. (figuratively) prompt or ready:--swift.
entries.5037: τέ TE/ té teh a primary particle (enclitic) of connection or addition; both or also (properly, as correlation of G2532):--also, and, both, even, then, whether. Often used in composition, usually as the latter particle.
entries.5038: τεῖχος TEI=XOS teîchos ti'-khos akin to the base of G5088; a wall (as formative of a house):--wall.
entries.5039: τεκμήριον TEKMH/RION tekmḗrion tek-may'-ree-on neuter of a presumed derivative of τεκμάρ TEKMA/R tekmár (a goal or fixed limit); a token (as defining a fact), i.e. criterion of certainty:--infallible proof.
entries.5040: τεκνίον TEKNI/ON tekníon tek-nee'-on diminutive of G5043; an infant, i.e. (plural figuratively) darlings (Christian converts):--little children.
entries.5041: τεκνογονέω TEKNOGONE/W teknogonéō tek-nog-on-eh'-o from a compound of G5043 and the base of G1096; to be a child-bearer, i.e. parent (mother):--bear children.
entries.5042: τεκνογονία TEKNOGONI/A teknogonía tek-nog-on-ee'-ah from the same as G5041; childbirth (parentage), i.e. (by implication) maternity (the performance of maternal duties):--childbearing.
entries.5043: τέκνον TE/KNON téknon tek'-non from the base of G5088; a child (as produced):--child, daughter, son.
entries.5044: τεκνοτροφέω TEKNOTROFE/W teknotrophéō tek-not-rof-eh'-o from a compound of G5043 and G5142; to be a childrearer, i.e. fulfil the duties of a female parent:--bring up children.
entries.5045: τέκτων TE/KTWN téktōn tek'-tone from the base of G5098; an artificer (as producer of fabrics), i.e. (specially), a craftsman in wood:--carpenter.
entries.5046: τέλειος TE/LEIOS téleios tel'-i-os from G5056; complete (in various applications of labor, growth, mental and moral character, etc.); neuter (as noun, with G3588) completeness:--of full age, man, perfect.
entries.5047: τελειότης TELEIO/THS teleiótēs tel-i-ot'-ace from G5046; (the state) completeness (mentally or morally):--perfection(-ness).
entries.5048: τελειόω TELEIO/W teleióō tel-i-o'-o from G5046; to complete, i.e. (literally) accomplish, or (figuratively) consummate (in character):--consecrate, finish, fulfil, make) perfect.
entries.5049: τελείως TELEI/WS teleíōs tel-i'-oce adverb from G5046; completely, i.e. (of hope) without wavering:--to the end.
entries.5050: τελείωσις TELEI/WSIS teleíōsis tel-i'-o-sis from G5448; (the act) completion, i.e. (of prophecy) verification, or (of expiation) absolution:--perfection, performance.
entries.5051: τελειωτής TELEIWTH/S teleiōtḗs tel-i-o-tace' from G5048; a completer, i.e. consummater:--finisher.
entries.5052: τελεσφορέω TELESFORE/W telesphoréō tel-es-for-eh'-o from a compound of G5056 and G5342; to be a bearer to completion (maturity), i.e. to ripen fruit (figuratively):--bring fruit to perfection.
entries.5053: τελευτάω TELEUTA/W teleutáō tel-yoo-tah'-o from a presumed derivative of G5055; to finish life (by implication, of G979), i.e. expire (demise):--be dead, decease, die.
entries.5054: τελευτή TELEUTH/ teleutḗ tel-yoo-tay' from G5053; decease:--death.
entries.5055: τελέω TELE/W teléō tel-eh'-o from G5056; to end, i.e. complete, execute, conclude, discharge (a debt):--accomplish, make an end, expire, fill up, finish, go over, pay, perform.
entries.5056: τέλος TE/LOS télos tel'-os from a primary τέλλω TE/LLW téllō (to set out for a definite point or goal); properly, the point aimed at as a limit, i.e. (by implication) the conclusion of an act or state (termination (literally, figuratively or indefinitely), result (immediate, ultimate or prophetic), purpose); specially, an impost or levy (as paid):--+ continual, custom, end(-ing), finally, uttermost. Compare G5411.
entries.5057: τελώνης TELW/NHS telṓnēs tel-o'-nace from G5056 and G5608; a tax-farmer, i.e. collector of public revenue:--publican.
entries.5058: τελώνιον TELW/NION telṓnion tel-o'-nee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of G5057; a tax-gatherer's place of business:--receipt of custom.
entries.5059: τέρας TE/RAS téras ter'-as of uncertain affinity; a prodigy or omen:--wonder.
entries.5060: Τέρτιος *TE/RTIOS Tértios ter'-tee-os of Latin origin; third; Tertius, a Christian:--Tertius.
entries.5061: Τέρτυλλος *TE/RTULLOS Tértyllos ter'-tool-los of uncertain derivation; Tertullus, a Roman:--Tertullus.
entries.5062: τεσσαράκοντα TESSARA/KONTA tessarákonta tes-sar-ak'-on-tah the decade of G5064; forty:--forty.
entries.5063: τεσσαρακονταετής TESSARAKONTAETH/S tessarakontaetḗs tes-sar-ak-on-tah-et-ace' from G5062 and G2094; of forty years of age:--(+ full, of) forty years (old).
entries.5064: τέσσαρες TE/SSARES téssares tes'-sar-es , or neuter τέσσαρα TE/SSARA téssara tes'-sar-ah a plural number; four:--four.
entries.5065: τεσσαρεσκαιδέκατος TESSARESKAIDE/KATOS tessareskaidékatos tes-sar-es-kahee-dek'-at-os from G5064 and G2532 and G1182; fourteenth:--fourteenth.
entries.5066: τεταρταῖος TETARTAI=OS tetartaîos tet-ar-tah'-yos from G5064; pertaining to the fourth day:--four days.
entries.5067: τέταρτος TE/TARTOS tétartos tet'-ar-tos ordinal from G5064; fourth:--four(-th).
entries.5068: τετράγωνος TETRA/GWNOS tetrágōnos tet-rag'-o-nos from G5064 and G1137; four-cornered, i.e. square:--foursquare.
entries.5069: τετράδιον TETRA/DION tetrádion tet-rad'-ee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of τέτρας TE/TRAS tétras (a tetrad; from G5064); a quaternion or squad (picket) of four Roman soldiers:--quaternion.
entries.5070: τετρακισχίλιοι TETRAKISXI/LIOI tetrakischílioi tet-rak-is-khil'-ee-oy from the multiplicative adverb of G5064 and G5507; four times a thousand:--four thousand.
entries.5071: τετρακόσιοι TETRAKO/SIOI tetrakósioi tet-rak-os'-ee-oy , or neuter τετρακόσια TETRAKO/SIA tetrakósia tet-rak-os'-ee-ah plural from G5064 and G1540; four hundred:--four hundred.
entries.5072: τετράμηνον TETRA/MHNON tetrámēnon tet-ram'-ay-non neuter of a compound of G5064 and G3376; a four months' space:--four months.
entries.5073: τετραπλόος TETRAPLO/OS tetraplóos tet-rap-lo'-os from G5064 and a derivative of the base of G4118; quadruple:--fourfold.
entries.5074: τετράπους TETRA/POUS tetrápous tet-rap'-ooce from G5064 and G4228; a quadruped:--fourfooted beast.
entries.5075: τετραρχέω TETRARXE/W tetrarchéō tet-rar-kheh'-o from G5076; to be a tetrarch:--(be) tetrarch.
entries.5076: τετράρχης TETRA/RXHS tetrárchēs tet-rar'-khace from G5064 and G757; the ruler of a fourth part of a country ("tetrarch"):--tetrarch.
entries.5077: τεφρόω TEFRO/W tephróō tef-ro'-o from τέφρα TE/FRA téphra (ashes); to incinerate, i.e. consume:--turn to ashes.
entries.5078: τέχνη TE/XNH téchnē tekh'-nay from the base of G5088; art (as productive), i.e. (specially), a trade, or (generally) skill:--art, craft, occupation.
entries.5079: τεχνίτης TEXNI/THS technítēs tekh-nee'-tace from G5078; an artisan; figuratively, a founder (Creator):--builder, craftsman.
entries.5080: τήκω TH/KW tḗkō tay'-ko apparently a primary verb; to liquefy:--melt.
entries.5081: τηλαυγῶς THLAUGW=S tēlaugōs tay-low-goce' adverb from a compound of a derivative of G5056 and G827; in a far-shining manner, i.e. plainly:--clearly.
entries.5082: τηλικοῦτος THLIKOU=TOS tēlikoûtos tay-lik-oo'-tos , or feminine τηλικαύτη THLIKAU/TH tēlikaútē tay-lik-ow'-tay from a compound of G3588 with G2245 and G3778; such as this, i.e. (in (figurative) magnitude) so vast:--so great, so mighty.
entries.5083: τηρέω THRE/W tēréō tay-reh'-o from τερός TERO/S terós (a watch; perhaps akin to G2334); to guard (from loss or injury, properly, by keeping the eye upon; and thus differing from G5442, which is properly to prevent escaping; and from G2892, which implies a fortress or full military lines of apparatus), i.e. to note (a prophecy; figuratively, to fulfil a command); by implication, to detain (in custody; figuratively, to maintain); by extension, to withhold (for personal ends; figuratively, to keep unmarried); by extension, to withhold (for personal ends; figuratively, to keep unmarried):--hold fast, keep(- er), (pre-, re-)serve, watch.
entries.5084: τήρησις TH/RHSIS tḗrēsis tay'-ray-sis from G5083; a watching, i.e. (figuratively) observance, or (concretely) a prison:--hold.
entries.5085: Τιβεριάς *TIBERIA/S Tiberiás tib-er-ee-as' from G5086; Tiberias, the name of a town and a lake in Palestine:--Tiberias.
entries.5086: Τιβέριος *TIBE/RIOS Tibérios tib-er'-ee-os of Latin origin; probably pertaining to the river Tiberis or Tiber; Tiberius, a Roman emperor:--Tiberius.
entries.5087: τίθημι TI/QHMI títhēmi tith'-ay-mee ; a prolonged form of a primary θέω QE/W théō theh'-o (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses); to place (in the widest application, literally and figuratively; properly, in a passive or horizontal posture, and thus different from G2476, which properly denotes an upright and active position, while G2749 is properly reflexive and utterly prostrate):--+ advise, appoint, bow, commit, conceive, give, X kneel down, lay (aside, down, up), make, ordain, purpose, put, set (forth), settle, sink down.
entries.5088: τίκτω TI/KTW tíktō tik'-to a strengthened form of a primary τέκω TE/KW tékō tek'-o (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses); to produce (from seed, as a mother, a plant, the earth, etc.), literally or figuratively:--bear, be born, bring forth, be delivered, be in travail.
entries.5089: τίλλω TI/LLW tíllō til'-lo perhaps akin to the alternate of G138, and thus to G4951; to pull off:--pluck.
entries.5090: Τιμαῖος *TIMAI=OS Timaîos tim'-ah-yos probably of Chaldee origin (compare H02931); Timæus (i.e. Timay), an Israelite:--Timæus.
entries.5091: τιμάω TIMA/W timáō tim-ah'-o from G5093; to prize, i.e. fix a valuation upon; by implication, to revere:--honour, value.
entries.5092: τιμή TIMH/ timḗ tee-may' from G5099; a value, i.e. money paid, or (concretely and collectively) valuables; by analogy, esteem (especially of the highest degree), or the dignity itself:--honour, precious, price, some.
entries.5093: τίμιος TI/MIOS tímios tim'-ee-os , including the comparative τιμιώτερος TIMIW/TEROS timiṓteros tim-ee-o'-ter-os , and the superlative τιμιώτατος TIMIW/TATOS timiṓtatos tim-ee-o'-tat-os from G5092; valuable, i.e. (objectively) costly, or (subjectively) honored, esteemed, or (figuratively) beloved:--dear, honourable, (more, most) precious, had in reputation.
entries.5094: τιμιότης TIMIO/THS timiótēs tim-ee-ot'-ace from G5093; expensiveness, i.e. (by implication) magnificence:--costliness.
entries.5095: Τιμόθεος *TIMO/QEOS Timótheos tee-moth'-eh-os from G5092 and G2316; dear to God; Timotheus, a Christian:--Timotheus, Timothy.
entries.5096: Τίμων *TI/MWN Tímōn tee'-mone from G5092; valuable; Timon, a Christian:--Timon.
entries.5097: τιμωρέω TIMWRE/W timōréō tim-o-reh'-o from a compound of G5092 and οὖρος OU)=ROS oûros ouros (a guard); properly, to protect one's honor, i.e. to avenge (inflict a penalty):--punish.
entries.5098: τιμωρία TIMWRI/A timōría tee-mo-ree'-ah from G5097; vindication, i.e. (by implication) a penalty:--punishment.
entries.5099: τίνω TI/NW tínō tee'-no ; strengthened for a primary τίω TI/W tíō tee'-o (which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses); to pay a price, i.e. as a penalty:--be punished with.
entries.5100: τὶς TI\S tìs tis an enclitic indefinite pronoun; some or any person or object:--a (kind of), any (man, thing, thing at all), certain (thing), divers, he (every) man, one (X thing), ought, + partly, some (man, -body, - thing, -what), (+ that no-)thing, what(-soever), X wherewith, whom(-soever), whose(-soever).
entries.5101: τίς TI/S tís tis probably emphatic of G5100; an interrogative pronoun, who, which or what (in direct or indirect questions):--every man, how (much), + no(-ne, thing), what (manner, thing), where (-by, -fore, -of, -unto, - with, -withal), whether, which, who(-m, -se), why.
entries.5102: τίτλος TI/TLOS títlos tit'-los of Latin origin; a titulus or "title" (placard):--title.
entries.5103: Τίτος *TI/TOS Títos tee'-tos of Latin origin but uncertain significance; Titus, a Christian:--Titus.
entries.5104: τοί TOI/ toí toy probably for the dative case of G3588; an enclitic particle of asseveration by way of contrast; in sooth:--(used only with other particles in the compound, as G2544, G3305, G5105, G5106, etc.)
entries.5105: τοιγαροῦν TOIGAROU=N toigaroûn toy-gar-oon' from G5104 and G1063 and G3767; truly for then, i.e. consequently:--there-(where-)fore.
entries.5106: τοίνυν TOI/NUN toínyn toy'-noon from G5104 and G3568; truly now, i.e. accordingly:--then, therefore.
entries.5107: τοιόσδε TOIO/SDE toiósde toy-os'-deh (including the other inflections); from a derivative of 5104 and G1161; such-like then, i.e. so great:--such.
entries.5108: τοιοῦτος TOIOU=TOS toioûtos toy-oo'-tos (including the other inflections); from G5104 and G3778; truly this, i.e. of this sort (to denote character or individuality):--like, such (an one).
entries.5109: τοῖχος TOI=XOS toîchos toy'-khos another form of G5038; a wall:--wall.
entries.5110: τόκος TO/KOS tókos tok'-os from the base of G5088; interest on money loaned (as a produce):--usury.
entries.5111: τολμάω TOLMA/W tolmáō tol-mah'-o from τόλμα TO/LMA tólma (boldness; probably itself from the base of G5056 through the idea of extreme conduct); to venture (objectively or in act; while G2292 is rather subjective or in feeling); by implication, to be courageous:--be bold, boldly, dare, durst.
entries.5112: τολμηρότερον TOLMHRO/TERON tolmēróteron tol-may-rot'-er-on neuter of the compound of a derivative of the base of 5111 (as adverb); more daringly, i.e. with greater confidence than otherwise:--the more boldly.
entries.5113: τολμητής TOLMHTH/S tolmētḗs tol-may-tace' from G5111; a daring (audacious) man:--presumptuous.
entries.5114: τομώτερος TOMW/TEROS tomṓteros tom-o'-ter-os comparative of a derivative of the primary τέμνω TE/MNW témnō (to cut; more comprehensive or decisive than G2875, as if by a single stroke; whereas that implies repeated blows, like hacking); more keen:--sharper.
entries.5115: τόξον TO/CON tóxon tox'-on from the base of G5088; a bow (apparently as the simplest fabric):--bow.
entries.5116: τοπάζιον TOPA/ZION topázion top-ad'-zee-on neuter of a presumed derivative (alternately) of τόπαζος TO/PAZOS tópazos (a "topaz"; of uncertain origin); a gem, probably the chrysolite:--topaz.
entries.5117: τόπος TO/POS tópos top'-os apparently a primary word; a spot (generally in space, but limited by occupancy; whereas G5561 is a large but particular locality), i.e. location (as a position, home, tract, etc.); figuratively, condition, opportunity; specially, a scabbard:--coast, licence, place, X plain, quarter, + rock, room, where.
entries.5118: τοσοῦτος TOSOU=TOS tosoûtos tos-oo'-tos from τόσος TO/SOS tósos (so much; apparently from G3588 and G3739) and G3778 (including its variations); so vast as this, i.e. such (in quantity, amount, number of space):--as large, so great (long, many, much), these many.
entries.5119: τότε TO/TE tóte tot'-eh from (the neuter of) G3588 and G3753; the when, i.e. at the time that (of the past or future, also in consecution):--that time, then.
entries.5120: τοῦ TOU= toû too properly, the genitive case of G3588; sometimes used for G5127; of this person:--his.
entries.5121: τοὐναντίον TOU)NANTI/ON tounantíon too-nan-tee'-on contraction for the neuter of G3588 and G1726; on the contrary:--contrariwise.
entries.5122: τοὔνομα TOU)/NOMA toúnoma too'-no-mah contraction for the neuter of G3588 and G3686; the name (is):--named.
entries.5123: τουτέστι TOUTE/STI toutésti toot-es'-tee contraction for G5124 and G2076; that is:--that is (to say).
entries.5124: τοῦτο TOU=TO toûto too'-to neuter singular nominative or accusative case of G3778; that thing:--here (-unto), it, partly, self(-same), so, that (intent), the same, there(-fore, -unto), this, thus, where(-fore).
entries.5125: τούτοις TOU/TOIS toútois too'-toice dative case plural masculine or neuter of G3778; to (for, in, with or by) these (persons or things):--such, them, there(-in, -with), these, this, those.
entries.5126: τοῦτον TOU=TON toûton too'-ton accusative case singular masculine of G3778; this (person, as objective of verb or preposition):--him, the same, that, this.
entries.5127: τούτου TOU/TOU toútou too'-too genitive case singular masculine or neuter of G3778; of (from or concerning) this (person or thing):--here(-by), him, it, + such manner of, that, thence(-forth), thereabout, this, thus.
entries.5128: τούτους TOU/TOUS toútous too'-tooce accusative case plural masculine of G3778; these (persons, as objective of verb or preposition):--such, them, these, this.
entries.5129: τούτῳ TOU/TW| toútōi too'-to dative case singular masculine or neuter of G3778; to (in, with or by) this (person or thing):--here(-by, -in), him, one, the same, there(-in), this.
entries.5130: τούτων TOU/TWN toútōn too'-tone genitive case plural masculine or neuter of G3778; of (from or concerning) these (persons or things):--such, their, these (things), they, this sort, those.
entries.5131: τράγος TRA/GOS trágos trag'-os from the base of G5176; a he-goat (as a gnawer):--goat.
entries.5132: τράπεζα TRA/PEZA trápeza trap'-ed-zah probably contracted from G5064 and G3979; a table or stool (as being four-legged), usually for food (figuratively, a meal); also a counter for money (figuratively, a broker's office for loans at interest):--bank, meat, table.
entries.5133: τραπεζίτης TRAPEZI/THS trapezítēs trap-ed-zee'-tace from G5132; a money-broker or banker:--exchanger.
entries.5134: τραῦμα TRAU=MA traûma trow'-mah from the base of τιτρώσκω TITRW/SKW titrṓskō (to wound; akin to the base of G2352, G5147, G5149, etc.); a wound:--wound.
entries.5135: τραυματίζω TRAUMATI/ZW traumatízō trow-mat-id'-zo from G5134; to inflict a wound:--wound.
entries.5136: τραχηλίζω TRAXHLI/ZW trachēlízō trakh-ay-lid'-zo from G5137; to seize by the throat or neck, i.e. to expose the gullet of a victim for killing (generally, to lay bare):--opened.
entries.5137: τράχηλος TRA/XHLOS tráchēlos trakh'-ay-los probably from G5143 (through the idea of mobility); the throat (neck), i.e. (figuratively) life:--neck.
entries.5138: τραχύς TRAXU/S trachýs trakh-oos' perhaps strengthened from the base of G4486 (as if jagged by rents); uneven, rocky (reefy):--rock, rough.
entries.5139: Τραχωνῖτις *TRAXWNI=TIS Trachōnîtis trakh-o-nee'-tis from a derivative of G5138; rough district; Trachonitis, a region of Syria:--Trachonitis.
entries.5140: τρεῖς TREI=S treîs trice , or neuter τρία TRI/A tría tree'-ah a primary (plural) number; "three":--three.
entries.5141: τρέμω TRE/MW trémō trem'-o strengthened from a primary τρέω TRE/W tréō (to "dread", "terrify"); to "tremble" or fear:--be afraid, trembling.
entries.5142: τρέφω TRE/FW tréphō tref'-o a primary verb (properly, τρέφω TRE/FW tréphō; but perhaps strengthened from the base of G5157 through the idea of convolution); properly, to stiffen, i.e. fatten (by implication, to cherish (with food, etc.), pamper, rear):--bring up, feed, nourish.
entries.5143: τρέχω TRE/XW tréchō trekh'-o apparently a primary verb (properly, θρέχω QRE/XW thréchō; compare G2359); which uses δρέμω DRE/MW drémō drem'-o (the base of G1408) as alternate in certain tenses; to run or walk hastily (literally or figuratively):--have course, run.
entries.5144: τριάκοντα TRIA/KONTA triákonta tree-ak'-on-tah the decade of G5140; thirty:--thirty.
entries.5145: τριακόσιοι TRIAKO/SIOI triakósioi tree-ak-os'-ee-oy plural from G5140 and G1540; three hundred:--three hundred.
entries.5146: τρίβολος TRI/BOLOS tríbolos trib'-ol-os from G5140 and G956; properly, a crow-foot (three-pronged obstruction in war), i.e. (by analogy) a thorny plant (caltrop):--brier, thistle.
entries.5147: τρίβος TRI/BOS tríbos tree'-bos from τρίβω TRI/BW tríbō (to "rub"; akin to τείρω TEI/RW teírō, τρύω TRU/W trýō, and the base of G5131, G5134); a rut or worn track:--path.
entries.5148: τριετία TRIETI/A trietía tree-et-ee'-ah from a compound of G5140 and G2094; a three years' period (triennium):--space of three years.
entries.5149: τρίζω TRI/ZW trízō trid'-zo apparently a primary verb; to creak (squeak), i.e. (by analogy) to grate the teeth (in frenzy):--gnash.
entries.5150: τρίμηνον TRI/MHNON trímēnon trim'-ay-non neuter of a compound of G5140 and G3376 as noun; a three months' space:--three months.
entries.5151: τρίς TRI/S trís trece adverb from G5140; three times:--three times, thrice.
entries.5152: τρίστεγον TRI/STEGON trístegon tris'-teg-on neuter of a compound of G5140 and G4721 as noun; a third roof (story):--third loft.
entries.5153: τρισχίλιοι TRISXI/LIOI trischílioi tris-khil'-ee-oy from G5151 and G5507; three times a thousand:--three thousand.
entries.5154: τρίτος TRI/TOS trítos tree'-tos ordinal from G5140; third; neuter (as noun) a third part, or (as adverb) a (or the) third time, thirdly:--third(-ly).
entries.5155: τρίχινος TRI/XINOS tríchinos trikh'-ee-nos from G2359; hairy, i.e. made of hair (mohair):--of hair.
entries.5156: τρόμος TRO/MOS trómos trom'-os from G5141; a "trembling", i.e. quaking with fear:--+ tremble(-ing).
entries.5157: τροπή TROPH/ tropḗ trop-ay' from an apparently primary τρέπω TRE/PW trépō to turn; a turn ("trope"), i.e. revolution (figuratively, variation):--turning.
entries.5158: τρόπος TRO/POS trópos trop'-os from the same as G5157; a turn, i.e. (by implication) mode or style (especially with preposition or relative prefix as adverb, like); figuratively, deportment or character:--(even) as, conversation, (+ like) manner, (+ by any) means, way.
entries.5159: τροποφορέω TROPOFORE/W tropophoréō trop-of-or-eh'-o from G5158 and G5409; to endure one's habits:--suffer the manners.
entries.5160: τροφή TROFH/ trophḗ trof-ay' from G5142; nourishment (literally or figuratively); by implication, rations (wages):--food, meat.
entries.5161: Τρόφιμος *TRO/FIMOS Tróphimos trof'-ee-mos from G5160; nutritive; Trophimus, a Christian:--Trophimus.
entries.5162: τροφός TROFO/S trophós trof-os' from G5142; a nourisher, i.e. nurse:--nurse.
entries.5163: τροχιά TROXIA/ trochiá trokh-ee-ah' from G5164; a track (as a wheel-rut), i.e. (figuratively) a course of conduct:--path.
entries.5164: τροχός TROXO/S trochós trokh-os' from G5143; a wheel (as a runner), i.e. (figuratively) a circuit of physical effects:--course.
entries.5165: τρύβλιον TRU/BLION trýblion troob'-lee-on neuter of a presumed derivative of uncertain affinity; a bowl:--dish.
entries.5166: τρυγάω TRUGA/W trygáō troo-gah'-o from a derivative of τρύγω TRU/GW trýgō (to dry) meaning ripe fruit (as if dry); to collect the vintage:--gather.
entries.5167: τρυγών TRUGW/N trygṓn troo-gone' from τρύζω TRU/ZW trýzō (to murmur; akin to G5149, but denoting a duller sound); a turtle-dove (as cooing):--turtle-dove.
entries.5168: τρυμαλιά TRUMALIA/ trymaliá troo-mal-ee-ah' from a derivative of τρύω TRU/W trýō (to wear away; akin to the base of G5134, G5147 and G5176); an orifice, i.e. needle's eye:--eye. Compare G5169.
entries.5169: τρύπημα TRU/PHMA trýpēma troo'-pay-mah from a derivative of the base of G5168; an aperture, i.e. a needle's eye:--eye.
entries.5170: Τρύφαινα *TRU/FAINA Trýphaina troo'-fahee-nah from G5172; luxurious; Tryphæna, a Christian woman:--Tryphena.
entries.5171: τρυφάω TRUFA/W trypháō troo-fah'-o from G5172; to indulge in luxury:--live in pleasure.
entries.5172: τρυφή TRUFH/ tryphḗ troo-fay' from θρύπτω QRU/PTW thrýptō (to break up or (figuratively) enfeeble, especially the mind and body by indulgence); effeminacy, i.e. luxury or debauchery:--delicately, riot.
entries.5173: Τρυφῶσα *TRUFW=SA Tryphōsa troo-fo'-sah from G5172; luxuriating; Tryphosa, a Christian female:--Tryphosa.
entries.5174: Τρωάς *TRWA/S Trōás tro-as' from Τρός *TRO/S Trós (a Trojan); the Troad (or plain of Troy), i.e. Troas, a place in Asia Minor:--Troas.
entries.5175: Τρωγύλλιον *TRWGU/LLION Trōgýllion tro-gool'-lee-on of uncertain derivation; Trogyllium, a place in Asia Minor:--Trogyllium.
entries.5176: τρώγω TRW/GW trṓgō tro'-go probably strengthened from a collateral form of the base of G5134 and G5147 through the idea of corrosion or wear; or perhaps rather of a base of G5167 and G5149 through the idea of a craunching sound; to gnaw or chew, i.e. (generally) to eat:--eat.
entries.5177: τυγχάνω TUGXA/NW tynchánō toong-khan'-o probably for an obsolete τύχω TU/XW týchō (for which the middle voice of another alternate τεύχω TEU/XW teúchō (to make ready or bring to pass) is used in certain tenses; akin to the base of G5088 through the idea of effecting; properly, to affect; or (specially), to hit or light upon (as a mark to be reached), i.e. (transitively) to attain or secure an object or end, or (intransitively) to happen (as if meeting with); but in the latter application only impersonal (with G1487), i.e. perchance; or (present participle) as adjective, usual (as if commonly met with, with G3756, extraordinary), neuter (as adverb) perhaps; or (with another verb) as adverb, by accident (as it were):--be, chance, enjoy, little, obtain, X refresh…self, + special. Compare G5180.
entries.5178: τυμπανίζω TUMPANI/ZW tympanízō toom-pan-id'-zo from a derivative of G5180 (meaning a drum, "tympanum"); to stretch on an instrument of torture resembling a drum, and thus beat to death:--torture.
entries.5179: τύπος TU/POS týpos too'-pos from G5180; a die (as struck), i.e. (by implication) a stamp or scar; by analogy, a shape, i.e. a statue, (figuratively) style or resemblance; specially, a sampler ("type"), i.e. a model (for imitation) or instance (for warning):--en-(ex-)ample, fashion, figure, form, manner, pattern, print.
entries.5180: τύπτω TU/PTW týptō toop'-to a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to "thump", i.e. cudgel or pummel (properly, with a stick or bastinado), but in any case by repeated blows; thus differing from G3817 and G3960, which denote a (usually single) blow with the hand or any instrument, or G4141 with the fist (or a hammer), or G4474 with the palm; as well as from G5177, an accidental collision); by implication, to punish; figuratively, to offend (the conscience):--beat, smite, strike, wound.
entries.5181: Τύραννος *TU/RANNOS Týrannos too'-ran-nos a provincial form of the derivative of the base of G2962; a "tyrant"; Tyrannus, an Ephesian:--Tyrannus.
entries.5182: τυρβάζω TURBA/ZW tyrbázō toor-bad'-zo from τύρβη TU/RBH týrbē (Latin turba, a crowd; akin to G2351); to make "turbid", i.e. disturb:--trouble.
entries.5183: Τύριος *TU/RIOS Týrios too'-ree-os from G5184; a Tyrian, i.e. inhabitant of Tyrus:--of Tyre.
entries.5184: Τύρος *TU/ROS Týros too'-ros of Hebrew origin (H06865): Tyrus (i.e. Tsor), a place in Palestine :--Tyre.
entries.5185: τυφλός TUFLO/S typhlós toof-los' from, G5187; opaque (as if smoky), i.e. (by analogy) blind (physically or mentally):--blind.
entries.5186: τυφλόω TUFLO/W typhlóō toof-lo'-o from G5185; to make blind, i.e. (figuratively) to obscure:--blind.
entries.5187: τυφόω TUFO/W typhóō toof-o'-o from a derivative of G5188; to envelop with smoke, i.e. (figuratively) to inflate with self-conceit:--high-minded, be lifted up with pride, be proud.
entries.5188: τύφω TU/FW týphō too'-fo apparently a primary verb; to make a smoke, i.e. slowly consume without flame:--smoke.
entries.5189: τυφωνικός TUFWNIKO/S typhōnikós too-fo-nee-kos' from a derivative of G5188; stormy (as if smoky):--tempestuous.
entries.5190: Τυχικός *TUXIKO/S Tychikós too-khee-kos' from a derivative of G5177; fortuitous, i.e. fortunate; Tychicus, a Christian:--Tychicus.
entries.5191: ὑακίνθινος U(AKI/NQINOS hyakínthinos hoo-ak-in'-thee-nos from G5192; "hyacinthine" or "jacinthine", i.e. deep blue:--jacinth.
entries.5192: ὑάκινθος U(A/KINQOS hyákinthos hoo-ak'-in-thos of uncertain derivation; the "hyacinth" or "jacinth", i.e. some gem of a deep blue color, probably the zirkon:-- jacinth.
entries.5193: ὑάλινος U(A/LINOS hyálinos hoo-al'-ee-nos from G5194; glassy, i.e. transparent:--of glass.
entries.5194: ὕαλος U(/ALOS hýalos hoo'-al-os perhaps from the same as G5205 (as being transparent like rain); glass:--glass.
entries.5195: ὑβρίζω U(BRI/ZW hybrízō hoo-brid'-zo from G5196; to exercise violence, i.e. abuse:--use despitefully, reproach, entreat shamefully (spitefully).
entries.5196: ὕβρις U(/BRIS hýbris hoo'-bris from G5228; insolence (as over-bearing), i.e. insult, injury:--harm, hurt, reproach.
entries.5197: ὑβριστής U(BRISTH/S hybristḗs hoo-bris-tace' from G5195; an insulter, i.e. maltreater:--despiteful, injurious.
entries.5198: ὑγιαίνω U(GIAI/NW hygiaínō hoog-ee-ah'-ee-no from G5199; to have sound health, i.e. be well (in body); figuratively, to be uncorrupt (true in doctrine):--be in health, (be safe and) sound, (be) whole(-some).
entries.5199: ὑγιής U(GIH/S hygiḗs hoog-ee-ace' from the base of G837; healthy, i.e. well (in body); figuratively, true (in doctrine):--sound, whole.
entries.5200: ὑγρός U(GRO/S hygrós hoo-gros' from the base of G5205; wet (as if with rain), i.e. (by implication) sappy (fresh):--green.
entries.5201: ὑδρία U(DRI/A hydría hoo-dree-ah' from G5204; a water-jar, i.e. receptacle for family supply:--water-pot.
