entries.5202: ὑδροποτέω U(DROPOTE/W hydropotéō hoo-drop-ot-eh'-o from a compound of G5204 and a derivative of G4095; to be a water-drinker, i.e. to abstain from vinous beverages:--drink water.
entries.5203: ὑδρωπικός U(DRWPIKO/S hydrōpikós hoo-dro-pik-os' from a compound of G5204 and a derivative of G3700 (as if looking watery); to be "dropsical":--have the dropsy.
entries.5204: ὕδωρ U(/DWR hýdōr hoo'-dore , and genitive case, ὕδατος U(/DATOS hýdatos hoo'-dat-os , etc. from the base of G5205; water (as if rainy) literally or figuratively:--water.
entries.5205: ὑετός U(ETO/S hyetós hoo-et-os' from a primary ὕω U(/W hýō (to rain); rain, especially a shower:--rain.
entries.5206: υἱοθεσία UI(OQESI/A huiothesía hwee-oth-es-ee'-ah from a presumed compound of G5207 and a derivative of G5087; the placing as a son, i.e. adoption (figuratively, Christian sonship in respect to God):--adoption (of children, of sons).
entries.5207: υἱός UI(O/S huiós hwee-os' apparently a primary word; a "son" (sometimes of animals), used very widely of immediate, remote or figuratively, kinship:--child, foal, son.
entries.5208: ὕλη U(/LH hýlē hoo-lay' perhaps akin to G3586; a forest, i.e. (by implication) fuel:--matter.
entries.5209: ὑμᾶς U(MA=S hymâs hoo-mas' accusative case of G5210; you (as the objective of a verb or preposition):--ye, you (+ -ward), your (+ own).
entries.5210: ὑμεῖς U(MEI=S hymeîs hoo-mice' irregular plural of G4771; you (as subjective of verb):--ye (yourselves), you.
entries.5211: Ὑμεναῖος *(UMENAI=OS Hymenaîos hoo-men-ah'-yos from Ὑμήν *(UMH/N Hymḗn (the god of weddings); "hymenæal"; Hymenæus, an opponent of Christianity:--Hymenæus.
entries.5212: ὑμέτερος U(ME/TEROS hyméteros hoo-met'-er-os from G5210; yours, i.e. pertaining to you:--your (own).
entries.5213: ὑμῖν U(MI=N hymîn hoo-min' irregular dative case of G5210; to (with or by) you:--ye, you, your(-selves).
entries.5214: ὑμνέω U(MNE/W hymnéō hoom-neh'-o from G5215; to hymn, i.e. sing a religious ode; by implication, to celebrate (God) in song:--sing a hymn (praise unto).
entries.5215: ὕμνος U(/MNOS hýmnos hoom'-nos apparently from a simpler (obsolete) form of ὑδέω U(DE/W hydéō (to celebrate; probably akin to G103; compare H05667); a "hymn" or religious ode (one of the Psalms):--hymn.
entries.5216: ὑμῶν U(MW=N hymōn hoo-mone' genitive case of G5210; of (from or concerning) you:--ye, you, your (own, -selves).
entries.5217: ὑπάγω U(PA/GW hypágō hoop-ag'-o from G5259 and G71; to lead (oneself) under, i.e. withdraw or retire (as if sinking out of sight), literally or figuratively:--depart, get hence, go (a-)way.
entries.5218: ὑπακοή U(PAKOH/ hypakoḗ hoop-ak-o-ay' from G5219; attentive hearkening, i.e. (by implication) compliance or submission:--obedience, (make) obedient, obey(-ing).
entries.5219: ὑπακούω U(PAKOU/W hypakoúō hoop-ak-oo'-o from G5259 and G191; to hear under (as a subordinate), i.e. to listen attentively; by implication, to heed or conform to a command or authority:--hearken, be obedient to, obey.
entries.5220: ὕπανδρος U(/PANDROS hýpandros hoop'-an-dros from G5259 and G435; in subjection under a man, i.e. a married woman:--which hath an husband.
entries.5221: ὑπαντάω U(PANTA/W hypantáō hoop-an-tah'-o from G5259 and a derivative of G473; to go opposite (meet) under (quietly), i.e. to encounter, fall in with:--(go to) meet.
entries.5222: ὑπάντησις U(PA/NTHSIS hypántēsis hoop-an'-tay-sis from G5221; an encounter or concurrence (with G1519 for infinitive, in order to fall in with):--meeting.
entries.5223: ὕπαρξις U(/PARCIS hýparxis hoop'-arx-is from G5225; existency or proprietorship, i.e. (concretely) property, wealth:--goods, substance.
entries.5224: ὑπάρχοντα U(PA/RXONTA hypárchonta hoop-ar'-khon-tah neuter plural of present participle active of G5225 as noun; things extant or in hand, i.e. property or possessions:--goods, that which one has, things which (one) possesseth, substance, that hast.
entries.5225: ὑπάρχω U(PA/RXW hypárchō hoop-ar'-kho from G5259 and G756; to begin under (quietly), i.e. come into existence (be present or at hand); expletively, to exist (as copula or subordinate to an adjective, participle, adverb or preposition, or as an auxiliary to a principal (verb):--after, behave, live.
entries.5226: ὑπείκω U(PEI/KW hypeíkō hoop-i'-ko from G5259 and εἴκω EI)/KW eíkō (to yield, be "weak"); to surrender:--submit self.
entries.5227: ὑπεναντίος U(PENANTI/OS hypenantíos hoop-en-an-tee'-os from G5259 and G1727; under (covertly) contrary to, i.e. opposed or (as noun) an opponent:--adversary, against.
entries.5228: ὑπέρ U(PE/R hypér hoop-er' a primary preposition; "over", i.e. (with the genitive case) of place, above, beyond, across, or causal, for the sake of, instead, regarding; with the accusative case superior to, more than:--(+ exceeding, abundantly) above, in (on) behalf of, beyond, by, + very chiefest, concerning, exceeding (above, -ly), for, + very highly, more (than), of, over, on the part of, for sake of, in stead, than, to(-ward), very. In the compounds, it retains many of the above applications.
entries.5229: ὑπεραίρομαι U(PERAI/ROMAI hyperaíromai hoop-er-ah'-ee-rom-ahee middle voice from G5228 and G142; to raise oneself over, i.e. (figuratively) to become haughty:--exalt self, be exalted above measure.
entries.5230: ὑπέρακμος U(PE/RAKMOS hypérakmos hoop-er'-ak-mos from G5228 and the base of G188; beyond the "acme", i.e. figuratively (of a daughter) past the bloom (prime) of youth:--+ pass the flower of (her) age.
entries.5231: ὑπεράνω U(PERA/NW hyperánō hoop-er-an'-o from G5228 and G507; above upward, i.e. greatly higher (in place or rank):--far above, over.
entries.5232: ὑπεραυξάνω U(PERAUCA/NW hyperauxánō hoop-er-owx-an'-o from G5228 and G837; to increase above ordinary degree:--grow exceedingly.
entries.5233: ὑπερβαίνω U(PERBAI/NW hyperbaínō hoop-er-bah'-ee-no from G5228 and the base of G939; to transcend, i.e. (figuratively) to overreach:--go beyond.
entries.5234: ὑπερβαλλόντως U(PERBALLO/NTWS hyperballóntōs hoop-er-bal-lon'-toce adverb from present participle active of G5235; excessively:--beyond measure.
entries.5235: ὑπερβάλλω U(PERBA/LLW hyperbállō hoop-er-bal'-lo from G5228 and G906; to throw beyod the usual mark, i.e. (figuratively) to surpass (only active participle supereminent):--exceeding, excel, pass.
entries.5236: ὑπερβολή U(PERBOLH/ hyperbolḗ hoop-er-bol-ay' from G5235; a throwing beyond others, i.e. (figuratively) supereminence; adverbially (with G1519 or G2596) pre- eminently:--abundance, (far more) exceeding, excellency, more excellent, beyond (out of) measure.
entries.5237: ὑπερείδω U(PEREI/DW hypereídō hoop-er-i'-do from G5228 and G1492; to overlook, i.e. not punish:--wink at.
entries.5238: ὑπερέκεινα U(PERE/KEINA hyperékeina hoop-er-ek'-i-nah from G5228 and the neuter plural of G1565; above those parts, i.e. still farther:--beyond.
entries.5239: ὑπερεκτείνω U(PEREKTEI/NW hyperekteínō hoop-er-ek-ti'-no from G5228 and G1614; to extend inordinately:--stretch beyond.
entries.5240: ὑπερεκχύνω U(PEREKXU/NW hyperekchýnō hoop-er-ek-khoo'-no from G5228 and the alternate form of G1632; to pour out over, i.e. (passively) to overflow:--run over.
entries.5241: ὑπερεντυγχάνω U(PERENTUGXA/NW hyperentynchánō hoop-er-en-toong-khan'-o from G5228 and G1793; to intercede in behalf of:--make intercession for.
entries.5242: ὑπερέχω U(PERE/XW hyperéchō hoop-er-ekh'-o from G5228 and G2192; to hold oneself above, i.e. (figuratively) to excel; participle (as adjective, or neuter as noun) superior, superiority:--better, excellency, higher, pass, supreme.
entries.5243: ὑπερηφανία U(PERHFANI/A hyperēphanía hoop-er-ay-fan-ee'-ah from G5244; haughtiness:--pride.
entries.5244: ὑπερήφανος U(PERH/FANOS hyperḗphanos hoop-er-ay'-fan-os from G5228 and G5316; appearing above others (conspicuous), i.e. (figuratively) haughty:--proud.
entries.5245: ὑπερνικάω U(PERNIKA/W hypernikáō hoop-er-nik-ah'-o from G5228 and G3528; to vanquish beyond, i.e. gain a decisive victory:--more than conquer.
entries.5246: ὑπέρογκος U(PE/ROGKOS hypéronkos hoop-er'-ong-kos from G5228 and G3591; bulging over, i.e. (figuratively) insolent:--great swelling.
entries.5247: ὑπεροχή U(PEROXH/ hyperochḗ hoop-er-okh-ay' from G5242; prominence, i.e. (figuratively) superiority (in rank or character):--authority, excellency.
entries.5248: ὑπερπερισσεύω U(PERPERISSEU/W hyperperisseúō hoop-er-per-is-syoo'-o from G5228 and G4052; to super-abound:--abound much more, exceeding.
entries.5249: ὑπερπερισσῶς U(PERPERISSW=S hyperperissōs hoop-er-per-is-soce' from G5228 and G4057; superabundantly, i.e. exceedingly:--beyond measure.
entries.5250: ὑπερπλεονάζω U(PERPLEONA/ZW hyperpleonázō hoop-er-pleh-on-ad'-zo from G5228 and G4121; to superabound:--be exceeding abundant.
entries.5251: ὑπερυψόω U(PERUYO/W hyperypsóō hoop-er-oop-so'-o from G5228 and G5312; to elevate above others, i.e. raise to the highest position:--highly exalt.
entries.5252: ὑπερφρονέω U(PERFRONE/W hyperphronéō hoop-er-fron-eh'-o from G5228 and G5426; to esteem oneself overmuch, i.e. be vain or arrogant:--think more highly.
entries.5253: ὑπερῷον U(PERW=|ON hyperōion hoop-er-o'-on neuter of a derivative of G5228; a higher part of the house, i.e. apartment in the third story:--upper chamber (room).
entries.5254: ὑπέχω U(PE/XW hypéchō hoop-ekh'-o from G5259 and G2192; to hold oneself under, i.e. endure with patience:--suffer.
entries.5255: ὑπήκοος U(PH/KOOS hypḗkoos hoop-ay'-ko-os from G5219; attentively listening, i.e. (by implication) submissive:--obedient.
entries.5256: ὑπηρετέω U(PHRETE/W hypēretéō hoop-ay-ret-eh'-o from G5257; to be a subordinate, i.e. (by implication) subserve:--minister (unto), serve.
entries.5257: ὑπηρέτης U(PHRE/THS hypērétēs hoop-ay-ret'-ace from G5259 and a derivative of ἐρέσσω E)RE/SSW eréssō (to row); an under-oarsman, i.e. (generally) subordinate (assistant, sexton, constable):--minister, officer, servant.
entries.5258: ὕπνος U(/PNOS hýpnos hoop'-nos from an obsolete primary (perhaps akin to G5259 through the idea of subsilience); sleep, i.e. (figuratively) spiritual torpor:--sleep.
entries.5259: ὑπό U(PO/ hypó hoop-o' a primary preposition; under, i.e. (with the genitive case) of place (beneath), or with verbs (the agency or means, through); (with the accusative case) of place (whither (underneath) or where (below) or time (when (at)):--among, by, from, in, of, under, with. In the compounds, it retains the same general applications, especially of inferior position or condition, and specially, covertly or moderately.
entries.5260: ὑποβάλλω U(POBA/LLW hypobállō hoop-ob-al'-lo from G5259 and G906; to throw in stealthily, i.e. introduce by collusion:--suborn.
entries.5261: ὑπογραμμός U(POGRAMMO/S hypogrammós hoop-og-ram-mos' from a compound of G5259 and G1125; an underwriting, i.e. copy for imitation (figuratively):--example.
entries.5262: ὑπόδειγμα U(PO/DEIGMA hypódeigma hoop-od'-igue-mah from G5263; an exhibit for imitation or warning (figuratively, specimen, adumbration):--en-(ex-)ample, pattern.
entries.5263: ὑποδείκνυμι U(PODEI/KNUMI hypodeíknymi hoop-od-ike'-noo-mee from G5259 and G1166; to exhibit under the eyes, i.e. (figuratively) to exemplify (instruct, admonish):--show, (fore-)warn.
entries.5264: ὑποδέχομαι U(PODE/XOMAI hypodéchomai hoop-od-ekh'-om-ahee from G5259 and G1209; to admit under one's roof, i.e. entertain hospitably:--receive.
entries.5265: ὑποδέω U(PODE/W hypodéō hoop-od-eh'-o from G5259 and G1210; to bind under one's feet, i.e. put on shoes or sandals:--bind on, (be) shod.
entries.5266: ὑπόδημα U(PO/DHMA hypódēma hoop-od'-ay-mah from G5265; something bound under the feet, i.e. a shoe or sandal:--shoe.
entries.5267: ὑπόδικος U(PO/DIKOS hypódikos hoop-od'-ee-kos from G5259 and G1349; under sentence, i.e. (by implication) condemned:--guilty.
entries.5268: ὑποζύγιον U(POZU/GION hypozýgion hoop-od-zoog'-ee-on neuter of a compound of G5259 and G2218; an animal under the yoke (draught-beast), i.e. (specially), a donkey:--ass.
entries.5269: ὑποζώννυμι U(POZW/NNUMI hypozṓnnymi hoop-od-zone'-noo-mee from G5259 and G2224; to gird under, i.e. frap (a vessel with cables across the keel, sides and deck):--undergirt.
entries.5270: ὑποκάτω U(POKA/TW hypokátō hoop-ok-at'-o from G5259 and G2736; down under, i.e. beneath:--under.
entries.5271: ὑποκρίνομαι U(POKRI/NOMAI hypokrínomai hoop-ok-rin'-om-ahee middle voice from G5259 and G2919; to decide (speak or act) under a false part, i.e. (figuratively) dissemble (pretend):--feign.
entries.5272: ὑπόκρισις U(PO/KRISIS hypókrisis hoop-ok'-ree-sis from G5271; acting under a feigned part, i.e. (figuratively) deceit ("hypocrisy"):--condemnation, dissimulation, hypocrisy.
entries.5273: ὑποκριτής U(POKRITH/S hypokritḗs hoop-ok-ree-tace' from G5271; an actor under an assumed character (stage-player), i.e. (figuratively) a dissembler ("hypocrite":--hypocrite.
entries.5274: ὑπολαμβάνω U(POLAMBA/NW hypolambánō hoop-ol-am-ban'-o from G5259 and G2983; to take from below, i.e. carry upward; figuratively, to take up, i.e. continue a discourse or topic; mentally, to assume (presume):--answer, receive, suppose.
entries.5275: ὑπολείπω U(POLEI/PW hypoleípō hoop-ol-i'-po from G5295 and G3007; to leave under (behind), i.e. (passively) to remain (survive):--be left.
entries.5276: ὑπολήνιον U(POLH/NION hypolḗnion hoop-ol-ay'-nee-on neuter of a presumed compound of G5259 and G3025; vessel or receptacle under the press, i.e. lower wine-vat:--winefat.
entries.5277: ὑπολιμπάνω U(POLIMPA/NW hypolimpánō hoop-ol-im-pan'-o a prolonged form for G5275; to leave behind, i.e. bequeath:--leave.
entries.5278: ὑπομένω U(POME/NW hypoménō hoop-om-en'-o from G5259 and G3306; to stay under (behind), i.e. remain; figuratively, to undergo, i.e. bear (trials), have fortitude, persevere:--abide, endure, (take) patient(-ly), suffer, tarry behind.
entries.5279: ὑπομιμνήσκω U(POMIMNH/SKW hypomimnḗskō hoop-om-im-nace'-ko from G5259 and G3403; to remind quietly, i.e. suggest to the (middle voice, one's own) memory:--put in mind, remember, bring to (put in) remembrance.
entries.5280: ὑπόμνησις U(PO/MNHSIS hypómnēsis hoop-om'-nay-sis from G5279; a reminding or (reflexively) recollection:--remembrance.
entries.5281: ὑπομονή U(POMONH/ hypomonḗ hoop-om-on-ay' from G5278; cheerful (or hopeful) endurance, constancy:--enduring, patience, patient continuance (waiting).
entries.5282: ὑπονοέω U(PONOE/W hyponoéō hoop-on-o-eh'-o from G5259 and G3539; to think under (privately), i.e. to surmise or conjecture:--think, suppose, deem.
entries.5283: ὑπόνοια U(PO/NOIA hypónoia hoop-on'-oy-ah from G5282; suspicion:--surmising.
entries.5284: ὑποπλέω U(POPLE/W hypopléō hoop-op-leh'-o from G5259 and G4126; to sail under the lee of:--sail under.
entries.5285: ὑποπνέω U(POPNE/W hypopnéō hoop-op-neh'-o from G5259 and G4154; to breathe gently, i.e. breeze:--blow softly.
entries.5286: ὑποπόδιον U(POPO/DION hypopódion hoop-op-od'-ee-on neuter of a compound of G5259 and G4228; something under the feet, i.e. a foot-rest (figuratively):--footstool.
entries.5287: ὑπόστασις U(PO/STASIS hypóstasis hoop-os'-tas-is from a compound of G5259 and G2476; a setting under (support), i.e. (figuratively) concretely, essence, or abstractly, assurance (objectively or subjectively):--confidence, confident, person, substance.
entries.5288: ὑποστέλλω U(POSTE/LLW hypostéllō hoop-os-tel'-lo from G5259 and G4724; to withhold under (out of sight), i.e. (reflexively) to cower or shrink, (figuratively) to conceal (reserve):--draw (keep) back, shun, withdraw.
entries.5289: ὑποστολή U(POSTOLH/ hypostolḗ hoop-os-tol-ay' from G5288; shrinkage (timidity), i.e. (by implication) apostasy:--draw back.
entries.5290: ὑποστρέφω U(POSTRE/FW hypostréphō hoop-os-tref'-o from G5259 and G4762; to turn under (behind), i.e. to return (literally or figuratively):--come again, return (again, back again), turn back (again).
entries.5291: ὑποστρώννυμι U(POSTRW/NNUMI hypostrṓnnymi hoop-os-trone'-noo-mee from G5259 and G4766; to strew underneath (the feet as a carpet):--spread.
entries.5292: ὑποταγή U(POTAGH/ hypotagḗ hoop-ot-ag-ay' from G5293; subordination:--subjection.
entries.5293: ὑποτάσσω U(POTA/SSW hypotássō hoop-ot-as'-so from G5259 and G5021; to subordinate; reflexively, to obey:--be under obedience (obedient), put under, subdue unto, (be, make) subject (to, unto), be (put) in subjection (to, under), submit self unto.
entries.5294: ὑποτίθημι U(POTI/QHMI hypotíthēmi hoop-ot-ith'-ay-mee from G5259 and G5087; to place underneath, i.e. (figuratively) to hazard, (reflexively) to suggest:--lay down, put in remembrance.
entries.5295: ὑποτρέχω U(POTRE/XW hypotréchō hoop-ot-rekh'-o from G5259 and G5143 (including its alternate); to run under, i.e. (specially), to sail past:--run under.
entries.5296: ὑποτύπωσις U(POTU/PWSIS hypotýpōsis hoop-ot-oop'-o-sis from a compound of G5259 and a derivative of G5179; typification under (after), i.e. (concretely) a sketch (figuratively) for imitation:--form, pattern.
entries.5297: ὑποφέρω U(POFE/RW hypophérō hoop-of-er'-o from G5259 and G5342; to bear from underneath, i.e. (figuratively) to undergo hardship:--bear, endure.
entries.5298: ὑποχωρέω U(POXWRE/W hypochōréō hoop-okh-o-reh'-o from G5259 and G5562; to vacate down, i.e. retire quietly:--go aside, withdraw self.
entries.5299: ὑπωπιάζω U(PWPIA/ZW hypōpiázō hoop-o-pee-ad'-zo from a compound of G5259 and a derivative of G3700; to hit under the eye (buffet or disable an antagonist as a pugilist), i.e. (figuratively) to tease or annoy (into compliance), subdue (one's passions):--keep under, weary.
entries.5300: ὗς U(=S hŷs hoos apparently a primary word; a hog ("swine"):--sow.
entries.5301: ὕσσωπος U(/SSWPOS hýssōpos hoos'-so-pos of foreign origin (H0231); "hyssop":--hyssop.
entries.5302: ὑστερέω U(STERE/W hysteréō hoos-ter-eh'-o from G5306; to be later, i.e. (by implication) to be inferior; generally, to fall short (be deficient):--come behind (short), be destitute, fail, lack, suffer need, (be in) want, be the worse.
entries.5303: ὑστέρημα U(STE/RHMA hystérēma hoos-ter'-ay-mah from G5302; a deficit; specially, poverty:--that which is behind, (that which was) lack(-ing), penury, want.
entries.5304: ὑστέρησις U(STE/RHSIS hystérēsis hoos-ter'-ay-sis from G5302; a falling short, i.e. (specially), penury:--want.
entries.5305: ὕστερον U(/STERON hýsteron hoos'-ter-on neuter of G5306 as adverb; more lately, i.e. eventually:--afterward, (at the) last (of all).
entries.5306: ὕστερος U(/STEROS hýsteros hoos'-ter-os comparative from G5259 (in the sense of behind); later:--latter.
entries.5307: ὑφαντός U(FANTO/S hyphantós hoo-fan-tos' from ὑφαίνω U(FAI/NW hyphaínō to weave; woven, i.e. (perhaps) knitted:--woven.
entries.5308: ὑψηλός U(YHLO/S hypsēlós hoop-say-los' from G5311; lofty (in place or character):--high(-er, -ly) (esteemed).
entries.5309: ὑψηλοφρονέω U(YHLOFRONE/W hypsēlophronéō hoop-say-lo-fron-eh'-o from a compound of G5308 and G5424; to be lofty in mind, i.e. arrogant:--be highminded.
entries.5310: ὕψιστος U(/YISTOS hýpsistos hoop'-sis-tos superlative from the base of G5311; highest, i.e. (masculine singular) the Supreme (God), or (neuter plural) the heavens:--most high, highest.
entries.5311: ὕψος U(/YOS hýpsos hoop'-sos from a derivative of G5228; elevation, i.e. (abstractly) altitude, (specially), the sky, or (figuratively) dignity:--be exalted, height, (on) high.
entries.5312: ὑψόω U(YO/W hypsóō hoop-so'-o from G5311; to elevate (literally or figuratively):--exalt, lift up.
entries.5313: ὕψωμα U(/YWMA hýpsōma hoop'-so-mah from G5312; an elevated place or thing, i.e. (abstractly) altitude, or (by implication) a barrier (figuratively):-- height, high thing.
entries.5314: φάγος FA/GOS phágos fag'-os from G5315; a glutton:--gluttonous.
entries.5315: φάγω FA/GW phágō fag'-o a primary verb (used as an alternate of G2068 in certain tenses); to eat (literally or figuratively):--eat, meat.
entries.5316: φαίνω FAI/NW phaínō fah'-ee-no prolongation for the base of G5457; to lighten (shine), i.e. show (transitive or intransitive, literal or figurative):-- appear, seem, be seen, shine, X think.
entries.5317: Φάλεκ *FA/LEK Phálek fal'-ek of Hebrew origin (H06389); Phalek (i.e. Peleg), a patriarch:--Phalec.
entries.5318: φανερός FANERO/S phanerós fan-er-os' from G5316; shining, i.e. apparent (literally or figuratively); neuter (as adverb) publicly, externally:--abroad, + appear, known, manifest, open (+ -ly), outward (+ -ly).
entries.5319: φανερόω FANERO/W phaneróō fan-er-o'-o from G5318; to render apparent (literally or figuratively):--appear, manifestly declare, (make) manifest (forth), shew (self).
entries.5320: φανερῶς FANERW=S phanerōs fan-er-oce' adverb from G5318; plainly, i.e. clearly or publicly:--evidently, openly.
entries.5321: φανέρωσις FANE/RWSIS phanérōsis fan-er'-o-sis from G5319; exhibition, i.e. (figuratively) expression, (by extension) a bestowment:--manifestation.
entries.5322: φανός FANO/S phanós fan-os' from G5316; a lightener, i.e. light; lantern:--lantern.
entries.5323: Φανουήλ *FANOUH/L Phanouḗl fan-oo-ale' of Hebrew origin (H06439); Phanuel (i.e. Penuel), an Israelite:--Phanuel.
entries.5324: φαντάζω FANTA/ZW phantázō fan-tad'-zo from a derivative of G5316; to make apparent, i.e. (passively) to appear (neuter participle as noun, a spectacle):--sight.
entries.5325: φαντασία FANTASI/A phantasía fan-tas-ee'-ah from a derivative of G5324; (properly abstract) a (vain) show ("fantasy"):--pomp.
entries.5326: φάντασμα FA/NTASMA phántasma fan'-tas-mah from G5324; (properly concrete) a (mere) show ("phantasm"), i.e. spectre:--spirit.
entries.5327: φάραγξ FA/RAGC pháranx far'-anx properly, strengthened from the base of G4008 or rather of G4486; a gap or chasm, i.e. ravine (winter-torrent):--valley.
entries.5328: Φαραώ *FARAW/ Pharaṓ far-ah-o' of foreign origin (H06547); Pharao (i.e. Pharoh), an Egyptian king:--Pharaoh.
entries.5329: Φάρες *FA/RES Pháres far-es' of Hebrew origin (H06557); Phares (i.e. Perets), an Israelite:--Phares.
entries.5330: Φαρισαῖος *FARISAI=OS Pharisaîos far-is-ah'-yos of Hebrew origin (compare H06567); a separatist, i.e. exclusively religious; a Pharisean, i.e. Jewish sectary:--Pharisee.
entries.5331: φαρμακεία FARMAKEI/A pharmakeía far-mak-i'-ah from G5332; medication ("pharmacy"), i.e. (by extension) magic (literally or figuratively):--sorcery, witchcraft.
entries.5332: φαρμακεύς FARMAKEU/S pharmakeús far-mak-yoos' from φάρμακον FA/RMAKON phármakon (a drug, i.e. spell-giving potion); a druggist ("pharmacist") or poisoner, i.e. (by extension) a magician:--sorcerer.
entries.5333: φάρμακος FA/RMAKOS phármakos far-mak-os' the same as 5332 :--sorcerer.
entries.5334: φάσις FA/SIS phásis fas'-is from G5346 (not the same as "phase", which is from G5316); a saying, i.e. report:--tidings.
entries.5335: φάσκω FA/SKW pháskō fas'-ko prolongation from the same as G5346; to assert:--affirm, profess, say.
entries.5336: φάτνη FA/TNH phátnē fat'-nay from πατέομαι PATE/OMAI patéomai (to eat); a crib (for fodder):--manager, stall.
entries.5337: φαῦλος FAU=LOS phaûlos fow'-los apparently a primary word; "foul" or "flawy", i.e. (figuratively) wicked:--evil.
entries.5338: φέγγος FE/GGOS phéngos feng'-gos probably akin to the base of G5457 (compare G5350); brilliancy:--light.
entries.5339: φείδομαι FEI/DOMAI pheídomai fi'-dom-ahee of uncertain affinity; to be chary of, i.e. (subjectively) to abstain or (objectively) to treat leniently:--forbear, spare.
entries.5340: φειδομένως FEIDOME/NWS pheidoménōs fi-dom-en'-oce adverb from participle of G5339; abstemiously, i.e. stingily:--sparingly.
entries.5341: φελόνης FELO/NHS phelónēs fel-on'-ace by transposition for a derivative probably of G5316 (as showing outside the other garments); a mantle (surtout):-- cloke.
entries.5342: φέρω FE/RW phérō fer'-o a primary verb (for which other, and apparently not cognate ones are used in certain tenses only; namely, οἴω OI)/W oíō oy'-o ; and ἐνέγκω E)NE/GKW enénkō en-eng'-ko ; to "bear" or carry (in a very wide application, literally and figuratively, as follows):--be, bear, bring (forth), carry, come, + let her drive, be driven, endure, go on, lay, lead, move, reach, rushing, uphold.
entries.5343: φεύγω FEU/GW pheúgō fyoo'-go apparently a primary verb; to run away (literally or figuratively); by implication, to shun; by analogy, to vanish:--escape, flee (away).
entries.5344: Φῆλιξ *FH=LIC Phēlix fay'-lix of Latin origin; happy; Phelix (i.e. Felix), a Roman:--Felix.
entries.5345: φήμη FH/MH phḗmē fay'-may from G5346; a saying, i.e. rumor ("fame"):--fame.
entries.5346: φημί FHMI/ phēmí fay-mee' properly, the same as the base of G5457 and G5316; to show or make known one's thoughts, i.e. speak or say:--affirm, say. Compare G3004.
entries.5347: Φῆστος *FH=STOS Phēstos face'-tos of Latin derivation; festal; Phestus (i.e. Festus), a Roman:--Festus.
entries.5348: φθάνω FQA/NW phthánō fthan'-o apparently a primary verb; to be beforehand, i.e. anticipate or precede; by extension, to have arrived at:--(already) attain, come, prevent.
entries.5349: φθαρτός FQARTO/S phthartós fthar-tos' from G5351; decayed, i.e. (by implication) perishable:--corruptible.
entries.5350: φθέγγομαι FQE/GGOMAI phthéngomai ftheng'-gom-ahee probably akin to G5338 and thus to G5346; to utter a clear sound, i.e. (generally) to proclaim:--speak.
entries.5351: φθείρω FQEI/RW phtheírō fthi'-ro probably strengthened from φθίω FQI/W phthíō (to pine or waste); properly, to shrivel or wither, i.e. to spoil (by any process) or (generally) to ruin (especially figuratively, by moral influences, to deprave):--corrupt (self), defile, destroy.
entries.5352: φθινοπωρινός FQINOPWRINO/S phthinopōrinós fthin-op-o-ree-nos' from derivative of φθίνω FQI/NW phthínō (to wane; akin to the base of G5351) and G3703 (meaning late autumn); autumnal (as stripped of leaves):--whose fruit withereth.
entries.5353: φθόγγος FQO/GGOS phthóngos ftong'-gos from G5350; utterance, i.e. a musical note (vocal or instrumental):--sound.
entries.5354: φθονέω FQONE/W phthonéō fthon-eh'-o from G5355; to be jealous of:--envy.
entries.5355: φθόνος FQO/NOS phthónos fthon'-os probably akin to the base of G5351; ill-will (as detraction), i.e. jealousy (spite):--envy.
entries.5356: φθορά FQORA/ phthorá fthor-ah' from G5351; decay, i.e. ruin (spontaneous or inflicted, literally or figuratively):--corruption, destroy, perish.
entries.5357: φιάλη FIA/LH phiálē fee-al'-ay of uncertain affinity; a broad shallow cup ("phial"):--vial.
entries.5358: φιλάγαθος FILA/GAQOS philágathos fil-ag'-ath-os from G5384 and G18; fond to good, i.e. a promoter of virtue:--love of good men.
entries.5359: Φιλαδέλφεια *FILADE/LFEIA Philadélpheia fil-ad-el'-fee-ah from Φιλάδελφος *FILA/DELFOS Philádelphos (the same as G5361), a king of Pergamos; Philadelphia, a place in Asia Minor:--Philadelphia.
entries.5360: φιλαδελφία FILADELFI/A philadelphía fil-ad-el-fee'-ah from G5361; fraternal affection:--brotherly love (kindness), love of the brethren.
entries.5361: φιλάδελφος FILA/DELFOS philádelphos fil-ad'-el-fos from G5384 and G80; fond of brethren, i.e. fraternal:--love as brethren.
entries.5362: φίλανδρος FI/LANDROS phílandros fil'-an-dros from G5384 and G435; fond of man, i.e. affectionate as a wife:--love their husbands.
entries.5363: φιλανθρωπία FILANQRWPI/A philanthrōpía fil-an-thro-pee'-ah from the same as G5364; fondness of mankind, i.e. benevolence ("philanthropy"):--kindness, love towards man.
entries.5364: φιλανθρώπως FILANQRW/PWS philanthrṓpōs fil-an-thro'-poce adverb from a compound of G5384 and G444; fondly to man ("philanthropically"), i.e. humanely:--courteously.
entries.5365: φιλαργυρία FILARGURI/A philargyría fil-ar-goo-ree'-ah from G5366; avarice:--love of money.
entries.5366: φιλάργυρος FILA/RGUROS philárgyros fil-ar'-goo-ros from G5384 and G696; fond of silver (money), i.e. avaricious:--covetous.
entries.5367: φίλαυτος FI/LAUTOS phílautos fil'-ow-tos from G5384 and G846; fond of self, i.e. selfish:--lover of own self.
entries.5368: φιλέω FILE/W philéō fil-eh'-o from G5384; to be a friend to (fond of (an individual or an object)), i.e. have affection for (denoting personal attachment, as a matter of sentiment or feeling; while G25 is wider, embracing especially the judgment and the deliberate assent of the will as a matter of principle, duty and propriety: the two thus stand related very much as G2309 and G1014, or as G2372 and G3563 respectively; the former being chiefly of the heart and the latter of the head); specially, to kiss (as a mark of tenderness):--kiss, love.
entries.5369: φιλήδονος FILH/DONOS philḗdonos fil-ay'-don-os from G5384 and G2237; fond of pleasure, i.e. voluptuous:--lover of pleasure.
entries.5370: φίλημα FI/LHMA phílēma fil'-ay-mah from G5368; a kiss:--kiss.
entries.5371: Φιλήμων *FILH/MWN Philḗmōn fil-ay'-mone from G5368; friendly; Philemon, a Christian:--Philemon.
entries.5372: Φίλητος *FI/LHTOS Phílētos fil-ay-tos' from G5368; amiable; Philetus, an opposer of Christianity:--Philetus.
entries.5373: φιλία FILI/A philía fil-ee'-ah from G5384; fondness:--friendship.
entries.5374: Φιλιππήσιος *FILIPPH/SIOS Philippḗsios fil-ip-pay'-see-os from G5375; a Philippesian (Philippian), i.e. native of Philippi:--Philippian.
entries.5375: Φίλιπποι *FI/LIPPOI Phílippoi fil'-ip-poy plural of G5376; Philippi, a place in Macedonia:--Philippi.
entries.5376: Φίλιππος *FI/LIPPOS Phílippos fil'-ip-pos from G5384 and G2462; fond of horses; Philippus, the name of four Israelites:--Philip.
entries.5377: φιλόθεος FILO/QEOS philótheos fil-oth'-eh-os from G5384 and G2316; fond of God, i.e. pious:--lover of God.
entries.5378: Φιλόλογος *FILO/LOGOS Philólogos fil-ol'-og-os from G5384 and G3056; fond of words, i.e. talkative (argumentative, learned, "philological"); Philologus, a Christian:--Philologus.
entries.5379: φιλονεικία FILONEIKI/A philoneikía fil-on-i-kee'-ah from G5380; quarrelsomeness, i.e. a dispute:--strife.
entries.5380: φιλόνεικος FILO/NEIKOS philóneikos fil-on'-i-kos from G5384 and νεῖκος NEI=KOS neîkos (a quarrel; probably akin to G3534); fond of strife, i.e. disputatious:--contentious.
entries.5381: φιλονεξία FILONECI/A philonexía fil-on-ex-ee'-ah from G5382; hospitableness:--entertain stranger, hospitality.
entries.5382: φιλόξενος FILO/CENOS philóxenos fil-ox'-en-os from G5384 and G3581; fond of guests, i.e. hospitable:--given to (lover of, use) hospitality.
entries.5383: φιλοπρωτεύω FILOPRWTEU/W philoprōteúō fil-op-rote-yoo'-o from a compound of G5384 and G4413; to be fond of being first, i.e. ambitious of distinction:--love to have the preeminence.
entries.5384: φίλος FI/LOS phílos fee'-los properly, dear, i.e. a friend; actively, fond, i.e. friendly (still as a noun, an associate, neighbor, etc.):--friend.
entries.5385: φιλοσοφία FILOSOFI/A philosophía fil-os-of-ee'-ah from G5386; "philosophy", i.e. (specially), Jewish sophistry:--philosophy.
entries.5386: φιλόσοφος FILO/SOFOS philósophos fil-os'-of-os from G5384 and G4680; fond of wise things, i.e. a "philosopher":--philosopher.
entries.5387: φιλόστοργος FILO/STORGOS philóstorgos fil-os'-tor-gos from G5384 and στοργή STORGH/ storgḗ (cherishing one's kindred, especially parents or children); fond of natural relatives, i.e. fraternal towards fellow Christian:--kindly affectioned.
entries.5388: φιλότεκνος FILO/TEKNOS philóteknos fil-ot'-ek-nos from G5384 and G5043; fond of one's children, i.e. maternal:--love their children.
entries.5389: φιλοτιμέομαι FILOTIME/OMAI philotiméomai fil-ot-im-eh'-om-ahee middle voice from a compound of G5384 and G5092; to be fond of honor, i.e. emulous (eager or earnest to do something):--labour, strive, study.
entries.5390: φιλοφρόνως FILOFRO/NWS philophrónōs fil-of-ron'-oce adverb from G5391; with friendliness of mind, i.e. kindly:--courteously.
entries.5391: φιλόφρων FILO/FRWN philóphrōn fil-of'-rone from G5384 and G5424; friendly of mind, i.e. kind:--courteous.
entries.5392: φιμόω FIMO/W phimóō fee-mo'-o from φιμός FIMO/S phimós (a muzzle); to muzzle:--muzzle.
entries.5393: Φλέγων *FLE/GWN Phlégōn fleg'-one active participle of the base of G5395; blazing; Phlegon, a Christian:--Phlegon.
entries.5394: φλογίζω FLOGI/ZW phlogízō flog-id'-zo from G5395; to cause a blaze, i.e. ignite (figuratively, to inflame with passion):--set on fire.
entries.5395: φλόξ FLO/C phlóx flox from a primary φλέγω FLE/GW phlégō (to "flash" or "flame"); a blaze:--flame(-ing).
entries.5396: φλυαρέω FLUARE/W phlyaréō floo-ar-eh'-o from G5397; to be a babbler or trifler, i.e. (by implication) to berate idly or mischievously:--prate against.
entries.5397: φλύαρος FLU/AROS phlýaros floo'-ar-os from φλύω FLU/W phlýō (to bubble); a garrulous person, i.e. prater:--tattler.
entries.5398: φοβερός FOBERO/S phoberós fob-er-os' from G5401; frightful, i.e. (objectively) formidable:--fearful, terrible.
entries.5399: φοβέω FOBE/W phobéō fob-eh'-o from G5401; to frighten, i.e. (passively) to be alarmed; by analogy, to be in awe of, i.e. revere:--be (+ sore) afraid, fear (exceedingly), reverence.
entries.5400: φόβητρον FO/BHTRON phóbētron fob'-ay-tron neuter of a derivative of G5399; a frightening thing, i.e. terrific portent:--fearful sight.
entries.5401: φόβος FO/BOS phóbos fob'-os from a primary φέβομαι FE/BOMAI phébomai (to be put in fear); alarm or fright:--be afraid, + exceedingly, fear, terror.
entries.5402: Φοίβη *FOI/BH Phoíbē foy'-bay feminine of φοῖβος FOI=BOS phoîbos (bright; probably akin to the base of G5457); Phœbe, a Christian woman:--Phebe.
entries.5403: Φοινίκη *FOINI/KH Phoiníkē foy-nee'-kay from G5404; palm-country; Phœnice (or Phœnicia), a region of Palestine:--Phenice, Phenicia.
entries.5404: φοῖνιξ FOI=NIC phoînix foy'-nix of uncertain derivation; a palm-tree:--palm (tree).
entries.5405: Φοῖνιξ *FOI=NIC Phoînix foy'-nix probably the same as G5404; Phœnix, a place in Crete:--Phenice.
entries.5406: φονεύς FONEU/S phoneús fon-yooce' from G5408; a murderer (always of criminal (or at least intentional) homicide; which G443 does not necessarily imply; while G4607 is a special term for a public bandit):--murderer.
entries.5407: φονεύω FONEU/W phoneúō fon-yoo'-o from G5406; to be a murderer (of):--kill, do murder, slay.
entries.5408: φόνος FO/NOS phónos fon'-os from an obsolete primary φένω FE/NW phénō (to slay); murder:--murder, + be slain with, slaughter.
entries.5409: φορέω FORE/W phoréō for-eh'-o from G5411; to have a burden, i.e. (by analogy) to wear as clothing or a constant accompaniment:--bear, wear.
entries.5410: Φόρον *FO/RON Phóron for'-on of Latin origin; a forum or market-place; only in compound with G675; a station on the Appian road:--forum.
entries.5411: φόρος FO/ROS phóros for'-os from G5342; a load (as borne), i.e. (figuratively) a tax (properly, an individual assessment on persons or property; whereas G5056 is usually a general toll on goods or travel):--tribute.
entries.5412: φορτίζω FORTI/ZW phortízō for-tid'-zo from G5414; to load up (properly, as a vessel or animal), i.e. (figuratively) to overburden with ceremony (or spiritual anxiety):--lade, by heavy laden.
entries.5413: φορτίον FORTI/ON phortíon for-tee'-on diminutive of G5414; an invoice (as part of freight), i.e. (figuratively) a task or service:--burden.
entries.5414: φόρτος FO/RTOS phórtos for'-tos from G5342; something carried, i.e. the cargo of a ship:--lading.
entries.5415: Φορτουνᾶτος *FORTOUNA=TOS Phortounâtos for-too-nat'-os of Latin origin; "fortunate"; Fortunatus, a Christian:--Fortunatus.
entries.5416: φραγέλλιον FRAGE/LLION phragéllion frag-el'-le-on neuter of a derivative from the base of G5417; a whip, i.e. Roman lash as a public punishment:--scourge.
entries.5417: φραγελλόω FRAGELLO/W phragellóō frag-el-lo'-o from a presumed equivalent of the Latin flagellum; to whip, i.e. lash as a public punishment:--scourge.
entries.5418: φραγμός FRAGMO/S phragmós frag-mos' from G5420; a fence, or inclosing barrier (literally or figuratively):--hedge (+ round about), partition.
entries.5419: φράζω FRA/ZW phrázō frad'-zo probably akin to G5420 through the idea of defining; to indicate (by word or act), i.e. (specially), to expound:-- declare.
entries.5420: φράσσω FRA/SSW phrássō fras'-so apparently a strengthening form of the base of G5424; to fence or inclose, i.e. (specially), to block up (figuratively, to silence):--stop.
entries.5421: φρέαρ FRE/AR phréar freh'-ar of uncertain derivation; a hole in the ground (dug for obtaining or holding water or other purposes), i.e. a cistern or well; figuratively, an abyss (as a prison):--well, pit.
entries.5422: φρεναπατάω FRENAPATA/W phrenapatáō fren-ap-at-ah'-o from G5423; to be a mind-misleader, i.e. delude:--deceive.
entries.5423: φρεναπάτης FRENAPA/THS phrenapátēs fren-ap-at'-ace from G5424 and G539; a mind-misleader, i.e. seducer:--deceiver.
entries.5424: φρήν FRH/N phrḗn frane probably from an obsolete φράω FRA/W phráō (to rein in or curb; compare G5420); the midrif (as a partition of the body), i.e. (figuratively and by implication, of sympathy) the feelings (or sensitive nature; by extension (also in the plural) the mind or cognitive faculties):--understanding.
entries.5425: φρίσσω FRI/SSW phríssō fris'-so apparently a primary verb; to "bristle" or chill, i.e. shudder (fear):--tremble.
entries.5426: φρονέω FRONE/W phronéō fron-eh'-o from G5424; to exercise the mind, i.e. entertain or have a sentiment or opinion; by implication, to be (mentally) disposed (more or less earnestly in a certain direction); intensively, to interest oneself in (with concern or obedience):--set the affection on, (be) care(-ful), (be like-, + be of one, + be of the same, + let this) mind(-ed), regard, savour, think.
entries.5427: φρόνημα FRO/NHMA phrónēma fron'-ay-mah from G5426; (mental) inclination or purpose:--(be, + be carnally, + be spiritually) mind(-ed).
entries.5428: φρόνησις FRO/NHSIS phrónēsis fron'-ay-sis from G5426; mental action or activity, i.e. intellectual or moral insight:--prudence, wisdom.
entries.5429: φρόνιμος FRO/NIMOS phrónimos fron'-ee-mos from G5424; thoughtful, i.e. sagacious or discreet (implying a cautious character; while G4680 denotes practical skill or acumen; and G4908 indicates rather intelligence or mental acquirement); in a bad sense conceited (also in the comparative):--wise(-r).
entries.5430: φρονίμως FRONI/MWS phronímōs fron-im'-oce adverb from G5429; prudently:--wisely.
entries.5431: φροντίζω FRONTI/ZW phrontízō fron-tid'-zo from a derivative of G5424; to exercise thought, i.e. be anxious:--be careful.
entries.5432: φρουρέω FROURE/W phrouréō froo-reh'-o from a compound of G4253 and G3708; to be a watcher in advance, i.e. to mount guard as a sentinel (post spies at gates); figuratively, to hem in, protect:--keep (with a garrison). Compare G5083.
entries.5433: φρυάσσω FRUA/SSW phryássō froo-as'-so akin to G1032, G1031; to snort (as a spirited horse), i.e. (figuratively) to make a tumult:--rage.
entries.5434: φρύγανον FRU/GANON phrýganon froo'-gan-on neuter of a presumed derivative of φρύγω FRU/GW phrýgō (to roast or parch; akin to the base of G5395); something desiccated, i.e. a dry twig:--stick.
entries.5435: Φρυγία *FRUGI/A Phrygía froog-ee'-ah probably of foreign origin; Phrygia, a region of Asia Minor:--Phrygia.
entries.5436: Φύγελλος *FU/GELLOS Phýgellos foog'-el-los probably from G5343; fugitive; Phygellus, an apostate Christian:--Phygellus.
entries.5437: φυγή FUGH/ phygḗ foog-ay' from G5343; a fleeing, i.e. escape:--flight.
entries.5438: φυλακή FULAKH/ phylakḗ foo-lak-ay' from G5442; a guarding or (concretely, guard), the act, the person; figuratively, the place, the condition, or (specially), the time (as a division of day or night), literally or figuratively:--cage, hold, (im-)prison(-ment), ward, watch.
entries.5439: φυλακίζω FULAKI/ZW phylakízō foo-lak-id'-zo from G5441; to incarcerate:--imprison.
entries.5440: φυλακτήριον FULAKTH/RION phylaktḗrion foo-lak-tay'-ree-on neuter of a derivative of G5442; a guard-case, i.e. "phylactery" for wearing slips of Scripture texts:-- phylactery.
entries.5441: φύλαξ FU/LAC phýlax foo'-lax from G5442; a watcher or sentry:--keeper.
entries.5442: φυλάσσω FULA/SSW phylássō foo-las'-so probably from G5443 through the idea of isolation; to watch, i.e. be on guard (literally of figuratively); by implication, to preserve, obey, avoid:--beward, keep (self), observe, save. Compare G5083.
entries.5443: φυλή FULH/ phylḗ foo-lay' from G5453 (compare G5444); an offshoot, i.e. race or clan:--kindred, tribe.
entries.5444: φύλλον FU/LLON phýllon fool'-lon from the same as G5443; a sprout, i.e. leaf:--leaf.
entries.5445: φύραμα FU/RAMA phýrama foo'-ram-ah from a prolonged form of φύρω FU/RW phýrō (to mix a liquid with a solid; perhaps akin to G5453 through the idea of swelling in bulk), mean to knead; a mass of dough:--lump.
entries.5446: φυσικός FUSIKO/S physikós foo-see-kos' from G5449; "physical", i.e. (by implication) instinctive:--natural. Compare G5591.
entries.5447: φυσικῶς FUSIKW=S physikōs foo-see-koce' adverb from G5446; "physically", i.e. (by implication) instinctively:--naturally.
entries.5448: φυσιόω FUSIO/W physióō foo-see-o'-o from G5449 in the primary sense of blowing; to inflate, i.e. (figuratively) make proud (haughty):--puff up.
entries.5449: φύσις FU/SIS phýsis foo'-sis from G5453; growth (by germination or expansion), i.e. (by implication) natural production (lineal descent); by extension, a genus or sort; figuratively, native disposition, constitution or usage:--(man-)kind, nature(-al).
entries.5450: φυσίωσις FUSI/WSIS physíōsis foo-see'-o-sis from G5448; inflation, i.e. (figuratively) haughtiness:--swelling.
entries.5451: φυτεία FUTEI/A phyteía foo-ti'-ah from G5452; trans-planting, i.e. (concretely) a shrub or vegetable:--plant.
entries.5452: φυτεύω FUTEU/W phyteúō foot-yoo'-o from a derivative of G5453; to set out in the earth, i.e. implant; figuratively, to instil doctrine:--plant.
entries.5453: φύω FU/W phýō foo'-o a primary verb; probably originally, to "puff" or blow, i.e. to swell up; but only used in the implied sense, to germinate or grow (sprout, produce), literally or figuratively:--spring (up).
entries.5454: φωλεός FWLEO/S phōleós fo-leh-os' of uncertain derivative; a burrow or lurking-place:--hole.
entries.5455: φωνέω FWNE/W phōnéō fo-neh'-o from G5456; to emit a sound (animal, human or instrumental); by implication, to address in words or by name, also in imitation:--call (for), crow, cry.
entries.5456: φωνή FWNH/ phōnḗ fo-nay' probably akin to G5316 through the idea of disclosure; a tone (articulate, bestial or artificial); by implication, an address (for any purpose), saying or language:--noise, sound, voice.
entries.5457: φῶς FW=S phōs foce from an obsolete φάω FA/W pháō (to shine or make manifest, especially by rays; compare G5316, G5346); luminousness (in the widest application, natural or artificial, abstract or concrete, literal or figurative):--fire, light.
entries.5458: φωστήρ FWSTH/R phōstḗr foce-tare' from G5457; an illuminator, i.e. (concretely) a luminary, or (abstractly) brilliancy:--light.
entries.5459: φωσφόρος FWSFO/ROS phōsphóros foce-for'-os from G5457 and G5342; light-bearing ("phosphorus"), i.e. (specially), the morning-star (figuratively):--day star.
entries.5460: φωτεινός FWTEINO/S phōteinós fo-ti-nos' from G5457; lustrous, i.e. transparent or well-illuminated (figuratively):--bright, full of light.
entries.5461: φωτίζω FWTI/ZW phōtízō fo-tid'-zo from G5457; to shed rays, i.e. to shine or (transitively) to brighten up (literally or figuratively):--enlighten, illuminate, (bring to, give) light, make to see.
entries.5462: φωτισμός FWTISMO/S phōtismós fo-tis-mos' from G5461; illumination (figuratively):--light.
entries.5463: χαίρω XAI/RW chaírō khah'-ee-ro a primary verb; to be "cheer"ful, i.e. calmly happy or well-off; impersonally, especially as salutation (on meeting or parting), be well:--farewell, be glad, God speed, greeting, hall, joy(- fully), rejoice.
entries.5464: χάλαζα XA/LAZA chálaza khal'-ad-zah probably from G5465; hail:--hail.
entries.5465: χαλάω XALA/W chaláō khal-ah'-o from the base of G5490; to lower (as into a void):--let down, strike.
entries.5466: Χαλδαῖος *XALDAI=OS Chaldaîos khal-dah'-yos probably of Hebrew or (H03778); a Chaldæan (i.e. Kasdi), or native or the region of the lower Euphrates:--Chaldæan.
entries.5467: χαλεπός XALEPO/S chalepós khal-ep-os' perhaps from G5465 through the idea of reducing the strength; difficult, i.e. dangerous, or (by implication) furious:--fierce, perilous.
entries.5468: χαλιναγωγέω XALINAGWGE/W chalinagōgéō khal-in-ag-ogue-eh'-o from a compound of G5469 and the reduplicated form of G71; to be a bit-leader, i.e. to curb (figuratively):--bridle.
entries.5469: χαλινός XALINO/S chalinós khal-ee-nos' from G5465; a curb or head-stall (as curbing the spirit):--bit, bridle.
entries.5470: χάλκεος XA/LKEOS chálkeos khal'-keh-os from G5475; coppery:--brass.
entries.5471: χαλκεύς XALKEU/S chalkeús khalk-yooce' from G5475; a copper-worker or brazier:--coppersmith.
entries.5472: χαλκηδών XALKHDW/N chalkēdṓn khal-kay-dohn' from G5475 and perhaps G1491; copper-like, i.e. "chalcedony":--chalcedony.
entries.5473: χαλκίον XALKI/ON chalkíon khal-kee'-on diminutive from G5475; a copper dish:--brazen vessel.
entries.5474: χαλκολίβανον XALKOLI/BANON chalkolíbanon khal-kol-ib'-an-on neuter of a compound of G5475 and G3030 (in the implied mean of whiteness or brilliancy); burnished copper, an alloy of copper (or gold) and silver having a brilliant lustre:--fine brass.
entries.5475: χαλκός XALKO/S chalkós khal-kos' perhaps from G5465 through the idea of hollowing out as a vessel (this metal being chiefly used for that purpose); copper (the substance, or some implement or coin made of it):--brass, money.
entries.5476: χαμαί XAMAI/ chamaí kham-ah'-ee adverb perhaps from the base of G5490 through the idea of a fissure in the soil; earthward, i.e. prostrate:--on (to) the ground.
entries.5477: Χαναάν *XANAA/N Chanaán khan-ah-an' of Hebrew origin (H03667); Chanaan (i.e. Kenaan), the early name of Palestine:--Chanaan.
entries.5478: Χανααναῖος *XANAANAI=OS Chanaanaîos khan-ah-an-ah'-yos from G5477; a Chanaanæan (i.e. Kenaanite), or native of gentile Palestine:--of Canaan.
entries.5479: χαρά XARA/ chará khar-ah' from G5463; cheerfulness, i.e. calm delight:--gladness, X greatly, (X be exceeding) joy(-ful, -fully, -fulness, -ous).
entries.5480: χάραγμα XA/RAGMA cháragma khar'-ag-mah from the same as G5482; a scratch or etching, i.e. stamp (as a badge of servitude), or sculptured figure (statue):--graven, mark.
entries.5481: χαρακτήρ XARAKTH/R charaktḗr khar-ak-tare' from the same as G5482; a graver (the tool or the person), i.e. (by implication) engraving (("character"), the figure stamped, i.e. an exact copy or (figuratively) representation):--express image.
entries.5482: χάραξ XA/RAC chárax khar'-ax from χαράσσω XARA/SSW charássō (to sharpen to a point; akin to G1125 through the idea of scratching); a stake, i.e. (by implication) a palisade or rampart (military mound for circumvallation in a siege):--trench.
entries.5483: χαρίζομαι XARI/ZOMAI charízomai khar-id'-zom-ahee middle voice from G5485; to grant as a favor, i.e. gratuitously, in kindness, pardon or rescue:--deliver, (frankly) forgive, (freely) give, grant.
entries.5484: χάριν XA/RIN chárin khar'-in accusative case of G5485 as preposition; through favor of, i.e. on account of:--be-(for) cause of, for sake of, +…fore, X reproachfully.
entries.5485: χάρις XA/RIS cháris khar'-ece from G5463; graciousness (as gratifying), of manner or act (abstract or concrete; literal, figurative or spiritual; especially the divine influence upon the heart, and its reflection in the life; including gratitude):--acceptable, benefit, favour, gift, grace(- ious), joy, liberality, pleasure, thank(-s, -worthy).
entries.5486: χάρισμα XA/RISMA chárisma khar'-is-mah from G5483; a (divine) gratuity, i.e. deliverance (from danger or passion); (specially), a (spiritual) endowment, i.e. (subjectively) religious qualification, or (objectively) miraculous faculty:--(free) gift.
entries.5487: χαριτόω XARITO/W charitóō khar-ee-to'-o from G5485; to grace, i.e. indue with special honor:--make accepted, be highly favoured.
entries.5488: Χαῤῥάν *XAR)R(A/N Charrhán khar-hran' of Hebrew origin (H02771); Charrhan (i.e. Charan), a place in Mesopotamia:--Charran.
entries.5489: χάρτης XA/RTHS chártēs khar'-tace from the same as G5482; a sheet ("chart") of writing-material (as to be scribbled over):--paper.
entries.5490: χάσμα XA/SMA chásma khas'-mah from a form of an obsolete primary χάω XA/W cháō (to "gape" or "yawn"); a "chasm" or vacancy (impassable interval):--gulf.
entries.5491: χεῖλος XEI=LOS cheîlos khi'-los from a form of the same as G5490; a lip (as a pouring place); figuratively, a margin (of water):--lip, shore.
entries.5492: χειμάζω XEIMA/ZW cheimázō khi-mad'-zo from the same as G5494; to storm, i.e. (passively) to labor under a gale:--be tossed with tempest.
entries.5493: χείμαῤῥος XEI/MAR)R(OS cheímarrhos khi'-mar-hros from the base of G5494 and G4482; a storm-runlet, i.e. winter-torrent:--brook.
entries.5494: χειμών XEIMW/N cheimṓn khi-mone' from a derivative of χέω XE/W chéō (to pour; akin to the base of 5490 through the idea of a channel), meaning a storm (as pouring rain); by implication, the rainy season, i.e. winter:--tempest, foul weather, winter.
entries.5495: χείρ XEI/R cheír khire perhaps from the base of G5494 in the sense of its congener the base of G5490 (through the idea of hollowness for grasping); the hand (literally or figuratively (power); especially (by Hebraism) a means or instrument):--hand.
entries.5496: χειραγωγέω XEIRAGWGE/W cheiragōgéō khi-rag-ogue-eh'-o from G5497; to be a hand-leader, i.e. to guide (a blind person):--lead by the hand.
entries.5497: χειραγωγός XEIRAGWGO/S cheiragōgós khi-rag-o-gos' from G5495 and a reduplicated form of G71; a hand-leader, i.e. personal conductor (of a blind person):--some to lead by the hand.
entries.5498: χειρόγραφον XEIRO/GRAFON cheirógraphon khi-rog'-raf-on neuter of a compound of G5495 and G1125; something hand-written ("chirograph"), i.e. a manuscript (specially, a legal document or bond (figuratively)):--handwriting.
entries.5499: χειροποίητος XEIROPOI/HTOS cheiropoíētos khi-rop-oy'-ay-tos from G5495 and a derivative of G4160; manufactured, i.e. of human construction:--made by (make with) hands.
entries.5500: χειροτονέω XEIROTONE/W cheirotonéō khi-rot-on-eh'-o from a compound of G5495 and τείνω TEI/NW teínō (to stretch); to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e. (generally) to select or appoint:--choose, ordain.
entries.5501: χείρων XEI/RWN cheírōn khi'-rone irregular comparative of G2556; from an obsolete equivalent χέρης XE/RHS chérēs (of uncertain derivation); more evil or aggravated (physically, mentally or morally):--sorer, worse.
entries.5502: χερουβίμ XEROUBI/M cheroubím kher-oo-beem' plural of Hebrew origin (H03742); "cherubim" (i.e. cherubs or kerubim):--cherubims.
entries.5503: χήρα XH/RA chḗra khay'-rah feminine of a presumed derivative apparently from the base of G5490 through the idea of deficiency; a widow (as lacking a husband), literally or figuratively:--widow.
entries.5504: χθές XQE/S chthés khthes of uncertain derivation; "yesterday"; by extension, in time past or hitherto:--yesterday.
entries.5505: χιλιάς XILIA/S chiliás khil-ee-as' from G5507; one thousand ("chiliad"):--thousand.
entries.5506: χιλίαρχος XILI/ARXOS chilíarchos khil-ee'-ar-khos from G5507 and G757; the commander of a thousand soldiers ("chiliarch"; i.e. colonel:--(chief, high) captain.
entries.5507: χίλιοι XI/LIOI chílioi khil'-ee-oy plural of uncertain affinity; a thousand:--thousand.
entries.5508: Χίος *XI/OS Chíos khee'-os of uncertain derivation; Chios, an island in the Mediterranean:--Chios.
entries.5509: χιτών XITW/N chitṓn khee-tone' of foreign origin (H03801); a tunic or shirt:--clothes, coat, garment.
entries.5510: χιών XIW/N chiṓn khee-one' perhaps akin to the base of G5490 (G5465) or G5494 (as descending or empty); snow:--snow.
entries.5511: χλαμύς XLAMU/S chlamýs khlam-ooce' of uncertain derivation; a military cloak:--robe.
entries.5512: χλευάζω XLEUA/ZW chleuázō khlyoo-ad'-zo from a derivative probably of G5491; to throw out the lip, i.e. jeer at:--mock.
entries.5513: χλιαρός XLIARO/S chliarós khlee-ar-os' from χλίω XLI/W chlíō (to warm); tepid:--lukewarm.
entries.5514: Χλόη *XLO/H Chlóē khlo'-ay feminine of apparently a primary word; "green"; Chloë, a Christian female:--Chloe.
entries.5515: χλωρός XLWRO/S chlōrós khlo-ros' from the same as G5514; greenish, i.e. verdant, dun-colored:--green, pale.
entries.5516: χξϛ XC#2 chx stigma khee xee stig'-ma the 22nd, 14th and an obsolete letter (G4742 as a cross) of the Greek alphabet (intermediate between the 5th and 6th), used as numbers; denoting respectively 600, 60 and 6; 666 as a numeral:--six hundred threescore and six.
entries.5517: χοϊκός XOI+KO/S choïkós kho-ik-os' from G5522; dusty or dirty (soil-like), i.e. (by implication) terrene:--earthy.
entries.5518: χοῖνιξ XOI=NIC choînix khoy'-nix of uncertain derivation; a chœnix or certain dry measure:--measure.
entries.5519: χοῖρος XOI=ROS choîros khoy'-ros of uncertain derivation; a hog:--swine.
entries.5520: χολάω XOLA/W choláō khol-ah'-o from G5521; to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric"):--be angry.
entries.5521: χολή XOLH/ cholḗ khol-ay' feminine of an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as G5514 (from the greenish hue); "gall" or bile, i.e. (by analogy) poison or an anodyne (wormwood, poppy, etc.):--gall.
entries.5522: χόος XO/OS chóos kho'-os from the base of G5494; a heap (as poured out), i.e. rubbish; loose dirt:--dust.
entries.5523: Χοραζίν *XORAZI/N Chorazín khor-ad-zin' of uncertain derivation; Chorazin, a place in Palestine:--Chorazin.
entries.5524: χορηγέω XORHGE/W chorēgéō khor-ayg-eh'-o from a compound of G5525 and G71; to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish:--give, minister.
entries.5525: χορός XORO/S chorós khor-os' of uncertain derivation; a ring, i.e. round dance ("choir":--dancing.
entries.5526: χορτάζω XORTA/ZW chortázō khor-tad'-zo from G5528; to fodder, i.e. (generally) to gorge (supply food in abundance):--feed, fill, satisfy.
entries.5527: χόρτασμα XO/RTASMA chórtasma khor'-tas-mah from G5526; forage, i.e. food:--sustenance.
entries.5528: χόρτος XO/RTOS chórtos khor'-tos apparently a primary word; a "court" or "garden", i.e. (by implication, of pasture) herbage or vegetation:--blade, grass, hay.
entries.5529: Χουζᾶς *XOUZA=S Chouzâs khood-zas' of uncertain origin; Chuzas, an officer of Herod:--Chuza.
entries.5530: χράομαι XRA/OMAI chráomai khrah'-om-ahee middle voice of a primary verb (perhaps rather from G5495, to handle); to furnish what is needed; (give an oracle, "graze" (touch slightly), light upon, etc.), i.e. (by implication) to employ or (by extension) to act towards one in a given manner:--entreat, use. Compare G5531; G5534.
entries.5531: χράω XRA/W chráō khrah'-o probably the same as the base of G5530; to loan:--lend.
entries.5532: χρεία XREI/A chreía khri'-ah from the base of G5530 or G5534; employment, i.e. an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution:--business, lack, necessary(-ity), need(-ful), use, want.
entries.5533: χρεωφειλέτης XREWFEILE/THS chreōpheilétēs khreh-o-fi-let'-ace from a derivative of G5531 and G3781; a loan-ower, i.e. indebted person:--debtor.
entries.5534: χρή XRH/ chrḗ khray third person singular of the same as G5530 or G5531 used impersonally; it needs (must or should) be:--ought.
entries.5535: χρῄζω XRH/|ZW chrḗizō khrade'-zo from G5532; to make (i.e. have) necessity, i.e. be in want of:--(have) need.
entries.5536: χρῆμα XRH=MA chrēma khray'-mah something useful or needed, i.e. wealth, price:--money, riches.
entries.5537: χρηματίζω XRHMATI/ZW chrēmatízō khray-mat-id'-zo from G5536; to utter an oracle (compare the original sense of G5530), i.e. divinely intimate; by implication, (compare the secular sense of G5532) to constitute a firm for business, i.e. (generally) bear as a title:--be called, be admonished (warned) of God, reveal, speak.
entries.5538: χρηματισμός XRHMATISMO/S chrēmatismós khray-mat-is-mos' from G5537; a divine response or revelation:--answer of God.
entries.5539: χρήσιμος XRH/SIMOS chrḗsimos khray'-see-mos from G5540; serviceable:--profit.
entries.5540: χρῆσις XRH=SIS chrēsis khray'-sis from G5530; employment, i.e. (specially), sexual intercourse (as an occupation of the body):--use.
entries.5541: χρηστεύομαι XRHSTEU/OMAI chrēsteúomai khraste-yoo'-om-ahee middle voice from G5543; to show oneself useful, i.e. act benevolently:--be kind.
entries.5542: χρηστολογία XRHSTOLOGI/A chrēstología khrase-tol-og-ee'-ah from a compound of G5543 and G3004; fair speech, i.e. plausibility:--good words.
entries.5543: χρηστός XRHSTO/S chrēstós khrase-tos' from G5530; employed, i.e. (by implication) useful (in manner or morals):--better, easy, good(-ness), gracious, kind.
entries.5544: χρηστότης XRHSTO/THS chrēstótēs khray-stot'-ace from G5543; usefulness, i.e. morally, excellence (in character or demeanor):--gentleness, good(-ness), kindness.
entries.5545: χρῖσμα XRI=SMA chrîsma khris'-mah from G5548; an unguent or smearing, i.e. (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the Holy Spirit:--anointing, unction.
entries.5546: Χριστιανός *XRISTIANO/S Christianós khris-tee-an-os' from G5547; a Christian, i.e. follower of Christ:--Christian.
entries.5547: Χριστός *XRISTO/S Christós khris-tos' from G5548; anointed, i.e. the Messiah, an epithet of Jesus:--Christ.
entries.5548: χρίω XRI/W chríō khree'-o probably akin to G5530 through the idea of contact; to smear or rub with oil, i.e. (by implication) to consecrate to an office or religious service:--anoint.
entries.5549: χρονίζω XRONI/ZW chronízō khron-id'-zo from G5550; to take time, i.e. linger:--delay, tarry.
entries.5550: χρόνος XRO/NOS chrónos khron'-os of uncertain derivation; a space of time (in general, and thus properly distinguished from G2540, which designates a fixed or special occasion; and from G165, which denotes a particular period) or interval; by extension, an individual opportunity; by implication, delay:--+ years old, season, space, (X often-)time(-s), (a) while.
entries.5551: χρονοτριβέω XRONOTRIBE/W chronotribéō khron-ot-rib-eh'-o from a presumed compound of G5550 and the base of G5147; to be a time-wearer, i.e. to procrastinate (linger):--spend time.
entries.5552: χρύσεος XRU/SEOS chrýseos khroo'-seh-os from G5557; made of gold:--of gold, golden.
entries.5553: χρυσίον XRUSI/ON chrysíon khroo-see'-on diminutive of G5557; a golden article, i.e. gold plating, ornament, or coin:--gold.
entries.5554: χρυσοδακτύλιος XRUSODAKTU/LIOS chrysodaktýlios khroo-sod-ak-too'-lee-os from G5557 and G1146; gold-ringed, i.e. wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry:--with a gold ring.
entries.5555: χρυσόλιθος XRUSO/LIQOS chrysólithos khroo-sol'-ee-thos from G5557 and G3037; gold-stone, i.e. a yellow gem ("chrysolite"):--chrysolite.
entries.5556: χρυσόπρασος XRUSO/PRASOS chrysóprasos khroo-sop'-ras-os from G5557 and πράσον PRA/SON práson (a leek); a greenish-yellow gem ("chrysoprase"):--chrysoprase.
entries.5557: χρυσός XRUSO/S chrysós khroo-sos' perhaps from the base of G5530 (through the idea of the utility of the metal); gold; by extension, a golden article, as an ornament or coin:--gold.
entries.5558: χρυσόω XRUSO/W chrysóō khroo-so'-o from G5557; to gild, i.e. bespangle with golden ornaments:--deck.
entries.5559: χρώς XRW/S chrṓs khroce probably akin to the base of G5530 through the idea of handling; the body (properly, its surface or skin):--body.
entries.5560: χωλός XWLO/S chōlós kho-los' apparently a primary word; "halt", i.e. limping:--cripple, halt, lame.
entries.5561: χώρα XW/RA chṓra kho'-rah feminine of a derivative of the base of G5490 through the idea of empty expanse; room, i.e. a space of territory (more or less extensive; often including its inhabitants):--coast, county, fields, ground, land, region. Compare G5117.
entries.5562: χωρέω XWRE/W chōréō kho-reh'-o from G5561; to be in (give) space, i.e. (intransitively) to pass, enter, or (transitively) to hold, admit (literally or figuratively):--come, contain, go, have place, (can, be room to) receive.
entries.5563: χωρίζω XWRI/ZW chōrízō kho-rid'-zo from G5561; to place room between, i.e. part; reflexively, to go away:--depart, put asunder, separate.
entries.5564: χωρίον XWRI/ON chōríon kho-ree'-on diminutive of G5561; a spot or plot of ground:--field, land, parcel of ground, place, possession.
entries.5565: χωρίς XWRI/S chōrís kho-rece' adverb from G5561; at a space, i.e. separately or apart from (often as preposition):--beside, by itself, without.
entries.5566: χῶρος XW=ROS chōros kho'-ros of Latin origin; the north-west wind:--north west.
entries.5567: ψάλλω YA/LLW psállō psal'-lo probably strengthened from ψάω YA/W psáō (to rub or touch the surface; compare G5597); to twitch or twang, i.e. to play on a stringed instrument (celebrate the divine worship with music and accompanying odes):--make melody, sing (psalms).
entries.5568: ψαλμός YALMO/S psalmós psal-mos' from G5567; a set piece of music, i.e. a sacred ode (accompanied with the voice, harp or other instrument; a "psalm"); collectively, the book of the Psalms:--psalm. Compare G5603.
entries.5569: ψευδάδελφος YEUDA/DELFOS pseudádelphos psyoo-dad'-el-fos from G5571 and G80; a spurious brother, i.e. pretended associate:--false brethren.
entries.5570: ψευδαπόστολος YEUDAPO/STOLOS pseudapóstolos psyoo-dap-os'-tol-os from G5571 and G652; a spurious apostle, i.e. pretended pracher:--false teacher.
entries.5571: ψευδής YEUDH/S pseudḗs psyoo-dace' from G5574; untrue, i.e. erroneous, deceitful, wicked:--false, liar.
entries.5572: ψευδοδιδάσκαλος YEUDODIDA/SKALOS pseudodidáskalos psyoo-dod-id-as'-kal-os from G5571 and G1320; a spurious teacher, i.e. propagator of erroneous Christian doctrine:--false teacher.
entries.5573: ψευδολόγος YEUDOLO/GOS pseudológos psyoo-dol-og'-os from G5571 and G3004; mendacious, i.e. promulgating erroneous Christian doctrine:--speaking lies.
entries.5574: ψεύδομαι YEU/DOMAI pseúdomai psyoo'-dom-ahee middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to utter an untruth or attempt to deceive by falsehood:--falsely, lie.
entries.5575: ψευδομάρτυρ YEUDOMA/RTUR pseudomártyr psyoo-dom-ar'-toor from G5571 and a kindred form of G3144; a spurious witness, i.e. bearer of untrue testimony:--false witness.
entries.5576: ψευδομαρτυρέω YEUDOMARTURE/W pseudomartyréō psyoo-dom-ar-too-reh'-o from G5575; to be an untrue testifier, i.e. offer falsehood in evidence:--be a false witness.
entries.5577: ψευδομαρτυρία YEUDOMARTURI/A pseudomartyría psyoo-dom-ar-too-ree'-ah from G5575; untrue testimony:--false witness.
entries.5578: ψευδοπροφήτης YEUDOPROFH/THS pseudoprophḗtēs psyoo-dop-rof-ay'-tace from G5571 and G4396; a spurious prophet, i.e. pretended foreteller or religious impostor:--false prophet.
entries.5579: ψεῦδος YEU=DOS pseûdos psyoo'-dos from G5574; a falsehood:--lie, lying.
entries.5580: ψευδόχριστος YEUDO/XRISTOS pseudóchristos psyoo-dokh'-ris-tos from G5571 and G5547; a spurious Messiah:--false Christ.
entries.5581: ψευδώνυμος YEUDW/NUMOS pseudṓnymos psyoo-do'-noo-mos from G5571 and G3686; untruly named:--falsely so called.
entries.5582: ψεῦσμα YEU=SMA pseûsma psyoos'-mah from G5574; a fabrication, i.e. falsehood:--lie.
entries.5583: ψεύστης YEU/STHS pseústēs psyoos-tace' from G5574; a falsifier:--liar.
entries.5584: ψηλαφάω YHLAFA/W psēlapháō psay-laf-ah'-o from the base of G5567 (compare G5586); to manipulate, i.e. verify by contact; figuratively, to search for:--feel after, handle, touch.
entries.5585: ψηφίζω YHFI/ZW psēphízō psay-fid'-zo from G5586; to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e. (generally) to compute:--count.
entries.5586: ψῆφος YH=FOS psēphos psay'-fos from the same as G5584; a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e. (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote:--stone, voice.
entries.5587: ψιθυρισμός YIQURISMO/S psithyrismós psith-oo-ris-mos' from a derivative of ψίθος YI/QOS psíthos (a whisper; by implication, a slander; probably akin to G5574); whispering, i.e. secret detraction:--whispering.
entries.5588: ψιθυριστής YIQURISTH/S psithyristḗs psith-oo-ris-tace' from the same as G5587; a secret calumniator:--whisperer.
entries.5589: ψιχίον YIXI/ON psichíon psikh-ee'-on diminutive from a derivative of the base of G5567 (meaning a crumb); a little bit or morsel:--crumb.
entries.5590: ψυχή YUXH/ psychḗ psoo-khay' from G5594; breath, i.e. (by implication) spirit, abstractly or concretely (the animal sentient principle only; thus distinguished on the one hand from G4151, which is the rational and immortal soul; and on the other from G2222, which is mere vitality, even of plants: these terms thus exactly correspond respectively to the Hebrew H05315, H07307 and H02416):--heart (+ -ily), life, mind, soul, + us, + you.
entries.5591: ψυχικός YUXIKO/S psychikós psoo-khee-kos' from G5590; sensitive, i.e. animate (in distinction on the one hand from G4152, which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from G5446, which is the lower or bestial nature):--natural, sensual.
entries.5592: ψύχος YU/XOS psýchos psoo'-khos from G5594; coolness:--cold.
entries.5593: ψυχρός YUXRO/S psychrós psoo-chros' from G5592; chilly (literally or figuratively):--cold.
entries.5594: ψύχω YU/XW psýchō psoo'-kho a primary verb; to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from G4154, which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of G109, which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e. (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively):--wax cold.
entries.5595: ψωμίζω YWMI/ZW psōmízō pso-mid'-zo from the base of G5596; to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish:--(bestow to) feed.
entries.5596: ψωμίον YWMI/ON psōmíon pso-mee'-on diminutive from a derivative of the base of G5597; a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful:--sop.
entries.5597: ψώχω YW/XW psṓchō pso'-kho prolongation from the same base as G5567; to triturate, i.e. (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand):--rub.
entries.5598: Ω *W Ō o'-meg-ah the last letter of the Greek alphabet, i.e. (figuratively) the finality:--Omega.
entries.5599: ὦ W)= ō o a primary interjection; as a sign of the vocative case, O; as a note of exclamation, oh:--O.
entries.5600: ὦ W)= ō o , including the oblique forms, as well as ἦς H)=S ēs ace ; ἦ H)= ē ay ; etc. the subjunctive of G1510; (may, might, can, could, would, should, must, etc.; also with G1487 and its compounds, as well as with other particles) be:--+ appear, are, (may, might, should) be, X have, is, + pass the flower of her age, should stand, were.
entries.5601: Ὠβήδ *)WBH/D Ōbḗd o-bade' of Hebrew origin (H05744); Obed, an Israelite:--Obed.
entries.5602: ὧδε W(=DE hōde ho'-deh from an adverb form of G3592; in this same spot, i.e. here or hither:--here, hither, (in) this place, there.
entries.5603: ᾠδή W)|DH/ ōidḗ o-day' from G103; a chant or "ode" (the general term for any words sung; while G5215 denotes especially a religious metrical composition, and G5568 still more specially, a Hebrew cantillation):--song.
entries.5604: ὠδίν W)DI/N ōdín o-deen' akin to G3601; a pang or throe, especially of childbirth:--pain, sorrow, travail.
entries.5605: ὠδίνω W)DI/NW ōdínō o-dee'-no from G5604; to experience the pains of parturition (literally or figuratively):--travail in (birth).
entries.5606: ὦμος W)=MOS ōmos o'-mos perhaps from the alternate of G5342; the shoulder (as that on which burdens are borne):--shoulder.
entries.5607: ὤν W)/N ṓn oan , including the feminine οὖσα OU)=SA oûsa oo'-sah ; and the neuter ὄν O)/N ón on present participle of G1510; being:--be, come, have.
entries.5608: ὠνέομαι W)NE/OMAI ōnéomai o-neh'-om-ahee middle voice from an apparently primary ὦνος W)=NOS ōnos (a sum or price); to purchase (synonymous with the earlier G4092):-- buy.
entries.5609: ὠόν W)O/N ōón o-on' apparently a primary word; an "egg":--egg.
entries.5610: ὥρα W(/RA hṓra ho'-rah apparently a primary word; an "hour" (literally or figuratively):--day, hour, instant, season, X short, (even-)tide, (high) time.
entries.5611: ὡραῖος W(RAI=OS hōraîos ho-rah'-yos from G5610; belonging to the right hour or season (timely), i.e. (by implication) flourishing (beauteous (figuratively)):--beautiful.
entries.5612: ὠρύομαι W)RU/OMAI ōrýomai o-roo'-om-ahee middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to "roar":--roar.
entries.5613: ὡς W(S hōs hoce probably adverb of comparative from G3739; which how, i.e. in that manner (very variously used, as follows):--about, after (that), (according) as (it had been, it were), as soon (as), even as (like), for, how (greatly), like (as, unto), since, so (that), that, to wit, unto, when(-soever), while, X with all speed.
entries.5614: ὡσαννά W(SANNA/ hōsanná ho-san-nah' of Hebrew origin (H03467 and H04994); oh save!; hosanna (i.e. hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration:--hosanna.
entries.5615: ὡσαύτως W(SAU/TWS hōsaútōs ho-sow'-toce from G5613 and an adverb from G846; as thus, i.e. in the same way:--even so, likewise, after the same (in like) manner.
entries.5616: ὡσεί W(SEI/ hōseí ho-si' from G5613 and G1487; as if:--about, as (it had been, it were), like (as).
entries.5617: Ὡσηέ *(WSHE/ Hōsēé ho-say-eh' of Hebrew origin (H01954); Hosee (i.e. Hoshea), an Israelite:--Osee.
entries.5618: ὥσπερ W(/SPER hṓsper hoce'-per from G5613 and G4007; just as, i.e. exactly like:--(even, like) as.
entries.5619: ὡσπερεί W(SPEREI/ hōspereí hoce-per-i' from G5618 and G1487; just as if, i.e. as it were:--as.
entries.5620: ὥστε W(/STE hṓste hoce'-teh from G5613 and G5037; so too, i.e. thus therefore (in various relations of consecution, as follow):--(insomuch) as, so that (then), (insomuch) that, therefore, to, wherefore.
entries.5621: ὠτίον W)TI/ON ōtíon o-tee'-on diminutive of G3775; an earlet, i.e. one of the ears, or perhaps the lobe of the ear:--ear.
entries.5622: ὠφέλεια W)FE/LEIA ōphéleia o-fel'-i-ah from a derivative of the base of G5624; usefulness, i.e. benefit:--advantage, profit.
entries.5623: ὠφελέω W)FELE/W ōpheléō o-fel-eh'-o from the same as G5622; to be useful, i.e. to benefit:--advantage, better, prevail, profit.
entries.5624: ὠφέλιμος W)FE/LIMOS ōphélimos o-fel'-ee-mos from a form of G3786; helpful or serviceable, i.e. advantageous:--profit(-able).
